Boba Fett discovered that Assemblers evolved from Nodes who killed their old master to take their place, sometimes through consumption of their creator. Two Assemblers named in galactic history were Kud'ar Mub'at and Balancesheet, the masterminds who acted as a go-between for criminal organizations and potential employees. Assemblers absorbed all particles that floated by them that were not valuable, such as dust and space debris. No further information on the Assembler's biology, such as how they digest food, was known. They had four legs and two strange claws that acted as either hands or extra feet. In addition, Assemblers had strange furry appendages which grew on their backs, probably for absorbing food. Counting these, Assemblers had twelve appendages. These factors produced several psychological factors within the Assemblers as a species. One would be that they tended to be possessive creatures and would on occasion act as scavengers should anything be trapped in their web. These items would be used to enhance the Assemblers webs performance in someway. Another aspect of their behavior would be that an Assembler would often be jealous of its nodes and would actively try to limit their intelligence and prevent them from becoming sentient. [[File:MubatFett-TERC.jpg|thumb|left]] Assemblers were connected to their webs by neurofibers, and the webs were connected to the Nodes in the same way. Kud'ar Mub'at had many Nodes to carry out day-to-day things. "Lookout" gazed through his single-lens eye to view the web's exterior, looking for problems and such. Calculator was much like a computer, interpreting data, and Identifier identified objects, ships, and people to see if they were valuable, dangerous, or not. Three nodes worked in Mu'bat's docking bay: Signaler guided ships in by waving his hands and with his glowing green eye, while Docker and Handler secured ships to the web with their tentacles. Listener heard sounds around the web with his tympanic membranes, and Balancesheet worked with Calculator to maintain Mu'bat's finances. It was Balancesheet that eventually rebelled against its creator, having reached the level of sentience where a node began to want to become the next Assembler. However, it was important for these nodes to remain useful to the primary Assembler as those that had no function would easily be re-ingested so that vital genetic information can be saved and reused for later use. Balancesheet appears, however, to have learned the lesson that his parent failed to learn fast enough, choosing to operate a freighter sold to him by Black Sun instead of relying on his own creations, which creates the risk of those creations revolting. An interesting facet of the species was that should an Assembler be killed but still possessed its body then it was possible to resurrect it. This required the application of a power to the web of the Assembler and the restoration of certain parts of the web to allow for memory to be 'remembered'. Boba Fett was able to do this with a pulsator and the Hound's Tooth around 4 ABY.

name: Assimilator
summary: The Assimilators were powerful cyborg warriors created by the Arkanians.
distinctions: Ability to assimilate the body parts of organics and droids, self-repair, and upgrade themselves.

name: Assorhian
summary: The Assorhians were the native sentient species of Assorhan.

name: Astrigia
summary: The astrigia were a species of fierce swooping predator with large eyes. They lived in the forests of steepara trees that covered the planet Dressel, and posed a constant threat to the sentient Dressellian species who shared the planet with them.

name: Asyyyriak
summary: Asyyyriaks were vicious arboreal creatures native to Kashyyyk. They spent most of their time high above the forest floor, using branches to travel among the trees. The brown-skinned body of an asyyyriak was covered entirely with long, brown and green hair, useful for camouflage among the stringy forest moss. Adult asyyyriaks averaged one to two meters in length. Asyyyriaks were great hunters, preying primarily upon avians and small arboreal animals. During the Kashyyyk's cold season, asyyyriaks hibernated; however, they stalked the forests during the warmer seasons, sometimes attacking vulnerable young Wookiees.
distinctions: 4 toed feet with razor sharp claws

name: At Attin frogdog
summary: The At Attin frogdog was a type of quadrupedal frog-dog from the planet At Attin. Inquisitive and loyal, they were kept as pets, and during the New Republic Era, the Ithorian Misses Ikk owned one and walked him on a leash. Two days in a row, the child Wim rushed past the pair, causing the frogdog to begin barking. The frogdog also barked at a pirate frigate that arrived on At Attin to take control of the world.

name: Atele
summary: Ateles were type of hooting bird that could be found in the Outer Rim planet Akiva's Canyon of Akar. While visiting the planet Kashyyyk in 5 ABY, the Akivan native and pilot Norra Wexley considered the relative silence of the world, comparing it to the noises made by Akiva's fauna, including ateles in the Canyon of Akar.

name: Atoan
summary: Atoans were a sentient Near-Human species from the Atoan system.

name: Atriik
summary: The Atriik were a sentient species known to exist during the time of the Clone Wars. Members of the species possessed horns on the sides of their heads and mottled skin. One Atriik was Mother Tunenep, a follower of the Path of the Open Hand. She lived to be more than 150 years old, an advanced age even for the Atriik.
distinctions: Horns protruding from the sides of the face

name: Atterran
summary: The Atterran were a race of pale-skinned humans that inhabit the planet Atterra Bravo. Casca Panzoro was an Atterran.

name: Atzerrian Meek
summary: The Meeks were a furry species native to Atzerri that stood on two hind legs. They were related to the moochers of Abregado-rae. They foraged through the trash on the Free Trader planet.

name: Aucfan
summary: Aucfans were small rodent-like creatures considered to be vermin. They had green skin, two large sharp ears and two red eyes. These creatures sometimes entered into cargo containers of spaceports or warehouses and had troubled the employees.

name: Aurean vulture
summary: Aurean vultures were a large non-sentient, avian species of vulture native to the planet Aurea. Possessing wings of over 4 meters in length, they lived in the planet's deserts where they stayed adrift on warm updrafts until, using their brilliant eye sight, they spotted prey. The vultures will then pursue their target as a flock, for days at a time if necessary, after which, at the height of day, they swoop down at the angle of the sun to attack. They use the sun in the hope that their prey, which could include sentients, would be blinded and unable to fight back effectively. Aurean vultures would use their beaks and talons to attack.

name: Aurra Sing's father's species
summary: This species had chalk white skin, sunken black eye sockets, and fingers with one more joint than a Human finger. Their long fingers were used for drawing blood. The lifespan of this species was much longer than that of a human. Aurra Sing's father was a member of this species. The species of Aurra Sing's father was speculated by the people that she worked for to have been Qiraash, Rattataki, Umbaran, or even Anzati, despite the fact that none of these could interbreed with Humans.

name: Averist
summary: Averists were the natives of the planet Averam.

name: Avka
summary: The avka was a large avian predator native to the planet Durace in the Unknown Regions.

name: Avogwi
summary: Avogwi were a sentient species of predatory birds native to Altor 14, which was also home to the Nuiwit. Except for their muscular, scale-covered legs, their bodies were covered in orange feathers, which camouflaged them against Altor's orange skies. Adult Avogwi had a wingspan of four to five meters. They had three fingers at the joint of each wing, which served as hands when not in flight. Avogwi viewed the Nuiwit as merely another prey species, though tastier than most. They reacted violently to suggestions that the two species evolved from a common ancestor. Due to their entirely carnivorous diet and clumsy hands, Avogwi society was relatively primitive, based solely on hunting and water gathering. Avogwi were not very social, living in mated pairs which would claim about fifty square kilometers as their exclusive territory. They also had very little technology, and distrusted that of other species. Despite this, they had developed a complex philosophy based on the teachings of the legendary hero Toro-toral, said to be the first Avogwi to fly. The basic tenets of this philosophy were that all creatures that wanted to live must kill, and that all creatures that would not kill would die so that others could live. The sayings of Toro-toral were repeated by the Avogwi at their only large-scale gatherings: ceremonial duels to the death to determine the Avogwi leader, or Avog. Avogwi had little to trade to the rest of the galaxy other than mineral rights to the territory surrounding their aeries. This, they refused to do, as they were unable to understand why offworlders would trade them anything useful in exchange for anything the Avogwi owned, unless it was to make the Avogwi weaker. Since their Nuiwit neighbors were willing to trade, and their cities and farms continued to expand and drive Avogwi out of their hunting grounds, the Avogwi did not prosper when the Rego Mineral Company contacted Altor 14 in 15 BBY. Some, unable to find aeries of their own, went offworld, where they found work as bounty hunters, assassins, or similar violent occupations. An Avogwi worked as the port boss at Mud Station on Shador. Another well-known Avogwi was Nevid d'Hon, an outfitter on Ord Mantell.
distinctions: Large predatory birds, bright orange feathers

name: Avoni
summary: The Avoni were the indigenous species of Avon. In 27 BBY, the Avoni attempted to conquer Radnor after a bioplague struck the planet, which resulted in death followed by evacuation. They sent Dol Heep, the ambassador of Avon, to conquer the planet when everyone was gone from Radnor.

name: Avrac Kefundee's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Avrac Kefundee was a member of this species.

name: Avril
summary: The avril, native to the moon Yavin 8, was a large bird of prey. It was covered with thick black feathers and had beady eyes. Avrils also had a wingspan of about eight meters and sharp twenty-centimeter-long talons. These birds were also capable of letting out an ear-shattering cry. Avrils were on the top of the food chain on Yavin 8 and preyed on several other species including raiths, reels, purellas, though their favorite were the children of the sentient Melodies.

name: Awor
summary: Awors were large gray animals that were used by the Travelling Jindas. During the Jindas' early days with the Rock Wizard, the animals were used to till the soil, helping the Jindas farm the area. Following the Jindas' exile, the awors were still used, but only to carry the Jindas' materials. The large beasts carried the Jindas' entertainment equipment and helped them set up their entertainment shows.

name: Axaleem
summary: Axaleem was a sentient species in the galaxy. Papa Toren was a member of the species.

name: Axton-tarsier
summary: The axton-tarsiers were a non-sentient species native to the planet Ques. Those big-eyed, floppy-eared furry creatures made trilling sounds and could be kept as pets.

name: Aybarian
summary: The Aybarian were a sentient species from the Aybaria system in the Outer Rim Territories. At some point before taking back control of Cloud City, Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian played a game of Six-Card Gizka Limit against a spice-drunk Aybarian diplomat, in which he won a Rossmoyne Vitiator Pistol from the diplomat.

name: Ayo Bons' species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Ayo Bons was a member of this species.

name: Ayo Tam's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Ayo Tam was a member of this species.

name: Ayrou
summary: Ayrou were a sentient species. Kilan T'Dara—who served as chair of the advisory council for Force-related groups known as the Convocation of the Force—was an Ayrou.

name: Azumel
summary: The Azumels were a sentient six-eyed species native to Azum. Argus Panox was a member of this species.

name: Azurdactyl
summary: The azurdactyl was a two-legged aquamarine and black reptavian found on the Outer Rim planet Jagomir. The flying creatures were somewhat intelligent, a fact that members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic learned while stationed on the planet.

name: Babb
summary: The Babbs were a sentient species that were small in stature. Consequently, they were occasionally thought of in contrast to Wookiees. In 27 BBY, a number of Babbs were present on the planet Euceron, which was hosting the Galactic Games, and they were seen by the Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker on a landing pad.

name: Backshin
summary: Backshin were wild herd animals hunted by the Chevin on Vinsoth.

name: Bactriasan scarab
summary: The Bactriasan scarab was a type of beetle that originated in the Inner Rim's Bactriasa system. It produced cementing fluids. The Illiseni Aerodyne company manufactured the Hobbycraft Microweight conveyance by producing a sealer from the Bactriasan scarab cementing fluids and coating the microweight's polymer wings with it, thereby rendering them sturdier than their appearance would suggest. At some point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, an advertisement for the Hobbycraft Microweight mentioning the beetles' role in its manufacture was included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology.

name: Bafforr tree
summary: The Bafforr trees, or simply Bafforrs, were crystalline plants native to Ithor. They had blue, glassy bark—which quickly blackened upon death—and black leaves. Though unintelligent on their own, groups of Bafforrs could communicate via intertwined root systems, becoming more intelligent. Seven Bafforrs could achieve a fully sentient collective consciousness, with whole Bafforr forests being wiser than any other being known to the Ithorians. Bafforrs communicated through a form of telepathy. Imported reeks' primary diet consisted of the Bafforr tree's leaves.
designation: Semi-sentient and sentient, depending on number in group mind

name: Bageraset
summary: The bageraset was a large, herbivorous herd animal native to Corellia. It was a distant cousin of the Naboo Falumpaset. Bageraset meat was comestible. The cookbook Essential Cooking Skills detailed how to best cook that meat.

name: Bagmim
summary: The Bagmims were a sentient species from the planet Xochtl, located in the Gordian Reach.

name: Bah'r Kilido
summary: The Bah'r Kilido were a species pink-skinned humanoids with long faces and thin limbs. Their noses and chins were studded with a pair of short tusks. Suppoon was a member of this species.
distinctions: Large horns on their chins and where their nostrils should be

name: Balana thranta
summary: The Balana thranta was one of the many species of thranta that were native to the planet Alderaan and became virtually extinct upon the planet's destruction. They escaped extinction, having been exported to Bespin long ago, along with the common thranta and its cousin, the giant thranta. The Balana subspecies was distinguished from the others by its larger body that had a brownish coloration. Furthermore, the wings themselves seemed more hook-like at the front giving an appearance of hands. The tail itself was also different with the horizontal lobes being larger than the vertical ones. Like the other thranta species, the Balana thranta would be trained to serve as a form as a transportation beast and allowed an open-seated raft to be strapped on the creature's back.

name: Baldavian pocket hare
summary: Baldavian pocket hare was a species of skittish creatures. Due to its skittish nature, cowardly individuals and acts were sometimes compared to them. As a colloquialism, comparisons to Baldavian pockets hares as a symbol of cowardice were in use in 0 ABY, when the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure compared the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk to one. This comparison was still used in 25 ABY, when the Extragalactic Society scientist Danni Quee jokingly likened her colleague Yomin Carr, who was secretly a Yuuzhan Vong saboteur, to a Baldavian pocket hare for declining to join an investigatory expedition to the planet Helska IV. Around the same time, the young Jedi Anakin Solo suggested his father, Han Solo, was "too pocket hare" when he balked at flying the Asteroid belt Lando's Folly on the grounds that he was too old and sore.

name: Balinaka
summary: The Balinaka (singular, Balinak) were a species of strong, amphibious mammals native to the arctic planet Garnib. They were covered with thick fur, though they also had a dual lung/gill system which enabled them to breathe both air and water. They also had webbing between each digit and flexible, long tails. Balinaka also had excellent vision, and could see in dark conditions. Their diet consisted mostly of fish. The Balinaka shared Garnib with the Vernols. Their homeworld was extremely cold, with several continents covered by glaciers dozens of meters thick. The Balinaka carved entire underground cities called Sewfes. The Balinaka were also skilled at sculpting ice, a skill which won them fame throughout the galaxy. Balinaka were encountered often enough by Rebel SpecOps personnel to acquire the nickname "bears." In the Senex sector, Balinaka and Ossans were used as slaves by House Vandron on Karfeddion and other neighboring worlds.
distinctions: High degree of color sensitivity, flexible tail and neck

name: Ball creature of Duroon"Bouncebeast"
summary: The ball creatures of Duroon were spherical, nocturnal herbivores.

name: Ballian
summary: The Ballian were a small furry species that originated from the Balli system in the Outer Rim Territories. The brother of Maisie was a Ballian on the planet Metagos.

name: Balmorran maweater
summary: The Balmorran maweater was a creature native to an island chain on the planet Balmorra in the centuries before the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The maweater was so named because it was the primary predator of the wingmaw, another creature native to the island chain, and the two species were unintentionally transplanted to the Balmorran mainland by unwary explorers around six hundred years before the Great War. However, the maweaters were wiped out when the Sith Empire bombarded the planet during the Great War, and as a result, the wingmaw population flourished and soon became a threat to both sentients and the planet's ecosystem.

name: Balmorran metal parasite
summary: The Balmorran metal parasite was a creature native to urban areas of Balmorra. It was a bony creature with two legs attached to its head. It used its sharp teeth to chew through fabrication equipment.

name: Balnab
summary: The Balnab were the inhabitants of the planet Balnab.

name: Balosar
summary: Balosars were a near-human sentient species which possessed two antennapalps on the tops of their heads, but were otherwise similar in appearance to humans. They were native to the ruined world Balosar.

name: Balti
summary: The Balti were a species of furry bipeds with prominent tusks. The smuggler Bingo Mehndra was a Balti. Rather than a birthday or a hatching day, Balti celebrated their "Spawning Day."

name: Balyeg
summary: The balyeg was a large reptilian creature that preyed on the pardlam. Bounty hunter Jango Fett considered it one of the scariest creatures in the galaxy. Hoping to teach his son Boba not to fear, Fett took him to the balyeg's planet and ordered him to get the creature's tooth. Boba was successful in this task.

name: Banasthaur
summary: The Banasthaurs were a species of winged sentients native to the Banasthau system, located in the Inner Rim. They were present in the galaxy by the time of the Galactic Civil War. In the year 0 BBY, several Banasthaurs visited a cantina on the planet Toprawa. The cantina, known as Al The Alchemist's, was patronized by mercenaries, gun-runners, and bounty hunters from across the galaxy, the infamous Boba Fett among them. Also present in the cantina that day was Havet Storm, a young Human boy whose grandfather had been a Jedi Knight. The patrons discovered that Storm was carrying a lightsaber, so the Banasthaurs and other bar-goers clustered around the boy, staring at him with hostile intent. Fett, who bore a grudge against the boy from a previous encounter, ordered the assorted patrons of the cantina to kill Storm, but the boy escaped.

name: Banchiian
summary: Banchiians were a diminutive avian sentient species native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Banchii. A primitive species, the Banchiians did not have a concept of personal property, believing that everything on Banchii was for everyone to share, and did not speak Galactic Basic Standard. When Banchii was settled by offworlders during the High Republic Era, the Banchiians took utensils and dishes from the settlement, leading to their discovery by Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi, her Padawan Keerin Fionn, and the younglings Nima and Viv'nia.

name: Bandara
summary: Known as the "sandbar dweller" in the Devaronian language, the bandara was a beetle-like creature that inhabited the rivers of Devaron. Drift-feeders, they gathered in huge swarms resting on sandbars while feeding on the detritus that floated by. Seeing a swarm of bandaras on the river was considered good luck by Devaronian river pilots because it warned them of shallow waters. During the mating season, male bandaras coarsely sang to attract potential mates, a drone that was unbearable to female Devaronians. They tried to wipe out the insects, but were unable to exterminate them completely. However, male Devaronians could tolerate the song of the bandaras. They were rumored to have hired mercenaries to help save the species.

name: Bandigo
summary: Bandigos (also called Bandingos) were a species of vicious omnivore commonly found within Sriluur's Temptation Canyon. They resembled large, dog-like creatures with four clawed-legs and wrinkled skin. They were widely known for their long, sinister howls—which many Weequay falsely believed to be produced by Water Nymphs living within the canyon. Bandigos lived in the sand, and often ambushed their prey by hiding under a thin layer of sand until the prey got close enough to capture.

name: Bane Back Spider
summary: Bane Back Spiders were large spiders native to various regions of the planet Dathomir. They were able to project their poisonous saliva to ward off threats. Shortly before 14 BBY, the spiders were domesticated by the Nightbrothers, a group of warriors who were managed and led by the Nightsister clan of Dathomirian witches. During his secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order in 14 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis encountered several Bane Back Spiders on Dathomir.

name: B'ankora
summary: The B'ankora were a sentient species of ruminants in the galaxy. Their homeworld suffered a cataclysmic collision with a meteor at some point before around 1300 BBY, which led the Galactic Republic to give them a small sanctuary, that eventually became the B'ankor Refuge, on their capital planet Coruscant. Chasen Piian, a Supreme Chancellor at the time of the Republic granted the land in perpetuity to the surviving members of the species so they could resume their sedentary lifestyle with humble homes, fields, and trails. The B'ankora continued to live on the land for over fifty generations. After the rise of the Galactic Empire, their Coruscant allotment was seized after an Imperial edict citing eminent domain was enacted and an Imperial energy research center affiliated with Project Celestial Power was build on their former lands. The entire species, around ten thousand individuals, was relocated to Parau VI, a dying world located in the Mid Rim which featured similar characteristics to those of the B'ankor Refuge. Not more than nineteen years later, the B'ankora had become extinct as a result of the Empire's actions.

name: Banshee bird
summary: The banshee bird was a type of winged avian. A brass banshee bird with its wings outstretched was mounted on the cross section of the Corellian Cross, a medal made to commemorate the contributions of the planet Corellia to the Alliance to Restore the Republic that was awarded as the Alliance's second highest honor.

name: Banshee
summary: Banshees were a non-sentient species of airborne predators native to the planet Umbara. During the Battle of Umbara in the Clone Wars, wild banshees attacked the Galactic Republic's clone troopers on several occasions. Jedi General Pong Krell killed a pair of banshees after they attacked the 501st Legion.

name: Bantam Dxun Reaper
summary: Bantam Dxun Reapers were non-sentient creatures of Dxun used as mounts around 3626 BBY.

name: Bantha
summary: {{Update|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land, Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine, Star Wars Helmet Collection 11, , Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy}} Banthas were a species of large, hairy mammals with sharp, spiraling horns. They inhabited the desert planet Tatooine, though they were bred on many worlds throughout the galaxy. They were social herd animals, and were often domesticated, and used prominently, by Tusken Raiders as mounts and companionship—though they never killed them for their food or hide. However, banthas were utilized by many other species for products such as bantha steak, butter, clothes, or furniture.

name: Barabel
summary: The Barabels were a saurian species native to the irradiated planet Barab I. They had blaster-proof scales and were incredibly strong, earning a fearsome reputation that put them in high demand as hired muscle in the criminal underworld. The species revered the Jedi Order and its combat prowess, but shared little of their morality and found the pain of others amusing.

name: Baraboo biomold
summary: Baraboo biomold was a microscopic aquatic organism native to Baraboo. Flecks of Baraboo biomold were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the Royal Icqui Aquaria on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

name: Baragwin
summary: The Baragwin were a large sentient species with pink and gray skin and yellow eyes. The thug Hermi Odle was a Baragwin. As a colonial species, they had migrated and adapted to dominate many worlds.

name: Baran turtle
summary: Baran turtles were a species of turtle native to the swamps of Tenoo. They were renowned for their durable shells, which were said to be stronger than beskar steel. In 232 BBY, the Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs encountered a group of baran turtles in a swamp on Tenoo.

name: Barbadelan
summary: Barbadelans were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Dobarn Tren and Karamu were members of this species.

name: Barbary bird
summary: Barbary birds were a kind of small, swift bird. Males of the species were easily visible with their black and yellow plumage.

name: Barbed ginx
summary: The Barbed Ginx was a relatively harmless, curious amphibian that frequented Makeb's marshes. They were first discovered by scientist Dep Aila on Makeb when he found the creatures surrounding his speeder having pulled the exterior casing off in search of food. The "barbed" in their name refers to the barbed "thumb" which allows them to peel bark from trees or fallen logs when foraging for insects. Ginx have a genetic relation to the more aggressive Vrakes. A dark green variety of Swamp Ginx was common amid the Endless Swamp of the planet Zakuul. The species was also prominent on the fourth moon of Yavin. Some of them were also present on the Chiss world of Copero. The small Ginx were of a relatively harmless nature, the large Ginx were aggressive. Ginx could be trained by a skilled handler to perform some tasks.

name: Barbed vesp
summary: The barbed vesp was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of vesp.

name: Barber bird
summary: The barber birds were a species of birdlike creature that was native to the forest moon of Endor. The blue-and-white colored birds were roughly two meters tall and had an affinity for ganga root, which they would retrieve from the ground.

name: Bardottan
summary: Bardottans were a sentient species of scaled reptiles native to the planet Bardotta, and were a proud and independent people who were reputed for their mysticism and attention to spiritual matters as well as for art and music throughout the galaxy.

name: Barghest
summary: The barghests were a species of non-sentient quadrupeds that could be kept as pets for protection. They had dark fur and skin, a large mouth filled with sharp teeth, and six red eyes. Although they looked monstrous, carnivorous barghests showed great loyalty toward their owners. Imperial warlord Janu Coin kept a barghest head mounted on his office wall during the New Republic Era. At the time of the Cold War, the Onodone forger Gwellis Bagnoro owned a pet barghest named Izby.

name: Barglechin
summary: The Barglechin was a species of giant fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War that was quite rare to catch.

name: Bark mite
summary: Bark mites were insects on Rori and Endor. They ate bark, and made large hives in trees and caves.

name: Bark rat
summary: Bark rats were stoutly built rats native to the planet Cholganna. They made up the bulk of the diet of the predatory nexu, a species that hunted in Cholganna's cool forests using their infrared vision to spot warm-blooded prey. The rats were more common than Cholganna's arboreal octopi.

name: Barolian
summary: Barolians were a sentient species. During the High Republic Era, Barolian pilots Jano Brayson and Teff, who both hailed from Baroli, served in the Republic Defense Coalition's Firebird Squadron.

name: Barri
summary: The Barri were semi-sentient beings native to an unnamed planet in Wild Space. They were enigmatic space-faring creatures that could hitch rides on asteroids and derelict spacecraft for thousands of years in space. Their acid secretions broke down and helped them digest the asteroid they clung to.

name: Bartokk
summary: The Bartokk were a species of clawed, sentient insectoids hailing from a nameless planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Controlled by a hive-mind, the Bartokk were barely sentient individually but highly intelligent when in groups.

name: Barundi
summary: The Barundi were a humanoid species native to the planet Barundi and encountered on an unnamed planet in Wild Space. A primitive society, the Barundi fashioned their lives around the promotion of perpetual happiness. The Barundi found in Wild Space worshiped the Yavin Vassilika as a god.
language: Dialect of The Thelvin Order of Barundi

name: Basiliskan
summary: The Basiliskans were an intelligent reptilian species native to the planet Basilisk, who later, after millennia of enslavement to the Mandalorians, degenerated into beasts known as the Lagartoz War Dragons.

name: Baspoor glider
summary: The baspoor glider, also called the "sky swimmer" for its fish-like appearance, was an omnivorous flying amphibian found usually on temperate worlds, in particular on Belsavis. The gliders usually lived near small pools on the planet, circling around these pools, its unique physiology allowed it to "land" in water, where it could continue to propel itself with its powerful wings. Due to the lack of proper legs, the gliders had very little mobility on solid surfaces and, should it find itself grounded, it had difficulty taking flight again. In their first months of life, the young of the baspoor glider were carried on the mother's back, eating her skin for nourishment, while the mother focused on her own needs, such as gathering her own food and protect herself from predators. The gliders were particularly fast to recover from injuries, making them heal their wounds quickly each day.

name: Bassa hound
summary: Bassa hounds were a type of heavy-hoofed dog. During the Imperial Era, a bassa hound belonged to the personal zoo of Harra the Hutt on the planet Vodran. By the New Republic Era, bassa hounds were trained as hunting companions at Kergans Academy. In 34 ABY, Resistance member Mattis Banz went on a mission to Vodran and had a run-in with a bassa hound and Harra's other creatures.

name: Bastak
summary: Bastaks were a species of non-sentient, carnivorous crustaceans that inhabited the lower levels of the prison moon Substation Grimdock. They had a hypnotic call, which only took effect with eye contact. The call would put those who heard it into a mesmerized trance, unable to move. Their chitinous outer layer prevented blasters from harming them, but thermal detonators would disorient them.

name: Batarikan
summary: Batarikans were a type of serpent found on the Outer Rim planet Galidraan. At some point during the High Republic Era, the mercenary Ty Yorrick was hired to hunt a batarikan on the world. However, she found that the snake had been infested by a Drengir—a type of sentient, carnivorous plant—with roots crammed into its eyes and nasal cavities, and its body leeched of nutrients. Knowing that many of Galidraan's residents had met the same fate, the mercenary opted to flee the scene despite having not completed the job, barely escaping with her life. While on the swamp planet Safrifa for a rescue mission in 231 BBY, Yorrick thought about her time on Galidraan for the batarikan hunt as she fought another Drengir.

name: Bathwa
summary: Bathwas were flying creatures native to Kiffex. Aayla Secura and the feral Anzati used them as mounts.

name: Batlizard
summary: Batlizards were a type of lizard that had the ability to fly, and lived in nests. Several Batlizards lived inside of Savi's Workshop in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, making nests in dark corners of the room.

name: Battle hydra
summary: The Battle Hydra was a type of large reptilian dragon-like Sithspawn that was created by the Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun.
distinctions: Whiplike tail with a poison stinger

name: Battlebird
summary: The battlebird was a type of bird that lived on the world Orimanther, in the Outer Rim Territories. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the Chevin slaver Phylus Mon traveled to Orimanther and attempted to capture a flock of battlebirds. However, he was initially unsuccessful, so he meditated and attempted to use a Force storm to knock the birds out of the sky.

name: Battrach
summary: The Battrach were a sentient species in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Knight Keeve Trennis claimed to have talked to a male Battrach gunrunner at Port Lennax when infiltrating the Nihil.

name: Batuu sea bear
summary: Batuu sea bears were bears that shared their name with the planet Batuu. In 382 BBY, a crystalized skull of an ancient Batuu sea bear was one of many artifacts in the artifact chamber of the Batuu Jedi temple, with a compass tucked behind it.

name: Batuuan braga bear
summary: Batuuan braga bears were a species of bear that lived on the planet Batuu. They were brown and chased after their prey. When the droid SF-R3 visited Batuu, he learned that the growl of a braga bear was a sign to run away.

name: Batuuan Rat
summary: Batuuan Rats were a species of rat native to the planet Batuu. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised rats to become pets or for other reasons.

name: Batuuan spider-roach
summary: Batuuan spider-roach was a type of spider-roach that could be eaten as food and shared its name with the Outer Rim planet Batuu. A meat trader sold crunchy Batuuan spider-roach in the Holy City on the Mid Rim moon Jedha by 382 BBY, during the High Republic Era. That year, while a group of wargaran creatures were loose in the city, the trader was bored and listed crunchy Batuuan spider-roach among the food items they had for sale.

name: Bavakar
summary: The Bavakar were a sentient species, members of which specialized in biological enhancements and related technologies. The species shared its name with the Bavakar Medical Research Labs company that was in business by 3956 BBY.

name: Baxthrax
summary: Baxthrax were winged sapients. They were one of many species that could be found in the avenues of Nar Shaddaa at the tail end of the Clone Wars.

name: Bay squid
summary: Bay squids were an aquatic species that lived in the Ugyir River of Coronet City on the planet Corellia. They had a habit of ducking in and out of the clear waters of the river. Following the arrival of the Galactic Empire, the construction of Star Destroyers on the banks of the river polluted the waters, eventually leading to the extinction of the species.

name: Baz nitch
summary: The Baz nitch was a species of short, bipedal creatures that lived on the remote world of Dathomir that gathered in packs. Though usually docile, they could become temperamental and aggressive when agitated. Their physiology was very similar to that of a nuna, with the exception of two long head protuberances, and four smaller ones. They also had a proboscis and eye stalks.

name: Bearded jax
summary: The bearded jax, or jax for short, was a small species of herbivorous felines found in the wilds of the forest moon of Endor and Naboo's moon of Rori. One of their most distinguishing features was a beard protruding from the creature's chin. Beast masters were able to domesticate the bearded jax as personal companions. Holographic depictions of the bearded jax were also stored on data cubes, allowing them to be projected as holopets. Their meat could also be cooked and consumed as sustenance. The mammoth bearded jax was a subspecies of jax notable for its considerably larger size. Bioengineers were also capable of using the DNA of the bearded jax to incubate mutated variants known as psychotic jax.
hairColor: White in the wild; varied when domesticated

name: Bearsloth
summary: Bearsloths were fierce arboreal predators found in the forests of the celestial body Arbooine. They had long furry bodies with six legs and four eyes. The species possessed a slow-acting venom and would bite prey and then hide while the venom weakened the target to a point where it could not defend itself.

name: beast
summary: The beasts were an ancient species. The myth "The Silent Circle" tells the story of how the trees, the fae and the beasts once lived in harmony on Batuu.

name: Beck-tori
summary: Beck-tori were aquatic parasites from Nam Priax's warm seas that grew to extreme sizes. Because the movement of a potential host through the water attracted Beck-tori, they sometimes would mistakenly attack boats and submersible craft. They were known to have fought frequently with the Gungans. The beck-tori had a strong connection to the Force, which they could use to heal themselves.

name: "Bedlam Spirits"
summary: The Bedlam Spirits were an omnipotent group of entities that inhabited the planet Bedlam near the Bedlam Pulsar. They consisted of Tilotny, Horliss-Horliss, Cold Danda Sine and Splendid Ap. The spirits were very powerful beings, capable of manipulating time and mass. However, they were prone to childish behavior. Sometime during the Galactic Civil War, Princess Leia Organa encountered them while escaping from Imperial troops.
distinctions: Ability to manipulate time and matter

name: Bee
summary: A bee was a small, winged creature that made a buzzing sound when in flight and stung painfully. Bees had three main body regions: a head, a thorax, and an abdomen. Their heads featured twin feelers, a pair of large eyes and a proboscis. They had two sets of wings that were attached to the thorax; two fore wings and two hind wings. Their abdomen was large, amber-colored with black stripes and ended with a sting. The Human named Han Solo compared the pain of his mending bones after the Millennium Falcons crash on Kessel to the sting of a bee. The humming of an IT-O interrogation droid was sometimes compared to that of a huge bee. Bees lived in oblong, dome-shaped nests called beehives, which hung from trees. Those flying creatures would bumble their way in the flowers, incidentally helping pollinate the plants that bore them.

name: Beek-monkey
summary: Beek-monkeys were a type of semi-sentient primate. They were noted for flailing when confined. Han Solo sometimes swore an oath, indicating a possible religious connotation.

name: Beekmonkey
summary: Beekmonkeys were a type of monkey. While trapped aboard the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon in 230 BBY, the pilot Leox Gyasi mentally compared fellow pilot Koley Linn—who he had a history of unpleasant encounters with—to a beekmonkey.

name: Beetul
summary: The beetul was an insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. Some species were large enough for Kubaz to ride on, while others were quite small. One species was iridescent blue.

name: Begamor two-headed dog
summary: The Begamor two-headed dog was a type of dog found on the planet Begamor during the High Republic Era. In 200 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Sean inspected the estate of President Jamie Brasson on Begamor. While visiting the kitchen of the Latero head chef Marino Pomana, Sean noticed that around half of Pomana's branded food products were counterfeit goods produced by the local company Opera Trade. Pomana acknowledged Sean's abilities, but warned that they could not afford to let their guard down. He further threatened to feed Sean to the president's Begamor two-headed dog if he made even the slightest mistake in the kitchen.

name: Beldon
summary: {{Update|Star Wars Battlefront II, Beyond the Clouds, , Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy}} Beldons were a large species native to the gas giant Bespin. They lived in the planet's lower atmosphere and could be found in large herds.
distinctions: Orange gas bladders, fleshy fins, long tendrils

name: Belly-bird
summary: Belly-birds were creatures that were native to Yavin 4.

name: Belonuk
summary: Belonuks were creatures native to the planet Dathomir. They were dangerous predators that possessed sharp claws and teeth and powerful, bony heads with which they could ram prey.

name: Belugan
summary: Belugans were an aquatic sentient species native to the planet Quarzite. Largely humanoid, the Belugans sported fleshy sideburns on the sides of their faces and had sectioned jaws that hid their baleen-like teeth. While the rest of the galaxy participated in the Clone Wars, the Belugans fought an ongoing conflict with the native Kage Warriors, who opposed Quarzite's tyrannical leader, Lord Otua Blank. Despite being equipped with advanced technology, the Belugans nonetheless encountered Kage Warriors during the latter's' ambushes on the formers' subtrams. This led to Blank hiring an outside team of bounty hunters to protect cargo traveling to his stronghold. Although the Belugan escorts were defeated, the bounty hunters successfully defended the cargo. When the bounty hunter Asajj Ventress learned that the cargo was a living Kage girl who had been kidnapped from her home, Ventress ended up having a change of heart. Instead of delivering the girl to the Belugans, Ventress freed her and alternatively gave Lord Blank fellow bounty hunter Boba Fett, much to the dictator's surprise.
skinColor: Brown-gray with blue or orange flesh "sideburns"
distinctions: Four-sectioned mouths, fleshy sideburns, prehensile tongues

name: Belvarian firegnat
summary: Belvarian firegnats were glowing insects from the Belvaria system that flew in swarms. They blinked red and green.

name: Benathy
summary: The Benathy were a large sentient species that resided on the planet Benath in Wild Space. During the Imperial Era, Darth Vader led a battle against the Benathy, which ultimately failed, though the Benathy were subdued. Kylo Ren of the First Order visited the Benathy for negotiations, accompanied by Captain Ruthford. The Benathy were massive compared to the average species, with brown hair covering their bodies. They also had two tusks protruding out of their face.

name: Bentail
summary: Bentails were large flying beasts native to the planet of Shaum Hii. Kian'thar derlac herders often rode bentails as they followed their herds across Shaum Hii's oceans. The empathic Kian'thar often formed close bonds with their mounts, treating them more like beloved pets than simple work beasts.

name: Berchestian
summary: Berchestians were a sentient species of humanoids or near-Humans that hailed from the planet of Berchest. A sizable population of them lived on Mrlsst as well. Berchestians had various characters either tattooed or otherwise imprinted on their bald heads.

name: Bergruutfa
summary: Bergruutfa, also shortened to "'gruutfa," were large docile pachyderms.

name: Berrite
summary: The Berrites of the planet Berri were considered to be stupid and clumsy by most other species, though they could be deceptively cunning. Berrites were one-meter tall creatures with two arms and four legs. Their skin was green and wrinkled, with patches of coarse black hair. They had poor vision and hearing, but they had a natural sonar ability which compensated for these deficiencies. [[File:Mexnean.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mexnean, a con artist]] All Berrites were hermaphroditic, though they would take on male or female identities when dealing with aliens depending on which gender would get them better treatment. They often had trouble telling male and female aliens apart. When Berrites reproduced, one would take on a male role and fertilize another's eggs. The second would take on a female role, carrying the eggs (usually three) within "her" skin folds. Hatchlings grew to full size within one year, but did not reproduce until the age of sixty. Berrites could live to be four hundred years old. Berrites were master foragers, sharing the scarce resources of their homeworld with one another in a spirit of anarchic cooperation. They often gathered together for hours on end to chew the food stored in their cheek pouches and listen to stories. Though Berrites had been known to galactic society for a long time, their planet attracted little trade, so few Berrites left Berri. Despite the scarcity of natural resources, the Galactic Empire made several attempts to enslave the Berrites and make Berri a factory planet. However, Berrites responded to Imperial pressure by pretending to be much stupider than they really were. After high accident rates and defective products, the planetary Governor gave up and requested a transfer. This behavior was typical of the Berrite response to pressure, which preferred cheerful uncooperativeness and feigned stupidity to violent conflict. Famous Berrites included Mexnean, a con-"woman" and petty thief active during the Galactic Civil War.

name: Besalisk
summary: Besalisks were a humanoid sentient species with four arms and an inflatable wattle that were native to the planet Ojom. Dex's Diner owner and friend of Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, Dexter Jettster, was a Besalisk, as was Pong Krell, a Jedi Master who fell to the dark side of the Force after having a vision of the Jedi's demise during the Clone Wars.

name: Bestine sea anemone
summary: Bestine sea anemones were likely marine cnidarians indigenous of the planet Bestine IV. The flabby, pale, fingerlike growths of Xabar fungus were dark purple in color with crimson tips. According to Boba Fett, they writhed like the tendrils of a Bestine sea anemone.

name: Bestoonian
summary: The Bestoonian were a sentient species. One Bestoonian was the Sith assassin Ochi, who hailed from the planet Bestoon.

name: Bezim
summary: The Bezim were a sentient race from the planet Bezim. They were humanoids with dome-shaped skulls.

name: Bha'lir
summary: Bha'lir were jungle predators from the planet of Iyred. Though gentle when treated with caution, the bha'lir were quite territorial and would respond violently if threatened.

name: Bharhulai
summary: The Bharhulai were one of several nomadic tribes that inhabited the planet Socorro. The Bharhulai roamed the northern polar regions of Socorro, and used crude weaponry and simple clothing. They were known for fiercely defending their territory and attacking any who dared to enter their lands. The anthropologist Arner Figgis believed that the Bharhulai may have descended from a crashed colony ship and regressed to their savage state, exemplifying his survival-regressive-isolationist theory.

name: Bhillen
summary: Bhillen was a type of animal that could be eaten by Humans. It could be stewed,, roasted, or used to a prepare a sandwich. In 0 ABY, the Human techician Deen Voorson recounted the story of about the Human Jedi Vici Ramunee to two fellow members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Mavis and Tarn. In the story, set around 4000 BBY, Ramunee found a spreed of food on a table that included a quarter roast bhillen only for it to vanish from the table after she turned away. By 3 ABY, Deen's cousin, Shannon Voorson, had learned to slice into Imperial data files while living in the Core Worlds Kuat System. Afterwards she would make up her own codes using animal names such as bhillen. When Deen visited Shannon in the Kuat System that year, the family caught up with each other over a pot of stewed bhillen. Shannon later used a bhillen sandwich as part of a lie to get past a security guard and join her cousin in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

name: Bhima Ook's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Bhima Ook was a member of the species.

name: Bifflefly
summary: The biffleflies were native flying insects found on the forest planets Tenoo and Yamradi. They were similar to butterflies.

name: Biituian
summary: Biituians were a near-Human sentient race indigenous to Biitu.

name: Biituian fen-hare
summary: The Biituian fen-hare was a species that originated from Biitu, a lush agriworld in the Cassandran Worlds. It was a timid creature, and by 4 ABY, it had been incorporated into a Galactic Basic Standard simile for a frightened person. The bounty hunter Boba Fett referred to it in this manner to describe fellow hunter Bossk after the latter bailed out of his own starship, believing that it contained explosives that were about to detonate.

name: Bilar
summary: Bilars were one of the few examples of a true group mind in the galaxy. Evolved from small, vegetarian primates on the tectonically active but highly fertile planet Mima II, each member of the species was a hairless, pink creature with large, dark eyes, a short muzzle, and two rounded ears. An individual Bilar was unintelligent, but the species had the ability to pool the knowledge and consciousnesses of groups of Bilars who shared a special bond with one another, creating conglomerations known as a claqas. Thus, a pair of Bilars collectively was as intelligent as a trained domestic animal, but a group of four achieved true sentience. The group mind developed shortly after the birth of those Bilars born nearby and within a few minutes of each other. The group mind depended on single Bilars sharing thoughts through pheromones, physical and visual contact, and telepathy. Larger claqas grew progressively smarter, with seven-member groups achieving genius-level intellects. Claqas with more than ten members were rare, and claqas generally referred to themselves as a single individual and went by a single name. Separation of any of the constituent Bilars resulted in a temporary loss of intelligence, and the death of a Bilar sent his or her claqa into a deep depression, sometimes leading to catatonia or the death of the whole. The plant life of Mima II was so lush that it provided the Bilars with a comfortable and carefree existence. Claqas of five or more members preferred to live in urban environments situated in stable fields on the planet, and the species had access to mass production and other advanced technology. However, the goods they had to offer were of little interest to outsiders. Coupled with the fact that many non-Bilars found interacting with a group mind unnerving, Bilars had limited contact with the rest of the galaxy. When they did manage to venture offworld, their generally carefree existences on Mima II left them unused to deprivation. Nevertheless, a few Bilar claqas did venture into the greater galaxy to work at occupations that made use of their ability to work together seamlessly.
designation: Non-sentient, semi-sentient, or sentient depending on size of group

name: Bildog
summary: Bildogs were oceanic, edible herd beast of Chadra. The animals were large sea slugs that would gather in groups of five to fifty. They could grow over 150 meters long and 15 meters in diameter. The species was considered graceful and gentle, but extremely dumb. They were not aggressive, and would flee attacks, depending on their thick layer of sub-dermal fatty tissue to act as armor.

name: Bilge-bug
summary: Bilge-bugs were a type of insect in the galaxy. The term was occasionally used as an insult.

name: Bilgefrog
summary: Bilgefrogs were a species of frog native to the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around dawn, they tended to make croaking sounds. In 13 BBY, Corellian scrumrat of the White Worms Qi'ra reminisced about the croaking sounds of the bilgefrogs which she normally heard in the Freighter boneyard.

name: Bimm
summary: The Bimms were a species of diminutive sentients who resembled short humans. Rycar Ryjerd, a patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine, was a Bimm. A different species of furred individuals with floppy ears was also called Bimm.

name: Bimm
summary: The Bimms were a sentient species characterized by their fur, feather-like whiskers and long, floppy ears. They spoke a language called Bimmini. A Bimm named Uumay Hawlatha served as a Jedi Master in the late Republic Era, while Voh was an elderly Bimm male who served as the seneschal of the Jedi outpost Sanctuary Mount on the planet Kwenn. A different species, similar to diminutive humans, was also called Bimms.

name: Bimmisaari tiga loreng
summary: The tiga loreng was a non-sentient beaked bird native to the planet Bimmisaari from the Mid Rim. The native inhabitants of Bimmisaari banned all weapons of violence and hunting on their homeworld, ensuring that tiga loreng thrived in the wild. Much of the planet's surface was covered with thick forests of asaari trees, whose leafy fronds constantly moved in response to stimuli, even when no wind was blowing. Flocks of brightly colored tiga loreng nest in the mobile branches, much like dartfish among sea anemones.

name: Bin Essada's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Bin Essada was a member of this species.

name: Binarian sabercat
summary: The Binarian sabercat was a predator native to the planet Binaros in the Kathol Outback. A huge feline animal, the sabercat had eight powerful legs tipped with large paws ending in razor-sharp claws. The sabercat was able to bring four of these paws to bear on an opponent at any time. Huge incisors gave the sabercat a vicious bite. The sabercat also had a two-meter tail that ended in a bony tip. While dangerous looking, the sabercat did not use the tail to attack prey. Instead, it was used in the sabercat's mating rituals. Typical sabercats had thick brown-tan fur with green splotches. The coloration of the fur assisted the predator in stalking prey by giving it a natural camouflage. In 8 ABY, the Defel Kl'aal cornered and killed a Binarian sabercat on Binaros during the layover of the FarStar on the planet.

name: Bioluminescent bacteria
summary: Bioluminescent bacteria were a type of light-emitting bacteria that formed colonies. They could be found in the Seikara Caverns on the Outer Rim planet Dekien. Two decades after the Imperial unification, the former Sith known as the Ronin noticed the bacteria in stalagtites and phytokarst crevices formed by previous generations of lichen in the Seikara Caverns while searching the caves for a shard of the kyber mirror of Shinsui Temple.

name: Bird of Paradise
summary: A Bird of Paradise was a type of reptavian. The Jedi Padawan Nakime wore earrings resembling them. During a spiritual trial, Nakime saw several of the creatures fly past her.

name: Birru
summary: Birrus were lacy-winged flying creatures, vulnerable to windstorms, that were native to the planet Ansion.

name: Bissop
summary: Bissops were non-sentient lizard-hounds used by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species. Bred by the Yuuzhan Vong to track and hunt living creatures, bissops were carnivorous and had snouts that they used to seek prey. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, bissops were utilized by Yuuzhan Vong warriors to track down both escaping prisoners and enemies who had infiltrated their territory on worlds such as Selvaris and Caluula. Additionally, bissops were used to pull the sled of Supreme Overlord Shimrra Jamaane in 29 ABY, during a ceremony on the planet Yuuzhan'tar.

name: Bith
summary: The Bith were a peaceful and intelligent sentient species that were native to the planet Bith. They had hairless, domed heads and black, glassy eyes that lacked eyelids and could not shed tears. Bith often found work as musicians, scientists, and engineers. Bith also had very sensitive hearing, being able to separate and isolate sounds around them. Because Bith had no noses, they smelled through special organs beneath the skin flaps on their faces.

name: Bitthævrian
summary: The Bitthævrians were warlike, bipedal sapients native to Guiteica, in the Kadok Regions.
distinctions: Regenerative quills on elbows and knees

name: Bitz bug
summary: A bitz bug was a type of insect.

name: Bivall
summary: The Bivall were a semi-aquatic sentient species of tall bipeds with lanky bodies, large stalked eyes, crested heads and long fingers that were native to Protobranch in the Core Worlds. Sionver Boll and Okalin were members of this species.

name: Bivalva contemplativa
summary: The Bivalva contemplativa was a species of clam native to the planet Perilix. They exhibited multigenerational narrative semaphores, which caused dispute among the xeno-ethnologists from the planet Coruscant as to whether the Bivalva contemplativa possessed true sentience. Some of the ethnologists argued this characteristic only reflected a form of hive building insufficient to demonstrate true sentience, while others argued it constituted conversation between individuals. By 19 BBY, Bivalva contemplativa had earned the nickname: the "thinking clams of Perilix," despite the argument over their sentience remaining unresolved.

name: Bix Creo's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Bix Creo was a member of this species.

name: Black behemoth
summary: Black behemoths were territorial predators from Veron, four meters long and two meters at the shoulder. Each behemoth claimed a personal territory and memorized the location of every tree, pool of water and vine. While not fast enough to keep pace with most creatures, it often fed after pursued prey became entangled in hanging vines or tree limbs. These creatures spent a great deal of time waiting in ambush. Once a black behemoth was aware that food was nearby, it sprang to life, ready for the hunt.

name: Blackback
summary: The blackback was an elusive forest-dwelling bird of prey that lived in the Hanna Wild Game Reserve and other protected regions on the planet Chandrila. The birds were a popular hunting prize, though they were well-protected by the Chandrilan government after their near-extinction. Blackbacks' diet consisted of squalls and other small rodents, which they sometimes hunted while circling thermal vents.

name: Blackfish
summary: The blackfish was a relatively common species of fish notable for their small size, black skin, and colored stripes. They could be found on multiple worlds throughout the galaxy, including lush worlds like Naboo and Yavin 4, or even more arid planets like Lok and Tatooine. Through the act of fishing, it was possible to lure and catch blackfish and use their meat as ingredients in various foodstuffs.

name: Blackstalker
summary: The Blackstalker was a genetically-engineered offshoot of the Garral created by Imperial scientists expanding on the work of Luthos Garral. The Galactic Empire intended to use them to assist Human scouts and guard patrols, but they proved to be very aggressive and nearly impossible to train. Their creators attempted to destroy them before they were put into service, but many managed to escape on outbound starships.

name: Bladderbird
summary: The bladderbird was a type of bird. It was a huge animal that received its name from its spherical body. This immense, avian creature was named for its bulbous body, which often attracted bugs.

name: Bladderworm
summary: Bladderworms were a type of parasitic worm that could infest the bladder of happabores, a domesticated species found on planets across the Western Reaches. Infestations of the parasite in happabores could be treated with Happy-Bore Medicated Dewormer, a product produced by Galacti-Stok that contained Trestibinexocycline 5-Gamma, thlank oil, greel-root acid and forage products. Use of the dewormer on bladderworms was suggested in the instructions for the slurry formulation of the product. While living on the desert planet Jakku, the scavenger Rey found a copy of these instructions and included them alongside information about happabores on Jakku in a survival guide that she compiled by 34 ABY.

name: Bladeback boar
summary: Bladeback boars were a rare and aggressive race of zucca boar, an animal native to the desert planet of Tatooine. In 1 ABY, one such bladeback boar terrorized residents of Tatooine, but was vanquished by a heroic spacer who was then awarded the Mark of Courage.

name: Blarina
summary: The Blarina were a short sentient species that were native to the planet Rina Major who were notably fond of words and were famously accomplished liars. Many other species found it difficult to tell different Blarina apart, which some Blarina used to their advantage when dealing with others. They had a broad face with a short, narrow snout; small, beady eyes; and a mouth full of sharp teeth. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, a Blarina named Wollivan was present in the castle of Maz Kanata shortly before its destruction by the First Order. Around the same time, the Blarina Naka Iit and Ohn Gos worked as a scavenger and a merchant respectively on the desert planet Jakku, and aided the Resistance pilot Poe Dameron in getting off the planet.

name: Blarth
summary: Blarths were a species of amphibian native to the planet Naboo. They possessed long grabbing tails ending with fine fingers at the tip, which they could use to catch their prey in the swamps they dwelt in. The sentient Gungan species who also lived in the swamps of Naboo often kept blarths as loveable pets, although their tendency to leave large, slimy puddles of drool around their owner's house was considered a bad habit.

name: Blast bug
summary: Blast bugs were projectile biots used by the Yuuzhan Vong. A relative of the thud bug, the blast bug was also shaped from a sparkbee. But unlike the thud and razor bugs, the blast bug was the Yuuzhan Vong analog of a guided missile. Upon reaching contact with the target, the blast bug would explode, sending the victim hurling through the air, causing severe burns, and even breaching armor. A Human caught in the explosion without armor had very little chance of survival.

name: Blastail
summary: Blastails were predatory felines that could be found on most levels of Kashyyyk's multilayered forests. Pollen would stick to the fuzzy bulb on their tail, and as they moved about the forest, they would cross-pollinate the flora of their world. Blastails carried infectious diseases, even ones that were able to infect a healthy full-grown Wookiee. They can shoot these infections through spores on their tip of their tail, usually for defensive purposes in order to escape harm.
hairColor: Dark beige or orange mottled with long stripes or spots
distinctions: Black and white vision in darkness

name: Blaze bug
summary: Blaze bugs were a type of bug. Rieve likened her memories of previous events haunting her to their habit of repeatedly biting.

name: Bleep-fly
summary: Bleep-flies were a type of fly that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Valo. While in the Lonisa City Zoo on Valo in 229 BBY the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem noticed some bleep-flies singing in the dusk air as they used their datapad to locate the Jedi youngling Gavi.

name: Blembie
summary: A Blembie was a carnivorous fish native to Naboo and were traditionally used in games of Theed quoits on Naboo. In the wild, they were known to swim in shoals and had bad tempers.

name: Blinkbird
summary: A blinkbird was a type of creature. They lived in trees and forest canopies.

name: Blismal
summary: Blismal were a non-sentient rodent species found deep within the caves and caverns of Ilum, an ice planet deep within the Unknown Regions.

name: Blister gnat
summary: A blister gnat was a type of gnat that had a low level of intelligence and a short life expectancy.

name: Blisterbug
summary: Blisterbugs were small, non-sentient, venomous creatures. Care had to be taken when poisoned with blisterbug venom, as an allergic reaction could cause swelling and possibly death. A Mandalorian once died from suffocation as he refused to remove the breastplate of his Mandalorian armor, believing it was dishonorable to do so. The bounty hunter veteran Ro-San Borokki wrote about the dangers of blisterbug venom in her chapter The Hunt, which was published in the Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook.

name: Blistmok
summary: Blistmok were a type of reptilian predator found on the volcanic Outer Rim planet Mustafar. They hunted in packs and were tireless, running down prey for days before attacking.

name: Blixus
summary: Blixus were rare, half-shelled semi-aquatic creatures native to Sljee.

name: Bliz
summary: A Bliz was a plump species of bird that was native to the world of Hapes. It produced pink-shelled eggs that were considered to be a Hapan delicacy. Blizes made their homes in blizcots.

name: Bloater
summary: The bloater was a gas-filled floating creature from the planet Spintir that traveled in herds.

name: Bloatfish
summary: The bloatfish was a type of fish known to expand its body by taking in water or air as a defense mechanism, giving itself the appearance of a much larger creature.

name: Blobfish
summary: A blobfish was a type of fish found in the galaxy. Unkar Plutt, a Crolute on Jakku, was blobfish-like, earning him the nickname "Blobfish."

name: Blog
summary: Blogs were a water-dwelling species located on Endor. They were fairly large and fierce, and would sometimes attack Ewoks.

name: Bloggin
summary: Bloggins were avian creatures that lived on the planet Jakku. Rey noted in her journal that bloggins may be the dumbest creatures in the galaxy.

name: Blood bee
summary: A blood bee was a type of bee. In 134 BBY, shortly after Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon arrived on the planet Siline, she was brought to a room within a crystalline tower, where she concentrated on sensing the flow of the Force. Lon felt that the planet's geology or atmosphere seemed to vibrate on a fundamental level, and although it did not clash with her sense of the Force, she mentally compared the distraction it caused to a blood bee buzzing around her head.

name: Blood beetle
summary: The blood beetle was a species of scavenging insect. The beetles had the ability to locate a corpse and devour it down to the bone.

name: Blood Carver
summary: Blood Carvers were a sentient insect-like race native to the planet Batorine.
lifespan: Child: 1-8 years *Young adult: 9-11 years *Adult: 12-38 years *Middle age: 39-65 years *Old: 66-82 years *Venerable: 83+ years

name: Blood spite
summary: Blood spites were bat-like creatures that fed on warm blood and inhabited the Old City on the planet Tython, deep in the Red Desert. Their existence was widely considered to be only a rumor by the Je'daii, though they were very much real as Lanoree Brock would discover as she entered the city in pursuit of her brother, Dalien.

name: Bloodfin
summary: The Bloodfin were dark red, semi-aquatic predators native to the oceans of Bastion. They were adorned with a scarlet crest on their head and four-legged with cloven hoofs like daggers. They could be trained to become a formidable mount capable of fighting after their rider was dead. Bloodfins were not known for their obedience off the battlefield and had a propensity to eat whatever fell in front of them in the heat of the moment, including riders. They were believed to be a subspecies of the Ghannoidal certecyes. Darth Maul's speeder was named after these creatures.

name: Bloodfly
summary: Bloodflies were swarming insects common to the broad plains of Lothal, a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Large and highly aggressive, they measured between ten and fourteen millimeters long and banded, black and white bodies with iridescent wings, mandibles, and bright green eyes. Bloodflies fed on mammal blood, although they also ingested pollen and nectar. They tended to gather around herds of large animals such as nerfs, where the food was plentiful. While they had an extremely painful bite, they were also extremely noisy flyers, which made them, at least for sentients, relatively easy to avoid. Bloodflies occasionally carried a blood-borne disease called "bloodfly sickness," which sapped afflicted sentients' strength and energy and caused fever, vomiting, and painful rashes. However, it was easily treated with bacta immersion and rest.

name: Bloodsniffer
summary: Bloodsniffers were vicious predators that were among the many dangerous beasts that could be found in the desolate Badlands of Kamar. Possessing a metabolism that consumed potassium at an incredible rate, bloodsniffers ingested their full body weight in fresh blood every two days, piercing the veins and arteries of their victims with their long, sharp tongues. Bloodsniffers lived in small packs, and the territorial creatures were known to attack each other over the blood they needed to survive.
distinctions: 4 stubby legs with razor sharp claws
Long and thin tongue with hollow, needle-sharp spur

name: Blossoming gulper
summary: A blossoming gulper was an aquatic predator from Mon Calamari. It would bury itself in the sand at the bottom of the sea and leave its petal arms, which resembled the seatree, to wave naturally with the current. When a creature brushed an arm, it would be seized by the gulper and eaten.

name: Blowfish
summary: Blowfish were a relatively common species of fish notable for their puffiness. They could be found on multiple worlds throughout the galaxy, including lush worlds like Issor and Naboo, or even more arid planet's like Lok and Tatooine. Through the act of fishing, it was possible to lure and catch blowfish and use their meat as ingredients in various foodstuffs. During the Moon Festival of 2 ABY on Omman Minor, the Socorran Drake Paulsen and his Wookiee companion Nikaede Celso were served a generous portion of deep-fired Issori blowfish snouts in Feyodor's Tavern.

name: Bloxian
summary: Bloxians were a sentient species native to the Bloxia system in Wild Space. The species was characterized by their large size and red-hued skin. Members of this species included Bakk and Chokk, enforcers for the Pliith loan shark Linkaas.

name: Blub
summary: Blubs were a type of marine fish native to the ocean moon of Kef Bir. The members of Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters living on the moon, fished for blubs and striped canths as a food source in raging seas that teemed with shoals of both creatures. On a productive day of fishing, the fishers would fill the two sea skiffs they used with blub and striped canth and then bake them over fires back on land. Members of the company used what they killed efficiently, harvesting not only meat but other materials as well.

name: Blubreen
summary: Blubreen were amphibious near-Humans from a planet in the Ploo sector.
skinColor: Ranges from purple to red, multicolored mixed
distinctions: Amphibious, aquiline features, webbed fingers and toes, gills, smooth-skinned skin

name: Blue aklyrr
summary: The blue aklyrr, commonly known as the aklyrr, was a rare creature found in the forests of the planet Tenoo. They were quadripedal creatures, featuring antlers and four eyes. Aklyrrs made dens on the ground, but were adept at climbing and were fast. They liked to feed on teega leaves at a certain time of the year. The town of Aklyrr Bend was named for the creatures. During the High Republic Era, the bounty hunter Ansen Strung was hired by the collector Draiven Bosh to find a blue aklyrr, and was assisted by the Jedi Initiates Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs. However, upon learning that Strung's client was Bosh—who did not intend to properly care for the aklyrr and merely wanted it due to its rarity—the Jedi convinced the bounty hunter to free the creature instead.

name: Blue bantha
summary: The blue banthas were sapient, Force-sensitive banthas found on the planet Entooine. The average height of a young blue bantha was two meters, whereas adults generally grew to an average height of three meters. Though named blue, they actually had white fur and were named for their beautiful, light-blue horns which were collectible items offplanet. When attacked, they defended using their horns as well as simply trampling their attackers. Though not very different physically from the normal bantha, all members of the species could use the Force to a small degree. Additionally, they could never forget any memory and were known to pass down their knowledge through the generations. Askhew shamans often communicated with them to ask for advice and received simple answers by watching how the banthas stomped their hoofs. To communicate, they believed they had to approach the blue banthas with the lower leg bone of a standard, brown bantha. Though this was not true, as the blue banthas had their own language, the Askhew simply did not understand it. Jowart Typok was known to hunt blue banthas for their horns sometime during the Galactic Civil War before he was stopped by a group of Rebels.

name: Blue-breasted hover ibbot
summary: The blue-breasted hover ibbot was a species of ibbot native to the Core Worlds planet Drall. The bird, one of sixty-eight varieties of ibbots found on the planet, had a wingspan of seven centimeters and evolved to hold a particular niche in Drall's ecosystem.

name: Blue-finned crayfish
summary: The blue-finned crayfish was a species of crustacean endemic to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The species was particularly elusive. At one point, priorite prospectors thought to capture the rare creature to sell at a high price. Their failures made many declare the species a myth. However, the blue-finned crayfish simply evaded capture by clinging to the underside of rocks and disguising itself by flowing with the water. If spotted, the creature still evaded capture due to its hydrodynamic body, which allowed it to be extremely slippery, and its sharp claws. In 9 BBY, the Sakavian fisherman Skoova Stev who resided on Koboh, caught a blue-finned crayfish at a bygone settlement in Rambler's Reach Outpost by covering his suit in grease as a way to combat the slipperiness of the creature. The crustacean was later added to the aquarium in Pyloon's Saloon.

name: Blue lizard
summary: Blue lizards were reptilian quadrupeds that lived on the forest moon of Endor. A line of spikes ran along their back, from the top of their head to the end of their tail.

name: Blue Meeka
summary: Blue Meekas, sometimes referred to as meekas, for short, were playful creatures found within the Blue Forest on the planet Tenoo. Meekas were drawn to shiny objects such as holocameras and would try to take them. Despite their propensity for thievery, their playful nature meant they would sometimes play catch with stolen items and their sentient owners. Between around 232 and 230 BBY, when Jedi Initiates Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs joined Padawan Celesta Kami on a camping journey into the Blue Forest to observe the annual electromagnetic phenomenon, the Night Lights of Tenoo, a group of meekas were drawn to the Jedi's shiny objects, including Kami's holocamera. The Padawan's pursuit of refuge from the meekas, ultimately chasing down one that stole her holocam, led to her and the younglings falling into a ravine as the Night Lights began. During the phenomenon, Kami took advantage of the meekas' enjoyment of playing catch. She tossed one a grappling hook up to where it was perched at the top of the ravine. When the creature threw it back, it looped the cable around a tree branch, allowing for the Jedi to use the hook and cable as a pulley system to raise each other out of the ravine and enjoy the dazzling lights.

name: Blue-spotted preaky
summary: Blue-spotted preaky were types of birds that were considered beautiful by some.

name: Blue-winged mink
summary: A blue-winged mink was a type of creature with blue wings. In 134 BBY, while Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon was training in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, she scrambled through a rope-and-bar course and mentally compared her speed and grace to that of a blue-winged mink's.

name: Bluebarb wasp
summary: Bluebarb wasps were creatures with the ability to sting individuals and cause swelling and poisoning. The venom, possessing a sharp and rancid stench, adversely affected a human's breathing and caused them to cough profusely. The Duros Shriv Suurgav once entered a nest of bluebarb wasps during his childhood, and was stung badly in the face as a result. His stings were later treated with antivenin. Prior to 22 BBY, a Clawdite disguised as collector Sinvatt Bovic used a blowgun to launch a dart containing the venom of the wasp at bounty hunter Jango Fett, striking him beneath his jawline during the latter's job at Bovic's residence on the astronomical object Fytoun. The poison entered Fett's bloodstream, causing him to cough and breath in ragged gasps. Fett located an antivenin and had his partner on the job, Zam Wesell, give it to him, before he drank it and was cured as a result.

name: Bluefish
summary: Bluefish were a relatively common species of fish notable for their small size, and blue colored skin. They could be found on multiple worlds throughout the galaxy, including lush worlds like Naboo and Yavin 4, or even more arid planets like Lok and Tatooine. Through the act of fishing, it was possible to lure and catch bluefish and use their meat as ingredients in various foodstuffs.

name: Blufferavian
summary: Blufferavians were birds native to Borcorash. They laid speckled eggs, and sometimes nested in rocky walls.

name: Blum-maggot
summary: A blum-maggot was a type of maggot. Between 5 ABY and 28 ABY, the Dulok King Gorneesh referred to the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick as a "snivelling blum-maggott" when Warrick ran to attack a group of Duloks at their camp on the Outer Rim Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Blurrg
