summary: A blurrg (plural: blurrg or blurrgs) was a non-sentient, two-legged reptilian beast of burden found throughout the galaxy. Blurrgs were notably used by the Twi'lek Resistance and Free Ryloth Movement during the Clone Wars and the Imperial Era. They were also corralled by the moisture farmer Kuiil on Arvala-7.

name: Blutopian
summary: Blutopians were a sentient species from the watery planet of Blutopia. Oolin Musters was a female Blutopian who was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire on Wobani. Oga Garra was another female Blutopian who owned Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

name: B'nishi
summary: The B'nishi were a sentient species native to the planet B'nish.

name: Boa
summary: {{Update|}} The boa was a type of snake in the galaxy. Boas were known to wrap around objects, a habit emulated by the grappling boa, a weapon named after the snake.

name: Boar-wolf
summary: Boar-wolves, also known as borras, were non-sentient, bristle-backed creatures that lived on Endor, a forested moon that orbited the planet of the same name. Boar-wolves had thick hair, humped backs, and and two tusks. They were killed for their meat by the Ewoks, a species of diminutive sentients native to Endor. Ewok hunting parties who managed to bring back boar-wolf meat were considered to have been lucky. Some Ewoks also crafted knives from boar-wolf teeth. Although boar-wolves could be dangerous, they were domesticated by the semi-sentient Gorax, who would care for the young after killing their mother.

name: Boar wolfcale
summary: The boar wolfcale was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of boar-wolf.

name: Bocatt
summary: Bocatts were predatory creatures native to the desert planet Tatooine. They had brown, leathery hide and two tusks. In 1 ABY, a cargo containing bocatts in cages was shipped to Tansarii Point Station, a space station in the Bright Jewel system. Upon being unloaded on the station, the creatures escaped the cages and attacked a guard. A spacer working for the station's hunter Raylen Finn later rescued the guard and killed a number of beasts.

name: Bodach'i
summary: Bodach'i were a species of sentient, pale-skinned reptiles. They had a tail and scaly skin. Following the rise of the Galactic Empire, the Bodach'i showed open defiance towards the regulations established by that new regime. Their planet was invaded by Imperial forces and the entire Bodach'i species was enslaved as punishment. Several Bodach'i were forced to work in the spice mines of Kerev Doi's Lower-Sea Province.

name: Boetay
summary: The boetay was a species of canine-like predator native to Garos IV. It hunted small, furry animals called hojvok. They where also sometimes used as pack animals, or for riding, by the inhabitants of Garos IV.

name: Bog guppy
summary: The bog guppy was a species of small fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War.

name: Bog rat
summary: Bog rats were carnivorous creatures found on the planet Bogano. They were quadrapeds with hardened skin and one large eye, but poor eyesight, making them easy prey for the oggdo. The creatures attacked in packs, feeding on smaller creatures such as boglings, though they weren't above attacking sentients as well. In 14 BBY, former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis was attacked by several bog rats on Bogano while trying to reach the ancient Vault built by the Zeffonians.

name: Bog slug
summary: The bog slug was a type of slug that lived in bogs on the Outer Rim Territories swamp planet Dagobah. Whenever they were available, the alien Jedi Master Yoda used bog slugs as an ingredient in the Mud and Bug Soup meal—which he admitted did not taste good—during his exile on the planet from 19 BBY to 4 ABY. Yoda eventually included a menu including the Mud and Bug Soup—and noting the bog slugs—in a travel guide he authored.

name: Bogan's brown nafen
summary: The Bogan's brown nafen, colloquially referred to as the butterbat, was one of the largest of the many species of nafen found throughout the galaxy. Bogan's brown nafen was widespread on many of the galaxy's warmer habitable planets. Bogan's brown nafen had a three stage life cycle. As juveniles, they were wingless, tailless rodents less than two centimeters in length. They were nocturnal herbivores which burrowed through the soil eating roots and tubers. At some point, a mysterious biological trigger would cause a juvenile's growth rate to greatly increase. Soon afterwards, the juvenile would burrow deeply into the ground and secrete a very sticky sebum from its skin. This sebum combined with its fur to form a cocoon. While in the cocoon, the nafen's wings, fangs, and poison glands developed. Upon maturity, the nafen would emerge from the cocoon, dig its way out of the ground, and fly off to join a swarm. Like all nafen, adult Bogan's brown nafen were flying insectivores who gathered their food on the wing. Since a population of these creatures would help control the population of insect pests, they were sometimes considered beneficial. However, these benefits were generally outweighed by the hazards of a Bogan's brown nafen population. For one, they were highly territorial, and traveled in large swarms which would attack any creature that strayed too close to their nests. They also had venomous fangs, though their venom was mild enough and their teeth small enough that a humanoid attacked by up to ten nafen would be essentially unharmed. However, larger swarms could inject enough poison to lead to a coma or death. Perhaps because of this effective defense, Bogan's brown nafen had no natural predators as adults. Even worse than the dangers posed by their venom was their role in spreading disease. The Hardan plague that killed 98% of the population of Dagelin Minor was later traced to a single shipment of Bogan's brown nafen imported to control the dhuru fly population. It was illegal to import nafen of any species to many systems, primarily to avoid spreading diseases. However, some systems actually encouraged their importation to attack insect pests. Some reptilian sentient species considered juvenile Bogan's brown nafen a delicacy.

name: Bogaranth
summary: Bogaranths were large, quadrupedal carnivorous creatures. They produced noxious slime when they were hungry, which was frequently. The Nihil used bogaranths in a battle rink onboard the Gaze Electric, wherein one contestant would ride the creature while a second served as a slime runner who guided the creature while attempting to avoid being eaten.

name: Bogling
summary: Boglings were small furry creatures native to the planet Bogano. They dug a number of tunnels and nests throughout the rocky plains and marshes of Bogano, working in large packs. They were preyed upon by both the bog rats and splox, with the latter often luring boglings out of the burrows to be attacked by bog rats, allowing the splox to enter the burrow and eat the bogling's eggs. Boglings could be considered valuable on the black market. The Latero Greez Dritus accidentally brought a group of boglings to the planet Koboh.

name: Bogstalker
summary: Bogstalkers were ancient creatures from the planet Taris. Before the Jedi Civil War, no one was able to see these creatures, but after Darth Malak's bombardment, bogstalkers appeared again on the planet's devastated surface. They survived for hundreds of years beneath Taris's sprawling undercity and, during the Cold War, they could be seen flying around the planet's toxic swamps. After its "rebirth", the pollution from Taris's destroyed industries made the bogstalkers more resilient and mutated their flesh, making them poisonous to most predators, even the voracious rakghouls.

name: Bogwing
summary: Bogwings were a reptavian species native to the planet Naboo. During Gulliball games played by Gungans, bogwings were released into the sky to signal halftime. Bogwings were known to be able to carry nine times their own weight. They were also very territorial. They could also be found on the swampy world of Dagobah, where they made their homes in gnarltrees. Other locations where they could be sighted were Aleen, Zygerria, Onderon, and Nal Hutta. There were two kinds of bogwings: the Greater Bogwing and the Lesser Bogwing.

name: Bol
summary: The bol was a species of mammal native to the planet of Dantooine. It was used primarily to produce milk, but also was a popular mount even outside of Dantooine. They were often hunted for their hide; however, due to over-hunting the population of bols was in steady decline. The hunting originated from the Dantooine Mining Outpost, where thousands of hunters and creature handlers gathered to hunt bols or to tame them. The bols usually frequented an area about a mile away from the outpost, so the hunters did not have to go far to kill them and destroy their homes. Bols produced milk. Bols could be domesticated by skilled beast masters and used as mounts for transportation.

name: Bolle bol
summary: The Bolle bol was a type of creature that could be found on Naboo and Endor.

name: Bolma
summary: Bolmas were reptiles that lived on Dathomir. They grazed in herds. Generally they were docile beasts, but elder males could be aggressive. Their physiology was almost exactly like a dewback, save two short shoulder spikes, and stubby eye stalks. Though primarily native to Dathomir, bolmas were known to also live on Endor's forest moon.

name: Bolotaur
summary: The Bolotaur was a large, long-necked reptilian creature native to Kashyyyk.

name: Bolraida
summary: Bolraidas were an animal species native to the planet Alderaan, distant relatives to the Iraida. They were considered one of the most aggressive animals in the galaxy that was a sharp contrast to the tranquility of their homeworld. Brutally effective hunters, they were known for running down prey with their powerful front legs before they gouged them with their hook-like tusks that protruded from their lower jaws. Early Alderaanian settlers were initially shocked to encounter these violent beasts and bolraida attacks were the leading cause of death on the otherwise paradise world. They were also noted for being impossible to train with every attempt made to domesticate them ending in disaster.

name: Bolstyngar
summary: Bolstyngars were carnivores indigenous to Kashyyyk. They were one of the quietest predators found in the jungles of the planet Kashyyyk, despite the fact that they stood more the four meters in height. Bolstyngars used a pair of auditory clusters to help them locate their prey, but these hypertympanic clusters also gave the bolstyngar the ability to hear virtually every sound the jungle made. Thus, the average bolstyngar was continually bombarded by sound, and it often preyed on those creatures that annoyed them the most.

name: Boltrunian
summary: Boltrunians were a sentient species which existed in the galaxy. Some Boltrunians were present in the medcenter of the Starlight Beacon space station when Administrator Velko Jahen arrived and was escorted through the facility by Okana. They originated from the Boltrunia system in the Outer Rim Territories.

name: Boma
summary: Bomas were ravenous beasts native to Onderon and its moon Dxun. Although most bomas were generally small, there were some that were extremely large in size, as experienced by the Jedi Exile and her companions while exploring the moon. They were dangerous predators and known to kill Mandalorians, but they themselves were preyed upon by the zakkeg beasts. Furthermore, they were, like most beasts of Dxun and Onderon, preyed upon by Drexl.
distinctions: Squat face with 2 horns and 2 tusks

name: Bomat
summary: A Bomat was a carnivorous creature native to Aruza. Considered a pest, they were attracted to gobbets of flesh.

name: Bomodon
summary: The Bomodons were a sentient species native to the planet Bomodon in the Churba sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. In 0 BBY, a number of Bomodon bounty hunters were present on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine and were witnessed by the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo entering Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the spaceport city Mos Eisley.

name: Bonbrak
summary: Bonbraks, also known as the barat-karabak, were a diminutive hairy sentient species native to the planet Bartokan V. They were classified as a protected species by the Galactic Republic. Several Bonbraks worked in the garage of the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram during the High Republic Era.

name: Bone gnasher
summary: Bone gnashers were a breed of subterranean arachne native to the planet Endor. Bone gnashers were so called because they were able to rapidly strip the flesh off corpses.

name: Bonegnawer
summary: Bonegnawers were a type of carnivorous bird of prey that lived on the desert planet Tatooine. Large, airborne creatures, they possessed strong beaks that could crush both rocks and bone. Bonegnawers targeted relatively large prey, and were known for stalking their target before consuming it on the spot. Bonegnawer parents would then bring the prey's bones back to their young at their nest, where they ate and shared the marrow with their offspring. The Flaming Ragerunner insignia seen on Luke Skywalker's personal T-16 skyhopper was likely a stylized bonegnawer.

name: Bon's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The individual Bon was a member of this species.

name: Bony hutta toad
summary: Bony hutta toads were a species of toad with an evenly-spaced grid of mismatched horns and bumps on their backs. Cities on the planet Dorin were often compared to the backs of bony hutta toads.
distinctions: Evenly spaced grid of mismatched horns and bumps

name: Bonzami
summary: Bonzami were large, four-legged beasts that could be found on Bahryn, one of Geonosis' moons. They had large, axe-shaped jaws, and were resistant to blaster bolts.

name: Boohar electric snake
summary: Boohar electric snakes were a species of snake. They were mentioned to hunt prey.

name: Boohar great scorpion
summary: Boohar great scorpion were scorpions.

name: Boolah
summary: Boolahs were a type of rodent native to the planet Kwenn. They possessed white fur and had a long, slinky body. Pogee Shrag owned a number of boolahs that had been abandoned by residents of Kwenn who had left the planet.

name: Boosodian
summary: The Boosodians were a sentient species with gray skin and twenty eyes that lived in the galaxy. Amuncie Tidian was a Boosodian who worked as a forger. In 9 BBY, a Boosodian vendor on Daiyu sold clothes to Obi-Wan Kenobi and Leia Organa whilst they were escaping the planet. Boosodian eyes were able to see a huge portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, which extended from x-rays to radio waves (though the latter was difficult to focus on). Additionally, Boosodians could focus on a specific part of the spectrum that they wished to watch closely.

name: Bora-finch
summary: Bora-finches were a type of yellow-and-blue bird.

name: Borcatu
summary: Borcatu were small, bad-tempered scavengers originally found on the planet of Escabar. Their original habitat was the deserts of Serhan, in the northeastern part of the planet. Beginning circa 150 BBY, when the ports of Escabar were opened to interstellar trade, the creatures began to spread from their homeworld by stowing away on departing starships. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, they could be found on planets from the Core Worlds to the Outer Rim Territories. Though originally desert animals, they easily adapted to habitats ranging from lush forests to urban slums. Borcatu had a scaly, thick hide which may have evolved to help resist sandstorms. They also have sharp teeth and claws, which they used to burrow or to defend themselves. They had a vicious temperament, biting anyone who came near them, and often fighting and cannibalizing one another when no other food source was available. Eliminating a borcatu infestation was difficult. Their mottled, dark skin made effective camouflage, and their pups were only a few centimeters long. As they were originally desert-adapted creatures, their metabolisms were also highly efficient, and they left very little waste. This made them difficult to find—and their natural weapons and quick movements made them tough to exterminate when they were found. Capital ships could host dozens of borcatu without the crew being aware of the infestation.

name: Bordok
summary: Bordoks were a species of sure-footed equine herbivores native to the forest moon Endor. Since the bordoks could carry large loads relative to their small size, the sentient Ewoks used them as both pack animals and mounts.

name: Borer beetle
summary: The borer beetle was a type of insect native to Kashyyyk. Wookiee shields were often stylized with the telltale eyespots found on the backs of these creatures. In 1 ABY a spacer found a specimen of this species on the premises of the Dathomir Imperial Prison. It is unknown how it found its way there.

name: Borgax
summary: The borgax was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of borgle bat and mawgax.

name: Borgle bat
summary: Borgle bats were large, nocturnal creatures native to the caves of Rori, one of the moons of Naboo. Being carnivorous creatures, they were known for capturing living prey and bringing them back to their warrens, where they would slowly drain the bodies of blood. They would then stack the bones of their victims in large cairns within their prescribed nesting area. The borgles were not believed to be originally native to Rori. Their homeworld was a mystery, but they also occurred on Endor.

name: Borhek
summary: Bred for pit fighting, borheks were usually genetically modified creatures measuring two meters in height, and their capacity to endure as well as absorb damage made them common in competitions, such as those seen on the Outland Station. This practice was so ancient that no one truly knew where borheks originated from. [[File:Borhekjango.jpg|thumb|left|Jango Fett fighting a borhek in the Outland Station arena.]] They were large insectine creatures covered with a color-changing carapace possessed of six limbs. Borheks were known to be remarkably strong because their exoskeleton could deflect blaster bolts. This armor was studded with spikes that would wound the borhek's attackers. The creature's head featured a prominent horn which allowed it to gore its target, making them equally dangerous, charging or evading a target. While the armor and spikes were strong they were also flexible and allowed the beast to curl into a ball and roll on the ground. This was usually done when the beast felt threatened by an attacker. The borhek's mandibles allowed it to clamp onto its victim after biting. Borheks were known to be temperamental creatures that would easily be goaded into a rampage, this tendency was exploited by those who used them in pit fights. Borheks were often fitted with illegal pain stimulators that induced the beast's rage, provoking them to attack their opponent. The Outland Transit Station notably hosted borhek pit fights in an arena, with a yellow champion borhek which remained undefeated until the cheating ways of Meeko Ghintee resulted in its death. Jango Fett, hunting Meeko due to the bounty on his head, was forced to contend with Meeko's rigged borhek which he killed after a brief fight. However, the deaths of the champion borhek and the one Meeko stole and rigged resulted in a 10,000 credit bounty being issued for his death, ironically enough being claimed by Fett.

name: Borleian imooda
summary: The Borleian imooda was a reptile with a spiked tail that resided in the jungle regions of Borleias.

name: Borlorian
summary: The Borlorians were a sentient species originating from the Borloria system in the Expansion Region's Dentari sector. Members of the species were able to sneer. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Merex was a Galactic Basic Standard–speaking Borlorian who had a years-long rivalry with the alien gambler and con artist Jabot. At one point, the two were the last two remaining players at a game of Helcos. Jabot—who was communicating via an implant communicator with his partner Dereth, who fed him information on Merex's cards—manipulated Merex into matching his bet of ten thousand credits and then tripling the wager. After Jabot ultimately revealed his superior hand of cards, the Borlorian howled in discontent, resulting in glasses around the room they were in shattering.

name: Borlovian
summary: The Borlovians were a feathered race native to the planet Borlov that communicated with multi-layered whistles and trills. They were a timid species with a medieval social structure that valued stability; mobility and change were quite frowned upon, and most never left the city or village of their birth. Space travel was all but unthinkable until the Borlovian misfit Llollulion departed with smuggler Booster Terrik.

name: Bormterran
summary: The Bormterrans were four-armed, fearsome, loyal, dragon-like, reptiloid sapients indigenous to Bormter. They were fierce melee combatants, which made them perfect for recruitment into Warlord Delurin's dragon troopers. Being from a primitive culture, they were not very comfortable with advanced technology but adapted to using it. They grew to an average height of 1.9 meters.

name: Bormu
summary: The Bormu were an enormous herbivorous creatures that inhabited the green plains of Balmorra. Bormus moved in herds through the plains and, despite their enormous size, they were gentle beasts and quite friendly to the people of the nearby settlements. They did not attack anyone and, if threatened, they relied on the strength of the entire herd for protection, stomping the predator. When Imperial forces bombarded the planet during the Cold War, many of the slow-moving giants were wiped out. With their number drastically decreased, Bormus had to face the pollution from the destroyed factories of the planet, which poisoned the land, their only source of food. Since their numbers were so low after the bombardment, they were easily overwhelmed by smaller but faster predators, such as the zeldrate. At the end of the conflict, the Bormu was at the brink of extinction, and only a few specimens survived the entire war.

name: Borneck
summary: Bornecks were Near-Humans native to the planet Vellity.

name: Borrim Shub's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Borrim Shub was a member of this species.

name: Bosph precursor species
summary: A species of primitive mammalian omnivores evolved on the Outer Rim planet of Bosph. Members of the species had six limbs and were hunted by predators called Luprisi which they had to out smart to avoid. The species eventually evolved into the sentient Bosph species, who maintained their precursors species six limbs.

name: Bosph
summary: The Bosphs were a mammalian species from the planet of Bosph in the Outer Rim Territories' Bosph sector. They had six limbs, no neck and a pair of multiple-lensed eyes that also functioned as auditory sense organs. The Bosphs were a fiercely independent and isolationist species who preferred seclusion from both the rest of the galaxy and each other. The homeworld, where most Bosphs remained, was controlled by a hierarchical government made up of various factions each consisting of Force-sensitive Bosphs. These Bosphs were the only individuals who had the right to claim ownership of any object, though any unclaimed object was equally owned by all Bosphs. The Bosphs also kept a tradition of recording the history of their travels, both on Bosph and in the galaxy by tattooing star maps on to their skin. Despite their isolation from the galaxy, the Bosphs' homeworld was bombarded by the Galactic Empire after Emperor Palpatine learned of their Force-sensitive government. The attack devastated the planet's surface and killed many Bosphs. Those left alive mostly remained on their homeworld, partially due to a quarantine by the Imperial Navy. All Bosphs, however, took up a policy of disremembrance toward the Empire, which was considered the greatest insult a Bosph could give. The attitude meant they no longer acknowledged the existence of the Empire and ignored its laws, believing that the bombardment had actually been punishment from a deity-like entity they called the Yentarr, meaning the "unknown spirits." One of the most famous Bosphs in the galaxy was the smuggler Bora Boru who worked during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Another Bosph during this period worked as a bounty hunter and answered Darth Vader's call to hunt the Corellian smuggler and Rebel Han Solo and his ship, the Millennium Falcon. During the reign of the New Republic, a Bosph named Morga Bunna opened a supply depot on Bosph's outermost moon after retiring from work as a bounty hunter. Bunna was questioned by the Jedi archivist Mander Zuma during the Jedi's quest to shut down the Tempest spice trade.
skinColor: From light brown to dark gray

name: Bothan
summary: Bothans were a group known for operating a spy network. Bothans were known to communicate with each other in a series of growls. Bothan spies were credited with obtaining information concerning the location of DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station, despite sustaining heavy casualties, thereby enabling the Rebel Alliance to plan an attack on the unfinished space station. The Bothans also provided the Rebel Alliance with other useful information, such as the door code for the shield generator bunker on the forest moon of Endor. They forged false chain codes that were implanted into Aqualish by Nautolan doctors.

name: Bothel's species
summary: Bothel and Trud were members of an elephantine species.

name: Botori
summary: The Botori, also known as the Botor, were a sentient species that inhabited around two dozen star systems in the Botor Enclave of the Core Worlds. Since the early period of the Galactic Republic, the Botori and the Dawferim Humans of the nearby Daupherm Planet States engaged in many wars, some of which lasted for centuries. Around 10 ABY, the Botor Enclave declared its independence from both the Galactic Empire and the New Republic.

name: Bottle bug
summary: Bottle bug was a species of insect native to the world of Haruun Kal. They were the favored prey of snapfish.

name: Bouf rat
summary: A bouf rat was a type of rodent that was preyed upon by a lyxine. While waiting to inform the Sith Lord Darth Vader that the crew of the Executor-class Star Dreadnought and flagship of the elite Imperial fleet Death Squadron, the Executor, had located the YT-1300 light freighter, the Millennium Falcon, newly-made Admiral Firmus Piett compared himself to a lyxine watching a bouf rat as he detailed how he had risen through the ranks of the Imperial Navy.

name: Bouncer
summary: Bouncers were the native sentient species of Ruusan. Globe-like green-furred creatures, they received their name from their method of locomotion: propelled by the wind, they bounced themselves off obstacles to reach great heights. Their bodies were covered in green fur, and numerous tentacles grew from their body, of which half ended in delta shaped appendages capable of digging and writing in the ground. The Bouncers' homeworld was the location of a great battle between the forces of the Army of Light and the Brotherhood of Darkness during the New Sith Wars. The Bouncers tried to ease the struggles of both sides, bringing support and comfort to the dying using their mild telepathic abilities. When the conflict ended with Lord Kaan unleashing the thought bomb, trapping the spirits of hundreds of Jedi and Sith inside, the Bouncers maintained a prophecy that "a Knight would come, a battle would be fought, and the prisoners go free." The Bouncers helped fulfill the prophecy when they guided the Jedi Kyle Katarn to the planet's Valley of the Jedi over a thousand years later. A Bouncer was also responsible for the survival of Rain, who went on to become the Sith Lord Darth Zannah.

name: Bovorian
summary: Bovorians were a species of sapient mammals indigenous to Bovo Yagen.
distinctions: Able to see into the infrared spectrum

name: Bozzie Baranta's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Bozzie Baranta was a member of this species.

name: Bpfasshi
summary: The Bpfasshi were a humanoid species associated with the religion the Truthsayers of Bpfassh. In 382 BBY, one member of the species who was a Truthsayer confronted Ran Yaltan for pretending to be a Truthsayer in the Holy City on the moon Jedha. They originated from the Bpfassh system.

name: Bracil
summary: Bracil were a species that lived in herds in the Hutt Space planet Klatooine's Ferelakk Savannah. The creatures were domesticated by Klatooine's native Klatooinians and served both as mounts and as one of the primary food sources for the savannah's residents.

name: Brackaset
summary: Brackaset were docile mount beasts that lived on Dathomir. They had an almost identical appearance to the falumpaset of Naboo. However, they are distinctly separated as a species for their skin folds that resembled armored plating. Brackasets could be domesticated and used as mounts for transportation.

name: Brain crawler
summary: Brain crawlers were a type of parasitic worm whose homeworld was Cheelit in the Mid Rim. They could infest the brains of members of the domesticated happabore species, which could be found on planets throughout the Western Reaches. The instruction manual for the slurry formulation of Galacti-Stok's Happy-Bore Medicated Dewormer—a product containing Trestibinexocycline 5-Gamma, thlank oil, greel-root acid, and forage products—recommended that the dewormer not be used to treat brain crawler infestations. The scavenger Rey found a copy of the instructions while living on the desert planet Jakku and included them in a survival guide that she had compiled by 34 ABY.

name: Brain slug
summary: Brain slugs or brain-slugs, were a species of slugs that hailed from Nusa Sept V. They had mouths and tongues, but lacked eyes. The commonly used phrase "like stealing slime from a brain-slug" meant that something was very easy.

name: Brain worm
summary: Brain worms were a species of parasitic worm from the planet Geonosis which were capable of entering the body of a host and taking control of it and had the potential to control entire societies. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Geonosian Queen Karina the Great used brain worms to control a host of undead Geonosians. After Republic forces defeated Karina and her minions, a brain worm managed to infect the clone trooper Scythe and used him to infect a number of other clones in Tango Company as well as the Jedi Padawan Barriss Offee onboard the Republic medical frigate TB-73. Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano was able to prevent the infection from spreading further by using extremely low temperatures to combat the worms, saving Offee and most of the troopers.

name: Bramblefish
summary: The bramblefish was a type of fish found on the Core World of Velusia. They could be giant in size. At one point during the Imperial Period, a group of adventurers on Velusia searching for a lost aquascout were forced to contend with a gigantic bramblefish that was attracted by the shine of the adventurers' own aquascout.

name: Bramlik
summary: Bramliks, also known as spikers by the locals, were spherical creatures indigenous to Koboh. If a bramlik was approached, the spines on its back would extend, deterring most threats. Although not usually aggressive, the bramlik would attack if confronted with a dangerous situation.

name: Brangus Glee's species
summary: A sentient species existed with a dexterous anatomy that included a head and a humanoid torso with two thin arms and long, wiry fingers. Their head featured two eyes, two nostrils, and a mouth, with a long neck connecting their head to their chest. The species was renowned for travelers. Brangus Glee, a Force-sensitive elder of the species with brown skin, originated from the planet Dor Nameth. Glee frequented casinos and spaceports during the Galactic Civil War.
distinctions: Thin arms with long, wiry fingers

name: Bravaisian
summary: The Bravaisians were a short, long-snouted sentient species that were native to Bravais. They had a dexterous tongue that they often used instead of their fingers. They were nocturnal, due to the intense heat of their homeworld and avoided daylight to protect their small sensitive eyes. When offworld, most Bravaisians wore goggles to protect their eyes. They also developed from a precursor species. Munduri and Sonsigo were two Bravaisians who were frequent sights at the castle of Maz Kanata.

name: Bravaisian precursor species
summary: A species of insectivorous animals with long, muscular tongues and flexible snouts eventually evolved into the sentient Bravaisian species. They were pack hunters that used their sturdy snouts to dig through the dirt and sand in search of tubers and nests of insects.
distinctions: Flexible snouts, long and muscular tongues

name: Brayan
summary: Brayans were a sentient species from the planet Bray. During the Clone Wars, a village on Bray was terrorized by Lord Ravna, leading to the local Brayan population to ask the Jedi Council for help. The Jedi Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi and Adi Gallia were then sent to the planet, and the Jedi successfully defeated both Ravna and Count Dooku, freeing the Brayans.

name: Breather Gand
summary: The breathers were a rare Gand subspecies. Scientists were unsure if this race was of an older evolutionary stock, destined to either die out or further evolve; or if they were another coexisting race. This subspecies possessed lungs, along with the usual assortment of internal organs that were typical for most humanoid species. These Gands were adapted to breathing only ammonia and, unlike the lungless variety, could not survive offworld without respiratory gear. Oxygen exposure could burn the inside of the lungs like acid, which would require organ transplants. If a breather Gand were exposed to oxygen, that individual would display various respiratory symptoms, which included chest pain, shortness of breath, and coughing, which would bring up blood. Due to the unavailability of the necessary treatment to repair the damage, offworld Gands stricken with oxygen inhalation had a higher mortality rate. Zuckuss, a Gand bounty hunter, was a member of this subspecies, as was his second-cousin Lu'daal-ud.

name: Brendoki flutterby
summary: Brendoki flutterby were a species of butterfly-like insect that were found on the planet Brendok. It was translucent and flew with its two diaphanous red wings. In 148 BBY, Verosha and Mae-ho Aniseya used the Force on one insect by a bunta tree on Brendok, holding it in place.
skinColor: Transluscent with blue and red hues

name: Brezak
summary: Brezaks, also known as Zygerrian gliding lizards, were giant reptavian lizards that were able to glide via their skin flaps.

name: Bri'ahl
summary: The Bri'ahls were humanoids indigenous to the forested planet of Bri'ahl. They had pink skin, large eyes that lacked colored irises, squarish noses, large sharp teeth, funnel-shaped ears, and three fingers and a thumb on each hand.
distinctions: Large eyes, squarish noses, sharp teeth

name: Bri'ahlian creature
summary: A green-skinned, yellow-eyed, quadripedal species of creatures with long snouts lived on the planet Bri'ahl. In 19 BBY, one such creature considered eating the discarded head of the protocol droid C-3PO, but ultimately decided against it and tossed the head down a hill.

name: Brigian
summary: The Brigians were a humanoid species native to the planet of Brigia, in the Tion Hegemony. They were thin and tall with purple skin and red eyes. The planet also had a sensitive ecosystem, requiring all incoming ships to undergo a phase-one decontamination before landing. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Yuuzhan Vong invaded Brigia. The native Brigians resisted at first, though they were eventually forced to go underground and begin a guerrilla war. The desperate Brigians pleaded with the Corporate Sector Authority for help, but the business minded organization ignored them. Ultimately, the surviving Brigians were enslaved and implanted with surge-coral implants.

name: Brine-eel
summary: Brine-eels were a large non-sentient species of eel that lived in salt water.

name: Brine-maggot
summary: Brine-maggots were a type of maggot that lived in groups known as schools. In 4 ABY, worry gnawed at the New Republic Mon Calamari Admiral Gial Ackbar like a school of brine-maggots after he learned that the Galactic Empire was blockading the planet Akiva and enacting a communications blackout there for reasons he did not know.

name: Britarro
summary: The Britarro were a mysterious sentient humanoid species that were native to Britaxis Minor. Nik Hepho was a Britarro who worked as a bounty hunter.

name: Brith
summary: The brith were a species of large, flying creatures that were indigenous to the grassy Outer Rim world of Dantooine. Their fin-like wings gave them the appearance of swimming through the air. The brith were similar in both appearance and behavior to the Felucian flying manta and, to a lesser extent, the thrantas of Alderaan.
skinColor: Green and purple (dorsal side), white (ventral side)

name: Brixian
summary: Brixians were a sentient species that originated from the Brix system. The Butcher of Brix was a member of this species.

name: Brizzit
summary: The Brizzit were a insectoid sentient species, difficult to identify by name and face. Tzizvvt was a Brizzit. Although he had been treasure hunting on Jandoon, that was not his homeworld; though there was a colony of Brizzit established there. Industrial Automaton's LOM-series protocol droids, which had insectoid heads designed to seem familiar to insectoid sentients, were marketed towards insectoid species such as the Brizzit.

name: B'rknaa
summary: The B'rknaa were a mineral-based sentient species native to Indobok, a moon orbiting the planet Kalarba in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. In actuality, the moon was itself an enormous member of the species. The B'rknaa's true appearance was that of crystalline clusters, but their inner energy could induce life into inanimate matter. When they were deemed old enough to take up a host body, the B'rknaa crystals animated giant stone husks in which they could move about. These sentients were considered unusual by Humans, and they were known to Jedi biologists for their resistance to Force abilities. The B'rknaa were also capable of merging together several stone bodies to form a much larger unit. The B'rknaa of Indobok were known to the wider galactic community since at least the first millennium before the Battle of Yavin. Compared to the civilized worlds of the galaxy, their technology level was very low: they did not build cities and wore no clothing, but they did develop a language of their own. Despite their bulky appearance, they were usually friendly to strangers, with the notable exception of those who tried to steal B'rknaa crystals. Around 6 BBY, the pirate Jace Forno planned on stealing some of them so she could supply the black market. Thanks to the intervention of the Pitareeze family from Kalarba, Forno's henchmen were driven off, and her plan was thwarted. Twenty years later, during the Great War, the B'rknaa were put in jeopardy when the Yuuzhan Vong, a species of extra-galactic invaders, destroyed Kalarba, dispersing radioactive material across the system in the process.
distinctions: Sentient mineral beings with high energy potential

name: Brodihi
summary: The Brodihi were a sentient species that had a pair of horns and a long snout. Artifacts of the Brodihi were recovered by the Chiss Ascendancy from a wrecked starship and displayed in an art gallery, though the Chiss did not know the beings' exact origins. After analyzing the artifacts, which included Brodihi dinnerware, the Chiss cadet Mitth'raw'nuru "Thrawn" deduced that the species possessed a rigid hierarchy and that they preferred short-range combat.

name: Brogune
summary: The Brogune were a sentient species with four eyes. In 22 BBY, a Brogune served as a concubine for the Hutt Soergg Vosadii Bezhin, who was a Bossban—a criminal leader—based on the Mid Rim planet Ansion. The Brogune was one of his many concubines, which included Humans and members of other species. Brogune were among the species whose females the Hutt found attractive.

name: Brolf
summary: Brolfi, singular Brolf, were a species of furry sentients who inhabited the planet of Barlok. Their skin, referred to as hornskin, was colored between different shades of green and yellow, and quivered when the Brolf was feeling emotional. They also had stumpy legs. Caulfmar was the governor of Barlok in the time before the Clone Wars during the time the Galactic Republic was planning to launch Outbound Flight.

name: Brosin
summary: Brosins were Near-Humans from Brosi.

name: Brownie
summary: The Brownies were a diminutive, long-lived species from Andowyne that defied most scientifc classifications. While they appeared magical, Brownies possessed little to no affinity for the Force, though they respected the supernatural and showed reverence for the fey folk with whom they shared the forests of Andowyne. As a species, Brownies tended to live in communities they referred to as kingdoms—a testament to their apparent inflated opinion of their place in the world—in small numbers, and appeared to be a predominantly male society as female Brownies went uncataloged along with the species' gender roles and reproductive systems. Despite their small stature, they were resourceful and extremely loyal, prostrating themselves before, and willing do to the bidding of Cherlindrea. Coupled with a tendency for pranks, however, the Brownies were considered to be pests and vermin by the planet's other species. Some Brownies were known to have kidnapped a Daikini baby.

name: Brrbrlpp
summary: The Brrbrlpp were the indigenous species of the planet Esfandia. They were often referred to by offworlders as the Cold Ones since it was easier to say than Brrbrlpp. They spoke a form of trinary via radio-waves which was taught to them by Commander Si of the Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base. The Brrbrlpp as a species were talkative and their calls could travel great distances. Like many other sentient species, Brrbrlpp youth were willing to risk death for excitement. Since Esfandia could not support a large and varied ecosystem, the species was never plentiful and during the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War, it was estimated that there were several thousand Brrbrlpp. On Esfandia, the Brrbrlpp tend massive gardens and bred swarms of flying insects which they traded for trace minerals filtered from the air.

name: Bruallki
summary: Bruallki was a herd animal used for food, which could braised and eaten formally at dinner, or cold as a light snack. Menkooro whiskey was considered to be the perfect accompaniment to bruallki, leading to the old saying "If you had some bruallki, you could have bruallki and Menkooro…if you had some Menkooro." Talon Karrde fed bruallki to his pet vornskr, Drang. In a formal dining setting, one should never use a three-pronged fork to eat bruallki.

name: Brubb
summary: Brubbs were reptilian bipeds from the planet of Baros in the Baros system. To adapt to life on an arid world with frequent sandstorms, the ancestors of the Brubbs evolved thick skins and tough, transparent membranes over their eyes for protection. Since there was little to hear on Baros other than howling winds, Brubbs were nearly deaf. Brubbs were strong for their size (1.5 to 1.7 meters tall), due to their origins on a high-gravity world. Brubbs also had the limited ability to camouflage themselves by changing skin color, though the color range was only from yellow to a greenish-gray. [[File:CorellianMerchantsGuild-GG9.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Brubb at a CMG guildhouse]] Brubbs were a very social people, living in large communal groups called habas. Most habas were extended family groups which raised children communally and operated some specialized business together, such as a farm, a mine, or even a vacation resort. Certain "university" habas, however, were drawn from the best and brightest of many habas. These groups had technology approaching galactic standard, especially in the areas of solar and wind power. According to Obo Rin's Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy, it was one of these university habas that first made contact with the outside galaxy, by beaming radio signals which eventually came to the attention of the Galactic Empire. Some evidence exists of earlier Brubb contact with other inhabited worlds, however. In 32 BBY, a cantina in Mos Espa on Tatooine was known as "The Blue Brubb". Each haba was governed by its ten oldest Brubbs. As female Brubbs had a lower life expectancy, due to the stress of egg-laying, the leaders were almost always male. At the same time that the Brubbs were dealing with first contact with aliens, many female Brubbs were arguing for an equal share in haba leadership, and protesting by refusing to lay eggs. [[File:Brasck.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Brasck]] Since Baros was a high-gravity world with few natural resources and low-tech natives, the Brubbs did not see much interstellar trade. Their main commodities were the Brubbs themselves—their strength and toughness made them prized mercenaries and laborers. Jabba the Hutt employed some Brubbs as guards on Khetanna, his sail barge. Other Brubbs, due to their sociable nature and interesting appearance, became "ornamental" beings hired as retainers for wealthy Core Worlders.
distinctions: Limited camouflage ability, thick skins, poor hearing, lived in communal habas.

name: Bruise-leech crawler
summary: Bruise-leech crawlers, alternatively known as Nelvaan bruise-leech crawlers, were leech-like creatures native to the Outer Rim planet of Nelvaan. Orvos, shaman of Rokrul village on Nelvaan, covered Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker's chest with bruise-leech crawlers as part of a ritual before sending him off to destroy a nearby Techno Union laboratory. The leeches caused pain as they crawled over Skywalker's torso and left behind blue trails.

name: Brush bat
summary: The brush bat was a chiropteroid species from the planet Kyrouac. When startled, it would produce a horrible screech.

name: Bruwose
summary: A bruwose was a large lizard native to Moorja. The lizards were effectively blind, using sound, heat and smell to navigate. They had large fore-paw talons, which they used to sift through soft rock while hunting small prey. They had pale skin, which provided little protection in fights. Six months after the Battle of Endor, Dirk Harkness and the Black Curs landed on Moorja after their reconnaissance of the Core Worlds. Harkness was trapped by three bruwoses in the Crumbling Lands while on his way to his hidden Y-wing. He was rescued by New Republic agents shortly after.

name: Brynjak
summary: Brynjaks were non-sentient creatures in the galaxy used as mounts during the Third Galactic War. Brynjaks were often hunted for their thick hide and sharp teeth, however they were a quarry that would challenge even experienced hunters.

name: B'trillan
summary: B'trillans were a squeaky-voiced, vaguely felinoid species native to B'trilla in the Gordian Reach sector. They were often encountered as laborers on other worlds in the Reach such as Feldwes, as well as in the Kalaminth, Spadja, and Thesme sectors, though their work ethic was not as well-regarded as their cleverness. They also possessed an agricultural colony on the drought-stricken planet Atorra.

name: Bubble shark
summary: Bubble sharks were a type of shark that was on display at Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures zoo on the Outer Rim world Hon-Tallos between 3 ABY and 4 ABY. During that time, while at the zoo to liberate a rancor, the Shani bounty hunter Deva Lompop told the Starros Clan member Sana Starros to look as though she was excited to see the zoo's bubble sharks—so they could hide their intent to cause a scene at the zoo as part of their plan to free the rancor.

name: Bufopel
summary: Bufopel were a sentient humanoid species that lived in the galaxy. Some of them, known as the Bufopel Protectors, fought with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

name: Bukesek
summary: Bukesek referred to a black-skinned subspecies of Rakata who lived in the volcanic sands of Lehon.

name: Buktari
summary: The Buktari were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Hoogenz and Anonda were members of this species.

name: Bulabird
summary: Bulabirds were a species of bird native to the planet Chandrila. They had star-tipped beaks and strutted around the pebbles and sand near a bar off Junari Point. They had good hearing.

name: Bulbous
summary: The bulbous was a creature that was used as a dejarik holomonster. They were native to the planet Dorin and could project toxic gasses to kill enemies.

name: Bulfus
summary: The bulfus (plural: bulfusi) was a large flying mammal native to the Core Worlds planet of Corulag. Roughly bat-shaped but with otter-like features, bulfusi were skilled hunters with a powerful aerial attack.

name: Bunny
summary: The bunny was a diminutive rabbit-like lagomorph species of unknown origins.

name: Buro
summary: The Buro were a species of sentient insects that were considered ethereally beautiful by some other species. They were native to Kaisa, a planet located in the Corva sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Buro had no presence offworld, but their homeworld did receive some visitors, among them a Human-crewed, geological survey starship. The survey crew negligently destroyed a forest on Kaisa, and the destruction of this habitat led to the extinction of the Buro species. In 24 ABY, the Diversity Alliance, an anti-Human organization, became aware of the extinction of the Buro and the role played by the survey crew. The Alliance's leader, Nolaa Tarkona, tasked the Chironian operative Lusa with wiping clean the navigation computers of the survey crew's starship; their next jump into hyperspace would see them emerge in uncharted territory. Lusa, however, was not prepared to go through with the act, and confessed her sabotage to the geologists before their departure.

name: Burra fish
summary: Burra fish were a species of fish native to the planet of Dathomir, who's flesh was edible by the Kiffar, Dathomirians, and Latero. After fishing families on the planet Batuu cultivated the foreign Burra fish for consumption, the Burra fish was sold as a part of several notable dishes at the Black Spire Outpost on Batuu and aboard the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon.

name: Bursantian
summary: Bursantians were a bipedal species native to the planet Bursant. Bursantians were covered in short black and purple fur, had two large red eyes, two arms that ended in three clawed fingers, and two legs with four clawed toes.

name: Butcherbug
summary: Butcherbugs were a species of insect that were native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah. While living in exile on Dagobah, Jedi Grand Master Yoda often found butcherbugs and various other swamp life coming through the door of his hut. He allowed all but the most venomous creatures to stay and keep him company.

name: Butter Newt
summary: The Butter Newt was a primitive species that did not react to slow stimuli.

name: Butterfly
summary: Butterflies were flying insects that sported two pairs of large, brilliantly colored wings. The planet Maridun was notably home to the carrier butterflies, who were often used as messengers. A species of blue-winged butterflies could be found on the Forest Moon of the planet Endor. The planet Sriluur also hosted another species of butterfly. Konkiv was also home to many butterflies.

name: Buzchub
summary: The Buzchub were a species of stocky beings covered in dark blue fur. The sentients were believed to be native to Harrandarr, a remote planet in the Bosph sector. The Buzchub enjoyed traveling the galaxy, using mechanical translators to communicate with other species. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, the Buzchub Und'l worked for sympathizers of the Galactic Empire, although he believed his employers were simply spice shippers.

name: Buzzbird
summary: Buzzbirds were avians indigenous to Tenupe. They were known for the buzzing noise they made.

name: Buzzfish
summary: The buzzfish was a predatory fish species found on Endor.

name: Caamasi
summary: The Caamasi were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were covered in grey or brown fur, and had two pointed ears and a snout. Like the Alderaanians, they were noted for their pacifism. The species shared its name with the Caamasi cheese pies and the Caamasi light sculptures. The Caamasi Jedi Master Ela Sutan was a member of the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era.

name: Caarite
summary: The Caarites were a sentient porcine species indigenous to the planet Caarimon.

name: Cabrool Nuum's species
summary: This species were a species of near-Human humanoid sentients possessing gray skin and ridged craniums. Male members of this species were hairless, with wrinkled skin, while females possessed light blue hair and much smoother features. Cabrool, Norba, and Rusk Nuum were all members of this species.

name: Cacop
summary: The Cacops were a sentient species native to the celestial body Veccacopia in the Outer Rim Territories' Tunka sector. They had eyes with retinae, and the visual appearance of individual Cacops tended to be difficult to distinguish for members of other species. Veccacopia was discovered by the wider galactic community at some point before 44 BBY and was designated a protectorate of the Galactic Republic. Over time, Veccacopia's judicial office grew corrupt, with convicted Cacops hiring Cacop stand-ins to serve their sentences instead. Not long after Veccacopia's discovery, the Human Finis Valorum served as a judge there. When Valorum learned of the Cacops' deception and the inability of his bailiffs to distinguish between the guilty individuals and the doubles, he broke the corruption ring of the local judicial office by instituting a mandatory retinal scan.

name: Cairnmog
summary: Cairnmogs were large spiked lizards indigenous to Chandrila. No longer able to survive in the wild, they were confined to the rocky hills in the Hanna Wild Game Reserve. They had hooves on their feet and bony protruding spikes, which they rattled and shook in displays of dominance. A cairnmog hibernated in winter, mated in the spring, and laid eggs in the fall. Female cairnmogs abandoned their clutch of eggs in the winter, leaving their young to incubate while they attempted to survive the cold temperatures. Cairnmog hunting on Chandrila was allowed, but carefully regulated.

name: Cairoka
summary: A cairoka was a type of creature capable of flight and found on the planet Alderaan. They had wings as white as snow. By 1 BBY, the Alderaanian youngling Rel watched cairoka fly over some trees on Alderaan.

name: Cal-serpent
summary: The Cal-serpent was a non-sentient species of predatory snakes native to Dra III, a planet in the Wyl sector. Cal-serpents were sometimes hunted on safaris by off-planet, big-game hunters.

name: Caldanian
summary: The Caldanians were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They had dark brown slimy skin, tendrils, and a flexible cartilage instead of bones. A criminal was a member of this species.

name: Calian
summary: The Calians were the Human inhabitants of the planet Shiva IV, located in Wild Space. They were muscular beings, and the majority of them were strong and courageous. They were united into the Calian Confederacy and spoke Calian. For millennia they remained cut off and unknown both to the Republic and the Empire. By Galactic standards, Calians were primitive and did not understand Basic; however, they did have repulsorcraft and blasters. They were capable of entering ryastraad, a battle madness similar to that of Wookiees. The Calians reached peace with the neighboring T'Syriél only after long years of war. The Calians were attacked by the Galactic Empire, which bombarded a Calian city. The Calians ousted the Empire from Shiva IV with the help of Leia Organa.
hairColor: Usually black or dark brown, sometimes blond

name: Calibop
summary: Calibops were an avian sentient species known during the times of the New Republic. The species had manes and prehensile wingtips. They also had a reputation of being better with words than with acts, something that not even the Calibops themselves argued. A number of Calibops were seen in the galaxy, including Chief of State Ponc Gavrisom of the New Republic, Sergeant at Arms Mif Kumas and a member of Boba Fett's Mandalorian Protectors.

name: Campi
summary: The Campi were a sentient three-armed humanoid species that existed in the galaxy. Two members of the species were the emissaries Xiering and Stingxi.

name: Can-cell
summary: Can-cells were a species of flying insect found of a number of planets across the galaxy, including Batuu, Kashyyyk, Aleen, Ryloth, Rodia, Taul, and Teth. They had quad wings and large eyes, and were capable of growing to over three meters in length. While watching the Star Gauntlet podrace on Janix, Brander Lawson compared the approaching podracers to a storm of can-cells, and referred to one, Tor Braxis, as having a worrisome stinger. The sentient Wookiees of Kashyyyk believed seeing a can-cell brought the viewer good luck and based the design of their Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft on the odd-looking creatures. Can-cell were attracted to the buzzing sound made by Wookiees' Oevvaor Jet Catamarans and would often congregate at landing pads where the vehicles could be found. Some residents of the planet Batuu raised native can-cell to become pets or for other reasons. Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano rode one on Teth to escape Asajj Ventress and reach the Twilight.

name: Canakal bird
summary: A canakal bird was a species of bird that lived on the remote planet of Kesh.

name: Canary
summary: A canary was a creature known for its delicate physiology. The avian Quor'sav species had a similarly frail constitution, which led the gambler Lando Calrissian to compare their physiology to a canary sometime between 3 BBY and 2 BBY.

name: Canary moth
summary: A canary moth was a type of moth that had wings. While on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila in 5 ABY, the pilot Wedge Antilles walked through a spaceport to meet with his colleague, the pilot Norra Wexley. As he made his way toward a shuttle, he noticed sachi blossom petals flitting in the air and thought they looked similar to a canary moth's shape.

name: Candori
summary: The candori was a tentacled carnivorous creature. Mezlo, the leader of a resistance group of Oruans on Horizon Base, kept at least two candori to fend off First Order forces.

name: Candovantan
summary: {{Update|}} Candovantans, or Candovants, were a sentient species from the planet Candovant recognized by their bulbous, hairless heads and brown, tan, and red skin. The New Republic senator Zygli Bruss was a member of the species, as was the Resistance pilot Zizi Tlo. They were considered by some to be a powerful force within the political landscape of the galaxy at one point in time. In Candovantan culture it was considered a grave offense to refuse a drink when offered.

name: Cannibal arachnid
summary: Cannibal arachnids were an immense insectoid species native to Duro that were eventually driven to extinction by that planet's pollution.

name: Cannok
summary: Cannoks were small, aggressive predators native to Onderon and its moon Dxun. They were relatively harmless to Humans, but they had a habit of eating anything that could fit in their mouths. They were known as pests, due to a high reproduction rate and notable curiosity. Cannoks were hardy, able to survive the rigors of Dxun by traveling in large groups. Several cannoks were transported to Telos IV by the Ithorians of Citadel Station during the years following the Jedi Civil War to assist in the Telosian Restoration Project, restoring the world to its natural state after the damage done by Darth Malak.

name: Cannolite
summary: The Cannolites were a sentient species native to the planet Canoliss IV. Their culture was based on three-dimensional mathematics, which caused problems for offworlders visiting their planet. This was exemplified in the locking mechanisms used to secure Cannolite doors, which were virtually impossible for non-Cannolites to operate.

name: Cannus solix
summary: Cannus solix were a species of animal kept as pets during the reign of the New Republic. At least one cannus solix may have been entered into Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show, a pet show held on the planet Taris in 43 ABY. When attempting to distract the Jedi Knight Seff Hellin later that year, Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo, who had attended the pet show and seen Seff there when he helped save their granddaughter from a kidnapping attempt, pretended to argue about which creature had nearly bitten Han's ankle at the show, with Han believing it was an Ornuk and Leia stating that it was the cannus solix. Leia claimed Han didn't know the difference between the species as he had missed one of the show's judges explaining it whilst he was away starting a fight.

name: Canoid
summary: Corellian canoids, best known simply as canoids, were animals that lived on Corellia.

name: Cantrosian
summary: The Cantrosians were sapient felinoids indigenous to Cantros 7. Scratches from their paws would result in Cantrosian-scratch fever. During the Galactic Civil War, the Cantrosians were staunch supporters of the Rebel Alliance, which led to an internecine conflict when a rogue operative tried to play factions against each other by insinuating Imperial sympathies among certain Cantrosian groups.

name: Canyon adder
summary: Canyon adders were a type of venomous snake. While on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 4 ABY, the woman Esmelle criticized her sister, the New Republic pilot Norra Wexley, for abandoning her son to join the Rebel Alliance. Wexley was infuriated by her sister's words, mentally comparing her to a venomous canyon adder.

name: Canyon charger
summary: The canyon charger was a species native to the planet Phemis.

name: Canyon krayt dragon
summary: The canyon krayt dragon was the smaller and more common species of krayt dragon, a predatory reptile from Tatooine. As its name suggested, it dwelled in rock caves and canyons. Canyon krayt dragons had brown skin and yellow eyes, and their head was covered with a multitude of horns. They were far more common than their relatives, the leviathan krayt dragons. One such beast had taken up residence in the Laguna Caves by the time of the Invasion of Naboo. As a young boy, Luke Skywalker once fell into the lair of a canyon krayt dragon in one of his daring outings. A canyon krayt dragon was slain by the First Order's Supreme Leader, Kylo Ren, after escaping from the prison it had been placed in by Gardulla Besadii the Elder. Ren used the beast's remains to create a suit and weapons, which he used to return to Gardulla's fortress and kill several of her guards.

name: Canyon raptor
summary: Canyon raptors were a species of giant predatory reptavian native to the "Armorer's planet." Following the rescue of Ragnar Vizsla, the Children of the Watch named them Shriek-hawks after the Shriek-hawk Training team, which themselves shared a name with the ancient Mandalorian bird Shriek-hawks.

name: Caphex
summary: The Caphex were a humanoid sentient species with wispy hair that grew from the sides of their faces. The Caphex Bryn was a member of the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era, serving under Melis Shryke in the Nihil Occlusion Zone. The Caphex Dante was a member of the Jedi Order at the end of the Clone Wars and was selected as a candidate member of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius. The Caphex Seossra Thwisp worked as a spy for Leia Organa's Resistance during the Cold War with the First Order. Thwisp's homeworld was Caphexdis, and she was later stationed at Organa's base on Ajan Kloss prior to the Battle of Exegol.

name: Capper spineflap
summary: The Capper spineflap was a type of creature that could be found on the planet Naboo and its moon Rori.

name: Capture beast
summary: The capture beast was a Yuuzhan Vong bio-engineered war beast deployed on battlefields to capture refugees and enemy forces during the Yuuzhan Vong War. They resembled gigantic cylindrical, bristled worms and sported a pair of bioluminescent eyespots and antennae. They scuttled forth on a hundred pairs of legs covered with organic suction cups used also to capture prisoners. When grouped together, these huge worm-like creatures formed a living perimeter around the target and moved inward slowly enough to cause fear in the huddled masses. Capture beasts were often transported to battlefields via tent-like pods.

name: Capuchin
summary: A Capuchin was present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine around the time Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were there. The Capuchin wore a red vest and was fond of dates.

name: Capupi fly
summary: Capupi flies were a species of insect found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Akiva. They were important pollinators on the planet. Capupi flies would secrete a type of oil after ingesting the flowers of the asuka trees that was considered quite valuable for its supposed ability to let people see into the future. Despite asuka tree flowers being their meal of choice the flies could sometimes be found inside of kurado fruit also found on Akiva. In 3 ABY, the scoundrel Kay Vess and her Merqaal companion Nix share a kurado fruit platter at the Zian street food stall in Myrra. When the cooking droid cut open the fruit for the pair, several Capupi flies flew out from the fruit. Nix enjoyed eating the flies.

name: Cara beetle
summary: A cara beetle was a type of small insect. Around 32 BBY, Jedi Master Mace Windu infiltrated an organization run by the gangster Chulok and slept in an apartment within Chulok's headquarters, the Floating Palace. Windu felt restless, as if cara beetles were crawling and biting him beneath his sheets, but he was unable to find any of the beetles after searching four times for them and so decided the feeling was likely due to his proximity to his enemy.

name: Caraboose
summary: Caraboose were furred ungulates native to Toola. They were hunted by the native Whiphid for food.

name: Caranak
summary: Caranaks were aquatic fowls native to Endor. They were notoriously difficult to domesticate. Luke Skywalker described the group that he was leading into the Maw blackhole cluster as "caranaks in a row," with his Jade Shadow yacht at the head of nearly a dozen Sith Tribe frigates, flying under the protection of the Rockhound asteroid tug.

name: Carax
summary: A carax was a large six-legged insectoid creature species. During the Galactic Civil War, Rrynt'vor, the overlord of the Rak'qua tribe, owned a carax named Ageaughu. After the Battle of Yavin, the beast lived in a cave of Station Gamma, in the Bright Jewel system.

name: Carcaros
summary: Carcaros were aggressive fish that lived in the oceans of Tordus. A group of them entered the Axil Research Station when it was sabotaged and attacked Kit Fisto and Nahdar Vebb. They had a mouth filled with sharp teeth and several dorsal fins.

name: Carchar
summary: The carchar was native to Droxine. It was a poriferal creature with a distinctive water-vascular system similar to that of the aiwha of Kamino.

name: Caridan
summary: The Caridan were a mammalian species of Carida. Average Caridans stood over two meters tall and possessed dense musculatures due to Carida's high gravity level. They spoke Caridan and most also spoke Basic. Caridan society was structured around a mercantile culture led by an active market and Caridan owned industrial firms. In fact, the Caridans were widely known for their appraisal and bartering skills. The Caridans cooperated with the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire in the operation of the Academy of Carida. The Empire's xenophobia ignored the Caridans outside the Imperial compound, although tensions grew after the Battle of Yavin. Many Caridans vanished from the galaxy with the destruction of Carida at the hand of Kyp Durron. The few Caridans that survived were off-world as traders, New Republic operatives, or fringers. Notable Caridans included Imperial Ambassador Furgan of Carida.
distinctions: Spindly arms and legs, squarish faces, three digits, and hooves

name: Carnelian dragon
summary: Carnelian dragons were a type of carnivorous reptilian dragon native to the planet Carnelion IV. They had four legs, eight blue eyes, red and green skin and an aggressive behavior towards other organisms. In 29 BBY, during a mission to investigate a distress signal on Carnelion IV, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Grecker, a resident of the planet, encountered three Carnelian dragons in the Celadon Sea—an icy mountain range filled with poisonous mist that was toxic to humans. Kenobi drew his lightsaber, and, under distress, Grecker fired a flare, only for it to catch the attention of the dragons further. A bystander, Sera, noticed their distress and tried to help. While helping Grecker into a safe building, he threatened Sera at gunpoint to close the door and leave Kenobi for dead, but Sera shot him instead, ultimately saving the Jedi. Sera then exclaimed to Kenobi that she saved him from the beasts.

name: Carnivorous seaweed
summary: Carnivorous seaweed was an aquatic carnivorous species of plant that grew in the oceans of the planet Hapes and used its tentacles to suffocate its victims. In 23 ABY, Jedi trainees Tenel Ka, Lowbacca, Jacen Solo, and Jaina Solo were nearly killed by a patch of carnivorous seaweed in the Hapan ocean when Ambassador Yfra sabotaged their wavespeeder. Later, the young Jedi drove their wavespeeder into some carnivorous seaweed to kill a group of Bartokk assassins who were following them. Those assassins were sent by Yfra to kill the matriarch of Hapes, Ta'a Chume, so Yfra could assume the role of Hapan monarch.

name: Carnivorous snail
summary: Carnivorous snails were predatory mollusks native to Dantooine. They preyed upon those fabools which were impaled upon blba trees. They grew to approximately the size of a Human hand. Tash Arranda was bitten by several such snails during her sojourn on Dantooine.

name: Carnovian eel
summary: Carnovian eel was a species of gigantic eels that inhabited the deep waters of the planet Carnovia. The pups of these eels were eaten by Hutts as a snack and were raised in pens by Hutt slaves.

name: Carosite
summary: The Carosites were a mammalian, sentient species who hailed from the planet Carosi IV in the Outer Rim Territories. However, when the star Carosi began to rapidly expand, they were forced to evacuate their entire population to the outer planet Carosi XII and rebuild their civilization from scratch. Carosites were renowned throughout the galaxy for their medical skills. Their medical academies attracted some of the galaxy's greatest doctors to study and teach, drawn by their significant advancements in the treatment of mental illnesses and in medical droid technology. Carosites were generally pacifists, although on occasion they flew into berserker rages to protect their patients. Their reverence for life and medical acumen culminated in their famous hospital ship, the Sudden Restoration. Throughout the Galactic Civil War, it provided free health care to all, without regard to political affiliation.

name: Carp
summary: A carp was a type of creature with fins. While onboard a pleasure barge operated by the company Eternity Enterprises on the Outer Rim planet Dekien, the former Sith known as the Ronin noticed the barge's billowing gold sails and mentally noted that they were similar to a carp's fins.

name: Carrier butterfly
summary: Carrier butterflies were tiny insects native to the planet Maridun. They could also be found on Saleucami and Daro. They were often used as messengers as they were able to listen to their owners' instructions and deliver messages to allies. Carrier butterflies had two front wings and two trailing ones. Their wings could be many different colors, such as blue, pink, white, or black. Tub had a carrier butterfly, which he used to warn his village of a Separatist invasion.

name: Carrion bird
summary: Carrion birds were a type of predatory bird. In 28 ABY, Leia Organa compared them with members of Rinnrivin Di's cartel who were in pursuit of her and Ransolm Casterfo.

name: Carrion bird
summary: Carrion birds were a species of carrion birds native to the planet Saleucami. They were known to be scavengers, and were seen feasting on clone trooper bodies after the Siege of Saleucami.

name: Carrion deathbird
summary: Carrion deathbirds were scavengers; seeing one was considered an ill omen.

name: Carrion serpent
summary: Carrion serpents were a type of serpent that lived on the Galactic Frontier planet Tiikae and fed on carcasses. In 231 BBY, after encountering Nihil pirates on Tiikae, Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh asked Jordanna Sparkburn—the San Tekka clan deputy on the world—what they would do with the Nihil's dead bodies. In response, Sparkburn told her to leave them for the carrion serpents, before they left for Sparkburn's settlement.

name: Carrion spat
summary: The carrion spat was an flightless avian creature native to the planet Corellia.

name: Carthasian
summary: Carthasians were green sapients indigenous to Benja-Rihn that also possessed large, orange eyes with black pupils, set-back nostrils on their large upper jaws and they had a collection of small green stubs visually similar to hair.

name: Carto Deeves' species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Carto Deeves was a member of this species.

name: Caskadag
summary: Caskadags were a sentient species with two stomachs that hailed from a desert world. Anglang Lehet, who worked as an assassin, was a member of this species.

name: Caspus Pillar's species
summary: A yellow haired species with blue eyes existed in the galaxy. One member was Caspus Pillar, who lived during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Other individuals could be seen on Ferrix in the years of the Galactic Empire.

name: Castilon gorg
summary: The Castilon gorgs were a non-sentient subspecies of the amphibious gorg. Bitey was a member of the species.

name: Casting hawk
summary: Casting hawks were predatory birds from Ralltiir.

name: Cat
summary: Cats were a type of creature which were known for controlling populations of rats and other rodents, as well as being kept as pets by various sentient beings. Tookas, Rada-cats and Loth-cats were a species of cat. They usually had pointy ears, whiskers, flat faces with slightly protruding muzzles, small eyes that could dilate when scared, excited or nervous and had a variety of colors. Most cats had talons very similar to birds, long mouths and two slit nostrils that sat below the eyes.

name: Catfish
summary: A catfish was a species of fish native to the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim Territories.

name: Cathar
summary: The Cathar were a catlike, felinoid humanoid sentient species. Members of the species possessed fur and manes, slitted eyes and noses, pointed ears, a mouth with teeth, and clawed hands. They were powerful, swift, and fierce fighters.

name: Cattail deer
summary: The Cattail deer was a creature native to the planet Lowick.

name: Catuman
summary: Catumen were sapient felinoids known for the fierce mercenary warriors of their species. Catuman warriors were raised in the arts of warfare from birth, and were said to be among the deadliest killers in the galaxy. Several Catuman warriors served as the bodyguards of Kharys, the Majestrix of Skye, and ruthlessly hunted down Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa on Tirahnn as part of the Majestrix's scheme to locate Han Solo.

name: Cave beetle
summary: Cave beetles were six-legged insects that lived in the caves of Tatooine. The cook Porcellus used rock beetle and cave beetle carcasses to make beetle broth for his master, Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

name: Cave creature
summary: The cave creature was a web-spinning, cave-dwelling arachnid that lived on the planet Tahlboor.

name: Cave jurgoran
summary: Cave jurgoran was a subspecies of Jurgoran evolved to live in near-dark environments such as caves. To adapt to the darkness, the species developed bioluminescent scales and a reflective hide, with each creature having a distinct glow pattern, nearly undetectable to most, but instantly recognizable by other cave jurgorans.

name: cave spider
summary: The cave spiders of Ord Cestus were one of the dominant species on the sparsely populated planet. As their name suggest, the spiders lived in the natural caves that were found throughout the planet. They were most likely related to the Spider People of X'Ting history.

name: Cavehopper
summary: A Cavehopper was an amphibian predator from Lamaredd. It had a frog-like body with a crocodile-like snout, and inhabited caves, sitting in a lair near the bones of its victims. Cavehoppers could see in the dark and attacked with their teeth and kicks. They were common in the mountains of the Krakana's Maw range.

name: Cavern Monster
summary: Cavern Monsters were non-sentient beasts from the planet Ventooine. They were very aggressive creatures and were prone to attack any other creature in range. During the reign of the Satabs, Cavern Monsters were used as tools of execution and punishment for their enemies. When Han Solo came to Ventooine some time during the Galactic Civil War, he was almost killed by a Cavern Monster that was released upon him in a mine, where it was secretly kept by the Satab. However, he was able to kill the creature when he caused a stalactite to fall from a cave and impale the monster.

name: Cavern spider
summary: A cavern spider was subterranean race of gaping spider, a giant, aggressive arachnid from the planet Dathomir. Most members of the Spiderclan emulated those quiet, efficient and deadly predators. [[File:Cavern_Spider.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A cavern spider attacking a prey.]] The spiders lived in caves like the Nightspider Cult cave and the Rancor Cave on Dathomir. A few cavern spiders were also brought to the Geonosian Bio-Lab on Yavin 4.

name: Caw-crab
summary: Caw-crabs were a type of crab that could be found in the Sarini Island zoo on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila. During a visit to the zoo in 5 ABY, Brentin, Temmin, and Norra Wexley saw several caw-crabs scuttling and splashing around in their enclosures.

name: Caysin Bog's species
summary: This species was a sentient species native to in Teres Lutha Minor. Caysin Bog was a member of this species.

name: Ceewag
summary: Ceewags were creatures found roaming on the planet Malastare. One member of the species was Ba'zhu

name: Celantes
summary: The Celantes were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Chippin Jat was a member of this species.

name: Celegian
summary: Celegians were a tentacled sentient species. One Celegian was present at the annual pre-Dragon Void Run celebration aboard the Dragon Void space station in 0 ABY.

name: Celestial
summary: The Celestials were ancient entities in the Force, the energy field that existed in all things, whose true nature could not be understood by the mortals of the universe.
