The Force was influenced under the Celestials' dominion, and three of them were known to have manifested into physical beings known as the Ones, Force wielders who were made up of the Father, the Daughter, and the Son. The Daughter and the Son embodied the Force's light side—life and harmony—and the dark side—death and chaos—respectively. The Father's duty as the Keeper of the Balance between the warring siblings was alleviated when they brought a mortal Servant into their family, eventually becoming the Mother. However, the Mother was fearful of being abandoned as she aged amid the ageless Ones, and committed the Forbidden—drinking from the Font of Power, granting her immortality, and swimming in the Pool of Knowledge. However, the power overwhelmed the woman, corrupting her into a powerful dark side entity known as Abeloth, the Bringer of Chaos. In order to contain Abeloth's chaotic influence that inflicted terror and destruction upon both the creations of the light and dark sides, the Daughter and the Son united as the Architects to design Centerpoint Station, which was constructed by the Killiks while they were granted usage of the Force by the pair. The giant tractor beam built the Maw to contain Abeloth on her planet in a prison surrounded by black holes and hidden by Sinkhole Station. Centerpoint was also used to create the Corellian system, and was one of many large artifacts that was believed to have been made by the Celestials throughout the galaxy, long before the dawn of the galactic community and even the Rakatan Infinite Empire. All traces of them disappeared by 30,000 BBY, and what little was known of the Celestials came from xenoarchaeology, as well as the memories of the isolated Killik Thuruht hive. Some among the Jedi and the Sith alike incorrectly theorized that the balance between the light and dark sides of the Force were actually under the guidance of the Celestials. During the Clone Wars, which was part of a series of conflicts between the Jedi and the Sith, Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One who was destined to bring balance to the Force, was lured to the Ones' residence on Mortis in order to replace the Father; however, the mission resulted in the deaths of the Ones by the Dagger of Mortis, the only object that could destroy the otherwise immortal beings. The Ones' deaths and the ongoing Jedi and Sith wars allowed Abeloth to take advantage of the imbalance in the Force and, after Jacen Solo inadvertently caused the destruction of Centerpoint Station in his attempt to change the future where the Sith ruled the galaxy, free herself from the confines of the Maw to terrorise the galaxy. Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order was nevertheless able to learn about the Celestials and eventually defeat Abeloth in 44 ABY.
distinctions: Immortal entities in the Force impossible to be understood by mortals

name: Cemas
summary: The Cemas were a species of sentient beings that had feet. At least one member of the species had entered the galactic community by 17 ABY. That year, the smuggler Han Solo helped a Cemas to its feet in the Crystal Jewel casino, on the planet Coruscant, after a bomb went off in the New Republic Senate Hall nearby.

name: Centran
summary: The Centrans were a sentient humanoid Near-Human species that hailed from Erilnar, capital of their home territory, the Centrality. Their civilization were descended from human setters, and partitioned into a separate race due to Erilnar unusual geography and harsh environment.

name: Cephalon
summary: Cephalons were a long-lived sentient alien species that had ganglionic intelligence, with multiple sub-brains that sent information to a central brain. Cephalons had no visible sensory organs, and to communicate with other beings they had to use computers to translate their thoughts. They also perceived the galaxy in four dimensions, resulting in an inability to specify past or future-tense ideas. Cephalons were present in the galactic community by 19 BBY. At least one Cephalon opposed the Empire as a member of the resistance movement known as Whiplash.
distinctions: Ganglionic intelligence; consciousness that existed in and perceived four dimensions; no visible eyes or other sensory organs
language: Communicated via thoughts that relied on computer translation

name: Cephalosaur
summary: Cephalosaurs were a type of creature with tentacle-like arms that could be found on the astronomical object Regnio III. During his youth, the Evereni Marchion Ro hunted the creatures while on Regnio III. In 228 BBY, while on a desert planet, Ro was reminded of the cephalosaurs he had hunted when he saw blue-green cacti that sprouted spindly bushes with long tentacle-like arms.

name: Cerean
summary: The Cereans were a species of sentient mammals hailing from the planet Cerea. They were distinguished by their enlarged conical cranium that contained a binary brain. The Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi, who sat on the Jedi High Council during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, was a Cerean male.

name: Cerean hopper
summary: A species of small animals lived on the grassy plains of the planet Cerea. Members of the species had two hind limbs and two much smaller for-limbs and on their head a pair of eyes and a mouth with lips large relative to the creatures face. They also possessed a pair of small antennae on top of their head, which ended in small nubs. The creature's hides could be pink in color with darker pink spots on their back. One member of the species was present in fields near Tecave City on Cerea when the Chevin smuggler Ephant Mon tested the air for the presence of the trace mineral Malium.

name: Cerean pack animal
summary: Cerean pack animals were domesticated animals indigenous to Cerea. They were used to pull Cerean carts.

name: Cerrabore
summary: The cerrabore was a hulking creature indigenous to the swamps of Naboo. Cerrabores were captured and partially domesticated by the Gungans to serve as living battering rams to smash enemy fortifications and military installations. With their thick skulls and natural aggressiveness, they could tear through reinforced metal walls through sheer brute force. They were, in fact, as effective as an energy pummel.

name: Cerulean skycatcher
summary: Cerulean skycatchers were a type of blue bird with a plucky nature found on the planet Akiva. In 4 ABY, on a quiet morning after rain, a pair of cerulean skycatchers ducked and dived through the air above the home of the couple Esmelle and Shirene in the Akivan city Myrra while the New Republic pilot Norra Wexley sat on the building's rooftop. Wexley felt the two birds chasing each other could have been taking part in a territorial dog-fight, a mating dance, or both given the creatures' nature.

name: Cha'a
summary: The Cha'a were a small, orange-scaled, reptilian species, known for their cunning natures. They were part of galactic society for many thousands of years. One of the most famous Cha'a was the Merchant Lord, Ssk Kahorr, who lived during the Great Hyperspace War. Other notable Cha'a included three Jedi students who trained alongside Jacen and Jaina Solo in the New Jedi Order.

name: Chaakrabbit
summary: Chaakrabbits were a type of creature that lived on the planet Chaaktil. The bounty hunter Bazine Netal was given the nickname "Chaakrabbit" by her mentor Delphi Kloda.

name: Chaakroach
summary: Chaakroaches were a type of creature that lived on the planet Chaaktil. According to the Resistance spy Vi Moradi, they were as big as her feet and could be a source of protein.

name: Chadra-Fan
summary: The Chadra-Fan was a sentient species of meter-tall, rodent-like humanoids from the Outer Rim world of Chad. They had large ears, and flat noses with four nostrils. The Chadra-Fans Troo-tril-tek and Tiver were bounty hunters during the Republic Era while Piikow and another Chadra-Fan were rebels that opposed the Galactic Empire. The Chadra-Fans Shortpaw and Orka were junk sellers. Many other sentient beings looked down on Chadra-Fans and saw them as pets or lesser beings.

name: Chadra-Fan precursor species
summary: The Chadra-Fan species was descended from a species of small, arboreal mammalians. This species was the source of the Chadra-Fan's natural climbing abilities.

name: Chagrian
summary: Chagrians were an amphibious sentient species of tall and horned humanoids with blue skin that were native to the planet Champala. Chagrians were most notable for their blueish skin and thick, sensory tentacles that grew down on either side of their head, coming forward to rest at the top of the chest and inner shoulders, with a horn or spine-like appendage growing from each. The male Chagrians possessed two additional horn-like extremities above their heads. The Chagrian Mas Amedda served as Vice Chair of the Galactic Senate under both Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum and his successor, Sheev Palpatine, only to become his Grand Vizier following the inception of the Galactic Empire.

name: Chak-chak
summary: The chak-chak were small, six-limbed rodents that were popular pets on their homeworld, the planet Chad. Their two arms were long and deceptively strong, folding away beneath their long fur, and they moved at great speed on the four smaller legs. Shortly before the Clone Wars, the Chad-based company Rebaxan Columni created the MSE-4, MSE-5, and MSE-6 series repair droids all inspired by the chak-chak. Although most potential customers were unconvinced by the prospect of owning a mechanical rat, the Galactic Empire eventually bought the company's entire remaining stock of MSE-6s.

name: Chakino eel
summary: A Chakino eel was a type of green eel served frozen along with Duradan Soup in Kijimi City on the Mid Rim Territories planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. In 3 ABY, the thief Kay Vess and her Merqaal companion Nix share a meal of Duradan Soup with Chakino eel. Nix got his tongue stuck on the ice encasing the eels before they had thawed and were ready to eat.

name: Chalactan
summary: Chalactans were humans native to the planet Chalacta. Two prominent Chalactans were Jedi Master Depa Billaba and her sister Sar Labooda.

name: Chalarax
summary: A chalarax was a creature that had spots. It could not change them, and, based on that fact, sometime before 3954 BBY a proverb had been formulated. That year, when Jedi Master Atris refused to let go of her distrust for fellow Master Revan despite the former's redemption from the dark side of the Force two years earlier, she quoted the proverb, comparing Revan to a chalarax.

name: Chalhuddan
summary: The Chalhuddan were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim planet Chal Hudda. They had two horn-like protrusions on their heads and five distinct genders. Members of the species shifted between these genders throughout their lifetime and their native language used complex pronoun cases to indicate both their current and past genders. Some individuals also used these pronouns to indicate the gender they expected to be their next. Because equivalents to these terms did not exist in Galactic Basic Standard, "you" or "they" were uniformly used in their stead. A proud people, Chalhuddans did not readily accept charity from "dry ones," only willing to accept something if spoken to honestly and allowed to provide something in return. One Chalhuddan was a Jedi Initiate during the Clone Wars. An entry on Chalhuddans was included in "Species From A to Z," a survival compendium sent out by Carson Teva during the New Republic Era.

name: Challat eater
summary: Challat eaters were vicious, swarming predators found on Troiken. They preyed upon the native Xexto population; they were carnivorous and devoured the flesh of anything they came into contact with. Challat eaters were small in size and glowed bright blue. [[File:Challat_eater_swarm.jpg|thumb|left|235px|A swarm of challat eaters attack Stark Commercial Combine forces trapped within Troiken's Mount Avos caves at the end of the Stark Hyperspace War of 44 BBY.]] They provided some trouble for the Republic force trapped in Mount Avos during the Stark Hyperspace War, and after Ranulph Tarkin destroyed the barrier erected by the Jedi to keep them out, they consumed the Stark Collective force that the Jedi trapped within the mountain stronghold after they were forced to seal it off. Tsian used droids modeled after the insects in her assassinations. "Challat" meant flesh in Xextese. [[File:Challat_eaters_confront_Kenobi_Vos.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jedi Padawans Obi-Wan Kenobi and Quinlan Vos encounter challat eaters in the Mount Avos caves during the Stark Hyperspace conflict.]]

name: Chanchaz Iryt's species
summary: A sentient species hailed from the high-gravity Mid Rim planet Kaump III. Its members had a short stature and limbs as well as a dense body structure and a flat face. The mercenary and pirate Chanchaz Iryt was a member of the species who grew up on Kaump III. Initially studying repulsorlift mechanics, he eventually turned to a life of crime and committed a series of high-profile robberies before leaving his homeworld aboard a luxury liner. Iryt subsequently went on to become a member of the Fatal Visionaries pirate gang.

name: Chando
summary: A chando was a type of herbivorous, short-necked, dinosaur-like creature that was used as a beast of burden on the planet Endregaad during the era of the New Republic. They were about three meters high and they responded to most stimuli by braying. In 19 ABY, there was an oubreak of a deadly viral plague on Endregaad, and the Human Simol Toc assembled a caravan of chandos to tow some cargo lifters to the Temple Valley and deliver medicinal supplies to families living in the surrounding region.

name: Chandrilan
summary: The Chandrilans were a cultural group of humans who called the planet of Chandrila home. They were regarded as peaceful but slightly haughty, pedantic, and interested in politics. Despite spending the majority of her life on Coruscant, Leida Mothma, who was born on Chandrila, enjoyed the simplicity of Chandrilan customs, unlike her mother, Mon Mothma, who regarded many of the Chandrilan traditions to be outdated in modern times. Following the Imperial Era, some Chandrilans disliked former Imperials. Chandrilans included Senator Mon Mothma and Ben Solo, the son of rebellion war heroes Han Solo and Leia Organa.

name: Chandrilan black-horned net spider
summary: The Chandrilan black-horned net spider were spiders found on Chandrila. Following the Battle of Endor, Leia Organa likened the Emperor's contingency plan to that of the Chandrilan black-horned net spider as they weave many intricate traps.

name: Channelfish
summary: The channelfish was a type of fish on the planet Tenoo. The fish was a huge delicacy and made into many varieties of foodstuff such as the Tenooan channelfish dumpling and the channelfish sandwich.

name: Char rat
summary: Char rat were a type of rat. Sometime between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Tasu Leech—a member of the bounty hunter T'onga's crew—called the bounty hunter Dengar a "double-crossing char rat" after the latter left the crew on the flagship of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn after he had been hired to help them infiltrate the ship.

name: Chargreck
summary: Chargrecks were heavily armored, spiked quadrupeds native to the planet of Orsis. Trezza would take favored students at the Orsis Academy on a hunting expedition to hunt kaabores only to have the student deliberately run into chargrecks with nothing but a wooden spear to defend oneself. Experiencing this firsthand, Kilindi Matako tipped her friend Maul off, who came prepared with electroshock nets, stunning the creatures and avoiding this trick.

name: Charhound
summary: Charhounds were a type of hound that could be found on the ore planet of Elphrona in the Outer Rim Territories. One charhound, Ember, was considered a member of the Jedi of Elphrona Outpost during the time of the High Republic.
hairColor: Black, white, and gray with red and orange spots

name: Charnoq
summary: Charnoqs were a species of predatory reptiles native to the planet of Maridun. This kind of reptile lived in the forests and had great climbing and leaping abilities. The Amanin, a primitive people from the same planet, secreted a poisonous slime from their bodies that kept their skin damp and helped fend off most of the carnivorous forests creatures — except for the charnoq, which was the only animal on Maridun that the Amanin feared.
distinctions: Resistance to Amanin poisonous skin slime

name: Charon
summary: Charon were a sentient species with both humanoid and arachnid features. They had four arms, two of which were extremely powerful, and four legs, which made them very stable on their feet and were known for their violent, emotionless nature. Originally from realspace, the Charon were essentially a subspecies of the Charr Ontee of Kathol, who came from ships which were "flipped" into otherspace to a cold, bleak planet in a pocket dimension made up of black holes beyond the known confines of the galaxy. The Charon were confined to otherspace, where most followed a cult which held the existence of all life, even their own kind, to be an abomination. Their contact beyond otherspace was limited, but it was enough to make them objects of horror. Shortly after the destruction of the second Death Star in 4 ABY, a splinter group of Charon devoted to maintaining peace and setting up new communities successfully constructed the species' first hyperdrive and departed otherspace, with many Charon taking up positions as bioscientists, developing bio-organic technology similar to that of the Yuuzhan Vong.

name: Charr ant
summary: The charr ant was a type of ant found on the Mid Rim planet Kashyyyk that shared a symbiotic relationship with the shi-shok tree. In 231 BBY, the Jedi Order and Hutt Clan undertook an assault against the sentient carnivorous plants known as the Drengir on their homeworld—the Wild Space world Mulita. During the assault, the Kotabi bond-twins Jedi Knights Ceret and Terec compared the symbiotic relationship of the charr ant and shi-shok tree to that of the Drengir and a local type of arthropod they had weaponized to act as guards.
distinctions: Symbiotic relationship with the shi-shok tree

name: Charr Ontee
summary: The Charr Ontee were sentient arachnids with two pairs of legs and two pairs of arms indigenous to Kathol. They were genetically created by the ancient Kathol species. They also were capable of exuding a sticky webbing. They were originally created as a race of farmers thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War, but despite their role, they were considered colleagues by the Kathol themselves. This way of life ended when the Rift Disaster occurred, which nearly destroyed the Charr Ontee. Those that survived served the Darkstryder as it watched over the Lifewell. When the time came for the Kathol to awaken, the Darkstryder defied its programming and banished the Charr Ontee for opposing it. This made them the eternal enemies of the Darkstryder construct, living far from the creature's fortress on the Kathol homeworld. This time apart allowed them to develop their own culture and society but they gradually discovered a terrible secret from their origins. They had learned that on a genetic level the species was degenerating, but this did not affect them learning to use the Ta-Ree life energy and they became quite adept in its usage. This made them a force to be reckoned with in the Kathol Rift and the more powerful of the Kathol servants. A group that survived the cataclysm on Kathol were thrown into a pocket of Otherspace and over time degenerated into the Charon subspecies who sought to destroy all life.

name: Cha'wen'he
summary: The Cha'wen'he people of the planet Wen'he'dinae were among the galaxy's most distinctive looking species. Cha'wen'he had two thin legs, decimeter-long bony spikes on their heels, and scaly ovoid bodies. Their most distinctive feature was their three heads, mounted on flexible two-meter long necks. Their three heads were in constant motion, making them difficult to catch them unawares. Their mouths were also ringed with pseudo-fingers, allowing them to use their heads as hands. When threatened, Cha'wen'he could fight back with their heel spikes, or retract their heads into their bodies for protection. With necks fully extended, Cha'wen'he stood up to four meters tall. Though the Cha'wen'he had three heads, they did not have the split consciousness exhibited by the two-headed Troigs and Paaerduags. This was because their single brains were located in their bodies, rather than in their heads. However, their consciousness did have one peculiarity—Cha'wen'he could access knowledge and skills from a collective "species memory". Some of this knowledge, such as simple motor skills, would be accessed immediately by Cha'wen'he hatchlings. More complicated skills could take years to surface in a Cha'wen'he's mind, or even remain locked in their subconscious permanently. Cha'wen'he, having evolved as herbivores on a planet teeming with predators, were typically nervous and excitable. Their society was organized in nomadic "flocks", whose informal leadership was constantly changing. This made it difficult for offworlders to arrange treaties with them, as an arrangement concluded with one flock might not be honored by their next leader, or by the next flock to live in the area. As a further frustration, Cha'wen'he owned all of their possessions and buildings communally. Though they learned to understand alien concepts such as "private property" and "no trespassing", they sometimes ignored them. Cha'wen'he had been in contact with the Galactic Republic for millennia, enthusiastically traveling the spacelanes as scouts, explorers, and navigators. While the Cha'wen'he were under the nominal rule of the Galactic Empire, their tendency to ignore certain Imperial dictates led to incidents of brutal oppression. Due to the fluidity of their leadership and their nomadic lifestyle, these were often directed at the wrong Cha'wen'he.

name: Chazrach
summary: The Chazrach (also known as "reptoids") were a short, stocky, reptilian extra-galactic sentient species from a distant galaxy with snubbed snouts who served the Yuuzhan Vong as slaves and soldiers.

name: Chekut
summary: The Chekut were a race of sentient beings that were native to the Cheku system. The Chekut forces opportunistically invaded the planet Sika during the Second Galactic Civil War.

name: Cheldu
summary: Cheldu was an insectoid herbivore species native to Umbara. Though their appearance could be off-putting to some prospective owners, few mounts could match the loyalty and affectionate nature of the Cheldu.

name: Chelidae
summary: Chelidae were a sentient species indigneous to the planet Castilon. While amphibious, they preferred to live above the water. They were enclosed in a natural protective shell, and the males sported facial hair while the females did not. Chelidae were able to slow down their life systems. A group of chelidae served as engineers on the space station Colossus.

name: Chell
summary: Chell lived inside the Skara Nal Mech on Skara Nal. It possessed gray skin, red eyes, sharp teeth, claws, and a long tail.

name: Chemilizard
summary: Chemilizards, originally known as orpali dragons, were reptilian life forms native to Nal Hutta. After the Hutts' terraforming and polluting of the environment, these lizards evolved to be able to extract nutrients out of the chemical pollutants that would kill most other living creatures. They also developed a unique coloring pattern and acidic saliva. Voontara Fa'athra kept several chemilizards in the beast pit of his palace.

name: Cherff Maota's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Cherff Maota was a member of this species.

name: Chestrashi
summary: The Chestrashi were a sentient species originating from Wild Space's Chestrashus system. They were ruthless and made extensive use of biological warfare. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the company Charendohl Exports, Limited manufactured the Chestrashi void spear, a weapon characteristic of the species. The void spear, which was available in extremely limited quantities, was a metal throwing spear with a tip containing thousands of microorganisms. Upon striking the target, the weapon's payload would attack their bone and central nervous systems. At some point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, the fiftieth-anniversary edition of Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology offered the datalog's customers an exclusive opportunity to purchase Chestrashi void spears.

name: Chev
summary: The Chevs were one of the two native sentient species of the planet Vinsoth. These humanoids were slaves of the Chevin, Vinsoth's other indigenous people, for most of their recorded history, a fact which shaped their culture and their interactions with the rest of the galaxy.

name: Chevin
summary: The Chevin were a large sentient elephantine species with massive heads that stretched the length of their entire bodies. They could have gray skin, black eyes, and blonde hair. The Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's head of security Ephant Mon was a Chevin. A colonial species, they had migrated and adapted to dominate many worlds.

name: Chewfly
summary: Chewflies were a type of fly on the Fruited Moon of the Outer Rim planet Hetzal Prime. They flew in seasonal swarms on the moon that destroyed the crops planted there, plaguing the Hetzalians residing there. At some point by the time of the High Republic Era, the flies were genetically modified, resulting in their extinction. In 232 BBY, the Hetzal system's Minister Zeffren Ecka worked to save his home from the effects of the incoming objects savaging locations in his system during the Great Hyperspace Disaster. Ecka compared the incoming threats as similar to the seasonal chewfly swarms that used to plague the Fruited Moon prior to the flies' extinction, thinking in frustration that nothing could be done other than rebuild after the damage was done.

name: Chiaki
summary: The Chiaki was a large snake-like predator native to the oceans of Iskalon. While their diet consisted primarily of other aquatic creatures, the chiaki were not at all opposed to capturing the unwary Iskalonian for their next meal. Like sharks, this beast hunted by scenting blood in the water.

name: Chiffon
summary: The Chiffons were avian creatures found on the planet Kondoraan. They used their wings to glide along the wind current of the planet.

name: Chiggnash
summary: The Chiggnash were a sentient species that resembled scorpions. The species had the ability to control the minds of other beings, and sometimes used that faculty to rapidly accumulate an expendable force of "warrior drones." At least some Chiggnash formed criminal extortion rings. Among bounty hunters, it was acknowledged that due to their control mind ability, special tactics were required to confront Chiggnash. For instance, an electrified smart-harpoon was an inappropriate weapon as it would soon short out against so many warrior drones. Similarly, a blaster would be of only temporary use against their hordes. The Chiggnash criminals Riley and Banda were active on Nar Shaddaa, the smuggler's moon of Nal Hutta, shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire. In 19 BBY, they worked with Pacithhip docking bay attendant Shnozitskigante-maximilliana in an attempt to rob the incognito Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. Confronting Kenobi with Squib tensor rifles and a force of warrior drones, the Chiggnash were instead cut down by the Dark Jedi Mei.

name: Chiilak
summary: Chiilaks were six-limbed marine mammals native to the oceans of Misnor's glacial regions. They were strong swimmers and omnivorous, being excellent hunters. Hunting them was legal under the Galactic Empire, but considered dangerous.

name: Chikarri
summary: The Chikarri were sapient rodents from Plagen. They were a sentient species with mammalian features. They had two arms and two legs with a long tail which made them very agile on their feet. Chikarri tended to be very inquisitive in nature. They had been known to disassemble pieces of technology quickly and rapidly discern its function. They then adapted the new technology to their own. This knowledge of a wide range of technology made them valued as technicians.
diet: Herbivorous|Herbivore]], mostly nuts, berries and grains

name: Chirodactyl
summary: Chirodactyls, also known as Dathomirian bats, were a species of winged carnivorous creatures native to the planet Dathomir.

name: Chironian
summary: The Chironians were a sentient species distinguished by their centauriform anatomy; while their torso, arms and head resembled those of a humanoid, their lower body was that of a four-legged equine. Another distinctive Chironian feature was the two transparent, smooth horns grown each year from the forehead. These horns started as small velvet-covered knobs, which eventually broke through as fully-fledged horns. If the velvet was cut prematurely, the wound could prove fatal. At least some juvenile Chironians were red-gold in color with white spots on their flanks and back; this color darkened with age and the spots faded. Chironians could grow long manes and tails. The Chironian species was native to the planet Chiron. This world was located in a portion of the Outer Rim Territories known as the Ash Worlds following the sacking and bombardment of many of its star systems by forces of the Hutt species, circa 24,500 BBY. Thousands of years later, many of the Ash Worlds were interdicted for weapons testing by the Galactic Empire. After the collapse of the Empire, at least one Chironian, Lusa, was kidnapped by the Empire Reborn movement, which sought to revive the Empire under the leadership of Lord Hethrir. Lusa was eventually rescued and reunited with her family. For a time, she joined the radical, anti-Human, Diversity Alliance, until she quit after being exposed to the Alliance's violent tendencies. Lusa sought help from Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, and aided the New Republic in suppressing the Alliance. She later became a Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order, and was killed while on her homeworld during the brutal Yuuzhan Vong War of 25 ABY to 29 ABY.
classification: Centauriform: equine lower body and humanoid torso
skinColor: Red-gold with white spots for juveniles

name: Chiru
summary: Chiru or sand wasps were insects native to Socorro. They were named the Socorran word for "deadly." Their hives could number over two hundred thousand. They were known to attack whole groups of nomads on the planet.

name: Chiss
summary: The Chiss were a near-human sentient species that possessed blue skin, red eyes, and dark blue hair. They hailed from the planet Csilla. The Chiss were notable for the nature and structure of their families, and how Chiss families dominated many aspects of Chiss society. The Chiss Ascendancy was located in the Unknown Regions and had little contact with the rest of the galaxy, and until Grand Admiral Thrawn's ascent in the ranks of the Galactic Empire, their existence was regarded as mostly a legend even within the Unknown Regions.

name: Chistori
summary: The Chistori were a saurian sentient species. They were known to be fierce warriors whose independence had kept them secret from the archives of the Jedi.
skinColor: Blue and purple on the back, brown and tan on the abdomen

name: Chitlik
summary: Chitliks were burrowing marsupials found on Ord Cestus. They lived in caves and had orange stripes. The females produced a salubrious milk called kista. Cestians would set traps for chitliks in order to harvest the kista from their mammary glands. The kista would be milked and then the chitliks would be released. One notable chitlik was Pocket, the pet of Chief of State Natasi Daala's aide, Wynn Dorvan. Another was Tamac's Zantay Aura, the winner of "Most Placid in Show" at the Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show.

name: Chlovi cat
summary: The Chlovi cat was a species of amphibian predator, that was native to the planet Nyriaan. They were named after the chlovi, a species of large fungus.

name: Choi
summary: The Choi were aliens from the planet Choi. A Choi named Susejo was eaten by the Sarlacc on Tatooine and talked with Boba Fett when he was trapped there. This Choi unintentionally helped Fett escape.

name: Choku
summary: Choku were Reptavians native to Yavin 4. These quadrupeds are known for their bright fur. The males were brown and white and the females were black and white. Living and hunting in packs, they were powerfully muscled carnivores and deadly hunters.

name: Chollas
summary: Chollas were herd animals that grazed the plains on the planet Kal'Shebbol in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 392 BBY, Twi'lek settlers, escaping from slavery, domesticated the herds that roamed their adopted homeworld. Along with the development of farms, the ranching of the chollas helped the Twi'leks to establish the basis of their new society. By 8 ABY, chollas were also found on the neighboring planet of Kolatill. The ranching of both chollas and banthas was a large industry on the planet; the hides and meat of the chollas sold for decent sums of credits in Kolatill's northern cities. Both the meat and hide were also exported off-world to the nearby planets of Gandle Ott and Torize.

name: Chon Actrion's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Chon Actrion was a member of this species.

name: Choreamnos
summary: The choreamnos was a type of lazy, arboreal animal. They hardly moved except to get leaves on other branches. A number of these creatures were kept captive on the Starhunter Dhelba until it crashed on Endor, thus introducing the species. On Endor, the species was known colloquially as the blasé tree goat due to the habit of hanging upside down in the blasé trees. They were a source of meat and milk.

name: Chortose
summary: The Chortose were a sentient species that resided on Chortose, an astronomical object in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The species had a small stature and was covered in brown fur. During the High Republic Era, the Nihil marauders attacked Agricultural Hub 42, a factory on Chortose ran by Chortose workers, for the sprayer droids that it utilized. Two Chortose brothers, Pango and Gru, sent a distress signal to the Jedi Order on Starlight Beacon, who sent the Jedi Knight Keeve Trennis to assist them. Trennis arrived to defend the Chortose workers from being killed by the Nihil, and was herself assisted by the Jedi Wayseeker Orla Jareni.

name: Christophsian
summary: Christophsians were a sentient race native to the planet Christophsis. They looked similar to humans in appearance. During the Battle of Christophsis, Christophsian rebels fought against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Clone Wars, they were represented by a senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.

name: Chroma-neeka
summary: Chroma-neekas were tiny rodent-like creatures that nested inside computers and other electric devices. The fed off the power lines causing malfunctions. Chroma-neeka's would spread by stowing away aboard tramp freighters. In gambler jargon, a chroma-neeka was someone who used the complicated layers of governmental and corporate bureaucracy to their own advantage.

name: Chroman
summary: The Chromans were a species of wormlike humanoids with smooth heads, smooth skin and webbed hands that were native to Chroma Zed. Their eyes were huge and round and their mouths were lipless. They burrowed into mountainsides and lived near trickling water to keep themselves moist. The Galactic Empire enslaved the Chromans because of their mining skills. The Empire made a practice of killing a random Chroman as an example to the rest in the group. The hapless Chroman would be dragged out of the group's moist tunnels and fastened onto sunbaked rock, where the Chroman would writhe under the heat, oozing slime until all that was left was a corpse. As a result, many Chromans joined Nolaa Tarkona's Diversity Alliance. After the alliance was defeated and replaced with the Cooperative Council of Independent Planetary Governments by the New Republic they were a species amongst the New Republic Senate that said why they joined the hate group.
distinctions: Wormlike humanoids with smooth bodies and webbed hands

name: Chromant
summary: Chromants were a type of ant that lived on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona, residing in nests that could contain up to a hundred individuals. During the High Republic Era, residents of the planet typically called in extermination units when they were having trouble with the creatures. In 232 BBY, a claim on Elphrona experienced difficulties with a nest of chromants. Jedi Master Loden Greatstorm—who was stationed at the Jedi Order's Elphrona Outpost south of the claim—intended to help them with the issue after finishing his meal and suggested that he could defeat one hundred of them. When Jedi Knight Indeera Stokes questioned whether an extermination unit could assist, he indicated he wished to fight the chromants. Greatstorm's Padawan, Bell Zettifar, wanted to help as well but had other training to do. However, the Jedi ultimately did not help the claim with their chromant issue because they dispatched on a rescue endeavor elsewhere on Elphrona instead.

name: Chrysalide
summary: The chrysalide, also known as the chrysalis beast, was a creature altered by Sith alchemy.

name: Chubafly
summary: The chubafly was a species of flying creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of chuba.

name: Chubbit
summary: The Chubbits were a species of bipedal, sentient reptiles indigenous to the desert world of Aridus in the Expansion Region. The average Chubbit stood shorter than a fully grown Human. Their skin was green or yellow, although some featured red or black spots. Their nervous system was easily crippled by ultra-strong frequency waves. On their dry homeworld, the Chubbits made use of indigenous technology such as wind-runners, wheeled vehicles that were propelled by large sails. The Chubbits suffered after the rise of the Galactic Empire. In 19 BBY, numerous Chubbits were held as enslaved individuals by gangs on the planet Telerath and one of its moons. The fugitive Jedi Dass Jennir freed many of these Chubbits. Meanwhile, Imperial troops on Aridus found valuable natural resources there. However, when mining outfits attempted to extract these raw materials, Aridus's ionized atmosphere rendered their equipment inoperable. The Empire thus approved construction of the Iron Tower, a massive power transformer and signal amplifier to rectify the technological problems; the Empire paid little heed when the tower's strong frequency waves crippled the nervous systems and even killed many of the planet's natives. The Chubbits responded by waging a guerrilla war on the Empire, armed with blasters, repulsor tanks, and crawler tanks supplied by sympathetic Yutrane-Trackata workers and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Other offworlders provided support as well, including the Human Wrenga Jixton and a man who claimed to be the Human Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. In 0 ABY, the Kenobi impersonator destroyed the Iron Tower when the devotion shown him by the Chubbits and the Rebel Alliance hero Luke Skywalker prompted him to thwart a ploy by the Sith Lord Darth Vader to lure Skywalker into a trap at the Iron Tower. In the aftermath of the structure's fall, Jixton swore his services to Vader in exchange for an Imperial retreat from the Chubbit homeworld, and in 4 ABY, the New Republic sought an alliance with the species. The Yuuzhan Vong later conquered Aridus around 27 ABY during their invasion of the galaxy.
skinColor: Light green or yellow with black or red mottling

name: Chuhkyvi
summary: The Chuhkyvi were a water-breathing species indigenous to Aquaris. Due to a natural disaster, a benevolent species relocated them to Iskalon, where they became part of the Iskalonian school. Although they adopted the common Iskalonian tongue, they also kept their own language. In physical appearance, they were similar to the Inleshat, but more Human-like, being the most humanoid Iskalonian species. They had tan skin and four fingers rather than the Inleshat's three. Their eyes were yellow and their noses more pronounced than those of the Inleshat, giving them a keen sense of smell. Like the Inleshat, their vision out of water was poor, but they had excellent hearing due to long, pointed ears. They could not survive out of water for over an hour without a water tank. Their bodies were short but thickly muscled. Of the members of the School, only the Chuhkyvi had the desire to leave their world and explore. They were a spiritual and principled people, ready to defend a cause they knew to be upright. A prominent Chuhkyvi was Kiro, the hero of Iskalon and the early Alliance of Free Planets. He also studied to be a Jedi at one point.

name: Churi
summary: The churi was a large avian native to Endor, a forested moon orbiting a planet of the same name. Logray, the shaman of the Ewok Bright Tree Village, wore a headdress made from the skull of a churi and his apprentice Teebo wore churi feathers atop a gurreck skull headdress. The ewoks used a tool known as a churi bird caller to call churi birds.

name: Chylaroo
summary: Chylaroo was a small rodent-like creature native to the planet Yamradi.

name: Ciasi
summary: The Ciasi were a rodent-like sentient species with tall, pointed ears and thin, trunk-like noses. Ciasi could be found with gray-colored skin and could grow prominent tusks. One famous Ciasi was the thin Podracer Slide Paramita, who performed in Podraces across the galaxy around the year 32 BBY.

name: Cidwen
summary: The cidwen were black, predatory, winged insects native to the planet Keros with dangerous beaks and claws. They were introduced to Atraken when a free-trader left a pair of them behind. By the time of 6 ABY, there were a dozen living on the planet. They could grow up to a half-meter long with a one-meter wingspan. They had grown an appetite for the diehard, an insect that was native to Atraken. Like the Aga and the Avogwi, they were often tortured, drugged and used as guards by the Galactic Empire.

name: Cilare
summary: The Cilare were a species of humanoids that subscribed to martial values. Around 25 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War, their homeworld was invaded by the Yuuzhan Vong who exterminated the entire species except for Arbeloa during a one-sided engagement.

name: Cinderhawk
summary: Cinderhawks were a type of hawk found on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona. After being severely injured by a harpoon during a battle against the Nihil marauder organization in 231 BBY, Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar imagined himself hearing the voice of a Jedi Master as he struggled to stay conscious. The voice told him about the energy in all living things, including cinderhawks and charhounds. The Padawan briefly considered the words and heard the sound of the hawks calling, but in reality, his charhound Ember was barking at him to keep him lucid.

name: Cingulon
summary: Cingulons were a sentient species with pebbly skin and flanged faces. A Cingulon senator served in the Imperial Senate during the time of the Galactic Empire. Dellso Prin was a Cingulon mechanic who joined the Resistance as a cargo pilot.

name: Clabronian
summary: The Clabronians were a sentient species from the world of Clabron. During the Clone Wars, they were led by Grand Minister Stin, who considered siding with the Galactic Republic, despite the fact that many Clabronians wished to stay out of the conflict. When Stin organized a meeting with Republic senator Padmé Amidala, the Separatists assassinated Stin. He was replaced by Second Minister Tarmin, who, while not wanting to fight in the war, promised to provide aid to the Republic in other ways.

name: Clantaani
summary: The Clantaani or Clantaanis were a species of sentient, long-eared humanoids from the arid world of Clantaano III. The Clantaani lived in marauding, nomadic tribes that fought endlessly over the limited resources of their homeworld. In the galaxy at large, Clantaani preferred to live on planets similar to Clantaano III, such as Tatooine—a place that also drew them due to its disproportionate number of criminals. Clantaani pirates and bandits stole regularly from crime lords such as the Hutts and returned home with their booty. A Clantaani known as Longo Two-Guns ran a criminal gang headquartered on Tatooine; after the bandit angered Jabba Desilijic Tiure, the Hutt placed a bounty on Two-Guns, dead or alive, in 32 BBY. The bounty hunter Jango Fett claimed the reward, along with other bounties placed on Clantaani members of Two-Guns's gang.

name: Clantanni
summary: The Clantanni were a sentient species in the galaxy. In 382 BBY, a member of this species was a follower of the Black Eye on Jedha.

name: Clarodian
summary: The Clarodians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Brothers Tianris and Guanlos Mez were members of this species.

name: Clave Rollek's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Clave Rollek was a member of this species.

name: Clawbird
summary: The clawbird or stana (as natives called it) was a black-feathered avian from Wayland that ate the flesh of dead animals and aliens. The clawbirds were among Wayland's species affected by the sabotaged Ossus Project. One attempted to scavenge the unconscious body of Cade Skywalker. Upon waking, however, he tamed the creature and used it to find his friend Deliah Blue, who had been abducted by the One Sith on the planet.

name: Clawdite
summary: Clawdites were a sentient reptilian species whose members could change shape to impersonate any humanoid close to their shape. Chromatophores allowed Clawdites to replicate the appearance of another person, but could not change their body size or mass. Adopting a new form, however, required great concentration, and wearing heavy armor could interfere with the shape-shifting. Many Clawdites chose to transform into personas that they would use in public so as to not reveal themselves as Clawdites.

name: Clawmouse
summary: Clawmouse was a species of rodent found in the deserts of the planet Dreighton. Within the Old Jedi Order, there was a clan for Jedi Initiates named the Clawmouse Clan.

name: Clever-bird
summary: Clever-birds were a type of squawking bird that lived in the Canyon of Akar on the Outer Rim planet Akiva. In 5 ABY, the Akivan native and pilot Norra Wexley thought about the noise made by the canyon's clever-birds and compared it to the relative silence of the planet Kashyyyk while visiting there.

name: Cliff hawk
summary: Cliff hawks were avian predators native to Prakith. Their plumage was speckled with browns and grays, allowing them to naturally blend into the mountainous regions in which they hunted. Common prey included small mammals, reptiles, and their fellow brethren. Huge, grotesque talons enabled the cliff hawk to hang upside down, an arcane ability for a bird of such size. Cliff hawks seldom flew, instead preferring to scurry about on two legs.

name: Cliff wampa
summary: The cliff wampa was a brown-furred, rock-climbing subspecies bioengineered from the wampa ice creature native to the frozen Outer Rim Territories planet Hoth. After learning of the ice wampa's powerful ferocity during the Battle of Hoth, the Galactic Empire captured several of the creatures, and Imperial biologists artificially adapted them to various environments. By 3.5 ABY, the Empire had placed the resulting cliff wampa on the rocky Outer Rim moon of Gall to guard local Imperial interests.

name: Cliffborer worm
summary: Cliffborer worms were parasitic, almost mindless, burrowing arthropods common throughout the galaxy. They flourished specially on the many planets that featured mainly arid and rocky climates, such as Tatooine.
distinctions: Large flaps of skin on either side of head

name: Cliffspringer
summary: Cliffspringers were a type of docile, fleet-footed, grazing mammal native to the ocean moon Kef Bir, where they dwelt on grassy islands. Members of Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters, hunted cliffspringers using energy bows without power augmentation, allowing for clean kills. The company harvested their prey efficiently, taking meat and hides from cliffspringers.

name: Clip beetle
summary: Clip beetles were small, non-sentient insects that were created by the Yuuzhan Vong species. In existence by 27 ABY, the beetles had an abdominal shell, a head with a pair of mandibles, and its flesh and shell were both nutritious. A clip beetle's head could be used as a natural type of stitching for wounds; the beetle could be encouraged to bite the flesh on either side of the wound, and the rest of the beetle's body would then be removed. The head would be left in place with the jaws still holding the wound shut.
distinctions: Use as a natural medical stitch

name: Cloddogran
summary: Cloddograns were a sentient species of which Bargwill Tomder was a member. At some point, two Cloddograns menaced Mahjo Reeloo in Galagolos spaceport on the planet Galagolos V until Hondo Ohnaka saved her.

name: Clodhopper
summary: Clodhoppers were omnivorous and dim-witted flightless avians from Naboo. A clodhopper was rarely more than three feet tall, but they fed in swarms, becoming a real menace. They were protected by tough, durable skin. A noteworthy attribute of the clodhopper was its ability to spawn 200 young in only two days, all of which spent most of their time eating. Fast-breeding, dimwitted, voracious herbivores, clodhoppers use their powerful forelegs to forage and hop. One favorite food of clodhoppers was the Tooke-trap plant. On Naboo, clodhoppers had natural predators like narglatches of any age, and even Gungans sometimes hunted them because of their meat (which made tasty snacks) and their thick skin (which was used to make musical instruments). Some centuries before the Battle of Naboo, however, the flightless birds were exported to other planets, which caused the utter devastation of entire colonies. Its export has been strictly forbidden since, under the maximum punishment allowable by law. The colony at Corva, in the Galaanus system, was wiped out by clodhoppers that had been accidentally shipped with grain from Naboo. Consequently, restrictions and inspection requirements on agricultural imports from Naboo existed on a number of worlds, some which callously supported the Trade Federation blockade in 32 BBY, if only to save the expense of funding inspections. On 32 BBY, the Army of Life managed to conceal clodhopper eggs in sealed boxes and shipped them to Stend IV in the Majestic Gundark. A Tarnab diplomat had a pet clodhopper.

name: Cloud angel
summary: According to rumors about Planet X, a mysterious planet many individuals believed to be a myth, cloud angels were sentient beings who could grant any wish and were found on the planet. In 382 BBY, while on the planet Batuu, the pilot Sky Graf told Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani about cloud angels and other rumors they had heard regarding Planet X. However, the hyperspace prospector Dass Leffbruk, who had previously been to the planet, refuted the rumors.

name: Cloud-deer
summary: Cloud-deer were a type of deer found on the planet Rei'izu that had white-flecked purple-gray fur and branching horns. Hundreds of cloud-deer lived on the grounds of a shrine in the pilgrims' ward of the city Yojou on Rei'izu. While a group including the Rei'izu native Ekiya, the bounty hunter Chie, and the former Sith known as the Ronin traveled through Yojou, many cloud-deer watched them and crossed their path. Later, when the Ronin and Chie encountered a group of citizens trying to shoo away a flock of cloud-deer that were intruding on a grocer's, they slowed with the intention of assisting the citizens, though ultimately did not do so.

name: Cloudripper
summary: Cloudrippers were a type of high-soaring avian found on the ocean moon Kef Bir. Alongside wanderwings, they were popular prey for Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters who used their custom energy bows without power augmentation to hunt the birds. When harvesting their kills, members of the company were efficient and gathered not only meat but also other materials.

name: Cloudsnake
summary: The cloudsnake was a variety of snake that had a smooth carapace.

name: Co-henpa
summary: The co-henpa was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of cu-pa.

name: Cochukka
summary: Cochukka, or cochukka sheep, were a species of sheep raised by shepherds on the planet Pkori.

name: Codru-Ji
summary: The Codru-Ji were a race of four-armed humanoids that inhabited the planet Munto Codru. Born as six legged canines known as Wyrwulves, they encased themselves in a cocoon at puberty, emerging weeks later as a two meter tall adult humanoid. Codru-Ji slept standing up, and communicated on a hypersonic level. As their homeworld had very few significant exports, the Codru-Ji were able to stay isolated from the affairs of the Galactic Empire and the New Republic. This allowed them to concentrate on their own complicated internal politics. Leading Codru-Ji families were often the target of "coup abductions", ritualized kidnappings of children by political rivals. These abductions almost always ended with the payment of ransoms and the safe return of the children. Ornate stone castles were scattered across Munto Codru. These castles were produced not by the Codru-Ji, but by an unknown extinct civilization. Many Codru-Ji avoided these castles, considering them to be haunted. However, they were sometimes used as provincial capitals. In 137 ABY, the citizens of Munto Codru were forced to join their tribes under the rule of the Empire controlled by Darth Krayt of the One Sith. A Sith Lord named Darth Kruhl personally visited the planet to coerce the Codru-Ji leaders into accepting Imperial rule and assassinate any opposing figure.

name: Coin-crab
summary: Coin-crabs were a species of small crustaceans, native to the coastlines of Taris, a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Known to be tasty when eaten, deep-fried coin-crabs were served at the Horizon Hotel in Taris' Upper City. In the year 40 ABY, the veteran Mandalorian soldier Goran Beviin ordered a bowl of deep-fried coin-crabs while visiting the Horizon Hotel for a meeting with Mand'alor Boba Fett.

name: Colicoid
summary: The Colicoids were a species of sentient, insectoid native to the planet Colla IV. Known for their completely emotionless and murderous ways, they created the design of the three-legged droidekas in their own image. They also led the Colicoid Creation Nest, a company that notably manufactured the Pistoeka sabotage droid and the Trident-class assault ship. The Trade Federation bought shipments of droidekas from the Colicoids in exchange for exotic meats.

name: Collypod
summary: Collypods were a species of small non-sentient creature used in cooking. They were regularly served flambeed and then smothered in a thick broth. In 22 BBY the Human chef Gab'borah Hise prepared stewed, flaming collypods with Tangerette cream and figs, whilst he worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Before the dish, which the cook considered delicious, was served to the Hutt, his Twi'lek Majordomo Bib Fortuna tried a sample, but one collypod was still alive and as it was aflame, managed to set the Twi'lek's sleeve on fire. Hise managed to put out the fire and bribed Fortuna a months worth of the cook's salary and a Ziziibbon truffle to persuade the majordomo not to have him thrown in the Sarlacc pit near Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine. Later that day he recounted the tale to the Mandalorian Bounty hunter Boba Fett whilst traveling to Jabba's fortress in an air yacht.
distinctions: Edible by Humans, Hutts, and Twi'leks

name: Colo claw fish
summary: The colo claw fish, also spelled colo clawfish, was a large and nightmarish creature found in the depths of Naboo's seas, as well as the Cordaxian Sea. The colo had a flat eel-like body, a bio-luminescent tail, a crocodile-like head, a row of sharp teeth, and a set of mandibles. They had a set of venomous fangs that they used to stun their prey. Their digestive system worked slowly, so they were at risk of being consumed from the inside out if they didn't kill their prey before eating it. A pair of large claws were located just behind the fish's head and were used to force food into the creature's large mouth. The bioluminescent skin of the colo claw fish lured in prey. While trying to reach Theed during the Invasion of Naboo, Qui-Gon Jinn, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jar Jar Binks were attacked by a colo fish. Before this colo could even touch the group's bongo, it was attacked and devoured by an even larger sando aqua monster.

name: Colony creature
summary: The colony creature was a sentient species that resided in the oceans of the planet Mon Calamari. The creature was made up of billions of independent cells that shared a collective consciousness, and it could also exert a weak form of mind control that enabled it to control the minds of dianoga. During the Clone Wars, the Mon Calamari established an underwater base on the seabed near to the colony creature's home. The presence of the base cut off the creature's food supply, almost killing it, but it survived by exerting control over the minds of passing dianoga and using them to bring it food. Seeking revenge, the creature then sent out a large force of dianoga to assault the underwater base. The attack was repulsed by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, and afterward Kenobi tracked down the colony creature. The Jedi attempted to negotiate with the creature, but it rejected his call to stop the fighting and instead it sent out more dianoga to launch a renewed attack on the base. However, via the application of the Living Force Kenobi became one with the soul of the colony creature and reached an accordance with it. The creature subsequently negotiated a peace resolution with the Mon Calamari Captain Gial Ackbar whereby the Mon Calamari would move their base and in return, the creature would aid them with tracking down Confederacy of Independent Systems invaders.

name: Color-crawler
summary: A color-crawler was a small creature that exuded a colored slime as it slid. Color-crawlers were sold for use in many cosmetic applications and came in a variety of colors, including black, silver, and various shades of brown and green. They were sold in packages sorted by color and were stored in their container until use. Once removed from the pack, crawlers could be applied to an individual's hair or fur or to cloth. They would then move around the surface that they were set on, dyeing it as they went. If several different colors of crawlers were used together it resulted in streaking. In 14 ABY, while searching for the kidnapped Solo children—Anakin, Jacen and Jaina—their mother, Chief of State Leia Organa Solo and the Wookiee Chewbacca used color-crawlers to change the color of their hair so they could disguise themselves as bounty hunters.

name: Colossus wasp
summary: Colossus wasps were a type of insect that the human journalist Rhil Dairo considered a horror. During the Battle of Eriadu in 228 BBY, during the High Republic Era, the Galactic Republic Stormwall Defense Fleet was attacked by Nihil scav droids, though due to the illusions created by the Nihil Child of the Storm H'Tar, the fleet believed it was under attack from what they feared most. While the Longbeam Gios came under attack from an illusioned Force-consuming Nameless creature, reports the Gios received stated that colossus wasps were attacking the fleet's ships, which Dairo informed Jedi Master Keeve Trennis of.

name: Columi
summary: The Columi were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Imperial Flag Lieutenant Edwig warned fleet and garrison commanders to be wary of members of the Columi species in a transmission sent on behalf of Admiral Firmus Piett.

name: Combat arachnid
summary: Combat arachnids were bantha-sized spiders from the planet Carida, whose bodies were covered in reflective spines. They had pointed legs, sharp fangs, and razor-sharp barbs on their lower abdomens. They produced chittering sounds with their teeth, but were also capable of roaring. Jabba the Hutt's menagerie of monsters included at least one such creature.
distinctions: Bantha-sized, with pointy legs, sharp fangs, barbs on the lower abdomen

name: Common ibbot
summary: The common ibbot, also known as the brown ibbot, was one of sixty-eight species of ibbot bird native to the Core Worlds planet Drall. Though it initially evolved to fill a particular role in Drall's ecosystem, the common ibbot was eventually domesticated by Drall's natives in order to supplement their diet. The bird could be prepared in many different ways and tasted mild and slightly salty when eaten. Members of the Drall species often described off-world foods as tasting like ibbot.

name: Common thranta
summary: The common thranta was the most common and well-known of the thranta species native to the planet Alderaan. The species was able to escape extinction even after the loss of their home, as some of the animals had been shipped to other locales such as Bespin. [[File:Thranta_Riders.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Thranta riders on Bespin.]] The beasts had strong wing muscles which allowed them to fly in the skies of their homeworld. Like the other subspecies, they were trainable and would be controlled by Thranta Riders. These handlers would place a compartment on the back of the beasts head while a larger passenger compartment was placed around its chest. Attempts were made to introduce the species to Coruscant, but the species could not survive the aerial pollution there. A large breed known as the giant thranta was identical to other common thrantas but, of course, larger in size. This is not to be confused with the great thranta, which was a distinct species.

name: Condluran
summary: Condlurans were a sentient species that existed within the galaxy. The Condluran Briff worked as a smuggler on Jedha during the High Republic Era. During the Imperial Era, Freck was a Condluran male who worked as a transport driver for the Galactic Empire on the mining planet Mapuzo.
distinctions: Snout with small tendrils protruding around it

name: Condor dragon
summary: Condor dragons, also known as mantigrues, were a species of creature native to the moon of Endor. The Ewoks of Bright Tree Village on Endor posted watchers in the forest canopy above their homes to watch out for condor dragons. The shaman Logray wore a cap adorned with the skull of a baby condor dragon.

name: Conduit worm
summary: Conduit worms were non-sentient, parasitic worms native to the planet Coruscant that fed on electricity. They absorbed components as they grew along the ecumenopolis' electrical conduits, turning them into organs. The worms could grow hundreds of meters long, infesting electrical power cable wiring in the Coruscant Underworld and feeding off starship power. The name "conduit worm" could also be used as an insult, akin to calling someone a "little parasite."
distinctions: Absorb components while growing along electrical conduits

name: Conjeni
summary: The Conjeni were a star-shaped sentient species. During Lina Soh's time as Supreme Chancellor during the High Republic Era, Force-sensitive Conjeni younglings were part of the Jedi Order's Clan Kowak. On one particularly hot day, the clan was chaperoned by Jedi Initiate Reina Bilass to a lesson at a swimming pool near the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. On the return journey to the temple, some of the rambunctious group wore their Jedi robes while others remained in swimsuits. Upon reaching Processional Way in front of the temple, Bilass silenced the Conjeni and other younglings with a snap of her fingers, causing them to fall into a straight line as they approached the steps to the temple. Grand Master Yoda and Jedi Master Avar Kriss then emerged from the structure to greet the group, and when Yoda asked how their swimming lesson had gone, the Conjeni younglings shouted back gleefully in response along with their human and Snivvian companions. Kriss then led the group into the temple to lead them in meditation.

name: Constancian
summary: Constancians were short, telepathic mammalian humanoids indigenous to Constancia.

name: Convor
summary: Convorees (singular: convor), also known as Trandoshan birds, were a species of beautiful, regal, and elegant owl. The slang phrase "chopped convor liver" was used to denote a person who felt they were getting less attention or consideration than someone else, as in "Do I look like chopped convor liver?"

name: Cooha
summary: Coohas were flightless, predatory avians native to Gandeid IV, a temperate, low-gravity planet in the Gandeid system. They were up to a meter and a half tall and covered in feathers. They had a large head in comparison to their lanky body, with a thin neck connecting them; their beaks were filled with small, slashing teeth. Coohas had two thin wings that ended in a long, sharp talon, and two long, thin legs that each ended in a two-toed, taloned foot. The cooha primarily fed on the flightless nestlings of noli, a species that, as adults, had powerful beaks and claws. The Cooha's slashing teeth were used to defend it from adults when it raided noli nests. Imperial governor Wilek Nereus of Bakura, a collector of the dentition of predatory creatures, included the cooha's slashing teeth in his collection.

name: Coosta mouse
summary: The coosta mouse was a type of mouse that roamed the Temple garden at the Jedi Temple on the forest planet Tenoo. Around 233 BBY, while on a trip to the planet Yamradi, the human Jedi youngling Kai Brightstar admired a group of small creatures known as chylaroos. He then compared them to the coosta mice because of their similar appearance.

name: Copek
summary: Copeks were predators that lived in the core of the planet Naboo. Many Gungan families were named after this species, namely a Gungan Boss who lived around 3000 BBY.

name: Cor
summary: The Cor were a feline sentient species native to the jungle world Gargolyn IV. The planet was chosen for settlement by the Karflo Corporation, which tried to forcibly relocate a Cor tribe despite legends warning of peril if this occurred. The following day, a large monster erupted from the ground, destroying Karflo's chosen site. Only the return of the Cor tribe was able to subdue the beast.

name: Coral bass
summary: Coral bass were a type of bass that partially shared their name with coral, stationary plant-like organisms. While in the San Tekka compound on the planet Naboo in 228 BBY, coral bass was grilled by the San Tekka family's kitchens. The dish was then served at a meal for Nihil General Abediah Viess—who had forcibly taken over the residence following the departure of its patriarchs, Vellis and Marlowe—and her captive, the human Cair San Tekka, a younger member of the family who engaged in anti-Nihil resistance activities. Though Cair was reluctant to dine with the Nihil, he mentally lamented that refusing the food would not be a smart decision for his physical well-being.

name: Coral-monk
summary: The Coral-monks were a sentient species.

name: Corellian
summary: Corellians were a cultural group of humans native to the planet Corellia. Han Solo, captain of the Millennium Falcon, was a Corellian who fought for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

name: Corellian butterfly
summary: The Corellian butterfly was a butterfly that lived in the swamps of Corellia. It had a long tail containing a stinger, and very large wings.

name: Corellian gluttonbug
summary: Corellian gluttonbugs were bugs that lived in hives. According to Rieve, the Grand Arena looked like a hive of Corellian gluttonbugs.

name: Corellian grass snake
summary: Corellian grass snakes were reptilian creatures native to Corellia that resembled ysalamiri, except that they had neither fur nor claws.

name: Corellian hound
summary: Corellian hounds, also known as Sibian hounds, were a type of hound from the planet Corellia. They were quick and nimble canines used by locals for a number of tasks. Due to their keen sense of smell, they were often used for hunting and tracking. They had a vicious bark and bite, which meant they could be quite effective for protection. Criminal gangs were fond of using the hounds for defense or to attack their rivals. They also had regenerating teeth. Corellian hounds were also present on the planet Ushruu, where they were known as snarlers, in addition to the Outer Rim planet of Ferrix, where they were referred to as Ferrix hounds.

name: Corellian sand panther
summary: Corellian sand panthers, also known as just sand-panthers, were a feline species native to the planet Corellia. The engineers of Coronet Arms based the design of the Mark V "Sand Panther" hunting rifle on an ancient rifle used to hunt sand-panthers. The Imperial pilot Tana Chellaine believed that her squadmate Huck Trompo had impulse control similar to that of a sand-panther in heat.

name: Corellian scavenge rat
summary: Corellian scavenge rats, also known as scavenger rats, were rodents native to Corellia.

name: Corellian slice hound
summary: The Corellian slice hound, also known as the razor hound, was a canine creature form Corellia
distinctions: Canine with sharp teeth and spiky body

name: Corellian sting-gnat
summary: Corellian sting-gnats were a type of gnat that shared their name with Corellia, a Core Worlds planet. In 230 BBY, during the High Republic Era, the starship known as the Vessel traveled to the Echerta system in the Outer Rim in an attempt to make a faster journey to the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon. After arriving in the Echerta system, the Vessel came under attack by starships of the Nihil pirates. Jedi Master Elzar Mann—who was traveling aboard the Vessel—went to its cockpit to determine how much trouble they were in. Following his arrival into the cockpit, Mann looked outside of the Vessel and immediately regretted his decision to as he saw that the system was flooded with Nihil ships and that they swooped in each direction. He then mentally noted that they were like clouds of Corellian sting-gnats.

name: Corellian wine-bee
summary: Corellian wine-bees were insects native to Corellia.

name: Corinathoth
summary: Corinathoths were massive, slow-moving herbivores native to the planet Maridun. The Korinatoths were slow-moving, which made these impressively looking creatures quite harmless. During the early years of the Galactic Empire’s Imperial Era, General Ziering's expedition encountered a herd of Korinatoths crossing the plains of Maridun, which lumber by, unheeded of the humans and their vehicles.

name: Coromon Headhunter
summary: The Coromon Headhunter was a fierce creature native to the terrestrial planet Fresia in the Core Worlds. The Z-95 Headhunter produced by Incom Corporation and Sublights Products Corporation borrowed its popular name from the Coromon Headhunter.

name: Coronet salamander
summary: Coronet salamanders were fly-eating salamanders that partially shared their name with Coronet City, a city on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. The Corellian former scrumrat Qi'ra mentally noted the Crimson Dawn operative Corynna's quick reflexes when the latter caught the transceiver linked to the former's enslavement tracking chip in the air, comparing the swift movement to a Coronet salamander catching flies.

name: Corosian phoenix
summary: The Corosian phoenix was a bird commonly regarded for its beauty. The ARC trooper Nate once saw one and briefly wanted to keep it as a pet, before deciding that doing so would go against military protocol.

name: Corpse-leech
summary: Corpse-leeches were a species of non-sentient carnivores native to Carnelion IV. They were distinguished by their six eyes, red skin, and wings.

name: Corragut
summary: The Corragut were a sentient species hailing from Altawar, a planet in the Core Worlds' Corellian sector. After the species was discovered by Corellians, the Corragut were offered opportunities upon introduction to the wider galaxy. However, they subsequently became a "client planet" for the planet Corellia—which was governed by a Human-centric culture—and had little say in governing themselves.

name: Corridor ghoul
summary: Corridor ghouls were creatures that lived in sewers in the underworld of the planet Coruscant. Around 3 ABY, a family of Imperial defectors encountered a corridor ghoul as they attempted to escape from Coruscant underworld police. Bevelyn shot and killed the creature, though it alerted the police officers to their location. Not long after, the rebel and Jedi Padawan Luke Skywalker, who had traveled to Coruscant to rescue the family, summoned a number of corridor ghouls to attack the police, which allowed for his and the family's escape.

name: Corthenian
summary: Corthenians were a sentient alien species from the Corthenia system in the Mid Rim. In 21 BBY, a Corthenian attended a hive ball with a Human and a Wookiee that was being held in honor of a pair of Galactic Republic diplomats, Barrister Doolb Snoil and Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi.

name: Coruscani ogre
summary: The Coruscani ogre was a large semi-sentient humanoid beast that lived in Coruscant sublevels, sewers, and dumps.

name: Coruscant game fowl
summary: Coruscant game fowl were farm-bred birds eaten on Coruscant.

name: Coruscant rodent
summary: Coruscant rodents were a type of rodent native to the Core Worlds planet Coruscant and liked to eat the flowers within the gardens of the Jedi Order's Jedi Temple. On at least one occasion after the Alcedian Jedi youngling Tep Tep arrived at the Jedi Temple after leaving the Outer Rim planet Valo in 229 BBY, the human Jedi youngling Jamil Sollis found Tep Tep—who had a special Force connection to animals—playing with the rodents. In 228 BBY, as Sollis went to find Tep Tep in the Temple, he mentally noted that if he did not find her playing with the Coruscant rodents, he would find her in the youngling dormitories or within the cargo hold of the research ship Innovator in a hangar. He found the Alcedian in the cargo hold.

name: Corvaj
summary: The corvaj was a predator that inhabited the Wilds, an area of overgrown jungle and swampy lowlands that was known as the location of insect swarms and vicious beasts. The corvaj was known to be deadly; they ambushed their prey, and were noted for ripping out a victim's liver. Corvajs had a distinctive snarl, and were capable of killing a grown Human. Some time during the Galactic Civil War, cadet pilots Ranna Gorjaye and Calson were flying a training patrol over a planet. While above the Wilds, Calson overcrowded the formation, causing both fighters to crash into the wilderness. Aware that corvajs inhabited the Wilds, Gorjaye sought to lead the pair of them to the safety of a settlement seventeen kilometers from their position. Calson, however, refused to follow the orders of a woman. Setting off on his own, Calson was ambushed and killed by a corvaj. Gorjaye managed to escape the Wilds.

name: Corvus isopod
summary: Corvus isopods were a species of invertebrate native to the planet Corvus.

name: Cosian
summary: Cosians were a species of long-lived sentient reptilian humanoids from Cosia. Jedi Master Tera Sinube was a Cosian who served the Jedi Order from the High Republic Era to the Clone Wars.
distinctions: Long tails ended with tuft of hair

name: Courataine
summary: Courataines were a sentient species of humanoids from a homeworld with lower than standard gravity. Their bodies were wobbly-fleshed, resulting in them wearing exoskeletal travel suits when they traveled. On their homeworld, they breathed a very thin atmosphere; to simulate this offworld, they used respirators built into their suits for comfort. At some point between 2 BBY and 1 BBY, a number of Courataines were present on the planet Bonadan at the same time that the smuggler Han Solo was there investigating an enslavement ring.

name: Covallon
summary: The Covallon were a bestial sentient species rarely seen away from their homeworld. The descendants of swift predatory quadrupeds, the Covallon had a developed capacity for sensing others' emotions, a holdover from hunting in packs. Covallon society developed to an early information technology level by the time of the Galactic Civil War, although most Covallon were comfortable with more advanced technology. The Covallon Dælar vuv Tertarrnek served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a spy, having been given to Imperial Moff Harlov Jarnek as a pet. From that position vuv Tertarrnek fed the Alliance with strategic information on Imperial troop and fleet movements in the Tandon sector.
height: 0.9–1.2 meters at the shoulder *1.8–2.2 meters on hind legs

name: Coway
summary: The Coway were a primitive race of humanoids that were native to the planet Mimban. Because of their intense dislike of outsiders, they spent most of their lives in the caves beneath the planet's fog-shrouded swamps.

name: Coyerti
summary: The Coyerti species was one of many life forms native to the planet Coyerti.

name: Coynite
summary: Coynites were a sentient species from the Coyn system. One such being was involved in a gladitorial fight in the city of Sclavos on Zygerria, which ended with the Coynite's death.

name: Crab-harp
summary: Crab-harps were bioengineered non-sentient creatures created by the Yuuzhan Vong species. Crab-harps had long legs with tendons that linked the tips of each of their legs to their bodies. When their legs were locked in an extended position, the stretched tendons could be used to create music by plucking them. In existence by 26 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, these crustaceans were used by the Yuuzhan Vong as musical instruments or were set loose at ceremonies to make their own music.
height: About the height of a Yuuzhan Vong's torso

name: Crab spider
summary: The crab spider was a non-sentient species of spider native to the planet Despayre, located in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Inside the shack of Celot Ratua Dil, a prisoner living at Slashtown Prison Colony on Despayre, there was a crab spider as large as Dil's hand that nestled in one of the upper corners near his roof. All the crab spiders on Despayre perished with the destruction of the planet by the first Death Star that occurred in 0 BBY.

name: Cracian thumper
summary: Cracian thumpers were bipedal herbivores used as pack and riding animals. Originally from the planet Craci in the Corporate Sector, they possessed clawed forelimbs and hindlimbs, and a powerful tail. Their large, padded feet allowed them to move very quietly, earning them their ironic name—the "thumper"—which implied it should have thumped as it ran. They were loyal creatures, and unusually bright for a beast of burden; they were capable of being trained to perform a number of different tasks, to recognize patterns, and to follow simple commands. Though normally inoffensive, their claws and tail made them deadly opponents when they were threatened or trained to fight. The usefulness of Cracian thumpers as riding and pack animals saw them heavily exported, making them the most widely employed land mount in the galaxy.
