They were frequently used in the Rebel Alliance, where they were an important part of its live mount scouting program, and were also heavily utilized by Alliance SpecForce personnel. Cracian thumper racing was also a popular sport in urban areas such as the Tapani sector.
distinctions: Bipedality; nearly silent movement; sharp claws; atypical intelligence for a beast of burden

name: Cragmoloid
summary: The Cragmoloid were a sentient elephantine species that lived in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, a young Cragmoloid named Flim was begging in the Holy City of Jedha.

name: Crane
summary: A crane was a type of bird. Types of cranes included the castua crane and the marsh crane. In 3 BBY, Princess Leia Organa met the girl Amilyn Holdo during a pathfinding class on the planet Alderaan and mentally noted that Holdo's thinness and gawkiness reminded her of a marsh crane. Later, during another session of the class on the world Pamarthe, Holdo tilted her head and Organa was reminded of a marsh crane looking for food. By 34 ABY, the Resistance members Sari Nadle and Mattis Banz saw a castua crane on the planet D'Qar. That year, while on the First Order's Starkiller Base, Nadle and Banze remembered occasions they saw birds on D'Qar, including when they saw castua cranes.

name: Cranial nodular worm
summary: Cranial nodular worms were a type of parasitic worm that could infest the craniums of the domesticated creatures known as happabores, which could be found on planets across the Western Reaches. If a happabore was infested with the parasite, it could be treated with Galacti-Stok product Happy-Bore Medicated Dewormer, which contained Trestibinexocycline 5-Gamma, thlank oil, greel-root acid, and forage products. Instructions for the slurry formulation of the product suggested use of the dewormer on cranial nodular worms and, while living on the desert planet Jakku, the scavenger Rey found a copy of these instructions. She then included them alongside information about happabores on Jakku in a survival guide that she compiled by 34 ABY.

name: Cranscoc
summary: The Cranscoc were an insectoid species from the planet Cartao who controlled Spaarti Creations. They reproduced slowly, and communicated by changing colors. A sub-species known as Twillers controlled the strange fluid technology that earned Spaarti Creations their profits.

name: Crast
summary: Crast, also called food-kin, were a race of crustaceans from Pria. They had a symbiotic relationship with the Priapulins. Crast eggs began to be incubated after being digested by a Priapulin. The Crast were willing to act as Priapulin food, and in return Priapulins cared for their children. Crast must be consumed by Priapulins before their children spoil. In 29 BBY, 12 year old Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker and Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi encountered the Crast aboard the Star Sea Flower. The Crast took a particular liking towards Skywalker. Charza Kwinn, the Priapulin on board, said that the Crast felt Skywalker was safe and that he posed a rare attraction for them. Skywalker, able to understand some of their communication, remarked that they were very smart creatures relative to their size and they were proud that Kwinn chose to eat them and only them.

name: Cratsch
summary: The cratsch was a tree-dwelling predator native to Bakura. Wilek Nereus personally killed one once, showcasing its teeth in his office. Drawn to namana trees by swarms of birds that feasted on its fruit, the cratsch waited for them to drop to the ground in a flightless, happy stupor before eating them. Despite its relatively passive method of feeding, the cratsch was a powerful fighter. Each male would stake out a stand of namana trees by marking it with musk glands located near the base of its furred, prehensile black tail. It would then defend those trees against all other cratsch males. During the mating season, one prime male could successfully defend a large timberland. The cratsch had a wedge-shaped head with black "mask" markings; a long, lithe body; short, strong legs; retractable climbing claws; and brown fur.

name: Craw-maw
summary: Craw-maws were birds that were genetically engineered by food corporations to be silent and wingless. They were raised on Ruan.
distinctions: Genetically engineered to be silent and wingless

name: Crawler
summary: The crawlers were 134 species of nearly two-dimensional life-forms that lived under high atmospheric pressures in the boundary between the atmosphere and core of the Outer Rim Territories gas giant Yavin Prime. Reaching sizes of several hundred kilometers across and no more than two decimeters in height, they constantly moved across the layer of frozen liquids that they inhabited, feeding on trace elements and reproducing by fission. Such activity led to the dislodgement of the valuable Corusca gems from Yavin Prime's core, followed by their rise to the higher levels of the planet's atmosphere. Although the crawlers were eventually discovered via long-range observations, no contact with the organisms had been made by 3 ABY.
height: From a millimeter up to two decimeters
length: From centimeters to hundreds of kilometers
distinctions: Able to withstand atmospheric pressure near a gas giant's core

name: Crawlfish
summary: Crawlfish were edible aquatic creatures native to Yavin 4's many spring-fed pools.

name: Crax eel
summary: Crax eels were a type of eel. At one point, the alien crime lord Sabi Sabo Acidy fed his brother to a pack of feral crax eels for a bottle of squig. Eventually the incident became known to the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra and New Republic Director Meteora Gray. No earlier than 5 ABY, after being informed Acidy was to return a precious totem to the Campi tribe in exchange for remaining in the New Republic's good graces, Aphra—who worked for the Republic—asked if it was referring to the same Acidy who had fed his brother to the crax eels. In response, Gray confirmed it was.

name: Creedok
summary: A Creedok was an amphibious reptile that lived in the swamp of The Green in Coronet City, Corellia. They would literally hunt themselves into a coma.

name: Creepmice
summary: Creepmice were a type of mice. In 382 BBY, Path of the Open Hand member Yana Ro encountered the mice on the moon Jedha. Jedi Initiates Sifo-Dyas and Dooku sneaked into the Archive of Forbidden Artifacts on the planet Coruscant in 88 BBY, with the former youngling making a comment about creepmice.

name: Crested arrow ibbot
summary: The crested arrow ibbot was one of sixty-eight species of ibbot, a class of bird native to the planet Drall in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds. Unlike most other ibbots, which ate algae, the crested arrow ibbot was predatory. The species evolved to fit a particular niche in Drall's ecology.

name: Crickbeet
summary: Crickbeets were a type of nocturnal critter known for their constant chirping, which would suddenly stop if they sensed danger. One type of crickbeet was the Lothalian crickbeet. It could be found in Capital City on the Outer Rim planet Lothal. One night, Imperial stormtrooper TK-626 was patrolling a TIE fighter airfield, listening to the crickbeets. When they stopped chirping, he sensed something was amiss, alerting his partner, MB-223, before the airfield was attacked by Mandalorian Sabine Wren.

name: Crier
summary: The crier was a type of avian predator native to Orellon II. It had a wingspan of 10 meters, short feathers, and sharp talons. Criers hunted in groups on the open plain, using their pointy beaks to impale their prey. They dwelt in nests on the peaks of the mountain of Orellon and were able to cling to the mountain sides using their talons. They were also able to fly noiselessly and execute stunning aerial acrobatics.

name: CRILOC Horse
summary: CRILOC Horses were gray-furred, black-eyed domesticated creatures that were used as mounts and beasts-of-burden in desert regions. CRILOC Horses possessed gray skin, clawed limbs, a bushy tail, and short, pointed ears located on the top of its head. The creatures each had a fanged mouth that contained a pink tongue. They could be saddled and mounted by Humans, and were sometimes startled by combat-scout droids. At some point, a CRILOC Horse was ridden by a Human male and was accompanied by the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 in a desert, where they met a combat-scout droid that alarmed and frightened the creature, despite the fact that the droid was not aggressive.

name: Crimson slug
summary: Crimson slugs were predators that lived in the vacuum of realspace. They could be found in the Tapani sector. The crimson slugs were variants of the exogorth space slugs.

name: Crintlian
summary: Crintlians were an alien species native to the Crintlia system. They were known to aggressively defend their territory, even against foes with a significant numerical or technological advantage.

name: Critokian
summary: Critokians were a species of two-meter-tall, arachnoid sentients from the Critoki system, although many dwelt in tribes on the moon Yavin 4. They used large claws to hunt prey on the jungle world, and several of their number eventually departed Yavin 4 and found work as bounty hunters. The Critokians' biological makeup featured a complex nervous system and six holes though which they could both communicate and breathe.
distinctions: Large claws, six holes for respiration and eating

name: Croaker
summary: A croaker was an animal native to the rain forest on Kirtania.

name: Croator
summary: Croator were flightless birds from Wyndigal 2's swamps and marshlands. They were spindly avians, with long double-jointed legs and small arms in place of wings. These limbs featured webbed feet and front paws and flexible joints, allowing them to crouch low in the water or to unfold their limbs to run at high speeds. Croators had long proboscises, which they used to suck small fish, insects, and microorganisms from the mud. Their backs were covered by a cape-like feathered membrane, with a similar hood over their heads. Their capes and hoods were white and blue in color, and were highly reflective. This helped them survive the intense ultraviolet radiation of their homeworld's sun. In the early part of the day, the cape and hood would drape loosely on a croator's body as they moved about. Later in the day, as the light became more intense, they would wrap their bodies and heads, and stay in one spot to feed. Spacers unlucky enough to be stranded on Wyndigal 2 would sometimes kill croator for these membranes, which they used to cover themselves for protection. Croator lived in temporary bands of three to five members, who scattered when their feeding grounds were depleted. They reproduced asexually, laying eggs once every standard year after a three-month gestation period. Young croator were fully viable when they hatched, immediately able to search for their own food. These young croator were frequently eaten by predators such as the nyantolo, but enough survived for the species as a whole to thrive.
distinctions: Reflective plumage and hood, flexible joints, asexual

name: Crocin
summary: Crocins were a reptilian sentient species that were native to Croce. Karjj was a member of this species.

name: Crocodina
summary: Crocodinas were a type of crocodile-like creature with scaley heads that included a pair of eyes and a long, thin snout with a toothy maw. In 1 BBY, Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine had the head of a crocodina displayed on the wall near its bar.

name: Croke
summary: The Croke were a species of sentient, multi-legged beings from the planet Crakull in the Unknown Regions who were extremely long lived; one individual enjoyed a lifespan of more than 20,000 years. In their natural form, the species resembled bristly-legged snails that were diminutive enough to be held in a Human hand. However, Croke were naturally skilled in illusion casting, a Force ability that allowed them to appear in larger guises. The Croke colonized a larger area of the Unknown Regions known as the Croke Reach and had a reputation in the galaxy for being unpleasant and vicious. At one point, the Croke fought a long and debilitating civil war. The destruction worsened greatly when one of the factions introduced a voracious species known as the Lugubraa—commonly employed as mercenaries in the Unknown Regions—as a weapon into the Reach's worlds. Many Croke-settled planets, such as Explume Minor, were destroyed by the Lugubraa, whose unfettered reproductive rate led them to feed voraciously. To wipe out the invasive species, the Croke purchased a genetically modified strain of Lugubraa, known as blind berserkers, from the cloners of Kamino. These clones, however, proved to be just as problematic as the original Lugubraa, and caused further devastation to the Croke Reach. The Croke species was nearly wiped out. One Croke, Rokur Gepta, left his homeworld and began a reign of terror in the galaxy. Gepta massacred a group of mystics known as the Sorcerers of Tund and later allied himself with the ruler of the Galactic Empire, Emperor Palpatine, who gave Gepta control of an area of space known as the Centrality. Gepta came into conflict with the smuggler Lando Calrissian, whom the Croke swindled into doing his bidding. The young smuggler eventually turned on Gepta and cost him control of a powerful artifact known as the Mindharp. After Calrissian became trapped by an Imperial blockade, Gepta attempted to kill him and all members of a species known as the Oswaft with a biological weapon. Gepta's plans were foiled on both accounts, and Calrissian personally shot the Croke and crushed him to death.
length: Small enough to fit in a Human hand; no bigger than a Wookiee's fist
distinctions: Extended lifespan; natural illusion ability; oily skin; many legs; vacuum resistance

name: Crolute
summary: Crolutes were a hulking aquatic humanoid sentient species from the planet Crul. Crolutes were exclusively male, while their mates, the Gilliands, were exclusively female. When removed from their native saltwater surroundings, Crolutes' buoyant, gelatinous body tissue sagged unsettlingly from their bodies. Like the Mon Calamari, they had flipper-like feet that could fit into standard humanoid boots.
distinctions: Buoyant body tissue, skin sagged when outside of saltwater

name: Crolute precursor species
summary: A species of amphibious creatures were native to the planet Crul in the Mid Rim, where they eventually evolved into the sentient Crolute species millions of years later. Members of the species used to come ashore during summers, with males (known as "bulls") fighting for females (or "cows") and guarding breeding colonies on the beaches.

name: Crop microserp
summary: Crop microserps were a type of parasitic worm that could infest the domesticated happabore species, which was found on planets across the Western Reaches. Happy-Bore Medicated Dewormer—a product produced by Galacti-Stok that contained Trestibinexocycline 5-Gamma, thlank oil, greel-root acid and forage products—could be used to treat crop microserps infestation in happabores. Use of the dewormer on the parasite was suggested in the instructions for the slurry formulation of the product. The scavenger Rey found a copy of these instructions while living on the desert planet Jakku and included them alongside information about happabores on the world in a survival guide that she compiled by 34 ABY.

name: Crown finch
summary: A crown finch was a type of bird. Jedi Knight Ky Narec fed crown finches and song sparrows, another type of bird, that lived in the training ground of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. Around 23 BBY, Narec's voice told his former Padawan, Asajj Ventress, that what he missed the most of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant was feeding the birds, which fluttered with their various colors around the Great Tree within the temple.

name: Crown of silk
summary: Native to the planet of Cerea, the crown of silk was both a beautiful and a dangerous creature. Although serene looking and graceful, the crown of silk was a vicious predator. It would encircle the head of its prey and compress it to paralyze the creature and feed on its ambient energies for one to a few hours, and would leave the victim dazed for a few days after the attack. Though many things could damage a crown of silk, only heat or fire would cause it to release its prey before it had finished feeding. Simply pulling off the crown could leave its victim with permanent neurological damage. The crown of silk was attracted to Force-sensitive people. Due to its own Force connection, the crown of silk could find prey regardless of invisibility or total darkness.
hairColor: Blue/Purple thread-like tentacles used to move around
distinctions: Interior mouth with cilia and openings
Thin tendrils above and below body

name: Cru
summary: The cru was a species of small, winged creatures. For their size, they had large noses and ears. Two front sharp teeth stuck out of the mouth. During the High Republic Era, a male named Cham Cham was the pet of the Force-sensitive, Zeen Mrala.

name: Crucrarocha beetle
summary: Crucrarocha beetles were a type of beetle used as an ingredient in crucrarocha beetle salad. In 228 BBY, in the Hutt Devirsivik Clan's palace on the planet Nal Hutta, a Toydarian cook served the Hutt Churo crucrarocha beetle salad and fried worrt with his green juice for breakfast, even though Churo had previously told the cook that he was a vegetarian. Churo's father made him finish his meal anyway, and his cousin Lorko mocked him and shoveled an extra helping onto his plate. Later that day, when Churo's sister Dahara Devirsivik Norri told him to stop grinning, Churo attempted to twist his face to look stretchy and mad like his sister's but felt that he only managed to look like he was trying to not throw up the crucrarocha beetles he had eaten.

name: Crulkon
summary: The Crulkon were a sentient species with a presence on the Outer Rim planet Turrak. During the High Republic Era, there were tensions between the Crulkon and the native Scalvi, the latter of whom contacted the Jedi Grand Master Yoda for assistance.

name: Crunchbug
summary: Crunchbugs were a non-sentient species of insects that were enjoyed as a snack food by members of the Hutt species. They produced chirping or peeping sounds. In 11 ABY, the Hutt crime lord Shala offered the Jedi Corran Horn a bowl of live crunchbugs in his base on the planet Courkrus, but the Force-sensitive had to decline as he claimed to have an allergy to insects. Horn later reflected that he wished to he could use the Force to perform a census of all the crunchbugs living in the city of Vlarnya on the planet. In 19 ABY, crunchbugs were served at a huge feast held by Popara Anjiliac Diresto in his penthouse on the planet Nal Hutta.

name: Crupa
summary: Crupa, sometimes called cloud crupa, were nocturnal songbirds from Garos IV.

name: Crynoid
summary: Crynoids, or snow spiders, were arachnids native to the ice planet Neftali. Skilled at climbing and jumping, the tiny, three-centimeter-long species had ten segmented legs and was colored gray and white. Preferring to live among certain mosses found in the planet's caverns near thermal vents, they were known to crawl into an individual's bedroll, and during the reign of the Galactic Empire, a small number were located in Exovar's Emporium. While the non-sentient crynoids mostly ate the mosses they lived among and were not generally aggressive, they would bite if harassed such that they felt threatened. This bite would inject a potent venom that could kill a humanoid within an hour. Those individuals that were lucky to survive or had a medpac handy would not escape or receive relief from the intense pain the venom would bestow for six hours, for there was no known remedy. The solitary creatures could only be seen in pairs when they had recently mated.
distinctions: Poisonous bite that results in extreme pain and potential death

name: Cryopede
summary: Cryopedes were a type of creature found in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. In 3 ABY, cryopedes got into the office of Wen Delphis, crime lord of the Sixth Kin gang, in Club Tarsus through the building's vents. She complained of the infestation and a technician at the club made plans to clear them out, but lost their keycard and so went for a drink in the club with one of the Sixth Kin's enforcers instead. The enforcer brought up Delphis's complaints about the cryopedes and offered to help the technician find the keycard after another round of drinks.

name: Crystal barnacle
summary: The crystal barnacle was a species of barnacle that clung to starships in drydocks on Bilbringi VII, a large chunk of ore in the Bilbringi system. The species had a spike-covered body with three pairs of legs.

name: Crystal bat
summary: Crystal bats were a type of bat found in the Triple Moon Caves on the planet Siline. In 134 BBY, while visiting the caves, the Silinese Rhos Arthyst told Jedi Padawan Yord Fandar to watch out for both crystal bats and endangered dry-rock salamanders. Although Fandar wanted to see the crystal bats, he resisted the urge to immediately crane his neck upward and instead relied on swift glances, noticing channels that led into the cave ceiling where he assumed the bats lived.

name: Crystal snake
summary: A crystal snake was a venomous reptile native to the moon Yavin 4. The crystal snake had curiously translucent flesh that, with the naked eye under typical lighting conditions, could barely be seen. One sign that a crystal snake was present would be the small shimmer of light that reflected off its scales, or its deep black eyes. The venom that crystal snakes secreted when they bit was nonlethal. However, it could be extremely dangerous, since the victim of a crystal snake bite would fall into an hour-long deep sleep. Hooded crystal snakes had the ability to flatten their neck.

name: Crystal web spider
summary: Crystal web spiders were a species of spider known for their extremely adhesive crystalline webs. Not only were their webs notably sticky, but also strong enough that a training lightsaber could not cut through it. A full-power lightsaber, however, could slice through their webs. The crystal web spider species included the much larger Spider-King. In 232 BBY, a large number of crystal web spiders aboard the starship of safari droid SF-R3 ("Aree") were accidentally released by Jedi Initiate Kai Brightstar into the Tenoo Jedi Temple after the boy was spooked by the Spider-King. Brightstar and Aree, with the help of fellow Initiates Lys Solay and Nubs used biscuits the spiders enjoyed to lure the spiders back onto Aree's ship. With Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zanna and her Padawan Wes Vinik away on a mission, the spiders quickly managed to weave numerous webs around the temple, entrapping many of its inhabitants. In spite of his fear, Brightstar, the Initiates, and Aree successfully recovered the spiders before the Spider-King completed his nest, allowing Aree to transport them to their new home.

name: Cthallops' species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Cthallops was a member of this species.

name: Cthon
summary: The Cthon were a troglodytic species that did not rely on visual senses. As such, the weapon known as the flashstick, which emitted a bright flash of blinding light when used, had no effect on them.

name: Cu-pa
summary: The cu-pa was a bipedal, theropod-like species of reptomammal native to the Outer Rim worlds of Nam Chorios and Tatooine. They were distant cousins of the tauntaun, another species of omnivorous reptomammals indigenous to the icy planet of Hoth. However, unlike the tauntaun, the cu-pa had a more brightly colored hide, and were not nearly as intelligent. However, they were very passive, and could be trained by beast masters to act as mounts. The cu-pa was mostly comparable in size to the tauntaun, but a subspecies known as the wasteland cu-pa could grow to much larger sizes. Bioengineers were also known to use the DNA of the cu-pa to incubate mutated variants known as co-henpa.
hairColor: Red in the wild; varied when domesticated

name: Cuckoo hen
summary: Cuckoo hens were a type of chicken that made clucking sounds. By the time of the Imperial Era, being compared to one of the hens could be considered a symbol of cowardice. While attending an emergency summit on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 4 ABY, Grand Moff Valco Pandion berated his fellow Imperials for their lack of courage to attack the nascent New Republic, questioning if they were part of an Empire consisting of cuckoo hens.

name: Cuirreal climber
summary: Cuirreal climbers were a species native to the planet Dressel. Their meat featured prominently alongside mushrooms and the seeds and syrup of the steepara tree in the diets of the sentient Dressellian species.

name: Culisetto
summary: Culisetto were a sentient species of small, tube-mouthed insectoids that fed off of blood and also wore traditional brown traveling smocks. The Dengue sisters were members of this species as well as the bounty hunter Vorhdeilo.

name: Culroon
summary: The Culroon were the natives of the planet Culroon III in Wild Space.

name: Cusverian
summary: The Cusverians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Levgo Mar was a member of this species.

name: Cuttle-tick
summary: The cuttle-tick was an edible creature that had a venomous carapace. In 3 ABY, the Devaronian Executive Chef Torro Sbazzle served cuttle-tick to a group of shipping barons from the planet Kuat, her staff warning them that the carapace was for show and not to be eaten. The barons had insisted on ordering the dish and while Sbazzle made it for them, she was worried that they might ingest the venom by mistake. Sbazzle later recounted the incident to her employer, the Baron Administrator of Cloud City, Lando Calrissian.

name: Cy Yunga's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Cy Yunga was a member of this species.

name: Cyblocian
summary: The Cyblocians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. An assassin was a member of this species.

name: Cyborrean
summary: The Cyborreans were the native sentient species of the planet Cyborrea in Hutt Space region of the galaxy. They were almost always at war with each other, and were a client species of the Hutts. When not engaged in battle, they hunted the vicious creatures of their planet to keep their skills sharp. They were known for breeding Cyborrean Battle Dogs, vicious, dog-sized creatures that were fitted with armor and cybernetic implants. They were often sold on the black market.

name: Cyclorrian
summary: Cyclorrians were an insectoid sentient species famed for their dedicated engineering skills. They were proud of producing advanced starships at the Cyclor Shipyards in the Mid Rim, which were second only to the Corellian shipyards during the High Republic Era.

name: Cy'een
summary: Cy'een were fish-lizards native to Chad with bronze scales and long, thick necks. These creatures were considered beautiful and were known to sing.

name: Cygnat
summary: Cygnats were small biting pests native to the planet Thisspias in the Expansion Region. They could be deterred by dense hair, such as the beard of Thisspiasian Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis. Almost two hundred years before the Galactic Civil War, a group of terrorists who assassinated the Blood Monarch of Thisspias wore something similar to a cygnat symbol. Because of that, when anti-monarchist abolitionist factions of Thisspiasians began wearing cygnat pins during the Galactic Civil War, it concerned even some moderate members of the species.

name: Cyphari
summary: The Cyphari were a sentient species native to the planet Cyphar. Cyphari were described as resembling large stick insects with snouts similar to that of a Rodian. They were covered in neat rows of short red fur. One group of Cyphari was known as the Afe clan. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Afe Clan was led by a Cyphari named Chief Joko.

name: Cyran
summary: The Cyrans were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At least one Cyran was living on the planet Skuhl during the Imperial Era.

name: Cyrillian
summary: Cyrillians were a species of tall, sentient reptiles native to the industrialized planet Cyrillia in the Expansion Region. The species invented the DUM-series pit droid to aid them in vehicle maintenance and made use of it during the reign of the Galactic Republic, when their homeworld became part of the galactic circuit of podracing. The species agreed to give up the rights to the model and produce it for the Serv-O-Droid, Inc. droid-manufacturing company, in return for profits after Cyrillia ceased to be part of the podracing circuit. During the Galactic Civil War, Cyrillia became a fortress world for the Galactic Empire, but the Imperials abandoned it in 6 ABY.

name: Czerialan
summary: Czerialans were a sentient species native to the planet Czerialus. They resembled humans with high cranial domes with tufts of white hair. Jannitha Xoczuko was a member of this species. During the Imperial Era, their homeworld was under Imperial control and the Xoczuko family sought to return after being disheartened on Corellia, unaware of the Empire's control on the planet.

name: Da-Vlunnian
summary: Da-Vlunnian were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, one Da-Vlunnian, Masakene, served as the chief steward for Skarabda the Hutt on the planet Ballum.

name: Dabi
summary: The Dabi were a sentient species that had four arms that they could operate independently. A member of the species could speak Galactic Basic Standard. In 40 ABY, a Dabi worked as a bartender in Zerria's Bar on the planet Drall. When a visiting patron, the Mandalorian Mirta Gev, destroyed the speech circuit of the droid waiter Forre Musa, the bartender applauded her action, claiming the droid had been ruining business at the bar.

name: Dac anchovy
summary: The Dac anchovy was a species of edible fish native to the planet Dac where they were cooked and eaten by the native sentient Mon Calamari species. During his travels of the galaxy, the Besalisk chef Dexter Jettster visited Dac and tried Dac anchovies, although he discovered he was allergic to them. Dexter later mentioned his intolerance of the fish, and the Mon Calamari who cooked them, in the introduction of his menu at Dex's Diner, an eatery he owned on the planet Coruscant.

name: Dactyl stork
summary: Dactyl storks were marsh-dwelling birds with long, bent-back legs.

name: Dagbat
summary: Dagbats, also known as Dagles, were a species of winged creatures native to Dagobah.

name: Dagger bird
summary: Dagger birds were a type of bird that was native to the planet Eriadu. They were distinct by their pointed blue-black wing pattern, along with their ability to dive into water to spear up fish for food. In 228 BBY, the human Pikka Adren had found the birds to be elegant, believing their ability to dive to be an excellent example of natural engineering.

name: Dagobah python
summary: The Dagobah python was a species of snake native to the planet Dagobah. It lived amongst the gnarltrees that were commonly found in the world's swamps, and was capable of swallowing up to fifteen times its own weight in food.
distinctions: Ability to swallow up to 15 times its weight

name: Dagobian caterpillar
summary: The caterpillars of Dagobah were carnivorous arthropods.

name: Dagopiller
summary: Dagopillers were a species of carnivorous arthropods native to Dagobah.

name: Daichyura
summary: The Daichyura were a sentient species found in the galaxy during the Galactic War. Humanoid in shape, the species possessed five-fingered hands, small mouths, and had a crest on top of their heads similar to those of Vurk. A Daichyura named Sellexith worked at Star Cluster Casino as a bouncer during a Soovada event.

name: Daimlo
summary: The Daimlos were a sentient humanoid species native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Daimla. They were short, thick, and heavily built, and their large heads were equipped with skullplates and horns. "Scorch" Zanales was a Daimlo who had distinguished himself in the sport of Podracing during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

name: Dalgo
summary: Dalgos were four-legged animals native to the planet of Onderon. Onderon rebels used dalgos as beasts of burden and battle mounts during the Battle of Onderon.

name: Daltarri
summary: The Daltarri were a plant-based species that lived on the planet Daltarri.

name: Dalyrake
summary: Dalyrakes were a large arachnoid species from Talus.

name: Danchaf
summary: The Danchaf, also called tree goblins by the Jenets, were predatory pack animals which originated on the planet Garban. Growing to about a couple of meters tall, the humanoid-build Danchaf were climbing creatures that possessed clawed feet and broad shoulders protected by scales with horn-like protrusions. Xenobiologists identified the goblins as non-sentient, although the Jenet argued that the creatures' abilities in problem-solving and reasoning manifested themselves when the offworld observers were not present. This belief was heightened more by Jenet legends that told of a time when the Danchaf ruled the world and were only driven back by the warriors of the Jenet.

name: Dancing spin
summary: Found on the Inner Rim planet Birren, the dancing spin was one of several types of bird that the human Kata Akuna watched while living there with her family. Having left Birren and lost both her parents, Akuna later joined the crew of the luxury yacht Stinger Mantis in 9 BBY, and in that year, she tried to list all the birds she remembered from Birren, including the dancing spin, while on board the yacht. The Mantis owner, Greez Dritus, overheard the list and asked what Akuna was doing, which Akuna explained, but when he asked for more information on the birds since he had never been to Birren, she put off the discussion till later.

name: Dania Francis's species
summary: Dania Francis belonged to a race of seahorse mermaids that had white hair and eyes and purple scales. The species was one of the eleven minor species in the School.

name: Danorian wolf
summary: Danorian wolves were a species of wolf in the galaxy. When Milo Graf encountered the Devaronian Cikatro Vizago, the boy likened Vizago's grin to that of a Danorian wolf.

name: Dantari
summary: The Dantari were a primitive species of Near-Humans that hailed from the planet of Dantooine, in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim. They lived a simple nomadic life, wandering about the plains of Dantooine in tribes.

name: Dantooinian creeper
summary: The Dantooinian creeper was a species of green arthropod indigenous to Dantooine.

name: Danzikan
summary: Danzikans were a swamp-dwelling, two-headed sentient species native to the swamp world of Danzik. Similar to the Troigs, both heads were independent and they used this to their advantage in card games and business deals. They were also often thought of as untrustworthy because of their tendency to cheat. Lark and Jonk were members of this species.

name: Darellian fire crab
summary: The Darellian fire crab was a species of crustacean hailing from the Darellia system in the Core Worlds. In 22 BBY, the Gungan Associate Planetary Representative Jar Jar Binks blushed like a Darellian fire crab when the Human Padmé Amidala asked him to assume her senatorial duties during her upcoming absence. Binks bowed as if to cover up his blushing.

name: Darga
summary: The Dargas were a Near-Human sentient species native to the red desert planet Zender.

name: Dark Lizard
summary: Dark Lizards, Dark Devils or Dark Tongues were large, reptilian creatures found on the planet Almas. They were a non-sentient species derived from hssiss stock, but the dark side of the Force so permeated the beasts that their scales were black, their eyes glowed red-orange, and their auras turned dark. The creatures had 10-centimeter, razor-sharp black teeth, prehensile black tongues, gooey black saliva, and jagged black spines in two rows on their backs with massive wings; only their menacing claws were white. Dark Lizards averaged three meters in length. They moved on all fours, and at full gait, they appeared to gallop. Amphibious, they moved in water as quickly. The creatures hunted in packs led by the alpha member. They quietly shadowed their prey and attacked with a loud, snarling roar. Dark Lizard packs attempted to herd their targets into a small group which the pack could then surround. They used their long tongues to ensnare prey and draw it into range of their teeth and claws. Their long tails were potent weapons, capable of delivering crushing blows. Power-hungry beings, such as crime lords, valued Dark Lizards as pets. The Sith on the planet Almas kept Dark Lizards, and after the planet's bombardment and the destruction of the Jedi's Almas Academy during Order 66, these formerly cloistered cultists roamed Almas with the creatures in search of victims. Several months after the bombardment, agents working for Jedi Master Denia, Squibs working for Squeerie the salvager, and Ugor scavengers encountered a pack of Dark Lizards near the ruins of the academy. Defeating the beasts was a bonding experience for the three factions, who walked away with a newfound respect for one another.

name: Darkfly
summary: The darkfly was a species of fly. A large number of darkflies lived inside the head of the decaying Sorcerer of Rhand Blessed Toxmalb and at Toxmalb's command, swarms of the flies would fly from his head and attempt to choke or suffocate his enemies.

name: Darkghast
summary: The Darkghast was a large creature that lived in the caverns of the planet Mustafar. It was similar to the rancor, though it had extra limbs and mandibles.

name: Darshi
summary: The Darshi, known as Thinfaces to residents of Batuu, were a wealthy sentient species that were employed by the warlike Grysk from the Unknown Regions. The Darshi themselves were believed by Thrawn to be a border society that traveled both Wild Space and the Unknown Regions. The culture of the Darshi were not deeply studied by the Chiss Ascendancy, and stories did not portray them as violent. As such, according to the stories told, the Darshi were not generally believed to show violent tendencies to outsiders. However, their bodies were evolutionarily built in such a way that suggested they were a violent people: Darshi had long claws that would do well in combat, while their thin bodies and heads would keep them well-defended. Around 174 days before a skirmish on Batuu where a group of Darshi attacked Thrawn and Darth Vader, a group of Darshi arrived on the planet Batuu and claimed they were on a pilgrimage. The group of Darshi built houses for themselves to the east of Black Spire Outpost due to claims that their journey required them to remain on Batuu for an extended period of time. After the construction of the houses, they spent three days meditating in the woods to the north, and filled Black Spire Outpost's with their ships, constantly arriving and leaving to distant locales on unknown errands. As a result, the Darshi drove away merchants, ships were discouraged from landing, and others abandoned Batuu entirely. The Darshi had also paid handsomely for the best food and resources, although some Batuu residents were not content with this, in particular business owners. Eighteen days before the skirmish, a new group of Darshi arrived with ten "coffins".

name: Dartfish
summary: The dartfish was a type of fish that lived in the sea among sea anemones. The relationship between dartfish and sea anemones was comparable to the one between tiga loreng, a creature native to the planet Bimmisaari, and the asaari trees they nested in.

name: Darvro
summary: The darvro was a beast of burden from the planet Ord Gimmel. The Darvro-class light freighter was named after the creature.

name: Dashade
summary: Dashades were a hulking reptilian sentient species. Two Dashades, Maliss and Sorath, worked as pirates. They were hired to run a mobile way station as part of Grand Admiral Balanhai Savit's scheme to capture freighters carrying vital components for Project Stardust. When the Grysks attacked the station, both Maliss and Sorath charged in to attack, and Maliss was killed. During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, a Dashade was present on the Wayward Comet refueling station, and got into a fight with the Resistance member Finn. They were known to be one of the several species that enjoyed blosphi extract as a delicacy.

name: Dashta eel
summary: The Dashta eels were a species of eels native to Ord Cestus and unknown to the outside galaxy. Immature ones were the size of a clenched Human fist when coiled, and had blind eyes. The young had no sexes; after they matured, they entered into sexual differentiation, gained a form of sentience, and grew larger. Unfertilized eggs develop into Dashta eels that remained immature and non-sentient. The head eels were the Guides. Dashta eels were from the Zantay Caves, and were worshiped by the X'Ting for thousands of years. They were named after Kilaphor Dashta. The unfertilized Dashta eels were given to the X'Ting so that they could make JK-series droids. Although these unfertilized specimens were not sentient, they still demonstrated a profound level of Force-sensitivity, making them the first known example of non-sentient Force sensitives. The sentient, adult Dashta eels also gave the X'Ting the first fungal spores used for food and medicine long ago. The mad geneticist Zeta Magnus experimented with dashta tissue during the Clone Wars.

name: Dathomir lizard
summary: Dathomir lizards had green skin that was used for leather garments. Tenel Ka wore Dathomir lizard skin leather. They would begin to fade and wear thin within one to two years.

name: Dathomirian
summary: Dathomirians, also known as Dathomirian Zabraks and culturally as Dathomiri or Dathmiri, were a subspecies of Zabrak native to the planet Peridea in a distant galaxy. On Peridea, the Dathomiri established a society known as the Witch Kingdom of the Dathmiri and learned to ride the purrgil, creatures able to survive in the vacuum of space and travel through hyperspace. Although their kingdom collapsed in the end, the Dathomiri who traveled into the known galaxy across the intergalactic void were able to reestablish themselves on a new planet, Dathomir. Tales of Peridea and its galaxy would go on to become nothing more than fairytales spoken among Jedi, and the map containing the Pathway to Peridea was long hidden in a stronghold on the planet Arcana. The Dathomiri were renowned for their use of magick, an aspect of the Force which manipulated magical ichor, which was found on Dathomir. By the time of the Clone Wars, the Nightsisters of Dathomir—a clan of magick-wielding Dathomiri witches—were led by Mother Talzin, and her son Maul was trained as the Sith apprentice of the Dark Lord Darth Sidious, while the Dathomirian Asajj Ventress became an acolyte of the apprentice who replaced Maul, Dooku, leading the Separatists. During the war, much of the species was eradicated under Talzin's leadership as she earned the ire of the Sith. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the last known survivors of the Nightsister clan were the Dathomirians Shelish, Yenna, Jerserra, Merrin, and Morgan Elsbeth—although other Dathomiri witch clans were also known to have survived. Later, during the New Republic Era, three Dathomirians known as the Great Mothers were found on Peridea—living proof of the existence of the old Dathmiri kingdom since its abandonment by the majority of its populace.

name: Daubird
summary: The Daubird was a bird native to Kashyyyk's Shadow Forest and were hunted by netcasters.

name: Dawndaddy
summary: The dawndaddy was a species that lived on the Forest Moon of Endor and made a noise at the rise of the moon's sun, Ibleam, signaling dawn. At one point, when the Ewok Teebo was held prisoner by an individual known as the Grudakk, he decided to stay awake for the whole night and escape once he heard the first dawndaddy. However, Teebo's plan was unable to come to fruition, as the exhausted Ewok fell asleep quickly.

name: Daywing
summary: Daywings were a species of insect found on the Mid Rim planet Qiilura. Notable for their extremely short lifespan, daywings hatched in the morning and died by the evening. The ruby– and sapphire–colored insects were found on the Braan River and other small standing bodies of water on Qiilura in 22 BBY.

name: Dazouri
summary: The Dazouri were a species of polymorphs that were genetic cousins of the Lahsbees in a manner analogous to the relationship between Human and Near-Human species. They had two forms, rest and rage. In their rest form, Dazouri were short, hairless humanoids with large black eyes and vestigial horns on their upper forehead. When a Dazouri was wounded, frightened, threatened, intimidated or infuriated they transformed into their rage form. In rage form they appeared as huge hulking brutes with shaggy black fur, large claws and fangs, and horns on the forehead and cheek. In rest form they were shrewd, calculating creatures that appeared helpless but in their rage form they were homicidal maniacs that attacked everything around them. The Dazouri were native to the planet Gibbela, where they farmed native crops.

name: Deadly laigrek
summary: The deadly laigrek was a subspecies of laigrek that was native to the grassy world of Dantooine. They were similar in appearance to their insect brethren, however they possessed tougher armor that could endure high temperatures, as well as the ability to breathe short streams of fire. Deadly laigreks were found in the subterranean areas of the hilly regions of the planet, however by 3951 BBY, a number of them had migrated to the sublevel of the bombed-out Jedi Enclave.

name: Deaon
summary: Deaons were a sentient species native to the astronomical object of Ord Gimmel. Members of the species possessed long fingers and manufactured a variety of makes and models of the short, squat variable holdout blasters, which were shaped to fit their hands.

name: Deathspine varactyl
summary: Deathspine varactyls were a type of varactyl that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. They could be found in the jungles near the city of Kachirho, where the planet wasn't completely covered with kilometer-high wroshyr trees. During the last decades of the Galactic Republic, a Deathspine varactyl was held within the space station prison Cog Hive Seven and in 33 BBY, the creature was released from it by the Zabrak Darth Maul—a Sith Lord who had infiltrated the prison as an inmate. Maul proceeded to ride the creature across the prison concourse and then killed the beast, and afterward he gave the varactyl's skull to the Chadra-Fan prisoner Coyle in exchange for Coyle's services as a counterfeiter.

name: Decay mite
summary: The decay mites were insects native to Talus, found also on Corellia.

name: Deer
summary: Deer were four-legged animals found in the oro woods of Alderaan. They were small creatures, colored bright red with golden stripes. They fed on shoots in the undergrowth of the ancient forests. The Orowood botanical garden at Coruscant also had an oro wood forest with deer. In 8 ABY, New Republic diplomat Leia Organa and Prince Isolder toured the garden while the deer were grazing. The Gallaze, a quadrupedal herbivore native to the planet Trinta, were noted to be like deer. The griffs of Abonshee were noted to be deer-like.

name: Deer-fly
summary: Deer-flies were a type of fly with orange eyes that could be found in the mountains on the planet Naalol. In 4 ABY, deer-flies buzzed around a mountain town on Naalol where valdeer shepherds had lived until it was ruined during fighting in the Galactic Civil War. When New Republic Chancellor Mon Mothma visited the town, she informed her advisor Hostis Ij that she planned to cut the Republic's military presence by ninety percent once the war was over, causing his mouth to fall open in shock as though he was trying to catch a meal of deer-flies.

name: Deesh Crozli's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Deesh Crozli was a member of this species.

name: Defancio Storsilt's species
summary: There existed a sentient species of tall bipeds characterized by a horse-like elongated snout. Notable members of that species included Defancio Storsilt and Askroh.

name: Defel
summary: Defels were a sentient species whose members had the ability to become almost invisible by bending light around themselves. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, a Defel named Arleil Schous was a patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina when Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived in search of transport to Alderaan. Glahst Ombra was a Defel mercenary who worked with Chelli Aphra until she was killed and skinned by Magna Tolvan.

name: Del Andue
summary: The Del Andue were a strange-looking sentient species. In 3 ABY, the Jedi Luke Skywalker spent some time living in a hovel on the planet Tatooine with two Del Andues while he made preparations to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt.

name: Dellalt canoid
summary: Dellalt canoids were dog-like wild animals that lived on Dellalt. They had a prehensile tail and needle-like teeth.

name: Delphanian
summary: The Delphanians were a sentient species noted for their scaly, claw-like hands and bellows-shaped noses. They came from the Delphania system, where they noted various tribal identities by piercing their protuberant lips. Delphanians sometimes added extra piercings after defeating a rival; in combat, their hands became dangerous slashing weapons. Delphanians were among the prisoners kept aboard the Imperial prison barge Purge in 1 BBY. Some of these imprisoned Delphanians formed the Delphanian Face Gang, headed at one point by the gang member Aur Myss.

name: Delphidian
summary: Delphidians were a group of related humanoid sentient species from the Delphidian Cluster, a stellar nursery on the fringes of Wild Space in the Mid Rim. The Delphidian all had finely striated, dark gray, or midnight-black skin with a leathery texture and black eyes but varied in their other physical characteristics. As such some geneticists thought that they shared a long-lost common ancestry, while others believed they were bioengineered as slaves by some vanished master, though the Delphidians themselves were silent on the subject. The species were part of a brawling confederation founded centuries before the Galactic Republic discovered their stars. The individual Delphidian species spoke a vast number of dialects and relied on a common tongue that evolved for trade within the Delphidian Cluster. During the High Republic Era, Jorinda Boffrey was a Delphidian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. Sidon Ithano was a Delphidian pirate captain who hid his heritage by wearing a bright red Kaleesh helmet. Ithano and another Delphidian, Durteel Haza, were both present in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata shortly before it was attacked by the First Order around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

name: Delrakkin
summary: The Delrakkin were a species of sentient predatory reptiles from the Delrakkin system. They were covered in scales which could be dun in color, and had claws. Senator Ta'am Khlaides, a Delrakkin woman, served in the the Imperial Senate in the early days of the Galactic Empire. They originated from the Delrakkin system.

name: Deltron
summary: The Deltrons were a sentient species from the planet of the same name. They had a torso, lungs, a heart, a lipped mouth, and iron-based blood. At least one individual, Brisha Shard, had golden skin and eyes the color of bronzium.

name: Deluvian fatworm
summary: The Deluvian fatworm was a type of worm that hailed from the Deluvia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Klina sector that was situated close to Hutt Space. It led a parasitic lifestyle, attaching itself to the back of members of the sentient Hutt species. In 3956 BBY, Jedi Padawan Revan visited the Mid Rim planet Kashyyyk. There, he met the merchant Eli Gand and his indentured servant Matton Dasol. When Gand attempted to interest Revan in his wares, Dasol warned the latter that the interest rates of the former's loans would "drain" him in a manner comparable to a Deluvian fatworm parasiting on the back of a Hutt. In response, Gand, who took offense at the comparison, claimed that the Hutts were, in fact, "ALL backside."

name: Demi-slug
summary: Demi-slugs, once known as sand slugs, were a type of carnivorous slug that lived on the planet Metagos. Their biology was altered by the Great Storm, a radiation storm that devastated much of the world's surface and caused the slugs' skin to become brittle and glass-like. The Jedi Master Mace Windu encountered a group of demi-slugs during a mission to Metagos in 32 BBY.

name: Demirian
summary: The Demirians were a species that inhabited the iron planet Demir in the Unknown Regions. When Captain Phasma of the First Order led an attack on Demir, the Demirians defended their world.

name: Demon squid
summary: A demon squid was a type of squid with poisonous barbs, acid-green skin, and long tentacles. It would expand when agitated but could deflate once calmed down. In 41 BBY, a baby demon squid was planted into Obi-Wan Kenobi's soup by Bolla Ropal. Its tentacles caused burn-like welts on Kenobi's skin before Prie stroked its spines, calming it down.

name: Demonsquid
summary: The demonsquid was an eight-armed mollusk native to the planet Aquaris, with large jaws beneath its clump of arms. It was a particularly vicious aquatic predator that attacked anything that came near its den. Its tentacles were powerful enough to slowly crush anyone caught in its grasp as well as easily shatter an aquaskimmer. However, its weak point was its brainsac on the back of its head, with a direct hit from the onboard weaponry from an aquaskimmer being sufficient enough to kill it. In addition, impaling one of its tentacles with either stun blasts or a sufficiently jagged object was enough to force it to release its prey, although the latter ran the risk of having it pursue those who impaled it with rage. The treacherous Aquaris Freeholders second-in-command Kraaken had a demonsquid play a role in trying to dispose of a stun-shot Luke Skywalker. Although he claimed the idea was to have Silver Fyre gain the trust of the Rebels to allow them to join the Rebels, and also made it seem as though he'd accompany Luke, in reality it was to act as a distraction while he tried to steal the data stored on R2-D2 (which Han used as bait to draw him out). After Fyre, to prove she had indeed changed, proceeded to blast the demonsquid before it could successfully devour the aquaskimmer, although it nonetheless did enough damage to shatter it, causing Han to escape and rescue Luke. After successfully rescuing Luke, however, the demonsquid proceeded to grab Han and attempted to crush him between its tentacles, although Chewbacca, Han's first mate of the Millennium Falcon, proceeded to save them both by using a jagged portion of the wreckage to impale the squid's tentacle, forcing it to release them, although it proceeded to chase them in fury. Since it was no longer focused on Silver Fyre's aquaskimmer, she then directed a clean shot on the brainsac of the demonsquid, instantly killing it and causing it to sink to the abyss. Aside from that particular one, Silver Fyre when explaining her plan to "save" Luke to gain his trust implied that demonsquids were one of several prevalent threats to the Aquaris Freeholders' base.

name: Deripor
summary: Deripors were docile mounts native to Ohratuu. Former Rebel general Reesen Jivrak used them as mounts in hit-and-run attacks, after his Science Research Droid, Geth, injected them with toxins that strengthened and enraged them.

name: Derkolo
summary: The derkolo were quick and aggressive pack hunters that dwelled on the planet Sileron, in the Veron Minor system of the Mid Rim. They were one of the more common predators on Sileron. They were aggressive and individual creatures seemed to have no fear of death. They consumed large quantities of food in preparation for the long winter. In the colder seasons, they hibernated in large burrows; some related species migrated to other other continents on the warmer side of the world.

name: Deschene
summary: The deschene was a clawed creature native to the Zoess, a large forest on the planet of Radhii.

name: Desert mangler
summary: Desert manglers were a creature that could be found in the deserts of the Inner Rim planet Sergia. The stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire used the creatures as mounts for their patrols. While on a mission to Sergia, Luke Skywalker and Warba Calip were pursued in a landspeeder by a desert mangler-mounted stormtrooper patrol.

name: Despayran crab spider
summary: Despayran crab spiders were creatures that hunted gutter-snails. Kwenn Space Station looked like a Despayran crab spider.

name: Dethro Glok's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Dethro Glok was a member of this species.

name: Devaronian
summary: Devaronians were a sentient species from the planet Devaron. They exhibited great sexual dimorphism, with the males typically being bald and sporting horns, and the mostly hornless females displaying a full head of hair. Cikatro Vizago, a crime lord on Lothal and the leader of the Broken Horn Syndicate, was a male Devaronian.

name: Devaronian fur-spider
summary: The Devaronian Fur-Spider was a kind of venomous arachnid native to Devaron. They were known to hunt only prey they considered a challenge. These spiders wove red webs, and were also known to be found in the Undercity of Coruscant.

name: Devaronian precursor species
summary: A species of horned, primitive mountain-dwelling primates had evolved from a species of horned reptiles on the Colonies planet of Devaron. Members of the species used their horns as a defensive weapon against birds of prey. The species eventually evolved into the sentient Devaronian species.

name: Devil beast
summary: Devil beasts were large flying creatures that lived on Endor. The purple and blue reptavian creatures had four limbs and a tail; their large wings connected from their shoulders to their hips and covered their arms all the way to the wrist. King Marlox, leader of the Quorks, had a devil beast whom he once threatened young Ewoks with.

name: Devil serpent
summary: Devil serpents were gigantic eels indigenous to the forest moon of Endor. They could shoot laser beams from their antennae. Orcon used one such creature as a mount.

name: Devilsquid
summary: Devilsquid were a species of cephalopod that dwelt within the deepest regions of the oceans of the planet Dac, such as Devil's Crevasse. They were far larger than an adult Human and known for being aggressive predators. They were highly similar in both name and appearance to demonsquid of Aquaris. In 137 ABY, Master Treis Sinde of the Imperial Knights used the Force to command a large number of Devilsquid to attack a Sea Leviathan, a creature created by the Givin scientist Vul Isen of the One Sith to bring about the extermination of the Mon Calamari. The squid overpowered the monster, and pulled the beast into their lair where they subsequently devoured it.

name: Devious Creep
summary: The Devious Creep was a domesticated bipedal creature that could serve as a companion around 3627 BBY.
skinColor: SWTOR Cartel Market Newest Additions: Week of October 22}}

name: Devlikk
summary: Devlikk was a sentient species. Wan Sandage, a podracer from Ord Radama, who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic race held on the planet Tatooine during 32 BBY was a Devlikk. During the early Imperial Era, a Devlikk was present on Janix in The Mark and Claim casino, owned by Rheena Sul, where the patron tipped off the Galactic Empire of a group of fugitives, Brander Lawson, his son Rylee Lawson, and two Jedi Devon Izara, and her Jedi Master Eeko-Dio Daki.

name: Devourer
summary: Devourers were carnivores twisted by the dark side of the Force and were indigenous to Dxun. Exar Kun was attacked by a devourer while trying to enter the tomb of Freedon Nadd, but killed the beast. Two devourers later ate Mandalore the Indomitable after he crashed on Dxun, leaving only his mask, which was found by Mandalore the Ultimate.

name: Dewback
summary: Dewbacks were thick-skinned reptiles native to the desert planet of Tatooine, where they were used as beasts of burden, as well as mounts for specialized sandtroopers known as Dewback troopers.

name: Deymasollian
summary: The Deymasollians were a sentient species native to the Colonies' Deymasoll system. They had two arms with delicate fingers and two legs—both limb pairs being relatively short—and a large mouth and prominent lower jaw. The Deymasollians had tan skin, dark eyes, and a coat of white fur. All Deymasollians had keen memory, and members of the species' society identified as belonging to at least one—female—gender. Faddaff Davenspon was a Deymasollian who was born around 265 BBY. By 35 ABY, she had led a long, well-traveled life and had become an outlaw tech-for-hire specializing in starship systems, with her fingers being well-scaled for precision technology work. Davenspon had spent many winters on the Mid Rim Territories planet Kijimi, which resulted in her fur having grown thicker, and at one point in 35 ABY, the Deymasollian was present at Kijimi City's Spice Runners' Den.

name: Dhanduese
summary: The Dhanduese were a flightless avian sentient species that inhabited Dhandu 3, a moon of the planet Dhandu. The low gravity of the moon did not affect them, as their clawed feet allowed them to grip onto the ground.

name: Dhani
summary: The Dhanis, also known as Aldhanis, were a cultural group of humans who called the planet of Aldhani home. Centuries prior to Imperial takeover, the hills of the planet were covered by hundreds of settlements that housed at least 40,000 Dhanis across the highlands. However, after about a decade of the Empire's presence, the Dhanis were cleared out and relocated to an Enterprise Zone in the Lowlands in the southern region of the planet. The Enterprise Zone was comprised of factories and new Imperial housing. By then, the only people who remained living in the hills were a few shepherds, nature lovers, mystics, and dead-enders. Once every three years, the Dhanis gathered for a celestial event called the Eye of Aldhani.

name: Dharus' species
summary: A humanoid species was little-known throughout the galaxy. Members of the species lacked visible ears and had a flat nose and a ridge on the brow. At least some of them had red eyes and orange-brown skin. They also had hair that could be brown. Dharus, a member of the species, was tall for a humanoid and used technology designed for Humans.

name: Dhislug
summary: Dhislugs were predatory gastropods native to Algara II that relied on externally-excreted acid to digest prey, as they lacked teeth. They had two antennae and grew over three meters long.

name: Diamal
summary: The Diamala (singular Diamal) were a species from the planet Diamal, in the Core Worlds, who, along with their rivals the Ishori, became prominent during the crises over the Caamas Document and the apparent return of Grand Admiral Thrawn. Diamala were recognizable by their leathery skin, white manes, and fan-shaped ears, which they could move independently to gesture with. The Diamala temperament was generally calm and unemotional, with a strong sense of personal pride. They had extensive financial and business holdings, which they attributed to hard work rather than luck. In 19 ABY, the Diamala objected when the Ishori refused to allow armed Diamalan vessels to escort Diamalan freighters into Ishori ports. The Iphigini offered to help resolve this dispute. Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Luke Skywalker, who acted as mediators during initial negotiations, were unable to help the two species reach an agreement. The rift between the two species only worsened when they took opposite sides on the dispute over the Caamas Document. While the Ishori were among the loudest voices demanding that the Bothans pay ruinious reparations for complicity in the destruction of Caamas, the Diamala sent Nebula- and Endurance-class ships to defend Bothawui. The Diamalan fleet also included twelve Marauder-class corvettes, a group of which were involved in operations against the Imperial Remnant during the crisis (though they were ostensibly purchased by their Commerce Ministry as freighter escorts). Their representative to the New Republic Senate in 19 ABY, Porolo Miatamia, was accused by politicians on the other side of being as manipulative as the Bothans themselves.

name: Dianoga
summary: Dianoga were large omnivorous cephalopods that hailed from the planet Vodran in the Si'Klaata Cluster, located in Hutt Space region of the galaxy. Although primitive, they were actually sentient, and some dianoga were sensitive to the Force.
distinctions: Seven suckered tentacles, several hearts, blue blood, ability to change color, ability to regenerate limbs

name: Diathim
summary: The Diathim, also known as the Angels as a result of spacers mistaking them for such beings, were a mysterious species of winged sentients who inhabited the moons of the planet Iego, specifically living on the largest moon, Millius Prime. Tall and beautiful, the beings called Angels had blonde hair, blue eyes, shining white skin and had a yellow aura. The Diathim stood at 2.35 meters, or 7 feet, 9 inches tall, and were capable of flight, due to their six wings. A species who were cautious around others, legends were developed around the Diathim, with stories of their reputed beauty being spread from the Outer Rim Territories to the Core Worlds by deep space spacers. They were regarded as potentially being the most beautiful beings in the known universe. When Anakin Skywalker first met his future wife Padmé Amidala, he compared her appearance to that of an Angel. By 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems had conquered Millius Prime, forcing the peaceful Diathim from their homes. Skywalker and Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi would later meet an Angel in the midst of their mission to Iego, during which they liberated Iego and its moons by destroying the LaserWeb Defense Station left by the Separatists.

name: Didac
summary: The didac was a species native to the planet Wielu.

name: Didelum rodent
summary: Didelum rodents were a type of rodent with prehensile tails that played dead when approached by predators. In 228 BBY, after the young Hutt Churo crashed on the planet Palagosal, he encountered the crew of the Galactic Republic yacht Redemption, who he had accidentally shot down while attempting to help them evade members of the Nihil pirates. Upon realizing that the crew included Jedi, who the Hutts had previously come into conflict with, Churo thought about didelum rodents and plopped on the ground to play dead like one. The Jedi youngling Tep Tep found him and asked if he was playing dead. Churo began to respond that he was doing so like a didelum rodent, but Tep Tep finished his explanation by exclaiming the rodent's name.

name: Didynon
summary: The Didynons were a sentient species in the galaxy. They had eyes that could retract into the calloused dermal plates on its head. Engi Golba was a Didynon from Didyma V who escaped his world's annexation by the First Order to join the Resistance.

name: Diehard
summary: Diehards were burrowing, predatory insects native to Atraken.

name: Dilonexican
summary: The Dilonexicans were the inhabitants of Dilonexa XXIII, an agriworld, and the only habitable planet in the Dilonexa system. As Dilonexa XXIII was deficient in heavy metals, the populace developed an allergic reaction to foods that contained too many trace metals in them.
diet: Allergic to foods with significant amounts of metal

name: Dimean
summary: The Dimeans were a tall sentient species from the Dimea system, known for their nasty disposition. Many years before the Mandalorian Wars, they were ruled by an overlord named Kraat. After capturing the Jedi Andor Vex, Kraat was killed when he threw the man down an intake shaft, inadvertently causing his warship to explode. The loss of the leader had a significant effect on the Dimeans and affected the political course of that sector for many years.

name: Dimok
summary: The Dimoks, colloquially known as the Dims, were a cultural group of the Sepan species native to Dimok, one of the two primary worlds of the Sepan system. The Dimoks were involved with the people of Ripoblus in the Sepan Civil War, a conflict which lasted intermittently for centuries.

name: Dingory
summary: The dingory was a hairless canine predator native to Lan Barell. They were raised on ranches and their meat was eaten by Humans and Qieg. Dingories themselves would eat Qieg if they had the chance.
distinctions: Can scent Qieg from up to a kilometer away, and will frenzy at the smell of them

name: Dinko
summary: A dinko was a small reptilian scavenger that was extremely vicious and tenacious. It was also notorious for emitting an unbearable stench, and for a mildly toxic bite which could paralyze a Human-sized creature with nausea. Dinkos were native to the planet Proxima Dibal I. They had thin bodies about ten centimeters long, with powerful rear legs, two front legs with a single claw, and a pair of smaller single-clawed grasping extremities on their chests. Their scent was not used for defense, but to establish mating dominance. Dinko vision worked by sensing movement—accordingly, they would attack anything that moved. Darth Sidious included dinkos in a particularly traumatizing training session with Darth Maul. When the two of them were walking in a field, the young Maul saw a Dinko and flinched in fear before the venomous creature leaped upon his foot and bit it. In rage, Maul crushed the Dinko beneath his foot but Sidious had already witnessed his apprentice flinch in fear, causing the Dinko to bite him. As a penance, Sidious locked Maul in his bedroom, having immersed it full of the clawing, biting creatures, thereby training Maul never to flinch or show fear again. Han Solo once bought a dinko, which he used to distract Ploovo Two-For-One on Etti IV. Han Solo told of this event in a personal log entry, Guri, the second-in-command of Black Sun, once used a dinko to distract the bounty hunter Boushh, enabling her to kill him and take his prisoner. Dinkos were not recommended for use as pets, though some exotic pet stores sold them anyway. Dinkos were also pitted against each other in the sport of dinko fighting. Nuri the Clawdite first morphed into an Arrak snake, and then a dinko to stun Boba with its noxious spray. Nuri also briefly attacked Boba with the dinko's claws, before scuttling away as a Fefze beetle.

name: Diollan
summary: Diollans were a species of sentient, featherless avians, that originated on the planet Dioll, in the Juvex sector. They were short and stocky, with broad beaks, leathery, mottled brown skin, and small intense eyes. Their sense of smell was sensitive enough to find Rodian pheromones repulsive. They were also masters of unarmed combat. Some Diollans served the local aristocratic Juvex House, while others opted to live elsewhere in the galaxy. The Nar Shaddaa-based bounty hunter Spurch "Warhog" Goa was a Diollan.They found the smell of Rodians disgusting.
distinctions: Stocky build, broad beaks, small eyes

name: Diptera maggot
summary: Diptera maggots were used by Yuuzhan Vong shapers to eat away decaying flesh following Escalation ceremonies.

name: Dirconite
summary: Dirconites were a sentient species of rotund humanoids with light skin and small, sharpened teeth that had the ability to produce hypersonic shrieks capable of stunning other humanoids. During the early days of the Galactic Empire, a male Dirconite crime lord known as Kleb Zellock controlled Tyne's Horky's criminal underworld.
distinctions: Capable of producing hypersonic shrieks, rotund, sharpened teeth

name: Dire-cat
summary: Dire-cats were carnivorous feline creatures that lived on the planet Corellia. They had spines coming out of their backs and shoulder blades, and would attack animals that had the scent of blood. Their keen sense of smell was also able to pick up traces of contaminants, such as synthetic poison, and as such avoid tainted meat. During 42 BBY, a pack of dire-cats attacked, killed, and ate the Mandalorian warrior Tor Vizsla after his stomach had been cut open with a switch-blade, heavily exposing the scent of his blood to the nearby cats. Dire-cats could also be found on the planet of Talus, existing as a subspecies known as the ferine razorfang.

name: Diredeer
summary: Diredeer were a type of deer edible by Quarren. In 382 BBY, when Quarren Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo was on the planet E'ronoh to discuss their conflict with their neighboring world of Eiram, he felt that he was being too coddled—he was served candied cactus flower—and would have preferred a burnt, crispy joint of diredeer, oily enough to stain clothing.

name: Diver
summary: The diver was a type of bird that could be found on Birren, a planet located in the Inner Rim Territories. While living on Birren with her family, the human Kata Akuna would go bird-watching and saw divers and other types of bird. She eventually left the planet and, after losing both her parents, she joined the crew of the Stinger Mantis, a luxury yacht owned by the pilot Greez Dritus, in 9 BBY. In that year, Akuna listed the diver as part of an effort to remember all the birds from Birren while she was on the yacht. Dritus asked what she was doing after hearing the list and, after Akuna explained, the pilot asked for more information on the birds since he had never been to Birren. Akuna, however, put off the discussion till later.

name: Divto
summary: Divtos were dangerous three-headed serpents native to the forest moon of Endor.

name: Divvik
summary: Divviks were small, gray, and dangerous creatures with multiple eyes and sharp claws that were indigenous to a world in the Outer Rim Territories. Hutts considered their egg-like pupae a delicacy, but once hatched, they become a venomous, ravenous nightmare. Impervious to blaster shots and able to paralyze most species with their venom, the divviks preferred to dine on live prey. It was said that their acidic saliva could melt through plasteel, and crushing one would release toxic gases. A Jedi lightsaber could seal the gaps. Divviks planted their larvae in the brains of living beings. Six months before the Invasion of Naboo, approximately two thousand divvik pupae were on a freighter detained above Tatooine, to be delivered to Jabba the Hutt. However, the grubs were too developed, and they all hatched. The crew was killed, and the only survivors were Sylvn, the daughter of Jedi Knight Ki-Adi-Mundi; her boyfriend, Maj-Odo-Nomor; her friend, Twin; and Chevin smuggler Ephant Mon, hiding in an escape pod. Ki came in his starship and attempted to rescue them. Mon threatened to destroy them by firing the pods thrusters, causing it to explode against the closed external hatch. Maj was shot, and Ki manually opened the hatch, saving them.

name: Dizonite
summary: The Dizonites were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim Territories moon Dizon Fray. At some point during the Imperial Era prior to 5 BBY, all of the Dizonites present on their homeworld were massacred by Imperial forces, and the genocide was broadcast and recorded as proof of mission. The choral dying screams of the Dizonites caused severe emotional distress to those who listened to them, leading to the audio's use as a torture method by the Imperial interrogator Doctor Gorst. Gorst curated the recordings to use what he believed were the screams of Dizonite younglings to cause as much distress as possible. The audio recordings were used by Gorst to torture the human female Bix Caleen in 5 BBY, which emotionally crippled Caleen and allowed Imperial Security Bureau lieutenant Dedra Meero to successfully interrogate her for information regarding her friend, Cassian Andor. Caleen later forced Gorst to listen to the same recording before she and Andor killed him.

name: Dlarnic grazer
summary: Dlarnic grazers were herbivores common to the Triumvirate worlds: Kalok, Jiroch-Saloch and Jiroch-Reslia. They were hunted by the Tunroth and formed part of their staple diet.

name: Doashim
summary: The Doashim of Ryloth were fierce and aggressive creatures found in the Dark Ridges of the subterranean world. Many Humans from across the galaxy thought they were reminiscent of demons from their own culture of origin.

name: Dobatan
summary: The Dobatan were a sentient species found within the galaxy. This humanoid species was distinguished by their short stature, with large heads, ribbed chins, downturned mouths, wideset eyes, and large, pointed ears. By around 10 BBY, one Dobatan from Ylesia, Weebahn, had been a podracer working for Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi, though had since gone missing.

name: Dochinie
summary: Dochinie were avian creatures indigenous to the moon Qina. At commands from a wind pipe by the sentient natives, dochinie would herd pechs and rujos.

name: D'oemir bear
summary: The d'oemir bears were a species of bear that were native to the Jhunia snow plains of the world of Neftali. They topped the food chain prior to the planet's colonization. Both their meat and fur caused them to be hunted to near-extinction, resulting in their hunting being regulated by license.

name: Dog
summary: Dogs, also known as hounds, were a classification of non-sentient, omnivorous quadrupedal or sometimes hexapedal species of canines in the galaxy. One type was the akk dog, which was found on Anoat. The Begamor two-headed dog was found on the planet Begamor. The term "dog" could also be used as a word for contempt. While C-3PO's head was temporarily attached to a B1-series battle droid's body during the First Battle of Geonosis, he was heard shouting, "Die, Jedi dogs!" Additionally, the phrase "wet dog" was used by Luke Skywalker to describe an odor he smelled while on Kupoh.

name: Dokma
summary: Dokma were small, timid gastropods native to Atollon. Often preyed upon by the spider-like krykna, they had protective shells and two eyestalks. Garazeb Orrelios nicknamed them "bogans." According to Volt Vescuso, the amount of milk a dokma drank was not to be underestimated. The dokma are considered timid animals. They are born underwater and lose their first shell after weeks of drinking the mineral-rich underground water until they finally crawl to the surface. Once they have found a suitable spot, they shed their shell and stick to a coral like a barnacle, from which they absorb food and eventually allow a new shell to grow. For further reproduction, dokma look for a suitable partner at another coral formation and bring their offspring into the underground waters, always having to watch out for the krykna.

name: Dokora
summary: The Dokora were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Cantu Fallum was a member of this species.

name: Dolandu
summary: The Dolandu were a white-furred humanoid species native to the moon Skalokor. They worked as trappers and mountaineers, forming small settlements for trading purposes.
