The Dolandu respected members of the Jedi Order, and Jedi Master Niquon and his Padawan, Nason Laric, at one time lived near the Dolandu settlement of Stomorr. The residents of Stomorr were attacked by forces under the control of off-world Dark Jedi, who sought to kill the Jedi Master; however, Niquon was able to defeat the attackers with the aid of Laric.

name: Doneer
summary: The Doneers were a sentient insectoid species from the planet Doneer'so, located in the Fakir sector. Their renown for building excellent starships gave them a reputation across the sector. The Galactic Empire selected Doneer'so as its sector capital, choosing clan-city Sotak'vik as its headquarters. While that pleased the Sotak city-clan, it made the other clans jealous. Some of those rivals sympathized instead with the Rebel Alliance in the Galactic Civil War.

name: Doo
summary: Doo were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by the large Colo claw fish and Opee sea killers that lived there. Doo themselves ate tiny yobshrimp.

name: Doog
summary: The Doogs were creatures from the planet of Morda and shared the planet with the Morlings. The Morlings used their leather to produce clothes.

name: Dor Namethian
summary: Dor Namethians were a sentient species from the Dor Nameth system. Lexo Sooger, who worked as a masseur was a member of this species.

name: Dorande
summary: Dorande were a species of pointed-eared humanoids indigenous to the planet of Dorande. At the start of the Dark Times, they attempted to seize the world of R-Duba, conspiring with the planet's royal advisors to murder Prince Jagoda. While the Dorandes intended to raid Jagoda's palace, their plans were foiled by C-3PO and Kirk Windjammer.

name: Doran'enok
summary: Doran'enoks were carnivorous, winged creatures that hunted in packs. They were captured by the Sith Empire to become Shock Troopers. Doran'enoks were hunted for food, and almost went extinct during the Great Sith War, and seemingly vanished from Arda I.

name: Dornean
summary: The Dorneans were a species native to the planet Dornea. The Dorneans designed the Braha'tok-class gunship, a gunship class manufactured by the Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate to protect their homeworld from the Galactic Empire. The starship became the representative ship of the Dornean race. A number of these gunships came to aid the Rebel Alliance, notably after Dornea joined the faction following the Battle of Yavin.

name: Doshan blood worm
summary: The Doshan blood worm was a Red-colored species of worm that was considered by the Trandoshans to be a delicacy. During the Clone Wars, the Padawan of the Jedi Master Bant Eerin met with the Trandoshan War Chief Raikhssa on the planet Trandosha to negotiate permission for the Galactic Republic to attack a Separatist base on the Trandoshan-controlled moon Akoshissss. During their meeting, Raikhssa offered the Padawan a bowl of Doshan blood worms to eat.

name: Doshian jellyfish
summary: The Doshian jellyfish was a type of jellyfish from the planet Trandosha. The claws of the sentient Trandoshan species could cut and flay wroshyr wood as easily as a they could a Doshian jellyfish.

name: Dostan
summary: Dostans were a bipedal tentacled species. Some members of this species could be found dwelling on Kundu Minor.

name: Dowaaka
summary: The Dowaaka were a sentient reptilian species with lizard-like heads and four breasts. A Dowaaka served as the host of the Clear River News Network around 200 BBY.

name: Dowutin
summary: The Dowutin were a species of large humanoids that were native to the frigid planet Dowut, which was located in the Core Worlds. Dowutins were known for their great size and strength, facial horns, and long lifespans.

name: Dowutin precursor species
summary: The sentient Dowutin species evolved from a species of non-sentient, omnivorous herd animals native to Dowut, a Core Worlds planet. The animals were migratory and moved across their homeworld's frozen plains in search of the substantial amounts of sustenance needed to sustain their large bodies. This included tubers, insect nests and dens of hibernating feeks, all of which they used their spiked fingers and chin tusks to dig for. These digging elements were retained in the morphology of the Dowutin during their evolution. Following the evolution of the Dowutin, large herd animals not dissimilar to the precursor species still roamed the frozen plains of Dowut.

name: Draag
summary: Draags were a species of stocky, reptilian humanoids from the planet Ninzam VI. Due to their cold-blooded nature, they often wore temperature-regulating suits while away from their homeworld. The species's aggression, intelligence, and pushiness made them natural supervisors, and some Draags also used their adeptness with blasters to work as security forces. In 32 BBY, several Draags worked for Haugg Nerf Industries in the Industrial District of the planet Coruscant. Among them were two Draag fugitives, Regg Kuuga and Slaag Lado. Both Draags were captured by the bounty hunter Jango Fett as he made his way through the plant to capture its boss, Groff Haugg.

name: Draagax
summary: The Draagax, sometimes called "drag" for short, was a large omnivorous rodent-like creature that inhabited the planet of Relkass. Standing two meters tall with long ears and venom filled teeth, the Draagax was also a dangerous predator when it ate the narcotic Relkass sentinel plant. Using its sight, which was capable of normal and infrared, the frenzied animal would hunt down anything warm-blooded foregoing its normal diet of razor grass and small rodents. The Draagax was a pack hunter, and frequented the equatorial regions of Relkass. Due to the danger posed by a Draagax under the influence of the sentinel plant narcotic, Relkass officials placed a reward for hunters to cull Draagax herds during the dry seasons, though few were able to take up the offer due to the hazards associated with Draagax hunting.

name: Drabatan
summary: Drabatans, also known as Drabatas were a sentient amphibious species native to the planet Pipada. Their homeworld was harvested for materials by the Galactic Empire, displacing much of the native population, including the Drabatans. Pao, a commando for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, was a Drabatan. During the Cold War, one Drabatan served as a mechanic on staff at the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar. The Drabatans primarily spoke a language called Drabatese. However, as this language was unusually loud, the Drabatans also used a second form of speech that was based off of passing air through a vocal pouch.

name: Drach'nam
summary: The Drach'nam were a sentient reptilian alien race from La'drach that was known more for size and strength than intelligence. They had three fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot. Drach'nam had pale, pinkish blood. A slave consortium on the planet Torpris was run by a Drach'nam crime lord, Chay Praysh. Praysh also stationed many Drach'nam within his facility.
distinctions: Tire-like mark running down center of face

name: Drackmarian
summary: Drackmarians were a methane-breathing reptilian species that hailed from Drackmar. They were recognized as ferocious warriors.

name: Dractuvian
summary: Dractuvians were a species of sentient, red-skinned humanoids from the planet Dractu. They built paved streets and resided in homes made of stone. The Besalisk cook Dexter Jettster traveled to Dractu in search of a Dractuvian cave slug, intending to prepare the dish for Obi-Wan Kenobi at Dex's Diner. In a Dractuvian village, Dexter spoke with a local elder bearing a long orange beard. A Dractuvian warrior volunteered to assist him and was trusted by the other to do so. The warrior guided Dexter to a cave where the slug could be found. Dexter was attacked by the creature but was ultimately rescued by the warrior.

name: Dractuvian caveworm
summary: Dractuvian caveworms were six-legged tubular creatures with sharp teeth. They lived in the caves of the planet Dractu. One of them attached itself to Dexter Jettster, who could not remove it without the assistance of a native Dractuvian.

name: DradanIllusions of Dradan, as produced by the Dark Jedi Halagad Ventor
summary: The Dradan were a species of peaceful sentients native to a planet in the Drada system of the Outer Rim Territories. After the Galactic Empire was formed in 19 BBY and began to hunt and kill the Jedi Knights, the Dradan offered their homeworld as a refuge to Jedi fugitives. The Empire discovered the Dradan's treachery by 1 BBY and retaliated with genocide of the species and despoliation of their homeworld. When the fallen Jedi Halagad Ventor fled torture at the hands of the Empire and took up a hermit's existence on the planet Trinta, he tapped into the world's natural dark side Force nexus to create illusions known as dreambeasts to chase away anyone who visited the swampy planet. Among the apparitions he used for those purposes were Dradan, whom Ventor presented as thin humanoids with red eyes and simple technology. When a group of Rebel Alliance operatives landed on Trinta, Ventor sent his spectral Dradan to lure them into eating poisonous food. However, Ventor's control over the illusions was incomplete, and the Rebels rejected the false Dradan's offering. Upon his failure, Ventor dissipated the phantasms.
homeworld: A world in the Drada system

name: Draedan
summary: Draedans were a species of sentient humanoids native to the aquatic planet of Sesid. They had green skin, red eyes, and sharp teeth, and were known for having large families. During Operation Yellow Moon, Leia Organa and her Rebel team made contact with the Draedan Aurelant, captain of the Daggadol—a subaquatic vessel crewed by Draedan pirates who opposed the Galactic Empire. Aurelant and his crew aided the Rebels in avoiding Imperial capture on Sesid, escaping off-world.

name: Draethos
summary: The Draethos were a sentient humanoid species. A Nihil Storm was a member of the species. They possessed massive teeth and had blue-colored skin, black eyes, and four-fingered hands. By the Imperial Era, a Draethos skeleton still remained sprawled at the feet of his great chair in his office in the Chamber of Antiquities in the Great Jedi Library on Ossus, while two stone guardians stood as silent sentinels to protect the chamber from intruders.

name: Dragon beast
summary: Dragon beasts, also known as Muunilinst lizards, were six-legged, four-eyed scavenging lizards dwelling in the impoverished sections of the cities of Muunilinst. They were small, nearly as large as a Human foot, red-orange in color, and feeding on the piles of garbage piled on every corner of the cities, like Pilaan. During the Battle of Muunilinst, Captain Fordo shot the ground in front of one in the city streets of Harnaidan to spook it off, sending it scrambling away in terror.

name: Dragon-bird
summary: Dragon-birds or dragon birds were avian predators indigenous to Onderon and Endor. Those of Endor were considered a bad omen by Ewoks. Those of Onderon inspired the appearance of dragon-bird robot drones. The dragon-birds on the two worlds may have been separate species sharing nothing more than a name.

name: Dragon slug
summary: Dragon slugs were large, fire-breathing creatures who ate lumni-spice, living on both Hoth and Corulag. The fungus that created the spice was the slug's favorite meal; this diet often made them grow to 20 meters and develop armor-like skin. They were able to maintain a steady diet of the Fungal spice through fermentation, indirectly farming the very food they would later eat.

name: Dragonet
summary: Dragonets were reptile creatures native to the planet Tatooine. Sometimes compared to young krayt dragons, they were often found in lairs made of bones.

name: Dragonsnake
summary: The dragonsnake (also spelled dragon snake) was a large, predatory reptile that dwelled in the muddy waters of certain planets, including Dagobah and Nal Hutta. During the Clone Wars, the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi had a run-in with a dragonsnake while searching for Ziro the Hutt on Nal Hutta. Years later, Luke Skywalker crash-landed on Dagobah, where his astromech droid R2-D2 was nearly eaten by a dragonsnake.

name: Draigon
summary: Draigons were an avian species native to an unknown watery planet between Bandomeer and Coruscant. They ate fish from the oceans of their world, although this did not make up their diet entirely. Draigons were covered in silver scales and had strong legs and large, single-clawed wings, along with yellow eyes and dagger-like teeth. Draigons were said to resemble flying Ithorian razor sharks. In 44 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi, along with many Offworld Mining workers, were aboard the ship Monument when the craft crash-landed on the draigon home planet. At first, Obi-Wan and Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn believed the draigons to be harmless; however, they later realized this was not the case. Whiphid thugs, under orders from their Offworld Mining Corporation superior Grelb (who himself was following orders from his own boss, Jemba), tried to shoot Qui-Gon down from a cliff he was scaling in an attempted recovery of stolen dactyl hidden inside a cave in the cliffside. Qui-Gon Jinn, after recovering a cache of dactyl, jumped off the cliffside and landed on a draigon, persuading it to fly him down to ground level. The blaster bolts began driving the draigons to the point of hysteria, but in their concentration and glee the Whiphids failed to notice. Eventually, Grelb noticed that his underlings were being eaten by the now-frenzied draigons. Although he tried to escape the avian predators by squeezing into a small crevice, the Hutt was subdued and devoured. Other draigons then attacked the Arcona who were taking shelter in the caves, though with the help of Obi-Wan and Qui-Gon they were beaten off, the two Jedi killing so many of them that their piled bodies nearly blocked the cave mouth.

name: Drakag
summary: Drakag were hulking but quick-witted creatures native to Seline. They were unknown to the galaxy until the Galactic War when a conflict on Seline brought them to the attention of Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire who used them as beasts of burden on the planet's rough terrain.

name: Drall
summary: The Drall were a species with eyes that were especially vulnerable to light. They inhabited the Corellia system alongside humans and Selonians. The non-lethal weapon known as the flashstick was particularly effective against Drall and was used almost exclusively by the Drall constabulary, with most users wearing polarized goggles to prevent the weapon blinding them as well as the target.

name: Drate
summary: The Drate lizard were a species of quadruped reptiles found on Taris. They had a frilled protuberance on top of the head and on both sides of the neck. They possessed a row of circular yellow spots on their flanks.

name: Dray beast
summary: Dray beasts were skeletal, eight-legged herd creatures used to pull carts on farms, a common sight on Dellalt and Azbrian.

name: Drayberian hawk
summary: The Drayberian hawk was a species of bird.

name: Dream shimmer
summary: A dream shimmer was a species of large, buzzing insect found on the planet Jagomir. The insect's thorax and abdomen were about the size of a small rodent. Dream shimmers were equipped with just one defensive mechanism—a stinger filled with hallucinogenic venom, which they used to either allow themselves to escape from predators or repeatedly attack and stun enemies. The creature's name was derived from its wings, which shimmered in the presence of light.

name: Dreambeast
summary: Dreambeasts were strange creations made through the dark side of the Force. The appearance of such beasts was never the same, as they took on the shape of what the opponent feared most in their mind. This allowed it to take on a wide variety of appearances. When the creatures were killed, the physical wounds they left on their opponent would seem to disappear, suggesting that the creatures inflict a form of telepathic pain that borders on the real and the imaginary. Furthermore, the mental trauma inflicted by these creatures was permanent, and would render most victims mentally unstable in the future.

name: Dreamvenom snake
summary: A dreamvenom snake was a type of snake. Han Solo shipped cargoes of dreamvenom snakes during his career as a smuggler.

name: Drebin
summary: Drebin were large herbivores found on the planet Kuat. They created a natural form of compost, which was used in gardening.

name: Dreeka
summary: Dreeka were a kind of fish native to Ithor. They were often fried and eaten. Zovius Mendu once hid from Jedi Master Feln in a crate of dried dreeka fish. They were known for their distinct chirping sound.

name: Drel
summary: Drel were a species of aquatic creatures that gasped when out of water.

name: Drengir
summary: {{Update|The High Republic: Into the Dark, The High Republic (2021) 4, The High Republic (2021) 5, Starlight: Hidden Danger, Star Wars: The High Republic: Heart of the Drengir, The High Republic: The Rising Storm, The High Republic: Race to Crashpoint Tower, The High Republic Adventures (2021) 6, The High Republic Adventures (2021) 7, The High Republic: Out of the Shadows, The High Republic: The Fallen Star, The High Republic: Temptation of the Force, The High Republic: The Edge of Balance, Vol. 3, The High Republic: The Edge of Balance, Vol. 4, The High Republic: Seeds of Starlight, The High Republic: Haunted Starlight, The High Republic: Into the Light, Life Day 1, Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi, Star Wars: Timelines, , The Art of Star Wars: The High Republic: Volume II}} The Drengir were a plant-like species of sentient, amorphous carnivores from the Wild Space planet Mulita who threatened to reap harvest across the Galactic Frontier during the High Republic Era. With twisted tentacles and a maw arrayed with teeth, the avaricious creatures shared a collective consciousness known as the root-mind that could dominate and corrupt other minds—even those of Jedi. The Jedi Knights feared the Drengir as meat was their sole desire, and they spread a darkness so great it perturbed and swayed Jedi Knights into their own collective mind, inflaming the chaos and imbalance upon which the Drengir thrived. With an aptitude for healing, the Drengir were largely impervious to the scorches of blasters and singes of lightsabers. When seared in half by the blade of a lightsaber, a Drengir could simply reform with two animated bodies. In the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, the Drengir spread in search of food, although they lacked the scheming nature and power structure of the anarchistic Nihil marauders that battled the Galactic Republic. Reflecting hues of green, the plant-like carnivores pursued their purpose of consuming life on worlds such as Batuu and Sedri Minor, deceiving farmers and kidnapping children; ruining crops and carving hideouts underground; ransacking villages and feasting on humans and non-humans alike. In 232 BBY, Jedi Master Sskeer's fate became inescapably linked to the Drengir on Sedri Minor.
skinColor: Various hues of green and brown
distinctions: Thrived on chaos and imbalance{{SWYouTube|nCSz73duvSs|The Drengir &
124; Characters of Star Wars: The High Republic|sw_url=video/the-drengir-characters-of-star-wars-the-high-republic}}
Cast a dark aura and gave disturbing visions
A shared collective mind known as the root-mind
Persuaded vulnerable sentients to join their collective consciousness

name: Dressellian
summary: Dressellians were a species of sentient humanoids that were native to Dressel. They lived in peaceful isolation from any conflict until the Galactic Civil War. As a species, they were loyal to the Galactic Republic and after its demise many Dressellians joined the Rebel Alliance. They had hairless heads and wrinkled visages and cranium. Orrimaarko, a male Dressellian, was a soldier for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Following the dissolution of the Imperial Senate, the Rebel Alliance's Commander-in-Chief Mon Mothma noted in a journal entry within the Rebel Files that she considered the Dressellian population, along with the Mon Cal and Sullustans to be especially vulnerable and that they should consider taking in refugees. During the Galactic Civil War, a Dressellian resistance fighter named Lokmarcha served as a major in the Rebel Alliance. Shortly before the Battle of Endor, several other Dressellians attended the Alliance briefing during which the attack on the Galactic Empire's second Death Star was prepared.

name: Dressto
summary: Dresstos were small jungle birds from Veron.

name: Drethi
summary: Drethi were a type of creature that had wings. During the dedication of the Starlight Beacon space station in 232 BBY, Jedi Master Elzar Mann met Jedi archivist OrbaLin for the first time and was left with the impression that the archivist was capable of boring the wings off a Drethi. Shortly before the start of the Outer Rim planet Valo's Republic Fair in 231 BBY, OrbaLin traveled to the world to attend the festivities. As Mann watched his colleague arrive, he remembered his impression of the archivist's capabilities.

name: Drexl
summary: Drexls, also known as warbeasts, were reptavian winged creatures indigenous to Dxun.

name: Dripdrinker larva
summary: The dripdrinker larva was a type of larva that possessed a tongue. Taking pride in their marksmanship, Churhee's Riflemen encouraged the rumor that their members could shoot the tongue off of a dripdrinker larva from a thousand meters.

name: Drivok
summary: Drivoks were a sentient species native to Faket in Wild Space. They had mauve-colored skin, no hair, and to all outward appearances, no distinct gender either. Drivoks could speak Basic, but seemed to have limited grasp of the syntax, often omitting articles from their speech. Drivoks had the ability to sense others, and therefore some Drivoks were employed as trackers and bounty hunters. In 21 BBY, Colonel Barev employed a Drivok bounty hunter to locate Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi for General Lok Durd.This Drivok was able to sense Obi-wan psychically and locate him on a world map. Obi-wan sensed this detection in the Force but was unable to recognize it.

name: Droch
summary: Drochs were parasitic insects that burrowed under the skin of the host and drank their life energies. Their feeding was the source of Death Seed plague.
distinctions: Life-energy draining parasites, non-sentient early in lifespan

name: Droffi steed
summary: The droffi steed was a four-legged reptilian native to Aridus. The steed could store water in its body tissues and it served as reliable transportation for the Chubbits.

name: Droidbreaker
summary: The droidbreaker, formerly known as the swamphulk, was a creature native to Belgaroth. Its native planet consumed by pollution and scrapyards, the droidbreaker evolved in a single generation to survive and fit its new surroundings. With a steady diet of plasteel and different forms of refined metal, the droidbreaker became a hulking figure that skulked the many junkyards that covered the planet. A droidbreaker steak could be made from droidbreaker meat and was high in iron content due to the droidbreaker's diet.
distinctions: An elongated proboscis consisting of sharp bone
A rough triangular carapace on the head

name: Droot
summary: Droot referred to a pale blue subspecies of Rakata that lived in the equatorial tidal coves of Lehon.

name: Drouk
summary: Drouk were a species of bipedal predatory creatures. They were powerfully built with armored carapaces and large arms. Some Drouks were capable of growing to immense size. Drouks could be trained to fight in combat and take commands. Several were used in battle by the Warstalkers on Denova. They were also kept as pets.

name: Drovian
summary: The Drovians were a sentient species that was bipedal in form, with corpulent bodies several times heavier than that of Humans. Their four limbs were extremely strong tentacles, which terminated in three pincers. Their bodies were grey or orange, with black or brown hair. Most Drovians developed an addiction to zwil, originally an offworld cake flavoring agent. The Drovians were native to Nim Drovis, a planet in the Meridian sector. The species was split into two tribes, the Drovians—from whom the species name was derived—and the Gopso'o. Having developed into a network of pastoral communities, these two tribes were engaged in a vicious civil war that persisted for centuries, its original cause lost to time. The first to make contact with the wider galaxy, the Drovian tribe became ascendant, with higher education, income and technology levels. Several Drovians spread out into the galaxy, eventually appearing on worlds such as Jebble, Taris, Tatooine and Cato Neimoidia, involved in criminal endeavors, such as swoop gangs, gladiatorial contests and working for underworld kingpin Jabba Desilijic Tiure. While a member of the Galactic Republic, on several occasions, the Drovians found their homeworld located within Sith territory, such as during the Jedi Civil War and the New Sith Wars. Nim Drovis was part of the Imperial splinter faction known as the Greater Maldrood, before joining the New Republic. The civil war came to a head in 13 ABY during a Death Seed pandemic, when the Gopso'o tribe almost gained control of the planet while financially aided by the Loronar Corporation. Eventually, emissaries from the New Jedi Order managed to peacefully resolve the conflict.

name: Drowan
summary: The drowan was a forest creature found on the planet Öetrago. During the High Republic Era, the forest habitat of the drowan and other creatures of Öetrago was ravaged by fires, and Jedi Master Sskeer and his Padawan, Keeve Trennis, were dispatched to the planet. The two Jedi held back the flames so that the creatures could escape, but one drowan calf became trapped. Sskeer left his Padawan to hold the blaze on her own while he rescued the drowan.

name: Drugon
summary: Drugons were fierce underwater predators found on many worlds, including Sulon and Ruusan. Despite their large bulk, drugons were surprisingly fast swimmers, and their powerful jaws could deliver a devastating bite. Three drugons were known to have been kept by Kaerobani on Rathalay.

name: Drutash grub
summary: Drutash grubs were a type of grub that were farmed as food by the Sullustan species in large dank caverns on the volcanic planet Sullust.

name: Druulgothan
summary: The Druulgothans were a species of lizard-like sentients native to the Druulgotha system, located in the Outer Rim's Thesme sector. They were present in the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War. In the year 0 BBY, several Druulgothans visited a cantina on the planet Toprawa. The cantina, Al The Alchemist's, was patronized by gun-runners, mercenaries, and bounty hunters from across the galaxy; the infamous Boba Fett among them. Also present in the cantina at the time was Havet Storm, a young Human boy whose grandfather had been a Jedi Knight. The patrons soon discovered that Storm was carrying a lightsaber, so the bar-goers—Druulgothans included—gathered around the boy and stared at him with hostility. Fett, who bore a grudge against the boy from a previous encounter, ordered the assorted patrons of the cantina to kill Storm, but the boy was able to escape.

name: Druyza
summary: Druyza were herd animals native to Socorro. They were the primary prey of monnoks, and the Ibhaan'I nomads raised them as beasts of burden and mounts, as well as for their hide, meat, and dung. The dung was used to make bricks.

name: Dry eel
summary: A dry eel was a type of eel edible to Quarren. During the High Republic Era, some of the eels were stored aboard Republic Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo's Alif-class Longbeam—the Paxion—for him to consume. In 382 BBY, while hosting a peace summit aboard the Paxion in the Outer Rim's Eiram system, the protocol droid AR-K4 offered Mollo a bowl of dry eels, which he took from her and devoured.

name: Dry-rock salamander
summary: Dry-rock salamanders were a type of salamander found in the Triple Moon Caves on the planet Siline. During the High Republic Era, they were endangered. In 134 BBY, while visiting the caves, the Silinese Rhos Arthyst told Jedi Padawan Yord Fandar to watch out for both dry-rock salamander and crystal bats and noted the salamanders' endangered status.

name: Dryax
summary: Dryaxes were a type of huge, humanoid-shaped predator found in the jungles of the planet Wayland. They had glowing red eyes and lupine features. During or after 18 BBY, the clones Omega and Crosshair encountered a dryax on Wayland while fleeing from Tantiss Base. The creature roared at them, but then fought a pack of lurca hounds sent from the mountain, allowing the clones to escape. When Clone Force 99 later traveled to Wayland to rescue Omega from Tantiss Base, the former Imperial Admiral Edmon Rampart, who was aiding the clones, rested against a sleeping dryax in the jungle not realizing it was a creature. The dryax awoke and then chased Clone Force 99 into the jungle before attacking a group of TK stormtroopers who were searching for the clones.

name: Dryden Vos' species
summary: Dryden Vos was a member of a near-human species which were nearly identical to baseline humans with the exception of their facial markings, which would change color when they were angry, and their clawed thumbs.

name: Dua-wurm
summary: The dua-wurm was a species of creature that could be found living underground on the world of Cularin. They were two-headed purple worm-like creatures that reached over two meters in length. Their needle-like teeth delivered acid into their prey with each bite, but the two heads could not attack the same creature at the same time. A dua-wurm attacked some allies of the Cularin resistance in the Cloud Mountain mines. They had been walking in a tunnel with a weak floor, which collapsed into the tunnel in which the wurm was resting.

name: Dubravan
summary: Dubravans were a species of green-skinned humanoids native to the world of Dubrava. They possessed yellow blood, black eyes, and webbed hands and feet with four digits apiece. Anatomically, females of the species were distinguished by their breasts; however, cultural signifiers of gender included clothing and hair styles. The swamps of the species' homeworld supported a simple civilization based upon wood construction and water-based transportation. During the Galactic Civil War, Dubrava became a site of conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. By 0 ABY, the Empire had dispatched stormtroopers to the world, while the Rebellion sent the Human pilot Jal Te Gniev there as a recruiter. The Rebel resented the assignment and rebuffed a young Dubravan named Bobek who wished to join the movement. However, when the Human revealed to a Dubravan female named Nevana that Rebel pilot Luke Skywalker had destroyed the Empire's Death Star battle station, she sold the information to a Dubravan bounty hunter named Sarma, who in turn informed the Empire. Nevana accidentally led a group of stormtroopers to the bar from which Gniev operated, and in the ensuing events, Nevana and Bobek both died, and Gniev fled the world to warn Skywalker that the Empire was pursuing him.
hairColor: Blond, brown, red, green, white, gray

name: Duck
summary: Ducks were a type of waterfowl that could be found on several different planets throughout the galaxy, notably Naboo.

name: Dug
summary: The Dugs were a sentient species from the planet Malastare. They were easily identified by their long snouts and the fact that they walked using their arms. On Malastare, the Dugs were ruled by the Dug Council, which during the Clone Wars was headed by Nakha Urus, who held the title of Doge. Some Dugs were known to travel off-world in order to seek lives off of Malastare. The pilot Sebulba became a well known and feared Podracer pilot, while a Dug named Preigo headed a popular circus. Dugs could also be found on the worlds of Coruscant and Tatooine.

name: Dugar dugar
summary: Dugar dugar were a species of deerlike creature native to the planet Batuu. They were described as slender, with long silky fur that was "the color of mushrooms." Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised dugar dugar to become pets or for other reasons.

name: Duinuogwuin
summary: The Duinuogwuin, colloquially called Star Dragons, were among the galaxy's more secretive and strange species.
skinColor: Variable shades of gray as well as purple
distinctions: Large size, long life spans, high regenerative capabilities, hardened skin, natural repulsorlifts, survival in vacuum, ability to travel through hyperspace, fire-breathing

name: Dulok
summary: Duloks were an aggressive sentient species native to the forest moon of Endor, where they lived in swamps.

name: Dumblefish
summary: The dumblefish was a type of fish. Between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, the mouth of Vardos Star Scouts member Drik Maylon bobbed open and shut like that of a dumblefish after his fellow scout Deeta Kardon informed him that a visitor that they were waiting for on the planet Vardos was coming from the planet Coruscant, introducing the possibility that it was Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine.

name: Dune bantha
summary: The dune bantha was a species of bantha, a type of omnivorous mammal native to the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine. Dune banthas were less furry then the other two known bantha species—the non-sentient common bantha and the dwarf bantha—and lived in the equatorial region of Tatooine where they had to survive extreme heat and severe droughts. Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts Director of Creature Cartography Ardis San Tekka mentioned dune banthas in an entry on banthas in her journal at some point after the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY.

name: Dune beetle
summary: Dune beetles were a type of beetle from Tatooine. They were a subspecies or race of the sand beetle.

name: Dune biter
summary: Dune biters were Tatooine scavengers.

name: Dune lizard
summary: The dune lizard was a species of carnivorous reptiles found on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine. Dune lizards formed in packs, and their gizzard could be consumed as sustenance. A chef by the name of Porcellus acquired dune lizard gizzards to prepare as an appetizer for the Hutt crime lord, Jabba Desilijic Tiure. They were known to be aggressive towards sentients, at one point having eaten an officer of the Galactic Empire.

name: Dune-rat
summary: A dune-rat was a type of rat that lived in warrens in deserts. In 9 BBY, two members of the Narkis Anchorites—a group assisting with the restoration of the Jedi Archives—within the Archive on the moon Jedha discussed Imperial patrols keeping one of the anchorites awake at night. The other anchorite remarked that the Narkis Anchorites were dune-rats to the Empire, hidden and safe. In 33 ABY, the scavenger Rey engaged in combat with two thugs attempting to take her scavenged materials on the planet Jakku. After she knocked one thug away with her quarterstaff, their accomplice threatened Rey and referred to her as a "dune-rat."

name: Dune worm
summary: Dune worms were dangerous worms that inhabited the Dune Sea of the desert planet Tatooine, though they were rumored to also call the rocky Jundland Wastes home. With skin the color of sand, they had enormous crystalline teeth and small beady eyes, and were attracted to movement. A young dune worm ten feet in length was considered small. The feeling of being caught in a sandstorm was sometimes compared to the bite of a dune worm. A few weeks after the Battle of Yavin, a bounty hunter was confronted by a young dune worm while searching for Han Solo.
distinctions: Enormous crystalline teeth, small beady eyes

name: Dunecat
summary: The dunecat was a species living in the deserts of Tatooine.

name: Duneclaw
summary: The duneclaw, also known as a guuria, was a non-sentient beast native to the planet Tatooine. It was rarely seen on the planet's deserts, this because it preferred to hunt near Tatooine's cliffside caves and other dark, enclosed spaces, thanks to its ability to navigate in dim light through echolocation and also to receive sound waves made by other creatures. Although its appearance reminded a manka cat, the duneclaw was much different from the Alderaanian feline: it was an omnivorous, reptilian and solitary creature. It was also supposed that it was a distant cousin of the wraid. The duneclaw had a very tough skin that was covered with armor-like plates, and a thick skull that could shatter Human's bones and crack stone only with a simple head-butt.

name: Dung worm
summary: Dung worms were edible animals on Tatooine. Around 9 ABY, Peli Motto supplied dung worms for Grogu to eat.

name: Dunsenn
summary: The dunsenn was a species of fish-like animal of vast size, indigenous to Naboo. With troop containers strapped to their undersides, such creatures were used as aerial troop transports called FlopCarriers by Gungans. [[File:Dunn2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Dunsenn.]] The body of the dunsenn was essentially an enormous balloon, enabling it to float in the air. It ingested water through its gills and drove itself forward by expelling air out through specialized funnels. Once airborne, it propelled itself with its strong rudder tail and navigated with a number of large, feather-like fins. The front lateral fins could also launch cold jets of water that served to lower the dunsenn's body temperature while floating in the hot sun.

name: Duor
summary: Duors were highly sentient, Force-sensitive delphinoids indigenous to the planet Arrakan. They believed the Leviathan Kithnarrock to be their creator. They created the Battrach by using bio-engineering techniques.

name: Dupei
summary: The Dupei were a sentient species. A group of Dupei monks resided on Nameel, and stole credits from a nearby Trandoshan tribe who tried to buy outlawed weapons from them. The Jedi Eno Cordova and Cere Junda were sent to Nameel to restore peace, and Cordova spoke with the Dupei, learning of their theft.

name: Dur Sabon
summary: The Dur Sabon were a species of tall, eel-like sentients native to the planet of the same name. Around 33 BBY, princess Foolookoola arrived on Dur Sabon as part of a covert operation, having been forced to flee the neighboring planet of Ootoola after her relatives were murdered by the conspirators. Friends of the overthrown royal family took the young Foolookoola in and expressed hope that she would one day be able to return home safely.
height: Twice the height of an average human
distinctions: A pair of muscular, five-fingered hands with webbing

name: Duraceph
summary: Duraceph was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Lobereki was a member of this species.

name: Duracrete slug
summary: Duracrete slugs, also known simply as duraslugs, were a species of non-sentient slug found in the underworld of the planet Coruscant. They fed on the artificial stone duracrete, then after digesting it, secreted it from their bodies to form a hard outer shell. The creatures used a series of mouth tentacles to sense their surroundings and could grow up to ten meters in length. Under their armored skin, duracrete slugs had tasty meat that was initially eaten by residents of the underworld out of necessity, before citizens of the planet's upper levels began using it and created Duraslug Rolls, a type of savory sandwich. Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs included a recipe for this in The Ultimate Cookbook between 34 ABY and 35 ABY.

name: Duracrete worm
summary: The duracrete worm was a large silica parasite which was found on the planet Coruscant. This parasite was a large (three to five meters long), slow-moving helminth, or parasitic worm. They occupied the lower portions of buildings, eating through foundations and plumbing. They reproduced by parthenogenesis. They also had primitive eyes, sensory tentacles near the mouth, and rasping teeth under the snout. They were similar in appearance to the duracrete slugs. Sometimes they are hunted by hive rats.

name: Durgolosk
summary: Durgolosks were a non-sentient, six-legged species of fearsome predators native to the swamps of the planet Barab I. Members of the species were huge and white and brown in color. They also possessed tentacles that were tipped with venom. Durgolosks spent more time sleeping than hunting but ate any creature they met when they did hunt. The Barabel species, which was also native to Barab I, considered the slaying of a durgolosk to be an impressive achievement.

name: Durkii
summary: A durkii was a large purple bipedal reptilian monster known for fits of rage when effected with kleex. Luminara Unduli defeated a durkii in the Arena of Doom using no Force abilities, but only simple physics. The evil vizier Ko Zatec-Cha kept a hungry durkii at the bottom of a deep dungeon pit on the planet Tammuz-an. He cast the royal prince Mon Julpa and his friends into the pit in the hope that the durkii would destroy them. The astromech droid R2-D2 quelled the creature's temper by removing a parasitic insect known as a kleex from its scaly hide.

name: Durni
summary: The durni was an eyeless rabbit-like species that used a sonic radar to navigate the wilderness they live in. This small creature lived underground in the old Selonian tunnels of Corellia. A slang term in use in the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War was dust durni, which was used to refer to a large pile of dust.

name: Duros
summary: The Duros were a humanoid species common in the galaxy native to the planet Duro. Notable Duros included bounty hunter Cad Bane who operated during the Clone Wars and Shriv Suurgav, a Duros who was a member of the New Republic Inferno Squad, and later the Resistance Inferno Squad.

name: Dust bunny
summary: Dust bunnies were a type of creature that the Force-sensitive youngling Grogu encountered at some point. The same group of dust bunnies that encountered him disturbed his meditation before chasing him, eventually gifting Grogu a flower.

name: Dust mite
summary: The dust mite was a species of mite. They were preyed upon by ibians.

name: Dust rat
summary: Dust rats also known as a Tatoo-rat were a type of rodent that lived on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine. They had brown or white fur and black or brown eyes as well as a long tail around the same length as their body. By 3 ABY, they were commonly found across all of the world's various settlements and farms. The rats relied entirely upon off the leftovers and trash of the world's population and were widely considered pests due to the severe amount of damage they could cause to farms and homes. By the same year, the rats were also found in the city Canto Bight on the desert planet Cantonica which was also located in the Outer Rim. In 4 ABY, three tatoo-rats were climbing on the bars of a cell in the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's palace on Tatooine as the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 were marched past the cell in order to reach the droid pool for work assignment.

name: Dust stalker
summary: Dust stalkers were a predatory species native to the Madlands on the planet Weik in Wild Space.

name: Dustweaver spider
summary: Dustweaver spiders were large, spindly-legged creatures found on the planet Tatooine, nesting in the Mospic rise. The appearance of the brain walkers used by the B'omarr Order reminded of those spiders.

name: Duuvhal
summary: The Duuvhals were a non-sentient reptilian species native to Yashuvhu. They were warm-blooded reptiles covered by green feathers. Their anatomy offered them significant ability to disguise and be unseen in the rainforests of their homeworld. Considered fast for their size, duuvhals did not commonly attack creatures other than natural prey. Duuvhals also had venomous fangs which could kill Humans. Though normally found in the wild, duuvhals could be domesticated. Some of the Yashuvhi kept them as pets, even being trained to bite on command. Force Adept and wanderer Valara Saar had a pet Duuvhal named Zeev. After Zeev died on Aargau, she took a second pet duuvhal, Jedi, upon her return to Yashuvhi.

name: Dwarf bantha
summary: The dwarf bantha was a diminutive species of bantha, a type of omnivorous mammal native to the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine. Dwarf banthas lived in the canyons and cliffs of the world's outermost deserts. Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts Director of Creature Cartography Ardis San Tekka mentioned dwarf banthas in an entry on banthas in her journal no earlier than 35 ABY.

name: Dwarf opee sea killer
summary: Dwarf opee sea killers were a downsized subspecies of the opee, a carnivorous non-sentient creature with reddish orange skin and yellow eyes that lived in the sweet waters of the planets Naboo and Aquilaris. While the "dwarf" opees were as heavily plated as their bigger counterparts, they were much rarer and measured less than half the size of the full-sized ones—which made them less than 10 meters. They were in fact genetically incapable of growing any larger than that. The zoo of Otoh Gunga, the underwater capital of the Gungans on Naboo, used to host two dwarf opees christened Nink and Vink until a Gungan named Jar Jar Binks accidentally released them into the city by deactivating their hydrostatic bubble.
distinctions: Dwarf subspecies of the regular opee

name: Dwarf rathtar
summary: Dwarf rathtar was a subspecies of rathtar found on Trillia. They were involved in an incident known as the Trillia Massacre.

name: Dwarf varactyl
summary: The Dwarf Varactyl was a small subspecies of varactyl that made its way to Tatooine. One distinct difference between the Dwarf Varactyl and its larger relative were four functional wings, with which it was able to avoid predators such as the Worrt.
skinColor: Green with red on the tail.

name: Dwoob
summary: Dwoobs were a type of creature with brown fur. In 9 ABY, a pair of Gamorrean fighters wore traditional leather and dwoob-fur trunks while brawling for sport in the arena at the honky tonk of Abyssin criminal Gor Koresh on the planet RTK111.

name: Dwuni
summary: The Dwuni were a species of short bipedal sentients. They had large heads with sharp-toothed mouths and eyes on stalks. Two Dwuni brothers, Blawz and Crodit, worked as enslaved miners in the mines of the planet Kessel in 10 BBY. Despite enjoying their work, they were among the liberated miners who poured out of the mines during a revolt that year. Five years later, three Dwuni were employed at a store in Ferrix City on the world Ferrix, although they were scared out of the building by the human Pre-Mor Authority Deputy Inspector Syril Karn while he was preparing an ambush on the thief Cassian Andor.

name: Dybbuk
summary: The Dybbuk Silencer also known as simply the Dybbuk was a fleshy, star-shaped yellow-green parasitic creature used by the Galactic Republic to subdue violent criminals in the High Republic Era. The silencer was a genetically modified from an atmospheric glider native to Dybrin 12 by Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals. Measuring 0.25 metres in width, the parasite would affect the user's mind by latching onto another organism's mouth with its adhesive pseupod pad and induce an altered state of consciousness while making a squelching sound, feeding off the host’s neural energy while transmitting euphoric alpha waves. Some subjected to the silencer reported nightmares while under its effects which Chiewab scientists denied. In 132 BBY, aboard the Republic prisoner transport Palwick heading to the galactic capital Coruscant, the parasite was used to subdue a human convict, Melo Tolicus. During an escape attempt aboard the ship causing the ship to drop out of hyperspace near the snowy planet Carlac, meknek Osha Aniseya used her repair droid Pip to electrocute the parasite latched to the convict. The electric shock caused the dybbuk to release its grip on the convict, freeing him and leaving the dybbuk chittering while escaping the ship into space before the ship entered Carlac's atmosphere and crash-landed.

name: Dybrinthe
summary: Dybrinthe were a humanoid sentient species native to the Deep Core moon of Dybrin 12. Due to the moon's poisonous and highly pressurized atmosphere, Dybrinthe out of Dybrin 12 had to wear large helmets and breathing gear when they left their homeworld.

name: Dyclops
summary: The Dyclops were a sentient species who, despite their mostly humanoid body, were distinguished by their two heads, both of which featured a mouth, a single eye, and an ear. In the early days of the Galactic Empire, a Dyclops had joined the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate group led by Reddjak. The Dyclops served as a gunner aboard the Blood Brother, Reddjak's starship.

name: Dynym Quid's species
summary: A sentient species of cephalopod-like humanoids lived in the galaxy. In 132 BBY, a member of this species was present at the Jedi Temple during a conversation between Jedi Masters Sol and Vernestra Rwoh. During the Great Jedi Purge, a member of this species was among the refugees on Jabiim who were given passage to Tessen aboard Kawlan Roken's Jabiim freight transport. Another member was Dynym Quid, who spent time at Canto Casino in 34 ABY.

name: Dyplotid
summary: Dyplotids were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy, possessing four eyes that allowed them to see both the ultraviolet and infrared spectrum. Members of the species had been present at locations such as the Lodge on Vandor and the First Light. Craykan was a member of this species who served as one of the three Tech Masters that ruled the planet Trionak, while Limal Pakt was a Dyplotid metalsmith who operated a shop in the Federal District on Coruscant.

name: Eagle
summary: Eagles were a type of predatory flying creature. During the High Republic Era, while on a mission to the astronomical object Cethis, Jedi Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo watched three Republic Defense Coalition transport starships landing as their security escorts circled above like watchful eagles.

name: Early death dog
summary: The early death dog, also known as urcaninus lic morte or simply urcaninus, was a foul-tempered, strong, and voluminous predator. It was a nocturnal hunter that inhabited swamps, veldts, and plains and fed on red and blue meat, including poisonous snakes, though it was also known for eating aquatic broccoli. Female early death dogs typically hid their offspring from the males to avoid cannibalism during the first years of life. The creatures could be found from the Middle Plains to 30,000 leagues south of the Troon, depending on the season. They were also kept as pets by certain species.
distinctions: Four limbs (two clawed and two pawed)
Overdeveloped torso with ancillary pelvic structure
Small eyes with dark periorbital pigmentation

name: Ebon hawk
summary: The ebon hawk was a type of hawk. They were known to prey on the skittermouse, a creature found on the Inner Rim desert planet Jakku, which the birds would catch in their talons. During her mission to the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, Resistance spy Vi Moradi compared the Batuuan residents believing that they were safe from the First Order to an unaware skittermouse that was being preyed on by an ebon hawk when speaking to the farmers Grana and Dolin, likening the presence of a First Order Star Destroyer to a hawk overhead.

name: Ebranite
summary: Ebranites were the native people of the planet Ebra in the Dousc system. They were adapted to life in Ebra's systems of caves and canyons. Ebranites had six arms, with two opposable thumbs on each six-digit hand. Their feet were also adapted for climbing, with three large clawed toes and a thumb-like appendage on their heels. Their arms and legs allowed them to climb quickly, but they walked slowly on level ground. Their thick reddish-brown skin was mottled with red, white or black patches as camouflage against rocks. They also had excellent vision, and could see in infrared.

name: Ebruchi
summary: The Ebruchi were a sentient race native to the Unknown Regions. They were humanoids with creamy white skin and mouths that were surrounded by worm-shaped tentacles. The Ebruchi were a clan—based civilization that dwelled in the unknown space where their held territory over a handful of star systems, and prowled the edges of the Outer Rim Territories and Wild Space, looking for prey that wandered. The Ebruchi were mainly composed of Ebruchi, but were known to accept others into their ranks, usually outcasts from the various alien species found in the Unknown Regions.

name: Echani
summary: The Echani were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They shared their name with a form of martial art. During the High Republic Era, when the Nihil attacked Valo, an Echani man who had come to attend the Valo Republic Fair had a run-in with Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh's pet targons, nearly being mauled before Jedi Master Stellan Gios held the large cats off so the man could flee.

name: Ecorb
summary: Ecorbs were a sentient species that inhabited the Detral Pits. They had coiled attachments called hampas on their gelatinous heads and possessed red, pulsating blup sacks. Ecorbs were said to have grown hampas after excessively feeding themselves with a particular species of radiant orange and blue flower, a trait that was supposedly hereditarily transmitted to following generations.

name: Edan tiger
summary: Edan tigers, also known as snowcats, were large predatory felines native to the colder regions of Edan II. They were covered from head to spined-tail in white fur with black stripes which helped conceal them in their natural habitat, both during warmer weather and the colder snow-covered months. They had two very large fangs that protruded from either side of their top row of teeth.

name: Eddel
summary: The Eddel, or Eddelians, were a sentient species known for their quick wit. They were native to Fehern, a hospitable Mid Rim planet. The Eddelians traveled throughout the Trax sector, and their distinctively styled Eddelian starships, carrying Eddelian traders, were a common sight in neighboring star systems. The Eddelians were targeted by the Republic's successor state, the Galactic Empire, as part of its pro-Human, anti-alien rhetoric. The Empire declared war on the Eddelians and decimated the species, subjugating the few thousand survivors of the conflict. The Empire took over their homeworld, and many Humans immigrated there. The remaining Eddelians were forced to serve those colonists as enslaved workers. The Empire also destroyed most Eddelian technology during the conflict.

name: Ee
summary: The Ee were a sentient invertebrate species indigenous to Trilos, the moon of Atraken. All members of the Ee were adept in at least one type of mental power, which were divided into three categories; physical skills, environmental skills, and mental skills. One in ten Ee was adept in two categories; one in a hundred Ee were skilled in all three. Each category had a number of different skills. The different areas of work in Ee society included: *Purifiers *Weavers *Thinkers *Mindbenders *Bulwarks

name: Eelfish
summary: An eelfish was a type of fish known for digging. While searching for a datapad in the hideout of the pirate Captain Qorvino on the planet Akiva in 3 ABY one hired gun ordered another to "make like an eelfish and get digging." When the other hired gun was confused by the phrase, the first sighed and clarified that they should just look for the datapad.

name: Eellayin
summary: The Eellayin were a civilization who resided on Polis Massa before their extinction. By the end of the Clone Wars, some Kallidahin archaeologists and exobiologists believed the Eellayin were their species' ancestor, so they began excavating Polis Massa in an attempt to recover Eellayin tissues and use Kaminoan cloning technology to recreate life.

name: Eerm
summary: Eerm was a serpentine predator from Dorin. It was also a common surname among Kel Dors.

name: Eero Iridian's species
summary: Flexible antennae distinguished members of a tall, spindly sentient species. The species also had feet, bright-yellow eyes, and shrill voices when concerned. They were members of the Galactic Republic during its final decades and were represented in the Galactic Senate by a senator. Eero Iridian, the senator's son, wished to replicate his father's success but twice failed to win the necessary election. Iridian later worked as an aide to Senator Blix Annon and arranged for his employer's kidnapping. The ploy was one of several abductions that Iridian organized in partnership with the pirate Lorian Nod to raise funds for another election campaign.

name: Eesin
summary: The Eesin were a sentient species in the galaxy. Their hives were known to be busy with much activity, to the point that an active landing bay could resemble one.

name: Eeusu Estornii's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Senator Eeusu Estornii was a member of this species.

name: Eickarie
summary: The Eickarie were a reptilian alien species from the Unknown Regions that were aligned with the Empire of the Hand. They were native to the planet Kariek. They had pale orange blood and orange and green skin with patterns of black scales around their large eyes and across the backs of their heads. They were close enough to Human norm in body shape to fit into standard stormtrooper armor. In the Eickarie language, shak meant "ready." In their culture, "left-handed" was associated with evil and deceit and "right-handed" with good and truth. Notable Eickaries included Su-mil and Ha-ran. They were formerly a fragmented tribal people who had been ruled by a tyrannical Warlord for 50 standard years prior to 22 ABY. While the Warlord was unpopular and reviled by much of the general population, he remained in power due to the tribal conflicts with the Eickarie people and the minute support of local collaborators. Eventually, the United Tribes of Kariek was formed during the United Tribes Agreement to oppose the Warlord. The United Tribes was covertly supported by the Empire of the Hand, which helped overthrow the Warlord during the Battle of Kariek. With the Warlord defeated, the Eickaries planned to join the Empire of the Hand.

name: Eirrauc
summary: Eirraucs were a sentient species from Eirrauus. They were easily recognizable from their six limbs and long, four-eyed faces. Eirraucs moved with a "leaping run," using their rear and middle pairs of limbs to swiftly travel the plains of their homeworld. Their middle limbs could also be used as arms, supplementing their upper limbs. Eirraucs were peaceful omnivores, feeding on grasses, fruits, and carrion. The Eirraucs were ill-prepared when the Galactic Empire arrived to conquer their homeworld. Unable to resist, they were subjugated and enslaved. Daushoroc, Tamoss, and Puroth all belonged to this species.

name: Ekkhound
summary: Ekkhounds were a type of hound. At some point during his time with the pirate Tanana Keem's crew, the pirate Coromont Vizzle was bitten by one of the hounds and the feral creature's bite injured his backside. Tanana's child—the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem—helped stitch Vizzle up after the incident despite their aversion to the messy situation. While raiding the research vessel Innovator in 229 BBY, Zyle told their Jedi colleagues—the Scarlet Skulls crew—about Vizzle's encounter with an ekkhound while trying to distract the group from their injuries and perilous situation.

name: Eklaad
summary: The Eklaad were quadrupedal vegetarian sapients indigenous to Sirpar. They were peaceful and primitive, not having advanced technology.

name: Elder viper
summary: The elder viper was a type of viper. It was larger and significantly less deadly than its cousin, the lesser leaf viper, which was native to the location Baran-Bai. In 134 BBY, during the dueling tournament of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual on the planet Siline, Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon's opponent commented on her small size. In response, Lon compared herself to a lesser leaf viper, noting that although it was smaller than an elder viper, it was also deadlier.

name: Elders
summary: The Elders were a reptilian humanoid species that inhabited ancient Naboo. Little was known about them other than their history of conflict with the Gungans and the monuments they left behind. Archaeologists were unsure whether the Elders' giant statues were representations of themselves or massive icons devoted to their deities. By the time of the Invasion of Naboo, the Elders were long gone. Several Gungan and Naboo chroniclers surmised that the Elders failed to live in harmony with the planet's delicate balance and were consumed by their own greed. One of their monuments, located north of Lianorm Swamp, became a sacred gathering place for the Gungans. The Elders also left behind a sanctuary on the Naboo moon of Rori.

name: Elephoth
summary: An elephoth was a massive, quadrupedal creature with a pair of tusks, green and thick hide, small red eyes, and two greenish trunks, covered with moss and vines. The All Terrain Armored Transports used by the Galactic Empire were described by some to bear a resemblance to steel elephoths on stilts, with laser cannons instead of tusks. The legs of an adult elephoth were said to be as thick as the trunk of a hornbeam. During his training on Dagobah, Jedi apprentice Luke Skywalker, his mentor Yoda, and the astromech droid R2-D2 encountered a mother elephoth who attacked them to protect her child.
height: As tall as a small tree

name: Elespad
summary: The Elespads were a pachydermoid, sentient species. They had brown or orange skin color, two large and floppy ears, a trunk and a pair of tusks. Luke Skywalker, a young Tatooinian farmer, encountered several hostile Elespads while looking for his droid R2-D2, who had been stolen by a changeling named Sasori Vader.

name: Elfish humanoid
summary: These elvish humanoids were a sentient species that lived on a small planetoid. They were ruled by a king until he was murdered during the invasion by the Yahk-Tosh warlord Lord Gar-Oth. The king's daughter, Princess Lourdes, managed to kill the invader with the help of Jedi Knight Yoshi Raph-Elan.

name: Elia-An
summary: The Elia-An were a sentient species native to the planet Oanne. They had a symbiotic gestation with the planet's nativity trees; those who wished to be parents connected with a Grandfather tree in order to find their seed-heart and pair with a younger tree. A Ho'Din scientist who had studied the Elia-An described their relationship with the trees as seeds to be cross-pollinated, with communities drifting to new trees. The Elia-An possessed an extra set of arms with seven-fingered forehands that they used to hook into their nativity trees. During the High Republic Era, the Elia-An made a trade deal with the Galactic Republic in return for study into their symbiotic gestation in the hope of determining an arrangement to allow them to travel offworld.

name: Elix
summary: The elix were rare predatory birds that hunted in flocks. During the Imperial era, their homeworld was threatened by a supernova explosion. In order to preserve the species, a population was established on the Imperial Species Preservation Zone planet of Dar'Or. There, the elix were even deadlier predators, as their new homeworld had much lower gravity than their old world did. The elix preyed on the native sentients, the Ri'Dars. Elix also attracted smugglers to Dar'Or, since their meat was prized by gourmets.

name: Ellam's species
summary: This four-armed alien race were blue-skinned humanoids with large heads and their V-shaped mouths gave them the appearance of a perpetual smile. Their homeworld's gravity was much less than standard, so they were confined to anti-grav chairs. Ellam was a member of this species.

name: Elnacon
summary: Elnacons were a large peaceful sentient species that hailed from Nacon, a world that had an ammonia-rich atmosphere. When on other worlds, they had to wear special breathing apparatus. They had noseless faces and four-fingered hands. They were often mistaken as thugs because of their alarming height and strength, but were actually a very peaceful, family-oriented species. Dava Cassamam, a deep cloud-miner on gas giant planets, was a keen sabacc player.

name: Eloag
summary: Eloags were a type of white bird native to Chad, eaten by cy'een.

name: Elom
summary: The Elom were a mysterious sentient species that were native to Elom who lived in frozen grottos. They were short and stocky, and covered in thick, oily fur. As a result of living in darkness, Eloms had exceptional eyesight, but found natural or bright lights intolerable. They had two tusks covering the opening of their mouth and small, black eyes located on the far ends of their wide faces. Though as a species that rarely ventured outside their caves, one Elom did make a name for himself offworld. Tanus Spijek was a spy for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Most, though not all, members of this species were sympathetic to the Rebel Alliance.

name: Elomin
summary: Elomin were humanoids from the planet Elom with tapered ears, a crown of horns around their head, and tusks on their cheekbones.
distinctions: Crown of horns, tusks on cheekbones

name: Emente
summary: Ementes were a sentient species with six eyes. In 10 BBY, an Emente managed speeder rentals at a busy spaceport on the outskirts of Witzer, the second largest urban area on the planet Sern Prime. When the criminals Jaylen Vrax and ND-5 arrived at the spaceport, she approved their rental, although four of her eyes lingered on ND-5 longer then Vrax. In response, ND-5 informed her that some visible damage to his chestplate was not a risk to anyone, and she offered a weak smile in return. After she explained the terms of the rental contract to Vrax, she carried out a retinal scan on him with a datapad and nodded when it was complete.

name: Emerald kofta-grouse
summary: Emerald kofta-grouses were a type of bird that partially shared their name with kofta-buns, a kind of bread. While on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 4 ABY, the bounty hunter Jas Emari watched the Imperial Advisor Yupe Tashu exit a shuttle, mentally considering that his hat looked silly, as if someone had killed an emerald kofta-grouse and placed it on his head.

name: Emerald shark
summary: The emerald shark was a huge species of shark. Multiple emerald sharks were part of the rainbow-colored school of fish that dwelt within a central column of water in an aquarium located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dubrillion in 25 ABY.

name: Em'liy
summary: Em'liy were a sentient species. One Em'liy, Mikilanie, lived on Jedha during the High Republic Era.

name: Emmerian
summary: Emmerians were a sentient species from the Emmer system. During the High Republic Era, one member of the Nihil was an Emmerian Cloud who was part of Pan Eyta's Tempest.

name: Enami
summary: The Enami were a species of furry humanoids native to the planet Ena. Their fur could range in shades of brown with speckles of color which could lose its hue or turn white with old age. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt. Sometime around 229 BBY, Jedi Master Keeve Trennis arrived on the planet with Republic forces to aid in the liberation of the Enami.

name: Energy spider
summary: Energy spiders or spice spiders were arachnids that inhabited the Spice Mines of Kessel. They lived in complete darkness inside the mine's caves spinning webs made of glitterstim, a rare kind of spice. The spiders would shoot webbing from their mouths to capture prey, impale them and then quickly suck the life energy from them. The spiders were known to feed on bogeys, as they were sources of pure energy that caused the glitterstim to react and produce light, alerting the spiders to their presence. The spiders also disliked bright light, since they lived in pitch black caves. Energy spiders were, however, drawn to the light produced by the glitterstim-bogey interaction, and there are even cases of mistaking other lighting sources for this interaction. They were one of the many threats faced by the spice miners, especially those who wandered too deep into the caves where the spiders lived. Often, the administrators and superiors on Kessel would send disruptive prisoners to work in these deep tunnels, ensuring an often permanent solution to a prisoner problem. As energy spiders feed on energy, blaster bolts are ineffective against them and are merely absorbed. Curiously, ion weapons, since they affect energy and its distribution, are highly effective (but not lethal) against them. A variant sub-species of energy spider was discovered by Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo while investigating a series of ground quakes on behalf of Lando Calrissian, owner of the spice mining operation. The newly discovered subspecies had a reddish hue and lacked the hooks and spines that are present on the arms of typical spiders. These "red spiders" were found to be herbivorous, feeding on the giant fungi found in the lower reaches of Kessel's spice mines. These red spiders had a poisonous effect on baseline energy spiders, allowing the two to coexist. Genetically, the two different types could even mate, though no documentation of the act nor results existed. When fed ryll, the energy spiders would produce glitteryll and grow to large sizes. A number of the creatures were smuggled onto Ryloth, which proved to be one of the few other worlds capable of supporting them. A few made their way to Coruscant for the Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition following the establishment of the New Republic in its arthropod exhibit, along with toxin/adrenaline-producing orbalisks and Death Seed-producing drochs.

name: Energy Vampire
summary: Energy Vampires were a humanoid sentient species, who drained the life forces of others by way of biting their enemies in order to feed. They had retractable serrated claws, elongated teeth, accelerated senses, and enhanced strength and speed. Their skin ranged from being pale white to varying shades of purple. They were able to drain beings of energy to feed as well as turning these beings into mindless zombies; when wounded, they could drain a being of energy to heal their wounds. However, they could still die from too much damage at once or from not healing their wounds fast enough. In rare cases, giving that the vampire had enough control, they could reverse the effect of feeding, and heal others by biting them, though doing so would severely weaken the vampire.

name: Ensel
summary: The Ensel were a sentient species from the world of Enselon. Jedi Alta Ranga was an Ensel.

name: Enso
summary: The Enso were a sentient species from the Ensolica system. Around 230 BBY, the defense minister of the planet Eiram was an Enso woman.

name: Entymal
summary: Entymals were sentient insectoids from Endex, an Outer Rim world of many canyons. They had a hardened exoskeleton, with chitinous membranes that enabled them to glide. The species functioned as a hive, with one fertile queen, numerous infertile females, and rare male drones. The Entymal had reputations as skilled pilots, but were enslaved by the Galactic Empire due to their strength. That slavery continued under the auspices of the Pentastar Alignment.

name: Enu
summary: Enu were Near-Humans from Deylerax.

name: Enyak
summary: Enyaks were native to the planet Ukio and were hunted by other carnivores for their food.

name: Enzeen
summary: Enzeen were rarely-encountered blue-skinned humanoids who inhabited D'vouran, though they were not indigenous to the planet. They had needle-like spikes in place of hair on their heads, and were slightly chubby in form. A colony of Enzeen was relocated to D'vouran by Borborygmus Gog as part of Project Starscream. They formed a symbiotic relationship with Gog's bioengineered world. The Enzeen attracted tourists to the planet and brought them into the forests, where the planet would devour them. In return, the planet provided sustenance, which the Enzeen sucked from its crust with their long tube-like tongues. All Enzeen on D'vouran wore small pendants that projected force fields, preventing the planet from consuming them. Enzeen were believed to hail from an unknown world, although some believed that the Enzeen were themselves a bioengineered race.
skinColor: Pale pink to blue to black

name: Eodon
summary: Eodons were a species of sentient pachydermoids found on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were large beings with blue-gray skin and prehensile trunks, but—at least to most other inhabitants of Endor—they were most noted for their long, ornate tusks. The Ewoks of Bright Tree Village, for example, believed that Eodon tusks held magical powers and great beauty. That meant that Eodons had to put up with others desiring their tusks, a fact that one member of the species discovered sometime before 3 ABY. That Eodon's tusks ended up in the possession of a merchant named Mooth, who put them up for sale in his trading post. The Eodon eventually traveled to Mooth's post to demand the tusks be returned, and a group of four young Ewoks, who had recently won them from the trader, dutifully complied.

name: Eollu
summary: The Eollu was a creature native to Dathomir and one of the many animals into which a Nightsister could transform using the Talisman of Transformation.

name: Eopie
summary: Eopies were quadruped mammalian herbivores native to the planet Tatooine. These tough creatures were adapted to their homeworld's endless deserts, and as a result were domesticated by the planet's inhabitants. They often worked as transports or beast of burden, though they were often bad-tempered and stubborn, and could break wind if their load was too heavy.
subspecies: Horned eopie{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-4-episode-guide|text="Can't Say I Remember No At Attin" Episode Guide &

name: Epfer-hen
summary: Epfer-hens were a type of chicken that could be eaten as food. During the High Republic Era, the Nihil I'nah's cruiser kept roasted epfer-hen available in the vessel's galley. While on the cruiser in 229 BBY, the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem visited the galley and began taking food, staring unblinkingly at the Nihil nearby as they shoved half a roasted epfer-hen in their clothing. Afterward, Keem fled with the provisions in an escape shuttle to travel to the Outer Rim planet Valo.

name: Epicanthix
summary: The Epicanthix were a warrior species of Near-Humans native to the Outer Rim world of Panatha, within the Pacanth Reach.
distinctions: Powerful mental shielding against The Force

name: Epsis
summary: Epsis was a predatory bird from Uba III. The epsis was a migratory species, moving alone or in mated pairs and never staying in one place for long. The epsis became extinct when the planet was destroyed.

name: Equani
summary: Equani were a sentient equinoid species native to Equanus in the Nharl system. They were tall bipeds who were covered in fur. All Equani possessed empathic abilities.

name: Ergesh
summary: The Ergesh were an indigenous sentient species from the planet Ergeshui.

name: Eriaduan rat
summary: Eriaduan rats were six-legged vermin indigenous to Eriadu, but also found on Koros Major. The rat was one of the few native species to escape extinction during Eriadu's industrialization, outliving most of the species that preyed upon it. The rats gave birth in huge litters, and with no predators to keep them in check, they multiplied at a vastly accelerated rate as Eriadu became more urbanized and polluted. They were vicious scavengers. Outside their territory, they were solitary and timid. Inside their territory, they were known to attack in packs of dozens or hundreds, regardless of the size of the prey. The rat's bite was not naturally toxic, but because of the environment in which they lived, it could carry numerous poisons and could be lethal, especially to Mon Calamari, who had a strong susceptibility to the toxins. An Eriaduan rat was considered slightly larger than a whisperkit.

name: Er'Kit
summary: The Er'Kit were a species of humanoids with large, elongated craniums and long, skinny legs. One Er'Kit was Ody Mandrell, a famous podracer who took part in the Boonta Eve Classic.

name: Erkush
summary: Erkush was a creature native to the Wild Space planet Kalee, as are members of the Kaleesh species. Kaleesh warriors hunt the Erkush for more than simply meat and generally kill to demonstrate their bravery, making its pelt for clothing and its skulls and bones for fearsome masks. They also valued their prey and wouldn't allow anyone near them. The Ithorian collector named Dok-Ondar owns an erkush-carved mask that had originally been worn by the late General Grievous, which was displayed in his Batuuan store, Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities, in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

name: Ermi
summary: The Ermi were a sentient species. According to the play Evocar, written by the Hutt playwright Direus'pei around 671 BBY, the Ermi were driven to extinction by the Tionese warlord Xim. When Xim was captured and placed on trial by the Hutts, he justified the extinction of the Ermi on the basis that they were slavers. Xim's conquests occurred approximately between 25,130 and 25,100 BBY.

name: Errop
summary: Errops were a domesticated species native to the planet Weik in Wild Space. They were used as draft beasts, and were notable for being furry and walking with a shuffling gait.

name: Erselu
summary: The Erselu were a species of wild and fierce predators native to the steepara forests of the planet Dressel, where they posed a constant threat to the Dressellese sentient species. They were similar in some way to the Wookiee species of the planet Kashyyyk.

name: Er'stacian
summary: Er'stacians were a sentient species of humanoids with purple skin and three clawed fingers per hand. They lived on Er'stacia, a planet in Wild Space, where they divided themselves into clans based upon lineages traced back to the tidal pools of their ancestors. The clans revered a single forebear known as the Venerable One, who was represented as a massive stone known as the Megalith. Despite such universal veneration for the object, each clan believed that it should have sole possession of the statue. The situation resulted in near-perpetual clan wars during which the Er'stacians wielded a mixture of low- and high-tech weaponry, such as swords, spears, and walkers. At some point between 22 and 19 BBY, one such Er'stacian clan war had grown so out of hand that, when word of it reached the Jedi Council on Coruscant, the Jedi feared it might result in genocide. The council sent Jedi Master Mace Windu to negotiate a peace settlement, but when the Jedi reached Er'stacia, he found that no peace was possible as long as the clans clung to the belief that only one of them could possess the Megalith. Windu was only able to halt the war by carving up the Megalith into thousands of pieces, forcing the Er'stacians to either work together to repair it or to divvy up the rubble.

name: Ertraxi
summary: The Ertraxi were a peaceful humanoid species with multiple eyes from the Wild Space planet Ertrax.
