At some point, a Galactic Republic starship crash-landed on the planet, and the Ertraxi eventually repaired the vessel and flew it offworld in order to contact other species. They subsequently made first contact with a group of explorers, who informed the wider galactic community of the discovery of the species and their homeworld, prompting traders, slavers, and would-be conquerors to attempt to exploit Ertrax.

name: Esh-kha
summary: The Esh-kha were an ancient alien species that inhabited the galaxy before being imprisoned by the Rakata on the planet Belsavis thousands of years before the Cold War.

name: Eskrat
summary: Eskrats were a species of rat that ran around a lot. The demolitions expert Skelly compared the pilot Kanan Jarrus and the miners of the Moonglow Polychemical company to eskrats after Jarrus showed no interest in hearing about a potential mining hazard.

name: Esoomian
summary: Esoomians were a sentient species from the Esooma system in the Outer Rim Territories.

name: Espirion
summary: The Espirions were a sentient species of humanoids that hailed from the planet of the same name. Although very similar to humans, they had red skin, dark hair, and yellow eyes with green sclerae. Although the Espirions had massive military forces, they were hospitable to strangers, so much so that they created micro-ecologies on their homeworld in order to support very different lifeforms. Long before the Galactic Civil War, a number of Espirions interbred with Alderaanians, a race of humans from Alderaan, giving rise to a hybrid population known as the Alder-Espirions.

name: Esral'sa'Nikto
summary: Esral'sa'Nikto, more commonly referred to as the Mountain Nikto, were a sentient subspecies of the Nikto. Oplock, who was a mechanic and friend of Marcus Speedstar, was an Esral'sa'Nikto.

name: Esseles bird
summary: An avian species with white feathers and a blue beak could be found wild on the planet Esseles. The species possessed long, thin tails and had blue skin around their yellow eyes. The species also had a multicolored crest above their beak. In the year 19 BBY, flocks of the species of birds could be found flying in the mountainous regions near Esseles' capital city of Calamar, as well as near the family villa of the wealthy Human Dezono Qua.

name: Ethersquid
summary: The ethersquid was a type of squid that was one of the things for which Gyndine, a planet of the Expansion Region's Circarpous sector with forests and lakes on its surface, was known for. It was a deadly creature that could endanger starships over Gyndine, and it had suckers that left marks comparable to those left on the body of the Human bounty hunter Boba Fett after he had emerged from the stomach of a sarlacc arthropod on the Outer Rim Territories planet Tatooine. In the aftermath of the Battle of Gyndine, an engagement fought as part of the invasion of the galaxy by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong species in 25 ABY, a team of Yuuzhan Vong aboard a ship in orbit over Gyndine were assisting with pacification efforts there. A Yorik-vec assault cruiser of Domain Yaght, a rival of the team's own Domain, led a group of ethersquids to attack the other ship, which eventually crashed on Gyndine.

name: Ethrani ourobouros
summary: An Ethrani ourobouros was a creature from the Ethrani system of the Valahari sector, a part of the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. Ethrani ourobouroi were known for devouring their own tails. During a battle near the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY, the leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems Dooku—secretly apprentice to the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious—mentally compared his master's plan to convert Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker to their side by killing his mentor Obi-Wan Kenobi to an Ethrani ourobouros consuming its own tail.

name: Etobi
summary: The etobi were a type of non-sentient quadrupedal creature native to the desert planet Pasaana, where they were used as mounts. The sentient Aki-Aki species there created toys and decorations in the creatures' likeness, which included four eyes, a pair of mandible pincers, and a long neck. The creatures were also used as mounts and pack animals on the desert planet Tatooine, where the Jedi Rey Skywalker encountered an elder with a saddled etobi near the Lars homestead in 35 ABY.

name: Etti
summary: The Etti were a sentient species of near-Humans who were originally native to the Galactic Core.

name: Euceron
summary: The Eucerons were a species native to the planet Euceron. They were tall humanoids with large, domed heads and delicate limbs. The Eucerons dressed in neutral colors, as if to offset the colorful building structures that filled their cities. Their government, the Ruling Power, hosted the Galactic Games on their world in 26 BBY.

name: Euphaus Biro's species
summary: A sentient species of insectoids lived in the galaxy, on worlds such as Ferrix. One member was Euphaus Biro, who lived during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

name: Evarrian
summary: An evarrian was a large insectoid predator native to the swamps of Jagomir.
skinColor: Deep purple with streaks of blue

name: Evarrian hunter
summary: Evarrian hunters were one of the races of the non-sentient Evarrian species. They grew to 4 meters and had hundreds of legs.
skinColor: Deep purple with streaks of blue

name: Evarrian Queen
summary: The Evarrian Queen was a type of Evarrian native to Jagomir. Queens could only lay 4-6 eggs per year, and the eggs hatch between 2 and 3 months. The queen is protected by 4 Evarrian hunters at the nest, and the evarrians want to protect their nest when the Ardan resistance arrives on Jagomir.
distinctions: Lays 6-4 eggs of evarrians per year

name: Evereni
summary: The Evereni were a sentient humanoid nomadic species, distinguished by their slate-gray skin and pitch-black eyes. They once hailed from the planet Everon before the Great Storm ravaged their homeworld, which led to centuries of wars between the Evereni people and ultimately forced the survivors to flee into the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, an Evereni male named Marchion Ro led a group of nihilistic marauders called the Nihil and posed a significant threat to the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order.

name: Evocii
summary: The Evocii were a primitive humanoid race from Evocar, which later became the capital Hutt world Nal Hutta.
distinctions: Preferred diet of dried fruits and boiled vegetables

name: Ewok
summary: Ewoks were a diminutive primitive species of furry bipeds native to the forest moon of Endor. They were most notable for helping the Rebel Alliance defeat the forces of the Galactic Empire at the Battle of Endor, allowing the shield generator there to be destroyed, and in turn, the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station. Ewoks were individuals that stood about one meter tall. They used spears, slings, and knives as weapons; they also used hang gliders as vehicles. Although skilled in forest survival and the construction of primitive technology, the Ewoks had yet to progress past stone-level technology when discovered by the Empire. They were quick learners, however, when exposed to advanced technology with simple mechanical processes and concepts.

name: Excargan
summary: Excargans were a Near-Human sentient species native to Excarga. During childhood, they were genderless; at around thirteen years old, their bodies would change and their gender would be determined. Many inhabitants of their planet worked for ore-processing corporations. They were attacked by the Separatists during the Clone Wars, which led to Republic intervention, and they sold materials to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Garr, whose mother and father were presumed dead after a Separatist attack, befriended fellow orphan Boba Fett in 22 BBY after Boba was rescued during the Conquest of Raxus Prime.

name: Exoboar
summary: The Exoboar was a vicious burrowing creature native to the planet Makeb.

name: Exodeenian
summary: The Exodeenians were a species of sentient beings native to the planet Exodeen. They had six arms and six legs, as well as six sets of teeth. They joined the Galactic Republic during the Expansion Era, circa 22,000 BBY. Their world's star system fell to the Mandalorians during the Mandalorian Wars and was under the control of the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War. Rejoining the Republic following these conflicts, the Exodeenians later joined its successor, the Galactic Empire. Although some Exodeenians served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Exodeen itself was an Imperial fortress world by 6 ABY. Shortly after, in 7 ABY, Exodeen joined the New Republic, represented in the Senate by Exodeenian M'yet Luure and two others. Luure successfully advocated to allow former Imperial functionaries to serve in the Senate. The Exodeenian R'yet Coome benefited from this and became the junior senator from Exodeen. As part of a political faction composed of former Imperials, Coome almost arranged a vote of no confidence in President Leia Organa Solo following the detonation of bombs in the Senate chamber. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Exodeenian homeworld fell to the extra-galactic invaders.
distinctions: Six arms, six legs, six sets of teeth

name: Exogorth
summary: Exogorths, also known as space slugs, were members of a silicon-based sentient species that resided in the hollows of asteroids, who prided themselves on maintaining a pleasant ecosystem within their bodies. At least one such being, named Sy-O, lived in the Hoth asteroid belt.

name: Extinct bird species
summary: An extinct bird species once inhabited the Bothan colony world of Kothlis, feeding on the native gankto tree. To thwart the birds, who nested in its upper regions, the tree began growing leaves only on its bottom branches, which led to the birds being caught and killed by predators.

name: Eye-snatcher
summary: Eye-snatchers were predatory red-feathered birds native to the Ottega system. Their nests were raided for their edible eggs, which resembled eyeballs. Attempting to rescue their stolen eggs, the birds would often mistake humanoid eyes for the pilfered eggs, and snatch up thieves' eyeballs by plucking them out with their talons. The bumbling Abyssin cyclops giant Gondry was one such unfortunate being. The Besadii Hutt crimelord Gardulla kept eye-snatchers in her luxurious if notorious pleasure garden, within her Tatooine palace near the Dune Sea.

name: Ezaraa
summary: The Ezaraa were a species of warmongering carnivorous sentients that were native to the the planet Ezaraa. They intended to overthrow the Galactic Empire, only to replace it with their own dominion and feed on the other species, which they deemed as lesser to them. Despite their wide reaching dreams of conquest, however, the Dominion was limited to a mere two continents on Ezaraa. To arm their revolution, the dominion sent Ezaraa to take advantage of opportunities such as the Auction of Rur.

name: Faa
summary: Faa, also known as faa fish or big-mouth faa, were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Naboo Abyss where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by the large colo claw fish and opee sea killers that dwelt there.

name: Fabool
summary: Fabool were balloon-like creatures that lived in the Dantarian savannas on Dantooine. Their main threat was being punctured by the thorns of the native blba tree. They were used by the Dantari to make fabool-hide pouches.

name: Facet spider
summary: The facet spider was a type of spider. It was served in a cantina on the planet Christophsis as a delicacy.

name: fae
summary: The fae were an ancient species. The myth "The Silent Circle" tells the story of how the trees, the fae and the beasts once lived in harmony on Batuu.

name: Fairfolk
summary: The Fairfolk were a very small race that resembled ethereal, floating Jawas. They were strong in the Force and a number of them working for Darth Vader on Dantooine attempted to sway an oblivious Luke Skywalker to the dark side by setting up a psychic link between Skywalker and Vader, who was stationed on board the Star Destroyer Conqueror. The arrival of Leia Organa freed Luke from the Fairfolk's trance.

name: Faiza's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Faiza was a member of this species.

name: Faksir's species
summary: The Nihil Faksir was a member of a sentient species with bright orange blood. The species was slightly more resilient to the poison that Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro used to kill Faksir, as he did not dissolve from the inside-out as Ro had expected. Their blood was also slightly acidic, as it had burned Ro when Faksir had spat some of his blood into the Eye's face.

name: Falleen
summary: Falleen were a repto-mammalian sentient species native to the planet of the same name. They were capable of projecting powerful pheromones. During the Clone Wars, the Falleen Ziton Moj replaced a cabal of Falleen nobles in leading the Black Sun criminal syndicate from their fortress on Mustafar.

name: Falumpaset
summary: The falumpaset was a herbivorous species of mammal found on the planets Naboo and Onderon. In the wild, the species lived in swamps, forests, and plains in family groups. They were domesticated by the Gungans and, along with other large and hardy animals such as fambaas, were used to transport heavy loads such as the shield generators used in the Battle of Naboo. Both the Gungans and the Naboo used falumpasets to pull carts. Falumpasets were great swimmers and their disproportionately long legs made them very maneuverable. Falumpasets shared their name with falumpaset cheese, an ingredient in the Batuuan dish mashed chokeroot.

name: Fambaa
summary: Fambaas were quadruped amphibians with tough hides that could be found on the planets Naboo and Onderon. They had a tail made out of cartilage, strong joints in pillar-like limbs to handle heavy loads and broad feet with wide toes to increase their stability and stop them sinking into marshes. Biologists surmised that both the fambaas and the falumpasets of Onderon were originally brought there by Naboo merchants, but there was little fossil evidence to back up that hypothesis.

name: Fanback
summary: [[File:Fanback_eggpic.jpg|thumb|left|A fanback egg]] The fanback was a cold-blooded amphibian from Naboo. Each fanback had a big dorsal spine along with a sensitive snout. Fanbacks were carnivores and had no problems eating the egg-eaters themselves. Soon after 32 BBY, the Gungans transported fanbacks and other animals to the moon of Ohma-D'un to try and establish an ecosystem. Most of the flora and fauna of Ohma-D'un, however, was destroyed by Separatists during the Battle of Ohma-D'un.

name: Fanbug
summary: Fanbugs were a type of flying bug that could be found on the moon of the Outer Rim planet Arli. When the San Tekka clan member Jordanna Sparkburn lived on the moon years before 228 BBY, she and her brother Harth Sparkburn attended a school in the city Birage. During their lunch breaks, the fanbugs used their wings to flutter along with the siblings. When she returned to the moon in 228 BBY, Jordanna mentally recalled when the fanbugs had drifted with her and Harth.

name: Fang-rat
summary: Fang-rats were creatures that were found in Nar Shaddaa's Darklands, where they were hunted by the district's residents.

name: Fanged tiglon
summary: The fanged tiglon was a species of feline creature.

name: Fanned rawl
summary: Fanned rawls, also known simply as rawls, were reptilian snakes from the Mid Rim world of Naboo.
skinColor: Various; shades included gray, blue, green, orange and red

name: Fantabu
summary: Fantabu were a species which produced fur and wool. The devotees of the Church of the Force living in Tuanul on the planet Jakku used the hair of fantabu in their clothing, with Lor San Tekka wearing a home-spun fantabu wool coat and Dasha Promenti wearing a vest fringed with fantabu-fur.

name: Fantanine
summary: The Fantanines were a sentient species with insectoid features. They had long lifespans and a small population, which led them to strongly avoid conflict within their species. The Ben Diffle Fantanines were a group of Fantanines who operated a mining colony.

name: Farakai
summary: The Farakai were a large anthropoid sentient species from the Outer Rim. They possessing a unique bonding ability in which two individuals would be joined with a bridge of bone and muscle. The Farakai were brutal and powerful and a notoriously secretive species that had clandestine rituals of war and mating. The Farakai Chu bonded with the Rodian Lok to become Chulok, who would become a gangster operating on the planet Metagos.

name: Farang
summary: The sentient Farangs evolved on the planet Ab'Bshingh alongside another intelligent species, the Waroot. The two species were at war for centuries, resulting in the development of unique tactics and customs. Imperial strategist Crat Dakerno studied these customs and based his holo boardgame B'shingh on them.

name: Farghul
summary: The Farghul were felinoid sapients indigenous to Farrfin. They had claws, incredible strength and speed, and were covered with tawny fur and possessed prehensile tails. [[File:Farghul_UAA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Farghul male.]] The species had a reputation for being both fearsome fighters as well as cunning thieves. They became quite fearful of the Jedi Knights after the destruction of a smuggling base on their homeworld during the times of the Galactic Republic. The Farghul were also generally distrustful of politicians and were considered slightly xenophobic. Despite this, they were known to friends as mischievous and playful beings who loved telling bad jokes. The Farghul's reputation for being cheaters, con artists, and thieves originated from their tendency to rig games, but if caught, a Farghul would often return their illicit winnings. However, this did not stop them from gaining their bad reputation in the galaxy. Farghul were extremely self-conscious about their appearance, and often wore elaborate clothes or jewelry.

name: Farlek
summary: The Farlek was a species of four-legged, predatory creature. They stood at a height of about 2 meters and were 4 meters in length, and they were covered in green, scaly plates. They also had wide, armored heads and long, sticky-tipped tongues, which they used to catch their prey. Farleks were fairly common on a number of worlds, but albino Farleks were considered to be rare, and the renowned Equat epic-poem Hunting Telik the White told the story of a quest to hunt one such elusive creature. During the Galactic Civil War, the wealthy, Torina-based businessman Pelleo Thog purchased an albino Farlek from the Ithorian pet shop owner Eeksa, and Eeksa hired a group of Rebel Alliance agents to transport the creature to Thog's estate.

name: Farlus hawk
summary: Farlus hawks were carnivorous hawks native to Alsakan.

name: Farn Klin's species
summary: This species had light pink skin. At least two juvenile members of this species, including youngling Farn Klin, were present in the Jedi Temple on the galactic capital Coruscant around 21 BBY for a hologram transmission from General Grievous of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

name: Farrow bird
summary: The Farrow bird was indigenous to Aruza. A flying predator, the avian would use its unique bioluminescent chest to blind or stun small airborne mammals long enough to make an easy catch over the planet's valleys.

name: Faruun
summary: The Faruun were an extra-galactic sentient species of ship-builders from Firefist, a satellite galaxy of the galaxy.

name: Fatfish
summary: A Fatfish was a type of fish. In 32 BBY, a Gungan stole a spatula from another Gungan on the planet Naboo who used it to cook fried fatfish.

name: Fathier
summary: Fathiers were a species of quadrupeds that resided in the galaxy. They were often used as mounts, and wealthy inhabitants of Kergans and Cantonica rode them in competition.

name: Faust
summary: Faust were an alien species of tall humanoids with pale blue skin, a double set of eyelids, and light-colored eyes. Their homeworld was the planet Adana. One notable member of this species was the scientist Doctor Nuvo Vindi, who recreated Blue Shadow Virus for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. During the time of the Galactic Empire, at least one Faust individual was arrested on Lothal as part of an Imperial crackdown following the Spectres' attack on the Empire Day celebrations.
distinctions: Narrow faces and two sets of eyelids

name: Faybo
summary: Faybos were rodent-like scavenger creatures of Tatooine found near Tusken Raider camps. They had large ears, long fangs and striped coat.

name: Feathered lizard
summary: The feathered lizards inhabited the forests of the planet Pzob. They would emerge to beg for food from the sentient population. At some point, a breeding population was introduced to Tatooine, and they were well-established by 4 ABY.

name: Feathered slice hound
summary: The feathered slice hound was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of Corellian slice hound.

name: Febrini sand-prestor
summary: The Febrini sand-prestor was a type of creature that originated in the Febrini system of the Inner Rim's Hapes Cluster. At some point by 3 ABY, the 434-FPC Personal Chef Droid 434-FPC prepared a meal for several people. Following the initial course consisting of caramaxoian salad with Dihneral herb-and-ale dressing, the droid planned to serve a rack of toasted Febrini sand-prestors paired with gangini sauce that the droid characterized as "subtle."

name: Fecklen
summary: Fecklen were stumpy, squat, horned, gracile-necked creatures that lived in herds on their homeworld Chandrila. They were the primary ranching animal on the planet and were raised for their meat and milk. Though quite peaceful, they were known to block traffic and were capable of producing a loud booming noise that served to frighten off predators and locate other members of their herd. Fecklens roamed widely and grazed on balmgrass. In 26 ABY, while New Republic general Wedge Antilles met with the Jedi Kyp Durron and Jaina Solo, a herd of fecklen near the shore of Chandrila's Silver Sea began to angrily make booming and whirring noises at a nearby group of squalls, members of a small quadrupedal species also native to Chandrila.

name: Feek
summary: Feeks were a type of animal that inhabited the frozen plains of the planet Dowut, where they lived in subterranean dens that they used for hibernation. The omnivorous herd animals that would eventually evolve into the sentient Dowutin species used their spiked digits and chin tusks to dig for hibernating feeks beneath the plains of their shared homeworld.

name: Feeorin
summary: Feeorins were a sentient species with thick tendrils hanging from the back of their heads. During the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign, a Feeorin named Warjak performed as a gladiator, holding the title of champion of the Outer Rim Carve-up. Zira was a female pirate who was also a member of this species.

name: Fefze
summary: The Fefze were an insectoid species who came from the planet Fef. While a single Fefze was non-sentient, swarms of Fefze collectively formed a sentient intelligence.

name: Fefze beetle
summary: The fefze beetle were originally a swarm of fefze who were contracted to work on the planet Duro. Fefze were large, beetle-like insects that shared a single group mind; however, due to Duro's pollution, the swarm began to mutate, losing their sentience and becoming aggressive predators. Due to the fact that all native life on the planet was killed off from the pollution, fefze beetles became the only fauna on Duro. Fefze were also able to spit digestive acids at short range. Nuri the Clawdite, shapeshifted into a fefze beetle in order to get away and reveal Boba Fett's presence to Wat Tambor. Fett, however, managed to paralyze him with xabar fungus. A number of the beetles lived in the mountains of Kessel. Trioculus hunted them during his time there, using it to release his anger. Some fefze beetles devoured a batch of naotebe winglings delivered by Nom Anor, helping clear the infested Settlement 32.

name: Felacatian
summary: Felacatians were a species of polymorphic felines native to the planet Felacat.

name: Feleen Bantillian's species
summary: This sentient species were tall, wide-bodied beings with triangular heads. Feleen Bantillian, Gavron Sil, and Drex were members of this species.

name: Felin
summary: The Felin were a sentient species originating from the planet Heleth 4. Greel Ptavvishh was known as the only great Felin philosopher and was credited with saving the Felins from extinction by reorganizing the government to prevent brutal wars between clans.

name: Felinian
summary: The Felinians were a species of sentient felinoids originating from the Felin system. During the Galactic Civil War, the Felinians had developed technology considered primitive in the galaxy at large, but a group of them residing in jungles of the planet Zoma V desired advanced weapons such as blasters, commodities for which they traded precious stones. The Saurian crime lord Sithless Leethe attempted to smuggle Imperial weapons to the Felinians under the oversight of his associate, a Saurian named Slopper. Nevertheless, the couriers he had chosen to deliver the cargo—spacers to whom he had sold a light freighter on condition of delivery of the unopened crates to the Felinians—chose to deliver the weapons to the Rebel Alliance instead.

name: Felinx
summary: Felinx were a furry, cat-like species often kept as pets. Over the years, they had been heavily inbred, causing them to have minimal brain mass. They sometimes required bio-stimulation circuit implants to stop them from crashing into walls or chewing off their own fur. Despite this, they were often considered ideal pets, as they required little more than food, water, warmth, and affection. This made them easy to care for. The expression "a game of felinx-and-rodus" suggested that rodus were a common prey for felinxes. In the years before the Clone Wars, droid engineer Hurlo Holowan of Kuat City kept a huge, genetically altered felinx to guard her laboratory in the House of Holowan. Bounty hunter Zam Wesell had to defend herself against the pouncing monster with stun shots from her blaster pistol to the animal's jaw and hind leg, causing it to scramble back into its cage. Kuat possessed a felinx.

name: Felnox
summary: A felnox was a type of creature that could be found in alleyways in the Holy City on the moon Jedha. In 382 BBY, the Evereni Path of the Open Hand member Yana Ro encountered a family of creepmice scurrying away from a mangy felnox in an alleyway in the Holy City.

name: Felshi
summary: The Felshi were a sentient species found within the galaxy. They were defined by their bulky builds and large limbs, with blue skin and small eyes. The one-armed boxer Kabb Uppercut was a member of this species.

name: Felucia bird
summary: An avian native to the planet of Felucia, this creature had a bulbous body and translucent, pale skin. One of these avians took flight in front of Jedi Knight Aayla Secura during her reconnaissance en route to Niango. The flying creature caught Aayla Secura's eye, thus leaving her unable to defend herself when Commander Bly and his troops opened fire, cutting her down in accordance with Order 66. [[File:Gummy_felucian_bird.jpg|thumb|A Felucian bird which distracts Aayla before her death]]

name: Felucian
summary: Felucians were a sentient species native to the plains and grasslands of the planet Felucia. At the time of the Clone Wars, many Felucians, including Casiss Midagatis, were peaceful farmers, growing nysillin and other crops.

name: Felucian firefly
summary: Felucian fireflies were a species of firefly native to the planet Felucia. By 34 ABY, Dok-Ondar kept a terrarium with Felucian fireflies in his Den of Antiquities on the planet of Batuu.

name: Felucian flickerbird
summary: A Felucian flickerbird was a type of sensitive bird that shared its name with the planet Felucia. In 228 BBY, while aboard the Emissary-class megacruiser Third Horizon, Republic Defense Coalition Admiral Pevel Kronara reflected that while a commander needed to externally appear stone-faced and implacable, they internally needed to be as sensitive as a Felucian flickerbird and attuned to changes in battle conditions, tactical situations, and the emotions of their forces.

name: Felucian ripper
summary: The Felucian ripper, or Flying ripper was a dangerous creature native to the jungle world of Felucia. The ripper was a large predator that hunted in the jungle canopy, although it dwelt in shallow rivers and creeks. It had a wide body and large mouth filled with jagged, scissor-like teeth. It could hide in even the shallowest waters and could leap out of the water to attack, provided that its movement ended back underwater. When hunting, rippers would fly low over the canopy, circling their prey, before swooping down to snap at the prey's head. Galen Marek encountered several such creatures during his second visit to Felucia, when the balance of the Force on the planet had shifted to the dark side.

name: Felucian slug
summary: Felucian slugs were gastropods with a several hard spines on their back. They could grow up to two meters in length. They lived mostly in the Fungal caves. They had spines as opposed to a full shell and tended to inhabit darker areas as compared to the Felucian snails they were related to.

name: Felucian snail
summary: Felucian snails were gastropods with a hard shell on their back. They could grow up to two meters in length. They lived mostly in the fungal forests and caves. They were related to the Felucian slugs.

name: Fen slug
summary: Fen slugs were a type of slug known to the Chiss Ascendancy. In 19 BBY, while flying in one of the shuttles of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet heavy cruiser Springhawk during a mission in the Unknown Regions Rapacc system, the Chiss Mitth'ali'astov, core name "Thalias," compared the maneuverability of the shuttle to that of a fen slug.

name: Fenelar
summary: The Fenelar were a species native to the Outer Rim Territories world Fenel. Notable for their starshipwrights and technologists, the Fenelar designed warships such as the Kandosii-type dreadnaught, as well as the legendary Fenelar armor suits. At one point, the Mandalorian Crusaders began raiding Fenel and its natives, ultimately rendering the Fenelar extinct by the 6700s BBY. The Mandalorians subsequently adopted Fenelar technology for use in other military campaigns.

name: Fengla
summary: A fengla was a type of small, hairless vermin with high haunches, green eyes, and crooked incisors. In 4 ABY, the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus encountered a fengala in the subterranean catacombs under the city Myrra on the Outer Rim Territories planet Akiva. At first, Velus saw only the fengla's eyes, which glowed like crystals in the darkness. However, once the light of several illumi-droids accompanying Velus and his companions reached the creature, he realised what it was as it hissed and spit before scurrying away with its claws clicking.

name: Fenn Booda's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Fenn Booda was a member of this species.

name: Fenner's rock
summary: Fenner's Rock was a rock-like creature named after Rivoc Fenner, a xenobiologist. They crawled using two appendages to drag themselves on top of stones and areas which had moss and lichen, with which they ate using their cartilaginous teeth. Believed to be non-communicative creatures, they were found to be joining communities of other "rocks" to "sing". On most planets they inhabited, they were considered as vermin because of their voracious reproduction that threatened to block natural waterways and they helped spread semi-dangerous bacteria.

name: Feragriff
summary: Feragriffs were wild predators native to Batorine. They were ritually hunted by Blood Carvers during rite of passage ceremonies. As Blood Carvers moved to Coruscant, they brought with them the Feragriffs so as to preserve their customs.

name: Ferbil
summary: Ferbils were small furry creatures found on the planet Kegan. They were often domesticated. Ferbils made chirping sounds when they were nervous, and the creatures could eat seeds for sustenance.

name: Fere
summary: The Fere were a sentient species of humanoids native to the world of Feree. They were considered to be master shipbuilders of their time. The average Fere was a tall, ivory-skinned being with six fingers on each hand. Around 192 BBY, the entire species was wiped out by a planet-wide plague that struck their homeworld.

name: Ferin
summary: Ferins were small non-sentient creatures that could be found on the swampy planet of Ques. When he still lived there, Dec Hansen used to feed a female ferin that came round his house every day.

name: Fern bicker
summary: Fern bickers were bipedal simian creatures that lived on Kashyyyk. For the most part, the fern bickers were solitary creatures. They had gray skin, green hair and four teats. They also featured three long, sickle shaped claws on each hand and foot. Fern bickers were so similar to the Kashyyyk ro-roo that it may have been a different breed or close cousin.

name: Fern chick
summary: A fern chick was a type of bird that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. They could be kept in a coop. In 382 BBY, while on Dalna, Jedi Padawan Kevmo Zink helped elevate a fern chick coop so it could be repaired after a flood in the town Ferdan. Afterward, Zink mentally noted that he felt he should be spending more time with the Path of the Open Hand cult to carry out his mission—to find the location of the Rod of Seasons, a Force artifact that had been stolen from the Hynestian royal family by the Path—and that elevating a fern chick coop so it could be repaired was not necessarily helping him find the rod.

name: Ferrazid hound
summary: Ferrazid hounds were animals native to the planet Taris. They lived in the planet's jungles and swamps millennia ago, before it became an urban environment. Before Darth Malak's bombardment during the Jedi Civil War they were believed extinct, with only a few specimens preserved in zoos. When the Republic returned to the ruins of Taris, its explorers found out that the ferrazid hounds survived and became stronger. They usually kept their distance from the small settlements in Taris's ruins, but, due to their territorial behavior, they were a serious problem for explorers and cargos.

name: Ferro-worm
summary: Ferro-worms were sightless snakes that made their nests inside of buildings. These worms could be found on the planet Coruscant and were often preyed upon by spire falcons.

name: Ferroan
summary: Ferroans were pale-blue skinned humanoids with gold eyes. Most females had white hair but some had traditional black hair. They were from Ferro and had colonized the Inner Ferro systems. They were known for their independence, reclusive manner, and for not often leaving their homes. A Ferroan year was equal to 3 standard years. On Zonama Sekot, they celebrated Uniting Day. They were the colonists of Zonama Sekot and believed in the Potentium. When Luke Skywalker first met them he mistakenly called them Zonamans. The Ferroans of Zonama Sekot were also very attuned to the idea of a sentient planet, many having grown up very aware of the lifeforces around them. However, they weren't symbiotic to it, as the Yuuzhan Vong were presumed once to be.

name: Fever wasp
summary: Fever wasps were insects native to the planet Haruun Kal.

name: Fexian skullborer
summary: Fexian skullborers were the apex predators of the purple moon of Fex in the Sha Qarot system of the Deep Core, inhabiting the trees of the mostly unexplored moon. The species' name was derived from the method by which they fed, drilling holes into the skulls of their prey via their long snouts and feeding off the victims' brains. The skullborers would drop down from the trees of the moon and latch onto their prey with their six limbs ending in clawed fingers. The predators also had a natural, full body camouflage they used to maintain the element of surprise when they attacked, as well as back spines that contained toxins that would poison their prey if they attempted to remove the skullborers from their head. The skullborers were first discovered and recorded shortly after the Battle of Yavin by a collection team of scientists sent to Fex by biotechnology company Kelen Biolabs. Unprepared to combat the skullborers when they attacked, three members of the collection crew were killed by the predators. Interested in harvesting the Skullborers for research on their toxins and boring physiology, the Biolabs sent a second collection crew to the planet with better armor and weapons. The crew managed to capture ten skullborers and return them to their starship the Harvester safely, but five of the creatures escaped from their containment and killed all but one of the second collection crew. Kelen Biolabs sent a third collection crew of Luke Skywalker and Nakari Kelen to the moon, who found the Harvester and killed the five escaped skullborers, despite their use of adaptive tactics to find the pair. Due to the intelligence the predators displayed in fighting the duo, Skywalker and Kelen believed the creatures possessed some level of sentience.

name: Fft
summary: The fft were a species of small, multi-legged lizards which were the main food source of both the Ssi-ruuk and P'w'eck species on Lwhekk. They were often cut open using a ceremonial knife called a fft knife.

name: Fftssfft
summary: Fftssfft, also known by the Ewoks as "dandelion warriors," were a semi-sapient botanical species characterized by their thicket of sharp yellow quills. They grew in a meadow on the surface of the Forest Moon of Endor, east of the moon's Great Forest. Like all vegetal species, the fftssfft had roots that conveyed water and nourishment to the rest of their bodies, but they were also able to move about. They protected their grasslands with great ferocity—when they detected movement on their territory, they used the strange quills that covered their heads by hurling them at trespassers. Their reason for killing, however, was purely territorial, and the fftssfft would usually remain immobile in the absence of intruders. The Ewoks of Bright Tree Village, who lived to the West of the grasslands, usually avoided crossing the territory of those they had nicknamed "dandelion warriors." However, in 3.5 ABY, the ffsstfft fought off what they perceived as a home invasion, when the Gupin Mring-Mring set foot on their territory. Shortly afterwards, an Ewok named Wicket Wystri Warrick—who was in search of a star urchin quill that would help him cure his dying father Deej Warrick—into the dandelion warriors' high grasses and freed the Mring-Mring, which provoked an aggressive response from the plant-like beings. The Ewok and his new Gupin companion escaped unhurt from the incident.
distinctions: Ability to move and to hurl their rigid yellow quills at opponents

name: Fian
summary: The Fian were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy that possessed a higher resistance to radiation than that of humans. During the High Republic Era, Ar Prace, a female Fian, served as a maintenance supervisor aboard the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon until its destruction around 230 BBY.

name: Fiery One
summary: Fiery Ones were mysterious sentient photonic beings indigenous to Kathol. Unlike most of the planet's inhabitants, they were apparently not creations of the DarkStryder. In appearance, they looked like balls of light. Communicating through incredibly powerful telepathy, they could use the Ta-Ree energy that came from the planet, and could use it as a weapon if needed.

name: Filar-Nitzan
summary: The Filar-Nitzan were a sentient species in the galaxy. The High Republic Era Jedi Master Nubarron, who looked like a pink-and-purple cloud shot through with lightning, refused to identify their species, leading to speculation they were a member of a previously unknown race of Filar-Nitzan. In 231 BBY, the Mirialan Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh mentally recalled the speculation regarding Nubarron's species, including the possbility of them being an unknown race of Filar-Nitzan, as she spoke with the Jedi Master on the space station Starlight Beacon.

name: Filla-fish
summary: Filla-fish was a species of fish. They were a tradeable commodity, but were required to be frozen if shipped in the cargo holds of starships.

name: Fillithar
summary: Fillithar were a snake-like sentient species hailing from the world of the same name. As a serpentine life-form, they lacked hindquarters. Their tail, however, was prehensile. During the High Republic Era, the Fillithar Jedi Master Simmix trained the Padawan Cohmac Vitus. Around 3 BBY, a male Fillithar named Sssamm Ashsssen was part of the Apprentice Legislature along with Leia Organa. Twenty years into the reign of the New Republic, the Fillithar were represented in the Galactic Senate. Around the time of the so-called Napkin Bombing, their senator sided with the Populist faction.
distinctions: Snake-like appearance, sharp vision, scale-covered body

name: Filordus
summary: Filordi (singular, Filordus) were sapients indigenous to Filordis.

name: Filvian
summary: Filvians were a species of sentient quadrupedal ungulates indigenous to the desert planet of Filve, notable for their technical aptitude, their hardiness, and their gregarious nature.
hairColor: Light brown to yellow or white
distinctions: Desert adapted, technological aptitude, partially bipedal stance

name: Finhead Stonebone's species
summary: This species was a sentient species found within the galaxy. Finhead Stonebone was a member of this species. These humanoids were distinguished by their wrinkled skin, as well large trunks, sometimes flanked by a pair of smaller openings.

name: Finned blaggart
summary: Finned blaggarts were serpents native to Yavin 4.

name: Firaxan shark
summary: Firaxan sharks were a type of shark. By 22 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Iskat Akaris had a polished firaxan shark tooth attached to the end of her first lightsaber. She made use of the lightsaber throughout the Clone Wars, but it was eventually destroyed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader shortly after Akaris joined the Inquisitorius.

name: Fire Bat
summary: The Fire Bat was a creature found on Hoth by early 3 ABY.

name: Fire beetle
summary: Fire beetles were tiny red bioluminescent insects native to Endor. They could be found illuminating the tunnels of the Fleebogs.

name: Fire Breather
summary: The Fire Breather was a huge leviathan with tough hide and natural chemicals that was manipulated by the Yuuzhan Vong for use as a heavy support organism.

name: Fire creeper
summary: Fire creepers were carnivorous cave-dwelling insects of the planet Nirauan. They migrated through their caves in massive swarms. They would devour anything living, including the Qom Qae and Qom Jha, which were their basic food source. When Builder With Vines and several other Qom Jha led Mara Jade, Luke Skywalker and their Qom Qae traveling companion, Child Of Winds, into an Imperial base, they were attacked by fire creepers. Mara, Luke and Child Of Winds were not harmed, but the fire creepers killed Builder With Vines, who had been swooping over the swarm and scooping up many of the insects in his mouth with each pass. He was eating the fire creepers to show off for Child Of Winds. But Builder With Vines got too close to the swarm on one pass; he was snared, pulled the cavern floor, and eaten alive.

name: Fire gnat
summary: A fire gnat was a type of gnat. In 33 BBY, when Jedi Master Depa Billaba threatened the pirate Zilastra after having been imprisoned by her in brutal conditions, Zilastra was unconvinced, assessing that Billaba could not even swat a fire gnat in her state.

name: Fire-kraken
summary: The fire-kraken were a non-sentient species of marine predator that dwelt in the deepest oceanic trenches of the planet Nal Hutta within the Y'Toub system of Hutt Space. Their most distinguishing feature was the snake-like tendrils they possessed, which they used to locate and capture prey. The species' presence in the trenches made trench-diving on Nal Hutta particularly dangerous; however in the year 22 BBY, the Nautolan Jedi Kit Fisto claimed that they were no longer a problem, having previously spent a week trench diving on Hutta himself.

name: Fire lizard
summary: Fire lizards were a type of lizard. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Wayseeker Vernestra Rwoh corralled a bloom of fire lizards on the planet Targusian. Around 160 BBY, while Rwoh was on the planet Cerifisis, she remembered corralling the fire lizards and felt that it was one of the simple acts she had done within the past few years to improve people's lives.

name: Fire rat
summary: Fire rats were a type of creature native to Mustafar. They were known to gnaw on the lava crystals that could be found on the volcanic world. While recounting a tale to the prisoner Thom Hudd about the exploits of the droid captain Spikewheel and her crew on Lotho Minor, the Sith attendant Vaneé likened the fear gnawing at the group to the teeth of fire rats gnawing at crystals.

name: Fire tick
summary: Fire ticks were a type of tick preyed upon by the lava meerkats of the planet Nevarro.

name: Firebird
summary: Firebirds were a type of bird that was apparently attracted to flames, hence the common phrase "...like firebirds to a flame."

name: Firedrake
summary: Firedrakes were large flying proboscised insects native to Gallinore that lit up in colored light, heat, and energy. They came out of their habitat, usually caves, at dusk. The insects communicated to each other via their blinks, with short blinks indicating a summon. Firedrakes might attack anything their size or smaller while hunting, which Jaina Solo and Tenel Ka experienced. They distracted their prey with the flashes and ambushed in packs. Firedrakes were brought to other worlds such as Hapes, but they did not adapt to them.

name: Firefly
summary: Fireflies were insects, capable of emitting a powerful glow.

name: Firehead
summary: Fireheads, also known as Rhinnalian fireheads, were one of the strangest lifeforms on the planet Rhinnal. This nimble creatures was a limbed fish native to the frozen polar regions of the planet, and could be found on the surface of the Zirfan glacier, where tenticulons hunted them. They tunneled through glaciers by using the heat that emanated from a knobby growth on their upper jaw, which smoldered like a nubbin of molten lava. This same growth was also used to kill prey. A school of fireheads would hunt by ramming a larger creature, burning holes into its body, and then nibbling at the floating carcass. These creatures served as sources of both heat and food for the native Rhinnalians. The population of Rhinnalian fireheads were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the Royal Icqui Aquaria on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
distinctions: Knobby glowed growth in its upper jaw

name: Fireworm
summary: The fireworm, or lava dragon, was a fire serpent, native to Eol Sha, that dwelt in lava pools. It was covered in crystalline scales that protected it from the lava; without this protection it was extremely vulnerable to its environment. It had a triangular head, with pointed ear tufts and bony eye ridges. Insulated air bladders allowed the lava dragon to rise or sink in the lava. Lava dragons fed on other reptiles that dwelt within the lava pools. Lava dragons were able to suck lava down their armored gullets and spew it back out in a dangerous natural defensive mechanism. Their crystalline scales also made it impossible for a lightsaber to slice through them, although a lightsaber strike would cause the scale it struck to shatter. In 11 ABY Luke Skywalker fought and killed a lava dragon on Eol Sha as the second challenge by Gantoris which Luke had to pass in order for Gantoris to agree to Jedi training.

name: Firrerreo
summary: The Firrerreo were a sentient species from the Firrerre system in the Outer Rim Territories. The Jedi Initiate Connis Dav, who was active shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY, was a Firrerreo.

name: Fisher bird
summary: A fisher bird was a type of bird. Two decades after the Sith rebellion, one of the four skiffs used by Jedi lord Hanrai's entourage on the Outer Rim planet Dekien was a white and sleek vessel sculpted to evoke a fisher bird.

name: Fisher
summary: Fishers, also known as corpses, were a sentient species of carnivores native to Carnelion IV. They were mutated from humans who lived on the planet as a result of the poisonous Celadon Sea.

name: Fissrit
summary: Fissrit were a type of carnivorous, many-legged arthropod that were native to ice worlds. Also known as fire worms, they could produce incredible heat through a natural chemical reaction in their underbellies, which allowed them to thrive in frozen conditions. The amount of heat they could produce was variable, with a fissrit at rest producing just enough to survive local conditions. When necessary, though, they could increase the temperature produced to melt snow or ice and to kill any prey creatures that investigated the pools of liquid water the melting produced. Fissrit typically measured just under a third of a meter in length, with the largest variants typically acting as solitary hunters. Other varieties dwelt in colonies, as all fissrit possessed a strong social instinct. Fissrit could be purchased for 1,500 credits during the Galactic Civil War but were hard to find for sale.
length: Just under one third of a meter

name: Fiumarian
summary: Fiumarians were a sentient species from the Fiumar system in the Core Worlds with pale pink skin, pupilless eyes, a sloping forehead, and yellow blood. They were deceptively fast and could remain neutral in heated negotiations, making them adept diplomats or smugglers.

name: Fjor-bat
summary: Fjor-bats were a species of flying creatures native to the star system that became the site of a battle between Resistance pilot Poe Dameron and the forces of Lord Terex.

name: Flakax
summary: The Flakax were an insectoid sentient species native to Flax.
distinctions: Hive society, glowing abdomen, noxious gas emission

name: Flame beetle
summary: Flame beetles were beetles that lived in the "multilayered deathtrap" ecosystem of the forests of the planet Kashyyyk. Ranging from 4 to 12 centimeters long, these pests could deliver an extremely painful bite due to their mild venom. The flame beetles were named for their ability to spontaneously combust into flames through chemicals in their bodies. While a lone beetle wasn't considered too dangerous, this event normally occurred throughout a whole swarm of over 100 individuals, each beetle exploding with the effect of a fragmentation grenade. Flame beetles hatchlings gave off unique pheromones. While Wookiee naturalists couldn't determine the reasons for their combustion, it was suspected that it was an extreme self-defense reaction. Normally the flame beetles only swarmed in the lower levels of wroshyr tree forests, and the few times when Wookiees did encounter them they could usually be driven off with simple smoke pots. During the Clone Wars a swarm of beetles set fire to Turren Lonarr's office. This was actually a distraction to cover his insertion of Trandoshan hunters into Kashyyyk. In 1 ABY, a spacer found a specimen of this species in a storage room of the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar.

name: Flame ibbot
summary: The flame ibbot was a subspecies of ibbot that lived along the Boiling Sea on the Core Worlds planet Drall. The omnivorous birds were colored copper, brass, or blue-black, and were capable of squirting a jet of scalding water and bile at predators.
distinctions: Capable of squirting a jet of scalding water

name: Flame tygah
summary: A flame tygah was a feline-like beast with six paws and an oily hide of variegated scales native to the Strafe Plains of the planet Tython. Its body blazed with such heat that its tail swished white fire, and its teeth and eyes glowed with intensity. An aggressive creature, its main form of combat employed its fiery claws that left simmering footprints and could ignite its targets. A large flame tygah could have paws the size of an adolescent Human's head. Because soft earth eased the tunneling of burrows, flame tygahs favored the piles of detritus thrown up by erupting sinkholes for their dens. It was from hidden hollows at the top of these mounds that they launched their predatory attacks. Though potentially hostile to travelers, it was also regarded as an elusive creature, and few were the holovids recorded of them. As such, the Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock as a child mistook them to be mythological beasts invented by her parents to scare her.
eyeColor: Ablaze as if heated by fire

name: Flann
summary: The Flann were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. One male Flann was a prisoner at a stronghold owned by Harra the Hutt.

name: Flapdragon
summary: Flapdragons were animals from Gamorr's swamps. Beasts that varied in size, with four wings and flaps next to their jaws that dripped with extremely toxic acid. They had the ability to spray fire when intimidated, although seldom used it. They attacked Gamorrean villages a few times a year to feed on their Dwoob pets or on the actual Gamorreans. Mostly, though, it absorbed energy from the acid swamps it spent it's days wallowing in.

name: Flarion
summary: The Flarion was an easily-startled bird native to Kashyyyk.

name: Flashfly
summary: Flashflies were a type of creature capable of flight. Around 19 BBY, the Chiss sky-walker Che'ri drew pictures of flashflies and birds with markers. Based on this and the fact that Che'ri drew landscapes as seen from above, Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo deduced that the sky-walker wanted to learn how to fly. Che'ri claimed that Thrawn was wrong, remarking that children drew flashflies because they were pretty, but ultimately admitted she wanted to fly. Fireflies hatch from cocoons.

name: Flatworm
summary: The flatworm was a type of nonsentient worm. The primitive nervous system of the Swokes Swokes—a sentient humanoid species from the planet Makem Te of the Outer Rim Territories' Nilgaard sector who lacked receptors for the sense of touch and as a result were nearly impervious to pain—was more similar to that of flatworms than those of other sentient humanoid species.

name: Flea
summary: Fleas were a type of insect found throughout the galaxy. They were known to bite, and their name could be used as an insult. A type of flea was a lava flea.

name: Fleebog
summary: The Fleebogs were a species of tiny, sentient beings characterized by blue skin, red eyes, and a yellow shell. They inhabited mazes of tunnels; one group of Fleebogs lived below the surface of the Forest Moon of Endor near the Ewok settlement of Bright Tree Village in such a habitat. The Endor Fleebog population used domesticated insects as beasts of burden and as lighting for their tunnels. In 3 ABY, the Fleebogs of Endor were threatened by the ravenous ra-lugg, an arachnid that had invaded their subterranean territory. To bring their plight to the attention of the Bright Tree Ewoks and thus gain their assistance, the Fleebogs used a type of plant known as a damsel flower to shrink the Ewoks' Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka down to their size. With the assistance of the princess and the similarly miniaturized Ewoks Teebo and Wicket Wystri Warrick, the Fleebogs defeated the ra-lugg and learned that even small beings could handle big problems.

name: Fleek eel
summary: Fleek eel was a species of slippery eel found in the Hocekureem Sea on Falleen as well as in the oceans of Aquilaris. They were caught with tridents or traps which were then brought in by submersibles. The eels were cooked in pepper oil, were considered a delicacy, and were often served alive in a cream. Around 3964 BBY, Marn Hierogryph, under the pseudonym Baron Hieromarn, solicited investments to pay for tankers to transport the eels to Taris. He predicted that the eels would be a smash hit among the denizens of the Upper City. Dex's Diner on Coruscant often served cream of fleek eel. It was possibly the source for Fleekskin. They were also served at the Manarai. There was also the proverbial expression spear two fleek-eels with the same trident to describe multiple success with little effort.

name: Fleet lizard
summary: The fleet lizard was a species of lizard that lived in the swamps of the planet Lowick. Fleet lizards had rib membranes that stretched beneath their arms and when escaping from danger, they would run on their hind legs and spread their membranes, in an attempt to sail away. At some point, the Hutt hunter Parella journeyed to Lowick on a quest to locate the last member of the Gorach species, and he had his droid drones bomb the world's swamps, in an attempt to drive out the creature. A number of fleet lizards subsequently fled from the flames that were ignited by the bombing.

name: Fleft-wauf
summary: The fleft-wauf were winged predators native to Taloraan, who hunted in packs. They were domesticated by the Wind Raiders, who used them as war mounts. Stormwing was the personal fleft-wauf of Jeru, a Wind Raider.

name: Flensor
summary: Flensors were a species of carrion bird capable of flight and native to the planet Sakiya within the Saki system in the region of the galaxy known as Hutt Space. The planet's native sentient species, the Sakiyans, considered flensors a bad omen, especially if they saw one flying over their bonepit.

name: Fleshfly
summary: Fleshflies were a type of fly that fed on animal carcasses. In 229 BBY, the Nihil recruit Driggit Parse reflected on the way the Nihil marauders had ravaged her homeworld—the Outer Rim planet Valo—thinking that the occupiers had swarmed over the locals like fleshflies to a carcass.

name: Flewt
summary: A flewt was a species of predatory butterfly that was found on Naboo.

name: Fliggerian firebeast
summary: The Fliggerian firebeast was a creature named for its digestive system, which used a form of combustion to break down its food. The name of this creature was also used as an oath between bounty hunters.

name: Flii
summary: The flii was an insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They grew up to two meters in length and were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. One species had green and yellow stripes. Other species included the Fyreflii, the Mayflii, and the Wingflii.

name: Flintwing
summary: Flintwings were a species of creature that inhabited the planet Batuu. They were known to make howls, which could be heard from the Saka homestead.

name: Flirron
summary: Flirron were avian beasts native to the planet Onderon. Their dazzling patterns were considered by many scientists to be a form of visual communication between each other. By 3627 BBY, flirron were so popular among Onderon's populace that citizens of Iziz frequently viewed them from the city.

name: Flit
summary: Flits were non-sentient flying reptiles native to the planet Lok. They had thick hides and extremely sharp beaks as well as a number of poisonous barbs, making them a dangerous predator. Flits were also found on Ord Mantell's Tansarii Point Station and the prison world Despayre. On Lok, the reptavians were hunted and used for meat, but they could also be tamed and made into effective fighters. One such tamed flit won the blood sport competition at the opening of the Aerie Casino on Naboo in 1 ABY.

name: Flitterbat
summary: Flitterbats were a type of bat with broad wings. They could be found on the ecumenopolis Coruscant and in the first year of the Empire's reign after its formation in 19 BBY, Senator Mon Mothma saw several broad-winged creatures that she thought might be flitterbats clinging to the underside of a pedestrian bridge in the Federal District of the planet and tucking themselves away for morning. Moments later, Mothma caused the detonation of a speeder near the bridge in order to kill the Separatist assassin Soujen Vak-Nhalis. As the blast knocked her to the ground, her final thoughts before falling unconcious were hopes that she had caused the explosion swiftly enough to spare the flitterbats and pedestrians on the bridge from its effects.

name: Flitterpod
summary: Flitterpods were striped, purple fish with fins that could be found in the river of the forest planet Tenoo. Around 233 BBY, the Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar and Lys Solay traveled down the river and noticed the creatures, with the latter becoming distracted by them and almost crashing her speeder. In other instances, a flitterpod took the Jedi youngling Nubs' lightsaber, and the droid RJ-83 encountered a pair of the fish while in Tenoo's river. In 232 BBY, the Jedi younglings Linh, Nubs, and Brightstar saw several flitterpods jumping out of the water.

name: Floater
summary: Floaters was an umbrella term describing many species of animals found in the atmospheres of Bespin and Yavin Prime. [[File:Floaters-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Bespin floaters.]] The Bespinese species were zooplankton which fed on algae. At least one species of them could also be found in the jungles of Kashyyyk. Some species resembled arthropods, while others resembled flying fish. The twelve species of floaters native to Yavin Prime were behemoth-sized creatures, more similar to Bespin's beldons. Gas-filled beings, ten of the species were herbivores, and were preyed upon by the other two species ("floater sharks" and "floater squid"), which were carnivores.

name: Floater squid
summary: The floater squid was one of two predatory species of floater creatures that lived in the atmosphere of the Outer Rim Territories gas giant Yavin Prime. Three hundred meters in size, its resilient body consisted of an elongated gasbag with tentacles attached to it, and it could reach a speed of three hundred kilometers per hour. It was an opportunistic predator that attacked anything regardless of size, which included the other non-herbivorous floater, the floater shark, as well as starships, including the craft of Corusca gem fishermen.

name: Floating jellyfish
summary: The Floating jellyfish were native to the terrestrial planet Baskarn. They were great jellyfish-like creatures, nearly a hundred meters across, that used lighter-than-air gases to float across the skies above the planet’s extremely thick and deadly jungles. White and almost translucent, they fed on the small birds and rodents that lived in the tops of the trees, ensnaring them with huge, pale tentacles that dangled among the branches. They could be dangerous to tree climbers as well as hazardous to airspeeders or even starfighters, which might collide with them by accident. The locals of Baskarn sometimes climbed trees in search of food and waited for one of the great floating jellyfish to drift by. They carefully avoided its dangling tentacles so as not to be stunned by its poison. Those with quick reflexes were able to steal a bird or a rodent from the jellyfish’s clutches, already incapacitated by its venom.
habitat: In the sky above the jungle

name: Florakeet
summary: A florakeet was a type of feathered creature that could be roasted and plucked. When being questioned by thugs working for the gangster Surat Nuat on the planet Akiva in 4 ABY, the junk dealer Temmin Wexley claimed that a transport belonging to Nuat had been roasted and plucked like a florakeet by members of the Uugteen species prior to Wexley claiming its contents, which he falsely told them meant he had not known who owned the starship.

name: Floubettean
summary: The Floubetteans were an avian race from the Floubette system. They were known for their complex mating dance. It was considered an art form by other avians but revolted most Humans.

name: Flower-flier
summary: Flower-fliers were native flying insects found on the forest moon Endor.

name: Flower serpent
summary: Flower serpents were a type of serpent found on the Outer Rim planet Haileap. The scientist Avon Starros—who lived for a time on Haileap—considered them to be pretty but deadly, and that they had no care for anything beyond themselves. In 228 BBY, after Avon's mother, Ghirra Starros, told her that Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro would be disappointed if she did not attend a dinner at the Nihil pirates compound on the Outer Rim planet Hetzal Prime, Avon mentally noted that Ro reminded her of a flower serpent.

name: Fluggrian
summary: The Fluggrians were a sentient species with yellow eyes and green, purple, white and pink skin that was native to Ploo IV. Elan Mak was a Fluggrian podracer who was active on Tatooine.

name: Fluorescent plankton
summary: Fluorescent plankton was a type of bioluminescent plankton that dwelled in caves. They were cited in a song called "If Only I Could Let Go and Cry."

name: Flutterbug
summary: Flutterbugs were insects found on Hosnian Prime and Dalna. Avon Starros once followed a flutterbug outside of her family home and was kidnapped as a result.

name: Flutterby
summary: Flutterby was a type of butterfly-like insect that was found in the galaxy. The Brendoki flutterby was one race of flutterby which was native to the forest planet Brendok.
skinColor: Transluscent with blue and red hues

name: Flutterer
summary: Flutterers were thumb-sized fish which traveled in large schools on the planet Marca.

name: Fluttery
summary: Flutteries were insects native to Cartao. They were flying, swarming pollinators.

name: Flyhorn lizard
summary: Flyhorn lizards, also simply known as flyhorns, were a type of lizard found on the planet Tatooine, where they lived solitary lives out in the world's deserts. While staying cool in the sand, the creatures would use their horns and wide fan-like tails to collect condensation and catch smaller insects to eat. Some moisture farmers habitually estimated their yields by observing flyhorn lizards near their farms.

name: Flying serpent
summary: The flying serpents were giant flying reptiles—essentially winged snakes—native to the planet Ophideraan. The serpents were hatched from eggs in a breeding ground within the caverns under the planet's surface. The serpents were used as riding beasts by the group known as the Serpent Masters. The warriors found the beasts responded to certain ultrasonic tones and pulses. Tyrann used a transmitter held within his medallion to send special tones to the serpents, effectively controlling their movements.

name: Fneeb
summary: Fneebs were a sentient species. In 0 BBY, a number of Fneeb bounty hunters were present on the planet Tatooine within Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Mos Eisley spaceport. The Rodian bounty hunter Greedo noticed the Fneebs among the other patrons while he drank Pica Thundercloud with fellow hunters Dyyz Nataz and Spurch Goa.

name: Fnessian
summary: The Fnessian were a sentient species indigenous to the Inner Rim planet Fnessal. They had two eyestalks on their head, from the back of which grew thick, fleshy tendrils. Fnessian biology included a gender known as "thos." Kn'ik Th'ronik was a Fnessian smuggler during the period of the Galactic Civil War and stole the freighter Morgannier while on Ord Mantell, causing the SoroSuub Corporation to place a large bounty on the Fnessian's head.

name: Fog creature
summary: Fog creatures or mist creatures were a predatory cephalopod species native to Kestavel. They lived in the kilometer-deep, fog-covered ravine surrounding The Lucky Twi'lek casino. While they never ventured out of the crevice, they were known to be very dangerous and would consume a falling individual before they reached the bottom. When the Uhumele took shelter in the fog during the Imperial attack on the casino, Shaylai Veila was cautious to remain outside the ship, fearful that the fog creatures might discover them.

name: Folded ear boosqueak
summary: The folded ear boosqueak was a rare, arboreal species that was native to the forested planet Fedje, located within the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Fedje was noted for its exotic lifeforms, as exemplified by the creature.

name: Fondorian
summary: Fondorians were a hairless Near-Humans species from Fondor.

name: Foora
summary: Foora were creatures native to Togoria.

name: Forage worm
summary: Forage worms were a large type of worm found on various worlds across the galaxy. Their slimy exterior could be many different colors, including shades of brown, grey and purple. Forage worms were carnivorous, and were known to exhibit territorial and ferocious tendencies. When fighting, forage worms would often burrow beneath the ground, and rise back up to attack. Spacers who went on treasure hunts were known to be attacked by forage worms while foraging the landscape for valuables. Some spacers were also known to domesticate forage worms as personal companions.

name: Force wielder
summary: Force wielders, or Force-wielders, were an enigmatic sentient species of highly Force-sensitive beings with the power to alter their forms. The Force wielders were known for their affinity to the Force and it was believed they were god-like beings. A family of Force wielders, collectively known as the Ones and the Mortis gods, took sanctuary on the realm-world of Mortis, which some believed was where the Force itself originated from, where they lived as anchorites. The three familial beings—the Father, the Daughter, and the Son—withdrew from the temporal realm when their power threatened to disrupt the galaxy. The Father acted as the balance between the Daughter and Son, who embodied the light and dark sides of the Force, respectively. The siblings were immortal, although only as long as the Father remained alive. Despite little knowledge remaining of the existence of the powerful Force wielder beings, the Father believed that the Sith sought to exploit his family's power for their own benefit. The Father also believed that if the Son, who had fully given into the dark side during Anakin Skywalker's mission to Mortis, was allowed to leave Mortis, he would bring doom across the galaxy and the universe itself.

name: Forest blurrg
summary: The Forest blurrg was a type of blurrg that was native to the forest moon of Endor.

name: Fork-nosed ice worm
summary: Fork-nosed ice worms were a rare species of worm that could be found on Hoth, a frozen Outer Rim planet. In 3 ABY, Doctor Chelli Aphra visited the world and recovered a fossilized fork-nosed ice worm. Aphra brought the fossil to the Shadow University, where she sold it to Sava Estat.

name: Forlyn
summary: Forlyn were creatures that were illegal to hunt. At some point by around 11 BBY, Lando Calrissian persuaded Prita Sven into letting him fly off Pantora with a cargo of illegally poached forlyn carcasses.

name: Forntarch
summary: Forntarch were edible, arboreal, carnivorous swamp rodents from Gorsh.

name: Forosnag
summary: Forosnags were a non-sentient species with several pairs of arms and six rows of teeth. They were immune to blaster fire due to their ability to swallow it. Forosnags were used by the Forosnag Attack Battalion of Sef Con, who confronted a team led by Han Solo during a standoff at Substation Grimdock. The slicer Peekpa hacked into the prison and opened panels in the floor below the forosnags and the Sef Con troopers, causing them to fall into the lower levels. Some of the forosnags survived, but were eaten by bastaks.
distinctions: At least two pairs of arms

name: Forrian
summary: Forrians were small, furry mammals that lived on the world Batuu. They harvested dried berries from the forest floor and had claws that they used to grip tree bark. Around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani encountered forrians when she climbed into the canopy of a forest on Batuu while searching for a shield belonging to her Master, Silandra Sho, who had tasked her with finding the shield as part of her Jedi Trials. Nitani's presence caused the forrians to become nervous, so she attempted to give off calming vibes in order to avoid the forrians attacking her with their claws.

name: Forshul
summary: The Forshul were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy that possessed long gray hair. During the High Republic Era, at least one Forshul was present on Valo during the Nihil attack on Valo.

name: Fosh
summary: The Fosh were a sentient bird-like species that were native to the Mid Rim planet Dallenor. They were among the guards at the Dallenor Excavation and the Krypder Riders, including leader of the riders, Hudso Shaku.

name: Fractal urchin
summary: Fractal urchins were a non-sentient species native to the Inner Rim astronomical object Protogeyser. Known to the galaxy by the time of the Ruusan Reformation of 1000 BBY, the species was distinguished by its lack of cellular structures and thus midi-chlorians, symbiotic life-forms that lived inside cells and allowed their host to detect the Force. This characteristic earned the fractal urchins a mention in the Jedi trainee guidebook The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force, first published as early as the year 990 BBY and still in use during the Clone Wars that began in 22 BBY. Authored by a Jedi biologist, Bowspritz, the "Galactic Bestiary" section of the book described fractal urchins as an example of animals that were connected to the Force despite their lack of midi-chlorians. More detailed information on the species was available in the Jedi Archives on the Galactic Republic capital world, Coruscant.

name: Frecker
summary: Freckers were a species of small sentient rodents. Though wild and brutal, they were capable of intelligent speech. Freckers also wore clothes, denoting some manner of culture. Five years before the Battle of Yavin, Gru'um Ropple and Miramba transported a horde of Freckers to Jabba Desilijic Tiure's palace, planning to assassinate the Hutt crime lord by unleashing the Freckers to kill him during his sleep. As it happened, Bib Fortuna, Jabba's majordomo, had plans of his own; he and six co-conspirators hoped to capture Jabba alive so that they could pry out as many secrets as possible before killing him. When the Freckers were unleashed upon the court, instead of carrying out his own plan, Fortuna ordered his men to kill the Freckers. The rodents in turn killed all of Fortuna's men save for Nivek, who had been blinded by the Freckers' bites and began yelling about "the plan". Fortuna, fearing discovery, shot the thug.

name: Freda
summary: Freda were a species from Freda. They were locked in an arms race against the nearby Jante until the Freda attacked Jante industrial plants on Rett II. The Galactic Empire, led by Moff Haveland ordered a ceasefire, which the Freda eventually withdrew from.

name: Freedi Pamular's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Freedi Pamular was a member of this species.

name: Frejuke
summary: The Frejukes were a sentient species that possessed heat-retaining blubber. Wolentic Dudge, a resident of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi, was a Frejuke whose blubber made him a good fit for the world's snowy climate.

name: Frenk
summary: Frenks were a slender reptilian humanoid sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Frid
summary: The Frid were an aquatic sentient species native to the planet Mackar. The Frid relocated to the water-covered planet Iskalon to escape a cataclysm that struck Mackar around five millennia before the Galactic Civil War, and became a part of the Iskalonian School, a cultural group of several aquatic species that had traveled to Iskalon with the aid of spacefaring benefactors. A fishlike species, Frid were characterized by their bulbous violet eyes, long mouth-flaps and green, scaly skin. Frid were sexually dimorphic, as males had fins on their heads which females lacked; they were also incapable of physical speech, instead communicating solely through telepathy. The Frid were noted for their extreme pacifism, refusing to fight back even when attacked.

name: Frigosian
summary: Frigosians were a sentient species that were native to the planet Tansyl 5. Small for the average humanoid, they had sensitive eyes that meant they had to wear goggles to protect them from the light in certain environments. The Frigosian Opeepit was a janitor on the Colossus platform, while the Frigosians Thromba and Laparo were cryptosurgeons working at Maz Kanata's castle.
distinctions: Nocturnal species with sensitive eyes and large mouths

name: Frist wolf
summary: Frist wolves were a type of wolf native to the Mid Rim planet Trandosha. They were hunted by the native Trandoshan species, whose culture was firmly rooted in hunting, often with the aid of Trandoshan hunting hounds. While searching for a Nihil sniper aboard a derelict Hutt Clan ship in 232 BBY, Trandoshan Jedi Master Sskeer stated he would need to do so like his ancestors had hunted frist wolves. After he discovered the Nihil's blaster on the ship's floor, Sskeer referred to the sniper as a frist wolf who had dropped their blaster.

name: Frizznoth
summary: The Frizznoth were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They were short in stature, and at least some members utilized giant mechanized battle armor to compensate for their small size. Mozeen Parapa, head of the Parapa Cartel, was a male Frizznoth.

name: Froffli
summary: The Froffli species were a New Republic member race easily recognized by their prominent hair-spurs. While many Humans found their appearance ridiculous, others (such as Talon Karrde's associate Chin) arranged their own hair in a similar fashion. Froffli culture was quite vindictive. During the Caamas Document crisis, they were among the first to demand that the Bothans pay the Caamasi reparations. This was partly because they wanted justice for the Caamasi, and partly because Bothan trade policy since about 4 ABY had taken a heavy toll on Froffli industry.

name: Frog
summary: [[File:Raining_frogs.gif|thumb|A HoloNet News weather report indicating possible frog rain]] Frogs were green non-sentient amphibians, widely known as good jumpers. They lived in the watery environments of various planets, including Belsavis. Occasionally, entire swarms of frogs rained down from the skies of a planet. Various species, both sentient and non-sentient, were metaphorically referred to as "frogs."
distinctions: Good jumpers, long sticky tongues, protruding eyes

name: Frog-dog
summary: Frog-dogs were a sentient species of lizard that, at first glance, were usually thought to be non-sentient and were often mistaken for pests. They often used this fact to their advantage, allowing prosperous masters to keep them as pets to secure themselves shelter and a constant supply of food. They were often ignored, and could therefore sneak unnoticed into palaces or ships and complete secretive tasks. The Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure kept the Frog-dog known as Buboicullaar as a pet, despite his sentience, and used him to spy on his many courtiers. Buboicullaar protected the Hutt from many assassination attempts. Frog-dogs like Bubo could pull 119 kilograms, or 262 pounds, with their tongue.

name: Fromprath
