summary: The Fromprath were a sentient, snakelike, six-armed species that lived in the galaxy. Hundreds of years before 3 BBY, the Fromprath lived on an Outer Rim planet but were forced to live in exile away from the planet after being forced out by the Nightsisters, who renamed the world Dathomir. During their rule over Dathomir, the Fromprath had exploited the world's natural resources. The Nightsisters formed a symbiotic alliance with rancors in order to drive out the Fromprath and claim the world for themselves, much to the sorrow of the Fromprath. Frapsen was a male Fromprath musician who played at the castle of Maz Kanata around 3 BBY.

name: Frong
summary: The Frong were a species hailing from a planet of the same name. Tightly-knit and clannish, the Frong had little to offer the galaxy, although looked to the New Republic and criminal organizations such as Black Sun and the Red Key Raiders for protection during the events leading to the Battle of Jakku.

name: Frosch
summary: Frosch were a species of lizard on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, a family of Ewoks on Endor needed to acquire frosch eggs for a potion to save their father, Deej Warrick, from rokna tree fungus. One of Warrick's sons, Weechee, went into the frosch grotto to try and get the eggs; he was successful doing so but had to quickly escape the cave as several frosch chased after him. He barely escaped, falling down a waterfall to avoid the frosch and surviving thanks to his brothers' help.

name: Frost Giant
summary: The Frost Giants were a race of sentients apparently made out of ice, as they could be melted if exposed to fire. They were eight times as large as Ewoks. Their breath could freeze other beings to death. A number of them lived in caverns in the Mountain of Doom on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were ruled by a king, who captured Teebo and Wicket. They were terrified of the fire-breathing dragon-birds of Endor. When the two Ewoks helped them kill a dragon-bird that was harassing their mountain, the Giants helped the Ewoks locate a fire plant, a species unique to the mountain.
distinctions: Eight times larger then an Ewok

name: Frost Sprite
summary: A Frost Sprite was a type of sentient humanoid. One Frost Sprite, Odra, the "Duchess of Sleet," lived on the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Frost-worm
summary: Frost-worms were a type of worm. In 3 ABY, a member of the Rokana Raiders group of pirates called several crewmates frost-worms while summoning them over to an entryway in the Khepi Tomb in the Khepi system that the group's captain, Stinger Tash, had recently blown open.

name: Frozian
summary: Frozians were a sentient species from the Froz system. The High Republic Era Jedi Nooranbakarakana was a member of the species.

name: Frunchettan-sai
summary: The Frunchettan-sai, referred to as the Frunchies by the Human trader Dubrak Qennto, were a species that originated in Wild Space and controlled several colony worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. By 27 BBY, an art piece created by a Frunchettan-sai was stored in the treasure room of a plunder starship used by the Vagaari species. The ship was captured that year by Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet, who, during a subsequent inspection of the treasure room in the company of Qennto and his crewmembers, identified the physical characteristics of the Frunchettan-sai artist without being previously familiar with their species.
distinctions: Sight largely in blue-ultraviolet part of spectrum

name: Fryiaan
summary: The Fryiaans were a sentient four-armed species from the Fryiaa system. In the Imperial Era, a female Fryiaan was a dancer and singer of a band.

name: Ftaaghn
summary: The Ftaaghn was a sentient species of large, viscous humanoids with octopus tentacles.

name: Fud Sang's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Fud Sang was a member of this species.

name: Fullor
summary: The Fullor was a vicious predator native to the planet Dra III. Fullors were hunted by off-planet big-game hunters.

name: Fur-bearing trout
summary: Fur-bearing trout were a native fish to Paulking XIV.

name: Furball
summary: Furballs were creatures native to the planet Kimanan. Described as tiny, tubby, clown-ish marsupials, they were commonly kept as pets. Sabodor and Eeksa both sold them.

name: Fuzzum
summary: The Fuzzums were a species of sentient avians indigenous to the planet Dandelo. Members of the species were roughly humanoid, standing shorter than the average Human on spindly legs. The arms and legs were hairless and brown-skinned, but the squat body was covered with orange fuzz. Fuzzums spoke their native language through a stubby, pale beak. They lived in a tribal society that relied on relatively primitive technology, characterized by simple musical instruments, cliffside cave dwellings, and ubiquitous wooden spears. The Fuzzums encountered offworlders sometime before 15 BBY. Eventually, the avians were faced with a group known as the Starhunters, who drove the Fuzzums from their homes in Dandelo's cliffs. The Fuzzums fled to the forests, but several of their number were captured. With the caves theirs, the Starhunters converted them into cages to hold beasts for the Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie. Their captive Fuzzums were forced to hunt down new species for the Starhunters' traveling show, while those who escaped set up camps in the woods. When a new group of offworlders later arrived on Dandelo, the forest-dwelling Fuzzums assumed the worst. Nevertheless, the trio—a protocol droid named C-3PO, an astromech droid named R2-D2, and a Tammuz-an prince named Coby—convinced the avians that they only sought to rescue a creature known as Ingey from the Starhunters. The Fuzzums and their new guests plotted and executed a rescue mission for the tessellated arboreal binjinphant. With the rescue of an old spacer named Greej and the timely arrival of miner Jann Tosh, the Fuzzums and their allies freed the beasts held in the caves, drove the Starhunters from Dandelo, and reclaimed their cliff dwellings.
eyeColor: Yellow or green with brown pupils

name: Fwit
summary: Fwits were a small, furry, carnivorous, mammalian non-sentient species native to the arboreal planet of Maridun. Expert hunters, they could run very quickly and catch most smaller prey. Averaging around half a meter tall, fwits were kept by Amanin on Maridun as both pets and guardians, due to their vicious, savage nature. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, hunters were encouraged to kill fwits on sight.

name: Fw'Sen
summary: The Fw'Sen were a species that mated only once, prior to being sexually mature, and retained the resulting fertilized eggs within their bodies until a later stage in their reproductive cycle. The reptilian Ssi-ruuk designed and produced a Fw'Sen-class picket ship.
distinctions: Retention of fertilized eggs until maturity

name: Fynock
summary: Fynocks were avian creatures that could be domesticated. They appeared as exotic birds with snake tails. Fynocks lived on the planet of Talus and were the atmospheric cousins of the vacuum-traversing mynock. A subspecies was the jungle fynock that lived in dense jungles of Talus.

name: Fyreflii
summary: Fyrefliis were a large insect species of bioluminescent flii native to the planet Kubindi. On their homeworld, which was frequently subject to solar flares, the species could be found within the Silver Forest of Dreams. The protocol droid C-3PO and another member of the Rebel Heroes of Yavin encountered four fyrefliis while lost in the forest in the year 0 ABY, thinking the insects were someone who could help them. When the heroes later left Kubindi in the Millennium Falcon, a YT-1300 light freighter, they saw many fyrefliis lighting up the night sky, thousands of feet above them.

name: Fyrnock
summary: Fyrnocks were silicon-based creatures originally indigenous to the jungles of the planet Anaxes. Surviving the destruction of their homeworld, many fyrnocks inhabited the resulting Anaxes asteroid belt, including the asteroid PM-1203, which contained Fort Anaxes, a military base used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Fyrnocks were hurt by sunlight and could only live under the cover of darkness, in which they became fierce predators. However, they were immune to lights that were not solar-based.
distinctions: Constant growth, able to grow to gargantuan sizes

name: Fyyrsprus
summary: The Fyyrsprus were a small species of humanoid reptilians. Members of the species were harmless but clumsy. At some point by the time of the existence of the New Republic, a group of Fyyrsprus technicians carried out several repair attempts on the custom-built light freighter Starcat of the Happy Blasters mercenary group. All the repair attempts were inadequate, leading to the Happy Blasters' Human technician Mac organizing efforts by the mercenary group to eradicate the Fyyrsprus.

name: Gabal
summary: Gabals were a large mammals native to the Zirfan glacier on the planet Rhinnal. Native Rhinnalians hunted wild gabals in the frigid borderland of the Zirfan glacier for their thick fur and as a source of food. Gabal wool was later sold or used by native Rhinnalians to create hand-woven, colorful, patterned garments.

name: Gabdorin
summary: Gabdorins were a sentient species of large, round-headed amphibians from Gabdor.
distinctions: Ridged nostrils and massive sweat glands

name: Gaberworm
summary: Gaberworms were half-meter worms found in the garbage of Coruscant. Their hair was harvested to make gaberwool.

name: Gab's species
summary: A sentient species of humanoid amphibians lived in the galaxy. One member of the species was Gab, who was a farmer on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era. Another member of this species lived at a nerf ranch on an unidentified desert world.

name: Gacerite
summary: The Gacerites were bipedal sapients indigenous to Gacerian.

name: Gackle bat
summary: The gackle bat was a nocturnal flying predator native to Yavin 4. Their primary food source were stintarils which they killed by injecting a muscle relaxant with their fangs. Gackle bat were also found on Devaron. It was said that Vilmarh Grahrk's Inferno resembled a gackle bat. The gackle stalker was a mutant subspecies of the gackle bat. After the Battle of Yavin, the Exar Kun cultists tamed a number of gackle bats, including one named Vin'Rith, that they used to defend the Temple of Exar Kun.

name: Gadon
summary: Gadons were a race from Gadon 3.

name: Gados
summary: The Gados were a species of sentient humanoids with slender, fur-covered bodies. They had elongated necks and lanky limbs, and their heads featured only two large eyes and a pair of protruding incisors. Gados internal organs ran like ribbons throughout their bodies. This arrangement meant that any injury a Gados sustained was potentially critical, with the loss of an appendage almost certainly fatal. The species was incredibly nimble; they were known throughout the galaxy for their gymnastic skills, an ability made famous by the Leaping Tee group of acrobats who toured with the Alsakan Circo-Menagerie. The Gados were indigenous to the planet Abregado-rae in the Abregado system of the Core Worlds. They developed a simple society independent of their homeworld's other native sentients, the Moochers, and the galactic community largely left them to their own devices for millennia. However, their world's relative obscurity and its location at the head of the Rimma Trade Route made it an ideal staging area for pirates, smugglers, and other scoundrels. Gados were known as highly amenable, overlooking major eccentricities and breaches of protocol, tolerance that encouraged immigrants from the galactic fringe to come to Abregado-rae, and the ever-amiable Gados welcomed them and learned the secrets of galactic technology. Over time, the Gados abandoned most aspects of their native culture, including the Gados language. As their culture became congruent with the galactic standard, they assimilated into the amalgamated culture of the alien inhabitants of Abregado-rae. After the rise of the New Republic, a multi-species oligarchy known as the Tundei regime took control of Abregado-rae's government and instigated strict new laws that challenged the longstanding frontier nature of the world. Although the Tundei tried to shift the planet's economy from criminal endeavors to manufacturing, conditions on the world worsened, and the Gados suffered. Especially heinous were new punishments for crimes, such as amputations and executions—which, to the Gados, were essentially the same thing. Nevertheless, some Gados supported the Tundei, working as spies.
distinctions: Prodigious leaping ability, ribbon-like vital organs

name: Gairk
summary: Gairks were aquatic predators that lived on Ansion. The gilled creatures had warty green skin and huge sucking mouths that were large enough to swallow a Human. Gairks could combine their mouths to create even larger amounts of suction. In 22 BBY, Jedi Padawans Barriss Offee and Anakin Skywalker, while on a mission to Ansion, became entangled with a school of these river-dwelling creatures. The young Jedi, however, were able to disengage from the force of the creatures' powerfully combined suction vortex and free themselves.

name: Gaja bird
summary: Gaja birds were a type of bird that could be found on the Core Worlds planet Hosnian Prime, where they plucked fish from the world's oceans. They bickered with each other and were hunted for sport. In 228 BBY, Starros Clan member Avon Sunvale recalled seeing the birds catching fish. During the Imperial Era, the clan's matriarch, Thea Starros, reproached her relatives Sana and Mevera Starros for bickering like gaja birds.

name: Galacian
summary: The Galacians were humanoids from the planet Gala. Their skin was a distinctive pale bluish tone, which they called "moonlight." They were therefore frequently called "moon people." The Galacians consisted of three separate tribes: the city people, the hill people, and the sea people. They were ruled by the Beju-Tallah dynasty until 44 BBY when Queen Veda stepped down in favor of a democratically elected leader.

name: Galandan
summary: The Galandans were Near-Humans from Galand. A number of them emigrated to Rishi.

name: Galderian
summary: Galderians were goat-like sapients indigenous to Galdar.

name: Galidyn
summary: The Galidyn were sentient reptilian predators indigenous to Fyodos.

name: Gallo
summary: Gallo were fish native to Naboo. Many Gungan families were named after this species.

name: Gallusian
summary: Gallusians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Luleo Primoc, who was a chart-topping singer who also performed on the First Light, was a member of this species. Bosnok was a Gallusian with a knack for numbers; the Imperial Governor Thorden offered him a job managing records of the Empire's shady dealings on the Outer Rim moon Toshara.

name: Galoomp
summary: Named for the unique sound they made when foraging for food at dawn or dusk, galoomps were herd beasts found on Naboo and Tatooine. Galoomps were large herbivores that, despite reptilian appearance, were actually mammals. [[File:Galoomps_Digging.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A group of Galoomps, digging for "desert plums".]] Their nostril slits protected them against sand. Their tail knob, filled with loose pieces of cartilage, shook to warn of approaching danger. A segmented, horny, ridged hide on their backside protected against predators and seemed to insulate against moisture loss. During sandstorms, they buried themselves in the sand, their nostrils being slit to protect against inhaling sand. Galoomps ran with their wide mouth open, filling their unusually large lungs with air. In full flight, a galoomp's lungs could expand to fill almost its entire body cavity. The galoomp's powerful hind legs were responsible for the animal's signature bounding gait. Its unique body structure allowed it to traverse the desert plains at great speeds. At rest, the front legs were used for digging roots and the galoomp's favorite food, "desert plums". The split hoof aided this creature's manual dexterity. Once per year, the galoomp would shed the bony rattle on its tail. The rattle was used to make toys for Gungan children. Ben Skywalker used the phrase "galoomp chase" to describe the diversion to find the Pool of Knowledge during the hunt for Abeloth.

name: Galub slug
summary: Galub slugs were giant, grub-white sea parasites native to Spira. They adhered to large sea animals to suck their blood. Generally very unintelligent, they would sometimes mistake passing boats for potential hosts, making them somewhat of a hazard to yachting tourists.
distinctions: Could adhere to solid surfaces through suction

name: Galva
summary: Galvas were a species of mammals native to the equatorial deserts of Saleucami.

name: Gama-Senn
summary: The Gama-Senn were a sentient, humanoid species from the Gama system. Gama-Senn had two thumbs per hand and flat facial features. In 11 ABY, the Gama-Senn ruler was convinced to swear the Gama system's loyalties to the reborn Galactic Emperor Palpatine after a demonstration of the Dark Empire's superweapon, the Galaxy Gun. Palpatine scoffed at the Gama-Senn representative for withholding allegiance until swayed by fear.

name: Gamorrean
summary: Gamorreans, derogatorily known as "pigs," were a sentient species of green-skinned pig-like humanoids that hailed from the Outer Rim planet of Gamorr. They grouped themselves in clans, each of which was led by a warlord and a Clan Matron. A number of Gamorreans were employed by the crime lord Jabba the Hutt to act as guards throughout his career.
distinctions: Upturned nose, fangs, poor eyesight, tusks

name: Gamorrean thunder wasp
summary: The Gamorrean thunder wasp was a winged insect from the planet Gamorr.

name: Gampassa
summary: The Gampassa was a species of turtle native to the planet Glee Anselm's oceans. Their skin was wrinkled and gray, while their bodies were round and elongated. A ponderous head and tiny tail grew from the creature's front and backside, respectively. The turtles had six pointed flippers, the two forelegs growing longer than the others. At least one Gampassa was 2,310 meters long, and the species' large size allowed for the Nautolans, another of Glee Anselm's native species, to use their shield-like shells as locations for their villages. Alternatively emerging above and submerging below the ocean every couple of centuries, different generations of native Nautolans would either be born above or below water.
distinctions: Alternatively rising above or submerging below water every couple of centuries

name: Gamwidge
summary: The gamwidge was an edible creature found on the planet Kinyen. Porcellus sometimes prepared goatgrass-stuffed gamwidge for Jabba the Hutt.

name: Ganathan
summary: The Ganathans, or Ganathians, were a sentient Near-Human species indigenous to the planet Ganath, located within a largely uncharted cloud of gases within Hutt Space known as the Oktos Nebula. Cut off from the outside by the uncharted and unexplored expanses of highly irradiated interstellar gases that surrounded their pocket of space, Ganathan technology remained at an archaic level in comparison to much of the rest of the galaxy. They had limited space-travel capabilities, making use of steam-powered spacecraft capable of slow, inter-system journeys. Despite their antiquated technologies in some areas, the Ganathans were quite advanced in other fields. For instance, the Ganathans helped craft the Human Jedi Empatojayos Brand's cyborg suit and the lightning gun weapons system. With his ship too damaged to travel, the severely wounded Jedi Knight had remained among the Ganathans, who combined their technology with his own to create the repulsorlift sphere that housed Brand's body and kept him alive. Eventually Brand came to be the Ganathans' leader, and ruled their civilization through the Jedi creed of justice. In 10 ABY, the severely damaged light freighter the Millennium Falcon flew into Ganathan Space, and the Humans Han Solo, Leia Organa Solo, and Vima-Da-Boda, and the Wookiee Chewbacca sought sanctuary among the Ganathans and their king.

name: Gand
summary: Gand were an insectoid sentient species native to the planet Gand. One subspecies breathed ammonia, forcing them to wear respirators to survive in oxygen-rich atmospheres. A notable member of this species was Zuckuss, a bounty hunter who was one of the first traditional findsmen to leave his homeworld.

name: Gangul
summary: The ganguls were creatures native to the planet Tenoo.

name: Ganimed
summary: Ganimed were a humanoid sentient species distinguished by the single black horn on top of their hairless heads. The species had pointy ears and a ruddy brown and muddy yellow skin tone. The bounty hunter Purong was a member of the species. By 0 BBY, Purong visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine and engaged in a lightfight against the Ariwook Rff Huff.

name: Ganjuko
summary: Ganjukos were large creatures from Fenn with beaks and thick coats of hair. They were known to stampede at a moment's notice. Their beaks were prized, as they could be crafted into expensive daggers, a sign of status among Bothan clan leaders. A ganjuk-carved dagger was possessed by Shrithek Al'lya.

name: Gank
summary: Ganks were a sentient species native to a planet located in Hutt Space that was conquered by the Hutt Cartel. The cartel was controlled by the Hutts from the neighboring world of Nal Hutta, who turned the Gank into slaves or vassals.

name: Gannifari
summary: Gannifari were a subspecies of Akk dog, a large reptomammal native to Haruun Kal. They were pink and tan, with silver eyes.

name: Gannymedan
summary: The Gannymedans were a sentient species native to the Gannymeda system.

name: Gant spider
summary: Gant spiders were large poisonous spiders that lived on the world Batuu. Around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani learned that a salmaca that was raiding Peka village was also protecting the village by preying on a nearby colony of gant spiders.

name: Gapillian grazer
summary: Gapillian grazers were a non-sentient herbivorous species native to the planet Ord Mantell. They were gentle-tempered beasts that wandered the grassy meadows of the planet, although their massive curved tusks and their hides, that looked like an armor, could give them a fearsome appearance. People could often get near them without being threatened, but, during their mating season, grazers could become a huge menace for anyone who tried to approach them; during this season the male specimens saw every approaching being as a "love threat" and, as a defensive action, a single spooked grazer could initiate a charge capable of leveling a small town.

name: Gaping spider
summary: The gaping spider was an arachnid creature native to the planet Dathomir.

name: Garagon
summary: Garagons were two-headed reptiles from the jungles of Koda's World. Unlike two-headed tortuces, their heads were on opposing ends of their bodies, rather than side-by-side. They were twenty-meter long fire-breathers. Garagons guarded the temple of the Tempestro.

name: Garalalesh
summary: Garalalesh in the Ergesh language, or swamp skimmers in Basic, were three-meter swimming predators that ate prey on the surface of Ergeshui's swamps using wide mouths.

name: Garbage hunter
summary: The garbage hunters were non-sentient creatures native to the Deep Core planet Vulpter. The species evolved in response to the planet's extremely polluted environment and serves as a striking example of how scale and surroundings can shape evolution. Garbage hunters thrived in filthy urban zones, which were also plagued by rodent infestations. Roughly 2 meters long and waist-high to a Human, they resembled other four-legged rodents but bore a chitinous ridge along their backs that rose an additional meter above the spine. As a result, a garbage hunter burrowing through waste heaps resembled an ocean predator gliding through water, closing in on prey with only the slightest warning. Possessing darkvision up to 20 meters, they hunted efficiently in low-light conditions, combining agility, strength, and keen survival instincts to dominate the urban wastelands.
height: Waist-high to a Human, with its chitinous ridge extending another meter

name: Garbage rat
summary: Garbage rats were a tiny yet sleek scavenger race that tended to set up warrens within the rubbish wastes that had accumlated in dirtier, less frequented byways. A sentient animal, they carried sharp but primitive digging equipment on their backs and spoke with a chatter, openly hostile toward larger species with whom they felt little empathy.
distinctions: Sleek shape; shrill chatter; glittering eyes

name: Garbage snipe
summary: Garbage-snipes were edible birds from Glottal.

name: Garbage worm
summary: The garbage worm was a genetically-manufactured creature, and one of Coruscant's most primitive and essential organisms to the garbage handling system. Any trash not packaged for orbital export was mixed with oils to be processed by the garbage worms. They chewed it down to tiny pellets, removing any last bits of organics, plastic, or recoverable metal. They reduced millions of tons of these pellets into carbon dioxide, methane, and other organics. Thousands, if not millions of worms occupied the garbage level of the city-planet. Their glass-like scales were large and loose, prized by collectors for their glittery quality. The largest worms were up to several hundred meters long and three or four meters wide in diameter. Their bodies had lines of small blue-black eyes. Rumor had it that a garbage worm could eat a useless hyperdrive core and survive—at least, for a few seconds. The creatures were also found on Raxus Prime and Belsavis.

name: Gargantelle
summary: The Gargantelles were a species of six-armed giants that inhabited Boz Pity until their extermination at the beginning of the Ductavis Era.
distinctions: Six arms, one or two eyes

name: Gargantua
summary: Gargantua were a species of large mammalian ape-like animals. At least one lived at Sil Gohtta's Nature Preserve.

name: Gargantuan Fissure Sleeper
summary: The fissure sleeper was a species of fish native to the planet Hoth. They spent the majority of their lives in the deep dark, feeding off of volcanic fissures, and almost never ventured into shallow enough waters to be caught by a fisherman. Their flesh was one of the rarest delicacies in Ortolan culture, however if not prepared carefully they were lethal when eaten.

name: Garhai
summary: Garhai were a species of armor-plated fish native to the planet Neimoidia. The planet's native Neimoidians saw the garhai as a symbol of obedience and "dedication to enlightened leadership." Along with its twin symbol, the Spherical Flame, this was considered one of the two most powerful symbols in Neimoidian culture and as such they were often displayed on the walls of Neimoidian buildings. This included the grotto on Neimoidia where in 33 BBY Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray first introduced his advisors, legal counsel Rune Haako and Deputy Viceroy Hath Monchar to the Sith Lord Darth Sidious. Gunray would later compare the fish to the Confederacy of Independent Systems's manta droid subfighters.

name: Garnant
summary: Garnants were small purple insects that lived in underground hives on Yavin 4, and communicated via vibrations and scent. They had stinging bites.

name: Garollian ghost viper
summary: Garollian ghost vipers were creatures native to a location within the Garollia system of the Expansion Region's Baroli sector. The ghost vipers had tongues that they could move rapidly. While engaged in a lightsaber duel against the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi during the Separatist attack on the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY, Count Dooku mentally compared Kenobi's lightsaber attacks to the quick movement of a ghost viper's tongue.

name: Garoos
summary: The Garoos (adj. Garoosh) were a member species of the New Republic. They could be found in all levels of Republic society. At the same time that a Garoosh senator's voice was heard in debates on the Caamas Document and the return of Grand Admiral Thrawn, another Garoos named Cromf was an informant for the smuggler Mazzic. Garoos had ear clusters which could be opened and closed, and spoke Basic with an odd, whistling accent. They breathed through purple-tinged gillis flaps.
distinctions: Gillis flaps, ear clusters, whistling accent

name: Garqi vert-mite
summary: Garqi vert-mites were a type of mite that partially shared its name with Garqi, an agriworld in the Cassandran Worlds. In 19 ABY, Imperial commandos Chik Apla and Chala Venan prepared to sabotage the Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade on the planet Coruscant. When caught hiding in nearby foliage by an employee of the venue, the pair claimed they were spraying for Garqi vert-mites inadvertently brought into the gardens by a tourist. After expounding on how they felt the creatures were fast and annoying due to the mite-dust they left behind, the employee believed their claims and left.

name: Garral
summary: The garral was a canine pack hunter genetically engineered by Imperial scientist Luthos Garral, who crossed the genes of the Mantessan panthac with those of several other creatures. The Galactic Empire deployed them to supplement Human security forces, for example to the forests of Wayland to protect the Mount Tantiss facility. According to Mara Jade, these animals used to be used as watchdogs for the Empire.

name: Garsath
summary: Garsath were massive and aggressive space-faring creatures. A group of Spice Runners of Kijimi attempting to escape the Zualjinn Syndicate by hyperspace skipping encountered a garsath along the Davezra Way.

name: Gartro
summary: Gartros were small dragon-like avian creatures that lived on Coruscant. They had spiked tails, and jaws filled with sharp teeth. The eggs of the gartro were served as a delicacy at Dex's Diner alongside nerf steak, protato wedges, and Quor'sav-fried steak. They were also served pickled, for 3.7 credits for three, or as a gartro egg omelet.

name: Garu-bear
summary: Garu-bears were a species of bear known for protecting their cubs. Because of the Yuuzhan Vong coomb spore diseased that attacked her organs, when Mara Jade Skywalker first learned that she was pregnant with her son Ben she briefly considered medical options of terminating the pregnancy to prevent the disease from attacking her child. When she dismissed the idea almost immediately, it was akin to a garu-bear protecting her cub.

name: Garwian
summary: The Garwians were a sentient species that hailed from the Unknown Regions planet Solitair. Their government was the Garwian Unity, which ruled Solitair and five colony worlds including Stivic. The Garwians were notable traders and merchants within their section of the Unknown Regions, and their planets served as regional trade hubs among various sentient species.

name: Gasnit
summary: Gasnits were large, bat-like carnivores native to an unscouted Outer Rim planet. They would inject their prey with massive amounts of venom before consuming them.

name: Gastropod
summary: Gastropods were a non-sentient species.

name: Gastrulan
summary: Gastrulans were sentient gastropods native to the planet Gastrula in the Outer Rim Territories. Standing just taller than Sullustans—who averaged a height of 1.5 meters—Gastrulans sported four short arms and spotted, bulbous heads. They had eyestalks on either side of their heads, located just above the neck. During the Galactic Civil War, the Gastrulans became the sole clients of Captain Bungo Bung's Great Bantha Breakfast Biscuit Run, an endeavor to earn credits for the Sullustan by selling Bantha Breakfast Biscuits, a popular snack food, to those unable to obtain them. Two weeks after the Run was established, the Gastrulans were threatened by the ravenous Giant Amorphous Bantha Breakfast Biscuit, a mutated version of the snack that evolved when the preservatives in the biscuits came into contact with Gastrula's atmosphere.

name: Gatag
summary: Gatags were shelled creatures used by the Yuuzhan Vong to make ceremonial platters.

name: Gatha Elbaphay's species
summary: A sentient species existed in the galaxy. They had green or tan skin and black eyes. One member of the species was Gatha Elbaphay, who was at Canto Bight in 34 ABY.

name: Gatori's species
summary: Gatori's species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Gaunt
summary: The gaunt was a bovine creature native to the planet Byss. The meat, hides, milk, and bones of the gaunt were used to provide many of the needs of the various Abyssin tribes who kept flocks of the creatures and herded them from oasis to oasis across the deserts of their homeworld.

name: Gaupa
summary: Gaupa were a type of creature native to the forest moon Endor. The sentient Ewoks also native to the moon would sometimes ride gaupa.

name: Gaxxan brain-slug
summary: A gaxxan brain-slug was a species of slug that was capable of killing an individual. At least one of the creatures was small enough to be left on a pillow. The gaxxan brain-slug was indigenous to the Gaxxa system, located in the Inner Rim. By 3956 BBY, the Zabrak mercenary Jurgan Kalta had been killed by a gaxxan brain-slug that was left on his pillow. The mercenary's custom power suit had prevented his enemies from succeeding with more conventional attacks.

name: Gazar
summary: The Gazaran (singular, Gazar) were arboreal sentient species indigenous to Veron.

name: Gazarant
summary: The gazarant was a species native to the planet Fresia. The Lower Coromon Chain was home to gazarant feeding grounds, which helped to prevent prisoners from escaping.

name: Gdan
summary: Gdans were predators native to the planet Qiilura. About thirty centimeters long when fully grown, it took a whole pack of them to bring down even a merlie calf. Despite their small size, they were not against advancing on sentients, at least when in packs. At day they were not offensive or harmful, but at night, when they emerged from their warrens and hunted, the local farmers locked their doors and stayed clear of the fields. It was not so much their teeth that the locals feared, but the deadly bacteria the animals carried; a minor scratch or bite could be fatal. Gdans lived underground, and were exceptionally good burrowers. They would excavate large tunnels big enough for human-sized sentients to crawl through, and Omega Squad, a Galactic Republic clone commando unit, used this to their advantage in the Mission to Qiilura. Gdans also dug large rooms, large enough for a clone commando to stand in, to allow them escape from flooding after a rainstorm. Omega Squad noticed small terracing on the tunnel walls that the gdans used as a refuge.

name: Geejaw
summary: Geejaws were a species of reptavians which lived on Endor. They could be made into geejaw omelettes.

name: Geelan
summary: The Geelan, or Geel, were a species of sentient, bipedal canines with pot bellies, lanky arms, and stubby legs. Thick fur covered most of their bodies except for parts of the face and hands. Each Geelan had two large, yellow eyes, a dark, wet nose, and a muzzle of sharp teeth. The species hailed from Needan, a planet in the depths of Wild Space, where they lived in cities and divided themselves into tribal nests under the ultimate rule of the Geeloniran, or "Master Geel." Members of the species were nosy and greedy by nature, traits that made them incurable hoarders of nicknacks and baubles. The typical Geelan made every effort to engage in a bout of haggling each day—and to a Geelan, haggling was a sport with no rules. Although such aggressive behavior did not endear them to many non-Geelan, it did make Geelan gifted entrepreneurs and businesspersons. Although Needan was once a lush world, a passing comet struck the planet and wrenched it from its orbit. The resulting cool-down forced the Geelan to move into domed cities to survive. After they were first contacted by outsiders from the galactic community, many Geelan fled the world to operate businesses and act as traders in the galaxy. One of the more visible Geelan business ventures was the space station Zirtran's Anchor, which was jointly owned and controlled by several nests. The Galactic Empire sent a representative to the station to demand the Geelan pay proper taxes and collect the proper tariffs, which annoyed the canines. At some point, Zirtran's Anchor disappeared mysteriously in an event that came to be known as "the Vanishing." Spacer rumors circulated about the cause of the disappearance, but the station eventually reappeared in another part of the galaxy, devoid of all life. The Geelan reclaimed their wayward property and reopened for business. Nevertheless, the specter of the station's previous fate hung over the place.

name: Gektl
summary: Gektls—occasionally spelled Gecktls—were a sentient species of bipedal reptilians native to the planet Hoszh Iszhir. They were regarded as tough survivors, and members of the species were capable of sloughing off their skin and even tails as a means of escaping danger. They were a long-established part of galactic society, known for their artistic and literary skill. Their painted eggs in particular were regarded galaxywide as beautiful and highly collectible artworks. The Gektl homeworld was protected with a planetary shield to defend its bounty of strategic metals from would-be invaders. Major Stafuv Rahz of the Imperial Military was a member of this species. Rahz betrayed his planet to the Empire, providing them with the codes necessary to breach Hoszh Iszhir's shield in exchange for his commission; he was later placed in charge of an operation designed to lure and trap Rebels by executing a schoolteacher and her students.

name: Gelagrub
summary: Gelagrubs, also known as Felucian ground beetles, were a species of insect that were found in the forests of the planet Felucia in the Outer Rim Territories.
distinctions: At least five pairs of short legs

name: Gelatinous pet slime
summary: Gelatinous pet slimes were creatures native to the planet Saclas. They were popular among young Gamorreans as pets during the early days of the New Order.

name: Gelfish
summary: Gelfish were a species of tentacled fish found in Tython's Moon Channel, where they once attacked Lanoree and Dalien Brock.

name: Gellbeast
summary: Gellbeasts, or Wardogs as they were also known were semi-intelligent creatures native to Gellefon which could grow to roughly 2.4 meters tall. They could be extremely vicious when hunting or when pushed into it. To those they bonded with—such as the Human settlers of Gellefon—they could be amazingly gentle and affectionate. Because of this, several of the creatures were used by the Imperial forces which were garrisoned on the planet. When fighting, they liked to leap at their opponents and rake them with their sharp claws. Once they got closer to their target, they would use their bite to finish the battle quickly.

name: Gen'Dai
summary: The Gen'Dai were a species of large, sentient beings. Their bodies were made up of a mass of regenerative tentacles, which allowed them to regenerate wounds quickly and, notoriously, be almost impossible to kill. Once a peaceful people, the Gen'Dai became violent nomads centuries before the Imperial Era and after the devastation of the Gen'Dai homeworld. The Gen'Dai did not tend to form lasting alliances with beings of other species, likely due to how much they will outlive them, which suggests that their true allegiance was often reserved for their own kind. Although a rare sight, the Gen'Dai that roamed the galaxy were feared and powerful. One of them was Rayvis, a warrior who lived through the rise and fall of the Jedi Order and the creation of the Galactic Empire, and who became at odds with Jedi Knight Cal Kestis. Another member of this species was the bounty hunter Durge, who aligned himself with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars and later worked with various individuals during the days of the Empire.

name: Genetian
summary: Genetians were a race of humans hailing from the astronomical object Genetia. Force-sensitive Genetians, such as Imri Cantaros, possessed powerful empathic abilities which could be difficult to control without the proper training. The Jedi Samara the Blue wrote about the empathic powers of the Genetians.
distinctions: Force-sensitives with strong Force empathic abilities

name: Gengh-Noghri
summary: The Gengh-Noghri were a subspecies of the Noghri native to the planet Tulpaa in the Unknown Regions, distinguishable by their crocodilian heads filled with flesh-tearing teeth and were over two meters in height, and were the descendents of Noghri slaves taken by ancient Rakata from the Outer Rim Territories to the Tulpaa years before the fall of the Infinite Empire.
distinctions: Crocodilian heads filled with flesh-tearing teeth

name: Genian
summary: Genians were a species native to the planet also known as Genian. They had violet or lavender skin and were known as skilled diplomats.

name: Geniserian sand monkey
summary: Geniserian sand monkeys were a rare monkey species native to the Geniseria system that had physical similarities to the Nimbanel species. The meat of a Geniserian sand monkey was considered a delicacy by some individuals when it was flambéed in foyvè oil. Jorrk, an associate of the Nimbanel criminal Mosep Binneed, nicknamed the Nimbanel "Monkey Jabba" due to his similarity in appearance to the Geniserian sand monkey and Binneed's occasional impersonations of Jabba Desilijic Tiure, a Hutt crime lord for whom Binneed worked.
distinctions: Some similarities in appearance to the sentient Nimbanel species

name: Genteslug
summary: The genteslug was a type of slug. Ugnaughts, a porcine sentient species that hailed from the planet Gentes in the Outer Rim Territories' Anoat sector and originated in a desert or wasteland environment, ate genteslugs as well as molds and fungi that they grew.

name: Geo Beast
summary: The Geo Beast was a large bipedal species resembling the Vorantikus of Voss. Like the vorantiki, the geo beasts had two fingers on their long hands, two toes and a back-facing claw on their feet and black stripes running across their bodies. They were covered in plating that was extremely resistant to heat. Their spleen was specialized to filter radioactive materials from their bloodstream, and was extremely similar to the spleen of a Trinthan prowler native to Quesh. Unlike the vorantiki whose bony spikes ended in rounded edges, the spikes on the geo beasts had sharp pointy ends and were glowing with lava-like appearance along with their bodies. The geo beasts started their lives as small larvae before eventually growing to enormous size as adults. They were abundant on the moon of Oricon and were also found on Hoth around the Glacial Fissure area. The brains of geo beasts were harvested as a delicacy and served during the Feast of Prosperity event on Nar Shaddaa.
distinctions: Two fingers on each limb, large pointed glowing spikes on the back

name: Geonosian
summary: {{Update|, , The High Republic Adventures (2022) 1, Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel, Darth Vader Annual 2, Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire}} Geonosians were a winged, semi-insectoid species native to the planet Geonosis that created nests in large, spire-like colonies on their homeworld. The Geonosians would fight on the side of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, defending their planet on multiple occasions. After contributing to the construction of the Death Star, they were nearly exterminated by the Galactic Empire. Only a single Geonosian, nicknamed Klik-Klak, survived the Imperial sterilization of their planet. There were rumors during the New Republic Era that some eggs could have also survived, creating hope that a new Geonosian hive could arise, but at this time the species was widely considered extinct and Geonosis uninhabited.

name: Geonosian hydra
summary: The Geonosian hydras were huge carnivorous insectoid creatures with three heads, though some hydras could have more than three—which would not be considered a mutation. Hydras were amphibious and lived beneath the few seas on Geonosis, like the Ebon Sea. Geonosian hydras preyed upon less defended Geonosian hives. They were sometimes used as the main event in Geonosian gladiatorial fights, where they would be pitted against a large number of armed gladiators. A Geonosian hydra exoskeleton was displayed inside the Royal Icqui Aquaria, a large, public aquarium that was situated on the planet Coruscant.

name: Geranite
summary: Geranites were a species that could only breathe a certain gas and wore special suits to survive. Doallyn was a member of the species.
distinctions: Special suits to breathe a certain gas to survive

name: Gerb
summary: The Gerb were a sentient lagomorph species native to the moon Yavin 13.

name: Gergilla
summary: Gergillas were a semi-sentient species that lived on the planet Vadran.

name: Geroon
summary: The Geroon were a sentient species hailed from the epynomous Unknown Regions planet. They were captured and enslaved by the Vagaari species in 27 BBY. Around nine Geroons were killed by B1-Series and droideka battle droids under the directive of the Vagaari leader, the Miskara, and many of them imprisoned within zero-g plastic bubbles on the Vagaari fleet's hulls. They were freed by the Chiss species and their government, the Chiss Ascendancy, after the Chiss defeated the Vagaari. Ascendancy Admiral Ar'alani provided foodstuff to the Geroons aboard a transport. Around 18 BBY, a Geroon was acquainted with the Cathar Sele, and in 22 ABY, several Vagaari—including Supreme Commander Estosh, General Bearsh and Purpsh—posed as Geroons to infiltrate the Chiss expedition to the remains of Outbound Flight colony starship. Many of the expedition's members did not notice the deception, but Ascendancy Aristocra Formbi knew that and let them accompany his party to begin a war against the slavers. The Vagaari were eventually defeated by Jedi Knight Mara Jade and Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.

name: Gesaril
summary: The Gesarils were a furred, six-limbed sentient species indigenous to Gesaril. Gesarils were all born with an affinity for the Force.

name: Gesaw rat
summary: The gesaw rat was a small quadrupedal rodent from the moon of Carreras Minor. Gesaw rats had thick blue hides, and fed on power. Several inhabited Ania Solo's junkyard. One scared Solo's friend Sauk, who was unfamiliar with the species. Several others later fed on the remains of SD, who had been destroyed by Darth Wredd who was posing as Imperial Knight Yalta Val.

name: Gharal
summary: Gharal were a sentient species of long-lived, scaled beings. Their life spans meant that Gharal were considered adolescents even into their thirties. The species sported thick neck ridges and light gray skin. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, a family of Gharal lived on the planet Langston, where they fell victim to an attack from the Separatists in 22 BBY. A Republic relief mission not long after saw Jedi Initiate Mill Alibeth deliver aid to the family, including its eldest surviving member, a thirty-year old girl named Rokura. These Gharal spoke in a broken form of Galactic Basic Standard.

name: Gharzr
summary: Gharzr, also known as the Dxunian stalker, were one of the thousands of varied predators that inhabited the forested moon of Dxun. They were notable for their twin stinging tails and stealthy hunting tactics. They managed to cross the gap between Dxun and Onderon, establishing homes in the jungles of both planets. The gharzr's scaly hide provides it with a degree of natural armor. About 3 meters long and weighing over 200 kilograms, the gharzr is surprisingly agile. Each of its tails ends in a swollen, scorpion-like poison stinger.

name: Ghaswar
summary: Ghaswars were fossorial creatures of Exodo II. They often burrowed into the lava of the planet.

name: Ghazakl worm
summary: Ghazakl worms were non-sentient annelids native to the planet Yuuzhan'tar, the homeworld of the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species. The worms were considered meaningless by the Yuuzhan Vong, and did not have enough intelligence to comprehend the most menial of tasks that the other species performed. By 28 ABY, when the Yuuzhan Vong were invading a galaxy other than their own, some Yuuzhan Vong still used the ghazakl worm in comparisons to make things or beings seem meaningless or unintelligent.

name: Gheriol
summary: Gheriols were a six-legged creature native to the planet Ruathi. The human woman Kliva of Arnt kept two within her fighting arena which she had Jedi Knight Indara fight after capturing the Jedi. Both creatures were eventually tamed with the Force by the Tholothian Force-sensitive Ty Yorrick and taken to a animal refuge on Hetzal.

name: Ghest
summary: Ghests were a predatory serpentine species native to the jungle swamps of the planet Rodia. With long, green bodies; claws; and sharp teeth, they preferred to ambush prey on swamp shorelines by pouncing on them from the water, rarely if ever hunting on land. Ghests were occasionally hunted by teams of the sentient Rodian species native to their homeworld, although the hunting parties usually sustained casualties, and the practice had become less common by the time of the Galactic Civil War. The Jedi Luke Skywalker and the Rodian Taneetch Soonta encountered and killed a ghest on Rodia while trying to visit the mausoleum of the Jedi Knight Huulik.

name: Ghhhk
summary: The Ghhhk were an insectoid species hailing from the planet Bith whose appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik. They were the apex predators of their homeworld. By at least 11 ABY, a Ghhhk was one of several creatures and gladiators belonging to species featured in dejarik that was unleashed upon the Mandalorian Din Djarin and Rotta the Hutt in the Pits on the moon Shakari, before escaping the arena and wreaking havoc on civilians.

name: Ghishi
summary: The Ghishi were a race of warrior-mantids from the planet of the same name. Ghishi were thin and lanky, with long insectile limbs and large orange eyes. Kraid Nemmeso was a Ghishi who became well-known on the podracing circuit during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

name: Ghoma
summary: The ghoma was a clawed creature native to the Zoess, a large forest on the planet of Radhii.

name: Ghoral bird
summary: Ghoral birds were found on the planet Makeb as well as a number of other worlds in the surrounding region. A survivor of the reconstituted Sith Empire's conquest of the world was saddened by the birds' absence following the catastrophic groundquakes that necessitated the evacuation of Makeb's population.

name: Ghorla
summary: Ghorla were equinoid creatures that lived on Chandrila. They were ridden by hunters that were chasing prey in the Hanna Wild Game Reserve.

name: Ghorlectipod
summary: Ghorlectipods, also known as Ghorman spiders, were a species of spiders found on the planet Ghorman and known for their silk.

name: Ghost spider
summary: Ghost spiders, also spelled ghost spydrs, were a shelled, clawed spydr species found in the Silver Forest of Dreams on the planet Kubindi. With some growing to the size of houses, the poisonous arachnids spun webs whose strands were stronger than steel. They were considered a delicacy in many cultures. The Kubaz, who valued the taste of the creatures, ate only the legs. To safely work with the animals, many Kubaz ranchers required regular injections to develop an immunity to the beasts' powerful and fatal poison.

name: Ghostling
summary: Ghostlings were a species of ethereal humanoids indigenous to the planet Datar. While mostly Human-like in anatomy, Ghostlings had key differences from that species. The Ghostlings' shiny, tan-colored skin radiated an aura of light. Their lower limbs ended in five-toed feet that gave the species a tip-toe posture. Because they were accustomed to the low gravity of their homeworld, Ghostlings were quickly overexerted on planets with higher gravitational pull. They were easily injured in such conditions, with a mere touch enough to cause a bruise and with even a slight blow potentially proving fatal. They lived in villages made up of nests, which hung from creeper vines in Datar's forests of bayah trees. There the Ghostlings defended themselves from intruders with simple weapons and traps. Nevertheless, they were often troubled by slavers, especially during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. In that time period, Ghostling children were sought after as pets or slaves by individuals who valued the Ghostlings for their extreme beauty and rarity. Indeed, in 32 BBY, Gardulla the Hutt bought a cargo of Ghostling children from the Dug Podracer pilot Sebulba so that she could place them in her personal pleasure garden. The children, among whom was Princess Arawynne, were freed by the Human slave boy Anakin Skywalker and his friends. Ghostlings and Humans found each other mutually fascinating and attractive. However, due to the fragile structure of the Ghostlings, sexual relations between the two species inevitably proved fatal to the Ghostling partner.
distinctions: Ethereal beauty, digitigrade posture, frail body

name: Ghular
summary: Ghulars were a sentient species. The Ghulars were enslaved by the Qhuloskians, forced to mine farium on Qhulosk.

name: Giant algae-bed
summary: Giant algae-beds were a species of sentience Algae from the Cygnus B system, a star system located in the Esaga sector of the Mid Rim. The algae-beds were extremely intelligent, with a highly complex brain. Like many such species, considered to be super-brains, they were unable to move around independently. As a consequence, the algae-beds had little involvement in the galactic community. They were known in the galaxy by 0 BBY. By that year, Luke Skywalker, then an inhabitant of the remote planet Tatooine, had seen a picture of the giant algae-beds.

name: Giant dianoga
summary: The giant dianoga was a colossal dianoga creature dwelling in the sewers of the galactic capital, Coruscant, around 4 ABY.

name: Giant horned hopper
summary: The Giant horned hopper was a species of bipedal, hopping, herbivorous mammal indigenous to the Vast Veldt of Cathar. They were often killed by the Cathar in blood hunts.

name: Giant squid
summary: The giant squid was a species of squid that lived in the oceans of Mon Calamari, a planet that was home to the Mon Calamari species. Giant squids had two eyes and ten tentacles. These manipulators sported numerous suction cups and flared out into sagittiform tips. The squids also featured a conical mantle with spots, and an arrow-shaped pair of fins at the end. Giant squids had eyes on either side of the head area. The squids were capable of being stunned into unconsciousness. While traversing the oceans of Mon Calamari in 5 ABY, Senate Planetary Intelligence Network agent Luke Skywalker's minisub was caught by a giant squid. The minisub and the squid were captured by the storage tanks in Imperial Captain Dunwell's Whaladon-hunting submarine. The minisub escaped as the squid was recovering from its stunning, just before the submarine self-destructed.

name: Giant thranta
summary: The giant thranta—not to be confused with the great thranta—was an oversized breed of common thranta, otherwise identical in appearance to the smaller variety. It survived the destruction of Alderaan, its homeworld, on planets such as Bespin.

name: Giant turtle gator
summary: The giant turtle gator, also known as the dinosaur turtle, or simply the lake monster, was a non-sentient reptilian creature, which was known to be aggressive. When it attacked the Mandalorians, one of whom it ate, Din Djarin arrived in his N-1 starfighter and fired torpedoes into the creature's side, killing it. The giant turtle gator was quadrupedal and had a long tail. Its skin was all but impervious to blaster fire. Its shell was also strong against the explosion of grav charge. It dwelled underwater but could also operate on land. Due to its enormous size, the lake monster relied on stealth to hunt its prey. It was also known to attack anything it percieved as potential threat to its existence. The flesh of a lake monster was considered to be a delicacy, likely due to the extreme difficulty in obtaining it.

name: Giants of living stone
summary: Giants of living stone were a species of giants made of a type of blue stone imbued with the Living Force that were native to a planet in the Vagadarr system.

name: Gibbit bird
summary: Gibbit birds were avian creatures native to Dathomir. Gibbit birds were symbiotic to the rancor. The rancor allowed the gibbit bird to roam freely in its mouth, where the bird cleaned its teeth by picking out stuck pieces of bones and flesh. This helped the rancor's teeth remain sharp and healthy, and allowed the gibbit bird to obtain food of its own.

name: Gigaun
summary: Gigauns were enormous, yet harmless, creatures native to the planet Ukio. They were also known as hatchet heads by the local workers. They were essential to Ukio's ecosystem, as they possessed subsonic cells within their bodies which caused seeds to germinate, as the gigauns moved along their migration routes.

name: Gigoran
summary: Gigorans were a sentient species of tall, hairy humanoids that hailed from the planet Gigor. They were often exploited for their strength and typically used as bodyguards.

name: Gilliand
summary: The Gilliands were one of the two sentient species that lived on the oceanic planet of Crul. They were exclusively female, while the other species, the Crolutes, were exclusively male. Z'Vk'Thkrkza was a Gilliand who ran a tavern on the Colossus, located on the planet Castilon.

name: Ginmid
summary: The Ginmids were a sentient species. They were bipedal with two five-fingered hands, light green skin, and a flattened nose with prominent nostrils. At some point prior to the outbreak of the First Order-Resistance War in 34 ABY, the Ginmid Tommet Sozach was the commander of a mercenary army composed exclusively of Ginmids. After the galaxy entered a prolonged period of peace, the army was disbanded and Sozach struck out on his own, making a living as a crowd-pleasing trick shooter. By 35 ABY, Sozach—who had by then become a personal defense instructor sentenced to death after a fatal accident in a marksmanship show that he had been putting on—occasionally felt remorse over giving up the leadership of the Ginmid army, most of whose soldiers had become retired. At one point that year, Sozach was present at the Spice Runners' Den in Kijimi City on the Mid Rim Territories planet Kijimi.

name: Ginntho
summary: Ginnthos were large non-sentient carnivorous spiders native to the planet Utapau who lived in the world's dark sinkhole caverns. They had the ability to spin durable silk, which they used to trap their prey before consuming it. Ginnthos were domesticated by Pau'ans, sometimes being kept in stables to remove vermin. At some point no earlier than 379 BBY, the Evereni Velya Faer remarked that the Evereni pirate leader Marda Ro was like a ginntho at the center of a web, which Ro mentioned in a message she recorded for her descendants. In 19 BBY, ginnthos in Utapau's capital Pau City were employed in the fight against battle droids belonging to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
distinctions: Ability to crawl on vertical surfaces

name: Ginzy
summary: The ginzy was a thick-bodied, monkey-like creature with a chunky clay-colored and blond plumage and black eyes. It stood on two skinny legs, and its tiny hands ended in hooked talons, which the creature used for defensive purposes. To distract its opponents, the ginzy made a countinuous atonal gibbering.
distinctions: Bipedal stance, hands ending in hooked talons

name: Givin
summary: Givins were a sentient species from Yag'Dhul. They had the appearance of an animated skeleton, and were renowned for their mathematical genius. During the Galactic Civil War, the Givin cryptographer Drusil Bephorin was recruited into the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
distinctions: Skeletal appearance, able to survive in a vacuum for short periods

name: Gizka
summary: Gizka were small reptiles that could be found all across the galaxy, on planets such as Lehon and Manaan.

name: Glabos
summary: Glabos were a type of eel that lived in caves on the planet Ryloth. During the first two years of the Clone Wars, which began in 22 BBY, the Twi'lek Jedi Knight Tualon Yaluna went on a mission to Ryloth, during which he learned how to fish for glabos as he waited for an opportunity to get his target. He pretended to enjoy the glabos, but in reality he preferred rations to the salty, slimy eels. Around 20 BBY, while traveling to the Wild Space moon Olgothon 3 for a mission, Yaluna recounted his mission and the glabos to fellow Knight Iskat Akaris. A clone trooper teased that they only had glabos stew for meals on the mission.

name: Glacier tauntaun
summary: The glacier tauntaun was a rangy subspecies that inhabited Hoth's valleys and ice caves. It was largely unstudied by science. Smaller than its larger cousin, the common tauntaun, the glacier variety was identifiable by its high-pitched and humorous screech, as well as its shorter horns, smaller fur, and longer muzzle.

name: Glacier worm
summary: Glacier worms were a species native to Hoth.

name: Gladiopod
summary: Gladiopods were a part-crustacean, part-reptilian carnivorous non-sentient species native to the shadow world of Umbara. The species had long spiked legs and multi-tentacled faces with four glowing red eyes on each side. Gladiopods lived in groups, fulfilling roles of either soldiers or workers.

name: Glarsaur
summary: The Glarsaurs were reptilian sapients indigenous to Gelgelar. Brutes by nature, they had curled tails and sharp claws.

name: Glassferran
summary: Glassferrans were a sentient species. They had three expressionless eyes, each of which could focus on a different object. Kartill was a Glassferran.

name: Glet-mite
summary: Glet-mites were small pests native to Nam Chorios. A group of mites were hormonally modified by a Kubaz chef, under the employ of Beldorion, to grow to huge proportions for the Hutt to eat. The chef also discovered how to use hall d'main excretions to complement the glet-mite's teleological system.

name: Glider
summary: Gliders were avians found on Corellia; they lived in large flocks. In 40 ABY, Han Solo fed these creatures crumbs of breadsticks in Keben Park while he was planning to assassinate Thrackan Sal-Solo.

name: Glider
summary: Gliders were lizard-like carnivores native to Orellon II They had a cape of skin between their limbs which allowed them to silently glide through the air from the trees that they resided in and onto their prey. They were intelligent, perhaps quasi-sentient, and hunted in packs. One glider would attack a herd of prey to make them enter into a state of panic whereupon the rest of the gliders attacks seconds later. Gliders had excellent visual senses as well as auditory and olfactory ones.

name: Glim worm
summary: The glim worm was a burrowing predator covered with knife-like scales, present on many planets.

name: Glimmerfish
summary: The Glimmerfish was a type of fish native to Alderaan. They were small but incredibly fecund swimmers no longer than a finger, covered with reflective metallic scales. Females would lay hundreds of eggs up and down the shores of Alderaan's canals and rivers. When all the eggs hatched at once, the water became a huge, glittering mass of silvery reflections that sparkled from the sunlight. Swarms of the tiny fish swam along the current towards large bodies of water, where they would grow and live out their lives. When no clouds covered the height of the day, it was possible to see the silvery light from orbit. To the people of Alderaan, the hatching of millions upon millions of tiny fish was a celebration of life, thus the holiday called the Silver Flow was a celebration of the hatching of these fish.

name: Gloam monster
summary: The Gloam monsters were undead members of the Katikoot species that had been taken over by the Miner's curse, a disease caused by living minerals found on the planet Gloam. The monsters were depicted in Katikoot legend, including being pictured in tapestries hung on the walls of the Ancient city on the planet. Sometime by 382 BBY, the caverns and tunnels underneath the ancient city were reopened for mining a special fuel after the Gloam mines ran dry. This accidentally unleashed many dormant Gloam monsters upon the planet.

name: Globblin
summary: Globblins were carnivores creatures with green skin and four-clawed limbs. They had sharp, white teeth and a jutting lower jaw. Their eyes, located on the sides of their head, glowed blue. They appeared to be capable of mimicking speech, as one was witnessed saying, "Feed me". While these predators were not very fast in terms of running, they did have a means of capturing their prey without usage of their legs: a long, prehensile tongue. Boba Fett once used a globblin to intimidate a captive into providing the bounty hunter with a sought-after possession.

name: Globlour
summary: The Globlours were a sentient species native to a planet in the Outer Rim.

name: Gloovan
summary: Gloovans were a sentient species that possessed a bulky figure and lumpy purple skin. Scram was a Gloovan gangster who led the Scram Gang during the time of the Galactic Empire. The Gloovan sniper Glunge worked alongside the swoop racer Kuru in an attempt to capture the bounty on the smuggler Han Solo during the Rion Swoop, but was disarmed by the Jedi Luke Skywalker.

name: Glothian
summary: The Glothians were a sentient species in the galaxy. While in the Mandalah system, a group of rebels heard a rude space traveler say they should get bullied by the Glothians from their onboard communicators.

name: Glottalphib
summary: The Glottalphibs were a reptilian sentient species indigenous to the planet Glottal.

name: Glow worm
summary: Glow worms, or glowworms, were a type of microscopic worm that glowed and could be found on the Hutt Space planet Nal Hutta. In 382 BBY, the Evereni Path of the Open Hand cult member Marda Ro noted glow worms did not light for as long as flutterbugs did after she saw a number of the bugs glowing while walking at night on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. During Nal Hutta's summer in 229 BBY, glow worms infested soil samples the Hutt Churo kept in his greenhouse laboratory. Churo recalled the incident a year later when speaking with his sister Dahara Devirsivik Norri.

name: Glowbug
summary: Glowbugs were a type of bioluminescent bug that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Valo during its warm season. In 229 BBY, several glowbugs flew through Valo's Lonisa City Zoo and cast their fluorescent light to the ground below as the Jedi youngling Gavi and the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem conversed near the former's escape shuttle. At one point, Keem pointed toward the planet's sky, tracing the path of a glowbug.

name: Glowdart
summary: Glowdarts were small insectoids native to the planet Wielu. They had a symbiotic relationship with the indigenous sloat, a snake-like creature. Glowdarts were used to break into Traygura's base by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and smuggler Rook Pryce.

name: Glowen Faquidde's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Glowen Faquidde was a member of this species.

name: Glowfish
summary: Glowfish were a type of fish found on the planet Sibensko. They had blue-white fins and traveled in schools.

name: Glowfly
summary: Glowflies were a type of fly that buzzed and flickered. Between 229 BBY and 228 BBY, the former Nihil pirate Krix Kamerat returned to a room in an abandoned apartment building where he and the former Jedi Padawan Ruu were interrogating the Nihil Haakon Pav. After entering the room, Kamerat thought about how the faulty power cell in the lantern lighting the room was buzzing and flickering like glowflies trapped in a bottle.

name: Glowzee
summary: Glowzees were a species of bioluminescent flying insects.

name: Glumbrig eel
summary: Glumbrig eels were eels that resided on the planet of Manaan and the third moon of Antine.

name: Glurrg
summary: Glurrgs were a species of non-sentient, bipedal creatures that were employed as workers for the Gungan civilization of the planet Naboo. Although glurrgs typically did not communicate in Galactic Basic Standard, they were skilled in a variety of areas, including farming, construction, fishing, hunting, and mining ores and nova crystals for use in building and maintaining Gungan settlements. Besides being capable of harvesting carbon from trees for conversion into duraplast at carbon processing centers, glurrgs were efficient laborers who compared favorably with the labor droids used by contemporaneous civilizations. Glurrgs were a pivotal part of Gungan society since at least 3000 BBY. During the War of the Gungan tribes, the creatures were used as laborers by all of the Gungan tribal factions involved in the conflict. Glurrgs continued to contribute valuable labor to Gungan society up to and during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY by the Trade Federation cartel. Glurrgs helped construct a monument at the recapture of Spinnaker to rally Gungan forces against the invading Trade Federation Droid Army and assisted in the Liberation of Harte Secur, which drew battle droid forces away from Naboo's capital city of Theed in a diversionary assault.

name: Gluss'sa'Nikto
summary: Gluss'sa'Nikto, or Pale Nikto, were a Nikto subspecies. They came from the Gluss'elta Islands of Kintan, causing them to be natural sailors. They had white-gray skin, eye-horns like the Kadas'sa'Nikto, and fins similar to those of the Esral'sa'Nikto, but smaller. Xenobiologists believed the first Gluss'sa'Nikto to have been born of a Kadas'sa'Nikto who mated with an Esral'sa'Nikto.
distinctions: Eye-horns like Kadas'sa'Nikto, fins similar to those of Esral'sa'Nikto

name: Glymphid
summary: The Glymphid were a sentient species with orange or red colored eyes and beige, blue, gray, green, and yellow colored skin. The podracer Aldar Beedo from Ploo II was a Glymphid.

name: Gnasp
summary: Gnasps were wasp-like insects native to the moon of Alaris in the Kashyyyk system, Alaris Prime. They were very large creatures that nested in giant underground holes and would attack in swarms. Gnasps had fang-like teeth and large stingers. Anakin Skywalker and Bera Kazan encountered these creatures during their time on the Wookiee-dominated moon, shortly before the battle of Alaris Prime. The fluttercraft used as patrol vehicles on Kashyyyk were named after these creatures.

name: Gnat
summary: Gnats were small creatures that lived on the planet Vorlag, congregated in swarms, and ate rotting meat. There was a large number of them outside Slussen Urla-fir Kal Kethin-wa Canker's palace because of the large amount of flesh stored there to be fed to his hroth-beasts.

name: Gnithian insect
summary: A species of nearly-extinct Gnithian insect was responsible for transmission of ix dbukrii in the wild. They sucked blood, and apparently fed on Gnithian oeps, which were the primary host of the ix dbukrii.

name: G'nook
summary: G'nooks were a species of non-sentient, ape-like humanoids. They were known for their lack of intelligence, which some postulated was due to their very small brain. While attending the New Republic Dagobah Tech school in 5 ABY, the young Jedi Prince Ken learned of the g'nooks as a part of his study of exobiology. Indeed, when Ken took the Dagobah Tech aptitude tests, several of the exobiology questions concerned that species. Accordingly, the Jedi Prince considered the test so ridiculous that only a g'nook could have designed its questions.
distinctions: Ape-like features, small brain, lack of intelligence

name: Gnooroop
summary: The gnooroop was a fish that lived within the seas of Aquaris, a completely ocean-covered world in the Expansion Region. Gnooroop traveled together in extremely dense schools that could reach up to 10 kilometers long, and were often hunted by Aquaris' menacing demonsquid. Gnooroop eggs were noted for being especially slippery.

name: Gnort
summary: Gnorts were herbivorous herd animals from Naboo. Gnort meat was comestible. The cookbook Essential Cooking Skills detailed how to best cook that meat. These creatures were sold as dried meat by Tasty Dried Critters franchise on Tatooine.

name: Gnort
summary: A gnort was a herbivorous animal that lived on the lush Mid Rim planet Naboo. While serving as a pilot for the Galactic Empire on Naboo, Litus Rowf's squadron kept a pet gnort in their hangar bay for years, which they named Titan. In an interview conducted by holojournalist Corwi Selgrothe for the New Republic Heritage Division, Rowf described the gnort as a little herbivore that hopped around and looked cute.

name: Goa lawah
summary: The goa lawah were a native species of bird on the planet Vortex. Their saliva contained toxic bacteria. The birds constructed nests in the grassy plains of Vortex, where they laid their eggs.

name: Gobindi
summary: The Gobindi were the native people of the planet Gobindi. They were master architects, responsible for the huge ziggurats found in the deep jungles of the planet. These ziggurats were built to contain a deadly virus the Gobindi had discovered in the jungle. Despite this, the Gobindi were completely wiped out by the Gobindi virus. They managed to create an antidote, but it was too late save them. The formula for this antidote was carved into the walls of the ziggurats.

name: Godoan
summary: The Godoans were a sentient species of deeply religious people who had a great reverence for the Dancing Goddess idol. They originated from the Godo system.

name: Gogomar
summary: Gogomars were creatures of Ansion. They were used as sacrifices by the shamans of the Alwari. They would read the entrails of the dead gogomar in order to resolve important affairs.

name: Gohai
summary: Gohai were a non-sentient quadruped species that could be found throughout the Expansion Region. With a well-muscled body comparable in size to large predators like the gundark or nexu, they had a long, thick tail. Their faces had two eyes, a flat nose, pointed ears, and a single wide mouth filled with sharp pointed teeth. The jaw also had a distinctly triangular-shaped pair of mandibles with their narrowest point jutting toward the creature's anterior. Gohai had a narrow waist, digitigrade limbs and the robust torso came to a peak between the shoulder blades. The Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook recommended that if they charged at a being, the target should drop to the ground. The bounty hunter Ro-San Borokki mentioned gohai when she wrote "The Hunt," a chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook.
distinctions: Torso that peaked between shoulder blades

name: Gokob
summary: Gokobs were a species of friendly, hairless rodents found in the canopies of the forests of Ossus. When frightened, they sprayed a stinking mist. Gokobs spent much of their time scavenging off food scraps and potams from the Jedi academy kitchens. Many escaped offworld, stowing aboard the many ships departing from the Academy during the New Jedi Order's use of it.

name: Goldfish
summary: Goldfish were fish that were consumable amongst Quarren.

name: Goldie
summary: Goldies were domestic fish, sometimes used to create a peaceful atmosphere in a room. Some were kept at the Jedi Academy on Ossus.

name: Gondar
summary: Gondar were a species of tusked creatures. Their tusks were used to make Gondar tusk masks.

name: Gooberfish
summary: Gooberfish were a species of fish found in the oceans of Naboo. When an Opee sea killer attacked the Bongo after viewing it as food, Jar Jar Binks referred to it as a "big gooberfish." At some point during Skoova Stev's time with Captain Wan'yek Whett aboard the Grapnel, they tried to sell the carcass of a gooberfish on Manaan.

name: Goorl
summary: A Goorl was a mammal-like creature that possibly came from Roon.

name: Gorach
summary: The Gorach were a sentient species.

name: Gorak
summary: Gorak was a species of bird that was native to the world of Alderaan. Roast gorak bird was sometimes cooked in malla petals. A Twi'lek vendor sold gorak on Asylum. Shortly after their rescue, the Outlander witnessed a customer request four orders of gorak from him.

name: Gorax
summary: Gorax were a semi-sentient species of seldom-seen giant humanoids that inhabited the mountains of Endor. They sometimes attacked the villages of the Ewoks, who were among the sentient inhabitants of the moon.

name: Gordelian
summary: Gordelians were a large, bloated, and slow-moving sentient species hailing from the Nishmar system, on the fringe of the Unknown Regions. They were often considered lazy and rarely seen away from their homeworld.

name: Gorg
summary: Gorgs, also known as chubas, was a general term used for several species of amphibians used as food by many different sentient species. They were available for seven wupiupi in the markets of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine, During the Naboo Crisis, the Gungan Jar Jar Binks attempted to use his long tongue to grab one from a stall for free. The Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic often ate gorgs, swallowing one live at the Boonta Eve Classic podrace and thirty-six years later in his palace. Kadas'sa'Nikto were also known to eat gorgs live.

name: Gorg Singo's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Gorg Singo was a member of this species.

name: Gorger
summary: The gorger, sometimes referred to as a hunter by Koboh locals, was a species of pack-hunting animal that was indigenous to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. They were lithe and agile, and had black skin with yellow mottling. Gorgers were effective at stalking and cornering their prey, but were naturally cautious. Indeed, gorgers would only strike their target when certain, before lunging at them with their sharp claws and lethal fangs. At several points, hungry gorgers killed priorite prospectors, including one who had attempted to escape prison by sneaking through dark caverns below the jail.

name: Gorgodon
summary: The Gorgodon was an aggressive species of reptilian native to the planet Ilum. They were known to be extremely dangerous.

name: Gorgy-bird
summary: A gorgy-bird was a creature after which the Rogue Squadron tactic, Wobbly as a mother Gorgybird, was named. Female gorgy birds wobbled in flight after giving birth. However, this wobbling was only a ruse to lure predators away from the nest.

name: Gorian Shard's species
summary: A sentient plant-like species was active in the galaxy. The Pirate King Gorian Shard was a member of this species.

name: Gorm
summary: The Gorms were a reptilian species from the moon Gormdin. Though they survived by hunting, they were known to be a peaceful race. The Galactic Empire legalized hunting Gorms for sport. When the New Republic came to power, Gorm hunting was made illegal.

name: Gorm-worm
summary: Gorm-worms were a type of worm.
