After Commission for the Preservation of the New Order agent Paramiah Shrove confiscated a spacer's strongbox in the Chorlian sector because it contained the book that would become known as the Smuggler's Guide, Chief Imperial Inspector Hedge Devlin left a note on the box's intake form criticizing Shrove for confiscating objectionable literature instead of spice and calling the agent a gorm-worm.

name: Gormaanda's species
summary: A grayish-brown-skinned humanoid species found within the galaxy on planets like Tatooine. Gormaanda was a member of this species.

name: Gormak
summary: The Gormak were a reptilian sentient species in the galaxy. The Nihil pirate Trilok was a Gormak who served in the Tempest of Tempest Runner Pan Eyta during the High Republic Era.

name: Gornalak
summary: The gornalak was a carnivorous reptilian species native to Taraloon. They inhabited the caves and tunnels of the planet. Being at the top of the native food chain, they had no natural predators—maybe with the exception of the pirate Chillo Sanpona who hunted Gornalak for sports.

name: Gornt
summary: The gornt was a domesticated, omnivorous creature native on the world of Hethar; it was introduced to many agriworlds, including Pakrik Minor.

name: Gorocco
summary: The gorocco was a species of maned creature native to the planet Koboh. It had orange skin and a black mane, and it had a pair of tusks. It was large, capable of growing above 1.82 meters in height. Goroccos had a hierarchal pack structure which usually had a gorocco matriarch as the leader. Gorocco made their homes in the bluffs and crevices of Koboh, and were keen on territorial defense. The species was powerful and fast, notable for hurling objects at potential adversaries.

name: Gorog
summary: The Gorog was a gargantuan beast used in the Tarko-se Arena on Cato Neimoidia. The immense, bipedal creature possessed a hunched stance, two human-like hands with opposable thumbs, two hearts, and four tusks protruding from its lower jaw. The Gorog was ordered released by Baron Merillion Tarko, against the advice of an aide concerned about the arena's untested restraint system, as a last-ditch effort to stop Galen Marek's clone from rescuing Jedi General Rahm Kota from the arena. This act of recklessness would prove fatal for Baron Tarko, as he was killed by the indiscriminate giant.

name: Gorothite
summary: The Gorothites were humanoid sentients indigenous to Goroth Prime. In their own language they were called "B'Dellyi (sing. B'Del)," which meant "the People."
skinColor: Brown to green with black markings

name: Gorph
summary: Gorphs were an amphibious sentient species who were native to the Forest Moon of Endor. They possessed green skin, and bluish-gray eyes with yellow sclera. Additionally, each of their hands possessed three webbed finger, and a singular protrusion was present atop their heads. One winter, the Ewok shaman Logray of Endor's Bright Tree Village claimed to Princess Kneesaa that the legendary Krooloks could eat Gorphs in a single bite. In 4 ABY, after thwarting the Imperial officer Tern Koyatta's attempted retrieval of an Imperial weapons cache, the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village invited several of their neighbors to an event, with the intent of promoting unity on the moon. At least one Gorph was present at the event, wearing a red and purple garment and handing an animal skull to Logray.
distinctions: Protrusion on the top of the head

name: Gorpion
summary: Gorpions were insects found on the desert planet Pasaana. They were often eaten by Pasaana's oki-poki.

name: Gorryl slug
summary: Gorryl slugs, also called protoplasmic slugs, were large, carnivorous slugs indigenous to the forests of the planet Kashyyyk. They were usually 1.5 meters long and could grow to a length of 2.5 meter and had brown skin and purple eyes on stalks. Gorryl slugs would usually calmly slither on the branches of the second levels of the larger wroshyr trees, grazing on small mites and other organisms in the tree's bark. The gorryls could be relatively quick for their size and if provoked, would raise it's body and "stand up" to appear threatening and would attack by smothering their opponents. Their stomachs could digest prey the size of one larger individual. Gorryl slugs were also highly resistant to damage and as such most creatures of Kashyyyk avoided them if angered due to their relentlessness and difficulty to kill. They also hung from tree branches, waiting to fall upon prey below. Wrapping its body around the prey, a slug would smother its prey and exude digestive juices, dissolving its prey to absorb nutrients. It was not only surely lethal to be attacked and slowly eaten by this creature, but it was extremely slow and painful. Most of the creature's deadliness came from the fact that it was nearly impossible to remove from its prey once it had attached itself. The slugs, usually brown in color, were excellently camouflaged against the wroshyr trees on which they lived. Although usually seen as visually disgusting, the gorryl slugs were considered to taste pleasantly and were at one point harvested and eaten as delicacies throughout the galaxy. Jacen Solo once enlisted a giant slug to defend his group of young jedi from Zekk and his Shadow Academy stormtroopers. The slug was unaffected by several blaster bolts and was able to knock several stormtroopers off a tree, sending them to their deaths on the forest floor below.

name: Gorset
summary: Gorset were a species native to Rhamalai. They roamed the plains of Rhamalai in herds of five to two hundred, and were easily domesticated. Denel Moonrunner had a gorset, Chaser, as a pet. Gorset were used to provide power for Rhamalian farm equipment and as transport, and could carry 150 - 200 kilograms.

name: Gorsian dragonfly
summary: The Gorsian dragonfly was a flying insect native to Gorse, a planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. Its multicolored wings were similar to those of the Thunian wart-hornet.

name: Gort
summary: Gorts were small creatures with blue feathers. They had a flat beak, three toes, a thin tail, and three eye stalks with one eye on top. They were kept as pets, and their eggs (whose shells were a translucent pinkish-pearl) were considered valuable in many cultures. Nicta was a gort.

name: Gorth
summary: Gorths were a type of creature with a tail that attracted flies. When New Republic pilot Norra Wexley flew through the innards of the second Death Star battle station during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, she mentally compared the TIE/ln space superiority starfighters that swarmed after her to flies on a gorth's tail. Later that year, she remembered the comparison in a dream while on the planet Akiva.

name: Gorum
summary: The Gorum were a species of humanoids with prehensile tails. They used these tails to hang from trees when they went to sleep. They had large red eyes and forked tongues which could suck fluids from food. Tormey was a member of this species.

name: Gorvin snu
summary: Gorvin snu were a species of small lizard-like creatures that inhabited the desert planet Arvala-7. Skittish quadrupeds, they could be found on the world in 9 ABY, when the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin encountered them.

name: Gosfambling
summary: Gosfamblings were a delicately-furred sentient species native to Gosfambling who were soft spoken and had whiskers. C-Gosf was a Gosfambling senator in the New Republic. They were wary of losers, thus if one lost any type of election, they could not run again.

name: Gossam
summary: Gossams were a diminutive blue-skinned species native to the planet Castell located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Several Gossams, such as Shu Mai and Amita Fonti, allied themselves with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
distinctions: Wrinkled skin, squat body, long neck

name: Gotal
summary: Gotals were a species of humanoid sentients native to the moon Antar 4. They were common throughout the galaxy and could be seen on many planets.

name: Gotarite
summary: Gotarites were a mole-like sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had pink skin, green eyes, a pair of powerful incisors, low-light vision, and an excellent sense of smell. Fugas Fandita, who was present at the Lodge on Vandor, was a member of this species. Filias and Soont Madas were two prospector and inventor brothers on Koboh who were Gotarites as well.

name: Gotiard
summary: The Gotiards were a sentient species that grew up to three meters in height. They were simian in physique, with heads that resembled goats. A traditional greeting among Gotiard males involved rubbing and slapping each other's chests. This practice was not expected to be replicated by outsiders, although in their interaction with the wider galaxy, some non-Gotiards imitated the practice in order to fit in with the beings. These attempts provided much amusement for the Gotiards.

name: Gotis
summary: A Gotis was a diminutive creature considered to be extremely rare. Brimey was a member of the species.

name: Gouge-beetle
summary: Gouge-beetles were a type of beetle native to the sandy deserts of Pasaana. These creatures would eat meat, having picked Ochi's bones clean after he had died in the caverns.

name: Gouka dragon
summary: Gouka dragons were immense creatures that lived underground on Aargonar. They used high body temperatures to create tunnels of fused rock in which they lived. They preyed on sarlaccs, but were uninterested in smaller creatures. They could be attracted by engine noise.

name: Govian
summary: Govians were a sentient species from the Govia system. A female member of this species was a receptionist at one of Dr. Cornelius Evazan's "clinics" who was stunned unconscious by Jodo Kast as he pursued the bounty on Evazan's head.

name: Gozzo
summary: The Gozzo were a sentient species that were native to the planet Drahgor III which was located in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. Han Solo negotiated with a group of Gozzo living on Troiken during the Galactic Civil War. Flix, Flanx, and Floog were members of this species.

name: Gra
summary: Gra were herd mammals raised by farmers on a number of planets.

name: Graadorian
summary: The Graadorians were a sentient species who developed an agrarian society on their homeworld, Graador. Located in the Mid Rim, the Graadorians' planet came to share its name with the Graador sector. The Graadorians drew scant attention from the Galactic Empire, the ruling authority in the galaxy during the Imperial Era, and for that reason, their homeworld was identified as a possible sanctuary for the Rebel Alliance Fleet; however, the presence of sentient, mutant mynocks and space slugs dissuaded the Rebel operatives who investigated the planet.

name: Grabworm
summary: Grabworms were giant predatory worms native to Toydaria in Hutt Space. Swamps were grabworms' natural habitat. The Toydarians evolved with wings, allowing them to escape the grabworm's lunges.

name: Grain maggot
summary: Grain maggots were a species of insect which members of the sentient Hutt species would roast and eat. After roasting, most maggots would lie in crispy husks although some would continue to squirm in an attempt to survive, although all would be eaten, dead or alive. In 12 ABY, the Hutt crime lord Durga Besadii Tai had roasted grain maggots served at a meal in his palace on the planet Nal Hutta, which was attended by several of his cousins and the Human diplomats of the New Republic, Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo.

name: Graiveh
summary: The graiveh was a pre-sentient, humanoid creature from the planet Ealor.

name: Grakkt
summary: The Grakkt was a native of marshes and deep swamps on the planet of Naboo. It could grow to about three meters long. The Grakkt roamed the damp grounds of the planet, with a body like a lion with armor, a crocodile-like head and a tail with spikes. Its bite delivered a dangerous venom through its saliva, which, if it was not treated as soon as possible, was fatal.

name: Gralloc
summary: Grallocs were a species of creature related to the mynock. They lived in the vacuum of space, attacking power cables in a similar way to mynocks, but were larger and stronger. Imperial governor Haveland faced issues with grallocs in the Esaga sector, as did Director Orson Krennic at an equipment transfer point associated with Project Stardust.

name: Gran
summary: Gran were a sentient humanoid species native to the planet Kinyen, but had colonies on many worlds such as Malastare, Hok, and Varkana. Identifiable by their three eyes and goat-like snouts, Gran also had small antennae-like nubs on the tops of their head and thick, bulky hands that could either have six large digits or five suction-cup-like digits. Members of this species included the Podracer pilot Mawhonic, the Galactic Republic senators Ask Aak, Philo, Kharrus, as well as the criminal Ree-Yees, who worked for Jabba the Hutt.
distinctions: Small antennae-like nubs on the tops of their heads

name: Grand Theljian snow dog
summary: The Grand Theljian snow dog, or simply known as a snow dog, was a type of large dog that could be kept as a pet.

name: Granik's species
summary: A diminutive species with brown skin and black eyes existed in the galaxy.

name: Granite slug
summary: Granite slugs were a type of small slug found on the ecumenopolis Coruscant. The slugs were silica parasites capable of consuming mineral matter, excreting acidic saliva as they moved across the surface of buildings and then consuming the resulting slime using their two mouths. This left behind trails of acid on the buildings that created rune-like scars in the duracrete. During the Clone Wars, the Senate Rotunda Preservation Committee, a committee within the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate, was responsible for exterminating granite slugs and keeping the Senate Rotunda in the Senate Building architecturally sound.

name: Grannan
summary: The Grannan were a Near-Human species from Granna. Distinguishing features of the Grannan included skin cuffs that allowed them to retract their fingers and toes, respiratory sacs that allowed the breathing of methanogen and loose eye creases. Grannan naming conventions placed the surname before the personal name. A small community of Grannan lived on Polneye until the whole colony was wiped out by the Yevethan Purge, leaving Plat Mallar as the sole survivor.

name: Grantaloupe
summary: The grantaloupe was a four-legged creature that lived on Kashyyyk and was often hunted and eaten by the local Wookiees.

name: Graphin
summary: A graphin was a creature with gray fur. The criminal Melo Tolicus wore a makeshift shawl made of graphin hide while being transported aboard the prison ship Palwick in 132 BBY.

name: Grass cricket
summary: A grass cricket was a type of cricket that lived in grass. In 382 BBY, while Jedi Padawan Kevmo Zink headed toward a river valley on the Outer Rim planet Dalna alongside his Master—Jedi Master Zallah Macri—he noticed there was a funny buzz, which he mentally guessed was some sort of grass cricket. Zink then wondered if he would be on Dalna long enough to learn the names of the planet's wildlife. Several days later, the Padawan and his Master were both killed by the Path of the Open Hand cult that resided on Dalna.

name: Grass frog
summary: Grass frogs were a type of frog that lived in grass on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. In 382 BBY, as the Evereni Path of the Open Hand cult member Marda Ro stepped outside of her cell in the Path compound and saw the nearby meadow, she heard grass frogs singing.

name: Grass hen
summary: Grass hens were a type of hen. In 382 BBY, while in the Ferdan town market on the Outer Rim planet Dalna, Jedi Padawan Kevmo Zink passed by a number of grass hens that had been plucked and strung up by their legs to be sold.

name: Grass kapir
summary: Grass kapirs were a species that could be found on Tython.

name: Grass Trekker
summary: Grass Trekkers were a semi-sentient race native to the forest moon of Endor. They were aggressive and skilled hunters.

name: Grasser
summary: Grassers were six-legged, three-eyed herbivorous ungulates native to Haruun Kal. They were the main transportation of the Korunnai in the jungle, and were protected by akk dogs. Growing as large as two tons in mass, they provided milk (which could be used to make a hard cheese) and were also used to make smoked meat. They ate portaak leaf, glass-fern, thyssel bark, and brassvine thorns. As of 22 BBY, they had been bred for 700 generations.

name: Grassfish
summary: Grassfish were a species of fish that was an ingredient in Grassfish congee. In 3 ABY, Imperial Governor Thorden prepared the congee which including chopping up the fish while waiting to meet with the scoundrel Kay Vess on Renpalli Station above the Outer Rim moon Toshara

name: Grate toad
summary: Grate toads were a type of toad that thrived on heat and waste produced by sentient life. They could be found on the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY.

name: Graul
summary: The graul was a large predator from the planet Dantooine. It was the planet's top predator and similar to the rancors of Dathomir except for the skin tone, which tended to be more green, and a pair of horns protruding from its head. Grauls could be domesticated by skilled beast masters and used as mounts for transportation.

name: Gravel-maggot
summary: Gravel-maggots were worms found in the badlands of the planet Tatooine. They were known to feed on rotting flesh of other creatures. Despite the obscurity of Tatooine, gravel-maggots were infamous throughout the galaxy, and it was a common if uncreative insult to call someone "gravel-maggot" or the "son of a gravel-maggot."

name: Graygl
summary: The Graygl were an aquatic species originally native to Danalbeth. The Graygl relocated to the water-covered planet Iskalon to escape a cataclysm that struck Danalbeth around five millennia before the Galactic Civil War, and became a part of the Iskalonian School, a cultural group of several aquatic species that had traveled to Iskalon with the aid of spacefaring benefactors. Graygl had a fearsome appearance, with a wide mouth filled with sharp teeth and red eyes, although this belied their gentle nature. However, their permanent look of anger allowed them to intimidate many dangerous predators, such as the chiaki.

name: Grayla Stindy's species
summary: A species of white-skinned beings counted among its members Grayla Stindy, an individual who once attended the Canto Casino and Racetrack on the planet Cantonica. Members of the species sported large skin flaps that arced down from their bulbous heads.

name: Grazer Domestic grazer (left) and wild grazer (right)
summary: The grazer was a docile, four legged, slow-moving herbivore native to the planet Alderaan. Bred for their rich source of nutritious and tasty meat and agricultural purposes, grazers were easy to manage and grew to tremendous sizes. Due to many been moved offworld long ago, they cheated extinction of their home world when it was destroyed in 0 BBY. Grazers were also related to the Nerf. Wild grazers were significantly leaner than the fatter and more well-fed domestic grazer.

name: Grazer
summary: Grazers were antlered herbivores who were native to the plains and mountains of the Corporate Sector planet Ammuud. Grazers lived together in massive herds, migrating at a ponderous pace across Ammuud, eating grass, scrub and lichen. The shaggy beasts were extremely large—the smallest adult grazer weighed at least four times that of a full-grown Wookiee—and were sometimes preyed upon by Ammuud's native pterosaurs, who attacked the slowest and weakest in a grazer herd from above. The grazers were quick to stampede when startled by a loud noise or a pterosaur attack, turning their plodding march into something swift and dangerous. One such stampede nearly trampled the Wookiee smuggler Chewbacca on a visit to Ammuud in 2 BBY, although he narrowly managed to escape using a glider crudely fashioned out of a pterosaur's corpse.

name: Grazer
summary: The grazer was a species found on the plains and in the valleys of the planet Troiken. It was preyed upon by packs of cat-like leaptigs.

name: Great ibbot
summary: Great ibbots were a subspecies of ibbot. They lived on the planet Drall and were used by the division of Drall police called the Wingriders.

name: Great oopik
summary: The great oopik, also known simply as the oopik, was a species native to Paramatan. Found in the planet's deep forests, the oopik's vestigial wings were thought to be the evolutionary link between the planet's reptiles and avians. They used echolocation to seek their food and stun them with powerful ultrasonic waves emitted from their throat sacs. The oopik was long thought to be extinct until some small clutches were located during the Galactic Civil War in the southern continent of Grxy.

name: Great thranta
summary: The great thranta was the largest of the thranta species native to the planet Alderaan and became extinct when the world was destroyed. Its size was estimated at being fifteen times longer then the pilotta thranta. This species of the thranta differed as they possessed a white coloration to their skin as well as a long neck ending in a stubby head. Their tail also differed as it was proportionally smaller and lacked the horizontal lobes common to the other species. As was expected, the wings of the beasts possessed strong muscles that allowed them to fly in the skies of their homeworld. Like the other subspecies, they were trainable and would be controlled by handlers who would place a compartment on the back of the beasts head while a larger passenger compartment was placed around its chest. Holograms of the great thranta and many other species that suffered extinction in the destruction of Alderaan were displayed at the Holographic Zoo of Extinct Animals. Lyrre T'enna used the streams there to create sketches to be compiled in a field guide. The species should not be confused with the giant thranta, which was merely a large breed of the common thranta.

name: Greater krayt dragon
summary: The greater krayt dragon was a large species of krayt dragon, predatory reptiles from Tatooine. Using its ten strong legs, it literally swam through the shifting sands.

name: Greater nasal nesting spit-crawler
summary: The greater nasal nesting spit-crawler was a type of parasitic worm of the spit-crawler variety. It could infest the snouts of the domesticated species known as happabores, which were found on planets across the Western Reaches. Along with lesser nasal nesting spit-crawlers, greater nasal nesting spit-crawler infestations could be treated with Happy-Bore Medicated Dewormer, a Galacti-Stok product that contained Trestibinexocycline 5-Gamma, thlank oil, greel-root acid and forage products. The slurry formulation of the dewormer had instructions recommending both types of spit-crawler as targets for the product's use. By 34 ABY, the scavenger Rey had found a copy of the slurry formulation instructions while living on the desert planet Jakku. She then included the instructions alongside information about happabores on Jakku in a survival guide that she compiled.

name: Gree
summary: The Gree were a little-known alien species with tentacles who were native to the Gree system of the Gree Enclave in the Outer Rim Territories. They also shared their name with the Outer Rim astronomical object Gree. Like the Aing-Tii, the Gree exhibited neural activity that greatly resembled the motion and reactions of the plasma within ancient wayfinders. After developing an early interest in alien species, the Clone Commander designated CC-1004 chose to nickname himself Gree upon completion of his advanced training on the planet Kamino. His hope was that he could identify others who shared his interests by provoking a reaction to his nickname, as anyone who recognized the name of the obscure Gree species was likely interested in exobiology.

name: Greel screamer
summary: Greel screamers were a non-sentient avian predator native to the forests of the planet Pii IV. They were capable of flight and had a carnivorous diet. Greel screamers resided in greel trees, often in groups of four to eight. The avian was named for their cries when their territory was threatened. The greel screamer featured a 0.75 meters long reptilian body, toothy beak, and flexible wings with a wingspan of 1.5 meters. Though the Greel Wood Logging Corporation took precautions to flush the hostile avian from trees before cutting them down, attacks from greel screamers could occur during logging. This threat demanded workers to be assigned "crimson duty" to defend the others. Sometime during the Galactic Civil War, a group of individuals joined a logging crew of the Greel Wood Logging Corporation to evade Imperial forces on Pii IV. While assisting the crew, the individuals fought off greel screamers.

name: Greelor
summary: The greelor was a quadrupedal carnivore. It had seven-toed feet, pale scales, a long tail, and a long, toothsome snout.

name: Green-scaled marsh hawk
summary: The Green-scaled marsh hawk was a creature native to the planet Lowick.

name: Greenbeak
summary: A greenbeak was a type of non-sentient animal found on the planet Vulta. Greenbeaks made a quacking noise and at times swam in bodies of water. In the year 3653 BBY, smuggler Zeerid Korr went to Karson's Park on Vulta to deliver a hoverchair to his crippled daughter, Arra Yooms. While he was in the park, there were some greenbeaks swimming in the pond, and Yooms was feeding them with food that she had bought from a utility droid that was cleaning the park. Once she received her chair, she proceeded to chase the creatures around the park.

name: "Greenie"
summary: "Greenies" was a nickname the Galactic Empire gave to one of the species native to the planet of Mimban. Although they did not take part in the insurgency, unlike the red-skinned Mimbanese, the Imperials regarded them as thieves, and suspected them of conducting reconnaissance for insurgents. Therefore, they were not allowed in Imperial camps unescorted.

name: Greenstripe
summary: Greenstripes were a species of venomous insect present on the planet Shihon. Unlike most toxic insects known to the Chiss Ascendancy, Greenstripes neither poisoned their victims by stinging them nor biting them. Instead, Greenstripes spat poisonous saliva at their targets. Greenstripes rarely attacked Chiss, but the Agbui Shimkif induced one to attack the Chiss mid-ager Yomie during the Great Migration to incapacitate the young woman. Once Yomie was incapacitated, Shimkif could "read" her emotions and the Agbui could advance their scheme to destroy the Ascendancy.

name: Greethka
summary: The Greethka was a large species of creature that lived on the planet Prakith.

name: Grefna
summary: Grefnas were avian beasts native to the planet Onderon. Their prominent cranial spine nerves allowed flock members to visually track others through the undergrowth due to ultraviolet striations on the planet's surface, and served to fend off predators. The "Fiery" grefna was a breed of grefna that could be won by attendees of the Star Cluster Casino and Club Vertica Casino.

name: Gregonian salamander
summary: The Gregonian salamander was a type of fire-resistant salamander from the Expansion Region's Gregonia system. In 1 ABY, the Shi'ido geneticist Mammon Hoole attempted to trap the bounty hunter Boba Fett in the engine room of his starship, the Shroud. However, Fett fired a wrist rocket from his suit's wrist rocket launcher at the ship's ion drive, which caused an explosion. In response to the flames, Hoole shape-shifted into a Gregonian salamander. Afterward, Hoole told his adoptive son, Zak Arranda, that had he not morphed into a Gregonian salamander, the flames would have killed him.

name: Gretalax
summary: The Gretalax was a semi-sentient Force-sensitive species native to the Galactic Frontier planet Loreth. It consisted of two races, the Greta and the Lax, which would join together in symbiotic mated pairs. When joined together, a Gretalax had the power of Force healing, capable of fully restoring even serious injuries. Gretalax horn could be ground into a potion which granted its users great strength. Around 231 BBY during the High Republic Era, Loreth was settled by a group of colonists led by Layton Wyke. Having heard of the properties of Gretalax horn, Wyke and a group of his followers wanted to brew the potion for themselves. They captured the Lax of a Gretalax living on the mountain Temple Peak, but were unable to capture the Greta, which attacked the settlement in an attempt to free its mate. Wyke decided to hire Ty Yorrick, a former Jedi Padawan turned monster hunter, to slay the Greta, but concealed the truth, with him and his archaeologist Tapel lying that they had never heard of the Gretalax before coming to Loreth. Yorrick, however, eventually discovered the truth, and put an end to Wyke's plans, exposing him to the residents of Wyke Town.
distinctions: Symbiotic pairing of Greta and Lax

name: Greysor
summary: The Greysor was a four legged, carnivorous primate from the planet of Naboo. It was long used during hunts and birding parties by the Nabooian aristocracy. [[File:Greysor2-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A domestic greysor.]] Wild greysors hunted in packs of 2 to 12 individuals. They hunted mostly rodents and shaaks, but occasionally scavenged carrion. When hunting, they relied on the sense of sight more than smell. Wild greysors were known to be plagued by fleas. There were several varieties of domesticated greysor—stubtail, bounder, and manadept being the most common. Domesticated greysors were most often kept in kennels; it was considered "unwise" to keep greysors and twirrls together. Greysors were born one at a time. They burrowed with their mother until they were mature (four to six weeks old). Greysors had nonretractable claws, ideal for running fast. To keep them balanced while running they had an aerodynamic tail.

name: Griagh
summary: The Griagh was a monstrous, four-headed creature that dwelled in a large cave system on Endor. Although it was long considered to be legendary, the Griagh was real indeed, and it was awakened late in the Galactic Civil War, when the Galactic Empire established a bunker on the moon. After leaving a trail of devastation, the Griagh was killed by the power of the Sunstar, which was destroyed in the process.

name: Griff
summary: Griffs were deer-like creatures native to Masterhome. The smell of griff-meat drove eaters into a feeding frenzy.

name: Grigna
summary: Grigna was a rare and little-known species used as beasts of burden. Their unusually high intelligence had seen their popularity increase among beast tamers across the galaxy around the third Galactic War.

name: Grillik
summary: The wild grillik was a large reptilian creature native to the jungle-moon of Nallastia. Covered in scales, the reptile had six muscular legs and a long, lean body. Its jaws encased three rows of very sharp teeth. Grilliks were generally peaceful, but they could be extremely territorial, especially toward those who wandered too close to their nests. The Margravine Quenelle issued sentences of death to poachers of Nallastian wildlife. In 23 BBY, in the grassy foothills of Nallastia's Mount Octan, an 18-year-old Jedi Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, crash-landed a CloakShape fighter that he'd borrowed from Senator Rodd while on a mission to Fondor. On his first night on Nallastia, near the jungle-fringes of his campsite, Skywalker came face to face with a wild grillik, which he battled and drove back into the dense jungle growth, relatively unharmed but with the admonition, "Let that be a lesson to you."

name: Grindalid
summary: Grindalids were a annelid sentient species native to Persis IX, an Expansion Region planet with a dense atmosphere that blocked out the light of its star. As such, they had photosensitive skin that caused them to burn very easily when exposed to sunlight. Lady Proxima led the White Worms on Corellia during the Imperial Era, alongside fellow Grindalids Moloch and Jabbat. Han Solo later exploited her vulnerability to light in order to escape the lair.

name: Grinjer
summary: A grinjer was a creature that could be found on Sorgan. The grinjer's bones could be turned into bone broth, a type of soup. In 9 ABY, the Mandalorian human Din Djarin ordered the broth from a tavern on the planet for Grogu he protected. The tavern's proprietor, Dara Vish, informed him that he was in luck, as she had recently killed a grinjer, providing an ample amount of the soup.

name: Grobel
summary: The grobel were creatures from the planet Minfar. They resided underground, where their scales helped them carve tunnels through the rock. The grobel would attack the native Zixon, who would use xinda flower dust to keep the creatures away.

name: Gronda
summary: The gronda was an elephant-like animal that lived on Corellia's plains. The Teräs Käsi attack of gronda stomp was named after the creature.

name: Ground-eel
summary: Ground-eels were a species of animal found on the planet Qiilura that made fluting courtship calls when attempting to find a mate. In 22 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Etain Tur-Mukan heard the mating calls of several ground-eels while she was hiding in a field of barq on Qiilura.

name: Grounger
summary: A grounger was a porcine creature found on Endor. Chirpa jumped onto a grounger's back and wrestled it onto the ground before binding its feet with a lasso, in order to demonstrate to the younger Ewoks how to capture a grounger.

name: Grove harrier
summary: Grove harriers were predatory birds from Kashyyyk. They ate mallakins.

name: Growzer
summary: Growzers were a species of domesticated animals present on the planet Celwis. Lakphro and his family owned a group of growzers used to raise and herd their Yubals. One of their growzers was named Slobber, who was trained to come at the sound of a jacket sealer. Growzers were also referenced in multiple turns of phrase, including "son of a growzer" and "Some days you're the growzer, and some days you're the growzer's son."

name: Grub toad
summary: Grub toads were a creature that the Tulgah witch Morag threatened to turn her beast into if it did not chase after the Ewoks Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka and Wicket Warrick in 3 ABY.

name: Grub worm
summary: A Grub worm was a type of worm.

name: Gruffin
summary: Gruffins were a species of non-sentient creatures. Gruffins could produce milk and wool, while their fat could be used to create soap and their meat could be eaten as food. Gruffin herds were present in a farming settlement on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

name: Grumph
summary: Grumphs were large lizards that were native Nimba Five. Their bodies covered with spines, and each hand was capped with sharp claws. No Human before the lucky Sam Heggs had ever survived to see one. Their eggs were purple and were found in shallow pits of snow.

name: Grutchin
summary: The grutchin was a bioengineered weapon used by the Yuuzhan Vong that resembled a half-meter long, black, winged, locust-like insect.

name: Gruthic Winged Beast
summary: Gruthic Winged Beasts were large non-sentient creatures having a pair of wings, two heads perched atop long flexible necks, a long tail, scaly gray-green skin and four limbs ending in sharp claws. Their heads featured two white eyes without pupils, a pair of slit nostrils, a nasal horn, a large mouth containing sharp fangs and a pink tongue, and an elongated chin with horn-like growths. When agitated, Winged Beasts emitted shrill, frantic cries. In 3 BBY, the gangster Tomith Garbis owned one, which he used as a combat mount. That beast notably saw action on the planet of Thune, when Garbis confronted the freedom fighters Sabine Wren and Garazeb Orrelios over a few unclaimed cargo containers.
distinctions: Twin heads, long tail, wings, nasal horn

name: Gruvian
summary: The Gruvians were the native sentients of the planet Gruvia in the Expansion Region.

name: Grysk
summary: The Grysks were a warlike sentient species that hailed from a planet in the Unknown Regions. Known to be half of myth, the Grysks were a nomadic warrior society that ruled an empire known as the Grysk Hegemony. They used a common script and a rare language. According to Chiss Grand Admiral Thrawn, they should not be underestimated and, if they fled, it would be because they chose to leave the battle. Thrawn believed that the Grysks were such a danger that they posed a threat to both the Chiss Ascendancy and the Galactic Empire. The Grysk army that attempted to overthrow the Chiss Ascendancy was led by a Grysk by the name of Jixtus who was killed by Senior Captain Thrawn and Admiral Ar'alani.

name: Gryzard
summary: Gryzards were gator-like carnivores that lived in the murky waters of the planet Veelo. During or after 18 BBY, a group of gryzards attacked the bounty hunter Fennec Shand and the clones Hunter and Wrecker as they traveled along a river on Veelo in a hydroskiff. After one dragged Hunter into the river, the group managed to fend off the creatures and escape on their vessel.

name: Gu-vandi
summary: The Gu-vandi were a sentient species. They were governed by the Gu-vandi Collective, and their area of space included the world Praven Prime, home to the L'Xing species. At some point by 3951 BBY, an HK-50 series assassin droid posing as a translator intentionally mistranslated a L'Xing language phrase, causing a civil war between the Gu-vandi Collective and the L'Xing. As a result of the conflict, the Galactic Republic withdrew its presence from Gu-vandi space.

name: Gualama
summary: Gualama were a species of herbivorous animal found on the grasslands of the planet Naboo. To describe someone as "Gualama-loving" was considered an insult, and during a family meal at their home on Saleucami the Imperial-loyal Webb Taffral used the term to against his brother Dav Taffral, who had joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

name: Guanomonger
summary: Guanomongers were a coprophagous species from the Outer Rim planet of Skye. They lived in the Entyrmion, a vast cavern complex located under the mountain ranges of Skye, and fed on skingle feces.

name: Guaqa
summary: The guaqa was a type of burrowing lizard that was capable of curling into a ball and was found on a desert planet. At some point during the Imperial Era, a pit was dug into the planet by individuals enslaved by the Galactic Empire. A guaqa helped one prisoner—a human named Crux—escape the pit by creating holes in the wall for him to grab onto when climbing out of the pit. Later, a guaqa observed a mural created by a painter in the pit.

name: Guarlara
summary: The guarlara were a species of non-sentient quadrupeds indigenous to the planet Naboo.
distinctions: Four legs, elongated muzzle, upright ears, curved horns

name: Guba bird
summary: Guba birds were a species of birds. They made their nests on the mountains of the Forest Moon of Endor. The young Ewok Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka once ordered her close friends to help her take jinjang berries to some baby guba birds nested on the top of a mountain.

name: Gubbur
summary: The Gubbur was a frog like creature native to Corellia. It had a long boney ridge coming from its nose and two antennae coming out of its mouth. Gubburs had three long whiskers, useful for sensing tectonic motion and could possibly predict earthquakes. It could also be found on Endor.

name: Guda fish
summary: Prized by trophy fishermen, guda fish were the largest fish found in the icy oceans of Neftali. They could grow three meters long, but were very thin, providing little (but succulent) meat.

name: Gueal
summary: The Gueal was a sentient species with red eyes, slit pupils, long snouts, and two pointy ears. Members of the species possessed four legs and beige skin. At some point, a Gueal wrote a lament about their journey with love.

name: Guf drolg
summary: Guf drolgs were large hostile reptilian creatures native to the planet Talus.

name: Gugverm
summary: Gugverms were a type of vicious creature which lived in the slums of Nar Shaddaa, an Outer Rim moon. In his youth, the human Malakili trained gugverms to stop stealing from food stores. With time, the creatures became his pets, friends, and protectors.

name: Guid
summary: Guids were large, hair-covered primates native to the Deep Core planet of Tython. The guid's massive frame was supported by their muscular arms and smaller hind legs, supporting their weight on their knuckles as they walked. Dominating the mountainsides of their homeworld as they grazed on the grassy open spaces, the guid's only natural predator were the primitive sentients known as Flesh Raiders. All other predators on the planet, including the manka cat and horranth, were not intelligent enough to pose a threat to the massive beasts and their strong arms. In 3640 BBY guids could also be found on the ice planet Ilum. Around 3643 BBY, an ill-tempered guid in the Tythos River Delta was driven mad by an unknown ailment and came to pose a threat to others, including its own kind. Members of the Jedi Order then put it down for everyones safety.

name: Guineo
summary: The Guineo were a bipedal, sentient species indigenous to the planet of Dohlban, where they were often used for manual labor. Typically, members of the species were tall and powerfully built. Guineo, however, were not very intelligent and lacked the ability to make complicated decisions, a condition that relegated many Guineo to very basic jobs. Many members of the species were hired off-world by criminal organizations. Among these groups was Haugg Nerf Industries, which was located in the Industrial District on the planet Coruscant. Several Guineo worked at the company, a nerf-meat packing plant that was used as a cover for transporting hallucinogenic death sticks from the crime lord Sebolto on the planet Malastare so that they could be sold on Coruscant. Among the Guineo working at Haugg Nerf Industries were Yol Areebi, J'Meeb Gumb, and Panza Hondi.

name: Gulginaw
summary: Gulginaws were flying creatures native to the planet Corellia. They were also known to live on nearby planet Talus.

name: Gull
summary: Gulls were a species native to the planet Ahch-To. They could emit cawing or crying noise.

name: Gulletbeast
summary: The Gulletbeast was a non-sentient aquatic predator living in the seas of the planet Lamaredd.

name: Gullipud
summary: Gullipuds were bulky, loose-skinned, self-inflating amphibians native to the swamps of Naboo. As they were small and easy prey for other animals, like pikobis, gullipuds would extend their spine to make themselves harder to catch and swallow. When inflated, gullipuds actually bounced. Because of this, they were used in gullipud ball games by the Gungans.

name: Gully rat
summary: Gully rats were a type of rat that thrived on heat and waste, byproducts of sentient life. It could be found on the planet Coruscant. In 19 BBY, while on the world, the Tac-Spec FIII Footman droid Solis thought about how gully rats, among other creatures, had adapted to living amongst the ecumenopolis.

name: Gulmarid
summary: Gulmarids were a sapient reptilian species indigenous to Gulma.

name: Gulper
summary: The gulpers were creatures native to Nim Drovis, a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They occupied the swamps and marshes of Nim Drovis. In 13 ABY, when the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 arrived on the planet along with the starship captain Bortrek, their landing pad was surrounded by swamps filled with gulpers, marsh-gunnies and green-eyed wadie-platts.

name: Gumfish
summary: The gumfish was indigenous to the swamps of Naboo, and a favorite meal of the Gungans. While loved by these amphibious peoples, most other species can't abide the bitter-tasting flesh of this fish. This is largely due to the gumfishes' diet - plants in the waterways of Naboo mostly use chemosynthesis rather than photosynthesis to produce energy. This process creates a sulfurous taste which is passed on to the gumfish.

name: Gundark
summary: Gundarks were vicious carnivorous desert mammals from the planet Vanqor. Renowned for their power and ferocity, the large creatures had sixteen claws and keen hearing. To tell someone that they "looked strong enough to pull the ears off a gundark" meant that they were healthy and strong. At some point prior to Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi's assignment of guarding Senator Padmé Amidala from an assassination attempt, Obi-Wan and Anakin fell into a gundarks' nest, although Anakin reminded Obi-Wan that he went in the nest to rescue Obi-Wan. The gang leader Tasu Leech used a gundark bone as his rifle's grip. A group of gundarks were present in Lexim's hunting ground on a forest planet.

name: Gungan
summary: {{Update|The High Republic: Convergence, The High Republic: Light of the Jedi, The High Republic: Temptation of the Force, Queen's Peril, Queen's Shadow, Last Shot, , Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy}} Gungans were an amphibious sentient species and the indigenous inhabitants of the planet Naboo. The various different Gungan races could live on both water and land, but often made their home in underwater cities such as Otoh Gunga. Physically, Gungans were tall humanoids with a flexible structure, strong leg muscles, strong bills, muscular tongues, and many other traits designed for living in the waters of Naboo. They had strong accents when speaking in Galactic Basic Standard. Gungans were also known to rarely leave Naboo. The Gungans had a tense and uneasy relationship with the non-native human Naboo people until the Trade Federation invasion. As a result of the invasion, the Gungans joined forces with the Naboo to expel the Trade Federation from their homeworld. Following the invasion, Jar Jar Binks would become the Junior Representative of the Gungan people in the Galactic Senate, serving alongside Senator Padmé Amidala of the Naboo.

name: Gungan Bomber
summary: The Gungan Bomber was a flying creature used by the Gungans of Naboo to bomb buildings.

name: Gunlabird
summary: Gunlabirds were avians of Endor eaten by yootaks.

name: Gupin
summary: Gupins were a winged sentient species who at some point thought to have been introduced to the moon Endor on a crashed ark around a millennium before the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. Shortly after the battle, a pair of Gupins visited the Ewok Bright Tree tribe in Bright Tree Village on Endor to share stories and work together.

name: Gurk
summary: Gurks were hairy humanoids native to the planet Lok. Despite their large size and their worrisome appearance, they were very peaceful animals. They ate primarily nuts, berries, and fruit. These creatures were known for their loud yell. The inhabitants of Lok used to capture Gurks and train them for domestic use. The hide of the "Gurk king" was said to be very useful in the construction of armor, especially Reinforced Insulated Sheath armor. During the Galactic Civil War, the Sulfur Lake Pirates trained a large gurk named the Bridge Troll to guard their hideout on Lok. The creature was later killed by a spacer working for Mako Ghast of the Lok Revenants.

name: Gurlanin
summary: The Gurlanins were a polymorphic species native to the planet Qiilura. At their normal state, they were canines with black fur all over their bodies. They had extremely sharp teeth that ran along the length of their snout, with four fangs protruding over their lower lip, each ending in a double point. This gave them a slight, almost comical lisp. All members of the Gurlanin race had orange eyes that were quite disconcerting to other races. However, the average Gurlanin had the ability to assume almost any form to a maximal Size of a full grown Human. Gurlanins were generally considered to be marsupials, and the females had a pouch on their belly in which they carried their young. Their ears were located in their snouts, so that they could use a loud snuffling as echolocation. Their voices were very smooth, and had been remarked upon as being hypnotically soothing, almost like liquid. In addition, Gurlanins were strongly telepathic to other members of their race, and could communicate without speech among themselves, they can also contact people who are sensitive to power. For this reason, the Jedi Etain Tur-Mukan considered the Gurlanin Jinart to be Force users. Although they could not read the minds of beings not of their race. This ability was a natural manifestation of the Force among their kind. As a whole the species were long lived; the average lifespan for a Gurlanin was 700 years. Although the Gurlanins had no love for the Galactic Republic, they agreed to assist it during the height of the Clone Wars after the Separatists established a base of control on Qiilura. Throughout their history, the Gurlanins had been feared or abused by the settlers of Qiilura, and they viewed the Separatists as the worst of the lot. Their assistance to the Republic's forces was given with the singular goal of removing the Separatists and freeing the Gurlanins. After the removal of the Separatists, the Gurlanins then demanded the removal of the Republic settlers (who had helped dislodge the Separatists as well). If the Republic refused to remove the settlers, the Gurlanins threatened to use their natural abilities to sabotage the Republic's war effort. In response, Etain Tur-Mukan led a detachment of clones under Commander Levet to Qiilura to remove the settlers by force if necessary. Complications arose when the settlers — earlier trained and armed by Etain — felt betrayed by the Republic. When two thousand settlers refused to leave after continued deadlines set by Etain, the Gurlanins supplied information to the Separatists which resulted in the loss of a troop transport with over 10,000 men on board. Etain then ordered Levet to remove the settlers by force, an operation that would take several weeks. When all the settlers had been removed, all Gurlanin spies also returned to Qiilura.

name: Gurnaset
summary: The gurnaset was a species of peaceful quadruped herd animal that was native to the world of Lok. It would lay eggs and eat insects and shrubs as well as small animals like frogs or lizards. Its meat was tough and gamy.

name: Gurrcat
summary: Gurrcats were wild carnivorous creatures native to the planet Corellia. They roamed the Corellian plains in packs, and if one of their group members were attacked, the whole pack would savagely defend it. Tamed gurrcats were sometimes used in hunting.

name: Gurreck
summary: Gurrecks were a species of predatory carnivores native to the forest moon of Endor. They had sharp fangs and tusks. The Ewok Teebo wore the skull of a Gurreck on his head despite the risks posed by the hat's fangs. Whenever the Ewoks managed to take down one such beast, they celebrated by throwing a feast, which usually included a special green gravy made with fresh Endorian herbs.

name: Gushiro
summary: Gushiro were small mammals native to the moon Toshara. Possessing densely-furred, slender bodies, they hunted small rodents and insects like the apono moths in the moon's shrublands, which were their primary habitat. Evasive creatures, they could also be found in the moon's settlements eating garbage and often broke into garbage containers, leading many cantinas and restaurants to have strict sanitation rules in order to ward the creatures off.

name: Guswan Askreeth's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Guswan Askreeth was a member of this species.

name: Gutkurr
summary: Gutkurrs were a species of vicious predatory insect carnivores native to the planet Ryloth, where they maintained hunting grounds. "Gutkurr" can also be used by Ryloth natives as a pejorative term.
distinctions: Thin arms, large, hooked claws, spiked carapace

name: Gutretee
summary: Gutretee were a crystalline sentient species indigenous to Isis. The Gutretee were immune to blaster fire.

name: Gutter rat
summary: A gutter rat was a type of rat. In 230 BBY, when Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro instructed the Nihil pirates X-10 and Zagyar to follow Nihil Chadra-Fan Doctor Kisma Uttersond as he did not trust Uttersond and believed he may have betrayed the Nihil, Ro called the doctor a "mange-crusted gutter rat." Two years later, "The Warden"—a disgraced Nihil enforcer who served as the warden of the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn—gathered his prisoners so they could be tested by the Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk to determine which of them was a Jedi. Apruk's associate, the Valon Nihil Driggit Parse, informed the Warden that she felt they were too exposed and that the prisoners knew something was about to happen. In response, the warden told Parse that the reality of the situation was too complex for a "tag-along gutter rat" from the Outer Rim planet Valo to understand.

name: Guudrian
summary: Guudrians were a species of sentient beings from the Guudria system. Each Guudrian was distinguished by a warty, wrinkled face, a short snout, and a wild mane of hair. Their eyes sported a pattern of black checks. Although their teeth were blunt, Guudrians had clawed fingers. Members of the species emigrated into the greater galaxy by 4 ABY, when a Guudrian known as Boom joined the crew of the New Republic corvette FarStar. Although they were relatively unknown away from their home in Wild Space, Guudrians could nevertheless utilize technology on par with that of the rest of the galaxy.
distinctions: Double-entry tube at top of skull

name: Gwayo bird
summary: The gwayo bird was a bird native to the homeworld of Sakiyan bounty hunter Djas Puhr. The bird's eggs were considered a delicacy. In 1 BBY, Han Solo smuggled a gwayo bird egg to Tatooine for Djas Puhr, his acquaintance, flaunting Imperial import-export regulations in the process. He risked strict legal penalty in choosing to not jettison the egg along with the rest of his illicit cargo, a fact that Puhr much appreciated upon receiving the egg. Beyond the culinary use of the gwayo bird egg, the bird's meat was also edible. Gwayo meat was used in the dish Fried Sakiyan Gwayo with Herb-roasted Topato, sold at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu in 34 ABY. The restaurant also sold the Temple Rootleaf and Moss Salad, which could be served with a marinated, soft-boiled gwayo egg.

name: Gweld
summary: Gweld were saltwater amphibians from Sedri. Sedrians made spears from their jaws.

name: Gwerax-hai
summary: Gwerax-hai were a tusked, reptilian species of predators native to the planet Veron. Localized in the planet's rain forests, the gwerax-hai were agile, yet slow and measured on average four meters in length.

name: Gwerp
summary: Gwerps were a non-sentient species of lean, frog-like creatures with protruding horns and tusks. Bobbajo, a Nu-Cosian nicknamed the "Crittermonger," used to carry small animals around in cages, including some gwerps.

name: Gwongdeenian sub-subterranean gastropod
summary: Gwongdeenian sub-subterranean gastropods were a non-sentient species of large snails native to the planet Gwongdeen. With little to no intelligence, the gastropods simply created tracks through the corridors of Gwongdeen, and then followed their tracks over and over. The locals paid no attention to the Gwongdeenian sub-subterranean gastropods, who showed no awareness of their surroundings, only stopping if someone got in their way.

name: Haagust reekbeetle
summary: The Haagust reekbeetle was a type of pungent beetle. In 9 BBY, the former smuggler Moran suggested to the fortune teller Tulakt that she was conning the prospectors of the planet Koboh with her fortunes, clarifying that he did not mean it as an insult to her. Tulakt then dismissed the comment, claiming that he could insult her no more than a reekbeetle would be able to insult a sleeping acklay, a type of large and dangerous Vendaxan predator. When Moran asked if he was the insect in the metaphor, Tulakt only offered to reveal the answer for twenty credits, which Moran appreciated.

name: Haali
summary: The Haali was a species of songbird native to the planet Ithor, the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Ithorian females sometimes had "Haali" as their given name.

name: Habassa
summary: The Habassa was the Habassa system's primary race.

name: Habeen
summary: The Habeen were one of two sentient species that were native to the Mylok system. Along with the other species that shared their star system, the Nharwaak, the Habeen jointly designed and produced a new form of hyperdrive technology. Approximately 3 ABY, the Habeen and Nharwaak entered into a civil war over control of this technology. Soon after the conflict erupted, the Imperial Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin was dispatched to the Mylok system in order to end the war and gain the new technology for use in his advanced new TIE Series starfighter, the TIE/ad starfighter and TIE/D Defender. The Habeen appealed to the Empire for assistance in exchange for the technology. Zaarin agreed, and along with ace pilot Maarek Stele, decisively routed the combined forces of the Nharwaak and the Rebel Alliance.

name: Habogad
summary: The Swamp Creature Habogad, also known as the Habogad, was a massive predator native to planet Dagobah.

name: Hagnoffarl
summary: Hagnoffarl were a subspecies of Akk dog, a large reptomammal native to Haruun Kal. They were silver and white, with orange eyes.

name: Hag'thyyr
summary: The hag'thyyr was a species of predatory reptile that was native to the world of Ebra. The Rull thildas used a flaming hag'thyyr holding a spear as the symbol of their clan.

name: Hairy Savage
summary: The Hairy Savages were primitive, violent, semi-sentient, predatory humanoids indigenous to Kuras III. The term was assigned to the species who was known to attack anything on sight.

name: Hakaran
summary: The Hakarans were a sentient insectoid species hailing from the swamp planet Hakara. The Hakarans remained unknown to the Galactic Republic until the Clone Wars, when they requested aid from the Jedi Order to fight off Separatist battle droids that had invaded their homeworld. Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano arrived on Hakara and taught the Hakarans how to defeat the droids. With the Jedi's help, the Hakarans were able to liberate their planet.

name: Halaisi
summary: The Halaisi were a sentient species in the galaxy. Humanoid in shape with a build similar to that of humans, they had golden skin and eyes, and four limbs with five-fingered hands. Their eyelids and lips could be blue, and they could have black eyebrows. It was possible for Halaisi to be Force-sensitive. Rig Nema, a Halaisi from Halais, was a member of the Jedi Order and a doctor during the final years of the Republic Era. She examined Grand Master Yoda in 19 BBY after other members of the Jedi High Council were concerned about his health.

name: Half-Bothan
summary: A half-Bothan, sentient species lived on the planet of Farfalla. It was distinguished by furred, unguligrade lower limbs, long tails, pointed ears and small forehead horns. Several half-Bothans, including Lirondo, formed part of Farfalla's Knights, a private army led by Jedi Lord Valenthyne Farfalla. Farfalla's Knights fought on the side of the Galactic Republic during the New Sith Wars, circa 1000 BBY.

name: Halisite
summary: The Halisite were a sentient species that originated on a planet on the frontier and were considered rare by the time of the High Republic Era. They possessed a bone fin that crested their head and pulsed red and blue as it flushed with blood in time with their heartbeat. One Halisite, Quith Meglar, was a member of the Nihil marauders who wished to defect.

name: Halkra
summary: Halkra, also known as "strangle vines," was an arboreal predator from the planet Bothawui.

name: Halurian ice-boar
summary: Halurian ice-boars were large, porcine creatures native to a location in the Haluria system of the Mid Rim. The creatures had thick hide plates that covered and protected their bodies. The plates were considered to be nearly impervious to such bladed tools as knives. When the Dark Lord of the Sith Skere Kaan attempted to dominate the mind of his fellow Sith Lord, Darth Bane, shortly before the final battle of the New Sith Wars on the planet of Ruusan in 1000 BBY, Bane compared Kaan's efforts with a knife scraping against an ice-boar's hide plates.

name: Hamadryas
summary: The Hamadryas were a simian humanoid species with green skin and ape-like snouts. They seemed to not possess the need to blink, and the species lacked a true carotid artery. The holoperformer Cebann Veekan was a notable member of this species. Senator Haydel Goravvus of Taris was a Human/Hamadryas hybrid.

name: Hammer-headed beast
summary: Hammer-headed beasts were creatures found on the diseased planet Carnelion IV. The beasts served as mounts for the planet's native species, the mutated Fishers.

name: Hammerfish
summary: Hammerfish were a type of fish from the Mid Rim planet Glee Anselm. At some point, the Nautolan Finial Bright hunted the fish while on Glee Anselm, and later reflected that they visually resembled the shape and aesthetics of a Longbeam cruiser. Between 34 ABY and 35 ABY, the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs traveled to the world and created a dish made of a sweet sauce and the fish—Broiled Hammerfish—in an attempt to mend relations between the planet's two sentient species, the Nautolans and the Anselmi.

name: Hanadak
summary: The Hanadaks were predatory primates indigenous to the forest moon of Endor. Ewoks have claimed that they were controlled by the Gorax, but none of them were able to prove this legend.

name: Hapan
summary: Hapans were the near-Human natives of the Hapes Cluster, a closely packed star cluster located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. They differed from baseline Human stock in a number of ways, most notably in that they possessed poor night vision and were considered to be, on average, more attractive than the typical Human standard for beauty. Due to the Transitory Mists that surround the Hapes Cluster, the Hapans were isolated from the rest of the galaxy both culturally and genetically. Because most of the male population, which made up the Lorell Raiders pirate gang, was largely wiped out by the Jedi around 4000 BBY, the Hapans adopted a matriarchal society and were ruled by a Queen Mother. The first Queen Mother closed the borders of the Hapes Cluster to the galaxy at large, which resulted in the Hapans dealing with intruders swiftly and lethally. Over the years, interaction between Hapans and the rest of the galaxy was extremely limited, due to their enforced isolation. However, in 8 ABY, the Hapans opened their borders to the rest of the galaxy, which dramatically increased their contact with the outside universe.

name: Happabore
summary: Happabores were a species of massive, gray omnivorous mammal.

name: Harch
summary: Harches were an imposing humanoid, spider-like sentient species native to the planet Secundus Ando, in the Mid Rim. They had six arms and six red eyes, and a pair of chelicerae near their mouths. The Harch were also a long-lived species. Harches had grey skin and were covered in brown or white hair. Harches also had a habit of making clicking noises sometimes when they talked. Admiral Trench of the Confederacy of Independent Systems was a male Harch. Trench was one of the largest members of his species.
distinctions: Spider-like with six eyes, eight limbs

name: Hardex
summary: The Hardex were a sentient species native to the Hardex system in the Jubilar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by 5.5 BBY, the Hardex sent an ambassador to the Targonnian leader Craw. Craw told a joke involving three Hardex and a bantha to the ambassador. However, when the leader's protocol droid translated the joke for the ambassador, they did not find it amusing. Consequently, Craw had the protocol droid deactivated and repurposed into a water fountain. In 5.5 BBY, the Targonnian captain Steggus reminded Craw of the joke and the ambassador's reaction to it.

name: Hardshell
summary: Hardshells were a type of creature lived in the cold deserts of the moon Jedha. Due to the inhospitable nature of their habitat, they had to find ways of adapting to stay protected. Most of them had hard shells, not to protect them from the weather, but against predators. However, not all hardshells had shells. The shell could be removed with relative ease, leaving the creatures defenceless without them. Though usually quickly dispatched, hardshells would swipe and spit at anyone they deemed a threat.

name: Hare
summary: Hares were a species that roamed around the icy planet Kavith III.

name: Harf
summary: The Harf were a sentient species with an elongated snout and massive arms. They had goggle-like eyes that shined red. In 4 ABY, a drunken Harf was present in the Mos Eisley cantina when the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk and the Mandalorian Boba Fett had a face-off. Bossk won, with Fett paying him a large number of credits.

name: Hark
summary: Harks were a species of avian beasts native to the planet of Vorzyd IV.

name: Haroot
summary: The Haroot was an avian species indigenous to the planet of Seylott. Golden orange in coloration, they made a distinctive "haroot" call.

name: Harpercod
summary: Harpercod were a type of fish indigenous to Dac. They were banded with speckles.

name: Harr
summary: Harrs were snouted creatures with thick, green fur, jagged teeth, and rough tongues. They communicated by oinking and whining. Harrs could be kept as domestic animals, and enjoyed having their bellies scratched.

name: Harrower assassin
summary: Harrower assassins, or Harrowers as they were more commonly known, were grotesque Sithspawn abominations created from Human Force-sensitives by the Sith sorcerer Fulminiss. During the Cold War, the Sith Emperor kept several Harrowers on his space station as guards. During the final days of the Cold War, a trio of Harrowers were sent to assassinate the Jedi Jomar Chul after he had obtained map data pinpointing the Emperor's space station's location. The Harrowers successfully shot down Jomar's vessel over Tatooine, but were intercepted at the crash site and subsequently killed by the Hero of Tython.

name: Harvap
summary: The harvap was a non-sentient creature native to the planet Nim Drovis, though it spread throughout Hutt Space after the species was discovered and named by Jarn Harvus. Harvaps were originally carrion-eaters, though they later adapted by incorporating industrial waste and garbage into its diet as they became populous on heavily-industrialized worlds. They were especially numerous in Hutt Space, and the atmosphere of the planet Quesh led to the evolution of an exceptionally hardy variety of harvaps that were able to survive the poisonous atmosphere. One of their adaptations to assist with this was that their lungs contained specialized microbes that could filter radioactive gases.

name: Harvester beetle
summary: Harvester beetles were giant beetles native to the planet Neimoidia. Settled on the other Purse Worlds, they were tamed by the Neimoidians to assist in the production of a fungus that brought them great wealth. They were found within Neimoidia's hot jungles.

name: Harvorisk
summary: Along with the harvap, with which it had no relation, the harvorisk was one of the few animals that was capable of surviving Quesh's toxic atmosphere. After its discovery on Nim Drovis by Jarn Harvus, the harvorisk was hunted by Hutts, who considered it alternately an exotic new pet and a tasty meal. But, due to its rapid rate of breeding and vicious behavior, the Hutts decided to get free of them, releasing them into the wild. It was presumed that these beasts could survive the planet's toxic atmosphere thanks to a genetic modification that could allow them to survive the pollution at the cost of half their lifespan. The Three Families introduced harvorisks to Quesh, genetically modifying them to survive in the atmosphere but at the cost of half of their lifespan.

name: Haserian
summary: The Haserians were a sentient species, native to the Haseria system in the Mid Rim. Around 18 BBY, a group of young Coruscanti Haserians played a game of shockball against a group of similar aged Rodians. The game attracted a large crowd, which included the spectators Jax Pavan, Dejah Duare and I-5YQ.

name: Hasikian
summary: The Hasikian were a humanoid species from the Hasiki system. They were known to have prominent scales over their heads. A notable Hasikian was Jedi Padawan T'Seely, who escorted Jedi Master Yoda to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

name: Hassarian
summary: The Hassarians were a species of the galaxy with willowy physiques, lilac hair, and long snouts. As of the High Republic Era, the species had a centuries-long rivalry with the Skembo. During the later period of the Republic Era, the Hassarians joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

name: Hassk
summary: The Hassks were a sentient species native to Hasskyn. They were almost completely covered in fur, except for their gray-skinned faces. They had sensitive hearing and keen night vision, all the better for hunting. Hassk were near-feral, and were thought of by most as wild animals. They lived in a primitive culture with limited technology. When they were first confronted with space travel, many left their homes and sought out worlds to wreak havoc, particularly in places of ill repute. A number of Hassks came to join Kragan Gorr's pirate gang. The Hassk triplets were thugs who spent time at Takodana Castle stirring up trouble.

name: Haver flea
summary: Haver fleas were a type of flea. Around 160 BBY, a planetary outbreak of haver fleas occurred on the planet Banchii. At the same time, Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh was on the planet Thelj to investigate the illegal manufacturing of four-seven nullifiers, devices that could disrupt lightsabers. Rwoh decided she needed access to the Jedi Archives, and while speaking with Jedi Master Yaddle via hologram, Rwoh asked if Banchii's Jedi temple was the closest to Thelj. Yaddle confirmed that it was, but because the temple was preoccupied with a number of issues, including the haver flea outbreak, she recommended that Rwoh instead visit the temple on the planet Hynestia, which she did.

name: Hawk-bat
summary: A hawk-bat (also spelled hawkbat) was a type of bat which had a beak with sharp contours. The nose of Wilhuff Tarkin, a bony human male, looked like a hawk-bat's beak. The Jedi youngling clan which Dooku belonged to was named after the creature. The species' name was also used as a derogatory term for an unsavory individual.

name: H'drachi
summary: The H'drachi were a species of sentient, humanoid sapients indigenous to the Expansion Region planet M'haeli. Somewhat resembling cameloids, the H'drachi were highly in tune with the Force, with a high number of the species being Force-sensitive.

name: Heart of Eroudac
summary: The Heart of Eroudac were a sentient species native to the planet Eroudac. They were white, pink, and green, with hair that imitated thorny plants. They buried themselves underground within a location known as the Oasis, waiting travelers who came searching for mythical flowers.

name: Heart-tailed tube larva
summary: The heart-tailed tube larva was the immature form of an insect species native to Selonia. It was a favored food of the Selonians.

name: Heat-fly
summary: Heat-flies were a type of fly that lived on Elphrona, a hot Outer Rim planet. The flies featured large, compound eyes that were visibly similar to those of Cyclorrians, a sentient insectoid species. During his training at Elphrona's Jedi outpost in the High Republic Era, Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar often noticed heat-flies buzzing through its halls. While aboard the Elite-class research vessel Innovator in 231 BBY, Zettifar mentally compared the eyes of the Cyclorrian technicians working there to the flies he had noticed on Elphrona.

name: Heep-heep
summary: Heep-heeps were creatures from Zrak. They possessed four legs, a backside, a reptilian head and black-colored eyes, and the species was known to dwell near tight holes on occasion. Heep-heeps could have at least one gender, male. A rhyming poem once spoke of a male Heep-heep that became stuck in a crack, and the more he tried to escape, the more he got stuck.

name: Heklu
summary: Heklu were a non-sentient, amphibious species native to the planet Riileb in the Riileb system of Hutt Space. The species' meat was considered a delicacy on many Core Worlds, and transporting heklu was one of the only reasons merchants found that made visiting the creatures' homeworld worthwhile.

name: Hekto
summary: Hekto were a sentient species possessing four arms. Members of the species were present in the Red Ronto cantina on Brink Station in 45 ABY.

name: Hela
summary: The Helas were a race of amphibious, nonsentient creatures native to the damp world of Enaleh.

name: Hela fish
summary: Hela fish were a type of fish that could be eaten as food. While she lived on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, the scientist Avon Starros ate hot fried hela fish for dinner, and considered it one of the things that made Coruscant "amazing." By 232 BBY, Avon had been exiled from Coruscant to the outpost Port Haileap on the Outer Rim planet Haileap by her mother—the Galactic Republic senator Ghirra Starros. On Haileap, Avon spent time with the Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros, which increased her curiosity about kyber crystals—crystals which powered the Jedi Order's lightsabers. That year, the girl mentally noted that she intended to be the first to analyze kyber crystals and their properties so she could enroll at the Coruscant University and return home to things like hot fried hela fish.

name: Heliko
summary: The Heliko were a sharklike sentient species from the aquatic planet Helikoprion. They were distantly related to the Karkarodon species, with whom they came into conflict with by the High Republic Era. The Heliko possessed clawed hands and flippered feet, as well as jaws that could unhinge to reveal several rows of sharp teeth. When in dry climates, the Heliko could dehydrate unless they wore a climate-regulating suit that would release vapor along their gills. During the High Republic Era, Haze Delik was a Heliko who joined the Nihil marauders.

name: Helio
summary: Helios were floating creatures native to Dagobah that eerily resembled Human brains.

name: Heliost
summary: Heliosts were avian creatures native to the planet of Bespin. They fed on the naturally-occurring Tibanna gas.

name: Hemes Arbora
summary: The Hemes Arbora were a sentient species from the Unknown Regions. They hailed from the planet Carrivar, but their migrations brought them to the planets Umaren'k and, eventually, Osseriton. During their stay on Umaren'k, the sentient planet Zonama Sekot moved into the system, compelling the native Umaren'k'sa to adopt much of Hemes Arbora culture.

name: Hepsalum Tash
summary: Hepsalum Tash, known collectively as "the Tash" were a sentient species native to the Dagobah system. Worm-like in appearance, they were a simple folk, valuing peace, stories, and musical entertainment. They had a cumbersome appearance, and were skilled craftsmen, able to fashion utensils and musical instruments. The Tash, however, were reclusive by nature.
distinctions: Claw-like right hand, humanoid left hand

name: Heptooinian
summary: Heptooinians were a sentient species that originated from the Heptooine system. Kaljach Sonmi and Haki Zeophrine were members of this species. Heptooinians had a humanoid posture, gray skin and flat noseless faces with long ears. They had an organ at their neck that could store half an hour worth of oxygen. It was a vestigial organ left over from a precursor species of the Heptooinians and as such was often removed during childhood.

name: Heptooinian precursor species
summary: A species that originated from the Heptooine system and eventually evolved into the sentient Heptooinian species. They possessed an organ that could store oxygen, which was considered a leftover vestigial by the Heptooinians and commonly extracted when still young, though those who kept theirs until adulthood could still store approximately half an hour's worth of oxygen inside.

name: Herabe
summary: Herabes were creatures of Zolan that could change the texture of their skin to blend in with rocks.

name: Herglic
summary: The Herglics were a species of sentient, hulking aliens with black skin, a wide mouth, oily eyes, and a blowhole. Due to mistreatment by the Galactic Empire, many took refuge on Level 1782, on Coruscant, where one rescued Anandra Milon from a stormtrooper. The Herglic Qensog provided Rebel Alliance fugitives with coordinates to the rebel vessel Home One.
distinctions: Wide mouth; rows of tiny, serrated teeth; tiny eyes in large head; no neck or chin; blowhole; slick skin; cartilaginous shoulders

name: Herlixx
summary: The Herlixx were omnivorous swamp creatures native to the planet Kasiol 3 who were comfortable on both land and in the water. They were 45 centimeters tall and stood on their rear stubby legs. Their long bodies allowed them to move through the trees and their obesity allowed them to float in the waters of Kasiol 3. Their diet consisted of a variety of fish, small amphibians, leaves and algae. Though they were quite fearsome in appearance they were considered harmless to anything larger than themselves.

name: Hermit crab
summary: Hermit crabs were a type of crab species the exist in the galaxy. The trash crab was a hermit crab-like species found on Lanupa.

name: Hermit spider
summary: Hermit spiders were dangerous arachnoid creatures living on the planet Naboo and its moon Rori.

name: Hesten
summary: Hesten were large-eared primates that lived on the planet Balnab. They were often trapped in nets by castaways on the planet. Hesten had white and blue fur. They had six limbs in total, four of them being arms with hands that included three long fingers each. Their feet had three toes.

name: Hethas
summary: The Hethas were a species of humanoids with long faces and large craniums. The gangster Gornt Seron was a member of this species.

name: Hewett
summary: The Hewett were a non-humanoid, sentient species from the Hewett system. At one point, an official banquet was held for Hewett senators, at which Konkeel pie was served on the menu. The pie was toxic to humanoids, and the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn almost ate some before his contemporary Adi Gallia stopped him.

name: Hig
summary: The Hig were a slender, blue-colored sentient species. The Hig Ginbotham served aboard the Yavin under Wedge Antilles' command, and saw action against the forces of the terrorist Kueller at Almania. Another Hig was a supporter of the Diversity Alliance, a pro-alien, anti-Human organization, donating her ore hauler to the cause.

name: High-hound
summary: High-hounds (derogatorily called Man-hawks, Stone-faces, or Birdies) were a species of birdlike scavengers native to Aduba-3. They resembled large birds of prey, but had almost Humanlike heads. They had compound eyes, containing many facets which served different purposes. The center facets made out colors and shapes, while the outside facets detected movement. They were omnivorous, getting their moisture from plants and protein from meat. They were known to chase Humans, scavenge corpses, and even eat other high-hounds. High-hounds spent their lives constantly migrating, following rain-fronts.
