Their arrival served as both a blessing and a curse to farmers. While it meant that the rainy season had arrived, it also meant that much of their maze-stalk crop could be lost to the scavengers. As a result, many farmers would build effigies to burn at the corners of their fields to frighten them off. Han Solo once rescued Merri from a high-hound.

name: Highglide
summary: Highglides were carrion-eating avians from Goroth Prime with emerald feathers. Gorothite mythology considered them a symbol of nobility.

name: Hiitian
summary: Hiitians were a species of human-sized sentient avians. They had feathers growing from their backs.

name: Hill people
summary: The hill people were humanoids from the planet Gala, one of three races of Galacians. Becoming a distinct race over a century before the Invasion of Naboo, the hill people were persecuted for having darker eyes than the so-called typical Galacian. Having fled the capital, Galu, they made dwellings in the low mountains outside the city. Not until Queen Veda of the Beju-Tallah dynasty decreed in 44 BBY that a democratic election would choose her successor did the hill people re-assimilate. Elan, the leader of the hill people, was discovered to be the first child and heir of the former King Cana. Deciding to support Wila Prammi as opposed to running herself, Elan, along with the hill people, chose to remain in the mountains after the election, although they began building a better relationship with the citizens of Galu.

name: Hillindor game fowl
summary: Hillindor game fowl, also known as Hillindor fowl, was a type of edible bird from the Hillindor system. It could be used to make Hillindor fowl soup.

name: Hippoglace
summary: A hippoglace was a creature with an azure hue. In 34 ABY, Resistance spy Vi Moradi used hippoglace yarn to knit a lumpy sweater for her brother, Baako. She intended to give the sweater to him—which she regarded to her astromech droid, U5-GG, as "hideous" and "infused with love"—after her mission. When the droid, nicknamed "Gigi," responded with disappointment, Moradi threatened to make a similar sweater for it.

name: Hiromi
summary: The Hiromi were a bipedal, sentient, insectoid species. Despite a strong instinct for self-preservation and a large aversion to anything that could bring them harm, the Hiromi saw themselves as a glorious race of mighty warriors. Their government was the Hiromi Empire, and they were members of the Alliance of Free Planets. The Hiromi secretly dreamt of galactic conquest; to achieve their aims, shortly after the Battle of Endor they tried to incite a war between Lahsbane and the Ewoks to tear the Alliance apart, but this plot was foiled. They then tried to conquer Zeltros, but were again foiled when the planet was later conquered by the Nagai, and in turn the Tofs. They gave up their dreams of conquest afterwards, helping the Alliance and the Nagai fight the Tofs.

name: Hismauli hawk-snake
summary: The Hismauli hawk-snake was a species native to the Hismaul system. Professional gambler Lando Calrissian stated that a Zeltron, who ran a brewery owned by Calrissian on the planet Clendor, was as mean as one of these snakes.

name: Hiss-wyrmgrub
summary: Hiss-wyrmgrubs were a type of creature from the Sullustan homeworld, Sullust, that ate the roots of subterranean trees and chewed up underground gardens. In 4 ABY, the Sullustan gangster Surat Nuat compared the frequent interference with his business interests by the junk dealer Temmin Wexley to the nibbling of hiss-wyrmgrubs.

name: Hisseenian
summary: The Hisseenians were a group of humans who inhabited the planet Hisseen. In 22 BBY, when the planet was attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic intervened to protect the Hisseenians.

name: Hitaka fish
summary: Hitaka fish were a species native to the planet Hitaka. These pink-scaled creatures were often served by the Hitakan people for dinner.

name: Hitcher crab
summary: The hitcher crab was a crustacean native to the deserts of Sevarcos II. They moved around the desert, and ate plants and smaller animals. A slow-acting poison coated their claws and shell, used both to disable prey and to discourage predators. With medical treatment, the poison was generally non-fatal for Humans. The Sevari often hunted them, both for their nutritious meat, and for their large water sacs. During summer months, the crabs would bury themselves in the sand to avoid the intense heat. This made the spiky shells a hidden hazard for unwary animals and traveling beings. However, the hitcher crabs also had substantially reduced body functions, and were more vulnerable to hunters. During the mating season, a male and female crab would mate and form a pack. After three weeks of gestation, the female would lay four to eight eggs, which would hatch in nine months. After that, the female newborns would depart and be raised with the mother, while the father raised the males. Hitcher crabs became full-grown adults at 15 standard years.

name: Hive rat
summary: Hive rats, also known as mutant hive rats, coruscani rats or simply mutant rats, were enormous, nearly hairless, rapacious rodents who inhabited the sewers and lowest levels of Coruscant. The mutant rat species was often believed to be the result of ecosystem damage and exposure to sewage, pollution, and reactor radiation.

name: Hka'ka
summary: Hka'ka were a nocturnal species of non-sentient creatures native to the planet Barab I. Preying upon the vsst species, hka'ka were the staple of the shenbit bonecrushers which roamed the world.

name: H'nemthe
summary: H'nemthe were a reptilian sentient species with sharp tongues. M'iiyoom Onith was a member of this species, and she was courted by the Gotal tax collector Feltipern Trevagg, who did not know the dangers of romancing a H'nemthe.

name: Ho'Din
summary: The Ho'Din were a species of yellow-green humanoids in the galaxy. Ho'Dins possessed two large dark eyes, long suction cup-tipped fingers and, on their heads, red-violet fleshy tendrils. A Ho'Din settlement on Moltok came under attack from a local Makurth boss, and asked for the assistance of the Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser Blood Crow to prevent the incident from becoming a full-scale war.
distinctions: Suction cup-tipped fingers and head tendrils.

name: Hoguss
summary: Hogusses were sentient beings with heavy bodies. During the Mission to Ansion, sanctioned by the Jedi High Council and conducted by Jedi Master Luminara Unduli, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Padawans Barriss Offee and Anakin Skywalker, a Hoguss wielding a killing ax attacked the two Mirialan Jedi at Cuipernam.

name: Hohokum
summary: The Hohokum was an amphibious animal from Naboo. Hohokums lived mostly in water, although they went to surface to lay their eggs in the mud or the sand. The eggs could be easily eaten by predators when laid on an ecosystem with predators, although most of the natural ecosystems of Hohokums lacked of egg-eaters. Teenage Gungans caught onto passing hohokums as a hobby to be pulled through the water as a game. Soon after 32 BBY, the Gungans transported hohokums and other animals to the moon of Ohma-D'un to try and establish an ecosystem. Most of the flora and fauna of Ohma-D'un, however, was destroyed by Separatists during the Battle of Ohma-D'un. The Great Hohokum was a 400-year-old specimen kept at the Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility. Jar Jar Binks was responsible for freeing it, along with all the other creatures in the complex.

name: Hokami
summary: Hokami were predators from Mutanda's plains. They had great skill at sneaking through Mutanda's grasses unseen. They were very aggressive and would attack virtually any creature. They were also known to attack repulsorlift vehicles with their sharp claws and their teeth.

name: Hole ball
summary: Hole balls were wild creatures that lived on Sulon. They were small animals whose fur were always covered in debris to provide camouflage. They dug many holes, which they hid in when they were frightened. Hole balls made squeaking sounds.

name: Holessian
summary: The Holessians were portly humanoids native to Holess, believed to be related to the Lannik. They were obsessed with law and regarded legal cases like a sport, although betting on outcomes was considered sacrilege. They revered judges like gods and regarded lawyers as celebrities.

name: Holwuff
summary: The Holwuff were a sentient species in the galaxy. One, Rogwa Wodrata was a senator.

name: Homanan
summary: The Homanans were a mysterious race of shape-changing sentients from the Homana system. They could change their size from anything the size of a Wookiee to that of an Ewok and were also slightly telepathic, as well as altering the pigment of cells within their flesh. Mimicking clothes, or anything skin tight, was an easy feat. Nana was a member of the species.

name: Honey glider
summary: The honey glider was a small non-sentient species found on the planet Dalna. They could jump and glide in the air using wing membranes. A diet of blue brikal larvae tinted the animals bright blue. One honey glider attached itself to the human child Simi for weeks after he shared porridge with it, and would hop between Simi and the other Path of the Open Hand children. Marda Ro, caretaker of the children, considered the bright-blue honey glider a good omen.

name: Hoojib
summary: Hoojibs were a sentient species of small, white-furred beings from the planet Arbra. They had long ears and an antenna on the top of their heads, and moved on four legs. The smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca brought a Hoojib for the menagerie of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt, hoping to win his favor, though the critter was not what it had seemed.

name: Hook hawk
summary: Hook hawks were a carnivorous bird species native to the Stark Forests on Tython during the time before the Old Republic. Packs of hook hawks used their mesmerizing songs to seduce prey into a somnolent trance before killing and devouring them.

name: Hoopaloo
summary: Hoopaloo were a sentient species covered head to toe in ruffled feathers, which could be brown with blue highlights. They had a sharply hooked beak, and their feet had three toes forward and one back. One known Hoopaloo was the information broker Graysom, while another, Skreech, worked for the criminal Rekias Nodo. The Hoopaloo professor Re-Bec Arclarka taught at the Lerct Historical Institute during the days of the New Republic, where he mentored the human Beaumont Kin. He was generally respected at Lerct, though at least one individual, Mico Haswell, felt personally offended that a Hoopaloo had been granted the position of professor, considering Arclarka's hiring to be an attempt of the administration to meet a quota.

name: Hoosha
summary: A Hoosha was a large flying creature that was able to generate electricity within its body to use as a weapon against fleeing prey. The Hoosha was able to sneak up on its airborne enemies and shock them with a powerful blast of electricity. This electric attack was directed by two long thin tentacles that appeared to be the Hoosha's only appendages. Besides its electric generating abilities, the Hoosha was capable of extended flight without wings or what would be considered an aerodynamic body type. Hooshas may have been native to the forest moon of Endor, as even young Ewoks were familiar with the large creatures when they came upon them. The Ewok Teebo immediately recognized a Hoosha attack during an expedition to the Twin Hills. The particular Hoosha that attacked the Ewoks happened to be a sort of pet for the Two-headed Gonster who lived in that part of Endor. A self-proclaimed beast catcher, the Gonster had taken the Hoosha as a pet after removing him from an unwanted area. However, the Gonster was unable to agree whether he had removed it for the Duloks or the Dragon Riders of Poolok. In any case, after taming the creature, the Gonster had set it on guard duty to keep unwanted intruders away from the Gonster's magical stores. During the Raich crisis, the Gonster's Hoosha came into contact with the Ewoks, Teebo, Latara, Wicket Wystri Warrick, and Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, who had come to the twin hills to talk with the Gonster. Unaware of the Ewok's intent, the Hoosha attacked the Ewoks, destroying one of their skin gliders. Luckily, the Gonster was able to call the Hoosha off after seeing how harmless the Ewoks were. After the Gonster had helped the Ewoks and devised a plan to end the Raich crisis, the Hoosha was able to give Wicket and Kneesaa a ride to the Raich's cave within the Dead Forest. After this, the Hoosha departed, likely returning to its master to continue its guard duty.

name: Hootbat
summary: Hootbats were bats native to Clak'dor VII, named for its hooting noise.

name: Hootle
summary: Hootles were herd animals found on Ansion.

name: Hoover
summary: Hoovers were a species of small, quadrupedal sentients that had long, blood-sucking trunks. One such hematophagous alien, a male named Attark, was owned as a pet by Jabba the Hutt. Members of the species were often mistaken for pests due to their appearance.

name: Hop-toad
summary: Hop-toads were a type of toad known to the Chiss species in the Unknown Regions. Around 19 BBY, when explaining to the sky-walker navigator Che'ri why some caregivers had to leave the sky-walkers they cared for, caregiver Mitth'ali'astov, core name "Thalias," stated it could be because of "short-sighted idiots" in charge of the process. When Che'ri failed to understand what Thalias meant by short-sighted, the caregiver instead metaphorically explained that the short-sighted people had the brains of a hop-toad.

name: Horansi
summary: The Horansi were sentient felinoids indigenous to Mutanda.

name: Horax
summary: Horaxes were a type of giant blue reptile native to the frozen Outer Rim world of Nelvaan. They had saber-sharp fangs and enormous horns. The tails of horaxes were covered in scales that young Nelvaanian villagers were tasked with acquiring as part of an initiation ritual. The scales could be used to make an elixir that was capable of repelling the beasts for an entire year.
distinctions: Saber-sharp fangs, enormous horns, and scales

name: Hordzat
summary: Hordzat was a spiny creature native to the planet Rena. Hordzats were prey for Renan bloodwolves.

name: Horian
summary: The Horian were a species that lived on Horain during the Clone Wars.

name: Horn-toed morglesnap
summary: Horn-toed morglesnaps were a type of creature featuring horned toes. While aboard the Jedi cruiser Star Hopper in 231 BBY, the Padawan Lula Talisola asked her friend, the Mikkian Zeen Mrala, how she was as they traveled to the latter's homeworld, Trymant IV. Though Mrala indicated she was fine, the Padawan did not believe her, remarking that she must be a horn-toed morglesnap if that was the case.

name: Hornagaunt
summary: Hornagaunts were furred, multi-stomached creatures with wings that were often clipped when domesticated. They were native to Tertiary Kesmere. Their personalities were marked by an inherent aggressiveness which made them dangerous but useful as pets. One hornaguant called Grendel was kept by the droid information-broker 8t88. Hornagaunts had a monstrous appearance had acute smelling and produced growling or purring sounds, either to express pleasure, or alertness. They have an underthrust jaw and big eye-lids. At least some had glowing red eyes. When in comfort, or in inquiring mood, they struck their stubby tail on the ground.

name: Hornbeak
summary: The hornbeak was a predator native to Orellon II. Being in an intermediate state between and avian and a reptilian, it had the body of a dinosaur and the head and feet of a bird. It was colorful like a bird, its head having the shape of a giant beak with razor-sharp tooth-like protrusions and a small horn at the end of the beak. It had poor eyesight but excellent olfactory senses and would attack virtually anything that moved.

name: Horned billipede
summary: Horned billipedes were a species native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space which the Graf family temporarily named Graf-World. While Milo Graf, the youngest Graf child, was attempting to capture an ash-rabbit he had discovered in the swamps, the family's droid CR-8R queried if the creature that Graf was pursuing was a sludge salamander or horned billipede.

name: Horned eopie
summary: Horned eopies, also known as antlered eopies, were a species of quadrupedal mammallians found on the planet At Achrann. They were a variant of the eopies who lived on Tatooine.

name: Horned krevol
summary: The horned krevol was a small territorial insect that has a large horn on its head. It lived on the planet Naboo and its moon Rori, as well as Corellia.

name: Horned raptor
summary: The horned raptor was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of kai tok.

name: Horned stoan
summary: Horned stoans were a type of creature that lived on the world Batuu. While meditating in the Batuu Jedi temple's meditation chamber around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani reached out with the Force, perceiving the life around her as glowing colors and sensing both a herd of horned stoans and a flock of skylar-birds in the wilds surrounding the temple.

name: Horranth
summary: Horranths were reptilian carnivores native to the Deep Core planet Tython. Quadrupeds with short, stubby legs and an array of horns across their back, horranths were typically seen in few numbers on the grassy mountainsides of their homeworld. Possessing a high birthrate, horranth matriarchs could lay hundreds of eggs but were often constrained by a limited food supply. When food was plentiful, the high horranth birthrate saw a sharp increase in their numbers. Congregating in large family groups, or broods, horranths often depleted their habitat's resources after a population boom. The mouse horranth was a diminutive, domesticated, version of the larger predatory horranth.

name: Horse
summary: Horses were hardy creatures used as mounts by the Ewoks of the Forest Moon of Endor. A horse-like species known as the orbak lived on the Kef Bir, the Ocean Moon of Endor.

name: Hortek
summary: The Hortek were a species of predatory humanoids that were covered with bony plates and had long necks and large unblinking eyes. They were among the few predatory races to join the New Republic. They were moderately telepathic, a skill that they developed to predict the actions of their prey. They were also known for their impatience, a trait associated with secretions from a gland called the pedrokk. Many Hortek sympathized with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The skills of Hortek interrogators were a prized asset of the Alliance Special Forces. Colonel Ejagga Pakkpekatt, an intelligence officer in the New Republic, was a member of this species.

name: Hosnian termite
summary: Hosnian termite were a type of small termite that shared its name with the Core Worlds' Hosnian system. Around 12 BBY, a team of Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate operatives—led by the woman Qi'ra—visited a Jedi temple on a planet to seek a Force artifact. One of the team's members, Lopie, observed the temple and commented on how the blocks of the structure were so tightly fitted that a Hosnian termite could not fit between them.

name: Hoth hog
summary: Hoth hogs were small, omnivorous relatives of the ice scrabbler that lived on the ice planet Hoth. They used their tongues to locate thermal vents or heated caves when scavenging in family units and then dug down to find their food using powerful clawed feet. Hoth hogs were eaten by members of the tauntaun species.

name: Hoth jellyfish
summary: Hoth jellyfish were a species of jellyfish that were native to the frozen world of Hoth.

name: Houjix
summary: The houjix were a species of quadrupedal cephalopods whose appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik. They were capable of sending electric jolts through prey, and rumor had it that they were popular pets on the Gran homeworld Kinyen. By at least 11 ABY, a Houjix was one of several creatures and gladiators belonging to species featured in dejarik that fought both Mandalorian Din Djarin and Rotta the Hutt in the Pits on the moon Shakari, before Rotta threw the creature at the laser fence and the houjix's electircal joints short-circuit the arena's defense grid allowing all the gladiators to escape and wreak havoc in the city.

name: Houk
summary: Houks were a sentient species of hulking humanoids that had massive forearms and were capable of building heavy musculature.
distinctions: Large forearms, heavy musculature, four-fingered hands

name: Howler
summary: Howlers were extragalactic furred quadrupedal creatures native to the planet Peridea. Howlers could be tamed and ridden, and would respond to commands as demonstrated by Enoch and Sabine Wren, who used the word "tota" to order one such creature to sit. Howlers were also ridden by a group of bandits that resided on Peridea. These bandits rode the creatures into battle when they attacked Sabine Wren, Ezra Bridger, and a group of Noti nomads.

name: Howler lizard
summary: The howler lizard was a type of arboreal lizard that could be found in the jungles around the Massassi Site on the moon Yavin 4 in 1 BBY. The reptile's cries could carry for miles.

name: Howler Tree People
summary: The Howler Tree People were a sapient species native to Bendone. They spoke a strange and difficult language which they spoke with ultrasonic voices. A team of translators were required to act as an intermediary between them and a speaker of Basic. Even then it would take a significant amount of time to exchange greetings. Their ultrasonic voices could also give non-Howlers a headache. In 23 ABY, New Republic Chief of State Leia Organa Solo entertained Howler Tree People diplomats. Despite the difficulty in communicating with them, Leia realized that entertaining these diplomats was crucial to the survival of the New Republic.

name: Howler
summary: Howlers were predators which lived on the moon Yavin 4. They got their name from their method of attack, which was a howl loud enough to stun their prey. Howlers were somewhat reptilian in appearance. They usually crawled on all four limbs, but sometimes when charging, leaping, and clawing, they used two legs for mobility.

name: Howlrunner
summary: Howlrunners were massive, skull-faced canids found in the deserts of Kamar. They were known to prey on humans if given the chance. The TIE pilot Howl of the Galactic Empire's Theta Squadron chose their nickname after learning about howlrunners via a holo.

name: Hrakian
summary: Hrakians were Near-Humans from Hraki.

name: Hrasskis
summary: Hrasskis were a sentient race from the planet of Hrasskis. They were distinguished by large, veined air sacs on their backs; they were represented in the New Republic Senate by the belligerent Senator Cian Marook. Hrasskis society believed strongly in the succession by seniority, with the highest social value being waiting one's turn.

name: Hrosma tiger
summary: The Hrosma tiger was a large feline predator with a horn on its forehead. It was native to Baskarn. It was Force-sensitive and thus a very dangerous and ferocious hunter. Hrosma tigers had long life-spans but were rare in numbers as they often fought and killed each other in competition for territory and prey.

name: Hroth-beast
summary: Hroth-beasts were an avian species native to the cavern strewn planet of Vorlag. They had red leathery skin with long wings. Its beak was covered in small worm-like tentacles that contained stingers. If something came in contact with the stingers, that part of the body would swell and be numb for hours.

name: Hrumph
summary: Hrumphs were a type of non-sentient quadrupedal herbivore found in the swamps of the planet Naboo. The had purple spots smattered across their lightly tanned body and four long horns that they used together with their highly sensitive ears to avoid predators. At some point after the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY, Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts Director of Creature Cartography Ardis San Tekka wrote about hrumphs in her journal.

name: Hssiss
summary: Hssiss, also called dark side dragons, were a lizard species with the ability to influence Force-sensitive beings around them. If bitten by a Hssiss, one would succumb to the effects of a dark side poison. Hssiss also had the ability to conceal themselves and become invisible, possibly doing so through the Force.

name: Hud
summary: Hud were herd animals with red and black-striped pelts native to the planet Rutan. They were used by Rutanians as mounts while hunting kudana.

name: Hueche
summary: Hueches were extinct predators from Colla IV, and the only natural predators of the Colicoids. If confronted by a hueche, or even a resemblance of one, a normally fierce Colicoid would instinctively curl itself into a ball and roll away. They were feline creatures with two rows of razor sharp teeth.

name: Huf dun
summary: Huf duns were large herd animals native to Talus, a planet located within the Corellian system. These herbivorous creatures were relatively peaceful, often ignoring smaller creatures that roamed around them. Only a few people ever managed to successfully domesticate or even capture Huf duns.

name: Hukla
summary: Huklas were an endangered non-sentient species that could rip through a man in seconds. The Spectres encountered one being transported to the Emperor's personal zoo, aboard a class four container transport while trying to rescue the argora.

name: Hulgren
summary: Hulgren were a species of snake-like creatures that could grow up to 40 meters in length. They were gray in coloration and had numerous eyes. They were found in the lower levels of the space station, Hosk Station.

name: Huloon
summary: The Huloons were a sentient species whose anatomy included hands. During the reign of the Galactic Empire a Huloon youngling lived as a beggar on the Five Points space station. While crouched in supplication in a park on board the station, the Huloon was given a handful of credits by the criminal Jyn Erso after she stole them.

name: Human
summary: Humans were a species of sentient, bipedal mammals with bilateral symmetry. Throughout the galaxy, they constituted the culturally dominant species and were commonly encountered on most settled planets, from the bountiful planet of Naboo to the desert world of Tatooine. Some believed humans were possibly native to the planet Coruscant but that theory was disputed. They were known to engage in many different pursuits, from politics to bounty hunting. Species that bore structural resemblance to humans (bipedal gait, two arms and two legs, opposable thumb) were referred to as "humanoids." Species that were very physically similar to, but still distinct from baseline humans were referred to as "near-humans." By the time of the Galactic Civil War, humans were the galaxy's most numerous sentient species. However, in total there were still more non-human sentients than humans, so humans constituted a plurality rather than a majority of the galaxy's sentients.

name: Humbaba
summary: The humbaba was a bovine animal native to a number of forest worlds, such as Corellia, Talus and Kashoon. Aarwynn was a notable mythological humbaba. Covered in dense fur, they were natural burrowers, making the soft swamp lands of their homeworlds an ideal habitat. With four known sub-species the humbaba of Kashoon were short-legged, long-trunked creatures while the humbaba of Corellia and Talus were tall and similar in appearance to the falumpaset. Humbaba curds were considered a rare delicacy.

name: Hummer
summary: The hummer was a species of Scarlet Bird that could be found on Vohai. While infiltrating the Arkanian Microtechnologies headquarters on the planet, Boba Fett noted one such bird.

name: Humming peeper
summary: Humming peepers were hummingbird-like creatures that lived on the forest moon of Endor. The peepers had white feathers and pink bellies. The planet Kegan also had humming peepers.

name: Hunanetre
summary: The hunanetre, or huna-netre, were a type of creature that could be found on Rentalles. While on display at a celebration of the Outer Rim on Serenno, the Dianectric Menagerie contained a number of hunanetre. Dagra Van, the beastmaster of Crakka the Hutt, captured a hunanetre on Rentalles, which Crakka presented to Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a gift.

name: Huralok
summary: Huraloks were sapient reptilians indigenous to Djurmo. They were known to be a vicious species that held long grudges with other beings and even their own. Huraloks were extremely long-lived, living to as old as the mid 300s. Their general demeanor was that of hatred, greed, deception, and manipulation. Huraloks despised each other to the degree that only in times of immediate danger to their species would they mate. Most of the time, Huraloks would keep to themselves and order minions of theirs to commit their dirty deeds for them. On rare occasions, they would travel the galaxy as soldiers or self-serving scoundrels. There are Force-sensitive Huraloks, however they would never end up joining the Jedi Order due to a lack of dedication and selflessness. Holodramas of the Imperial Navy combating Huralok pirates were very popular.
distinctions: Triangular heads, thick claws, black-striped scales

name: Hushstalker
summary: A hushstalker was a type of creature that could be kept as pets. Skrrll once had a hushstalker named Brutux and was reminded of it by the rib-cat Warm Face.

name: Husk lizard
summary: The husk lizard was a diminutive reptilian creature native to Herego, frequently kept as pets by wealthy humanoids in the Outer Rim Territories. The Squalris trading magnate Sanglui was known to have kept an unusually tame husk lizard named Farnak, who would perch on his master's arm and yip beseechingly whenever food was near.

name: Husliki
summary: The husliki was a species that had a bumpy hide. In 21 BBY, the Human Devi, a miner who lived in the village Torbel on the planet Lanteeb, wore her hair fastened in tiny knots in a style that caused the knots to stand up on top of her head and resemble a husliki's hide.

name: Hutlarian
summary: Hutlarians were a sentient species of humanoids who possessed red eyes and orange skin. Native to the world of Hutlar, a small, dim and chilly planet located within the Mid Rim's Senex sector, Hutlarians had a reputation for being tough. For millennia members of the species served as bodyguards and shock troops for the Senex and Juvex lords.

name: Hutt
summary: Hutts were a large slug-like sentient species who were native to the planet Varl, but considered their homeworld to be Nal Hutta after abandoning Varl due to the Kayfoundo Kapa. They were well known as galactic gangsters who controlled the Hutt Clan crime syndicate. One famous Hutt was the crime lord Jabba, who ruled a massive criminal empire from his palace on Tatooine.

name: Hutta snake
summary: A Hutta snake was a common type of snake that partially shared its name with the planet Nal Hutta. The Hutt Churo studied the skin-shedding habits of Hutta snakes. In 228 BBY, when Churo's sister Dahara Devirsivik Norri brought him to their family's hangar on Nal Hutta, Churo saw Dahara's new starship, the Viperi-class cargo shuttle Sarlacc's Scorn, and mentally noted the shape of its cockpit reminded him of the head of a Hutta snake. Later, while Churo was trying to repair a comm tower on the planet Palagosal, he wished that machines were as easy as studying the skin-shedding habits of Hutta snakes.

name: Huurton
summary: Huurtons were large, slender, canine creatures native to the planet Dantooine. They were characterized by armored backs and long claws, and were highly aggressive. The females were the hunters. A separate species of huurtons was known as huurton howlers. Some were turned into cyborgs in the Imperial installation Warren, on Dantooine.

name: Huwawan
summary: The Huwawans were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Brothers Taibik Kajok and Wiltoo Kajok were members of this species.

name: Hyallp
summary: The Hyallp were a sentient race of insectoid beings. They were multi-legged arthropods. Little was known of their planet of origin or culture. Noy Waglla was a Hyallp.

name: Hydroid Medusa
summary: Hydroid Medusas were massive jellyfish cyborgs combined with armor and other cybernetic enhancements developed by the Karkarodons on their homeworld Karkaris. Hydroid Medusas were used by Karkarodon Confederacy of Independent Systems Commander Riff Tamson during the Battle of Mon Cala. They were practically invulnerable, with blasters and lightsabers doing no damage to them. After causing numerous casualties, the Republic and Mon Calamari forces were forced to retreat. When Republic reinforcements arrived in the form of the Gungan Grand Army, their boomas were able to do some damage to the Hydroid Medusas.
skinColor: Transparent yellow, brown undersides and tentacles

name: Hydrosnake
summary: Hydrosnakes were a type of snake. During or after 18 BBY, the clone Echo called former Imperial Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart a hydrosnake when questioning if he could be trusted.

name: Hyenax
summary: Hyenax were vicious, carnivorous canines from the planet of Vaal, with skin in different shades of brown, black stripes on their back and hair on their neck and upper back.
skinColor: Light to dark brown skin, black stripes

name: Hylobon
summary: Hylobons were a sentient species native to the Hylobi system. Aemon Gremm and his men, including Toht Ra, were all members of this species. They were part of the Hylobon Enforcers, who served Dryden Vos as bodyguards in the criminal organization Crimson Dawn.

name: Hyropodic aetherbeast
summary: Hyropodic aetherbeasts were a type of creature native to only three biomes on the world of Yolthani VI. They possessed a large muscled upper torso, with two arms and a head. Their faces included two white eyes and a mouth of sharp teeth surrounded by red tentacle-like appendages. The beasts' skin was purple with red spots covering parts of their head, shoulders and upper arms. Around 0 ABY, a hyropodic aetherbeast was brought before the queen of the planet Ktath'atn as a curiosity in the hopes that it would pique her interest enough for her to grant its owner an audience to make a request of her. The queen was initially interested in the beast enough to consider its owner's request but ultimately turned the owner away with compensation after being presented with the Jedi Luke Skywalker by the archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra.

name: Hysalrian
summary: Hysalrians were a sentient species from the Hysalria system. N'Kata Del Gormo, rumored to have been an early instructor of future Grand Master Yoda, was said to have been a Hysalrian. In 32 BBY, when Jedi Master Mace Windu recognized a sand sculpture in Yoda's quarters as depicting Hysalria, he thought of the rumor of the Hysalrian teaching Yoda, but the Grand Master dismissed the sculpture and used the Force to form it into an Alderaanian rose.

name: Hy'tras
summary: The Hy'tras was one of the five races of Shatras. The second most common race after Y'tras, Hy'tras, composed the 10% of the Shatras population. They were probably technologically advanced once, but a vast, centuries-long war with the Y'tras made them reject technology. Then, the Y'tras made a deal with them: Leaving the Hy'tras alone in exchange of their riches. Both parties respected the agreement.

name: I-Zellam's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. I-Zellam was a member of this species.

name: Iagoin
summary: The Iagoin were a race of semi-intelligent creatures that floated among the gaseous clouds of the gas giant Tyed Kant. All Iagoin were gelatinous and ovoid, with a single eye that could move around the surface of the creature. The creature's mouth was a conical opening with a series of filters, and they had long, paddle-like tentacles which were used for stability, movement, and defense. Iagoin could be as small as a few centimeters, or as large as sixty meters.

name: Iakaru
summary: Iakaru were a sentient species native to the planet Iakar. Bistan was a member of this species.

name: Ibbeet
summary: Ibbeets, also known as Ibbe, were a serene sentient species from the Wild Space planet with the same name. They tried to live in harmony with the rest of their planet. Between 230 BBY and 229 BBY, the princess-pirate Tanabi Yar recommended the Jedi knight Vernestra Rwoh to visit the Ibbe's planet to heal and move on.

name: Ibdis Maw
summary: The Ibdis Maw was a superorganism that lived on the planet Bracca, located in the Mid Rim. While resembling a sarlacc from outside, the Ibdis Maw consisted of a number of mouths connected by a vast digestive system located hundreds of meters below the surface of the planet. Bracca's Scrapper Guild fed the Ibdis Maw metal from the wreckage of scrapped starships, causing its mouths to grow to immense sizes.

name: Ibian
summary: The Ibian is a small amphibious creature native to Tatooine, the ibian fed on microscopic dust mites and insects. It was in turn preyed upon by the worrt. These small lifeforms could be recognized by their elongated orange and blue bodies, as well as their distinctive eye stalks. It is assumed that, like the amphibious gorg, ibians retained moisture by inhabiting abandoned profogg burrows, as such accounts did exist.

name: Ibliton
summary: The ibliton was a swamp creature of Randorn 2. A mollusk by nature, its shell was about two meters long with three meter long tentacles. Like many mollusks, its shell was chambered and coiled with its fleshy body protruding out. Unlike most mollusks, its segmented body and knife-like legs were covered by an insectoid exoskeleton. It was believed by the native Mizx to be an avatar of Hershoon the Destroyer, created by its demented soul so that its legacy would be perpetuated. However, Ibliton fossils dated back to 600,000 BBY, predating the Mizx.

name: Icarii
summary: The Icarii were a near-Human species native to Vestar who were wiped out in the so-called Icarii campaign by the Galactic Empire's Lightning Battalion under the command of General Nim and Colonel Abal Karda. Lightning Battalion employed a horrific biological agent to eradicate the Icarii after months of vicious fighting. Only one Icarii survived, later to be killed by Darth Vader. Imperial forces referred to the Icarii as Ikies, a derogatory word. Due to the Icarii's unique biology, they could survive dismemberment, even decapitation, and still remain alive. However, it was possible to kill an Icarii by severing the brain in half. A common phrase, brought on by these abilities was that you had to kill an Icarii seven times. The species had green blood.

name: Ice Bat
summary: Ice Bats were flying creatures native to Hoth.

name: Ice Cat
summary: Ice Cats were predatory felines native to Hoth. Like Spiners, they could attack their prey by shooting quills from their fur. They were also found on Dagobah.

name: Ice Demon
summary: Ice Demons were sentient humanoids with ice-like traits, possessing bodies that appeared similar to white crystal, as well as resistance to frigid temperatures. They had long, curved horns and sharp, icicle-like teeth. Their eyes were black with white centers, and their feet ended in sharp spikes. At least one member of the species, the sorcerer known as Stagorr, lived on the forest moon of Endor. Several years before 3 ABY, Stagorr fought in a duel with the Ewok shaman Logray and was banished to the inside of Ice Mountain. The Ice Demon hatched a scheme to lure Logray back to free him, but it backfired when Wicket W. Warrick used fire magic to melt some ice, douse the Ice Demon in water, and trap him when it refroze.

name: Ice dragon
summary: The ice dragons of Toloran were noted for their ferocity and size.

name: Ice-lobster
summary: Ice-lobsters were crustaceans indigenous to the planet Dac's polar seas.

name: Ice Piranha
summary: The Ice Piranha was a type of piranha found on the ice planet Hoth.

name: Ice puppy
summary: Ice puppies were creatures that were native to the frigid planet of Toola. The creatures were weak, and so the term developed into a Whiphid insult.

name: Ice-river vaban
summary: An ice-river vaban was a type of creature that, judging by its name, inhabited cold water currents. According to Goran Beviin, the scarlet and blue color barbels of the ice-river vaban resembled the growths of the Yuuzhan Vong vessel miid ro'ik.

name: Ice scrabbler
summary: Ice scrabblers (also known as frozen carrions) were furry, land-scavenging rodents native to the icy wilderness of the planet Hoth. They were the most abundant species on the planet, making up 32% of the world's animal population. Until the Alliance to Restore the Republic encountered wampas, these creatures were thought to be the only other native lifeform on the planet other than the tauntaun. [[File:IceScrabbler-ThreatOfTheConqueror.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An ice scrabbler.]] Having sharp claws and pronounced beaks, ice scrabblers were able to burrow into the icy surface of the planet to build dens and find food, sometimes delving as deep as twenty-five kilometers under the ice. They had a very keen sense of smell which enabled them to detect a form of lichen, their primary food source, even under layers of icy crust. It was this powerful sense of smell that likely drew large concentrations of ice scrabblers to pester Echo Base. They were able to smell the Rebels' food supplies. This concentration of the vermin is also what probably attracted wampas there as well.

name: Ice shark
summary: Ice sharks were a type of shark. In 382 BBY, the pilot Sky Graf absconded with their brother Helis Graf's ship, the Brightbird. When Helis warned Sky to stand down after catching up to them, the latter joked they would do so when ice sharks arranged a tap dance as they prepared to flee.

name: Ice-spider
summary: Ice-spiders were a type of spider that wove webs. While aboard their Brightbird starship in 382 BBY, the pilot Sky Graf worked with their colleagues—their friend Dass Leffbruk and Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani—to use a Graf astro-resonance machine to attempt navigating to the planet known as Planet X. Leffbruck inspected the wiring of the device, comparing it to ice-spider webs rather than something that could help their group navigate hyperspace.

name: Ice tiger
summary: Ice tigers were feline predators from Toola.

name: Ice troll
summary: An ice troll was a type of troll. Between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, during a particularly bleak winter on the moon Endor, the Ewoks Wicket Wystri Warrick, Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, and Teebo attempted to trap a Kroolok, another type of troll that supposedly lived on Endor. As part of their plan to do so, they dug a hole deep enough to contain an ice troll.

name: Ice worm
summary: The ice worms were large predatory creatures from Akuria II. Their burrows honeycombed Akuria II's icy surface, making it highly dangerous to walk on. Ice worms were green, slug-like creatures, with mouths filled with sharp teeth and lined with tentacles. They moved through their burrows on a series of small pseudopods. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, they were nearly extinct.

name: Ice wyrm
summary: Ice wyrms were a creature found on the planet Barton IV.

name: Icefish
summary: Icefish were a type of fish that were edible to humans and Latero. In 18 BBY, Milo Graf regretted eating the last of a stock of icefish for breakfast while enduring a particularly turbulent ride in space. In 9 BBY, the Latero Greez Dritus asked the Jedi Knight Cal Kestis if their human crewmate Bode Akuna had any allergies, explaining that if Akuna did not then he could cook icefish, Mygeeto burgers, and enyak bobs to celebrate once they reached the planet Tanalorr.

name: Icehead
summary: Iceheads were a species of sentient humanoids with lean, black bodies that held spiked, rectangular heads that resembled blocks of ice. Their large mouths brimmed with jagged teeth, and their three-fingered hands sported sharp claws. While they could walk like other humanoid species, members of the species could travel faster by flipping onto their heads and sliding on icy surfaces. A group of Iceheads lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. There, armed with specialized clubs, they guarded the Snow Palace and went on missions for a sorcerer called the Snow King and his mistress, Odra. In 3 ABY, they stole the season scepter, an artifact, from the Sun King on their masters' orders and plunged Endor into perpetual winter. A group of Ewoks infiltrated the palace disguised as Iceheads, recovered the artifact, and restored the scepter and the season to their previous states.
distinctions: Can move on snow at full speed, can skate about on their heads

name: Icetromper
summary: Icetrompers were a type of giant creature that inhabited the valleys found between the mountains of the frigid, snow-covered, Outer Rim world Gigor. Hardy shrubs, mosses, and coniferous trees grew in the valleys, providing the ecosystem in which the icetrompers survived alongside ice scrabblers and jakobeasts.

name: Icewolf
summary: The icewolf was native to the planet Spintir. Icewolves were predatory, hunting with teeth and claws, and inhabited the forested valleys and mountain caves on the planet. After rendering prey unconscious, icewolves would bury it in ice. In the forest near the Caves of Light and Shadow, the icewolves were corrupted by the dark side and became maddened, but also stronger and more resilient. Because of this, other animal life stayed away from the forests near the caves. In 0 ABY, a pack of icewolves were corrupted by the presence of Malefax at the Dawn Temple and attacked a group who were there to rescue Hethan Romund. Later, the same group encountered the pack led by a den mother at the Cave of Light and Shadows, a vergence in the Force.

name: Iceworm
summary: The iceworm, also spelled ice worm, was a burrowing species of annelid native to the ice planet Hoth. The tidal pull of Hoth's three nameless moons caused fissures in the ice-layers of the massive frozen ocean in Hoth's southern hemisphere, sending jets of ocean water into the freezing air. The intense cold froze these jets into spires of ice, suspending primitive ocean algae in these tall columns and glaciers. The iceworms would carve their way through the ice to feed on the algae, leaving odd tiny holes in the ice. When Hoth's winds blew through these iceworm tunnels, they produced an eerie musical sound.

name: Idalowd
summary: Idalowd was a species of sentient beings that were identified by their purple, puncture-proof skin. Countess Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion was a member of the species. Another member attended a dinner party hosted by the Imperial Senator Mon Mothma and her husband Perrin Fertha on Coruscant in 5 BBY.

name: Igitz
summary: Igitz were a species of small amphibians hailing from the planet Naboo. Those blue-skinned, omnivorous critters dwelled in the planet's many dense swamps. Because of the environment in which they had evolved, the igitz were well-adapted to both land and water: while their front paws were clawed for treading on land, their hindquarters were finned, allowing it speed when in water. The igitz were a popular pet in most Gungan civilizations. A certain Gungan diplomat of the New Republic owned one. The diplomat often traveled with his pet igitz to the galactic capital of Coruscant, transporting it in a vivarium shaped like a Gungan hydrostatic bubble.

name: Iguana
summary: The iguana was a species of reptile that was found on the moon Endor. The Ewok Chirpa had a pet iguana.

name: Ikkrukkian
summary: Ikkrukkians, also known as Ikkrukki, were a sentient species native to the Mid Rim planet Ikkrukk. One member of the species, Porter Engle, served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Their physiology enabled them to be able to live for centuries.

name: Iknayid
summary: An iknayid was a non-sentient arachnid species that was native to the swamps of the planet Zakuul. The Zakuulans sometimes trained iknayids as gladiatorial beasts for their arenas. Several taxidermied iknayids were displayed at the Royal Hunting Lodge of Onderon around 3627 BBY .

name: Ikopi
summary: Ikopis were a mammalian species of non-sentient, long-legged herbivores that could be found on the grass plains and turf of the planet Naboo. Ikopis were also found on a ocean planet.
distinctions: Long legs, elongated tongue, short neck, crown of antlers

name: Ikov
summary: The ikov was a species of rodent that was native to the wroshyr tree forests of Kashyyyk. One of the planet's smaller predators, it inhabited one of the upper levels of the Kashyyyk ecosystem, right beneath the tree-top level. It was a small, lean, and streamlined creature, adapted to stealthy and swift climbing through the trees. It fed primarily by scavenging prey that had fallen from the uppermost wroshyr tree branches; these animals rarely survived such a fall, and the furtive ikov was almost always the first to find them. The inner surfaces of its finely-serrated, blade-like teeth were reflective and iridescent, a trait uncommon among predators; these sharp teeth allowed the ikov to quickly cut a piece of meat and run if chased from its finds by larger predators, which it was too small to fend off. Wilek Nereus possessed three specimens of this animal in his tooth collection, two of which, likely immature specimens, he had surprised in a fur-lined tree hollow.

name: Iktotchi
summary: Iktotchi were a horned sentient species from the moon Iktotch. Jedi Master Saesee Tiin, a member of the Jedi High Council prior to and during the Clone Wars, was an Iktotchi.

name: Ilohian
summary: Ilohians were a cultural group of humans from the planet Iloh. The most distinguishing phenotypic trait Ilohians were known for was having naturally green hair, a highly-irregular color for humans outside of the use of hair dyes. Ilohian fashion was heavily influenced by Iloh's tropical biome, and Ilohians commonly wore “iridescent combs made of (local) shells” to hold and style their hair, and simple pearl fixtures were worn as jewelry. The Imperial commander Tian Karmiya was an Ilohian, as was the Imperial-turned-Rebel soldier and pilot Kendy Idele. Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan briefly assumed the Gatalentan Amilyn Holdo to be Ilohian upon first meeting her because she had dyed her hair green.

name: Ilosian
summary: A sentient species, the Ilosians hailed from the agricultural world Ilos. Millennia before the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Ilosians settled many nearby worlds before becoming engulfed in Hutt Space and enslaved by the Hutts. The Ilosians, however, preserved relatively more freedom than other species in the Hutts' servitude.

name: Ilwizzt
summary: The Ilwizzt were a sentient species with mahogany skin and a prominent trunk. That trunk flared and vibrated when they spoke. Brco was an Ilwizzt who attained the rank of major in the G'rho Defense Force. He was in charge in 1 BBY when a Ssi-ruuvi strike-force invaded the Wild Space planet. Despite ordering G'rho's Conjo fighters to attack the invaders, Brco and virtually all the other colonists were captured by the Ssi-ruuk.

name: Imbat
summary: Imbats were a sentient species, known for their size and relative lack of intelligence.

name: Immolanoid
summary: The Immolanoids were a sentient species that were known to combust. By the year 18 BBY, some Immolanoids had lived and commuted on Coruscant, the capital planet of the Galactic Republic. The Besalisk chef Dexter Jettster mentioned the species in the ice cream section of the menu for his CoCo Town Coruscant restaurant, Dex's Diner, prior to its destruction at some point during the first two years of the Galactic Empire.

name: Implanter
summary: Implanters were Yuuzhan Vong creatures that "implanted" surge-coral into sentient beings to make them into slaves. Also known as "creepers", these creatures carried dozens of surge-coral seeds on their backs. The creeper would inflict pain on and disable their victims by using their feathery appendages to disrupt the victim's nervous system. The victim would then be implanted with the seeds. Relatives of implanters were used in the escalation ceremony.

name: Imroosian
summary: Imroosians were a sentient species that existed within the galaxy from the volcanic planet Imroosia. Imroosians developed flinty, chalk-like skin, cracked like dried out desert ground, to adapt to their heated climate and were hairless. During the High Republic Era, Archivist Ru-Ru was an Imroosian serving the Jedi Order at the temple on Banchii. Another notable Imroosian was Margo, who served as Dryden Vos' concierge aboard his yacht, the First Light during the Imperial Era. Mem was a young Imroosian who lived on the planet Lenahra during the late Republic Era. Also during the Imperial Era, a young Imroosian named Agira served the House of Organa as the handmaiden of Princess Leia.

name: Imyni
summary: In the opera The Kallea Cycle, the Imyni were a sentient species from the Outer Rim Territories world Imynusoph. The Human scout Freia Kallea treated them presumptuously while enlisting their aid in exacting revenge on her rivals, the Neimoidians Thoax and Farge Osaax. As a result, when Kallea ordered the Imyni to bind the Osaaxes while she sprung her trap in a temple on Imynusoph, the natives instead turned on all the offworlders, leading to a climactic battle.

name: Imzig
summary: The Imzig species was a sentient Humanoid race native to the planet Couronne. The species differed from base Humans through bony ridges surrounding the formers' eyes, raised eyebrows, and wider nostrils. At least one was light-skinned, with blue mottles on the face, as well as light brown hair. Utris M'Toc was an Imzig who hailed from his species' homeworld. When a bloody coup occurred on Couronne, M'Toc, who worked as a member of the monarchical High King's Guard, fled the planet. In 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire occupied Cloud City on the planet Bespin. By that time, M'Toc had joined Cloud City's Wing Guard, becoming a leader in the security force, and he was present on Cloud City during the Imperial takeover.

name: Inchichtok
summary: The Inchichtok were a xenophobic sentient species. Around 200 BBY, the Inchichtok had their first contact with the Galactic Republic, meeting the scout expedition commander Arnoth Draenell and his crew in an unscouted star system that later became known as the Bissillirus system in the Mid Rim. Though Draenell's crew attempted to continue their expedition, the Inchichtok prevented them from doing so by ending their lives.

name: Indu
summary: The Indus (singular, Indu) were a Human race from the planet Indu San.

name: Inleshat
summary: Inleshat were a sentient species. Anst Wozo was an Inleshat who operated during the High Republic Era.

name: Insect-bird
summary: Insect-birds were red animals from Yavin 4.

name: Insectomorph
summary: Insectomorphs were a domesticated four-legged species on the planet Malastare which were used as mounts by soldiers of the sentient Dug species.

name: Ion eel
summary: The Ion eel was a species of eel found on the ice planet Hoth.

name: Iotran
summary: The Iotrans were a humanoid species from the Iotra system. When Merei Spanjaf and Jix Hekyl tried to smuggle a pulse-mag into a data center on Lothal, they encountered a hulking, bald example of this species with a blaster who warned them that they'd be "two smoking spots" if they took another step. Iotrans were a burly militaristic species, and considered short and stocky. The Separatist Iotran Guard was made up of Iotrans.

name: Ipharian-Da'Lor
summary: The Ipharian-Da'Lor were a species of reptilian beings with truncated snake-like bodies from the planet Iphar. They had spiny ridges which extended down from the back of the head to the tip of the prehensile tail, from which a spike could be extended. This spike could be used in personal combat to deadly effect. Their skin was naturally gray, but they could change its color to match their surroundings. Their faces had elongated snouts, large slanted pupils and rows of sharp teeth. It was a custom of the Ipharian-Da'Lor to cover their faces. A notable member of this species was the bounty hunter Vallikor En-Vahdi.

name: Ipsidon buck
summary: Ipsidon bucks were a species of herding creature resided on an ipsium-rich planet Ipsidon. The species was quadrupedal, had blue fur with a white underbelly, and had three horns; two atop its head, and a single horn affixed between its eyes. The Ipsidon bucks were strong and fast deerlike creatures who travelled in herds through the sometimes narrow caverns of the desert. To flee the planet's storms, the species would flee and stampede through canyons.

name: Iraida
summary: Iraidas or Lraidas were a species of predatory reptomammals that were native to the planet Alderaan. They were characterized by their long ears which permitted them to develop an advanced hearing which they used to hear and hunt their prey. They had a light-blueish grey fur that protected them from the cold of Alderaan mountains. They are distantly related to the bolraida, another species that lived on the planet, but they had demonstrated a far more superior intelligence than their more vicious and aggressive brethren. This superiority made them more cunning predators than the bolraida and led them to use different approaches to get to their prey. They were sometimes used as watch-beasts, even if their roles were limited and also played a major part in the arenas during the "gladiatorial" challenges, this entertainment was most appreciated by the crowd.

name: Irax
summary: An irax was a creature.

name: Irewing
summary: Irewings were large avian creatures found on the planet Ruhnuk.

name: Iriaz
summary: Iriaz were docile creatures from the grassland planet Dantooine. While not normally aggressive, they could attack if provoked, charging with their horns. They were a prey of choice for local hunters given that they were a relatively common creature, particularly near the Jedi Enclave.

name: Irid
summary: Irids were flighted birds native to the planet Ragoon VI. With yellow feathers on their wings, they were noted for plumage that was pleasing to the eye. Nevertheless, they were notorious for their violent behavior toward others of their species. In contrast, they were quite nurturing to their young and taught them how to take care of themselves. Upon reaching maturity, when they developed that pugnacious disposition, offspring would often attack their own parents indiscriminately. Two Jedi, Qui-Gon Jinn and Tahl, saw an irid while visiting Ragoon VI for a training mission in the wake of Jinn's apprentice, Xanatos, turning to the dark side around 53 BBY.

name: Iridescent fangscale
summary: The iridescent fangscale was a species of giant, shiny fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War.

name: Iridonian
summary: Iridonians, also known as Iridonian Zabraks, were a race of the sentient Zabrak species native to the planet Iridonia. Eeth Koth and Agen Kolar were Iridonian Zabraks who became Jedi.

name: Iridonian
summary: The Iridonians, colloquially called Iridorians, were a warrior people with a particularly bloodthirsty reputation. Most galactic citizens feared them, for it was rumored that they would continue to attack a corpse even after the target was dead and turn against each other in battle when their bloodlust overwhelmed them. The Iridonians were rivals to the Echani and Mandalorian cultures, and members of the species were found on such planets as Manaan during the Jedi Civil War, a period of galactic unrest between 3959 and 3956 BBY. The amnesiac Jedi Knight and former Sith Lord Revan encountered an Iridonian mercenary on Manaan during the war. The armored warrior told Revan of his people's history before Revan continued on his quest for the maps that would lead him to the Star Forge superweapon of the Sith Empire.

name: Irling
summary: Irlings were a large, non-sentient species of insectoid ptero-creatures that lived on the planet Ord Mantell. They were nocturnal creatures, preferring dark environments such as caverns and mining tunnels, and would form hives made out of a web-like substance within them. They were visually sensitive to light and became highly aggressive if disturbed by noise during their sleep.

name: Irrukiine
summary: The Irrukiine were four-armed sentients indigenous to Malrev IV. They were sometimes referred to as Irks. They are believed to have been influenced greatly by the Sith Temple hidden within the forests of Malrev IV. They developed a strong sense of ownership over the temple, attacking anything that entered the vicinity of the ancient structure. However, a being who learned how to wield the Sith magic that emanated from the temple would have been able to manipulate them, such as the mad Devaronian Cartariun. He armed them with Imperial blasters for ground assaults and even motivated them to fly TIE Fighters in aerial combat. Even under Cartariun's control, the Irrukiine retained their volatile nature.

name: Ishi Tib
summary: Ishi Tib were a sentient species of amphibious humanoids from the planet Tibrin. They had skin that ranged from green to blue, large eyes that extended from angular stalks on either side of their skull, and a beak-like mouth. A number of Ishi Tib were employed for Jabba the Hutt, while others fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

name: Ishori
summary: The Ishori, a species indigenous to the planet Isht, were long-time rivals of the Diamala. Their disputes over commerce and resource-sharing were a common source of tension in their part of the Core Worlds. In 19 ABY, the Ishori refused to allow armed Diamalan vessels into their ports. An attempt by the Iphigini to resolve the dispute (with Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Luke Skywalker as mediators) was unsuccessful. Their dispute with the Diamala soon became a flashpoint in a larger dispute in the New Republic over the Caamas Document. While the Diamala took a "forgive and forget" approach, Ishori Senator Ghic Dx'ono was one of the leading voices in favor of making the Bothans pay for their complicity in the destruction of Caamas. The apparent return of Grand Admiral Thrawn at the same time did not concern the leadership of the Ishori Confederene, many of whom suspected it to be some sort of Bothan plot. Despite their anti-Bothan stance, the Ishori fleet participated in the Battle of Bothawui against three Imperial Star Destroyers, as fleeing from an enemy that the Diamala stayed to fight would have been too great an embarrassment. Psychologically, Ishori had what some called a "fight or think" response. They found it difficult to discuss any complicated issue without becoming emotional and agitated. Ishori had horn-tipped fists.

name: Iskalloni
summary: The Iskalloni, or Iskallons, were a sentient species of short, blue-skinned, humanoid cyborgs indigenous to the Wild Space planet of Iskadrell. Possessing a physiology that allowed their bodies to integrate foreign matter, the Iskalloni experimented with cybernetic implants, sometimes replacing entire limbs with prosthetics. An isolated civilization with a technological base fusing biotechnology with mechanical devices, they rarely came into contact with the rest of the galaxy. Since their technology produced deadly toxic waste and they did not want to risk their own lives processing it, the Iskalloni resorted to slaving raids on other species, whom they transformed into cyborgs and forced to work with the dangerous waste. Viewing Humans as inferior, the cyborgs were intent to enslave them in particular. Unable to develop safer technology by themselves, the Iskalloni also studied captured Human starships in the hopes of finding a way to build machinery that would not be so deadly to operate. Prior to the Great Sith War, the Iskalloni were responsible for raising the Zeltron Antos Wyrick, who went on to become the infamous Mandalorian scientist "Doctor Demagol." During their first contact with the Galactic Empire, the cyborgs enslaved Imperial agents, prompting the Empire to attack Iskadrell in retaliation. Half of the planet was devastated before the Iskalloni repelled the attack, but they did not pursue the fleeing Imperials. During the reign of the New Republic, a group of Iskalloni attempted to capture a New Republic starship with the help of the outlaw Wertram Farege. Farege lured the ship into Iskalloni space, where it was boarded by the cyborgs. The Iskalloni betrayed Farege and attempted to convert him into a cyborg, but the latter managed to escape aboard the New Republic vessel along with its crew.

name: Island-beast
summary: The island-beasts were colossal floating grazers native to Taloraan where they inhabited the upper atmosphere. Island beasts kept themselves afloat by storing gas inside their huge hollow bodies. They had thousands of tendrils hanging from their undersides and a hole on top and one at the bottom for intake and releasing gas. The Wind Raiders tribe of Humans had domesticated some of these creatures and used them as their homes, having built camps inside of them. Its tendrils were typically one to two kilometers long.

name: Isnr
summary: Isnr was a class of birds with vivid colors native to Cerea. It was a common name among Cerean females.

name: Issori
summary: Issori were amphibious, carnivorous humanoids indigenous to Issor.

name: Itch mite
summary: Itch mites were a type of mite. When the Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi boarded the Invisible Hand, flagship of Separatist General Grievous, during the Battle of Coruscant in 19 BBY, Grievous refered to the Jedi as itch mites when ordering a group of B1-series battle droids to attack them.

name: Ithorian
summary: Ithorians, commonly referred to as hammerheads or as leathernecks as an insult, were a sentient species from the planet Ithor. Ithorians had two mouths on the opposite sides of their necks, giving them a deep, rumbling voice. Most Ithorians were peaceful and revered nature. The species' pacifism was so strong that they exiled violent individuals from their homeworld of Ithor. Notable Ithorians include Dok-Ondar, a collector on Batuu, and Momaw Nadon, an Ithorian gardener who was exiled from his homeworld.

name: Ithorian dragon
summary: Native to the planet of Ithor, the Ithorian dragons were reptilian predators as old as the Ithorians.

name: Ithorian razor shark
summary: Ithorian razor sharks were a predatory fish that lived in the oceans of the planet Ithor. The sharks had dagger-like teeth that lined their large mouths. In 44 BBY, the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi saw a draigon—a silver-scaled reptile with yellow eyes and large needle-like teeth that arced from its gums—and was vaguely reminded of an Ithorian razor shark.

name: Ithullan
summary: The Ithullans were a humanoid species that hailed from the planet Ithull. As natives of the Stenness Node, they were one of the 25 species collectively called "Nessies". Two-hundred years before the rise of the Galactic Empire, the Mandalorians waged war against the Ithullans and nearly wiped them out. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, there were very few Ithullans left, and only a few scattered members of the Ithullan race could be found wandering the streets of Mos Eisley on Tatooine. Both the bounty hunters Gorm and Dyyz Nataz were known to wear Ithullan armor.

name: Ivuur
summary: The Ivuur was a species of bird found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. An Ivuur could sing two different songs simultaneously, and some female Ithorians had "Ivuur" as a given name. The name could have negative connotations.

name: Ixll
summary: Ixlls were a sentient species of flying creatures native to the moon Da Soocha V, also known as the Pinnacle Moon. Ixlls were descended from omnivorous predators, and had a well-developed feudal society that was generally peaceful; they also had an aptitude for tool and craft making, creating simple but elegant bags and ornaments, as well as black powder grenades they called "exploding stones." [[File:Ixlls--falcon.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ixlls guide the Millennium Falcon into Pinnacle Base.]] Their language consisted of high-pitched chirps, clicks, and whistles that carried over great distances in the thin air of the pinnacles. They lived in warrens at the tops of the flattened pinnacles, and often collected odds and ends to decorate them. To see in the dark, they had natural sonar. They could fly at speeds of up to 80 kilometers per hour, and glide at around 64 kilometers per hour. Pinnacle Moon was home to Pinnacle Base, a New Republic fortification used after the fall of Coruscant to Imperial warlords prior to the resurrection of Palpatine. Ixlls often flew through the pinnacles of the moon and darted around New Republic ships. They also demonstrated great friendliness and playfulness with New Republic personnel, and were quickly learning about galactic technology, even learning to use their whistling speech to reprogram astromech droids as pranks. Their legends often centered around tumnors, large predators of their young. When the New Republic evacuated the world in advance of the Galaxy Gun's projectile, they took several Ixlls with them; eventually, they established a colony on one of the uninhabited moons of Endor.

name: Ixzinian rock ram
summary: Ixzinian rock rams were beasts native to the planet Pellastrallas and the Ixzinia system. They were grazing animals with an armored frill around their head and long, thick coat. They had black eyes and brown coat with white stripes along their backs. Some of them were prey of the arqet, which hunted them in the planet's forests. Many beast masters hunted this animal for exotic animal collections and circuses.

name: Iyra
summary: The Iyra were a species of sentient cephalopods from the watery planet F'tral. Each Iyra had four or more limbs that spread from the radially symmetrical body, an arrangement that made each member of the species one to two meters in diameter. The mouth opened from the ventral side of the body, and one eyestalk grew for each tentacle. As an Iyra became older, he or she grew more tentacles and eyes. The species' leathery skin was elastic and capable of changing color for camouflage or for courtship rituals. Although they were aquatic and resided in large undersea cities, Iyra were able to survive on land. They were clumsy out of water, however, and preferred to travel on small repulsor sleds known as floating ponds. Iyra society was governed by a rigid caste system that placed Iyra with more tentacles—the older and larger members of the group—at a higher position. Iyra careless enough to lose a tentacle through accident or in combat suffered a reduction in caste and had to destroy an eye to correspond to the lost limb. Disputes between Iyra of equal caste were sometimes settled via duels. The first to lose a tentacle was immediately reduced to a lower caste and forced to yield to the superior combatant. The lowest caste, composed of four-armed Iyra, was responsible for raising the young. Iyra tended to view members of other species through the lens of the caste system; Iyra with five or more tentacles thus looked down upon humanoids and other two-armed bipeds. The Iyra's attitude lent them a reputation as arrogant among other species. Since Iyra could absorb oxygen through their skin, Iyra starships were filled with gaseous atmosphere heavy in water vapor. The strategy contrasted that of many purely aquatic species whose attempts to design craft filled with liquid water made them both heavier and more expensive to operate. Iyra were leaders in the manufacture of corrosion-resistant metal alloys and the design of gravity-manipulation equipment and inertial devices for starships. Famous Iyra included Tem Eliss, the eminent sentientologist who wrote The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life.
distinctions: Radial symmetry, four or more arms and eyestalks

name: Izizian monkey
summary: Izizian monkeys were a type of creature native to the Inner Rim jungle planet Onderon. The creature shared its name with Iziz, Onderon's capital city. In 231 BBY, when Onderon received a sky-island with a replication of its environment for the Valo Republic Fair, fair organizers led by Coordinator Samera Ra-oon avoided stocking the sky-island with more dangerous creatures, opting for a few monkeys and birds as they did not want any of their visitors killed or eaten. When Ra-oon told Jedi Master Elzar Mann about the jungle safaris that would be offered on the Onderon island, she mentioned the presence of the Izizian monkeys.

name: Jabarek lizard
summary: Jabarek lizards, also known simply as jabareks, were a type of lizard found all across the planet Akiva, where they prefered to live beside lakes or other large bodies of water. Excellent swimmers, they possessed two sets of yellow eyes, one set of which was adapted specifically spot fish deep beneath the water's surface.

name: Jablogian
summary: Jablogians were a sentient species native to the planet of Nar Kanji. They were noted for their overweight torsos, blemished red skin, pointed ears and beady eyes. Azmorigan, Drahric and Nazgorigan were members of that species. The species shared its name with the language of the same name, which was spoken by the human Tasu Leech.

name: Jack-a-dale
summary: Jack-a-dales were birds native to Utharis that lived in abandoned buildings.

name: Jackelope
summary: The rare and elusive jackelope was a small horned creature native to the planet Douglas III, a part of the galaxy's Centrality region. Famous game hunter Mendel Douglas, after whom Douglas III was named, traversed the planet in a bid to acquire the jackelope's hide. Although the jackelope made it back for his collection, Douglas did not survive the expedition. By 3 BBY, the working-class bar Poly Pyramid on the neighboring Centrality planet Rafa IV decorated its interior with incompetently taxidermized galactic fauna, both nailed to the walls and suspended from the ceiling. A jackelope from Douglas III numbered among the creatures displayed.

name: Jacuna
summary: Jacunas were Haruun Kal scavengers, although they would eat living creatures as well. They were birds the size of Kowakian monkey-lizards that traveled in packs of up to several dozen. They were able to fly, run, climb, and swing from tree branches.

name: Jaggalor
summary: A jaggalor was a species of Corellian predatory animals that was virtually identical to the asharl panther and was considered to be powerful and extremely aggressive. Some specimen were kept in the Coronet Zoo. During the Battle of Corellia, a number of jaggalors escaped captivity and roamed the Axial Park district, attacking anything they came across. Imperial Lieutenant Boonan was forced to deal with the jaggalor problem by hiring an Imperial hero to exterminate them.

name: Jagomiri swamp stalker
summary: Jagomiri swamp stalkers were a non-sentient species of vulpine native to the planet Jagomir. When the Ardan resistance arrived on Jagomir, many rebel patrols had to fight off various swamp stalkers.

name: Jaing's species
summary: The humanoid species training master Jaing belonged to possessed skulls that bore a striking resemblance to that of a male mythosaur. [[File:JaingSkull.png|thumb|left|200px|The skull of Jaing's species served as the initial inspiration for the Mandalorian crest.]] Members of the species had large horns that grew downwards out of the sides of their elongated heads and could live for thousands of years. The only known member of the species, Jaing, was a renowned Mandalorian training master who fought in multiple Mandalorian conflicts over the millennia. The Mandalorian clans who served under Jaing adopted a crest that bore the skull of his species as a way to honor him. Due to the skull's close resemblance to the skull of a male mythosaur, the Mandalorians of later times would interpret the crest as a depiction of a mythosaur skull. While the Mandalorians would adopt the crest as the collective symbol of their people, all connections to the crest with Jaing and his species were forgotten.
distinctions: Elongated head, downward curving horns, quadactyl feet

name: Jakelian
summary: The Jakelians were a sentient species from the Outer Rim Territories' Jakelia system. They developed edged weapons and, during the Mandalorian Crusades, became a vassal species of the Taung Mandalorian Crusaders. Later, during the reign of Mandalore the Ultimate, Jakelians were among the species whose members became full members of the Mandalorian clans.

name: Jakobeast
summary: Jakobeasts were a brown-furred type of animal that inhabited the valleys between mountains on the snow-covered Outer Rim Territories planet Gigor. In 9 BBY, when Princess Leia Organa of the Core World Alderaan was told by her mother, Queen Breha Organa, to apologize to her cousin Niano for insulting him, Leia responded that she would rather be digested by a jakobeast. Navigator Plesko Marno wore a coat with sleeves make of jakobeast-fur while on the planet Kijimi in 35 ABY.

name: Jakoosk
summary: Jakoosks were a species of large creatures capable of flying and burrowing under snow native to the ice moon Celsor 3. They had thick gray skin that was able to resist starfighter cannons, though its lighter underside was more vulnerable and a direct hit with a blaster cannon to it would kill a jakoosk dead in one shot, as well as a large mouth filled with equally large teeth and several sets of pincer-like limbs on their undersides that could be used to grab prey and force them into its open mouth. Jakoosk meat, once cooked, could be eaten by a variety of species such as humans, Gilliands, Gamorreans, Gozzos, Chadra-Fan, Theelins, and Nautolans; this fact did not appear to be common knowledge, as both Kazuda Xiono and Jarek Yeager expressed surprise upon being informed that jakoosk meat was edible. When the Ace Squadron conducted combat training exercises on the moon, they awoke a jakoosk that eventually attacked them. Hype Fazon was the first pilot targeted by the creature, though it was freed when Torra Doza caused an ice pillar to collapse on top of it. Soon after, the same jakoosk captured Jarek Yeager in his fighter, before the other Aces managed to free him by collapsing another ice pillar onto the creature. The jakoosk that had threatened the Aces was later hunted to provide food for the Colossus platform, first by the Warbird gang. The warbird gang ignored Kazuda Xiono's warnings regarding the creature, and as a result, returned to the Colossus empty-handed. Xiono and Torra Doza later returned to Celsor 3, in another attempt to hunt the jakoosk. The jakoosk had briefly disabled the cannon meant to bring it down, but utilizing CB-23 as a battery instead, Xiono managed to bring the jakoosk down. The jakoosk's remains were made into food by Aunt Z.

name: Jakrab
summary: Jakrabs were a species of long-eared swift bounding lagomorphs native to Tatooine and Neimoidia. [[File:Jakrabs-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Alarm (left), Curiosity (center), Calm (right)]] These herbivores would get food and water from plants and shrubs relying on a small nipping beak and a wide, 180-degree vision range for protection from predators like anooba.
