They had long ears which they used for hearing, heat dissipation, and communication. These ears relayed the creatures' attitude. When alarmed, they would put both ears up; when curious, they would put one ear up and leave the other down; when all was well, they would simply leave both ears down. They sometimes hang out with scurriers.

name: Jaltiri tribals
summary: The Jaltiri tribes were a cultural or/and planetary community that inhabited the world of Toskhowwl VI in the Mid Rim. Around 5 ABY, the Jaltiri tribals were known beyond their homeworld for their custom of constructing stacks made from severed heads.

name: Jaluku
summary: The Jaluku were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy that had white skin and an elongated chin. Jaluku lived on worlds such as Vandor and Daiyu. Seleno Chandro was a Jaluku male bounty hunter who formerly worked in the Bounty Hunters' Guild and would later join Citizens' Fleet during the Battle of Exegol. Jaluku could be commonly seen wearing goggles to cover their eyes, Chandro wore data goggles in particular.

name: Jandoonian salamander
summary: Jandoonian salamanders were a type of salamander found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Jandoon. They could be domesticated and kept as pets.

name: Jante
summary: The Jante were a species native to the planet of Jante. They were locked in an arms race against the nearby Freda, who eventually attacked Jante industrial plants on Rett II. The Galactic Empire, led by Moff Haveland, ordered a ceasefire, from which the Freda eventually withdrew.

name: Jarell
summary: Jarells were a humanoid reptiloid species native to the planet Oon Tien in the Kathol sector. They developed a primitive society on their homeworld, organized into matriarchal city-states, before contact with colony ships from the Galactic Republic approximately three centuries prior to the Battle of Endor. Jarells were a historically violent species; the various monarchies that ruled Jarell society forced their own young into periods of indentured servitude in exchange for weapons and technology. Since their discovery by the Republic, Jarells migrated to several other planets in the Kathol sector and were often found serving private citizens, corporations, and criminal organizations as hired muscle.

name: Jart
summary: Jarts were birds of prey native to Ryloth. They hunted at night.

name: Jashwik
summary: The Jashwik were a species of orange-skinned, jowled humanoids that hailed from the planet of Jashwa and were related to the Sullustans of Sullust. Cody Sunn-Childe was a Jashwik. He once theorized that his species was possibly a naturally Force-sensitive one.

name: Jassk
summary: Jassks were an endangered non-sentient species that swallowed its prey whole and digested it for weeks. The Spectres encountered one being transported to the Emperor's personal zoo, aboard a class four container transport while trying to rescue the argora.

name: Jastaal
summary: The Jastaal were an avian sentient species that spoke in a trilling language. They had wings that partially extended when they walked, lifting their bodies so that they appeared to be half-gliding along, bouncing on the wind. At some point between 2 BBY and 1 BBY, a number of Jastaal were present on the planet Bonadan at the same time that the smuggler Han Solo was there investigating an enslavement ring. After noticing them, Solo reflected that their plumage was beautiful.

name: Jawa
summary: Jawas were a nomadic sentient species of meter-tall furry humanoids native to the Outer Rim desert world of Tatooine. Jawas who migrated from Tatooine were referred to as Offworld Jawas.

name: Jawenko lava beast
summary: The Jawenko lava beasts were a creature native to Mustafar. It naturally produced Nkllonian lava extract from liquid xonolite. One such creature stranded on Tatooine gave basis to a Jawa and Sand People deity named "Great Jawenko." After a massacre against the Rrhr hunting band of Tusken Raiders by the Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker in retribution of the death of his mother, Shmi Skywalker Lars, in 22 BBY, the Tuskens proceeded to believe that Shmi may have in fact been a witch that was the mate of the Great Jawenko.

name: Jawfish
summary: Jawfish were a type of fish from the planet Eiram's lagoons edible by Quarren. In 382 BBY, while visiting the planet E'ronoh, Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo felt that he was being too coddled; he would have preferred roasted diredeer or freshly caught jawfish.

name: Jazbinan
summary: The Jazbinans were humanoid sentients with feline traits indigenous to the planet Jazbina. They were ruled by an aristocratic family, headed by Lord Prepredenko in 0 ABY. Many Jazbinans were opposed to the rule of the Galactic Empire but resigned to its rule, doing little more than complaining among themselves over its transgressions. However, when Darth Vader had Prepredenko executed shortly after the Battle of Yavin and imposed direct Imperial rule, the masses rose against him, led by Princess Syayna, who was the former Lord's daughter, and the Rebel hero Luke Skywalker.

name: Jeby
summary: The Jeby were a species that dwelled on the world of Rainboh, a planet of the Hapes Cluster. They were jovial creatures, shedding their pink or red spots whenever they laughed. The Jeby then had to use their twelve tentacles to gather these spots and reattach them to their bodies. Jeby had three long necks, which terminated in three round heads, each with a single hair at its apex. They stood on four thin legs, which were striped white and red.

name: Jeco
summary: Jeco were creatures capable of making swift attacks. Dezix of the Imperial Security Bureau was described as being capable of striking as swiftly as a jeco.

name: Jedha Glider
summary: Jedha Gliders were a species of winged reptile that lived on Jedha.

name: Jefi
summary: The Jefi (plural form: Jefies) were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. The Jefies were considered to be a species of incredible loyalty, unflinchingly following anyone who presented them self as a competent leader. This led them even to submit to the rule of individuals from other species including humans. They were the indigenous inhabitants of the planet Botajef and made up 85 percent of the population.

name: Jekaran shark
summary: Jekaran sharks were a species of shark native to the waters of the Mid Rim ice planet Jekara, where they were able to sense blood. In 3 ABY, Lady Domina Tagge of the Tagge Corporation sent the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra and the smuggler Sana Starros to gather information on the resurgent Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate and other Tagge Corporation competitors at an upcoming auction hosted by Crimson Dawn on Jekara. Tagge warned the two of the other syndicates, comparing them to Jekaran sharks.

name: Jekoon
summary: Jekoon was a floating non-sentient species that existed in the galaxy. A Xi'Dec kept a Jekoon at the Canto Bight casino.

name: Jellybee
summary: Jellybees were creatures found on Nedij. Usually traveling in groups of twelve to fifteen, each jellybee could deliver a mildly painful shock to attackers.

name: Jellyfish
summary: Jellyfish were marine invertebrates composed of a bell-shaped jellylike exterior, with tentacles dangling from its innards.

name: Jemian
summary: The jemians were petite birds that had been domesticated and raised for their delicious eggs.

name: Jenet
summary: Jenet were a rodent sentient species. One Jenet, Cenevax, was a crime lord who operated an unlicensed gambling ring on Coruscant. The Jenet were able to dredge up past events with perfect accuracy.

name: Jeodu
summary: The Jeodu were a tall, brown-skinned species. Their heads were topped with a conical white crystal; for this reason, the name "Dequc" (meaning "Whitehead") was common among them. A Jeodu, Dequc became the leader of Black Nebula in 3.5 ABY, in an attempt to resurrect the Black Sun criminal organization, and many Jeodu joined the organization. Besides Dequc, other Jeodu included Eoodso, Traff, Chackra, and Clomv.
distinctions: Head topped with conical white crystal

name: Jerba
summary: The jerba was an equine pack animal and beast of burden native to the desert planet Tatooine. Many jerbas were raised to produce meats, milk, pelts and leather.

name: Jerethian clamberwolf
summary: Jerethian clamberwolf were a highly intelligent species of wolf native to Jereth VI.

name: Jerni
summary: The sentient Jerni were the original inhabitants of the ancient Outer Rim desert planet Jerne, where they once ruled over a glorious empire before suffering extinction many eons before the Galactic Civil War. In a failed bid to capture Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker of the Rebel Alliance shortly after the destruction of Alderaan, the Dark Lord Darth Vader tricked his nemesis into chasing after the fabled Eternity Crystal, a device allegedly crafted by the Jerni that promised to save Alderaan through the power of time travel.

name: Jessar
summary: The Jessar were a sentient species native to the planet of Qaras. In 44 ABY, the Jessar led by Rokari Kem revolted against their enslavers, the Minyavish species. The Jessar were known for their pacifism, choosing to overthrow the Minyavish government in a single night resulting in a nearly bloodless coup (and even that only after years of exhausting more peaceful solutions). Kem subsequently passed a law forbidding retaliation against the Minyavish, but later forced them to leave the planet, believing that both species needed to learn about themselves without the other. When Qaras was accepted into the Galactic Alliance, Rokari Kem was elected as the senator for the planet. She became the target of Abeloth when the dark-side creature saw her interview on the HoloNet and witnessed how deeply the Jessar people loved Rokari - going so far as to call her "Mother". The species was described as humanoid, with slender limbs & three-fingered hands. Their skin was a pale blue and Rokari was described as having large, expressive green eyes and blue-green hair. The Jessar believed that words have actual, physical power over things, and did not have a word in their language for deception. Therefore, the Jessar were regarded as completely honest, with slaves taking a vow of silence during the revolt rather than lie to their Minyavish masters.

name: Jexxel
summary: Jexxels were tundra-dwelling, white-furred, red-eyed felines. They had serrated front claws and a mouthful of razor-sharp fangs. Their eyes glowed in the dark and gave them excellent night-vision. They were vicious predators that were very territorial and aggressive. They hunted in packs of five, and would attack anything they came across.

name: Jexxel cat
summary: Jexxel cats were a type of feline that lived in the caves that riddled the mountains of the frigid Outer Rim planet Gigor. The cats shared the caves with snow shredder bats and sentient Gigorans, with edible molds and mushrooms thriving deep inside due to the presence of hot springs.

name: Jeylac
summary: The Jeylac were a sentient species. During the Clone Wars, the Separatist sympathizer Aviso carried a Jeylac slave aboard his starship, and he attempted to use XNA-580—an experimental device that could alter the brainwaves of some species—to influence the slave's mind.

name: J'feh
summary: The J'feh were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Lady Nadrian DuQuosenne, a J'feh female, served as the senator for her homeworld Yabrenito during the twilight years of the Galactic Republic and into the early reign of the Galactic Empire.

name: Jhadd
summary: Jhadds were strong non-sentient creatures that had talons and a razor-sharp beak.

name: Jiivahar
summary: The Jiivahar were a sentient species descended from hairless simians. They were excellent climbers, with a number of physical attributes that facilitated that ability. They had a streamlined body, with hollow bones, giving them a light frame. Their long limbs were flexible and were covered in tiny pockmarks that provided additional grip. The Jiivahar also secreted sarvin from the pores of their hands and feet. That substance was a strong adhesive that adhered to virtually all materials. The Jiivahar were native to Carest One of the Inner Rim Territories. Their society was organized around talins, aggregates of five to ten families. Talins were semi-nomadic, roaming freely among the thykar conifers during the warm months, but returning to permanent, yet primitive, settlements for the cold months. Talins annually redistributed material goods among their membership, in festivals known as Kinn-taas. Carest One was a popular tourist destination, attracting visitors with its beautiful towering forests. Some Jiivahar, such as Jannpyr, offered their services as guides to these visitors. That interaction with offworlders also led to the introduction of advanced technology to the Jiivahar. Those technological items amazed the Jiivahar and disturbed the community equilibrium achieved by the Kinn-taas, as individuals refused to redistribute them to others. A number of Jiivahar traveled out into the galaxy to satiate their curiosity. Some became involved in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, while others found work in the underworld, such as Klevb, a terrorist-for-hire.

name: Jillsarian
summary: Jillsarians were a sentient species with four arms that hailed from the Jillsaria system in the Outer Rim Territories. Doctor Quadpaw, who otherwise kept his name a secret, was a male Jillsarian who lived during the Imperial Era and found work as a for-hire physician. Beyond his four dexterous arms, Quadpaw made use of cybernetic-enhancements, which enhanced his eyes and ears; together, his enhancements and Jillsarian biology allowed him to carry out precise, if expensive, work as a surgeon on the Outer Rim moon Frezno in an unassuming tent.

name: Jilruan
summary: The Jilruans were a sentient species native to a planet located in the Jilrua system in Hutt Space that was conquered by the Hutt Cartel, which was controlled by the Hutts from the neighboring world of Nal Hutta, who turned them into slaves or vassals.
homeworld: A planet in the Jilrua system

name: Jimvu
summary: The jimvu was an agile, six-legged, ungulate-like reptile whose only defense was its swiftness. Their main predators were the veermok and narglatch. They lived in the Gungan swamps of Naboo.

name: Jin
summary: The Jin were sapients native to the Zchtek worlds of the Mid Rim. Rebel Alliance officer Dutra Zeneta was a Jin. Jin could see in the infrared spectrum, allowing them to see in complete darkness providing there were nearby heat sources. The Jin were also known to have a culture rich in arts and literature.
distinctions: Able to see into the infrared spectrum

name: Jinda
summary: Jindas were a sentient species from the Jinda system that were introduced to the moon of Endor at some point. During the High Republic Era, a cruiser with a troop of Jinda dancers attended the Republic Fair on the planet Valo. During the Fair, Skuun reported the details of the accidental explosion of a the cruiser.

name: Jin'ha
summary: The Jin'ha were a enigmatical species famous for their work with the lightsaber-resistant cortosis ore. The Jin'ha also sold some of their cortosis ore to the Trade Federation, which utilized it for their experimental assassin droids. The common weapons the Jin'ha used were pikes, maces and blasters.

name: Jinn Reeso's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Jinn Reeso was a member of this species.

name: Jiruusi
summary: Jiruusi were the sentient inhabitants of the planet Jiruus. Most of them barely spoke Galactic Basic Standard, and they strongly opposed the Galactic Empire.

name: J'kuutak
summary: The j'kuutak was a riding animal used as a mount on Guiteica. Major-Guardian Aul Tarrus Vishav was skilled at riding a j'kuutak.

name: Jocorro
summary: Jocorros were animals from Bespin with delicate wings.

name: Jodi's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Jodi was a member of this species.

name: Jogan-bat
summary: Jogan-bats were a type of bat that shared part of their name with jogan fruit. When the junk dealer Temmin Wexley launched a speeder bike out of the bay doors of the MK-4 freighter Moth during the rebellion on the planet Akiva in 4 ABY, it was comparable to a jogan-bat with its wings on fire.

name: Jokhalli
summary: Jokhalli were sapients indigenous to Blimph 3. They had four arms with long snouts and antennas, closely resembling that of a Dug. Their skin tended to have a green look to it, though their leaders tended to have a brighter shade. The species was known to speak Baragwinian and were also fond of trading and gambling. Jokhalli thought themselves to be the best die casters in the game of divot, their favorite form of gambling. Some Jokhalli tended to have xenophobic tendencies, evidenced by their dislike of foreigners to their home planet and air of superiority in issues related to trade and gambling. However, it deserves to be noted that Jokhalli were familiar with the trade-dialect of the Baragwin, and so must have been familiar, if not comfortable, with offworlders.

name: Joopa
summary: Joopas, or joopa worms, were a non-sentient species of giant, worm-like creatures that lived below the surface of the dusty planet Seelos and could grow to be 21 meters in length. Their distinguishing features included a crown of bright red eyes, long pink tongues, and carapaces of rigid plates covering their otherwise soft bodies. They had a membrane behind their eyes that caused the retinas to reflect light, making their eyes to appear to glow. Lacking teeth, they swallowed prey whole. They were particularly fond of Lasat meat. They were known to use their prehensile tongue to snatch prey on the surface while remaining underground but could emerge from the ground to attack directly. While Joopas enjoyed the taste of Lasats, a similar beast, the Rishi eel preferred the taste of clones. Following the proclamation of the Galactic Empire, some clone troopers of the defunct Galactic Republic (Rex, Wolffe, and Gregor) retired to Seelos, where they would hunt joopas, which Gregor described as delicious. Some time after the fifteenth celebration of Empire Day, the rebel team known as the Spectres traveled to Seelos in search of the clones, whose skills could help the fledgling rebellion. In order to help the clones catch a joopa, Spectres member Garazeb Orrelios, a Lasat, agreed to be used as bait.
distinctions: Large jaws divided into seven parts

name: Jostran
summary: Jostrans were a sentient species native to the planet Munlali Mafir. They were a type of arthropod that could grow up to as large as a Human arm, and resembled slow-moving centipedes. Their civilization was wiped out when the living planet Zonama Sekot passed through their star system and caused prolonged periods of seismic and volcanic activity that was almost responsible for their extinction. A small population of Jostrans did manage to survive the upheavals though, as they adapted to the new environment by becoming symbiotic with the native Krizlaw species, crawling into the mouths of their hosts and then burrowing into their abdominal cavity. Once there they would wrap themselves around the spine and use their legs and fine hairs to infiltrate neural tissue and take control of the body. Because of this unusual configuration, the resultant species had two minds, a controlling and intelligent "rider" and a primitive animal mind. Jedi who were following the trail of Zonama Sekot's retreat into the Unknown Regions soon learned how hard it was to influence the minds of these creatures because of how different both minds were and also because of the natural adaptive habit of the Krizlaws to form hunting packs of eleven hive-linked minds.

name: Jotaz
summary: {{Update|}} Jotaz were a species of large and aggressive but slow predators found on the planet Zeffo. With a thick hide and strong forearms, the Jotaz used brute strength to overwhelm their enemies but had vulnerabilities such as the abdomen region where the skin was thinnest. Cal Kestis discovered and killed a rabid member of the species while exploring a crashed Venator-class Star Destroyer. Five years later, Kestis found and killed a uniquely coloured Jotaz on Coruscant.

name: Jran
summary: The Jran were small Non-sentient predators which preyed on the tiny Wenton creatures, if they could catch one. The continual hide-and-seek existence between both species, gave rise to the phrase "a game of jran and wenton" which indicated series of events in which one party tried to avoid contact with the pursuing party.

name: Jubba bird
summary: Jubba birds were a non-sentient species of bird native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah, where they made their nests using mud. The birds were capable of manipulating the Force, which they used to calm others through songs and quiet their young when danger was near. During the Galactic Civil War, a handful of smugglers captured jubba birds from the canopies of Dagobah, as the birds' soothing songs were prized throughout the galaxy. Jubba birds sang to the Jedi Yoda while he lived in exile on Dagobah, and when he died in 4 ABY they huddled in fear due to the dark presence that was no longer suppressed by the Jedi.

name: Judd's species
summary: This sentient reptilian species had blue skin. Jedi Master Judd was a member of this species.

name: Jumerian
summary: The Jumerians were a sentient species native to the Jumeria system of the Core Worlds. Some Jumerians later became members of the New Republic. In 8 ABY, a number of Jumerians presented Princess Leia Organa Solo with a singing lamp as a gift for her wedding. Although she disliked the item, she kept it in the Coruscanti apartment she shared with her husband, Han Solo. That year, the Wookiees Mallatobuck and Chewbacca visited the apartment with their son Lumpawaroo, who began rummaging through the space. As the parents listened to objects breaking inside, Solo commented that while his wife might be angry about the damage depending on what items were affected, she would probably appreciate if the Jumerians' singing lamp was one of the items broken.

name: Jumurra
summary: The Jumurra were a sentient species with tan skin, pointed ears, and brown eyes. They also possessed jowls. During the High Republic Era, the elder Naasa, a member of the species, was in the Brendok coven.

name: Jundak
summary: The Jundaks were a large vicious creature feared by many for its deadly life cycle. The beast was essentially a parasitic organism native to the planet Mustafar, more specifically the equatorial region of the world. They began life as a small organism which would attach itself to a host, where it would begin gaining nourishment from the 'parent'. Eventually, it would burst forth in its adolescent stage and thus kill the host. From that point on, the Jundak would begin to slowly grow to adulthood. While deadly, it was discovered that the Jundak could not live outside beyond its native environment, which was fortunate for other forms of life. Despite this, however, some holodramas, such as "It Came From Mustafar!", tried to insinuate that Jundaks invaded another planet.

name: Jungle bantha
summary: The jungle bantha was a subspecies of bantha.

name: Jungle Felucian
summary: Jungle Felucians were a primitive sentient species of amphibians native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Felucia. Members of the species were tuned to the ever-changing presence of the Force on their homeworld. Jungle Felucians largely kept to themselves, but when members of the Gossam species arrived on the world they drove the Jungle Felucians into hiding deep within the planet's wild forests. The Jungle Felucians were one of two species native to Felucia with the other being the more peaceful Felucians.

name: Jungle slinker
summary: Jungle slinkers were animals from Kirtania which, as camouflage, looked like woody vines known as lianas.

name: Jungle worrt
summary: Jungle worrts were amphibious creatures found on Kashyyyk. Jungle worrts used their long green tongues to catch smaller prey.

name: Junk beetle
summary: Junk beetles were insects native to the planet of Dagobah. It was included in many dishes and was served with Dagobah mud cake for example. In 1 ABY a spacer found a specimen of this species in the Mokk Stronghold on the planet Dantooine.

name: Junker
summary: The Junkers were a sentient group made up of natives to the planet Lotho Minor. Apparently hybrids of various organic species and mechanical debris, they scavenged the caustic surface of their ruined homeworld for discarded cybernetics to augment their bodies with. The Junkers' origin was a mystery, and many brave scientists investigating the Junkers vanished before they could report back. The Junkers were effective at repairs, scavenging, survival and unarmed combat. When the Sith Lord Savage Opress journeyed to the planet, a large group of Junkers attacked him, only to be killed with ease by his lightsaber.

name: Jurgoran
summary: Jurgorans were large, amphibious animals native to Dromund Kaas, where they were challenged only by the gundark for a position at the top of the food chain. They were known for their sharp claws and tough hides, and they had been transplanted to several worlds across the galaxy. On Taral V, several jurgorans attacked a Republic strike team that was trying to gain information on a missing Jedi.

name: Juriod fang-flier
summary: The Juriod fang-flier was a species of creature native to the planet Jurio. When being transported as cargo aboard starships, they were required to be frozen which induced a state of dormancy in them.

name: Jyykle vulture
summary: Jyykle vultures were solitary flightless avian creatures that lived on Kashyyyk. Their feathers were normally ruffled and their hide was very leathery. They were not aggressive at all and normally ran away when provoked. Some more vicious ones were sometimes found in groups of five and assaulted random people but this was very rare.

name: Kaabore
summary: Kaabores were creatures native to Orsis that could be hunted relatively easily. Trezza, headmaster of the Orsis Academy, would often invite favored students to hunt these beasts, only to have them run afoul of the much more dangerous chargrecks.

name: Kaadu
summary: Kaadu were creatures native and indigenous to the planet Naboo. During a fight on the Great Grass Plains, kaadu were deployed with fambaas to support the Gungan Grand Army to fight off the Trade Federation battle droids. Kaadu were raised as livestock for consumption by some residents of the planet Batuu. They possessed a keen sense of hearing. Gungans considered taming a kaadu to be a sign of reaching adulthood.

name: K'aarg
summary: K'aargs were large, bipedal reptilian humanoids from the planet Shira. They were described as being not very accommodating, and were feared for their mouth full of sharp teeth.

name: Kaastoag
summary: Kaastoag were scavenging creatures with stingers and tentacles used by the Yuuzhan Vong to clean food waste from the floors of their mess halls. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, several were present in the mess aboard the vua'spar interdictor Sunulok shortly before the commencement of the Yuuzhan Vong's Battle Plan Coruscant in 27 ABY, where they fought over yanskac remains cast to the floor by Yuuzhan Vong Warmaster Tsavong Lah while he consumed its meat.
diet: Food waste such as yanskac entrails

name: Kaat Thrick-Thrick's species
summary: This sentient species was a polygamous species that possessed eyestalks and were native to the Nebula Forso. Kaat Thrick-Thrick was a member of this species.

name: Kabatha
summary: Kabatha were creatures which guts were made into a breakfast and eaten by Wookiees.

name: Kabieroun
summary: The Kabierouns were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Kabieroun in the Outer Rim Territories. Their physiology was roughly humanoid, with a long, wrinkled snout that featured two dark eyes and a triangular mouth. The Kabieroun face hung from a lengthy, muscular neck that swooped forward from a bulky torso. With a large frame, Kabierouns towered over most Humans. At least some members of the species integrated into the greater galaxy, attending schools and finding employment. However, after the rise of the New Order, the Galactic Empire enslaved Kabierouns on their homeworld, and those members of the species abroad faced speciesism. Detien Kaileel, a green-skinned member of the species, served for decades as a security agent but turned to running blasters to the Rebel Alliance after the enslavement of his people.
distinctions: Curved neck, long snout, pointed ears

name: Kadas'sa'Nikto
summary: The Kadas'sa'Nikto, or Green Nikto, were one of the subspecies of the Nikto species from the planet Kintan; another was the Kajain'sa'Nikto. They had scaly green, gray, or red skin, black eyes, and symmetrical horns.

name: Kaddyr bug
summary: Kaddyr bugs were chirping insects indigenous to Ossus.

name: Kadrillian
summary: Kadrillians were a sentient species from the Kadril system in the Outer Rim Territories. They possessed terrapin half-shells, and had scaled skin which could be orange in hue. During the High Republic Era, Detective Tals Trilby of the Temple District Police on the planet Coruscant was a Kadrillian.

name: Kadri'Ra
summary: The Kadri'Ra were a large sentient species believed to be related to the Duinuogwuin. The planet of Arapia was their adopted homeworld. Like the Duinuogwuin, the Kadri'Ra were a long-lived species, with a natural lifespan of 1,000 to 1,500 years. Though they shared the Duinuogwuin ability to survive in the vacuum of space, the Kadri'Ra could only survive in space for a few days while Duinuogwuin were said to live in vacuum for months at a time. Some of the Duinuogwuins' more unusual abilities, like natural repulsorlift flight and biological cold fusion, were also absent in the Kadri'Ra. Kadri'Ra continued to grow through their life, reaching lengths of up to two hundred meters. They were protected by a tough exoskeleton, which expanded along with every growth cycle. Older, and therefore larger, Kadri'Ra could become a danger to themselves and others, often retreating to deep caverns or asteroid caves, where their exoskeletons conformed to their surroundings. Kadri'Ra were wise and philosophical by nature. Despite this, or perhaps because of it, they were declared a non-sentient slave species by the Galactic Empire. Their immense strength and ability to survive vacuum made them popular targets for slavers, who forced them to become heavy laborers in construction projects or space docks. Slavery had reduced the Kadri'Ra population on Arapia from an estimated 140 million during the days of the Galactic Republic to a mere 14,000 by 0 BBY. The Force-sensitives among the Kadri'Ra also suffered, forced to hide their abilities or be killed. Saadoon-Kauldi, a crime lord and Rebel sympathizer based on Neftali in the Socorro system, was one of the galaxy's prominent Kadri'Ra during the Galactic Civil War period.

name: Kage
summary: The Kage were a near-human sentient species native to the planet Quarzite. Although they resembled humans, their striking eyes and pale skin set them apart. Their eyes were evolved to see in gloomy caverns lit by luminescent crystals. A spirited and dedicated people, they formed the Kage Warriors to fight the tyrannical Belugans, the other sentient species who inhabited their homeworld, in the near-constant war on Quarzite.

name: Kagles
summary: The Kagles were a trio of sentient, brown-furred brothers who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were distinguished by their differently colored shirts: one in blue, one in green, and one in yellow. They lived near Bright Tree Village and the home of Larry the Shriek. The Kagles enjoyed gambling. The Kagles also enjoy a variety of foods like swamp pickles, fried mahuga, jinjang berries and tobo leaves.

name: Kahmurra
summary: The kahmurra, also known as khmurra, was a herbivorous herd animal with bristley hide and tusks that lived on Talus.

name: Kahmurra blanca
summary: The kahmurra blanca was a subtype of kahmurra, a race of murra bioengineered in the Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station on Talus. A mutated variant, this creature was larger, stronger and more resistant to average kahmurra. It also had large horns and tusks. The existence of the kahmurra blanca was first reported during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, adventurous spacers traveled to Talus in order to hunt painted spats. At least one was known to be found near the Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station. The heads of these animals were sometimes displayed as a trophy by locals and big-game hunters who had killed them.

name: Ka'hren
summary: The Ka'hren were sentient humanoids indigenous to V'shar. This long-lived, long-armed, big-handed species was known to have thick flesh protecting their internal organs from physical damage. They had fur only in their temples and forearms; big teeth; and a crested forehead. A Ka'hren's skin color ranged from dark red to black, but the usual colors included blue and purple. Until contact with other species, the Ka'hren did not feel a need to record past facts, and thus their historic memory was at best distorted; for instance, the legendary Unfyr warriors were all but forgotten. However, they honored what they knew about their past, trying to keep their ancestor's way to the best of their skills. Due to their vast respect towards their old people, Ka'hren elders were commonly elected to lead the government of V'shar. The government of V'shar was a representative democracy with a great amount of theocracy: Leaders were elected to represent each of the religions in V'shar. There are seven nations in V'shar, each of them with one "main" leader plus other "lesser" leaders representing less-popular religions. Ka'hrens were devoted to their religion (called Jydan) and traditions, although there were many religions on V'shar during the Rebellion era. Each religion was supposed to be devoted to one particular god, but also to pay tribute to each of the gods. Upon the sacred Jydan Writings, a god's teachings were to be written by the three prophets of that god, and the Volumes of Truth, also written by the three prophets of each gods, would tell of that god's laws and ethics. Upon their religion, the galaxy was ruled by the gods since the beginning of time, and the gods provided their favor to the Ka'hren species. Ka'hrens were so respectful with each other that they could not grasp the idea of betrayal until they were contacted by other species. Due to their dislike of "treacherous" species, they remained an isolationist species: If one individual Ka'hren wanted to leave V'shar, he was to receive specific permission from each of the nation leaders on V'shar. Their contact with other species altered their idea of recording historical facts, which led to the creation of the University of Timb in V'shar. One of the most popular religions as of 2 ABY was Ni'Shaw-Dak, a relatively recent sect created by Kaltor Naklian.
distinctions: Crested foreheads; long arms; huge hands; fur in forearms and temples; thick flesh

name: Kai tok
summary: Kai toks were flying predators of Rori.

name: Kaijura
summary: Kaijura were a huge, non-sentient species native to Burantia, also known as Planet WG4587. One was gifted to a leader of the group known as the Banished on the planet Sinsara, but the creature began attacking the Banished each season and killing many of them. Between 40 BBY and 34 BBY, Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi experienced a Force vision of a kaijura attacking a T-6 shuttle, which later proved true when he and his Jedi Master, Qui-Gon Jinn, were sent to Planet WG4587 to rescue Senator Bail Organa. As foreseen, a kaijura destroyed the Jedi shuttle, but the pair was able to escape a pack of the creatures with Organa in his CR70 corvette, firing the escape pods into a kaijura that reared up and grabbed the vessel. When Jinn was later poisoned by a member of the Banished, the Jedi Aayla Secura and Mace Windu traveled to Sinsara and slew the kaijura there in return for an antidote to the poison from King Gara of the Banished.

name: Kailynn
summary: The Kailynn were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. One tiny female Kailynn was a prisoner at a stronghold owned by Harra the Hutt.

name: Kairos's species
summary: A humanoid species with chitinous features was native to a jungle planet. The species perceived there to be two worlds, their own and everything beyond it, and did not wish to come into contact with anything from outside of their planet. Its members wore wrapped garments and masks in order to conceal themselves and remain pure, additionally believing that doing so could heal their spirit if they did become unpure. One member of the species who would come to be known as Kairos, an emissary between her people and the outside world, was taken prisoner by the Galactic Empire forces that occupied the planet and experimented on in a prison camp. Having become unpure as a result, Kairos cocooned herself in wrappings and a mask in an attempt to heal. Before her spirit could be mended, however, she suffered severe injuries during the New Republic's campaign in the Cerberon system, and in order to prevent her from dying, the surgeons were forced to remove her suit. Feeling incomplete due to the interruption of her healing process, Kairos refrained from wearing her mask after reawakening. Kairos became stranded on her homeworld with Chass na Chadic and Yrica Quell when she navigated her U-wing to the planet after its navicomputer failed to function. The three of them resided in the then-abandoned Imperial outpost while attempting to salvage equipment to repair the vessel, and a number of Kairos's people converged on the area, assuming the Empire had returned and wishing to drive them out. As Kairos refused to let her people see her, they departed the outpost to repair the U-wing.

name: Kajain'sa'Nikto
summary: The Kajain'sa'Nikto, also known as the Red Nikto, were a subspecies of the sentient humanoid Nikto species from the planet Kintan. Their natural habitat was desert or wastelands. Aside from their skin color, they were also distinguished by their scaly, coarse skin, and their horns and spikes. They also have tubes on their necks. Members of the subspecies included the Jedi Master Ima-Gun Di, galactic crime lord Rinnrivin Di, and Vedain, an employee of Jabba the Hutt, Leoz, Narvin and the unidentified pirate of the Warbird gang. Many Kajain'sa'Nikto lived to serve the Hutt families as well.

name: Kakala
summary: Kakala were a diminutive sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Dubat Krom was a member of the species.

name: Kakran
summary: Kakrans were a species of rock people who lived on the planet Kakra, a sentient world that was a giant Kakran itself.

name: Kalaanite
summary: The Kalaanites were native to the planet of Kalaan. Red-skinned humanoids with large red eyes and squarish snouts, they spoke the Kalaanite language. When their lush planet, which had served as a Rebel base, was conquered by the Empire, many Kalaanites joined the Kalaanite resistance movement.

name: Kalai
summary: The Kalai were a species who, during the Galactic Civil War, suddenly appeared at Zirtran's Anchor aboard the starship Destiny. Among the galaxy's most strange inhabitants, little was known of them outside of speculation, rumors, fear, and very few facts.

name: Kalan
summary: Kalan were furry, quadrupedal, tusked herbivores of Mutanda that grew over three meters tall. They moved in large herds and were hunted for food by Horansi and tourists. They had four limbs, with elongated bodies, short necks and broad heads. Unlike many species of herbivores, kalans would not flee predators and abandon weak members. Their tactic was to act as a unit in defending themselves when attacked, making them very dangerous. They would coordinate their defense, with several individuals trying to lure the attacking predator into the center of the rest of the herd, which then overwhelmed the attacker. As the predator closed in for the kill, the other kalans charged the creature with their tusks, hoping to crush or gore the attacker. While they were deadly in close combat, kalans were defenseless against ranged weapons.

name: Kalduu
summary: The Kalduu were sapients indigenous to Ropagi II.

name: Kaleesh
summary: The Kaleesh, also known as the Kaleeshi, were a reptilian sentient species from the Wild Space world of Kalee. They had red, scaly skin and possessed the distinctive snake-like, slitted yellow eyes, a flat or snub nose, and elongated, pointed ears, surrounded by two enormous tusks on their lower jaws. A primal yet spiritual people, the Kaleesh were formidable warriors, and they were not likely to display empathy, kindness, or vulnerability. All Kaleesh nearly always concealed their facial features behind terrifying customary war masks, which were typically crafted from the skulls, bones, and teeth of the deadliest predatory beasts on their home planet—mumuu, erkush, and karabbac. Despite their technological inferiority, the fierce and proud warriors engaged in numerous conflicts, particularly against the Yam'rii, their technologically superior adversary and planetary neighbor, an insectoid species of the desolate planet Huk in the system of the same name near their own. The most notorious member of the species, General Grievous, fought as the Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies during the Clone Wars.
distinctions: Snake-like eyes, flat nose, elongated ears, large tusks, four-fingered hands, five-toed feet, digitigrade stance

name: Kalidor
summary: The kalidor was a type of savage avian predator from Davnar II, a planet in the Core Worlds. The creature possessed wings and was capable of flight. During the Galactic Civil War, the highest honor awarded by the Alliance to Restore the Republic was the Kalidor Crescent, a medal named for the kalidor. The award included the detailed likeness of a large gold kalidor in flight pinned upon its ribbon.

name: Kalkal
summary: Kalkals were a sentient species. They had wide, flat nostrils and wide mouths. They possessed excellent vision, even during the night, and were famous for their ability to digest almost any substance and regurgitate the rest. Kalkals were somewhat inarticulate. Melvosh Bloor was a Kalkal.

name: Kalleran
summary: Kallerans were a tall sentient species native to the planet of Kaller.

name: Kallidahin
summary: The Kallidahin were a sentient species of humanoids that lacked facial features. Although they originated on Kallidah, they also established their presence in the asteroid field of Polis Massa. Because they stayed so long on the planetoid, they came to be known as Polis Massans. Those Kallidahins were archaeologists and exobiologists who borrowed some of the Kaminoans' cloning techniques to attempt to recreate life from tissues recovered from archaeological digs. They excavated Polis Massa, in order to find remains of the extinct Eellayin civilization, ancestors to the Kallidahin. Kallidahin were typically silent, communicating only through telepathy. The species lacked facial mouths or noses, but they could still speak and breathe. Small and wiry statures and four-fingered hands are characteristic of the Kallidahin. One Kallidahin was the curator Utani Xane, but was killed by Darth Vader during the theft of the Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix. The Kallidahins on Polis Massa attempted to save Padmé Amidala when she died delivering Luke and Leia.

name: Kallidahin speaker
summary: The Speakers were a subgroup of the Polis Massan species. Unlike the other members of their species, the Speakers were able to vocalize speech.

name: Kalzerian
summary: The Kalzerians were near-Humans from the planet Kalzeron with gray, leather-like skin. They also had black teeth, and yellow eyes. Developing from a feudal, tribal people with a defining sense of battlefield honor, the Kalzerians had not yet reached the atomic era by the time of the Galactic Civil War. When Kalzeron was subjugated by the Galactic Empire, some Kalzerians such as the mercenary Azuroth Khell joined off-planet resistance movements, intending to gather equipment and training enough to return and liberate their planet in a glorious revolution. Before this came to pass however, Kalzeron was freed from the Empire's yoke following the Battle of Endor, when Imperial forces were withdrawn. Those Kalzerians who had left the planet were branded as cowards by their fellows on their homeworld's resistance and a formal charter from their over-council decreed them as traitors.

name: Kama bird
summary: Kama birds were a type of large predatory bird native to the savannas of the moon Toshara. The birds' preferred prey was robuma calves, and they circled around herds of the creatures for some time before striking. As such, robuma farmers—as well as wild robumas—learned to fend off attacks from the kama birds. Kama bird feathers could be worn to symbolize harmony with nature. In 3 ABY, the scoundrel Kay Vess bought a Kama feather charm from a human merchant in the Hutt Poaching Outpost on the planet Akiva.

name: Kamarian
summary: The Kamarians were an insect-like species native to Kamar. During the Imperial era, the most technologically advanced Kamarians had just developed nuclear weapons, and were well on their way to developing clean fusion and spaceflight. Despite this, they still lived in a feudal society. They organized themselves into small tribes or city-states called tk'skquas which often battled each other for territory.

name: Kaminoan
summary: The Kaminoans were a tall, thin amphibian sentient species that hailed from the aquatic planet of Kamino in Wild Space. Living in large stilted domed cities that rose high above the ocean surface, Kaminoans were known to specialize in pioneering cloning and genetic engineering technology, as well as developing more conventional, non-biomedical, technologies for various clients, including the Galactic Republic.

name: Kaminoan electroeel
summary: Kaminoan electroeels were creatures that were native to the planet Kamino. They tended to swim in swarms and give a dim glow underwater. Kaminoan electroeels were one of several species of eel in the galaxy.

name: Kamoradon sea dragon
summary: Kamoradon sea dragons, shortened as just kamoradons and also known as saberjowls, were large aquatic reptiles native to the oceans of their homeworld Kamino. Six-limbed carnivores, they used their razor-sharp teeth to eat prey such as smaller sea creatures. They had a shell to protect them from predators, although few creatures attacked them, and they laid their nests of eggs in the deepest parts of the ocean to avoid unwanted visitors. Kamoradons sought food in the waters around Tipoca City on Kamino, and in 19 BBY, the fugitive clones of Clone Force 99 drew the attention of one such creature. The reptile attacked the Kamino tube system that the clones were using to escape the bombardment of the city by the Galactic Empire, causing damage to the tubes that allowed water in. The kamoradon was then deterred by an electric shock when the medical droid AZI-3 re-activated the tunnel's power. The Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts droids SF-R3 and CAM were sent to witness a kamoradon hatching event on Kamino and located a nest using a submarine. The parent of the nest attacked and chased the submarine, although the droids still witnessed the hatching before the adult kamoradon hurled the submarine back to the surface. SF-R3 and CAM's colleague Ardis San Tekka included an entry on kamoradons in her journal at some point after the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY.

name: Kamurith
summary: The kamurith was a species of quadrupedal, reptilian carnivore that was native to the world of Dathomir. They were characterized by their brown skin, white bellies, and impressive, long orange-back sails. They also possessed rows of a few short spikes protruding above their forelegs.

name: Kanduh
summary: The Kanduh were an ancient sentient species from the planet Kaldahan.

name: Karabbac
summary: Karabbac was a predatory creature native to the Wild Space planet Kalee, as are members of the Kaleesh species. Kaleesh warriors hunt Karabbac for more than simply meat and generally kill to demonstrate their bravery, making its pelt for clothing and its skulls and bones for fearsome masks, and even using its blood as war paint, drawing lines over their eyes on their masks before battle. They also valued their prey and wouldn't allow anyone near them. [[File:TommetSozach-TROSSeries1Base.png|thumb|right|200px|Tommet Sozach wore a jacket made from cloned karabbac-pelt.]] Based on one he had once worn as a Kaleesh warrior, General Grievous's cybernetic faceplate had engraved lines over his eyes that resembled the patterns of Karabbac-blood war paint and featured duranium teeth that mimicked the beast's. The personal defense instructor Tommet Sozach wore a jacket made from the pelt of a cloned karabbac.

name: Karafankata
summary: The karafankata was a creature of the Outer Rim planet Ah Re Won. Carnivorous creatures, karafankata fiercely protected their young. Between around 40 BBY and 32 BBY, a karafankata lived on Ah Re Won with several babies. After the Sith apprentice Darth Maul killed and buried the mayor of the nearby town, the creature encountered Maul, digging up the body. A party of hunters led by Prince Afolonkin later attempted to hunt the karafankata, but the Sith murdered the group before they could kill the creature.

name: Karduran
summary: The Kardurans were a sentient species native to Kardura system. They were slim humanoids known for their dancing troupes. They were a client species of House Kassido.

name: Kargul
summary: The kargul was a type of worm that lived on Trindello, a cool, forested moon located in the Trindello system of the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. Reaching eighty meters in length, kargul could burrow underground and did not rely on sight. The worms were nocturnal and lived in packs. They were generally shy but could become fierce opponents when agitated. Kargul laired at the center of the clusters of gigantic trees known as Trindellan oaks, which covered the moon's surface. By the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War that lasted from 25 ABY to 29 ABY, several parties of loggers who were harvesting the valuable Trindellan oak wood had come into conflict with kargul.

name: Kari
summary: The Kari were small sentient insectoids covered with a black exoskeleton. They were the only sentient race indigenous to Karideph. Their language was similar to singing, appearing closer to the whistling and beeping of droids rather than a sentient species' speech.

name: Karkarodon
summary: {{Update|The High Republic: Convergence, Dooku: Jedi Lost, A Crash of Fate, Galaxy's Edge: Black Spire, Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide, , Shadow of Maul 4}} The Karkarodon, a shark-like, amphibious-aquatic humanoid species that was native to the ocean world of Karkaris, were known to be fast swimmers and fierce hunters, capable of ripping-apart their enemies or their prey with their teeth. The Karkarodon Riff Tamson was a commander in the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and briefly was ruler of Mon Cala before Lee-Char overthrew and killed him. A Karkarodon was also imprisoned in the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center around 20 BBY.
distinctions: Sharp teeth, webbed hands and feet

name: K'Armyn Viraxo's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. K'Armyn Viraxo was a member of this species.

name: Karnak Alphan
summary: The Karnak Alphans, alternately Karnak, were the indigenous sapient species of the planet Karnak Alpha. Other than their hair, none of their bodies could be seen. The hair of young females was knotted into ribbons while young males had bells tied to strands of their hair. Children were highly prized and protected in Karnak Alphan culture, and having many was a status symbol. This respect of children was so great that they were allowed to participate in the government through a special children's council. In the galaxy at large, it was considered appropriate to honor a guest by serving him first at dinner. This was not so with the Karnak Alphans who considered it an honor for the guest's youngest child to be served by one of the host's children. Additionally, the most senior adult guest would consider himself to be most honored if the host's youngest child served him. Karnak Alphans were also fond of unusual animals and devoted much of their resources to creating and maintaining holographic dioramas and large alternate environment zoos. Because of Karnak Alpha's strategic importance, a banquet was held in honor of the arrival of a new Karnak Alphan ambassador in 23 ABY in the Imperial Palace. Among the attendees were Leia Organa Solo, Han Solo, Jacen Solo, Jaina Solo, Anakin Solo, Zekk, Tenel Ka Chume Ta' Djo, Lowbacca, C-3PO, the new Karnak Alphan ambassador, and her children. In the early stages of the banquet, a number of diplomatic gaffes on the New Republic's part were averted by Tenel Ka's knowledge of Karnak Alphan culture. As the evening progressed, Zekk mistook a bouquet for a salad and ate it. When he proclaimed his favorable opinion of the "salad," Leia Organa Solo, despite her lack of knowledge of Karnak Alphan culture, made sure that everyone else among her delegation would eat their "salad" as well. This turned out to be one of the factors in smoothing the way for an alliance and trade agreement with Karnak Alpha.

name: Karnex Dragon
summary: Karnex dragons were a species of predators native to the planet Drahgor III, which normally lived deep underground.

name: Karnis bird
summary: Karnis birds were a type of bird found on the planets Tenoo and Batuu, as well as on a desert astronomical object. On Tenoo, the birds resided in a forest on the world. At least one Karnis bird was kept in Black Spire Outpost's Creature Stall on Batuu.

name: Karran
summary: The Karrans were a sentient species indigenous to Karra.

name: Karran beetle
summary: Karran beetles were a non-sentient insectoid species that were native to the planet of Karra. They used their large mandibles as weapons, and could do great damage to living flesh. The Karrans themselves learned how to control the beetles, and used them in battle against their enemies. Basilisk war droids were said to look like a mechanical cross between a Zalorian rock-lion and a Karran beetle.

name: Karran mantis
summary: The Karran mantis was a non-sentient insect species that was native to the world of Karra.

name: Karvathian
summary: Karvathians were a sentient species from the Karvathia system that could hear high-pitched sounds. They created the music style trusk, which, during the time of the Old Republic, was originally performed in dingy establishments at pitches that only members of the species could hear. In 3 BBY, a Karvathian trusk septet played at an auction on the planet Cantonica organized by Cli Pastayra of the Wandering Star criminal syndicate. During the auction, Pastayra remarked about the history of Karviathians and the trusk to his droid Fenbolt. The species also shared its name with the Karvathian sequined tarp, one of which was found in 7 ABY on Frander's Bay, a space station orbiting the planet Chandrila.

name: Kasham
summary: Kasham were deadly creatures that formed flocks. They were found on the planet Sriluur, and occasionally attacked the city of Dnalvec.

name: Kashoonara
summary: The Kashoonara were a sentient species native to Kashoon. The savage humanoids were conquered by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War; however, with support from the Alliance to Restore the Republic, they were able to drive the Empire from their homeworld after a number of successful guerrilla assaults. Based on their ancient folklore, the Kashoonara considered the humbaba species to be sacred and defended the creatures against any offworlder depredation.

name: Kashyyyk bantha
summary: Kashyyyk Bantha was a subspecies of bantha native to Kashyyyk. They were much larger than the banthas on Tatooine, and had slightly shorter fur. They should not be confused with the Kashyyyk greyclimber, which was also referred to as a "Kashyyyk bantha." Whereas the true Kashyyyk bantha had three straight, smooth horns, the Kashyyyk greyclimber had two massive slabs of bone on the top of its head to be used as a battering ram. It was believed that the planet's bantha population had grown from specimens brought back to Kashyyyk by Wookiee traders. Their massive sizes made them good war steeds. The Jedi Luminara Unduli even rode one into battle at the Battle of Kashyyyk.

name: Kashyyyk blue primate
summary: The blue primates of Kashyyyk were arboreal monkeys. Each of their hands and feet had five digits, one of which was opposable. They had long tails and wide, flat faces. Their fur and skin were blue, but their eyes were yellow. They could be found in the vicinity of Palsaang. Near the Clone Wars, one such primate took an interest in Luminara Unduli and Quinlan Vos, who hand-fed it berries.

name: Kashyyyk slash-spider
summary: The Kashyyyk slash-spider was a species of arachnid native to the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. The scissors-like mandibles of the spider provided the name for the slip-jaws, a maneuver that was utilized in starfighter combat. The spiders typically loitered around ponds and shores in order to hunt smaller fish and crustaceans.

name: Kashyyyk treeworm
summary: The Kashyyyk treeworm, taking its name from the forested planet of Kashyyyk, was a creature that produced exceptionally durable silk. This material could be found near the planet of Bespin and its tensile strength had no equal in that region as of 3 ABY.

name: Kassk
summary: The Kassk were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy around 34 ABY. Two Kassks were the members of the Warbird gang led by Kragan Gorr.

name: Katarn
summary: Katarns were dangerous and deadly predators that were native to the planet Kashyyyk, where they prowled the deeper, lightless levels of the world's complex vertical ecosystem. The imposing Katarn-class Commando Armor worn by clone commandos of the Grand Army of the Republic, was named for the deadly creatures, and the armor's capabilities lived up to the name.

name: Kath
summary: The Kaths were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. A shopkeeper was a member of this species and had scales and at least one scaly hand. To refer to someone as a member of this species could be an insult to some, as a man she spurned referred to Jyn Erso as a "coldhearted Kath."

name: Kath hound
summary: Kath hounds were predatory creatures indigenous to the planet of Dantooine.

name: Kathol
summary: The Kathol, also known as the Precursors, the Old Ones, or Cthol, were an ancient race who lived on the planet Kathol in the Kathol sector. They possessed organic technology and were a highly advanced civilization, proven when they created the Codex. Thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin, several Dark Jedi attempted to conquer the Kathol. They were defeated, but the Kathol were almost wiped out. Most of the Kathol were able to store themselves in the Lifewell, guarded by DarkStryder. Unfortunately, DarkStryder refused to release the Kathol after the danger had passed, and the Kathol were trapped in a form of limbo. Their life force became the mystical Ta-Ree energy. Only after DarkStryder was destroyed by the crew of the FarStar were the Kathol freed. However, they were unable to reclaim corporeal form, and instead chose to dissipate themselves. A few hundred decided to live, but were constantly at odds with each other. As mentioned, the Kathol possessed advanced technology and were capable of growing advanced biological machines. They crafted several servant species to serve them which included the: *Charr Ontee *DarkStryder *Maoi The Darkstryder in turn crafted for itself a few servants which included the: *Krakai *Segmi *Yapi *Yimi *Zizimaak The name "Cthol" was considered a mispronunciation of "Kathol", but still continued to appear in common usage up to 4 ABY due to being written so in erroneous documents.

name: Katikoot
summary: The Katikoot were a batlike sentient species from the twin planets of Gloam and Aubadas. Originally native to Gloam, the Katikoot were forced to immigrate to Aubadas after mining activities unleashed a plague which turned members of the species into zombie-like monsters. The Katikoot lost their ability to fly sometime after the move, and eventually forgot their true origins. They spoke a whistling language, but could also speak Galactic Basic Standard.

name: Katouan
summary: Katouans were a cultural group of humans native to the planet Katou.

name: Kauronian
summary: The Kauronians were a sentient species native to the world Kauron in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 0 BBY, a number of Kauronian bounty hunters were present on the planet Tatooine. During that time, the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo watched several of them enter Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Mos Eisley settlement.

name: Kav-Dann
summary: The Kav-Dann was a type of predatory reptilian native to the world Nubia. The Kav-Dann power armor, a type of body armor created by engineers on Nubia, was named after the Kav-Dann.

name: Kavaavik
summary: Kavaavik was a small flightless avian on the Yuuzhan Vong homeworld, an extra-galactic world destroyed in a devastating ancient conflict. Millennia before this event, the eyes of the kavaavik had adapted to burrowing through dark subterranean tunnels. This ability appealed to the bioengineering sciences of the Yuuzhan Vong, and over time, this kind of creature was replaced, as was common among their creations, by a genetically-altered freak with a powerful echolocation sense, which was co-opted to allow the Yuuzhan Vong to see in the dark. The kavaavik was a delicate bundle of flesh and thin bones, its pale skin puckered as if freshly plucked. When a Yuuzhan Vong placed a kavaavik over his eyes, the bioengineered creature gripped the wearer’s head with its two remaining limbs and inserted its spinal needle into the optic nerve through the tear duct of the right eye. When worn in this manner, the subject saw whatever the kavaavik saw, as its echolocation pulses were translated into visual images, temporarily granting the wearer the ability to see in complete darkness within a range of 500 meters. The wearer perceived his surroundings only as silhouettes, and a Yuuzhan Vong using a kavaavik was unable to read a datascreen or a paper scroll unless the scroll had raised lettering. If the kavaavik was killed while attached to a host, the host was temporarily blinded for several seconds until the optic nerve adjusted to the shock. Kavaavik were typically carried in membranous pouches.

name: Kayfoundo Kapa
summary: The Kayfoundo Kapa, Huttese for the "Hungry Hands", were a type of space-borne predator found in the Varl system, where they preyed upon members of the Hutt species until the Hutts fled their homeworld Varl to escape from the creatures. The Kayfoundo Kapa were drawn to heat and produced sounds that entranced their prey into approaching the predators. In 29 BBY, Baron Grott of the Pyke Syndicate began breeding Kayfoundo Kapa on Varl's moon Black Rock in order to use them against his enemies, but they escaped during the Varl Tournament that Grott used as a cover for his activities and the star system was abandoned due to their presence.

name: Kayven whistler
summary: Kayven whistlers were vicious carnivorous flying creatures, resembling a cross between a monkey and a bat. The magician Xaverri created illusions of them in her act, flying over and swooping down at the audience. Jabba Desilijic Tiure kept some kayven whistlers as pets at his townhouse and palace and took great delight in feeding his enemies to them.

name: Kdak
summary: A kdak was an ancient creature of Arda II that had a huge slug-like body, a mouth surrounded by cilia-like feelers that could grab objects, a beak, nine eyes, and a strange-smelling slime trail.

name: Kedorzhan
summary: The Kedorzhans were a rotund, rodent-like species—native to Kedorzha in Senex-Juvex—who operated mines in SoroSuub Landing on the planet Taris in the years prior to its devastation by Darth Malak. Kedorzhans had excellent senses of smell, but were virtually blind after hours in the darkness of the mines.

name: Keed
summary: The Keed were a near-Human species from the Outer Rim Territories planet Keedad. They shared their homeworld with Human colonists since the early history of the Galactic Republic. Around 26 BBY, the Keed/Human hybrid Ytavarg Aleema was born on Keedad. Ger Plortor, a scout for the Shad Furies shockball team, recruited Aleema after witnessing him participate in a lettranin game on Keedad. Afterward, the Keed athlete eventually became the most renowned shockball player in the galaxy. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, after killing a group of Human Galactic Empire agents in retaliation for their murder of a fellow alien shockball player, Aleema also became a secret Rebel Alliance patron and agent.

name: Keedee
summary: Keedees were a type of bird that could be found on Akiva. While living in the city of Myrra on Akiva, Norra Wexley and Wedge Antilles kept keedees, which they collected eggs from. They sported multi-colored tail plumage.

name: Keejin
summary: Keejins were a species that inhabited the galaxy. They were likely to be encountered in caves.

name: Keelkana
summary: Keelkana were creatures used as mounts by the Mon Calamari Knights of the planet Mon Cala. Mon Calamari energy lances were designed to be used from atop the back of a Keelkana.

name: Keena's species
summary: A species to which Keena belonged to inhabited a planet in the galaxy. Several members of this species worked as child laborers in a Factory Workshop on the planet.

name: Keeper's makers
summary: The Keeper's makers were humanoids hailing from Keeper's World. They were a strictly non-violent people, and feared war. When a galactic war entered their system they chose to flee their planet. To restore their homeworld after the war's devastation, they created The Keeper, in the hopes that they might one day return. The Keeper created the androids Earth, Fire, Rain, and Wind in the image of this species.

name: Keeradak
summary: The keeradaks were non-sentient creatures that were native to Skako Minor.

name: Keffi
summary: Keffis were quadruped mounts native to the planet of Anaxes. Like most riding beasts in the galaxy, most Keffis were selectively bred for intelligence, speed, color, size, and many other characteristics deemed useful by the Anaxsi nobles.

name: Kel Dor
summary: {{Update|}} Kel Dors were a sentient species native to the planet Dorin. In order to survive oxygen-rich environments, they wore specialized breath masks that covered their eyes and nostrils. Jedi Master Plo Koon was a Kel Dor who served on the Jedi Council in the last years of the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. Bo Keevil was also a member of the species, who served as a pilot in Ace Squadron.
distinctions: Rebreathers to survive in oxygen environments

name: Kelbird
summary: A kelbird was a avian creature. Roast kelbird was a spicy Corellian delicacy that Danta Belissa sold at his food and souvenir store on Cloud City.

name: Keldar
summary: The Keldar were a species of the galaxy. They settled on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Nag Ubdur after being transplanted along with Artiodac refugees and the Ubdurian natives.

name: Kell dragon
summary: Kell dragons, also known as kell drakes, were quadrupedal predators sometimes utilized in disposing of captives by crimelords and Dark Jedi.
distinctions: Three banks of red or yellow dorsal spines

name: Kelrodoan
summary: The Kelrodoans were a sentient species native to the planet Kelrodo-Ai. During the Western Reaches Operation in 17 BBY, the forces of the Galactic Empire attacked Kelrodo-Ai and several Kelrodoans, including the warrior chieftain Fara, were assigned to act as grooms for the pilots of the Empire's Sword Squadron.

name: Keltrian
summary: The Keltrians were a sentient species from the Keltria system. A book called Ancient Keltrian Poets: Masters of Alliteration contained poetry that ancient Keltrians wrote.

name: Kenari
summary: The Kenari were a group of humans native to the planet Kenari. They spoke the language Kenari. They were described as having dark features and large, dark eyes. After large scale mining devastated Kenari, tribes of orphaned children were the only Kenari to survive on world. Cassian Jeron Andor was a Kenari who was adopted by Maarva Andor and Clem Andor.

name: Kentian
summary: The Kentian or Kentinian were a species in the Galaxy. The Kentians styled their fur into braids which they would stroke when nervous. They would wrap their braids around their broad feet to silence the clapping noise of their walking instinctually. This was because speed and stealth had been integral to the species' survival. Walking in the presence of another individual without doing this was a sign of great respect and trust in their culture. For this species, kneeling down with their forehead touching the ground was the most solemn form of begging.

name: Kentra
summary: The Kentra were a winged feline sentient species indigenous to Orellon II. They were simple and friendly with a sense of humor and honesty. Even though they were supple in terms of truth, they placed much emphasis and value on honor, which was more than just a simple social grace. Honor was the primary social measure among Kentra. A dishonorable Kentra would be banished from society forever.

name: Keon
summary: Keons were curious, rodent-like marsupials, that had an ability to mimic sounds. This ability allowed the creature to repeat words uttered in the vicinity, though at a higher pitch. Keons flicked their tails back and forth, perked up their ears, and gazed with their huge eyes to show curiosity. They had four digits on each birdlike forefoot. The Human smuggler Ramsey Lanclo kept a female as a pet for a few weeks, although he did not have the proper permit and license to do so. The creature cost him 1,500 credits, and he gave it to Imperial Customs agent Hewat, in order to distract her from searching his cargo, a large amount of glitterstim. She in turn gave it to her daughter, Kora, who lived on Yityl.

name: Kerch Kushi's species
summary: Senator Kerch Kushi was a member of a near-human species with blue skin, red eyes, and teal hair. Members of this species inhabited the planets Rattatak and Raxus Secundus and the moon Zardossa Stix. Many, including Kushi, were members of the Separatist Parliament.

name: Keredian
summary: Keredians were a species of humanoids whose members were thinly spread around the galaxy. Little information existed about them, including their homeworld. Initially some of the Keredian race joined the Partisans but after the Death Star destroyed Jedha City, they joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic to continue their fight against the tyranny of the Empire. One such member of this race was Cycyed Ock, who used a vibrorang as his weapon. Ruk was also a Keredian who was a member of the Tech Masters. Other Keredians were much more apathetic to the civil war, with a Keredian named Dewi Pamular working as a squiggly fisher along with an alien named Freedi Pamular on the moon Narkina 5 in 5 BBY which they visited using an old TUG-b13 quadjumper. Dewi Pamular still shared their species' hatred for the Empire, though, and happily assisted Cassian Jeron Andor and Ruescott Melshi, at the time fugitives from the Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex, escape the moon aboard their starship.

name: Kerestian
summary: Kerestians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The big game hunter Iothene Jacontro was a member of this species.

name: Kerk
summary: The Kerk were a sentient species. The mercenary Caratoo, who led a mercenary band during the High Republic Era, was a Kerk.

name: Kerko
summary: Kerko were quadrupedal predators used for protection. Esano's sister owned a pet kerko during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 20 BBY, her kerko was killed by Darth Maul when the fallen Sith Lord and his brother Savage Opress attacked Esano and his guards.

name: Kerkoiden
summary: The Kerkoiden, known also by the slang term Kerk, were a sentient species from the planet Kerkoidia. The Confederacy of Independent Systems General Whorm Loathsom was a Kerkoiden, as was one of the many guards employed by the crime lord Talvee Chawin on the planet Coruscant some time after the Battle of Endor. The Retail Caucus operated a security force of Kerkoiden warriors.

name: Kerrakk
summary: The Kerrakk were an insectoid sentient species whose members were grouped in hives. A hive of Kerrakk enforcers operated during the Imperial Era, but were killed by the bounty hunter crew led by T'onga after they attempted to rob the Carbon Score Cantina on Burnin Konn.

name: Keshian
summary: Keshians were a sentient species nearly identical to humans from the planet Keshi. The only visible distinction between the two were the Keshians' eyes, which were large and oddly colored, allowing them to detect a broad spectrum ranging from ultraviolet to infrared. Keshian Iolo Arana, a New Republic pilot, used this to his advantage in dogfights.
distinctions: Large eyes capable of detecting a broad spectrum of radiation

name: Keshiri
summary: The Keshiri were a sentient species from the Wild Space planet Kesh. They could have skin colors of either, different shades of lavender and violet or blue, and could have red eyes and purple hair. Sohi and Chellwinark Frethylrin were members of the species.
skinColor: Different shades of lavender and violet

name: Kessarine
summary: Kessarine were a sentient species. Females, or egg bearers, had one tail, while males had multiple. Members of the species also had cheek frills, double eyelids, and webbed fingers. The Galactic Basic language did not have exact equivalent terms for their genders, but when Kessarine matured, the child's will contributed to whether or not they became an egg bearer. Out of a litter of five, the common proportion of those that would mature into egg bearers was two of them. Although the species started as amphibious, they lost that ability and could not breathe underwater. They did not require as much rest as most sentient species.
distinctions: One tail for females, and multiple for males

name: Kessel
summary: Kessel was the nickname of an unidentified species of bird found in the Aeneid system. Lando Calrissian, Marshak, Fonker Dahk, and others once tricked Han Solo into buying 17,000 credits worth of the worthless and pestilent birds.

name: Kessurian
summary: Kessurians were a sentient species that originated in the Kessur system. They had red skin and elongated ears and montrals, which increased their senses.

name: Kete
summary: The Ketes were a large insectoid species that resided on the forest moon of Endor. A group of Ketes lived inside a hive on the Endor moon, although they usually lived in spiral mounds made out of a sticky substance.

name: Keteerian
summary: Keteerians were a sentient species that inhabited the galaxy. Teroj Kee, an ally of the First Order, was a Keteerian, as was Terrib Igmusk, a hotel employee at Canto Bight.

name: Ketrann
summary: The Ketrann was a dangerous carnivore native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Alk'Lellish III. Described as "huge and snarling," the Ketrann had four long, white fangs. It fed on migrating herds of metarshi, which it killed by leaping onto the metarshi's back and biting it once through the neck. Wilek Nereus personally killed one once and hung its teeth in his office on Bakura.

name: Ketton
summary: The Ketton were a sentient species. The assassin Derrida was a Ketton who was active during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, she needed a partner for an assassination job against the Alliance on the desert planet Tatooine. The Devaronian Kardue'sai'Malloc was aware of the job, but considered it too much work, arranging for the Kubaz spy Garindan ezz Zavor to work with Derrida instead.

name: Ketzalian
summary: Ketzalians were a small reptilian sentient species from the Ketzali system that possessed wings that allowed them to fly and hover. One Ketzalian, Lita, worked in the smuggler crew led by Ana Tolla.

name: Kexing
summary: Kexing were a sentient species that had gray skin. The species also could grow hair and had vestigal teeth along their cheekbones. By 228 BBY, the Kexing Jayd served as one of the Nihil Minister of Information Ghirra Starros's most trusted aides.

name: Khamarill
summary: Khamarill was a sentient amphibious species in the galaxy. Dobbu Scay was a member of the species.

name: Khardax
summary: The khardax was a creature from the planet Rodia. Fraulda Rynn once tried to kill Cikatro Vizago using one such beast.

name: Khasva
summary: Khasva were a species of fish indigenous to Dac. They could be eaten fried. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker once brought home khasva rolls for dinner with his wife, Senator Padmé Amidala. These rolls were also called sushi.

name: Kheilwar
summary: The kheilwar was the name given by the Defel species to a small poisonous insect native to their homeworld of Af'El. It was also known to other races as a homunculus-wasp.

name: Kheilwar wasp
summary: Kheilwar wasps were a type of exotic creature with fatal stings. In 34 ABY, the cargo vessel Sketter's Quarrel was discovered dead in space after its crew were stung to death by kheilwar wasps that had escaped from a damaged shipping container on board the vessel. The Sketter's Quarrel had been carrying a range of creatures to deliver to Regent Solculvis of the Mol'leaj system, who maintained a collection of exotics. Members of the Sector Rangers law enforcement agency investigated the vessel, and information from their file on the case was included in Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious, a book authored by Police Commissioner Exantor Divo and published in 34 ABY.

name: Khepi
summary: The Khepi were a theocratic species on the planet of Khepi, a group which worshipped the Stars. The Khepi existed in the Khepi system, moving to the Sayma Nebula after their world was predicted to be destroyed. Within a tomb constructed to preserve the species, they remained concealed from the galaxy until their tomb was reached by the Rokana Raiders. Present since the formation of the Galactic Republic, the Khepi remained independent from the Republic even until the High Republic Era, when they first made contact with the Jedi Order and the Republic. Later, the Khepi would interpret ten years earlier that their world will be destroyed by a meteorite. In response, the Khepi began the construction of a tomb within an asteroid inside the Sayma Nebula. Constructed with roxodium, the tomb was designed to last for thousands of years to preserve the species. For the protection of the tomb, guardian droids and the artifact of the Architect's Scepter have also been made.
