The entire population of the Khepi would then move and hibernate within the tomb, preserving until the the Sayma Nebula collapses into a proton star. During the hibernation of the Khepi, many raiders and pirates attempted to reach the Khepi Tomb in pursuit of a rumored treasure within, but has never located the tomb and make the journey alive. However, the Galactic Empire researcher Dr. Jessik was able to locate the tomb, providing the coordinates to Stinger Tash and the Rokana Raiders. The Rokana Raiders would then be able to locate the tomb and establish presence within the tomb in search of fortune, but would be unsuccessful for missing a part of the Architect's Scepter. After the outlaw Kay Vess assisted the legendary Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka to unlock the tomb, the raider would eventually abort the tomb after a catastrophe followed the completion of the Architect's Scepter.

name: Khil
summary: The Khil were a sentient species native to the planet Belnar. They were among the earliest member species of the Galactic Republic, and had spread to countless worlds throughout the galaxy by the time the Galactic Empire came to power. They were enthusiastic supporters of the Republic and the peaceful order it represented. Khil were involved at all levels of the galaxy's society, acting as soldiers, scientists, musicians, entrepreneurs, and politicians. Most Khil considered themselves "citizens of the galaxy."

name: Khoan
summary: The Khoan were a species who, though shorter than Humans, weighed twice the average Wookiee. They had yellow skin, a dorsal fin, and spikes on their faces. These spikes fanned around the face, forming a spiked collar around their faces. Khoan imagined themselves as the fairest of all intergalactic races. A Khoan played against Han Solo in fan-tan at the Fifteen Moons Casino on Ord Mantell, shortly after the Battle of Yavin.

name: Khommite
summary: Khommites were a near-human species native to the fertile Deep Core planet Khomm.

name: Khommite strider
summary: Khommite striders were elegant four-legged creatures found on the fertile Deep Core planet Khomm.

name: Khormai
summary: Khormai were a sentient species from the Khorm system. One Khormai bothered Asajj Ventress in the Belsallian Cantina on Serenno, and the Sith apprentice knocked him unconscious with a tray from a serving droid.

name: Khramboan
summary: The Khramboans were a diminutive species of blue-skinned, black-eyed sentients. Khramboan eyes were on the sides of horizontal eyestalks at the center of their egg-shaped heads, and their mouth was covered with tentacle-like appendages. Four holes were present at the center of their "forehead." Khramboans had also three-fingered stubby hands. Droogan, a vendor who operated on Coruscant, was a Khramboan, as was his grandfather.
distinctions: Mouth hidden behind two thick face-tentacles

name: Kh'ymm's species
summary: A sentient winged species lived within the galaxy. The species possessed gray and brown feathers and had the ability to fly. The astronomer Kh'ymm was a member of the species.

name: Kian'thar
summary: Kian'thar were humanoid nomadic people from Shaum Hii, most notable for their ability to sense emotions. Though they evolved from land-dwelling reptiles, their culture was based around the seas and oceans of Shaum Hii. They only became part of the galactic community in about 300 BBY, due to the difficulty of travel in the Tragan Cluster and the Bakisian Drift. They were finally discovered by the Shistavanen scouts who charted the cluster.

name: Kibbin
summary: The kibbin was a type of rodent-like creature native to the planet Tenoo.

name: Kibnon
summary: The Kibnon were a green insectoid sentient species distantly related to the Verpine. With six limbs and two bulbous eyes on stalks, they had an exotic appearance to many species. During the Galactic Civil War, the Kibnon Sinthia Pulchatt operated as a spice merchant on Tatooine, while other Kibnon were found on the planets Tresidiss and Ando.

name: Kichicolia
summary: Kichicolia were sociable, herbivorous primates native to Najarka discovered by the Imperial Zoological Agency. Their call was a loud trilling squawk. A number were taken to Palpatine's gardens on Coruscant and Kailor V; the breeding pairs sent to Palpatine's gardens had their vocal cords removed so as not to annoy the Emperor's guests.

name: Kiffar
summary: The Kiffar were a near-human species from the planets Kiffu and Kiffex. Although they seemed human in appearance, Kiffar were distinguished by their scarlet blood and facial tattoos, which indicated their clan affiliation on their species' homeworlds. Jedi Master Quinlan Vos, who took part in the Clone Wars, was a male Jedi Master Kiffar. Vildar Mac was also a Jedi Knight during The High Republic. A small number of the species, including Vos, possessed the gift of psychometry, the ability to read the memories of inanimate objects through touch.

name: Kikla
summary: According to Kaminoan legend, the kikla were a sentient species of tiny water dwellers on the planet Kamino. They swarmed together to challenge the significantly larger god-beast Protas for rule over the oceans of Kamino. The kikla met Protas at the Ancient Trench and fought the mystical being for a month, but they were unable to defeat the god-beast, who ate the last kikla when the new moon was in the sky. Despite his victory, Protas was eventually defeated by a pod of aiwha.

name: Kilassin
summary: The Kilassin were a species native to the jungles of Cularin. They resembled great lizards and dinosaurs from other planets in the galaxy. Their scales varied in color ranging from the subtle to the glaringly obvious, partly due to the fact that color didn't hinder their hunting ability.

name: Kilit
summary: Kilits were winged predators native to Zelos II.

name: Kilji
summary: The Kiljis were a sentient species that hailed from the Unknown Regions' Kilji homeland. The species' wrinkly, rubbery-looking, dark orange skin stretched and formed patterns that reflected the Kiljis' emotions. Deeply religious, the Kiljis sought to enlighten the universe to the Kilji religion and were hostile to those that did not follow the Kilji philosophy. The species' nation was the Kilji Illumine, which the Generalirius Nakirre ruled. The Illumine's battle fleet, the Illumine Kilhorde, engaged in conquests of enlightenment of several Unknown Regions worlds. In 18 BBY, Nakirre allied himself with the Grysk operative known as "Jixtus," who promised to guide the Kilhorde's conquests while Nakirre allowed Jixtus to travel aboard his Kilji war cruiser, the Whetstone, while helping the operative destroy the Chiss Ascendancy nation. When the pair attempted to instigate a civil war in the Ascendancy by manipulating the Chiss families into fighting each other, Illumine General Crofyp's task force—consisting of the Kilji war cruiser Anvil and Colonel Tildnis's Kilji picket cruiser Hammer—and the Kilhorde attacked several worlds in the Unknown Regions. The Chiss Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo destroyed the Anvil and retrieved data on the Kilhorde from the Hammer. The Chiss shared the data with the Paataatus Hiveborn nation, which obliterated the Kilji battle fleet, prompting Jixtus to murder Nakirre as he considered him useless without the Kilhorde.

name: Kill-wing
summary: Kill-wings were a type of beast which Malakili trained for Hutt circuses.

name: Killcrab
summary: Killcrabs were a type of crab. An ingredient imitating their meat was used by the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs as a filling for fungus caps in the dish known as Constable's Caps. In 34 ABY, he mentioned killcrabs in a recipe for the dish in his first cookbook, The Official Black Spire Outpost Cookbook.

name: Killik
summary: The Killik were an insectoid sentient species known to reside in nests. Around 4 ABY, the New Republic Vanguard Squadron pilots Keo Venzee and Feresk Tssat led a mission to recover an astromech droid from Laanen, an ice moon of the gas giant Navlaas. In response, the Imperial Logistics Division confiscated all supplies of Clouzon-36 from the nearby space stations of the Navlaas Triad, an action that the New Republic intelligence chief Ardo Barodai likened to the buzzing of a Killik nest. During the First Order-Resistance War, Poe Dameron and Finn encountered a Killik and their nest in a passenger car of a train on a mission on the planet Kamil to negotiate a deal for livestock that the Resistance needed.
distinctions: Four arms ending in long two-toed claws protruding from their torsos

name: Killspike
summary: A killspike was a native bird of the jungle-moon Nallastia. A rather dim-witted avian with extremely thick reptilian skin, the winged killspike migrated in low-flying flocks. As 18-year-old Anakin Skywalker very nearly discovered in 23 BBY, piloting a Nallastian V-wing shuttle while on a mission to Fondor, the 'winged reptiles' were capable of doing a great deal of damage to low-flying ships.

name: Kilmaulsi
summary: The Kilmaulsi were sentient avians indigenous to the planet Kilmaulsias. While they possessed no wings, they had colorful ruffs of feathers under their jaws and along their arms. Members of the species were curious but devout by nature, leading their tribal society to become strongly religious. Originally a warlike species, they ended numerous intertribal conflicts when the Vorzydiak species made space travel available to them. Once introduced into the wider galaxy, the Kilmaulsi became common as guards and soldiers, particularly throughout the Vorzyd Cluster, where their homeworld was located. The former Jedi Dass Jennir encountered a Kilmaulsi on the planet Cato Neimoidia in 19 BBY, and Rebel agents Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker ran into a Kilmaulsi working as a guard on the world Vorzyd V during the Galactic Civil War.
distinctions: Beak, digitigrade, absence of wings, feather tufts

name: Kilmaulsi precursor species
summary: A species of winged avians were native to the planet Kilmaulsias in the Vorzyd Cluster, where they eventually evolved into the sentient Kilmaulsi species. Members of the species had colorful feathers beneath their jaws and were able to fly using their wings, although the Kilmaulsi lost both the wings and the flying capability but retained the feathers.
distinctions: Colorful feathers, wings, ability to fly

name: Kilmo's species
summary: This species was a sentient species found within the galaxy. These bipedal humanoid sentients were distinguished by their red skin, with heads featuring eyes with green irises, a wide nasal ridge but lack of visible nostrils, distinctly segmented cheeks that cut off around the upper lip, two rows of blond facial hair, one on the aforementioned ridge and the other along their jaw, and massive pointed ears. In 13 BBY, a member of this species, Kilmo, worked as a criminal in Coronet City on the planet Corellia, coming into conflict with fellow criminal Han, though the latter would escape.

name: Kilotowan
summary: Kilotowans were a sentient species in the galaxy with pink skin and hair, as well as gentle-peaked ears. One member of the species was Leyli Romero.

name: Kiltik
summary: Kiltik were giant beetle-like omnivores that lived on Cathar. They lived in hives consisting of hundreds of guards, along with a single, even-larger queen. Kiltik rested during the day, coming out of their nests en masse at night to feed. Entire sections of Cathar were reduced to barren desert by them, and Cathar warriors would periodically engage in ritualistic blood hunts to cleanse their nests. Sylvar once wiped out an entire nest. They may have gone extinct in 3963 BBY, when Cathar was devastated by the Mandalorians in the Battle of Cathar, although this was never proven, and entire hives might have existed underground.

name: Kima
summary: The kima (plural: kimas) was a small species of herbivorous canines found in the wilds of Talus, one of the Twin Worlds which orbited Centerpoint Station in the Corellian system. Unique to the world, kimas were a fast and agile quadruped which hunted alone in remote rural areas. However, despite their solitary nature, they could still be found in packs. One of their most distinguishing features was their powerful and intimidating growl. Several different breeds of kima could be found on Talus, which although virtually indistinguishable in appearance, harbored at least some different behavioral characteristics. Beast masters were able to train kimas as personal companions.
hairColor: Gray in the wild; varied when domesticated

name: Kimogila
summary: The Kimogila was a huge reptilian creature, quite similar to the krayt dragon of Tatooine, that was native to the planet Lok.

name: Kindalo
summary: Kindalo were a species of tall, bioluminescent, tree-like sentients who could be found in the subterranean caverns of the planet Aleen. The air on the surface of Aleen was poisonous to those botanical beings, who guarded the passages between the two biotopes and were capable of provoking groundquakes to seal any breaches. At one time, there was conflict between the Kindalo and the Aleena, but the fighting ended in an agreement that left the Aleena the surface and the Kindalo the underground. The Kindalo's government was unique to their species, as they only took action at a societal level if every Kindalo agreed. This led some off-world xenobiologists to believe that the total Kindalo population was small. At some point during the Clone Wars, the droid partners C-3PO and R2-D2 fell into the underworld, where they encountered four Kindalo, who through their collective decision-making. directed them to Orphne. The scholars of the Galactic Empire believed that Kindalo were possible client species of the Rakatan Infinite Empire, though there was little evidence of any occupation of their planet.

name: Kinor bat
summary: Kinor bats were a species of bat found on "Graf-World," a planet in Wild Space discovered by the cartographers Auric and Rhyssa Graf. Kinor bats had purple skin and lived in flocks inside caves.

name: Kinrath
summary: Kinraths, or Netcasters were yellow spider-like creatures found deep within the forests of the planet Kashyyyk, where they weaved sprawling webs amongst the tall woodland trees. These arachnids each possessed six eyes, which sat above a flower-shaped organ on their heads, and four long legs with claws or fangs at the end. Netcasters distinguished between hostile and peaceable encroachers upon their territory and responded based upon this judgment. Hostile trespassers would be attacked, enveloped in webbing, and lifted into the netcaster nest for consumption; peaceful passersby were allowed passage unharmed. By 18 BBY, a colony of netcasters had nested on Kashyyyk near a remote Wookiee village which had once been the home of the Jedi Gungi. Gungi—who had survived Order 66 and the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge—returned to his homeworld with the assistance of Clone Force 99 in hopes of rediscovering his native village. As the group trekked through the Kashyyykian wilderness, they encountered the netcasters' dense webbing and began to slice through it; the arachnids promptly descended and confronted them but ultimately allowed the non-hostile intruders to proceed. Later, the same colony found their territory aflame when a conflict was ignited between Gungi's allies and an association of Trandoshans and Imperial troops. During the fight, the Trandoshans, who showed no similar amicability toward the creatures, provoked the wrath of the netcasters and were quickly overrun by their numbers. Meanwhile, the Trandoshan commander Babwa Venomor was captured, wrapped in silk, and lifted into their web for consumption.
distinctions: Four legs, three pairs of eyes

name: Kintan crusher
summary: The Kintan crushers, also known as Kintan enforcers and a host of other names, were a species of powerfully-built creatures from the planet Kintan in Hutt Space. They were related to the semi-sentient Kintan striders, a species they surpassed in intelligence. Indeed, the Kintan crushers' obedience and ability to follow complex orders made them a favorite source for enforcers for members of the Hutt Cartel, and the species had been subject to centuries of domestication by the Hutts by the time of the Cold War. Crushers were built to pound and bash: While their legs were short and stocky, their upper body and arms were immense and helped propel their meaty fists in combat. They became savage opponents in battle, slapping, stomping, and bashing foes and even causing minor groundquakes. Crushers varied in size from slightly taller than an adult Human to truly gargantuan proportions. While the Hutts often employed beast masters to manage crushers in captivity, the species was capable of surviving in the wild by foraging. Kintan crushers roamed the grounds of both the palace of Fa'athra the Hutt and that of Karagga the Hutt on the planet Nal Hutta. Among these, Foreman Crusher was the most immense and formidable, guarding the entrance to Karagga's palace until being defeated by a group of invaders. Kintan crushers also lived beyond the borders of Hutt Space during the Cold War and its aftermath, with one specimen roaming the Clabburn Tundra of the ice planet Hoth.
height: From about 2 meters to gargantuan proportions

name: Kintan strider
summary: Kintan striders were a species of silicon-based lifeforms from the planet Kintan who were intelligent enough to use simple tools. Their appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik. Tasu Leech, topboss of the criminal Kanjiklub gang, owned a Donderbus blaster pistol whose handle was made from the ulna of a Kintan strider. They were the namesake of the Kintan Striders Gang, a gang of Niktos active on Tatooine in the early New Republic Era. By at least 11 ABY, a Kintan Strider was one of several creatures and gladiators belonging to species featured in dejarik that was unleashed upon the Mandalorian Din Djarin and Rotta the Hutt in the Pits on the moon Shakari, before escaping the arena and wreaking havoc on civilians.

name: Kip
summary: Kips were a sentient species native to the planet Kip. They were considered to be noticeably small in stature. Zorba Desilijic Tiure was imprisoned on their world for illegal ulikuo gemstone mining,

name: Kiros bird
summary: Kiros birds, also known as just Kiros, were a beautiful, regal, and elegant species of small bird native to the planet Kiros. They were highly intelligent and capable of understanding conversations. Kiros birds were very similar in appearance to convors, who also possessed grabbing tails. The two species could be differentiated by the fact that convors had gold and brown feathers instead of purple and blue ones. Three Kiros birds were owned by Miraj Scintel during the Clone Wars.

name: Kirruk
summary: The kirruk was a reptilian native to Ossus. Quadrupeds, kirruk were domesticated by the Ysanna following the planet's ruin during the Cron Supernova. They were named for their squawking call, and served as mounts for their Ysanna masters.

name: Kissai
summary: The Kissai were a subspecies of the Sith species who were enslaved by exiled Dark Jedi on Korriban. The Kissai were the priest class in the Sith caste system, where the Kissai would study the nature of the dark side of the Force and practice ancient Sith sorcery and alchemy.

name: Kite
summary: The kite was a species of flying creature native to the Core Worlds planet Alderaan. For generations, the Alderaanian inhabitants of the world tamed two species, kites and thrantas, to act as airbourne steeds and convey individuals from one city to another. Alderaan was destroyed by the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY.

name: Kitehawk
summary: The kitehawk was a type of hawk. In 231 BBY, Pan Eyta, a Tempest Runner of the Nihil marauder organization, captured a hologram recording of the Talortai Nihil Udi Dis, who had recently gained favor with the group's leader, Marchion Ro. Eyta, who had ensured that the recovering reedug addict Dis had received a sample of the drug in order to gain information from him, described the Talortai as being as high as a kitehawk when playing the recording to fellow Tempest Runners Lourna Dee and Zeetar.

name: Kitonak
summary: The Kitonak were a sentient species with pink skin and small eyes that was native to the planet Kirdo III. Their bodies released a vanilla-like scent. They boasted thick, leathery skin, which allowed them to adapt to harsh climates as their tough skin protected them from the sun. The musician Droopy McCool from Kirdo III was a Kitonak. His true name was a series of whistles only pronounceable by other Kitonaks. A colony of Kitonaks was rumored to exist on Tatooine, near Mos Eisley. Thaddeeus Marien was a male Kitonak who lived in the Reestkii settlement on Jakku.

name: Kittle
summary: The kittle (plural: kittles) was a small species of felines kept as personal companions or house pets. They were regarded as cute, and had a cat-like growl. Through the process of bioengineering, beast masters were able to incubate kittles by using their DNA.

name: Kivan
summary: Kivans were the people native to the planet Kiva. They were a peaceful people, known by many as artists and architects. When life on Kiva was wiped out by an experiment, they remained as disembodied wraiths. They appeared as shadows with red eyes. They believed that Mammon Hoole, one of the scientists involved in the experiment, was responsible for their fate and tried to kill him when he arrived on the planet many years later. They later learned that Borborygmus Gog, Hoole's fellow scientist and the mastermind of Project Starscream, was truly to blame. They all converged upon him, and the Kivan wraiths, along with Gog, vanished without a trace. They also seemed vulnerable to ion weapons.

name: k'Jtari
summary: The k'Jtari were a sentient species. They created a martial art that influenced its practitioners both mentally and physically. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, their martial art was considered ancient. The Human Dunan Par'Ell, who worked as head of security at the Ace of Sabres resort on the planet Kluistar, was proficient in it.

name: K'kayeh dragon
summary: The k'kayeh dragon was a gigantic, serpentine beast that was created by the Sith Lord Darth Rivan to defend his fortress on the planet Almas. The dragon was 200 meters in length and was covered by thick skin as strong as armor that was the exact color of the sands of the Almas Wasteland that surrounded Rivan's fortress. The creature preferred a subterranean lifestyle and rarely strayed to the planetary surface, instead choosing to spend most of its time roaming the deep underground caverns and swimming along subterrestrial rivers. After Rivan was driven from Almas during the New Sith Wars, in his absence the k'kayeh continued to reside on Almas for over a thousand years, coming to be regarded by the population of Almas as a creature of legend. Circa 17 BBY, the gatekeeper of an ancient holocron that Rivan had created summoned the dragon to attack the Imperial Inquisitor Valin Draco and a group of Alderaanian Resistance agents inside a cavern beneath a ruined Jedi academy. The agents withstood the creature's attack, and after Draco was sent tumbling off a ledge and into a deep chasm below, the k'kayeh ceased its assault and retreated.
distinctions: Razor-sharp teeth taller than a Wookiee

name: Kkekkrrg rro
summary: Kkekkrrg rro, also called Shadow Keepers, were predators that lived on Kashyyyk. They had five limbs, which fascinated xenobiologists. However, none were ever captured alive or dead, and no corpses were ever found.

name: Kkorrwrot
summary: Kkorrwrot were creatures native to Kashyyyk and distant cousins to the walluga. They were often seen in the Etyyy hunting grounds. Intelligent, but reclusive, they had a mouthful of tusks and sharp teeth. They evolved to become one of the most efficient hunters on Kashyyyk, dominating the Hracca Glade. Extremely intelligent, some researchers believed that the kkorrwot had a unique tendency to form temporary bonds with other (intelligent) creatures while hunting for food.

name: Kkryytch
summary: Kkryytch were avian creatures that were native to Kashyyyk. Their primary diet was based on hard-shelled seeds, which the bird was able to crack with its large, powerful beak.

name: Klako fish
summary: Klako fish were a type of fish that the Starros Clan member Mevera Starros loved. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the fish were on display at Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures zoo on the Outer Rim world Hon-Tallos. During that time, after the Weequay Jand arrived at the zoo to help liberate a rancor, he asked Starros if she had seen the klako fish. In response, Starros stated she had not but that she loved them.

name: Klatooine paddy frog
summary: The Klatooine paddy frog, also known as Klatooinian paddy frogs, was a species of frog from Klatooine that made up part of a Hutt's diet. Jabba kept an aquarium of these frogs by his throne at all times, and some in a neon green liquid inside of a green orb. The term "paddy frog" was also used by journalist Suralinda Javos toward the Resistance pilot Poe Dameron. Around 34 ABY, the Klatooinian paddy frog was sold at Ronto Roasters, a restaurant at Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, in a small drink container with a variety of beverages. The frog was used as a metaphor for the gradual establishment of Imperial control by the ISB, referring to the belief that the frog will not notice that it is being boiled to death if the temperature is raised very slowly.

name: Klatooinian
summary: Klatooinians were a species native to the planet Klatooine, who often worked as henchmen and bounty hunters. Klatooinians possessed a strong physique that led many of them to work in the criminal underworld. Some Klatooinians included Barada and Kithaba, who both worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

name: Kleex
summary: A kleex was a creature that possessed a shell. Kleex were known to retreat into their shells.

name: Kler'terrian
summary: The sentient species known as Kler'terrians were native to the Kler'terria system, a Core Worlds star system. The Kler'terrians had four arms, which they could move independently of each other. On the top of their heads, they had three eyestalks, arranged equidistant from each other. During the Galactic Civil War, the Kler'terrian Gor'telp worked as a bartender at Shilley's, an establishment on the planet Questal.

name: Kli'aari
summary: The Kli'aari were a four-armed species native to Kli'aar. They were known for their gentleness and their mechanical skills. Enclaves of Kli'aari could be found on most inhabited worlds located in the Gordian Reach.

name: Kliknik
summary: The Kliknik was a dangerous insectoid species native to the jungles of Yavin 4. These voracious carnivores lived in large underground hives and reported only to their queen, who oversaw every last Kliknik. Hive members carried out specialized tasks, dividing them into workers, hunters, warriors and defenders. During the Galactic Civil War, a hive of aggressive klikniks inhabited the Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster. After the Battle of Yavin, Doctor Maldien conducted illegal and highly dangerous bioengineering experiments in a laboratory on Corellia to create very aggressive and intelligent creatures. This included engineered klikniks.

name: Klinnet
summary: Klinnet were aquatic creatures that inhabited the canals of Neral's moon. They were able to flash with neon colors in order to communicate with each other.

name: Kloodavian
summary: The Kloodavians were small, yellow-skinned reptilians. They had the ability to regenerate lost limbs and were immune to mind tricks.

name: Kloperian
summary: The Kloperians were a sentient species native to the Inner Rim planet Kloper. They were a short, gray species, with fish-like eyes and mouths and extensible necks. Lines of tentacles, several of which were capped with hands, ran down both sides of their bodies. Their physique, combined with a natural affinity for mechanics, made the Kloperians some of the best engineers and technicians in the New Republic. In 17 ABY, a large group of Kloperians were involved in a plot by the Dark Jedi Kueller to cripple the New Republic. The Kloperians worked on Coruscant upgrading the Republic's fleet of starfighters, hiding detonators within the inner workings of the starships. However, their sabotage was discovered by R2-D2, the astromech droid of Jedi Master Luke Skywalker. While checking up on what was supposed to be routine maintenance on the Jedi's starfighter, the droid became suspicious of the Kloperians. He eventually discovered the detonators, and alerted General Wedge Antilles and Chief of State Leia Organa Solo to the danger the devices posed. The Chief of State had the Kloperian mechanics suspended from their duties until they could be thoroughly investigated. R2-D2 later traveled to Telti where the detonators were produced, and remotely deactivated similar devices across the galaxy.

name: K'lor'slug
summary: K'lor'slugs were a species whose appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik. Pink, tubular beasts, they had suction cup-like mouths and sharp teeth. They were speculated to be swamp dwellers from the Outer Rim Territories. By 33 BBY, a K'lor'slug had been stolen from a zoo on Valo and taken to Nar Shaddaa, where it was intended to be sold on to a buyer assembling a set of living dejarik pieces as a gift to Jabba the Hutt. By at least 11 ABY, a K'lor'slug was one of several creatures and gladiators belonging to species featured in dejarik that was unleashed upon the Mandalorian Din Djarin and Rotta the Hutt in the Pits on the moon Shakari, before escaping the arena and wreaking havoc on civilians.

name: Kluuzot
summary: The Kluuzot were a species of sentient lemuroids that were indigenous to the world of Krann.

name: Klytonian
summary: The Klytonians were a sentient species originating in the Klytonia system of the Outer Rim Territories' Bheriz sector. Their bodies were covered with leathery scales, which produced electric field vibrations that allowed them to communicate with each other. In 0 BBY, multiple Klytonians were present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Mos Eisley settlement on the Arkanis sector planet Tatooine. The Klytonians communicated with each other across the room they were in.

name: Knaar
summary: Knaars were, fast-moving, nocturnal, reptilian, predators, with yellow eyes, purplish-blue scales, and a silver frill of razor-sharp spines along their backs. These predators possessed powerful jaws for tearing apart prey as well as a slashing tail armed with barbs for defense. Native to the planet Anobis, these migratory creatures traveled by night in packs of several hundred or were attracted by the natural light created by fire. With no understanding of stealth, these fearless creatures use intimidation via hooting and howling while pounding their clawed feet to panic prey as they stampede towards them. Knaars possess a ravenous apatite so extreme they even devour the wounded and/or corpses of their own kind if the opportunity presents itself. Human victims had been observed being swallowed whole by the Knaar during a stampede.

name: Kneeb
summary: Kneebs were small, rodentlike creatures with yellow fur. The Hutts considered them a delicacy and used the cured hides to cover luxury items. They were apparently named for the cries they made. Transporting crates of kneebs was part of a lucrative shipping business. One thousand kneebs were slaughtered and served at the wedding feast of Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo and Anachro the H'uun.

name: Knobby white ice spider
summary: The knobby white ice spider, also known as the Maldo Kreis ice spider, was a species of spider that lived in ice caves on the planet Maldo Kreis. The spiders ranged in size from very small to starship-sized, and attacked Din Djarin's ship, the Razor Crest, after Grogu consumed one of the eggs found in the planet's ice caverns. Similar arachnid species could be found on several other planets across the the galaxy; spice spiders, located on the planets Aaloth and Taul, and the Krykna spiders of the world of Atollon, were similar to the knobby ice spiders, as were the similarly named knobby white spiders, which were native to the planet Dagobah and grew into gnarltrees. Unlike most spiders, the head of the knobby white ice spider was in the center of their body, hanging downward and ending in a circular mouth comprised of outer, grasping teeth and inner rows of smaller teeth, presumably to grind up their prey. They could produce and shoot webbing from their mouths and they had green blood. The species laid soft-shelled eggs in which their young would hatch. The eggs themselves were filled with green juices, slime, and webbing, and were edible by Yoda's species. Smaller members of the species could be killed with most common weapons or even by hand, as demonstrated by Din Djarin crushing a spider that tried to attack him with his bare hand. The larger, mature ice spider had eight legs, while the smaller, younger creatures had only six legs.

name: Knobby white spider
summary: The knobby white spider was a species of spider that lived and lurked on the planet Dagobah. They later grew into gnarltrees. Their name was similar to the knobby white ice spiders of the planet Maldo Kreis, a species that was in fact similar to the arachnids of Dagobah and other worlds. The knobby white spider was discovered and studied by Commander Halka Four-Den and her Alpha Team when they visited Dagobah, although they were eventually overwhelmed by the local flora and fauna.

name: Knowledge Bank
summary: The Knowledge Bank, also known as Pakoukou, was a sentient native to Mon Calamari that was aware of all events that happened on the ocean world. Consisting of a cluster of mollusks, the Knowledge Bank used telepathy to gain information on events all across the planet as well as from the minds of those who visited it. It would then relay that information to those who could communicate with it, either telepathically or with the special ritual language other denizens of Mon Calamari used. The Bank was sacred to the native Mon Calamari and Quarren, and its existence was kept a closely guarded secret. A group of smugglers and bounty hunters accessed it in 1 BBY in their search for the treasure known as the Yavin Vassilika, and the Jedi Cilghal used it in 11 ABY to find the missing Admiral Gial Ackbar.
distinctions: Shells, yellow glow, possibility of forming a telepathic Force-bond
habitat: Between underwater mountain ranges on a coral shelf 12 meters deep

name: Knytix
summary: The Knytix was a non-sentient mantid from Thyferra that the Vratix employed in a number of capacities. They were said to make excellent pets and soup, and their saliva was used in the construction of Vratix buildings. Iella Wessiri found this an odd custom on her visit to a Verachen village, but accepted it as one of the very many cultures of the diverse galaxy.

name: Kobarian swamp dog
summary: Kobarian swamp dogs, sometimes known simply as swamp dogs, were a non-sentient species of domestic canine originating from the planet Kobaria. Two of these creatures, Higgs and Twiggs, were meant to be wedding presents for the Wroonian Pelf Pachoola and her fiancé around the year 22 BBY.

name: Kobok
summary: The Koboks were a sentient species of skeletal insectoids.

name: Kodashi viper
summary: The Kodashi viper was an ophidian indigenous to the rainforests of the Outer Rim world of Dathomir. Kodashi vipers were the most poisonous serpents in Dathomir's jungles, and those who failed to heed the multicolored aposematic patterns of their hides often fell victim to the Kodashi's neurotoxic venom. Despite the lethality of their natural defensive poison, Kodashi vipers were safely edible, and their skins were used by the natives to fashion garments. In 43.5 ABY, Kodashi vipers were exploited by the Nightsister clan of Dathomiri witches as the means by which they attacked the annual gathering of the Raining Leaves and Broken Columns Clans. Through their command of the Force, the Nightsisters directed several Kodashi vipers into the camp of the Broken Columns, which resulted in the deaths of four clansmen.
skinColor: Green, with bands of red and yellow

name: Kod'yok
summary: Kod'yoks were a peaceful non-sentient species of shaggy, horned quadrupeds that roamed the open plains on the snowy planet of Vandor.

name: Kogini
summary: The Kogini were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Anbert Dregil was a member of this species.

name: Koi eel
summary: Koi eels were a species of exotic eel with blue and gray skin and six black eyes that could be found in the galaxy. During the New Republic Era, Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth possessed several koi eels within her pond inside her residence on the planet Corvus.

name: Kolvor
summary: The kolvor was a type of bird that lived on Naboo. They were known for snatching children and dashing them on rocks. Because of this villagers in the mountains called them vangartracks, which meant vanishers.

name: Kon'me
summary: The Kon'me were a sentient reptilian species native to the ocean planet Bal'demnic in the Outer Rim's Auril sector. Living on the small islands that littered the surface of Bal'demnic, the Kon'me divided themselves into two prominent social classes, an upper-class that resided in luxurious bubble-like structures on oceanside cliffs, and a lower-class that lived in simple, thatch, beachside dwellings. Known to be extremely distrustful of off-worlders, the Kon'me tried to keep from involving themselves in larger galactic affairs unless absolutely necessary, but they were unable to avoid being forced into the Clone Wars when it was discovered that Bal'demnic's cliffs contained the rare mineral cortosis. In 19 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded Bal'demnic, seeking to mine the cortosis ore, with the higher-class Kon'me reluctantly allowing the Separatists' occupation. However, the beachfront Kon'me were less compliant, and rebelled against the Confederate battle droid army. During the resulting battle, the Galactic Republic sent a detachment of its clone army led by a number of Jedi Knights to assist the Kon'me insurrection. The Kon'me rebels, however, seeing all the off-worlders as tyrannical invaders, fought back against both Confederate and Republic armies, eventually forcing the two intruding factions to leave Bal'demnic.
skinColor: Pink with dark spots on their backs

name: Koorivar
summary: The Koorivar were a sentient species of near-humans distinguished by their reptilian skin and large cranial horn that spiraled upwards from the center of their skull.

name: Korban
summary: The Korbans were a species of blue-skinned sentients that hailed from the planet Korba. Korbans possessed a head with green hair, two pink cheeks, and two large, pink eyes. Several of them worked as miners on Korba, mining kyber crystals in Korba's spires for the Jedi Order, which was deeply grateful for their work. No member of the species had left their world. The young Force-sensitive girl Aau and her father, Abat, were two Korbans who lived at their dwelling on Korba. The former was able to purify kyber crystals by singing, which her father deemed dangerous. After the Jedi Kratu visited their home, the pair traveled to a Korban settlement, where Abat walked to a new mine shaft in Spire 17 and Aau groomed purple beasts that the Korbans rode. However, Aau abandoned her work and followed her father to a mine, where she entered a cavern filled with kyber crystals. She sang and purified the crystals, causing the spire that contained the cavern and other nearby spires to collapse; as a result, she, Abat, and the miner Attu tried to escape. Attu successfully escaped, but the other two fell from a bridge, being saved from the fall by Kratu, who generated a Force shield to protect them from the rocks that were falling from the spires. Aau then sang and purified the nearby kyber crystals and stopped the spires' collapse, saving herself, her father, and Kratu, who invited her to leave Korba with her so that the Jedi could nurture the girl's singing abilities. Aau accepted and became the first member of the alien species to leave her world.

name: Kordan
summary: Kordans were a sentient species, native to Korda Six.

name: Korrak
summary: Korraks were a non-sentient species of large, serpent-like reptiles native to the planet Sacorria. They possessed eight short and stubby but powerful legs, ending in clawed feet and allowing them to move incredibly quickly both and lands and when climbing trees. Covered in pebbly scales, a korrak's body was long and sinuous and allowed them to be relatively agile. To attack the creatures either attempted to wrap themselves around a target and crush it or used the deadly neurotoxin in their bite. They would sometimes attack sentients.
distinctions: Eight powerful legs, long sinuous body, potent neurotoxin in bite

name: Korriban zombie
summary: Korriban zombies, also known as Korriban Sith zombies, were semi-sentient, undead humanoid predators native to the Sith tombworld Korriban. Originally created prior to 7000 BBY by Sith King Dathka Graush's experiments using Sith alchemy and magic to reanimate corpses, the creatures were soon discovered to be capable of creating more of their kind by biting living sentient beings. After a tumultuous fifty-year reign, Graush was assassinated, and the spirits animating the zombies were collected in a crystal that was buried with him in his tomb located in Korriban's Valley of Golg. For the next seven millennia, the zombies served as guardians of the tombs of the Sith Lords in both the Valley of Golg and the Valley of the Dark Lords. The creatures laid dormant for extended periods of time, and were only awakened by the commands of the deceased Sith Lords' spirits or the disturbance of Graush's crystal in order to eliminate any intruders or would-be tomb robbers. The zombies' limited intelligence allowed them to wield weapons, and this attribute, coupled with their intimidating presence, ensured that few sentients prevailed during an encounter with the creatures. In 3997 BBY, self-declared Jedi Knight Exar Kun survived an encounter with the guardian zombies while exploring the Valley of the Dark Lords, as did a group of Jedi Knights and their respective Padawans nearly four millennia after Kun, during their pursuit of a galactic criminal. A subsequent encounter with the creatures occurred six months before the Battle of Yavin, when a pirate vessel crash-landed near the Valley of Golg.
distinctions: Ability to transmit their condition to living sentient beings through biting

name: Korrina
summary: The korrinas or corrinas were a wolf-like canine predator found on the Forest Moon of Endor. A very smart species, Korrinas naturally traveled in packs, and were particularly active during the winter months. Young korrinas had ligther fur and a shorter tail. A group of these creatures raised the Ewok warrior Asha after she was separated from her mother, Ra-Lee, by a hanadak attack.

name: Korsk
summary: Korsks were creatures used by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species to scrub. When the Yuuzhan Vong shaper Nen Yim was younger, sometime before the Yuuzhan Vong War, in which the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong invaded a galaxy other than their own, she and a pair of crèche-mates, P'loh and Zhul, put a korsk in a communal eating area where it proceeded to eat all of the i'fii foodstuff. In 29 ABY during the war, Yim discovered that the Jedi Knight Tahiri Veila shared her memories, including the korsk incident. This led Yim to realize that her own personality had been implanted in Veila's mind during an attempt to make Veila believe that she was a Yuuzhan Vong via shaping, a form of Yuuzhan Vong bioengineering.

name: Kotabi
summary: The Kotabi were a humanoid sentient species in the galaxy. Jedi bond-twins Terec and Ceret were members of the species and originated from the planet Sagamore The planet Kotab was also a homeworld of the twins.

name: Kouhun
summary: {{Update|, Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy}} Kouhuns, also known as Indoumodo kouhuns were small, multi-legged arthropods from the jungle planet of Indoumodo that were able to deliver a deadly venom to their victims. As their venom was typically lethal, they were sometimes employed by assassins to kill their targets.

name: Kououra
summary: Kououra were predators native to Kashyyyk. Despite its disarming appearance, it had a toxic bite. It was carnivorous with pale tender flesh.

name: Kouru's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Kouru was a member of this species.

name: Kova
summary: The kova was a non-sentient reptile native to Hynestia, living beneath the surface. The Hynestians hunted the kova for food, and also made kova leather from its skin. The Gran Kovali was a kova owned by the Hynestian royal family, and the severest punishment on the planet was being fed to it.

name: Kowakian ape-lizard
summary: The Kowakian ape-lizard, also known as the Kowakian ape, was a huge, semi-sentient predatory reptilian creature native to the planet Kowak.

name: Kowakian monkey-lizard
summary: Kowakian monkey-lizards, also known as Kowakians, were a race of semi-sentient reptilian creatures often used by members of the underworld as pets. Owners of Kowakians included Jabba Desilijic Tiure, Hondo Ohnaka, and Emil Graf. They were capable of using weapons such as a blaster and, in the case of Pikk Mukmuk, a pirate tank. One Kowakian became a bounty hunter and turned the Wookiee Chewbacca over to the Galactic Empire. They were related to the much larger Kowakian ape-lizard. Due to their appearance they were often mistaken for pests. Monkey-lizards were quite intelligent and capable of mimicking almost any language.

name: Krabbex
summary: The Krabbex was a species of crustacean that was native to the oceanic world of Dac. It was characterized by its ten legs, dual mandibles in its mouth, two rows of spines running along its back, eighteen black eyes with four on its front, and grasping claws. Krabbex were often hunted by the Mermen of Mon Calamari. It was the subject of one of the dioramas within the Holographic Zoo of Extinct Animals on Coruscant. Admiral Gial Ackbar's Foreign Intruder Defense Organism resembled a krabbex.

name: Krag
summary: Krags were very large herd animals native to Frithia, capable of trampling humanoids to death. They were domesticated over time by the Zabrak colonists of the world. Many Zabrak males were named after the species.

name: Krahbu
summary: The krahbu was a herbivore herd animal with bristly, red-white hide native to Corellia.

name: Krakai
summary: The Krakai were an insectoid species indigenous to Kathol. They were created by the DarkStryder.

name: Krakana
summary: Krakanas were carnivorous creatures that existed on Mon Cala. In the culture of the Mon Calamari, the remains of those who lost in ancient rites of challenge were fed to krakanas. A Mon Calamari saying went that "a wounded krakana can still bite." The creatures were the namesake of the Mon Cala Krakanas, a Huttball team.

name: Krakavora
summary: The krakavora were a species of aquatic flying creature found on the planet Aeos Prime.

name: Krantian
summary: Krantians were a sentient species that hailed from the Krant system in the Mid Rim. A family of Krantians, including mother Lerahel and child Sarry, attended the Republic Fair on the planet Valo. When the Nihil marauders attacked the fair, Lerahel and Sarry were the only ones of the family who survived.

name: Krawg
summary: The Krawg were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, a group of Krawg pirates raided credits from the planet Mykapo and later used them to pay the bounty hunter Sana Starros for a crate of Imperial blasters with the promise she would deliver them twelve more. However, she turned around and turned them in as the thieves to the Empire. In 3 ABY, the Rokana Raiders pirate group lost multiple starships full of stolen parts to the Krawg. One member of the raiders complained about this to a comrade and claimed their group was spread too thin while guarding the Khepi Tomb in the Khepi system.

name: Krayt dragon
summary: The term "krayt dragon" referred to a number of large, carnivorous reptilian species that hailed from Tatooine, a desert planet in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Krayt dragons, despite their fierceness, were hunted for the precious pearls found in their bodies.

name: Kreegon
summary: Kreegons were extinct predators once indigenous to the forest moon of Endor. Morag once reanimated a kreegon skeleton.

name: Kreetch eel
summary: Kreetch eels were large predators from Naboo capable of feeding on and conducting electricity, which they used to stun prey.

name: Kreetle
summary: The kreetle was a parasitic, burrowing insect often found in homes and around cities. They could be found on a variety of worlds, including Tatooine, Naboo, Kashyyyk and Geonosis.

name: Krel shark
summary: Krel sharks were a type of shark that lived on the planet Eiram. According to legend, the deity Krel transformed into the sharks. Around 397 BBY, when he was young, the future heir to Eiram, Phan-tu Zenn, was stuck in the oceans of Eiram and was surrounded by krel sharks, none of which harmed him.

name: Krendel
summary: Krendel was a large lizard-like creature. The reptile's skin was glossy yellow with vibrant blue and green mottled spots running down its back. It had large, bulbous black eyes and rubbery, sticky pads on its feet that allowed it to climb surfaces of sheer rock. When attacking, it could also make use of sharp needle-like teeth and the ability to breathe out corrosive gas. Krendels were born and raised in Recopia's toxic seas but developed lungs and limbs later. These biological advantages enabled them to creep on land in search of their prey, usually seabirds nesting in the island cliffs. Krendel, having no keen sense of sight, hunted primarily by scent and motion. They hunted in mated pairs.

name: Kresch
summary: The Kresch was a semi-sentient mollusk native to Naboo. It contained information about nearly every aspect of Gungan civilization, and when opened, its blood would form pictures and words on its skin. Because of this, the Gungans used the Kresch as an encyclopedia of sorts. The Kresch proved useful when the Gungans colonized Ohma-D'un, because it provided information about all the animals being released on the moon.
distinctions: Ability to form pictures and words on its skin

name: Kretch insect
summary: The kretch insect was a scorpion-like insect that could be found in subterranean passages of Belsavis and Aargau. Kretches had six legs, two jaws, and a barbed tail. During the visit of Leia Organa Solo to Belsavis while she was searching for information about the children of the Jedi, she was attacked by one such creature and later threatened with a swarm of them by Irek Ismaren to help in her capture. The Jedi children, during their stay with Ho'Din Jedi Plett, were warned from straying into the crypts adjoining his home with the saying "the kretch will get you." In 22 BBY, a young Boba Fett encountered a kretch in the dank tunnels of Aargau's Undercity while on his quest to secure the fortune left to him by his father Jango. The enterprising future bounty hunter quickly and efficiently dispatched it with the solid thrust of his boot. The creature was the namesake of the Belsavis Kretch smashball team.

name: Krevaaki
summary: The Krevaaki were a race of sentients native to Krevas. The Krevaaki people possessed an exoskeleton. The face of a Krevaaki was composed of a series of shifting, chitinous plates with a limited range of expression. During face-to-face communication, it was difficult for anyone who was not a Krevaaki to read their facial expressions. Krevaaki used their tentacles instead of arms and legs like bipeds. They often concealed the true number from humanoids.

name: Krex
summary: The Krex were a sentient species native to the planet Rokirex. Humanoid in shape, the species possessed a large build, five-fingered hands, big jaws and was taller than many other Humanoid species due to the large horn on top of their heads. A Krex named Grenkk worked at Club Vertica Casino as a bouncer during a Soovada event. In addition, General Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun was a Krex.
distinctions: Large horn on top of the head

name: Kri-snort
summary: Kri-snorts were a type of flying creature that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Valo. In 231 BBY, Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram noticed several kri-snorts slowly flapping toward Valo's Lake Lonisa as he traveled toward the world's capital, Lonisa City.

name: Kriek
summary: The Krieks were a species of sentients that were indigenous to the world of Kriekaal in Wild Space.
distinctions: Able to see into the infrared spectrum

name: Krikthasi
summary: The Krikthasi were large sentient marine mollusks indigenous to Baralou.
distinctions: Color changing chromanin, eight tentacles, water propulsion

name: Kril
summary: Kril were unintelligent, harmless arboreal herbivores native to Kidron. They were easy prey and also raised by the Orfites as the mainstay of their diet. A local company, Attakril Meats, exported their flesh throughout the Elrood sector. People who acted out of stupidity were derogatorily called "krilheads."

name: Krill
summary: Krill were small crustaceans that lived in water in great numbers. In the oceans of the planet Kamino, they were a major source of food for the semi-aquatic aiwha species, which had baleens in their mouths to filter krill out from seawater. On the planet Sorgan, freshwater krill were farmed by the inhabitants of an isolated village, and were used to brew the drink spotchka.

name: Krill shark
summary: Krill sharks were a type of shark found on the planet Eiram. During a seasonal ritual, krill sharks broke through the surface of the water. On one occasion, in the city Erasmus on Eiram, the Eirami Jedi Raa-lyn Las was present when locals gathered along piers to watch the ritual. In 228 BBY, when Las and the Republic Defense Coalition pilot Lexi Greylark were trapped in a bunker on the planet Palagosal, Las used the Force to share her memory of seeing the krill sharks during their seasonal ritual with Greylark.

name: Krillcrab
summary: Krillcrab were a type of crustacean whose meat could be eaten. When the junk dealer Temmin Wexley saw the pale flesh of an Uugteen's limbs through the joints in its armor on the planet Akiva shortly before the Rebellion on Akiva, it reminded him of the flesh of a krillcrab that had been flipped over so that its meat was accessible.

name: Krinnan
summary: Krinnan was a species that roamed the jungle of Kindosorn.

name: Krish
summary: The Krish were a sentient species. While searching for information concerning Imperial attempts to sure up the Empire's relations with criminals following the Battle of Endor, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca were ambushed by a trio of Krish marauder-ships in the Mid Rim. Upon engaging the three Krish vessels, the smugglers discovered that the weapons of their YT-1300 light freighter, the Millennium Falcon, had stopped working after Chewbacca had been attempting to fix an issue with the hyperdrive. This resulted in the Falcon taking some serious damage, and the smugglers were only just able to escape from the marauder-ships.

name: Krishel
summary: Krishels were a type of strong, hardshelled, burrowing quadruped native to the Outer Rim volcanic planet Mustafar. They were hunted by the sentient Mustafarians native to the world, who tracked them through seemingly endless subterranean labyrinths of tunnels and caverns.

name: Kroa bird
summary: Kroa birds were a type of bird found exclusively on the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The birds had four, featherless, yellow wings and a featherless tail. Their feather colors were green on the top of their head, purple from their yellow eyes to their chest, and white down to their feet. Kroa birds also possessed a long, skinny bill and two antenna-like appendages on the top of their head. Sometime between 232 BBY and 230 BBY, Jedi Youngling Lys Solay and Astromech Gigi were on a mission to find a lost package, but got distracted by a kroa bird before they could find it. While the bird was flying with Gigi, Solay suspected the bird enjoyed the droid's company.

name: Krodyur
summary: A Krodyur was a flat creature, sporting a white fur and a dreadful jaw. Extremely dangerous and hard to see in the mountain of Shingra—especially during the night—it would often attack the voyagers.

name: Kroolok
summary: Krooloks were a species of creatures that supposedly inhabited the forest moon of Endor, a type of troll. At some point, a Kroolok apparently stalked the forest around an Ewok village while its inhabitants sheltered against the cold. In fact, the Kroolok was apparently a legend created by Logray, the chief shaman of the Bright Tree tribe, along with Chirpa, the chief of the Council of Elders. It was unclear if any such creature really existed. It was described as being taller than a borra beast, with spiked antlers, huge feet with three vicious talons, a long tail and teeth as white as a moon moth's wings. Despite this, its powers of stealth were such that it could easily hide among trees, such that its victims would never know it was there until it was too late.

name: Kroyie
summary: Kroyies were a large birdlike species native to the planet Kashyyyk. Avian animals, the kroyies were hunted as a food source by the natives of Kashyyyk, the Wookiees. Kroyies lived in the high branches of Wroshyr trees and were attracted to bright lights, causing the Wookiees to use powerful searchlights projected into the sky or clouds in order to catch them.

name: Krozurbian
summary: The Krozurbians were a green-skinned sentient species native to the Krozurbia system, near the Centrality. At one point in time, they engaged in a war amongst themselves for two hundred years. That conflict was finally ended due to the intervention of the Ithorian scientist Zorneth, who supplied the Krozurbian War Council savorium-fed thookahs. Savorium was a drug that produced a pacifistic euphoria in its consumer, and the effect of steaks made from these thookahs on the Krozurbian War Council led them to embrace peace and end their war.

name: Krusk
summary: A violent herbivorous species known as krusk was native to the Mid Rim planet Bothawui. The species name was used by the Bothans, a sentient species native to the planet, as a first name given to some members of the male sex.

name: Krykna
summary: Krykna were predatory, non-sentient, spider-like creatures native to Atollon. They were resistant to blaster bolts and highly sensitive to negative emotions, making them extremely difficult to tame with the Force. They were repelled by the signal emitted by sensor beacons.

name: Krytollak
summary: Krytollaks were a species of sentient, armored mammals indigenous to the planet Thandruss. They were led by an empress and had a rigid social structure, thinking that absolute monarchy was the only sensible form of government, both on a planetary and galactic level. When Palpatine anointed himself Galactic Emperor at the end of the Clone Wars, the Krytollak empress Devir recognized his right to rule, and her people become staunch supporters of the newly created Galactic Empire. Under the Imperial rule, the Krytollaks went through an era of unprecedented technological development, and some of them left their homeworld for the first time to join the wider galactic community as merchants, mercenaries or bounty hunters.

name: Kthoo-Ra's species
summary: This species was a sentient species found within the galaxy. These bipedal humanoid sentients were distinguished by their hulking frames, towering over most the average human, with green skin and solid white eyes with red patches underneath them. By around 0 ABY, one member of this species, Kthoo-Ra, was trained as a gladiator by the Xonti Brothers, though he was eventually killed by the Wookiee bounty hunter Krrsantan. Later, in 34 ABY, two members of this species served as body guards for the owner of the Coruscant Hotel and Casino, Jorka Edy, equipped with full suits of armor and potentially cybernetics.

name: Ktilac
summary: The Ktilacs were a species that originated at the Inner Rim planet Ktil. They ruled sixty-three star systems in the Ktilac Regions, an area of space that they co-inhabited with the Murachaun and Tocoyans, and the three species had a common culture and quasi-religion. The Ktilacs' homeworld was a part of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire, and the isolationist Ktilac Regions nevertheless held the status of an Allied Region under the New Republic and the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.

name: Kuan'Mar
summary: The Kuan'Mar were a sentient, lizard-like species native to the desert planet of Trillia.

name: Kubaz
summary: The Kubaz were an insectoid sentient species that were native to the planet Kubindi. They lived on a diet of insects, using their long snout to snatch their prey from inside hives. This did not make them very popular with sentient insectoid species, such as the Geonosians, despite the Kubaz themselves being descended from insects. They had dark skin, long snouts, and sensitive eyesight causing them to require protective eyewear. On the whole, their appearance resembled that of the northern Mustafarians. Kubaz were unable to pronounce the phonemes of Galactic Basic Standard, and their language was made of whirring syllables. At one time, the Kubaz wrote in a script which, by the High Republic Era, was remembered as Ancient Kubaz. The Galactic Empire conquered the Kubaz species after claiming they could be allies. The Empire enslaved Kubaz and sought to brainwash others to make them into spies.

name: Kubaza beetle
summary: The Kubaza beetles were a vicious hive-dweller species of giant beetles that existed on the volcanic planet of Mustafar. Their diet consisted of the minerals and, as such, they were a common sight near lava flows. Kubaza were aggressive creatures when they felt their nests were threatened, and they had a unique way of handling attackers which was simply to explode upon being fatally wounded. Commander Lina Graf and her crew encountered one when they crash-landed on Mustafar. When the bodyguard droid XM-G3 attacked it, the wounded beetle exploded, sacrificing itself so its brood could escape the perceived threat.

name: Kublag
summary: The kublag was a type of creature found on the forest moon of Endor. They had six legs, broad antlers, and glossy skin. During an especially bleak winter on Endor, a group of Ewoks from Bright Tree Village caught a kublag while out hunting for essential supplies. The hunting party tethered the creature onto the back of a sled, which the Ewoks Deej and Chukha-Trok then pulled back to the village. Although the kublag looked impressive on the sled, it proved to be no where near large enough to feed the entire Bright Tree tribe. The Ewoks Teebo and Wicket Wystri Warrick helped to make a stew from the creature, thickening the broth with raventhorn root and ground-apple stock, but it struggled to fill their bellies. Warrick's brother Weechee later tied the horns from the kublag around his head as part of a costume he created to impersonate the mythical Kroolok while trying to scare Warrick and his friends.

name: Kudana
summary: Native to the planet Rutan, the Kudana were herd animals. Their pelts were prized for the metallic colored sheen of their skin, and the silky mane that ran down their shoulders. Their skin was extremely tough and could be used to make body armor, clothes, and furniture. Several efforts to breed them on other planets failed. They stood almost two full meters tall, and were built with powerful muscles. Their mouths were massive, with flat teeth used to crush wood and grass to pulp. Kudana had incredible strength, and sharp hooves used for defense and for digging for roots. A very select group of hunters are allowed to hunt them, but only at a great fine. Kudana were very easily spooked, trampling and crushing anything in its way.

name: Kudon
summary: Kudon were a sentient species in the galaxy. A number of Kudon resided on the moon Kudo III. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems enslaved a village of Kudon, forcing them to work in a foundry to create battle droids. The Kudon were freed when Jedi General Anakin Skywalker infiltrated the foundry and discovered the slave operation. In the time of the Cold War between the New Republic and the First Order, Mek Nu'Tiv was a Kudon trader.

name: Kui fish
summary: Kui fish were a type of fish that could be pickled. In 228 BBY, Marl kept a jar of pickled kui fish behind the register of his restaurant Marl's Good Enough Eats.

name: Kulless
summary: Kulless were a sentient species from the planet Gerres Gule. Members of the species were bipedal, with a round torso and a thick tail. In 24 BBY, the Kulless Shrivel Braittrand competed on the professional Podracing circuit, piloting a Podracer of his own design. Braittrand was particularly favored on the SoroSuub Facility track.

name: Kullp
summary: The Kullp were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. When Han Solo and Lando Calrissian were searching for a pilot on Frander's Bay, Solo dodged a lumbering Kullp after he pushed his way through a group of Teek.

name: Kulthka fish
summary: The kulthka fish was a non-sentient species of fish found across the planet Dac. The Knowledge Bank had a connection with the fish that allowed it to record everything that the fish saw or heard.

name: Kumumgah
summary: The Kumumgah were an ancient species from Outer Rim planet of Tatooine. They developed spaceflight, drawing the attention of the Rakata, who conquered, enslaved, and annexed them to their Infinite Empire in 25,793 BBY. The Kumumgah eventually rebelled and were punished by the Rakata, who bombed the surface of the once-lush world of Tatooine into little more than fused glass. This glass eventually crumbled and became desert sand. Over time, the Kumumgah would evolve into two species: the Ghorfas, who would become the Tusken Raiders, and the Jawas.

name: Kundril
summary: The kundril was a species of huge, flying insect that was indigenous to the world of Brentaal IV, one of the few lifeforms that wasn't displaced by colonization and terraforming. Kundrils grew to be at least twenty meters and often much larger. They had long, slender, multi-segmented bodies, bulging out to hardened wedges at the tail end. These wedges could be used to bash their prey into submission. Their bodies were lined with row upon row of thin, translucent wings, which were used for maneuvering in the air, but the actual method of flight was a series of internal gas bladders inside their exoskeletons, which were filled with lighter-than-air gases. Kundrils did not have eyes and hunted by means of echolocation. Kundrils typically lived and hunted by the shore and at sea, swooping down from the air to catch fish or sea mammals. Kundrils mated and laid their eggs on land, hidden in sand nests. Seagoing kundrils were typically blue or green. Most land-based kundrils became extinct, either supplanted by non-native creatures or exterminated. In the mountains and canyons, a few bright red Imperial kundrils still existed, often near volcanoes. Kundrils were formidable, but rarely attacked Humans or Human-sized creatures unless provoked. They were, however, capable of attacking and devouring humanoid sentients and could in fact even defend themselves against airspeeders if necessary.

name: Kupohan
summary: The Kupohan were a sentient species from the planet of Kupoh in the system of the same name. Due to the strong winds of their ecosystem, they had evolved their frequency filter organs to screen out all the noise and detect voices, which also helped them hunt. They helped the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, so when Luke Skywalker came across one of their ships being attacked by a pair of TIE/ln space superiority starfighters while on a mission to Rodia, he decided to risk his mission in order to help out the Kupohans, who were able to escape to hyperspace with Luke's help.
distinctions: Frequency filter organs, four eyes, three nostrils

name: Kuranu
summary: Kuranu were a sentient species that possessed smooth purple skin and pupil-less eyes. The species also had an almost pathological fear of germs. The inventor Mantessa Chekkat and her daughter, Klerin, who lived during the High Republic Era, were Kuranu.

name: Kuret
summary: Kurets were a species of small, brown-colored insects, approximately one centimeter long, found on the world of Kubindi. They possessed a hive-based mentality and were often found in swarms. This made them dangerous as they had the ability to coordinate their attacks via pheromones, and especially because of their sharp pincers. They were prized as food by the Kubaz, though they were untamed, which made them somewhat of an expensive meal.

name: Kurnbeast
summary: The kurnbeast was a type of creature found on the Outer Rim forest moon of Endor. During a particularly bleak winter on Endor between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, the Ewoks Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, Wicket Wystri Warrick, and Teebo set out on a hunting expedition from Bright Tree Village. As they left the village, Kintaka wondered if they would manage to catch a kurnbeast, a boar-wolf, or a condor dragon, although ultimately they returned empty handed.

name: Kurtzen
summary: The Kurtzen were a pale, hairless, humanoid species from the planet Bakura. They were the only sentients native to the world; few in number, they became a minority when Human settlers arrived in 150 BBY. Kurtzen suffered from a degenerative genetic disorder that limited their population growth. Although medicine provided by the Human settlers helped them overcome the disease, Kurtzen comprised only five percent of Bakura's population by 4 ABY. Despite this, it was unusual for more than two children in a family to reach adulthood. Kurtzen society was divided into tribes and clans. The Kurtzen were peaceful nomads with stone-age technology when first encountered by Human representatives of the Bakur Mining Corporation. Kurtzen religious beliefs centered on a universal life force that could be channeled via clothing and personal effects called totems or life trinkets; scholars speculated that such beliefs developed as a response to population decline. However, by the time of the Galactic Civil War, younger Kurtzen were largely abandoning their old ways in favor of adopting Bakuran Human culture. Indeed, the Kurtzen were extremely grateful for having received medical and technological assistance from the Bakuran Humans, and they gained representation in the newcomers' government. At the time of the Invasion of Bakura, two out of the forty members of the Bakuran Senate were Kurtzen. Most of the Kurtzen population was concentrated in the Kishh district on the continent of Braad, and after Human colonization, the uninhabited eastern continent of Kishh'daar was reserved for Kurtzen settlement once their numbers warranted it.

name: Kusak
summary: A kusak was a partially armored predatory canine from the planet of Lok. Kusaks usually roamed the rocky terrain hunting in packs. If one tamed a kusak, it was loyal until death. Pirate warlord Nym kept two kusaks, named Razor and Scourge, as guardians in his palace. A pack of kusaks, including Runt, Bedhead, Blinky, Scarecrow, Slobbers, Troubles, Wart Face, Gargle, Ding and Speedbump, was also used to guard Nym's Stronghold.

name: Kushiban
summary: Kushibans were sentient lagomorphs, with two big ears and mood fur covering their bodies. This mood fur was white when the Kushiban were at peace, and changed colors according to their mood.
hairColor: White at rest, changes color with mood.
eyeColor: Change color, have been seen blue, brown, green.

name: Kwa
summary: The Kwa were an ancient species native to the Outer Rim world of Dathomir that built the Infinity Gates and Star Temples during the Pre-Republic era. The Infinity Gates were permanent structures capable of enabling instantaneous travel between interstellar locations and were housed within the Star Temples.

name: Kwazel Maw
summary: The Kwazel Maw was a large aquatic predator that was native to the swamps of the planet Rodia. During the Clone Wars, the Gungan Jar Jar Binks encountered one of these creatures while on a mission to Rodia, which he befriended and named "Bogey." Bogey helped Binks secure the Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray's capture by toppling his shuttle.

name: Kwi
summary: The Kwi were the degenerated descendants of the saurian Kwa—Dathomir's first sentient inhabitants.

name: Kyaddak
summary: Kyaddaks were massive Force-sensitive insectoid creatures native to the planet Christophsis. They had many saw-blade limbs that made a loud tak-tak-tak sound as they roamed through the Crystal forests, which served as their habitats. Kyaddaks also had multiple heads, each with many eyes. In 5 ABY, a group of kyaddak hunted a group of pilgrims who were returning kyber crystals back to where they came from.

name: Kybuck
summary: The kybuck was a creature that had spiral horns and brown fur. Kybucks were native to the planet Kashyyyk, and also inhabited the planet Shili, where they resided in its forests. In 35 BBY, the Togruta Pav-ti Tano took her daughter Ahsoka Tano on a hunt, which was a custom that took place a year after Tano's birth. During the hunt, Pav-ti tracked a small herd of kybucks, and successfully killed one of them. The Kybuck Clan, a Jedi Initiate Clan to which Obi-Wan Kenobi and Gehren Rand belonged, shared its name with the creature. Kybuck fur could be used to make clothes. Wolentic Dudge, a resident of Kijimi City, wore a vest lined with kybuck fur.

name: Ky'lessan
summary: The Ky'lessans were a reptilian sentient species with oily, scaly skin. They were active in the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War and spoke Basic with a lisp. Soon after the Battle of Yavin, the Ky'lessan known as Snake-Eyes, who was the assistant of Captain Scarlet Bloodhawk in her repair port, betrayed his boss for profit.

name: KyLessian fruit bat
summary: KyLessian fruit bats were carnivorous, nocturnal bats native to the planet KyLessia. Their name referred to their nesting in wulfruit trees; they did not eat fruit. The creatures were small, measuring 15-30 centimeters long, and were extremely lightweight. They possessed webbed wings and skin that grew feather-like scales. They were black in color, and their dark coloration extended even to the enamel on their fangs, which was a dark gray that approached black, making the creature nearly invisible at night. Their vision took in the infrared spectrum, allowing them to see in darkness; and they communicated using ultrasonic calls that exceeded the range of normal human hearing. While a single Kylessian fruit bat was unlikely to be a threat, large groups of them could be very dangerous. They hunted on cloudy nights devoid of starlight or light from any of the planet's three moons. They would land as a flock on a prey animal; their black coloration, quiet flight, and extremely light weight meant that the animal neither saw, heard, nor felt their arrival until all were settled in place. One observation saw 48 bats gathered on a single prey animal, nestled in groups along the creature's flanks. Once the entire flock of fruit bats had gathered, they would issue an ultrasonic signal that observing colonists were unable to detect, but that triggered the entire flock to simultaneously attack, burrowing into the creature's fur. The resulting wounds on the animal looked as though it had been savagely attacked by a much larger predator. The livestock of the colonists on KyLessia were frequent victims of the KyLessian fruit bat, and these livestock losses were originally thought to be the result of predation by bigger creatures. Infrared observations on cloudy nights demonstrated that the fruit bats were responsible. In addition to nesting in wulfruit trees, they often hid in caves and sheds during daylight hours. Nocturnal by nature, bats found in daylight were easy to subdue. Imperial governor Wilek Nereus of Bakura, a collector of the teeth of predatory creatures, included the fangs of KyLessian fruit bats in his collection.

name: Kynachi
summary: The Kynachi were the native species of the planet Kynachi in the Wild Space. The Kynachi were generally distinguished by their golden hair. Their golden hair was partially a result from their native diet, so those who were not raised on the planet of Kynachi did not share this particular trait. One example was the silver-haired, Coruscant-raised Jedi Master Ring-Sol Ambase. During the year 32 BBY the Trade Federation seized the world of the Kynachi under the force of the Skakoan Umbrag. In the year 22 BBY, the Kynachi were liberated from the Trade Federation occupation by the Galactic Republic Breakout Squad unit led by Padawan Nuru Kungurama.

name: Kyren
summary: Kyren were relatively small but lethal flying creatures native to the planet Ansion. Almost jet black with four membranous wings, two large at the front of the thorax and two smaller ones at the rear, the kyren would glide on the upper wings while being propelled by the rear ones. A bright yellow splotch decorated each wing, possibly as an aid for identification. The kyren were legless, and instead boasted a pair of thick, furry tufts that ran the length of its underside, like runners on a sled. Since they were airborne for most of their lives, the kyren had little need for legs. The kyren's mouth seemed large for its body size, a wide gape lined top and bottom with twin ridges of razor-sharp horn. Kryen used these ridges as airborne scythes, clipping the crests of ripened grain on the plains as they flew by. Thus, the field of grain was never flattened or destroyed, only shorn of their ripened seed, and left looking perfectly manicured. Kyren migrated from region to region according to the seasons, traveling in flocks that grew to 150 million, and upwards of as many as 200 million individuals, creating for land-dwellers a dark eclipse as they flew overhead. Kyren flocks did not move to avoid any objects in their way, whether unable or unwilling, and thus despite their herbivorous nature were highly dangerous to any creature that could not find proper cover to hide behind. They made a screeching noise, and reportedly smelled very bad. Though many hundreds died during migration, no one ate them because even after a kyren was cooked, it tasted "like boiled mud. All grease." In 22 BBY, while on a mission to settle a planetary border dispute and to convince all parties involved to resist all efforts at secession and to vote to remain within the Galactic Republic, a Jedi diplomatic team encountered a migrating swarm of kyren. The Jedi, their Alwari guides, and their suubatar mounts took cover behind native jijite columns until the blindly lethal (but also suicidal) avian swarm had passed.

name: Kyuzo
summary: Kyuzo were a sentient humanoid species native to the gravity-heavy Outer Rim world of Phatrong, where they evolved dense muscle fibers and fast reflexes.
