summary: Manjtoo were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Members included Scrapjaw Motito, a scavenger who worked on the planet Jakku, and Gapgrin Dozito, a prisoner on Selnesh.

name: Manka cat
summary: Manka cats were a non-sentient feline species native to the planets Tython and Alderaan. Fur-covered quadrupeds, manka cats were considered dangerous by most sentients who encountered them, and were often hunted for safety reasons as well as for food gathering. While hunted primarily for their meat, manka tusks and teeth were also prized for their medicinal use to cure illnesses. Carnivores with gnashing teeth and strong forelegs with sharp claws, the manka hunted in packs and alone, capable of bringing down nerfs and other large animals. [[File:MankaCatCub-SS.png|thumb|left|200px|A Jedi hermit holding a manka cat cub.]] Capable of domestication, manka cats were kept by the Flesh Raiders of Tython in their camps, gnawing on bones of past prey and aiding in the defense of their camps from local Jedi exploring the region during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. Manka cats saw some exportation during the history of the Galactic Republic to other worlds, including Kashyyyk and a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Therefore, when the hyperlanes to Tython collapsed and Alderaan was destroyed in 0 BBY, manka cats were still widespread in the galaxy, and knowledge and familiarity with them was quite commonplace.

name: Mannovan
summary: The Mannovans were a race of sardonic gray-furred beings native to the planet Mannova. They were seemingly unruffled by the ecological disaster their homeworld became.

name: Manollium
summary: The manollium or manullian was a species of avian that was native to the planet Ithor. Specimens were characterized by their yellow-feathered bodies. The birds were also found on Belsavis, having been brought there by the Brathflen Corporation.

name: Manta
summary: Felucian flying mantas were graceful creatures that appeared to swim through the air. They resembled the brith of the planet Dantooine but were smaller, with a thicker tail, multiple eyes, and shorter wing span.

name: Mantabog
summary: The mantabog was a creature native to the planet Malastare. They shared their name with the Mantabog Crevice Rally, a podracing course that had been set up by around 10 BBY. By around 9 ABY, the mantabog was extinct and was one of several creatures on display at the Holographic Museum of Extinct Animals on the planet Coruscant. Around that year, a cabbie droid driving Doctor Penn Pershing from the Galaxies Opera House to Amnesty Housing on Corsuscant advised the doctor, who was new to the world, to take a day trip to the museum, as the droid had found several of the creatures there fascinating. The droid began to tell Pershing about the mantabog, but was interrupted by their arrival at their destination.

name: Mantellian flutterplume
summary: Flutterplumes were feathered carrion eaters native to the planet of Ord Mantell that also had a sizable population on Alderaan. The enormous scavenger bird was noted for its impressive hook-like beak and four sets of curled talons that it used to tear apart and consume rotting carcasses. Its beautiful feathers were valued as good-luck charms. An abundant supply of fresh battlefield kills attracted flocks of these carrion eaters, and there were stories of wounded men unable to defend themselves being eaten by the hungry winged predators. Flutterplumes hunted in flocks of three or four, gliding on the thermal currents that blew across the Scraplands north of Worlport.

name: Mantellian Savrip
summary: Mantellian Savrips were a sentient, but technologically primitive, reptilian species from the planet Ord Mantell whose appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik. Large in size, they had gray skin and horned heads with red eyes, attached to their upper torsos by long necks partially covered in strands of orange hair. Mantellian Savrips had a pair of long, powerful arms that terminated in claw-tipped, four-fingered hands and two short legs with three-toed feet. Earning fame, Kalhar was a Mantellian Savrip who found work as a gladiator and brawler. By at least 11 ABY, a Mantellian Savrip gladiator was one of several creatures and gladiators belonging to species featured in dejarik that was unleashed upon the Mandalorian Din Djarin and Rotta the Hutt in the Pits on the moon Shakari.

name: Mantessan panthac
summary: A creature from the forest world of Mantessa, the Mantessan panthac was one of its most dangerous predators. The fierce pack animal was so deadly that several attempts to breed it offworld caused severe destruction to the native fauna of planets where it was raised. Nevertheless, panthacs were also smuggled out of Mantessa by slavers and hunters. Infamous Chevin slaver Phylus Mon kept a pack of Mantessan panthacs as a part of his personal security entourage. The Galactic Empire used the panthac as the base template for the creation of the genetically modified garral. A Galactic Alliance unit, the Orange Panthacs, were named after the animal. It also spawned the phrase "A panthac doesn't change its stripes". It's unclear whether this striped version of a panthac was a different species, sub-species, the product of the Imperials' experiments or simply just a point being made in the phrase's context.

name: Mantorr
summary: Mantorr was a non-sentient species native to the shadow world of Umbara. The species stood on two legs and had single sharp claws as front limbs. They had spikes along their back and a large horn atop their noses. Mantorrs spotted different colors and varied in size, from the small mantorin to individuals large enough to ride as mounts. The Commander and Lana Beniko killed several mantorrs during the events of the Crisis on Umbara.

name: Mantys
summary: The mantys was a species of flying insectoid native to Kubindi.

name: Maoi
summary: The Maoi were amorphous sapients indigenous to Kathol and were created by the ancient Kathol race. The DarkStryder considered them amoral and self-centered, and attempted to discard them in the Segmi tunnels after the Rift Disaster. Despite this, the Maoi survived and thrived in their underground environment. Like other Kathol servants, they developed an affinity with the Ta-Ree life energy and used it to hold their prey while they devoured it. They did this by forcing themselves through the mouth and into the body of the prey; where they would digest the prey from the inside out by eating the internal organs with powerful digestive acids.

name: Maramu
summary: Maramus were herbivorous furred creatures on the forest moon of Endor. They stood upright on powerful hoofed hindlegs and moved by hopping and jumping. They had forearms which also ended in hooves, prominent horns jutting from the sides of their heads, manes, and long tails. The Duloks and the carnivorous Raich used maramus as food.

name: Marasan
summary: The Marasans were sentients indigenous to Marasai, a planet deep within the Marasa Nebula. They were notable for their extensive use of cyborg implants.

name: Marcrow
summary: Marcrows were a type of bird with pink feathers that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. In 382 BBY, a marcrow feather fell into the compound of the Path of the Open Hand cult. As she made her way to the compound's central garden, the Evereni Path member Marda Ro picked up the feather, which she mentally described as "pretty." A short while later, Marda again made her way to the garden, this time with her cousin Yana Ro. As Marda saw a freighter fly across the sky, the whine of its engines scared a flock of marcrows, causing them to scatter.

name: Mariqar snow q'lk
summary: Mariqar snow q'lk were herbivores which resembled scaled-down banthas with white fur. They were native to the Jhunia Snow Plains on Neftali.

name: Marit
summary: Marits were a species of sentient beings brought by Human colonists to the world of Gaftikar, a forested planet with vast grassy plains. They were meter-tall reptilian humanoids. The Marits had light beige scales that were slightly iridescent. They had sharp muzzles and small black eyes with red slit-like pupils. The dominant members had very prominent red neck-frills. These dominant members were mostly female, as Marit society was matriarchal. When Humans settled Gaftikar, the Marits were hired and brought to the planet to build the cities and their infrastructure. The Marits were selected because of their natural abilities that made them brilliant engineers: excellent visiospatial awareness, superb mathematical skills, and an aversion to wastefulness. When construction of the cities were completed, the Humans expelled the Marits from the new populated areas of the planet, effectively exiling the Marits in the wilderness. The Galactic Republic would eventually intervene, assisting with a coup to overthrow the Human government. The Marits, natural engineers, impressed the commandos of Omega Squad when a group of them were able to rapidly assemble and transport the weapons given to them from the Republic, such as E-Web blasters, without poring over a manual. Marits were also able to disseminate information quickly throughout the populace. ARC N-11 discovered that the Marits were especially good at "cascading training." A'den Skirata would train ten Marits, they would train ten each, etc. until the information was shared with the entire force in a matter of hours. It was custom for Marits to recycle the bodies of dead family members by consuming them, usually in the form of cooked food, such as soup. This led to Clone commando Darman Skirata of Omega Squad advising his squadmates to remember to tell the Marits to not dig up and devour the bodies of two dead Covert Ops clone troopers that Darman had killed in self-defense.

name: Markul
summary: The Markul were a species of sentient aliens. In Melvosh Bloor's opinion, they did not resemble Kowakian monkey-lizards. Darian Gli was a Markul.

name: Marlello
summary: The marlello duck was a waterfowl native to the planet Lowick. Its large eggs were a delicacy to the Pa'lowick, whose long snouts were perfectly adapted to eating marlello eggs, which they punctured with their tongues to suck the yolk through their tube-like mouths. Marlello eggs could also be consumed by Humans, and could be bought in grocery stores on Coruscant. Freighter pilot Nyreen Vollen once delivered stocks of marlello eggs to Clan Skirata's home on Kyrimorut on the planet Mandalore.

name: Marmaw
summary: Marmaw were reptilian marine predators native to a tropical world in the Almar system. The marmaw was a huge-mouthed shore dweller, with teeth that formed in 20 to 30 bud rows throughout its mouth and throat and developed as they migrated toward the edge of its mouth. Outer marmaw teeth were frequently lost, and were quickly replaced by teeth growing in behind them. The blade-shaped final teeth were large enough to grasp its prey, which included land and sea creatures. Marmaws had both lungs and gills, although they had to spend at least three hours per day in water to avoid dehydration.

name: Marrovian pig
summary: Marrovian pigs were a type of pigs species that were native to the planet Marrovia. They were fed in giant farms before being processed in planet's rendering stations.

name: Marsh crane
summary: A marsh crane was a type of crane. In 3 BBY, during a pathfinding class on the planet Alderaan, Princess Leia Organa met the girl Amilyn Holdo and was reminded of a marsh crane by her thinness and gawkiness. Later, during another session of the class on the world Pamarthe, Holdo tilted her head and Organa was reminded of a marsh crane spotting food.

name: Marsh-gunny
summary: The marsh-gunnies were small creatures native to Nim Drovis, a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They occupied the bayous, swamps, and marshes of Nim Drovis. In 13 ABY, when the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 arrived on the planet along with the starship captain Bortrek, their landing pad was surrounded by swamps filled with marsh-gunnies, gulpers and green-eyed wadie-platts.

name: Marsh haunt
summary: A marsh haunt was a Force-using red-eyed creature.

name: Marsh pig
summary: Marsh pigs were a type of pig species that were native to the swamps of the planet Corellia.

name: Marsh pony
summary: Marsh ponies were a type of pony that had a vegetarian diet. In 228 BBY, while unloading supplies on the Republic Defense Coalition mobile launch and repair station, the pilot Jordanna Sparkburn thought about how her girlfriend Sylvestri Yarrow wanted to one day buy land on a prairie moon where she could herd marsh ponies. Sparkburn also mentally noted that her vollka Remy loved herding vegetarians.

name: Marsh spider
summary: Marsh spiders were a type of spider that could be found stalking the swamps of the planet Dagobah.

name: Marsh Wyrm
summary: Marsh Wyrm were large serpentine creatures from the planet Gelgelar. They were also referred to as the "Great Gelgelar Monsters".

name: Marsune
summary: The marsune was a species of long-extinct behemoth that lived underwater on the Mid Rim planet Naboo. Marsune was also used as a surname among the Gungan species on Naboo.

name: Martigrade
summary: Martigrades were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were very large beings with heads roughly the size of the average adult human's torso. According to Casca Panzoro, they were persecuted by the Galactic Empire.

name: Maru
summary: Maru were agile reptiles native to the forest moon Alaris Prime in the Kashyyyk system. They had muscular hind legs and a long tail, though their forearms were vestigial. The Wookiee inhabitants of Alaris Prime used the beasts as war mounts, equipping the maru with special saddles, dual bowcasters, and a seismic pulse emitter.

name: Massassi
summary: The Massassi were a species who lived on Yavin 4, the fourth moon of Yavin Prime. Thousands of years before the Imperial Era, they built enormous stone temples on the moon for unknown purposes. It was believed that the Massassi may have been a slave race in thrall to the Sith, who brought them to the moon. The Massassi went extinct millennia before 0 ABY, sometime after finishing their temples.

name: Massassi tree
summary: Massassi trees were purple-barked trees native to Yavin 4. The trees featured huge crowns and upsweeping branches and were capable of reaching 200 meters in height. Nebula orchids and ferns climbed on them. The thick mulch from their bark and leaves nourished blueleaf shrubs. The tree received its name because it was the most common species around the Massassi temple ruins.
distinctions: Wide crown, upsweeping branches, purplish-brown shedding bark

name: Massiff
summary: The massiff was a reptilian species of dangerous hunters found on desert planets including Tatooine and Geonosis. Massiffs were domesticated for sentry and guard tasks, and were used by the Tusken Raiders of Tatooine.

name: Mastiff phalone
summary: Mastiff phalones were a non-sentient species of avian quadrupeds that were native to the savannas of Maridun. As carnivores, they were dangerous predators.

name: Mastmot
summary: Mastmots were a species of massive, furry, and friendly beasts of burden native to the frozen world of Toola. They had tusks which were prized for use in necklaces.

name: Maungur
summary: Maungurs were predatory beasts that were only known from Rishii legends. They were said to inhabit the extreme polar regions of the otherwise mostly-warm planet Rishi — and within that region, they stuck to the warmer valleys, avoiding the highlands where the Rishii people lived. Only in the warm season would they venture to the higher altitudes. However, for unknown reasons, the maungurs avoided wandering into the more temperate latitudes of the planet. The maungurs walked bipedally and stood at three meters tall, but instead of paws or hands, their forarms ended with whips of strong, flexible cartilage, called kithaji or limb-tails. The Rishii said that one hit from a kithaj could eviscerate a being, indicating that they must have ended with tiny claws or sharp hooks. Their skin was thick and brown or black. Their lower arms and legs had tufts of red hair, and black spikes dotted their spines. Their mouths ended in a sharp, grey beak. Their main food was the herbivorous khi'r. The Rishii both feared and revered the maungurs: the name of the species signified "a spirit of violent, senseless conflict that can't be reasoned with." Maungurs were relentless hunters, and once they had prey in sight could stalk it for days or weeks. When the Rishii feared a maungur attack, they would abandon their home nests rather than risk a direct confrontation. Yet the Rishii also considered the maungurs holy. They avoided speaking about them directly, and to kill one would be a grave offense. Some non-Rishii colonists settled in valleys known to be the haunts of maungurs. Some of these colonies reported nighttime attacks, but they all were able to drive the attackers off; this might contradict the Rishii legends about the creatures' tenacity.

name: Mawan
summary: The Mawan were a species of humanoids from the planet Mawan. They had pale skin, two hearts, and blue blood vessels close to the surface of the skin. It was considered a mark of refinement for a Mawan's veins to show through the skin. The Mawan gesture of friendship and welcome was to give a brief nod, then to hold out the hand, palm out, while offering a verbal salutation or greeting.

name: Mawgax
summary: The Mawgax was a large bipedal herbivore that lived in the forests of Yavin 4. It used its sharp beak to defend itself.

name: Maxilan's explosive bloatworm
summary: Maxilan's explosive bloatworm was a type of parasitic worm native to Lanteeb in the Outer Rim. They could infest the domesticated happabore species, which was found on planets throughout the Western Reaches. The slurry formulation of Galacti-Stok's Happy-Bore Medicated Dewormer—a product containing Trestibinexocycline 5-Gamma, thlank oil, greel-root acid, and forage products—came with instructions that recommended against infestations of the bloatworm. The scavenger Rey discovered a copy of the dewormer's instructions while living on the desert planet Jakku and included it in a survival guide that she had compiled by 34 ABY.

name: Mayflii
summary: The mayflii was a two-meter long, green insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. They laid eggs in the swamp.

name: Maz Kanata's species
summary: A sentient species existed in the galaxy. The Force-sensitive being Maz Kanata and an assassin were both members of the species.

name: Meadow-prowler
summary: The meadow-prowler was a creature. Jannah, the leader of Company 77, a group of First Order stormtrooper defectors, wore a custom tunic made from meadow-prowler hide while living on the ocean moon Kef Bir.

name: Mear
summary: Mears were six-legged hooved mammals native to Gacerian. They had sizable horns and a body length of about 2.5 meters. Their multiple limbs allowed them to climb well in the mountains, where they ate what few plants they could find.

name: Medoslean
summary: Medosleans were a sentient species from the Medoslea system which resembled large jellyfish. Shortly after arriving on the Starlight Beacon, Administrator Velko Jahen saw one Medoslean, spread over two cots, being administered drugs by Doctor Gino'le, the Chief of Medical Operations. The patient had an adverse reaction to the treatment, choking the nurse Okana with her fronds, but Jahen was able to stabilize her by injecting a booster.

name: Meduza
summary: The Meduza were a non-sentient, apparently exotic species. Although they were not sentient, they were able to be trained, to some extent, as guardians. They could heed simple commands and recognize their name, but not too much more than that. Meduza appeared to be fairly large green jelly-like blobs. They could slither along fairly quickly to capture prey. They had the ability to produce electricity in their bodies and carry it in their various bulb-headed stalks that protruded from their bodies. When they touched a creature with the bulb, the electric shock was enough to kill a Human. They then engulfed the body whole, leaving behind nothing but a wet stain. Doctor Cornelius Evazan was known to have had a pet Meduza, Rover.

name: Mee
summary: The Mee, also called the mee fish, were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by the large colo claw fish and opee sea killers that dwelt there. Like most other scalefish, they were hebivorous, but could pose a danger because of their poisonous spine. The mee fish could also be found on the Outer Rim planet Koboh and on Sakavi Tar, where they had a different temperament. The mee on Koboh were deceptive fish that were daring predators. These fish used their hundreds of small, razor-like teeth to tear apart the small fish they consumed. This presented an additional danger to sentient beings, since the mee would often draw blood with their teeth. In 9 BBY, Sakavian fisherman Skoova Stev caught a mee fish in Prospector's Folly on Koboh, which he subsequently put in the aquarium in the nearby Pyloon's Saloon.

name: Meek
summary: Meeks were a primitive sentient species, with three eyes. A village of Meeks was afraid that a rancor would eat them.

name: Meerian
summary: The Meerians were a sentient species. They could have silver skin and gold hair. One Meerian, Yeet, was a member of the Nihil.

name: Meetle
summary: Meetles were arthropods known to inhabit the sewer systems of the Meatlump Hideout beneath the streets of the city Coronet on Corellia. Although they closely resembled kreetles in appearance, Chef Schlump referred to the meetles as rodents. The Meatlump Gang was known to stomp on the meetles and worrmps infesting their hideout, and use their juices to create Meatlump wine, a preferred drink of the Meatlump King.

name: Meftian
summary: Meftians were a fur-covered sentient humanoid species that had long black and white fur. They were also slightly reminiscent of the Wookiees. Kullbee Sperado, a member of this species, was a gunslinger and a member of the Partisans.

name: Megalliform
summary: Megalliforms were a type of giant, tough-skinned bird found in the galaxy. When the chef Strono Tuggs challenged the Nu-Cosian Bobbajo to bring exotic ingredients to cook, Bobbajo returned with a megalliform, which Tuggs had to wrestle into submission.

name: Megarian bog-worm
summary: The Megarian bog-worm was a type of worm that existed in the galaxy. The Chiss Fraulda Rynn owned a pet Megarian bog-worm named Skoogia.

name: Mekle
summary: The mekle was a predatory flying creature native to the jungle planet Minfar. They had two sets of wings, and were large enough to pick up and carry away a human. Mekle had an aversion to bright light, and as such would not attack an individual wearing a reflective suit.

name: Melbu
summary: The Melbu were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their respirator horns, which were connected to a breathing mask worn on the mouth and their bright orange eyes. Auromae Iselo, a member of the Cloud-Riders, was a Melbu.
distinctions: Respirator horns connected to breathing mask

name: Melitto
summary: Melitto were a species of insectile humanoids native to the planet Li-Toran. They had no eyes or mouth, but were capable of sensing their environment using super-sensitive cilia. Melitto had chitin plates on their heads and forearms, and required the use of cybernetic breathing tubes when operating in alien atmospheres.

name: Mellcrawler
summary: Mellcrawlers were native to Sullust, a volcanic planet in the Outer Rim Territories. They gave off a noxious smell, which worsened when one of the creatures died By the year 20 BBY, the Sullustan reporter Den Dhur was familiar with the smell of a mellcrawler that had been dead for a week. During that year, while in the cantina of Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7 on the planet Drongar, Dhur was reminded of the odor of a mellcrawler that had been dead for a week after smelling the Tyrusian red ale being imbibed by his table companion, an Ugnaught named Rorand Zuzz. The Sullustan reporter remembered finding the smell of a dead mellcrawler to be quite unpleasant.

name: Melodie
summary: Melodies were a humanoid water-based species native to Yavin 8. The species lived deep within the purple mountains of their homeworld, most notably Sistra Mountain.
distinctions: Grow mermaid tails when 20 years old

name: Melter
summary: Melters was the name given to the energy based beings that lived in the meltmassif of the Taspan system. They were given this name because they "melted" out of the meltmassif at will, they used the meltmassif for their physical form. The melters could produce an energy discharge that had an effect much like a stun blast. Originally they lived in the crust of Taspan II. The Big Crush was initially of great benefit to them, as they fed on stellar radiation and stayed in communion despite being physically scattered. However, many pieces of meltmassif fell to the world of Mindor. Some died as their meltmassif burned up in the atmosphere. Those which survived suffered in slow asphyxiation, as the vaporized meltmassif screened Taspan's rays. Cronal used captive melters to reprogram and enslave his Pawns, making them form crystalline "shadow webs" that ran alongside each Pawn's nervous system. With the Shadow Crown, a meltmassif construction, he was able to control them and, through them, control meltmassif. Melters on Mindor also acted as a kind of unwitting security force. When they encountered organic beings such as Aeona Cantor's group, they caused vaguely Humanoid legless shapes to rise out of the meltmassif, stun the organics, and half-encase them in meltmassif in locations Cantor referred to as "Melter crypts". Melters had minds and sensory experiences totally unlike those of most other sentient beings, although they did have analogues to curiosity and puzzlement. Their minds were so alien that Cronal felt that they supported his theory of the Way of the Dark. Luke Skywalker, known for a Force-given ability to communicate with nearly anything, even mineral-based sentients like the Tsils, had great difficulty trying to connect with them. He was unable to determine if they were one being made out of many pieces, or a number of individuals, referring to them once as a culture/mind. Human nervous systems produced energy in the general wavelength of melters, drawing them, and they had no conception of the fact that by entombing captives they were killing them. At the end of the Battle of Mindor, Luke Skywalker acted through the Shadow Crown and liberated the Melters by "feeding" them with the light of the Force. "Never again would they feed upon light; there would never be the need. They would forever shine with light of their own." This had the additional effects of causing the meltmassif they were in to become liquid and pour out of the bodies they had been inserted into, and killing all of the stormtroopers controlled by meltmassif.

name: Meltfox
summary: The Meltfox was a creature native to the planet Lowick.

name: Membibi
summary: A membibi was a non-sentient four-legged insectivore native to the rocky outcroppings on the planet of Ansion. Membibis had a low-slung snout protruding from the face with a splotchy pale white body, which ended in a long whip-like tail. In 22 BBY, Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and her apprentice, Barriss Offee, and Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his apprentice Anakin Skywalker, encountered membibis while on a mission to the planet Ansion. One of the membibi, while running upwind from its den to a burrow, was attacked by a carnivorous-poisonous chawix plant that was carried by the wind onto the membibi's back. The chawix used the nerve poison in its thorns to incapacitate and kill the membibi. One of the Jedi's Alwari guides wished the same fate (but expanding the number of attacking chawix to twelve, to accommodate size) for his former employer, Soergg the Hutt.

name: Memory moth
summary: The memory moth was a type of moth native to the Mid Rim planet New Holstice. When released, they held a single name that they whispered back. They were also considered immortal. Memory moths were then released into a giant cylinder where thousands more were held, each one commemorating every Jedi that ever died. Anakin Skywalker used these after the Battle of Jabiim for the deaths of his Padawan friends, the Padawan Pack. Glowing insects strongly resembling memory moths appeared on Ossus in 137 ABY when Wolf Sazen, K'Kruhk and Shado Vao were meditating in a garden.

name: Menahuun
summary: The Menahuun, unofficially known as "little buggers" and sometimes believed to be gremlins, were a furry anthropomorphic lemuroid species from the planet Lamaredd —known as "Great Menahua" in their native Menahu language—. These arboreal mammals initially had a peaceful culture of hunters-gatherers but, in later times, they changed to become more competitive and aggressive.

name: Mennis Duren's species
summary: A sentient species had yellow skin, gray hair, and orange eyes. Mennis Duren was a member of this species, who was present on the Ring of Kafrene trading outpost in 1 BBY.

name: Mephitisian
summary: The Mephitisians were a four-armed sentient species from the planet Mephitis. Their homeworld had a noxious atmosphere, and as a consequence, the species had evolved adaptations to limit exposure to these gases, such as lids over their eyes and the lack of a nose. The Mephitisian Mosh Pelkan gained prominence on the planet Questal as a Turf Boss—a criminal leader with quasi-official authority. He hosted a celebration for the birthday of local Imperial Moff Bandor, which was infiltrated by Rebel Alliance agents.

name: Mephout
summary: The Mephout was a sentient species originating in the Wild Space Mephout system. In the Mephout society, all diplomatic duties were handled by the females of the species. The RST Model Translator Droids, humanoid automatons designed in the image of female Mephout, handled nearly all translating duties throughout the sector known as the Mephout Dominion until its discovery by the Galactic Empire.

name: Merdeth
summary: Merdeths were a type of huge insectoid that dominated the barren exterior of their homeworld, the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. Omnivores, they would eat any organic matter they came across, using eight powerful tentacles to pull prey into their mouths. The enormous merdeths formed a symbiotic relationship with swarms of tiny, parasitic mips that fed on ichor found between the merdeth's carapace. In 22 BBY, small hangars that dotted the perimeter of the Geonosian Stalgasin hive's droid loading fields were equipped with Geonosian fighters that were ready to make lightning strikes against the occasional marauding merdeth. The merdeth's homeworld was sterilized by the Galactic Empire around 9 BBY.

name: Merdoc
summary: A merdoc was a subterranean predatory lizard that lived on Ahakista. It was smaller than a telcar.

name: Mere
summary: The Mere were sentient humanoids that hailed from the aquatic planet of Maramere. They had orange fur covering their bodies, and could breathe underwater. They had both noses and gills.

name: Merek
summary: Mereks were strange half-arachnid, half-monkey creatures native to the Forest Moon of Endor. They were loners and not particularly aggressive in the wild.

name: Meri
summary: The Meris were a tall humanoid race with dark blue skin, similar to the Teltiors, with whom they shared the planet Merisee. Distinguishing features included a strongly-pronounced eyebrow ridge, a slightly conical ridge on the top of their head, webbed hands with an opposable thumb and finger, inward-spiraling cartilage in the ear, and several thick folds of skin around the neck. Some Meris were associated with the Cult of Those Who Redeem, though others were part of the Loag cult of assassins.

name: Merqaal
summary: Merqaals were a rare species of small, quadrupedal manidae exhibiting a high level of intelligence. Their bodies were covered in both fur and scales, with pink exposed skin at the end of their tails and on their paws. Their heads bore three sets of articulate feelers that allowed them to sense their environment for danger or items of interest. The scales were blue-grey and covered their back and the tops of their head, tail, and top set of feelers. Their belly, face, legs, and feelers were covered in fur that varied in color from brown and dark red at the base of their tail and feelers, to light tan on their belly and face. Their "sticky" paws combined with their strong tail allowed them to traverse vertical environments and difficult terrain. This, combined with their small size and agility meant they could explore tight spaces with ease. They were prized by collectors as exotic pets, notably catching the eyes of the Sixth Kin crime syndicate and later Jabba the Hutt, who added a member of the species, Nix, to the menagerie at his palace. The merqaal Nix accompanied the outlaw Kay Vess after she freed him from the Sixth Kin in Canto Bight.
distinctions: Large eyes{{UbisoftYouTube|ojXzNi1JFlA|Ubisoft Forward: Official Livestream – June 2023 &

name: Mesa groat
summary: The mesa groat was a sure-footed, golden-horned herbivore native to the highlands of Teyr.

name: Metagosan
summary: The Metagosan were a reptilian sentient species. Possessing dense musculature, they were similar to the Trandoshans. The species had a typical sibilant hiss when speaking. One Metagosan was Vin-Vin Sunfall, the bartender of Vin-Vin's Wheelhouse in the city New Xaxxis on the Outer Rim planet Metagos.

name: Metal-eater
summary: Metal-eaters were a type of creature native to the planet Ylagia where they fed upon the jagged spears of the world's iron jungles. By the first year of the Empire's reign after its formation in 19 BBY, metal-eaters were nearly gone from Ylagia, allowing the jungles to grow wild and cover much of the world's eastern continent. However, enough remained to keep the jungles away from Ylagia's city fortresses and preserve the towers that rose from its mountains and spiral roads.

name: Metarshi
summary: Metarshi were herbivorous herd animals from Alk'Lellish III. They were hunted by the four-fanged predator known as the ketrann.

name: Methnap
summary: Growing twelve to fifteen meters in length, methnaps were used as mounts by the seagoing ranchers of Chad. They were akin to tsaelke and cy'een. They could carry up to 125 kilograms.

name: Mewvorr
summary: Mewvorr were a diminutive, domesticated, version of the larger predatory mawvorr. Mewvorrs were often kept as pets during the time of the Galactic War, and their popularity was such that many different breeds existed. Some owners also took to selling cybernetically enhanced versions as well. Known breeds included aquatic, flameshell, goldplate, heatglow, prismatic, and woodland, whilst cyborg breeds included cyberlamp, cyberglow, and cyberlight.

name: Midi-chlorian
summary: Midi-chlorians were microscopic, intelligent life forms that originated from the foundation of life in the center of the galaxy and ultimately resided within the cells of all living organisms, thereby forming a symbiotic relationship with their hosts. The Force spoke through the midi-chlorians, allowing certain beings to use the Force if they were sensitive enough to its powers. In order to gauge an individual's potential in the Force, blood tests were used to estimate the number of midi-chlorians within the subject's cells, known as an M-count. Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One, possessed the highest known count in galactic history—over twenty-thousand midi-chlorians—surpassing the potential of Grand Master Yoda and all Jedi. According to the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, his Sith Master Darth Plagueis could influence the midi-chlorians to create life. In the New Republic Era, Imperial scientist Doctor Penn Pershing experimented with blood samples that he harvested from Grogu, a Force-sensitive youngling with a high midi-chlorian count.

name: Mikan
summary: The Mikans were a sentient species native to the asteroid Mika, also known as Jellyfish Cove. They took the form of beautiful near-Human women; however, once they had attracted someone to them, they turned into huge jellyfish-like creatures and consumed their targets. They could only come out in night or on foggy days, as when the sun came out, the natural light reacted with their tissue and froze them into statue-like rocks. Bara was a Mikan. Like the Felacatians, the Mikans only had the ability to alternate between two distinct physiologies. Practiced Mikans could switch between the two forms at will.

name: Mikkian
summary: Mikkians were a humanoid species that were native to the planet Mikkia, identifiable by their manes of head-tendrils and their bright skin pigmentation. The twin sisters Tiplar and Tiplee, who fought and died in the Clone Wars as Jedi Masters, were Mikkians. Another member of the species, a female named Sakas, fought with the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Galactic Civil War.

name: Mikoan
summary: The Mikoans were a sentient species native to Miko. They were humanoid, and appeared Human, bar their green skin pigmentation. The Mikoans resisted the Galactic Empire until their homeworld was bombarded by Moff Delurin from aboard the prototype Dragon-class heavy cruiser. That overwhelming show of force compelled them to surrender. However, they were saved when Delurin abandoned the star system to establish his own splinter faction of the Empire, as the "Warlord of Wild Space." The Mikoans were again attacked by Delurin just as they were about to join the New Republic. A notable Mikoan was Jade, a mercenary who did some work for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She played a role in ensuring that the Alliance received intelligence that alerted them to the presence of the Galactic Emperor aboard the Death Star II at the time of the Battle of Endor.

name: Millipod
summary: Millipods were a species of giant insect native to the planet Kubindi. The insects' shells were fire-red in color and they dwelt in the swamps of their homeworld, where they were raised as a food source by the indigenous sentient Kubaz species. When the bounty hunter Dengar traveled to Kubindi in the year 0 ABY, he saw millipods wallowing in a bog as he flew above the surface of the planet in his JumpMaster 5000 starship, Punishing One.

name: Millitile
summary: The millitile was a long, serpentine creature from Kothlis that migrated among gankto trees. They climbed the tree's upper bare branches to eat symbiospore spores found there, then moved on. It had a flat head, most of which was a large round mouth full of blunt teeth. Its body was carried by hundreds of tiny legs, that offered its slithering motion. They could run, but only for short time. While migrating between trees, they would fall prey to the myntors and Hawk-bats. The legs which were considered a delicacy by Bothans, often served with tangy fuirt sauce, and reached high prices in food markets for hunters. When a millitile bit a larger creature, the spore residue in its mouth sometimes acted as a mild poison to the victim.

name: Milodon
summary: Milodons were non-sentient, centipede-like insects native to the caves of the planet Quarzite, where they were used as mounts by the indigenous Kage. They could also be found on Hissrich, where one attacked Jedi Masters Kit Fisto and Prosset Dibs during the Clone Wars. Later, the Kage Warriors used milodons during their rescue of Pluma Sodi.
skinColor: Mottled purple and brown or green

name: Mimbanese
summary: The Mimbanese were one of several sentient species native to the planet Mimban. Experts in guerrilla warfare, the Mimbanese had the unsettling ability to seemingly disappear into the mud and murk of their homeworld.

name: Mimbanite
summary: Mimbanites were one of the native races of the planet Mimban.

name: Mimph
summary: Mimphs were small, semi-sentient creatures native to the Forest Moon of Endor. Although not fully sentient, mimphs were intelligent, and they were able to comprehend and use language to communicate with fully sentient beings like Ewoks. They were also able to manipulate tools and build villages, and teams of mimphs could even capture much larger prey. In 3 ABY, a group of mimphs from a community near Bright Tree Village captured the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick and put him on display in their village. When a monstrous hanadak rampaged through the village, Warrick defeated the beast and saved the village residents. Later, when Endor was covered in snow and ice by the Snow King, the village was buried, and the mimphs had to use shovels to remove the massive amounts of snow until the Snow King was defeated.
distinctions: Small stature; long ears and whiskers

name: Mind eel
summary: A mind eel was a species of eel native to the West Fissure, an agricultural region on a planet situated near the moon Raspar-6, in the Raspar star system, located in the Tragan Cluster within the Outer Rim Territories. Mind eels thrived and were excited when solar flares hit the planet's surface. Weather forecasts recommended the watching of mind eels and their offspring during such stellar flares, which one time occurred during the months of Neevlit and Dha in that world's calendar. These creatures did not heed the crop boundaries set in The Relevant Farm Act of Thairwsthis 12.

name: Mind-witch
summary: Mind-witches were a humanoid vampire-like species who used Force illusions to fool their victims. They had intense psychic abilities that they could augment with unique stone columns. These unique near-Humans possessed potent mental abilities which they would use to probe the minds of other beings and see their desires. Once this was done, they developed a relationship with the individual at which point they developed a psychic link with the person. Through this link, they would create illusory environments which were highly desirable to the individual. This was done with only one purpose in mind: to leech the mental life energies of the person to replenish their own. Though they were usually powerful telepaths, some well skilled mind-witches also developed telekinetic powers. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, mind-witches were all but extinct. They were present in many tales around the galaxy, but their existence was thought to be a myth. The last known mind-witch was S'ybll, who tried to seduce Luke Skywalker. However, he was able to break through her illusions and escape. S'ybll died when Luke drew his lightsaber to him and accidentally stabbed her.
distinctions: Ability to leach a victim's mental and life energies to replenish their own

name: Mine crab
summary: Mine crabs were small but dangerous scavengers who lived within the subterranean levels of Artus Prime. They did not resemble crabs in the traditional sense, though they scuttled about on three crablike legs. Instead of pincers, mine crabs possessed large mouths lined with sharp teeth. They had red and purple eyes. Because of their small size, mine crabs worked together to bring down larger prey, such as Humans. They were not very strong individually, but greatly made up for this in number. Kyle Katarn experienced this firsthand when he was on Artus Prime on a mission for Mon Mothma. He would also later witness a pit fight between two of these creatures in Baruk's Bar on Nar Shaddaa.

name: Mine rat
summary: Mine rats were subterranean creatures from the Forest Moon of Endor. During the Galactic Civil War, a pack of mine rats lived in the underground tunnels of the Death Watch bunker.

name: Miner's horror
summary: The miner's horror was a ancient large, space-borne creature of mysterious origins found only in space. Often over twenty meters in size, they were vaguely fish-shaped, with large dorsal spines and a set of large, saw-like teeth. They fed on asteroids, which they chewed into dust and slowly digested and refined into the pure metals and minerals which nourished them. Over decades, a miner's horror could eat entire asteroid belts. As they were constantly hungry, they were a significant hazard to inhabited asteroids, space stations, and spacecraft, which they would devour for their metallic content. Luckily for most spacers, miner's horrors were fairly easy to outrun. If they could not be outrun, however, they were difficult to destroy. All the same, mining companies sometimes sponsored hunting expeditions in order to recover refined ore from a horror's body. It was uncertain where the miner's horrors originated, with the first recorded miner's horror was encountered by a group of pirates in the galactic fringes circa 5000 BBY. Their reports were not believed, until the remains of a starship attacked by one of the beasts was discovered. Two armed freighters went after the creature, with only one returning intact. Since then, rare sightings of miner's horrors continued, though the most sightings in the Imperial Period were in the relatively remote Tion Cluster. These were all sightings of lone creatures, save one sighting of three horrors eating the wreckage of a recent battle. Some believed that the miner's horrors were part of a very slow-moving invasion force, and that larger miner's horrors than the freighter-sized creatures encountered to date were on the way.

name: Ming Po
summary: The Ming Po were a group of humans native to the Outer Rim planet Carlac.

name: Minstyngar
summary: Minstyngar were animals that lived in packs on Kashyyyk. A massive simian creature, the minstyngar haunted the lower levels of the Rryatt Trail. The minstyngar had a rudimentary social structure. Although many adult minstyngar could be found roaming the Rryatt Trail, the elders and younglings were often hidden deep in the forest, far from prying eyes. Their skin was either a shade of green or brown.

name: Minyavish
summary: The Minyavish were a sentient species native to the planet Qaras. For seven thousand years they saw themselves as managers of the planet with native Jessar species as their servants. In 44 ABY, the Minyavish were revolted against by the enslaved Jessar. The Jessar then forced the Minyavish to leave the planet.

name: Miow Joon's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Mip
summary: Mips were minute parasitic creatures found on the arid planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. They traveled in swarms and formed a symbiotic relationship with the enormous merdeths that dominated Geonosis's barren exterior. Mips fed on the ichor found on their own bodies and between the carpace of the merdeths. The Galactic Empire sterilized Geonosis around 9 BBY.

name: Miraluka
summary: The Miraluka were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had tanned brown skin, gray or white hair, and did not possess eyes. One Miraluka was Prosset Dibs, a member of the Jedi Order who went on a mission to the planet Hissrich with the Jedi Master Mace Windu and two other Jedi. He turned against his comrades after discovering what he perceived as the Jedi Council's intentions to exploit Hissrich. Following the fall of the Jedi Order, Dibs was a part of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, taking the name Tenth Brother. The Tenth Brother traveled to the planet Mon Cala with Darth Vader and two other Inquisitors to hunt a surviving Jedi. He was killed when the Jedi at hand turned his Purge Troopers against him. The historian Tohan Lege was also a Miraluka, just like the legendary hunter Diago Velaar.

name: Mirialan
summary: Mirialans were a long-lived, near-human species native to the planet Mirial. They had skin tones ranging from green to yellow or pink to purple. Most had traditional geometric tattoos on their faces which symbolized personal achievements. The species had a strong connection with the natural world and typically believed in the Force. Mirialans included several members of the Jedi Order, including Jedi Masters Luminara Unduli, Cyslin Myr, Katri, and Vernestra Rwoh, the former Padawan Barriss Offee, and the Seventh Sister, both of whom were fallen Jedi who hunted Great Jedi Purge survivors as a member of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius.

name: Miridon
summary: The miridon sea monster was a large, green reptilian beast native to the oceans of Tarnoonga. It would frequently nest and swim about the various undersea mountain tops that broke the ocean's surface. In 15 BBY, the pirate Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha used one of the mountain peaks as a base of operations. One of his favorite hobbies included forcing prisoners to walk the planks of his desert skiffs and watching them drop down into the sea–a snack for the miridon. Kybo believed that he had domesticated the creature and that it would actually respond to his commands, but this was merely a delusion of grandeur on Kybo's part. On one such occasion, Kybo's men cast Jann Tosh and the droids, C-3PO and R2-D2, into the ocean depths in the hopes of watching them get devoured by the miridon. Thanks to R2's dome propeller extension however, they were able to avoid being eaten, and successfully trapped the animal inside the remains of a sunken freighter. The miridon eventually escaped from this trap and returned to Captain Kybo's pirate cove in search of more morsels of food–the two-legged kind.

name: Mishalope
summary: The mishalope was species of striped, furry mammal indigenous to Firrerre.

name: Mistfly
summary: The Mistfly was a type of creature native to the planet Neimoidia.

name: Mizi
summary: The Mizi were a sentient species with long limbs, a long nose, and a lower susceptibility to radiation than most other species. As a result, Mizi often transported cargo that other species were unable to. The Mizi also preferred to remain nameless to strangers and additionally had a rivalry with the Orincans, another species from the same area of the galaxy. A number of Mizi were stranded on an abandoned space station when hyperspace travel throughout the frontier of the Galactic Republic was closed in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster. The Mizi were one of the parties who initially attempted to loot the station, additionally coming into conflict with a group of Orincans who were similarly stranded. Along with the other groups who refused to cooperate, the Mizi were eventually convinced to share their resources by the crew and passengers of the transport Vessel. After several days aboard the station, limited hyperspace travel was permitted, and the Mizi and Orincans celebrated together before leaving the station.

name: Mizx
summary: The Mizx was a species of sentient humanoids that was indigenous to the swamp world of Randorn Two. Mizx were occasionally preyed upon by a native predator, the ibliton. Unable to defend themselves from the creature with their primitive weapons, the Mizx developed myths explaining the creature's origin: it was believed to be an avatar of Hershoon the Destroyer, fashioned from his demented soul through the operation of magick. The Mizx performed cleansing funeral rites on those individuals killed by ibliton attacks, believing that prevented souls reincarnating as ibliton. The Mizx had contact with the galaxy, in particular with researchers that visited Randorn Two to study the ibliton. Researchers from both the Galactic History Foundation and the Tyberious Institute of Xenobiology took an interest in the ibliton's origins.

name: Mluki
summary: The Mlukis were a sentient primate species indigenous to Belsavis. They grew to adolescence at the age of seven and were considered old at the age of thirty. Jevax was a Mluki.

name: Mmhmm butterfly
summary: The mmhmm butterfly was an insect native to the jungles of the planet Baskarn. They sometimes covered every tree and bush in sight in the jungle. The mmhmm butterflies served as a food source for the native Yrashu people and could be picked like ripe fruit. The body of the insect was poisonous, but its wings were considered sweet.

name: Moappa
summary: The Moappa were one of the intelligent deep-sea species living in the oceans of Mon Calamari. Telepathic, they formed a sentient group intelligence from the nearly mindless individuals. There were millions of these small glowing creatures in the worldwide ocean of Mon Calamari; although individually appearing harmless at first sight, when threatened Moappa could combine into large groups, forming a gigantic group organism to defend themselves. If one Moappa in this group consciousness died, it would be replaced by others. Jedi Master Kit Fisto fought with a group of Moappa during the first months of the Clone Wars, when they aided the Quarren Isolation League during the Battle of Mon Calamari. Angry at the arrogance of the Mon Calamari in claiming the world as their own, the Moappa aided the Quarren even after Fisto captured the Quarren leadership. After learning of their true nature, Fisto advised the Calamari to find a diplomatic, as opposed to military, solution, and peace was eventually made between the Moappa and the co-inhabitants of their world. Over a century later, under the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, the Moappa's home planet was purged of all life. The Galactic Alliance Remnant spearheaded an evacuation of the Moappa and the other species.

name: Mober snake
summary: Mober snakes were deadly reptiles with poisonous heads at both ends of its body.

name: Modbrek
summary: Modbreks were a species of pale-skinned humanoids (or possibly Near-Humans). They had small noses and mouths, sharp facial features and large eyes. They were hairless, save for a mane of blue hair. At least one family of Modbreks lived in Mos Eisley on the desert world of Tatooine. Some Human males found female Modbreks physically attractive, though the Gotal tax collector Feltipern Trevagg found them to be wispy and insubstantial in appearance, and merely semi-sentient in intellect.

name: Modrol
summary: Modrols were large predatory creatures native to the jungle world of Port Haven. They walked upright, had thick skin covered in hair-like tendrils and a dense fur. Their skin coloration could change to match their surroundings which aided their ability to stalk their prey. They had clawed legs and sharp talons on their hands. The middle talon was elongated to form a blade that was used to open up a prey. During the latter years of the Galactic Republic, the species was introduced to Neftali, where it developed into a variant known as the ice modrol.

name: Moggonite
summary: The Moggonites of Arorua were better known as one of the most obnoxious and treacherous species in the galaxy. They were short mammalian creatures, standing approximately 1/2 meters tall. They were able to interbreed with at least one other species: Big Gizz, the leader of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's swoop gang, was a Moggonite hybrid. Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi experienced a sour encounter with a Moggonite named Mosko Bolpa on the planet Arorua in 44 BBY.

name: Mogo
summary: Mogos were creatures with hooves and ten legs found on Roon, though like most of the planet's fauna, they were not believed to be indigenous. Their shaggy fur was used to keep a wild mogo warm in the mountains. The mogo was domesticated as mounts. A typical mogo could carry three Human-sized beings with no problem.

name: Mohsenian
summary: The Mohsenians were a sentient species with cream skin, graying fur, and large dark eyes. Mohsenians had extremely powerful noses that could smell sickness and injuries. They had dexterous clawed fingers that where originally designed for digging. Twylope Nur was a member of this species who worked as a field medic for the Resistance. A Mohsenian assisted Barriss Offee when she was known as "the healer," serving as one of her two attendants.
distinctions: Ability to smell illness and injury

name: Moing
summary: Moings were a species of small animal. They were among the creatures exhibited at Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show on Taris.

name: Mokko's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Mokko was a member of the species.

name: Molator
summary: The molator was a creature in the galaxy. They appeared in Alderaanian mythology, where they were considered to be a magical creature. Molators were used as dejarik holomonsters. During or after 11 ABY, a Molator was one of several creatures and gladiators belonging to species featured in dejarik that was unleashed upon the Mandalorian Din Djarin and Rotta the Hutt in the Pits on the moon Shakari, before escaping the arena and wreaking havoc on civilians.

name: Molavaran
summary: Molavarans were a sentient species indigenous to Molavar. They had caramel colored skin and a long face. Their scalps had multiple tendrils on the sides and back of their head. They bore pointed teeth and large cheek bones.

name: Moldwarp
summary: Moldwarp were a scaled sentient species. One Moldwarp, Edmo Ectacle, hailed from Lespectus, and was present in the casino in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in around 34 ABY. Another, Draiven Bosh was a con-man during the High Republic Era.

name: Mole creature
summary: Mole creatures, as C-3PO called them, were sapient moles who lived underground on Tatooine. Occasionally, surface dwellers would fall through the surface into the mole creatures' tunnels. The mole creatures would feed these unfortunate beings to Gotar, the acid lizard.

name: Mole-flea
summary: Mole-fleas were a sentient species native to the planet Kowak. Lugubrious Mote was a member of this species.

name: Mole serpent
summary: Mole serpents were burrowing predators native to the Kathol sector. They dwelt almost entirely underground and ranged from 10-28 meters long. One such creature escaped into the deserts of Tatooine. The creatures are the natural predators of the Tirginni beasts.

name: Molemen
summary: Molemen were a species of diminutive, naturally blind humanoids with white skin. In 22 BBY, when the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker confronted Zam Wesell in the Outlander Club on Coruscant, three molemen were being escorted by a tour guide to the club's Digisee gaming floor.

name: Moloskian
summary: Moloskians were a species originating within the Moloskia system. They had eyes in the backs of their heads.
distinctions: Eyes in the back of the head

name: Momong
summary: Momongs, or Trandoshan monkeys, were a species of primates that lived in the trees of forests on Wasskah, the moon of the planet Trandosha. They had six limbs, a long tail, big ears and green eyes. Their fur was mostly orange, with occasional black and white patches. The momongs were carnivores and aggressive hunters, preying on the yellow birds known as the convorees. They were at least semi-sentient, as proven by their ability to use simple tools or weapons. During the Clone Wars, many momongs had found their way offworld. In 20 BBY, several momongs were kept in cages in the Governor's tower by the Zygerrian Darts D'Nar after the Separatists relocated the Togruta from the planet. A momong was seen in a slave market on Zygerria, where it dueled with a Kowakian monkey-lizard with miniature swords.
distinctions: Six limbs, long tail, large ears

name: Mon Cal microplankton
summary: A species of bioluminescent microplankton were native to the planet Mon Cala. The microplankton could be used as a hair dye if it was washed into an individuals hair, as it would bond with each hair strand and then emit pulsating glow. The Mandalorian artist and demolitions expert Sabine Wren read about the microplankton and wrote about them in her journal around five years before the Battle of Yavin. Despite wanting to try coloring her hair with the microplankton, Wren wrote that she thought having glowing hair would probably be detrimental to any stealth missions she undertook.

name: Mon Cala eel
summary: The Mon Cala eel also known as the Mon Calamari eel, or the electric eel, was a species of predatory eel found in the oceans of Mon Cala. They were reputed for being slippery.

name: Mon Calamari
summary: The Mon Calamari (also known as Mon Calamarians) were a humanoid, aquatic species native to the planet of Mon Cala. They shared their home planet with the Quarren.
distinctions: Large, goggle-like eyes, high-domed heads, webbed hands

name: Monar serpent
summary: The monar serpent was a type of serpent that shed its scales. The serpent's scale shedding was similar to the Separatist flagship Invisible Hand losing pieces of its hull as it descended through the planet Coruscant's atmosphere during the Battle of Coruscant in 19 BBY.

name: Mongo Beefhead
summary: Mongo Beefhead were a species of individuals on the edge of extinction. The group was native to the Outer Rim planet of Tatooine and were members of the Rebel Alliance. The Arkanian mutant Zeta Magnus consumed Mongo Beefhead meat, though it was nutritionally poor.

name: Mongworst
summary: Mongworst were a species of vicious and deadly insects found on the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. They were bred for combat by the native Geonosians and made to participate in pit fights for the Geonosians' pleasure. During the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY, tiny, mutant mongworts were being kept in a secure holding pen carved into the rock beneath the Stalgasin hive's Petranaki Arena on Geonosis. The Galactic Empire sterilized Geonosis around 9 BBY.

name: Monnok
summary: Monnoks were a sentient biped species that were feared by many, including the desert nomads of Socorro. Although they looked primitive, they used spears, and were excellent hunters on their homeworld Socorro. Their appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik, which had red and yellow skin, black eyes, and carried a staff. By at least 11 ABY, a Monnok gladiator was one of several creatures and gladiators belonging to species featured in dejarik that was unleashed upon the Mandalorian Din Djarin and Rotta the Hutt in the Pits on the moon Shakari before being slain by Djarin.

name: Monsail
summary: Monsails were large predatory fish native to the swamps of Trinta. They had long eel-like bodies and large sails on their backs.

name: Monzu
summary: The monzu was a predatory species found on the planet Zolan. As a result of a spike of solar radiation from Zolan's sun, the monzu and various other species on the world developed the ability to alter their skin color and change their body shape as an adaptation. Many of Zolan's native creatures died out during the spike, but those that survived until the radiation levels dropped again, like the monzu, were dramatically shaped by the event.

name: Mooc
summary: The mooc was a species of felinoid creature.

name: Moocher
summary: Moochers were small, semisentient, fur-covered lizards of Abregado-rae. They were believed to be somehow related to the Atzerrian Meek. They lived in dens with populations in the thousands, all birthed by a single queen. This queen was extremely intelligent, but birthed offspring that were comparably unintelligent. Often, the queen would expel Moochers she was displeased with, and they would branch off to form their own dens, or turn to a life of panhandling in the planet's spaceports, the latter being considered a nuisance by most inhabitants. Moochers could move on all fours or on their two hind legs and used their prehensile tails to manipulate objects. Their language was mainly based on gestures with the occasional bark or whistle. They can detect their surroundings from up to 80 meters away, even in complete darkness, by sensing energy fields. Moochers were also susceptible to the Veizen fever, which could drive them mad. When an outbreak seemed possible, the Tundei regime allowed the extermination of nearly all the Moochers, to prevent it from spreading to the Gado.

name: Moof
summary: Moofs were beasts of burden native to Cerea. They were used as riding mounts as well as to pull plows on local farms.

name: Moog
summary: Moogs were a small non-sentient species of creatures indigenous to the planet Dathomir that were the favored food of the reptomammalian rancors. They were known to be quite difficult to catch as they were both swift and fast-moving animals. They made a snuffling sound and lived in lairs. Mother Talzin of the Nightsister coven of Dathomir Witches mentioned the creatures in her manifesto, Wild Power, comparing their snuffles to the echoes of the Fanged God, a being of the dark side of the Force who resided in the realm of Mortis and was worshipped by the Nightsisters as a deity. Wild Power was one of many writings collected in the Book of Sith, a Sith historical book assembled by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious sometime between 19 BBY and 18 BBY. The term to "play moog-and-rancor" referred to a situation in which one party was chasing another, specifically during dogfights.

name: Moogan
summary: Moogans were a sentient humanoid species native to the planet Mooga. They had slender builds with long limbs and a long neck as well as bright green blood. There existed a type of tea called Moogan tea.

name: Mooka
summary: The mooka was a small creature with avian physical attributes. Mookas were covered in fur and feathers, with bird-like beaks and tails, four ears and clawed feet. They were easily domesticated, and often kept as pets. Halagad Ventor from Alderaan kept pet mookas as a boy. The Jedi Prince Ken once owned a pet mooka which he named Zeebo.

name: Moon fish
summary: Moon fish were a type of fish edible by tooka cats. In 230 BBY, Jedi Knight Yacek Sparkburn cooked moon fish in the Jedi temple on the Outer Rim planet Dalna which he then placed into a woven bag with fruits among other items in other bags. As Sparkburn approached a group inside the temple's while carrying the bags, the temple's tookas flocked to him wailing piteously, causing the Knight to laugh. Sparkburn then stated that cats the must have smelt the moon fish he had brought, before introducing himself to Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh and her Padawan, Imri Cantaros.

name: Moon hen
summary: A moon hen was a type of hen that lived in nests. In 382 BBY, when the Evereni Path of the Open Hand cult member Yana Ro visited Elecia Zeveron—the leader of the Path—in her listening chamber in the Path compound on the Outer Rim planet Dalna, she saw her sitting among a pile of pillows. In response, Ro mentally compared Zeveron to a moon hen in a nest.

name: Moon moth
summary: Moon moths were a type of moth with white wings that were found on the forest moon of Endor in the Outer Rim Territories. When describing the mythical kroolok to a group of young Ewoks during a particularly bleak winter on Endor between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, the shaman Logray described the beast's teeth as being as white as a moon moth's wings.

name: Moorjhoni
summary: The Moorjhoni were an indigenous species of felinoids native to the planet Moorjhone.

name: Moraband serpent
summary: The Moraband serpent was a type of snake from the Sith planet Moraband. During the Clone Wars on a mission to the planet, Jedi Master Yoda encountered Moraband serpents. They had the ability to cluster together into a much larger serpent consisting of hundreds of snakes and speak collectively. The serpents were conjured by the Force Priestesses and the power of the dark side of the Force in order to determine whether Yoda would train to preserve his identity after death.

name: Moragan
summary: Moragans were a sentient species native to the planet Moraga. Morfizo and his wife Morfizia were members of the species.

name: Moralan
summary: The Moralan were a sentient species who lived on the planet Moralan in Hutt Space. They were enslaved by the Hutt species but freed themselves and formed a republic with encouragement from the Tionese. The Hutts later reconquered the republic and drove the Moralan to extinction during the Xim Wars.

name: Moraysian
summary: Moraysians were a species of tan, stout humanoids from the Moraysi system. They were skilled inventors and builders of starships, and had an ability to actualize their schematics. They were overrun by criminal elements such as the Pyke Syndicate, who forced the Moraysians to outfit them with technology.

name: Mordageen
summary: The Mordageen were a sentient species from the planet Mordagon. The species was bipedal in form with pink skin and pointed ears. One notorious Mordageen was the smuggler Bendix Fust, who worked for the Dug crime lord Sebolto. Captured by Republic Security Forces, Fust revealed all he knew of his employer's organization, and was placed in Desolation Alley, a prison on Oovo IV. There, he was broken out by two bounty hunters so that Sebolto could get his revenge.
distinctions: Pointed ears, flat noses, wrinkled skin

name: Mordon
summary: The mordon was an endangered species of creature. The Spectres encountered one being transported to the Emperor's personal zoo, aboard a class four container transport while trying to rescue the argora.

name: Morellian
summary: The Morellians were a species of sentient near-Humans native to the planet Morellia in Wild Space. They dominated the Morellian Commonwealth, a region patrolled by a law enforcement body known as the Morellian Enforcers. The Enforcers were known for their choice of weaponry: the .48-caliber Enforcer pistol was a slugthrower manufactured by the Morellian Weapons Conglomerate that was as strong as a heavy blaster pistol. The Morellians had long lifespans proportionate to Humans; at age 110, a Morellian had yet to reach their best years. Nevertheless, by the Galactic Civil War, the species was nearing extinction. The Morellian Barosa Warren headed the Galactic Outdoor Survival School and posed a threat to the Rebel Alliance. Four of Warren's half-Human children served as Rebel operatives.

name: Morganian
summary: The Morganians were a species of slender, white-skinned Humanoids. They had pointed ears and were renowned for their beauty.

name: Morish
summary: The Morish were a short, furry species from the planet Morishim in the Outer Rim. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a secret communications center was established in a cave on Morishim; after the Empire pulled out, a Morish known as the Old Recluse found the abandoned communications link, and used its newsfeeds to fool others into believing he had clairvoyant abilities. Other Morish, meanwhile, plied their wares at a local marketplace.

name: Morling
summary: The Morlings were the native sentient species of the planet Morda.

name: Morodin
summary: Morodins were a species of large, sentient herbivores. Often mistaken for massive herd animals, the Morodins had long, slender bodies that could grow up to twenty meters in length. They possessed six legs and two forearms, as well as a wide spoon-shaped snout. The most distinctive feature of the Morodins was their ability to secrete a nutrient slime trail that promoted growth and mutation in plant life that it covered. The composition of the secretion varied with the Morodin's diet, and they were always experimenting with new combinations by eating plants, exuding the secretion to create a new, more nutritious, strain of flora which then entered their food chain. Originally from a homeworld that struggled to feed its growing population, the Morodins established a colony on the planet Varonat to grow food. The Morodins turned part of Varonat into a vast jungle and transported their bounty to the homeworld aboard organic space vessels. However, an ecological disaster on their homeworld prevented the Morodins from growing their ships, and contact with the homeworld was lost. The Morodins on Varonat continued to thrive. Eventually, Human colonists reached Varonat and saw the Morodins as wild beasts intent on destroying their plantings when, in reality, the Morodins were trying to help the Humans to grow their food. During the early years of the New Republic, a group of Krish began planting in the jungle and actively allowing the Morodins to fertilize the crop. At the same time, a safari had been established by the same group of Krish that killed several Morodins a year as part of a big-game hunt.

name: Morp
summary: [[File:KnobbySpiderMorp-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A morp riding a knobby white spider.]] Morp was a carnivorous amphibian species native to the planet Dagobah. Related to the nharpira, these creatures would paralyze their prey with venomous bites, which could cause paralysis in a Human in a matter of hours. They were known to rely on their small size and agility to avoid detection from larger predators such as Lesser Bogwings. They were swamp-bound creatures, often found hiding in wormholes. Heeth and Raal Panteer imported at least one morp, along with hundreds of other creatures, to their estate in the Ryloth system. Raal was bitten by a morp while showing Leia Organa around the wildlife preserve, and ultimately died from its venom. The morp droids used by Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars were named after these creatures.

name: Morrt feeding on Kufbrug
summary: The morrts were a furry species of parasitic bloodsuckers native to Gamorr.

name: Morseerian
summary: Morseerians were a sentient species native to the planet Merj.

name: Morvak
summary: Morvaks were unusual creatures that resembled large crustaceans that were meters across. They were considered an unusual example of life as they gained sustenance from rocks and stones. Furthermore, they did not require 'standard' liveable conditions such as gravity or atmosphere and thus had no problem surviving in environments like asteroid belts. The only requirement they needed was an abundance of food sources. Should none be present then they would enter into a state of hibernation till new food sources developed, a process that would sometimes take many years. They possessed a heavy exo-skeleton which would protect them from harm. Locomotion was carried out by two pairs of legs and a pair of clawed limbs allowed them to manipulate their food into their tentacle covered mouths. They were able to exude a powerful acidic chemical which was used to break down the composition of rocks, as well as stones, into a more digestable form. The mouth tentacles was also used to 'feel' the rocks and gave the Morvak an understanding of what kind of material they were burrowing through. While they seemed as vicious creatures due to their appearance they were in fact sociable creatures that would work in packs to repel predators or to locate new sources of minerals. It was never discovered whether they were a planetary based species that adapted to space or evolved in the vacuum of space; and as such their homeworld was never found.

name: Mosciive
summary: The Mosciives were a near-Human species that inhabited the Inner Rim planet of Simocadia. They were distinguished from the Humans only by their distinctive red eyes.

name: Mosgoth
summary: Mosgoths were large flying reptiles native to Togoria, the Togorian homeworld. They were used as mounts by the Togorian people who befriended them. Another species of flying reptile, the liphons, often preyed on both mosgoths and the primitive Togorians. When the Togorians realized that they and the mosgoths had a common enemy, they started to camp near mosgoth nests for mutual protection. Eventually, Togorians domesticated the mosgoths, and started using them as mounts. This was the event which led to the formation of a Togorian civilization of settled females and nomadic male hunters riding mosgoths to the hunt. Even after making contact with galactic society, both male and female Togorians preferred to walk or ride mosgoths rather than use motorized vehicles. Togorians bonded strongly with their mosgoth mounts. [[File:DqellSisters-KOTOR41.jpg|left|thumb|D'qell Sisters on Mosgoths.]] Mosgoths were easily tamed, and strong enough to carry a Togorian male on their back in flight. They also enjoyed being petted, like many tame animals. Mlatar Thon Gra, a Togorian Master Smith and member of the Zulirian Swordmasters, owned a mosgoth called Ktlin.

name: Mosquito
summary: Mosquitos were sanguivorous insects similar to msqitos.

name: Moss ghoat
summary: Moss ghoats were a type of ghoat. During the High Republic Era, the Path of the Open Hand cult had moss ghoats that they gathered fertilizer from to use in their fields at their compound on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. In 382 BBY, when the Path member Marda Ro was showing Jedi Master Zallah Macri and Padawan Kevmo Zink around the compound, Zink asked why they did not use better tools or fertilizer. Ro responded that they did use fertilizer, which was natural and gathered from their moss ghoats, but that the Path chose to only use technology when necessary because they believed it interfered with their harmony with the Force.

name: Moss-hopper
summary: Moss-hoppers were the tiniest race of burrowers, rodentlike species which lived throughout the worldwide tundra of Yavin 8. Moss-hoppers were carnivorous predators which attacked the largest of creatures with their hollow, needle sharp front incisors—which injected a weak venom into the veins of their prey.

name: Mostlaa
summary: The Mostlaa were a humanoid, sentient species. Individuals of the species had heavy brows, sunken eyes, and large, pointed ears. The Mostlaa named Jimmer had a receding hairline and a beard, creating an overall weasel-like impression. Jimmer stood 1.3 meters tall and wore a hooded, long-sleeved robe, a wrap around the waist, and boots. Jimmer worked as an executive assistant for Nilya Fek'ra, a crime lord based on the Outer Rim Territories' planet Cotellier during the period of the Galactic Empire.

name: Mosyk
summary: The Mosyk were a sentient reptilian species. They had green skin, a bone-like structure on the back of their heads—similar to Vurk—as well as as three fingers on each hand. The Jedi Master Eeko-Dio Daki, who survived Order 66 and went into hiding with his Padawan Devon Izara on the planet Janix, was a member of the species.
distinctions: Bone-like structure on the back of their heads

name: Mott
summary: Motts were a species of non-sentient, horn-nosed herbivorous mammals found on the planet of Naboo. They fed off swamp vegetation.

name: Mottled electric fish
summary: The mottled electric fish were a type of electricity-producing fish found in the oceans of the planet Kamino. They were the favorite snack of kamoradon sea dragons and after the bounty hunter Jango Fett caught a mottled electric fish while fishing from Tipoca City a kamoradon ate it and pulled Fett into the ocean.

name: Mottled hexskip paddler
summary: The mottled hexskip paddler was a species of black-skinned aquatic creature that lived in the oceans of the planet Corellia and was sold by fishmongers on the docks of Coronet City. The paddlers had long, thin bodies with a lateral steering fin on each side and a large flat tail. The species had six eyes and a pair of sensory tentacles at the front of its body. In 13 BBY, two were hanging up in a fish market in Coronet City that the fugitive scrumrats Han and Qi'ra fled through while trying to escape the White Worms gang.

name: Mouf
summary: Moufs were medium-sized, solitary creatures that often got together to feed or mate.
