In 22 BBY, when the Clone Wars broke out between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, their planet seceded to the Confederacy, although much of the populace had a great respect for the Jedi, the devoted protectors of the Republic. Following the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, a Null Imperial Intelligence agent was employed by the Church of the Dark Side as an imitator of the Emperor's Mage Jedgar, an imposingly tall Human who matched Nulls in height.

name: Numm
summary: The Numm were a technologically-primitive sentient species Han Solo and Chewbacca encountered after the Millennium Falcon hyperdrive malfunctioned, forcing them to land on the Numm's world. The Numm feared CZ-4, the droid Han and Chewie were tasked with delivering as a gift from Boonda to Jabba Desilijic Tiure. After CZ-4's disappearance, the duo discovered the Numm's fear of droids resulted from a band of Krath war droids which had terrorized them since the droids crashed on the Numm's world centuries ago. The war droids' leader, known as the Blade Master, abducted CZ-4 to cannibalize for spare parts, but Han and Chewbacca were able to reprogram the war droids, saving CZ-4 and ending the Numm's oppression. The grateful Numm then led Han and Chewie to a freighter wreck, from which the pair were able to salvage parts to repair the Falcon and depart to complete their delivery.

name: Nuna
summary: Nunas, also known as swamp turkeys, were small bipeds native to the swamps of the planet Naboo that spread to many other planets across the galaxy and could also be found on planets such as Tatooine, Coruscant and Saleucami. Their meat was used to make several dishes.

name: Nus Whale
summary: Nus Whales were creatures native to Dorumaa. When food was plentiful, a Nus Whale could grow up to twenty meters in a single year. As of 31 BBY, there was one herd of Nus Whales swimming Dorumaa's oceans, consisting of twelve cows and ten bulls. The bulls were at least 100 meters long, large enough to swallow a fishing boat in a single gulp, and the cows were 80 to 90 meters long. Despite being called whales, Nus Whales reproduced by laying eggs, which would be buried in the deep ocean and took several years to hatch. Nus Whale could easily eat a fishing boat such as the Icon. Nevertheless, some fisherbeings, such as Icon captain Drac Gerrat, dreamed of hunting (or fishing) one Nus Whale to polish its bones and sell them as good luck charms.

name: Nuuno
summary: Nuunos were a race of crustaceans native to the wastes of Saleucami. As the world's apex predator, a nuuno was considered extremely dangerous by the Saleucamians.

name: Nuxan
summary: The Nuxan were a sentient humanoid species from the Nux system in the Mid Rim Territories. They were distinguished by their unpleasant, rotten odor. The species possessed green skin riddled with brown spots, a pair of green eyes which had brown markings directly above and below, a pair of five-fingered hands, and fin on the back of their heads. Bodo Linx was a Nuxan informant during the Imperial Era who could speak Galactic Basic Standard. Around 2 ABY, Linx met the rebel fugitives Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, and Han Solo, along with the smuggler Sana Starros, in a cantina on the Outer Rim astronomical object Barnahof. When Imperial stormtroopers arrived at the cantina, Starros referenced the Nuxan's odor as an excuse for the space between her and Linx where the fugitives had previously sat. After the stormtroopers left, Linx gave the rebels the location of his contact on Brentaal IV, a planet located in the Core Worlds.
distinctions: Face markings above and below their eyes

name: Nuzzle shrew
summary: The Nuzzle shrew were race of savage creatures native to the Outer Rim world of Mandalore.

name: Nyantolo
summary: Nyantolo were aquatic mammals native to the swamps of Wyndigal 2. Up to three meters long, they had two front flippers, two small pelvic fins, and upright flukes on their tail. Their large mouths had shovel-shaped jaws and bony beaks which could deliver a powerful bite. Nyantolo secreted a sticky substance on their backs, which attracted insects and swamp debris. This accumulated and hardened into an irregular carapace with many hollow chambers. In addition to camouflaging the creature, a nyantolo could use breathing tubes in its back to blow air through the carapace, producing an eerie moaning whistle. Older nyantolo had larger carapaces, and thus louder songs which would attract more mates. Nyantolo had three sexes, and mated communally, laying eggs three weeks later. The wailing of dozens of nyantolo during mating season was described as maddening. Nyantolo ignored one another completely outside of mating season. Over their two to five year lifespan, they would stake out a feeding ground, drifting or slowly swimming through the swamps, and shoveling swamp debris and small fish into their jaws. In addition to allowing food to cross their path by chance, two of the five known subspecies secreted an oily fluid from glands in their mouths. This fluid attracted small fish and croator, an avian species which was also found in the swamps. Finally, if a larger being came too close, they moved surprisingly swiftly, attacking with their flippers and their beaks. The nyantolo were named for Nyantolo, an unfortunate Rodian scout who came across one by accident. After one of the creatures killed him, the species was named in his honor. Visitors to Wyndigal 2 were thereafter cautioned against disturbing the swamp beasts.

name: Nydak Alpha
summary: The Nydak Alpha was a rare subtype of the Lesser Nydak, apex predators native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir. They shared many similarities with the Lesser Nydak, such as their black eyes, though it had several differences including its light blue and gray skin, with larger spikes along their limbs and back. Additionally, their bones were hardened and rich in nutrients due to being covered by a resistant hide, making it impossible to sever its arms. Their forearms allowed for versatile climbing and asymmetrical traversal. The Nydak Alphas were more aggressive, relentless, and reclusive than the Lesser Nydaks. Due to their powerful forearms, they were also deadlier than the regular nydaks. In combat, the Nydak Alpha used intellect and strength to defend against multiple parries. In 14 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis visited Dathomir as part of a secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order. During his journey, Kestis killed a Nydak Alpha in the planet's Nightmare Ruins.
distinctions: Larger spikes than the Lesser Nydak

name: Nyemarian
summary: The Nyemarians were a species hailing from the planet Nyemari.

name: Nyork
summary: The nyork was a small, hard-shelled, carnivorous clam native to the swamps of Naboo. They "nipped" with their mouths located inside their shells, and would jump out of the water at whatever seemed to be prey to them. The nyork's main predators included the otta, the pikobi, and the blarth. Gungans also ate nyorks, usually wrapping the meat in nave leaves. Jar Jar Binks was eating a nyork when he was rescued by Qui-Gon Jinn.

name: Nyriaanan
summary: The Nyriaanans, also known as Nyriaanan natives, were the near-Human inhabitants of the planet of Nyriaan.
distinctions: Eyes adapted to see in dim light

name: Oasis mother
summary: The oasis mother was a species of sentient, predatory plant that was native to the desert-covered world of Endregaad. Oasis mothers lived atop small pools of water. Their bodies consisted of a series of intertwined vines that formed a trunk with over-hanging branches. From the limbs hung sacks that contained immature oasis children, juvenile forms of the plant. Oasis children were mobile and bipedal in form, and their main role was to hunt living animals to feed to their mother. Though sentient, oasis mothers had very different thought patterns from other intelligent species and were completely amoral, caring only about their own well-being. During the time of the New Republic, a band of oasis children attacked a caravan of travelers that that was passing through the wildernesses of Endregaad en route to the planet's Temple Valley region.
distinctions: Trunk formed from vines, with overhanging branches

name: Oblee
summary: Oblee were three-armed sapients indigenous to Oblis, although originally from the Unknown Regions. Each Oblee had four eyes, in two rows. The color of each row could vary, as was the case with well-known Oblee Nirama. In cases of little sleep, the Oblee would show wrinkles under all of their eyes. Some members of the species found the Sith artifact known as the Darkstaff. The device eventually destroyed their homeworld, leaving the Oblee survivors adrift in the galaxy as spirit creatures that were referred to as shadow lurkers. They would sometimes try to interact with the physical world by sucking the life out of sentient beings and inhabiting their bodies. The Oblee had spread their DNA throughout the galaxy and eventually one called Nirama was born, believing that he was the only member of his species in existence. Common Oblee names included Azbedal, Flef, Kiffel, Nirama, and Ronorra.

name: O'cerry
summary: The o'cerry was a non-sentient herbivore species native to the Expansion Region moon of Alchenaut. Discovered and named by Jedi biologist Bowspritz at some point prior to 990 BBY, the species was noted for its habit of acting as a predator alarm for other herbivores in the ecosystem. Bowspritz included o'cerry in the "Galactic Bestiary" section of The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force, which introduced the species to numerous generations of Jedi trainees.
distinctions: Acted as a predator alarm for other herbivore species

name: Ociock
summary: The Ociocks were a sentient avian species that lived in the galaxy. A family of Ociocks including a female and her mother were imprisoned at Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on the planet Wobani during the time Jyn Erso was there.

name: Oclatar
summary: An oclatar was a many-tentacled creature found on the abandoned starship which contained the Tomb of Sarasti Thel, founder of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door. By 32 BBY, a nest of oclatars settled in the dark, depressurized interior of the ship despite the lack of atmosphere. When a team of archaeologists led by the Caphex Shanto restored the ship's atmosphere and boarded to explore and learn about the untouched vessel, Shanto wandered into the darkness and was slain by the creatures. The other archaeologists, who could not see into the darkness in which the attack occurred, came to believe the cryptic ship was haunted. When Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan, Obi-Wan Kenobi, arrived to investigate Shanto's disappearance, they too encountered an oclatar. The stealthy creature ambushed Kenobi, disarming him with a tentacle before lurching for the kill. Jinn was able to calm the oclatar with the Force and convince it to move along. The pair of Jedi eventually stumbled upon the nest of numerous oclatars, who perched from the ceiling. This time, the duo fled before the creatures could attack. Before long, however, many of the oclatars were incapacitated by Minakatso, a member of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door pursuing Jinn.

name: Ocsin
summary: The Ocsin, also known as the Ocsinin, were a near-Human species with white skin and black, pupilless eyes that hailed from the Wild Space celestial body Farana. Believed to be descended from the Human Tionese culture of the Tion Cluster, the Ocsin established first contact with the Galactic Republic at some point before 4500 BBY. The species' members included merchants and explorers, and it established at least several dozen colonies in Farana's galactic neighborhood, including the worlds Ocsin and Saclas. The female Ocsin Cene Gilvent grew up on Saclas, eventually traveling offworld where she became one of the founding members of the Zulirian Swordmasters group of melee weapon afficionados.

name: Octani
summary: Octani were a race of aliens that lived in the galaxy. They were tall and bulky with tan skin, four eyes, and four arms. Poe Dameron and Finn encountered the Octani Dhar Wat on a mission where they obtained parts for the Resistance from an Wat, who had them confiscated by First Order officers on a train.

name: Octeroid
summary: Octeroids were an amphibious sentient species native to the aquatic world of Octero IV. They were known galaxy-wide for their striking appearance and simple lifestyle. They were thought to be gentle giants with little technology, preferring to stay on their homeworld. Octeroids who chose to explore the galaxy had a breathing apparatus developed so they could survive in foreign atmosphere. Glaucus was a member of this species.

name: Octomorph
summary: The Octomorph was a tentacled, water-dwelling creature Phee Genoa claimed to have defeated with her bare hands. The story involving the Octomorph, which also included her discovery of the Grand Pearl of Novak, changed every time Genoa retold it. She mentioned the Octomorph to Ketch and Bolo, regular patrons of Cid's Parlor in Ord Mantell City, between 19 BBY and 18 BBY.

name: Octopoid
summary: Octopoids were creatures on the planet Mannius Eight. Auric Graf used to study Octopoids.

name: Octopus
summary: Octopi (singular octopus) were cephalopods with eight tentacles.

name: Octowhale
summary: The octowhale was a type of creature with claws. While on a jungle planet, in 30 BBY, the Quarren Senator Tikkes mentioned the great creature's brazen claws after witnessing a meteor shower bombard the planet's surface sooner than he expected.

name: Octucor
summary: The octucor was a forest-dwelling land squid from the Outer Rim Territories moon Endor. Sporting an eight-meter-long body with striped skin and eight three-meter-long tentacles, it was a fierce nocturnal predator that reached into the branches of Endor's trees in search of prey, which included the sentient Ewoks. During the Battle of Endor, a team of Rebel Alliance operatives encountered an octucor in the Endor forest that attempted to consume them.

name: Octuptarra
summary: {{Update|}} Octuptarras were eight-eyed, gasbag-headed vine walkers native to the planet Skako that were the namesakes of the octuptarra tri-droid, a model of droid walker manufactured by the Techno Union.

name: Octusi
summary: The Octusi were a semi-sentient species that lived on the planet Blaudu Sextus, where they were used as slaves by members of the world's mining colony. In 44 ABY, the slaves held a freedom march, but when Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala heard of the development from Wynn Dorvan, her Chief of Staff, she arranged for a brigade of Mandalorians to be sent to Blaudu Sextus to prevent the incident from becoming a full-fledged revolution.
homeworld: Blaudu Octus, in the Albanin sector, Regulan system
distinctions: Centauriform, Ithorian-like torso, hammer-shaped head, beauty horn, four hooves

name: Ocuvox
summary: Ocuvox were a species of winged animal found in the forests of the planet Wielu during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Members of the species had three eyes, a beak, and two blue feet as well as blue feathers covering their body and wings, apart from the tips of the wing which had purple feathers. Ocuvox wings also bore strips which glowed white in darkness. The winged animals were capable of squawking and were known to create infestations. Around 21 BBY, the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi was on Wielu hunting a Shistavanen criminal named T'mott Zoat, and mistook the strips on an ocuvox's wings for his target's eyes. After slashing at the animal with his lightsaber, he caused it to fly away, and the smuggler Rook Pryce, who had witnessed the attack, taunted him for the mistake.
distinctions: Three eyes, glowing strips on wings

name: Odenji
summary: The Odenji were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Issor, which they shared with their cousin species, the Issori. Originally a nomadic underwater society, the Odenji moved to the land after being discovered by the Issori, with whom they formed a merged society. The two species advanced together and colonized the rest of their native star system, after which they were discovered by the rest of the galactic community. Members of the species could breath on land and in water, due to possessing gills and lungs, and instead of a nose each Odenji possessed four olfactory flaps. The Odenji suffered a long period of species wide depression known as the melanncho, during which their population was severely reduced. Following the disastrous period, the Odenji became a sad and pitiful species, rarely displaying happiness and taking a more apathetic role in their homeworld's society. Individual Odenji continued to suffer personal melanncho long after the period of species wide depression was over.
skinColor: Range from dark brown to tan

name: Odupiendo
summary: The odupiendo were a species of large, flightless avians from Naboo. Although unable to fly, the odupiendo were fast runners. Taking advantage of that particular skill, a sport called odupiendo-racing was created, which involved several of those avian creatures running along a circular track. It was one of the betting sports at the Outlander Club on Coruscant. Bodhi Rook, an Imperial cargo pilot, bet on odupiendo races on Jedha.

name: Odux
summary: Odux were domesticated quadrupedal horned beasts of burden that were ridden by sentient beings around 3623 BBY. There were a number of Odux variants, including "Mudland," "Firebrand," "Resplendent," and "Snowblind" Odux.

name: Oevvaor
summary: The oevvaor was a predatory marine reptile that lived on the shores of Kashyyyk. The males of the species possessed an axe-like horn on their heads. The Wookiees named one of their military vehicles, the Oevvaor jet catamaran, after this beast.

name: Ogemite
summary: Ogemites were a sentient species in the galaxy that partially shared their name with the celestial body Ogem in the Mid Rim Territories. In 232 BBY, several Ogemites boarded the starship Journeyman on the Mid Rim planet Cerea. However, the Journeyman was damaged by an impact with debris during the galactic-wide Great Hyperspace Disaster while traveling on a hyperspace route and sent out a distress call. Jedi Master Cohmac Vitus, who boarded the vessel to assist with saving its occupants, saw a few of the ship's Ogemite passengers while moving to clear a blockage preventing access to the nearby escape pods. Vitus successfully eliminated the obstacle, allowing the Journeyman travelers to flee the ship safely before it exploded shortly afterward.

name: Oggdo
summary: Oggdos were a carnivorous species native to the planet Bogano. Oggdos were alpha predators and used their adhesive tongues to attack their prey. They had thick, lightsaber-resistant hide, making them dangerous at close range. A subspecies of the creature was the Oggdo Bogdo. In 14 BBY, Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis encountered and fought several oggdos on Bogano, during his search for the ancient Zeffonian Vault on the planet.

name: Oggdo Bogdo
summary: The Oggdo Bogdo was a rare subspecies of the Oggdo, a dangerous apex predator native to the Outer Rim planet Bogano. Highly aggressive and ferocious, the creature was larger and much deadlier than a common Oggdo, boasting a highly lightsaber-resistant shell and tremendous strength.

name: Ogre
summary: Ogres were a species of large sentient humanoids with stocky, well-muscled physiques. One specimen, named Gantu, had pale, warty skin, pointed ears, and unkempt black hair on his small head. That Ogre inhabited the land of Zandor on the Forest Moon of Endor, where he raided other sentient beings from his base in a large cave. The Ogre cut down the region's sunnydew flowers, which cast Zandor into permanent drought and angered the resident Zandor Rockers. Gantu's raids were cut short when the Ewok chief, Chirpa, stole the bridge crystal that Gantu used to create the Rainbow Bridge that allowed him to cross the Gorge of Fire and enter Ewok territory. Years later, the crystal was destroyed for good in a fight with the Ewoks Teebo and Wicket W. Warrick, cutting the Ogre off from Ewok lands indefinitely.

name: Okfili
summary: The Okfili were a sentient species. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, they were allied with the Alliance. At some point by that time, an art object of great religious significance to the Okfili was stolen from them, coming into the possession of a group of pirates based on the Mid Rim planet Sayblohn. The Okfili requested that the Alliance find the art object, to which end a Rebel special operative team was sent to Sayblohn to retrieve the artifact. The Rebel team ultimately succeeded in its task.

name: Oki-poki
summary: The oki-poki were a species of cliff-dwelling rodents native to the desert planet of Pasaana. They fed on thistlebuzzers, gorpions, and other insects. The oki-poki had large, vibrating ears that could detect very distinct sounds, as well as sensitive vibrating eyes that allowed them to "see" sounds. The tufts of fur on top of their ears helped aid in sensing wind direction. Occasionally, oki-poki were domesticated by the Aki-Aki in order to rid crops of pests.

name: Oku
summary: The Oku were a white-furred species of primitive alien sentients native to the frigid, mineral-rich planet Tokmia in the Outer Rim Territories. The Figg Excavations mining company exhausted Tokmia's mines and eventually abandoned the planet, leaving behind a cargo cult among the natives. Remembering the handouts that Figg employees gave them during each mining operation, the Oku lit huge fires to serve as landing lights in the hope that the offworlders would one day return.

name: Ollopom
summary: Ollopoms were short, gentle non-sentient herbivores native to the swamps of the planet Naboo. A species of rodent, they were often mistaken for pom petals, a plant that was part of their diet. An ollopom named Ollie was owned by the Ithorian Dok-Ondar on the Outer Rim world of Batuu, given to him as a gift by the pirate Hondo Ohnaka. The Amani Bina included Ollie in her interactive book, Bina's Guide to the Creatures of Batuu, and creature enthusiast Ardis San Tekka wrote on entry on ollopoms for her journal.
skinColor: Pink and yellow with purple spots

name: Omereth giant eel
summary: An eel of epic proportions lived on the Outer Rim planet Omereth. Whilst on the planet, Luke Skywalker witnessed a bounty hunter and his ship disappearing into the maw of one such eel.

name: Omophron
summary: The omophrons were an insectoid species.

name: Omwati
summary: Omwati were a sentient species whose members had a crown of feathers atop their heads, spindly fingers, and beaks which clacked during speech. Shi Shu, the second of the pirate captain Eleodie Maracavanya, was an Omwati.
distinctions: Crown of feathers, spindly fingers, beaks

name: Onahk
summary: Onahks were semi-amphibious creatures from the temperate wetlands of Osirrag.

name: Onderonian
summary: Onderonians were a cultural group of human natives who called the Inner Rim jungle planet Onderon, their homeworld.

name: Ongidae
summary: The Ongidae were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Pemmin Brunce was an Ongidae who worked as the head of security in the Canto Bight casino on Cantonica.

name: Ongree
summary: The Ongree were an amphibious sentient species native to the planet Skustell. The Jedi Pablo-Jill was a member of this species, as were Jedi Master Coleman Kcaj and the Anklebiter Brigade member Urk G'lar.

name: Ongun-nur
summary: The ongun-nur were large bird creatures native to the planet of Ansion. Despite their great, intimidating size, the ongun-nur were generally timid creatures. They usually traveled in large flocks. They had yellow eyes, pointed beaks, and their bodies were large, but mostly filled with air. The ongun-nur had very thin wings, and were unable to fly against the wind. They instead went wherever the wind took them.

name: Oni
summary: The Oni were a sentient species native to the planet Uru. They were a militant species who were often known to work off-planet as mercenaries. Female Oni were electrophoretic and could store static electricity in a unique capacitor gland within their bodies. This species' members included a female mercenary who was a patient of Lieutenant Kornell Divini's on Drongar.

name: Onodone
summary: Onodones were a sentient elephantine species distinguished by the trunk-like mouths, some long enough to be draped over and behind their shoulders and down their torsos. They were rarely seen and often missing from galactic events, obscuring details about this unusual species, their history, and their homeworld, although they perhaps originated in the Unknown Regions. Gwellis Bagnoro was a mysterious Onodone who was very secretive about his past and an expert forger. Bagnoro spent time at the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata, on the planet Takodana.

name: Oodoc
summary: Oodocs were a sentient species known for their great size and strength but not their intelligence. They had spiked arms and backs and massive torsos. In 17 ABY, a number of Oodocs on Coruscant and the asteroid Skip 1 were affected by the Almanian Uprising, during which the Almanian dictator Kueller exploded droids across the galaxy to destabilize the New Republic.

name: Oolid
summary: Oolids were native to Oolidi and were affiliated with the New Republic. Tolik Yar was their senator.

name: Oorg
summary: The oorg was a small animal native to Cerea. It was domesticated by the Cereans. It was small, pink, and had a long snout.

name: Ootoo
summary: Ootoos were a sentient species from Ootoo Prime. Ayva Ackler was an Ootoo miner who lived during the High Republic Era.

name: Ootoolan
summary: The Ootoolans were a species of amphibious sentients indigenous to the beautiful aquatic world of Ootoola. They generally possessed humanoid features, but their skin was a mottled bright green, and their heads were adorned with a fin-like ridge and several finned jowls. Due to their fish-like appearance, members of this species were derogatorily nicknamed «fishfaces» outside Ootoola. On their homeworld, amid water and unusual twisted rocks, the Ootoolans adapted by built their cities within the rocks. One of their most significant cultural creations was the Central Palace, constructed before 4000 BBY, which served both as the main residence of the ruling leader and as a temple. During the Old Republic, their society was ruled by a theocratic patriarchal government. The ruler was expected to strictly adhere to their laws, thereby achieving a certain level of purity. Around 33 BBY, a group of dissenters formed the Revolutionary Purist Council and orchestrated a coup d'état, during which the reigning patriarch and his wife were executed by planted thugs. The rebels then appointed a new patriarch whom they considered to be more «pure». Princess Foolookoola, daughter of the murdered monarchs, was the last heir to the throne. As she was expected to be the Purists' next target, Vilmarh Grahrk was hired by the remaining loyalists to aid in her evacuation. With his help, and that of her assistant, Naradan D'ulin, the princess escaped to Dur Sabon.
distinctions: Sharp teeth and a protruding lower jaw

name: Opee sea killer
summary: Opee sea killers were creatures found in the oceans of the planets Naboo and Strokill Prime. They contained evolutionary traits from multiple other animals, and had strong armor, jaws with double rows of teeth and long prehensile tongues which they used to quickly devour small prey, or to capture large prey and pull it in to their jaws. The creature moved by taking in water through its large mouth and expelling it through small vents on its back. It would close the distance on its prey and use its long gooey purple tongue to pull it into its mouth.
distinctions: Double row of teeth Purple prehensile tongue

name: Ophidions
summary: Ophidions were a formidable species of translucent moray eel native to the planet Taypho. They were one of the many dangerous aquatic creatures that resided in the planet's oceans, living among the coral masses. Ophidions would hide from unsuspecting victims before attacking them with a bite. A Galactic Empire prison on Taypho had its cells extend deep into an underground lagoon, and multiple ophidions were placed there to help prevent escapes via the lagoon. During the Galactic Civil War, a group of Rebel Alliance agents were aiding the Taypho freedom fighter Yele l'Ecumeuse with a revolution the goal of which was to free the native Taïs from Imperial rule. During a firefight, some members of the revolution were captured and taken to the prison, which forced the Rebels to traverse through the eel-infested waters of the lagoon in order to free the prisoners.

name: Orbak
summary: Orbaks were a species of horse-like riding beasts. Found on several worlds, their exact galactic origins were unclear, although the ocean moon Kef Bir was the homeworld of a herd of orbaks.

name: Orbalisk
summary: An orbalisk was a parasitic creature found on Dxun that lived in groups. They lay inactive in caves or other dark places, until they found a suitable host creature on whose skin they would attach themselves to in order to feed. Orbalisks, once attached to a host, would multiply and grow, eventually enveloping and suffocating their victim. However, the holocron of Freedon Nadd contained the knowledge to make armament to prevent the orbalisks from covering the face, hands, and feet of the host, allowing them to keep this armor hidden. Perhaps by nature or as a result of residing on Dxun (which was itself a great focus of dark side power), orbalisks were able to feed on the Force-sensitivity of darksiders. It was said that the orbalisk armor's durability was such that lightsabers had a hard time penetrating it, making a wearer basically immune to lightsaber attacks. The only weakness to this armor were the exposed joints at the neck and wrists, but these gaps were so small a lightsaber could only barely slice through. However, orbalisk armor was unable to protect the wearer from electricity, as Darth Bane discovered when he was attacked by Umbaran Shadow Assassins wielding Force pikes. However, the Orbalisks did offer some limited protection from the electrical shocks; despite being set to kill, the force pikes did not deliver a strong enough charge to subdue Bane. Orbalisks caused the wearer to feel pain, fueling the wearers dark side power and if they were removed or killed, they would release a highly potent toxin into the host's body.

name: O'reenian
summary: The O'reenians were the inhabitants of the planet O'reen in the Unknown Regions; although originally Humans, they eventually evolved into a distinct sentient species of near-Humans. The species appeared similar to Humans physically with the exception of orange-hued skin. Their society and culture, on the other hand, were unique in that the O'reenians were divided into several distinct castes based upon military service. O'reenians who served in the military for six or more years were granted the rights and privileges of citizenship, while those who did not were relegated to menial occupations of the sort generally carried out by droids on worlds more technologically advanced than O'reen. Only slaves occupied a social position below non-citizens. A military dictator known as the Magnus ruled the O'reenian government and commanded its military. The system made O'reenian society highly regimented and disciplined, with an emphasis on martial prowess. Indeed, even O'reenian scientists wore sidearms while at work. Although they were descended from colonists sent to O'reen by the Galactic Republic in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace War, the location of their homeworld in the Unknown Regions kept the O'reenians isolated and self-sufficient for millennia. Through several chance encounters with offworlders, the O'reenians realized that their technology had fallen behind that of the rest of the galaxy, and the government implemented a policy of raiding nearby star systems to take weapons and devices that O'reenian researchers could then reverse-engineer. These missions, normally carried out by pilots in the O'reenian Star Corps, afforded the species a sense of protection against what they perceived as outside threats. Government policies of the Galactic Republic and the O'reenians alike regularly maintained that keeping the species isolated was the most beneficial course of action; nevertheless, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Magnus adopted a policy of potentially taking advantage of the conflict to expand O'reen's sphere of influence.

name: Orfite
summary: The Orfites were sapients indigenous to Kidron.

name: Orgon
summary: The Orgons were intelligent plants, and the native sapient species of Gorsh.
length: 0.5 meter diameter, limbs up to 4 meters

name: Orincan
summary: The Orincans were a porcine sentient species from the Orinca system in the Outer Rim Territories. They appeared similar to Gamorreans, though had paler skin. The Orincans had a dislike for the Mizi, another sentient species from the same region. An Orincan starship was one of several vessels that became stranded on the Amaxine space station when hyperspace travel was limited after the Great Hyperspace Disaster. The Orincans came into conflict with a group of Mizi who were among the others stranded on the space station, though the two groups later celebrated together when travel to Coruscant was permitted.

name: Orishen
summary: The Orishen were a sentient species native to the planet Orish. Known for their sense of nobility and honor, the Orishen were enslaved by the Galactic Empire and poisoned their homeworld in order to emancipate themselves. Characterized by the smooth plates peppered over their bodies, as well as their nose-slits and bisected jaws, the Orishen numbered only a few thousand during the era of the New Republic, during which time Orishen Senator Tolwar Wartol represented the species and vied for chancellorship of the Republic with Mon Mothma.
distinctions: Smooth skin plates, nose-slits, bisected lower jaw

name: Orkellian cave slug
summary: The Orkellian cave slug, also known as the Orkellian space slug, was a type of blind slug native to the Orkellia system of the Mid Rim. Around 1000 BBY, the newly-proclaimed Dark Lord of the Sith Bane compared his fellow Dark Lord Skere Kaan's ignorance about the potential of the dark side of the Force to the blindness of an Orkellian cave slug. A millennium later, that same disability of the slug was compared by the smuggler Han Solo to waiting in his starship, the Millennium Falcon, while its sensor array was under repair.

name: Orlax
summary: Orlax were venomous non-sentient predators native to the planet Onderon. Being four-eyed creatures, they are able to keep multiple targets in sharp focus at one time. The orlax attack their prey with great speed, leaving few survivors.

name: Orobird
summary: The orobird was a type of egg-laying bird. Their eggshells and egg yolks could be eaten by humans and the bitterness of the former balanced the sweetness gooeyness of the later. In the first year of the Empire's reign after its formation in 19 BBY, human Senator Mon Mothma ate orobird eggshells while at a droid-operated diner on the 4643rd level of the planet Coruscant during a meal with fellow Senator Lud Marroi.

name: Orooturooian
summary: Orooturooians were a sentient species from the Orooturoo system. The species had purple skin and large bodies with several tendrils. Meerou Woodring was an Orooturooian crime lord who owned an asteroid fortress.

name: Orpali dragon
summary: Orpali dragons were a rare species of lizard that was considered a delicacy by the Hutts. Orpali dragons were bred and grown in captivity, killed in infancy, and then traditionally served on a bed of glazed chuba eyes. At least a century before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire orpali dragons were on the menu for the centennial feast of Bakuush the Hutt, but several dragon hatchlings escaped from Bakuush's palace through the sewers into the toxic swamps of the planet Nal Hutta, where they eventually evolved into chemilizards.

name: Orphne's species
summary: This reptilian, humanoid, alien species had green skin, purple eyes, brown, branchlike hair and resided in the Underworld of Aleen. A notable member of this species was Orphne.
distinctions: Bulbous fingers, mottled skin, eyes lacking pupils, extensible tongue

name: Orray
summary: Orrays were big creatures native to the planet Geonosis. They were used by the Geonosian picadors as mounts and beasts of burden.

name: Orryxian
summary: Orryxians were an intelligent, sentient feline species from the Orryxia system in the Outer Rim Territories. They were encountered often enough by the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Ops teams to acquire the nickname "Cats," though the Orryxians resented the colloquialism. The popular intoxicating beverage Orryxian Catsblood, also from the Orryxia system, shared its name with the Orryxian species.

name: Orthar
summary: An Orthar was a lizard-like creature, sporting a very thick fur and extreme resilience. It was used by the local populations as a mount in the frozen mountains of the planet of Shingra. One Orthar would cost 200 credits.

name: Orthog's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Ortolan
summary: Ortolans were a sentient elephantine species of squat, blue-skinned bipeds with large, floppy ears, beady black eyes, and a trunk-like nose that were native to the cold planet Orto. They consumed large amounts of food in order to develop a warm layer of blubber due to the frigid temperatures of their homeworld. Maximilian Rebo, founder of the Max Rebo Band, was a male Ortolan.

name: Oruan
summary: The Oruans, also known as the Oru, were a group of humans native to the planet Oru. A warrior people, the Oruans fought back when their planet was taken over by the First Order. A resistance group of Oruans led by Mezlo almost succeeded, but were forced to flee to Horizon Base, where the Resistance undertook a mission in order to recruit them.

name: Orycat
summary: The orycat was a small woodland predator native to Orryxia that could be found in packs of 12-24. Imperial official Wilek Nereus obtained a dental specimen of an orycat but was unable to complete a survey of its environment due to inclement conditions.

name: Oskan blood eater
summary: Oskan blood eaters were bipedal carnivores found on a variety of planets, often used as guards for penal colonies. They had two large hooves on each foot and four arms, each ending in a blade-like claw. They fed on any animal with oxygenated blood, preferring large mammalian creatures such as Humans and humanoids. The sight of a humanoid or other prey animal was enough to send them into a violent feeding frenzy. Though their senses were not particularly acute, they were determined trackers, who would hunt escaping prey for weeks. Blood eaters were notable for the gruesome way they killed and ate their prey. They would attack by slashing their prey to bits with their four large, slashing claws, leaving nothing more than a pile of flesh and blood. They would then lower their heads, and drink the remains through their perforated mouths. There was little variation between individual blood eaters, partly because they reproduced through a parthenogenetic process which made every blood eater almost genetically identical to its mother, and partly because of an efficient mutation correction mechanism in their cells. Despite this, they could thrive in a variety of environments on many worlds. [[File:Oskan_blood_eater_2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Nim Abek's blood eater.]] Although they were found in several different systems, blood eaters did not appear in the mythologies of any planet, as carnivores of their size would be expected to. This, together with their genetic peculiarities, led many to believe that they were artificially created creatures. Imperial Intelligence's Destab Branch supported these rumors, claiming that they were developed by the Old Republic. In actuality, they were bio-engineered during the early Clone Wars by the mad genetic terrorist Zeta Magnus. The Galactic Empire would later experiment with the blood eater pups that were recovered from Zeta Magnus's fortress laboratory by Republic clone troopers. Oskan blood eaters were popular with the galactic underworld. The crimelord Jabba Desilijic Tiure once kept a blood eater as a "pet" in his palace on Tatooine. Chalmer Trillili, leader of a pirate gang called "The Scourge," also owned a blood eater, recovered from an Imperial vessel, which he kept as a guard animal in his hideout on Dega. The Nikto shipjacker Nim Abek also kept one for gladiatorial combat. Zeta Magnus grew blood eaters in his palace on the planet Skye and unleashed a small pack of them in subterranean tunnels underneath it as guards. However, this pack was killed thanks to the efforts of Obi-Wan Kenobi and the commando unit known as Tark Squad.

name: Oslet
summary: Oslets were six-limbed, arboreal, three-meter-tall herbivores from Joralla. They were used as mounts by the Tikiarri. An oslet's neck was flexible enough that it could rotate its head 360 degrees.

name: Ossan
summary: The Ossan were a mammalian species used—and sold—as slaves by the Ancient Houses of the Senex sector. Their homeworld was Ossel II, and they had sizable populations on Asmeru and Karfeddion, the latter being used by House Vandron as an Ossan breeding planet.
distinctions: Strong, long toothy snouts, single nostril, floppy ears

name: Oswaft
summary: The Oswaft were sentient, transparent, manta-like creatures that lived inside the ThonBoka nebula in the Centrality.

name: Ot'oak
summary: An Ot'oak, also known as a mole, was a burrowing creature native to Endor.

name: Otolla
summary: The Otolla were one of the two major races of the Gungan species. They were characterized by their tall and usually lanky bodies, longer haillus, prominent bills, and inquisitive eyes that sat up on short stalks. The Otolla were a younger race than the bulkier Ankura. Jar Jar Binks was a typical Otolla.
distinctions: Lanky build, long haillus, retractable eyes

name: Otta
summary: The Otta was a small, mammalian predator native to the Gungan swamps of Naboo.
diet: Fish, nyorks, pom-hoppers, tookes, and typically ollopoms

name: Ottegan
summary: Ottegans were a cousin species to the Ithorians a race of Hammerhead shaped beings from the Ottega system. Praster Ommlen, an devotee of the Sacred Order of Ramulus was a member of the species. As was the criminal Ola Hest who was active during the High Republic Era. They differed from Ithorians by having only one mouth as opposed to two, something which their Ithorian cousins mocked them for.

name: Ovissian
summary: Ovissians were a sentient species with a bipedal figure and two pairs of horns. A population of Ovissians inhabited the planet Krystar by the time of the Clone Wars. The Ovissian Boolio, a mine overseer on the Sinta Glacier ice asteroid, was a secret associate of the Resistance during its war against the First Order.

name: Ovoni
summary: The Ovoni were a humanoid species native to Otavon XII. They opposed the Galactic Empire during its early days. They succeeded in destroying Tremor Base, an Imperial Outpost established for the construction of AT-ATs on Otavon XII.

name: Owl
summary: Owls were non-sentient avian creatures. Types of owls included convorees and snow owls, which could be found on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan in the snowy area surrounding the mountain Appenza Peak. The helmet of the Mandalorian Bo-Katan Kryze incorporated the face of an owl. The Astronomer Kh'ymm, was a owl like alien.

name: Owriss
summary: An Owriss was a large blob-like creature from the forest moon of Endor. They were considered harmless.

name: Ozrelanso
summary: The Ozrelanso were a sentient species found in the galaxy. Male members of the species had lekku that grew on the sides of their skulls.

name: Paaerduag
summary: Paaerduags, whose actual name was unpronounceable in Galactic Basic Standard, were symbionts that consisted of a large, yellowish, hunchbacked, two-legged creature with a small green, four-eyed creature sprouting out of its back. Much of the language, including the true name of their homeworld, was not pronounceable or comprehensible by non-Paaerduag, for one required two mouths and four ears to truly speak and hear it. The green head communicated with non-Paaerduag, as the sounds produced by the other could not be heard by most species. Their homeworld was Sorjus, a planet far off the Perlemian Trade Route. At birth, the two humanoid components were separate beings, which as they grew up, fused together. It seems the larger creature controlled movement as the smaller creature would tell it to turn around so it could see things opposite itself. Paaerduags were seen often around the time of the Jedi Civil War, and Revan encountered two Paaerduags during his travels; one named Ja'Gatcha, who was trapped on Taris due to the Sith quarantine and was likely killed when Darth Malak's fleet bombarded the surface from orbit. Another was named Mic'tunan'jus Orgu, a merchant in Anchorhead on Tatooine.

name: Paar's ichthyodont
summary: Paar's ichthyodonts were large saurian creatures that lived on Panna Prime.

name: Paataatus
summary: The Paataatus were a sentient species with a swarm mentality. The Chiss Ascendancy led an attack on numerous Paataatus fighters above the Paataatus homeworld, Nettehi.

name: Pabu fish
summary: Pabu fish was a type of fish that inhabited the ocean of the planet Pabu. The fish was mostly purple in color with orange on its back and a lighter purple underbelly. It had a single horn protruding from its forehead, black eyes, and teeth that protruded from its mouth. The fish lacked a dorsal fin but had a caudal fin with a forked lower lobe, two pairs of smaller ventral fins, and a large pectoral fin. Large in size, a Pabu fish could be as big as an adult human. Pabu fish were edible by humans. During or after 18 BBY, Clone Force 99 member Wrecker used a fishing pole to catch a Pabu fish while he was fishing off a recently built fishing dock in Lower Pabu. Wrecker proceeded to excitedly tell Mayor Shep Hazard and fellow clone Hunter that he had caught their dinner.

name: Paccosh
summary: The Paccosh, also known as the Pacc, were a sentient species from the planet Rapacc. The Paccosh held females of their own and other species in high, almost venerated, regard. After a group of refugees led by the Magys, escaping a civil war on their homeworld, arrived at Rapacc, they were given shelter by the Paccosh. The Nikardun Destiny, led by General Yiv, blockaded Rapacc, having been manipulated by Haplif of the Agbui. While speaking the trade languages Taarja and Minnisiat, Paccosh made noises likened by the Chiss to the "whinnying" of a packbull. Haplif was responsible for the civil war on the Magys's homeworld, and tricked the Nikardun Destiny into believing that the refugee ship was a group attempting to recruit forces against them. The Magys urged the Paccosh to send out a remnant of their species to escape in case their own world was similarly destroyed. The Paccosh sent out two refugee starships, though neither ship survived. The Paccosh Uingali foar Marocsaa was a leader within the Paccian Governance, and the being from whom future Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn ultimately became acquainted with his personal symbol, the chimaera.

name: Pacithhip
summary: The Pacithhip were a sentient species with wrinkled gray or green skin, long trunks, and twin elaborate tusks. They had two eyes situated on the sides of their head, and the back of their skull was protected by a thick ridge. A Pacithhip named Bok Askol was an acquaintance of the Toydarian junk dealer Watto and attended the Boonta Eve Classic from his private box. Another Pacithhip, named Ketwol, was in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, Mos Eisley, on the fateful day that Luke Skywalker first met Han Solo.

name: Packbull
summary: Packbulls were a non-sentient species domesticated by the Chiss. Packbulls were known to "whinny", a sound that sky-walker Che'ri drew a comparison to for the accents of the Paccosh when speaking Minnisiat. Packbulls were also protective of their fields, as exemplified by the expression "wandering into the packbull's field alone."

name: Pada
summary: The Pada were a species of round-faced, mammalian bipeds. They had yellow fur, short horns, and large claws that made them excellent at climbing. They also had superb night vision. The Pada were extremely peaceful and honorable and were not allowed to kill another being, even in self-defense.

name: Padlom
summary: The Padlom were a sentient species. The former bounty hunter Rheena Sul was a member of the species.

name: Paigun
summary: Paiguns were toadlike sapients indigenous to the planet Paigu. The Paigun body shape was similar to that of the Muuns, though they had knobby, scaly skin and were often more technologically apt. Paiguns were famous for their love of mathematics and logical thinking. They did not like fighting and preferred to let others fight for them. Many were talented engineers and mechanics. Some engineers, called "amptechs" had the duty of maintaining the massive lightning rods that powered major cities on their stormy homeworld.

name: Painted spat
summary: The painted spat was a subtype of carrion spat, an avian creature native to the Corellian system. A mutated variant, this creature was larger, stronger and more resistant to average carrion spat. Somewhat similar in appearance to the carrion spats of Corellia, the painted spat differed: The coloration of the skin was much darker with pronounced horizontal stripes along the back; the bony structure protruding from the mandible was not, from appearance, a true beak (the jaw did not resemble a beak at all, rather, resembling a reptilian jaw).

name: Pakiphantos
summary: Pakiphantos were a sentient elephantine species that existed in the galaxy. They had large ears, pillar-like feet, and trunks which they could use to make a trumpeting noise.

name: Pakoukou
summary: Pakoukou was a species of large intelligent mollusk that existed in the galaxy. At the time of the Invasion of Naboo, one such sentient mollusk kept records for Senator Tikkes, who represented his homeworld of Mon Cala in the Galactic Republic's Senate. It rested in a pool in Tikkes's office at the Senate Building.

name: Palak
summary: Palaks were an insect species of near-microscopic beetle which were believed to share large portions of their genome with the predatory voroos species. Zoologists theorized that voroos, which were immobile, reproduced through palaks, with the beetles exchanging genetic information with the large animals and then carrying the fertilized gametes to new environments. Voroos could be found on many planets across the galaxy in almost any environment, meaning if the theory was correct, palaks would be found in each of these areas as well.

name: Palandag
summary: Palandags were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They were notable for having an exolung. Dhuz, Hhex, and Jhat were Palandags who worked as musicians. Palandags' language was comprised of sounds that some considered to be naturally musical.

name: Palarian
summary: The Palarians were a sentient species native to the planet Pal Goral. They were often recruited to work on the Corporate Sector world of Duroon. Once there, however, the promised jobs turned out to be a position of near-slavery, and the Palarians were forced to mine the planet's vast resources alongside other indentured species. The Palarians did not take this turn of events laying down, and started a guerrilla war against the Corporate Sector Authority.

name: Paledor
summary: Paledors were Corellian animals that became extinct. Han Solo acquired a small, valuable statue of one such animal when he robbed Teroenza's collection.

name: Pallaskean
summary: The pallaskean was a species of sea serpent that resided in the oceans of the planet Ahch-To. While training with Luke Skywalker on Ahch-To, Rey uncovered a pallaskean nest, angering the mother, which then attacked them. The two of them and Chewbacca rushed in and replaced the rock over the eggs. After the creature was pacified, Rey confirmed that she learned a lesson about rushing in.

name: Palliduvan
summary: Palliduvans were a near-human species From the Wild Space planet Palliduva, characterized by their lanky frames, chalk-white skin, and long, bony fingers used to draw blood. Palliduvans included the bounty hunter Aurra Sing and the pirate Valik.

name: Palmien
summary: The Palmiens du Tigre, or simply Palmiens, were humanoids indigenous to the planet Palme du Tigre. The Palmiens had a pre-spatial technology level. They were apparently wiped out as the last test of a stormtrooper training program.

name: Pa'lowick
summary: Pa'lowicks were a sentient species of long-limbed reptilian humanoids that had spotted skin, eyes that protruded from the tops of their heads, and trunk-like mouths. Sy Snootles, the lead singer of the Max Rebo Band, was a Pa'lowick.
skinColor: Yellow, with blue or purple spots
distinctions: Long limbs, protruding eyes, spotted skin, trunk-like mouths

name: Pamarthen
summary: Pamarthens were a cultural group of humans from the planet of Pamarthe. They had their own language and they enjoyed a reputation for courage, skill, and enthusiasm. Most Pamarthens learned how to handle watercraft at a young age and, eventually, how to pilot starships. They were also reputed for producing a high-octane wine known as the Port in a Storm that few other humans could drink. Greer Sonnel, Bors, Torret, and Vee were Pamarthen.

name: Pan-preneur
summary: The Pan-preneur were amphibious sentients indigenous to Sonn Vilmari. They resembled many other aquatic races, and were believed to be distantly related genetically to the Mon Calamari, though many aquatic species shared similar genetics.

name: Panagra
summary: The panagra were a predatory species which stalked their prey. They were native to the planet Dressel, where they lived in steepara forests and posed a constant threat to the sentient Dressellian species who also called the planet home.

name: Pangrack
summary: The pangrack was a species of creature.

name: "Panna bird"
summary: This bird was an avian that lived on the Mud Moon of Panna. The animal had blue feathers, a long, thin beak, large and pale bulbous eyes, and long, thin legs nearly equal in length to its body, from beak to tail tip. The bird species fed at waterways and walked through the garbage heaps outside of Panna City. One specimen witnessed the bounty hunter Boba Fett and Wookiee Rebel Chewbacca leave the city on a Paar's ichthyodont shortly after the Battle of Yavin, being pursued by an Imperial patrol on a speeder.

name: Panna dragon
summary: The Panna dragons were large reptilian creatures that lived on Panna Prime.

name: Pantolomin halfback
summary: The Pantolomin halfback was a creature native to Pantolomin and used in the gambling game Halfback's Bluff.

name: Pantoran
summary: The Pantorans were blue-skinned near-humans native to the moon Pantora. They were part of the Galactic Republic, during the waning years of that government.

name: Pantran whitefang
summary: Pantran whitefangs, also known as Ice Cats, were a non-sentient feline species native to the planet of Hoth. They had the characteristic of having their bodies composed for the mostly of muscles. These felines did not store any fat, and consequently had to constantly be on the hunt. On Hoth they were the only creatures capable of matching the speed of a tauntaun, making them their only "active" predator. During the Cold War, some crime lords tried to capture wild whitefangs in order to train them as guard animals, but these experiments always ended with the death of both the trainers and the beasts. On the other hand, these crime lords had a lot of profit with the underground arenas, where they let the felines duel to death.

name: Pappfak
summary: A Pappfak was the name of an alien species known for possessing long, blue-colored tentacles. Pappfaks could regularly be found inhabiting the marketplaces at Mos Eisley on the planet, Tatooine. They may have had three sexes: at the wedding of Lady Valarian, musician Doikk Na'ts of the Modal Nodes observed three of them in what he described as a "prenuptial embrace."

name: Paqwe
summary: The Paqwe were aliens native to the planet Paqwepor Major. They loved good bargains, tall tales, and had big ambitions. Most hated politics and any law that could limit their expressive freedom, basically any law. They were short with yellow-green skin, had a wide carriage and a sway-backed, waddling gait.

name: Para fish
summary: Para fish were a type of silver-scaled fish with black eyes. They were found inhabiting large water bodies on the planet Bogano. Primarily feeding on small fragments of algae and other plants, many of the fish would die off if algae supplies became scarce. When this happened, the decomposition of the dead para fish would raise the acidity of the water body. This acidity would then wear down the ground below the water and form sinkholes. In 14 BBY, a group of para fish were living in a pool at the bottom of the cave known as the Subterranean Refuge on Bogano. While on Bogano in 14 BBY, the former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis had his droid companion, BD-1, scan the para fish in the Subterranean Refuge and added an entry on the fish to droid's databank.

name: Paralope
summary: Paralope were grazing herd animals native to Talus. Paralope sported two backward pointing horns. Their young had fur in a shade of either gray or black. They were a common sight, and specimens could also be found on Corellia, though its unknown how they arrived there. This goes for most Talusian creatures that ended up on Corellia The acicular defender was a subspecies bred for the defense of the herd.

name: Paralyngian dire slug
summary: The Paralyngian dire slug was a bloated gastropod credited to be discovered by the Devaronian hyperspace trailblazer Viron Ghartoth. By Ghartoth's standards, the slug was deemed "excellent" when lightly broiled. Ghartoth once presented his patron, Gerba the Hutt, with a dish of the slugs in fruit sauce, however Gerba had a virulent allergic reaction. Gerba never fully recovered, and from his sickbed, Gerba had Ghartoth slowly devoured by a captive acklay.

name: Pardlam
summary: The pardlam were creatures native to a planet. The balyeg preyed on the pardlam. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, in 25 ABY, the cargo ship Pardlam participated in the battle of Shramar.

name: Parfue gnat
summary: Parfue gnats were parasitic sanguivores which fed on the blood of watumba bats. Glottalphibs ate parfue gnats.

name: Parvinoth
summary: Parvinoths were non-sentient insects found on planets throughout Outer Rim Territories, including the forested planet Ashas Ree. While on a supply run in 34 ABY, the siblings Kel and Eila followed a swarm of the creatures to the entrance of Ashas Ree's Temple of the Force, entranced by their beauty.
homeworld: Throughout planets in the Outer Rim Territories

name: Parwan
summary: Parwans were a sentient species native to Parwa. During the High Republic Era, Parwan Jedi Master Obratuk Glii was a respected diplomat within the Jedi Order. During the Clone Wars, the Parwan Derrown was considered one of the best bounty hunters in the galaxy by Count Dooku.

name: Pascwa
summary: The Pascwa were a sentient species that lived on Pii IV, a planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

name: Pashvi
summary: The Pashvi were a sentient species whose bodies, while largely humanoid, featured a wider torso and/or longer arms than a Human. They lived on a planet in the Pashvi system of Wild Space, the surface of which was dotted with many thousands of rock pillars, atop which grew both edible plants and extremely dangerous flying predators. That led to the Pashvi becoming both attracted to and frightened of the pillars and, more generally, made them keep their emotional distance from people and things they valued. Pashvi were generally peaceable beings with little skill or inclination for fighting. Their homeworld was raided by the Vagaari nomads some point prior to 27 BBY. Pashvi art had a stable but small market, mostly in the Corporate Sector.
distinctions: Humanoid, with a wide torso and/or long arms

name: Pastorian
summary: Pastorians were a sentient species with several insectoid features from the Outer Rim planet Pastoria.

name: Patitite
summary: Patitites were a species of diminutive sentients native to the planet Patitite Pattuna. During the Clone Wars, they had to start a democracy after the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 caused the death of their dictator, "Big" Hay-Zu.

name: Patrolian
summary: Patrolians were a highly intelligent piscine amphibious sentient species that were native to the aquatic planet Patrolia. With gills and fins on their heads, they were able to live both underwater and capable of breathing air and living on land, but were most comfortable underwater, preferring to be immersed in liquid. They were extremely resourceful, and often worked as bounty hunters. When not in water, their clothes required alteration to accommodate the protruding dorsal fin on their backs. Bannamu, Kanna, and Robonino were members of this species.

name: Pau'an
summary: Pau'ans were gaunt, long-limbed humanoids from Utapau. They dwelled in their planet's sinkholes, and tamed the local varactyl for riding. Due to their long life-span, they were also known as the Ancients. The Utai, another indigenous species that lived on Utapau, along with the Pau'ans, were collectively known as the Utapauns.

name: Pau'an and Utai precursor species
summary: Eons before the Clone Wars, a species of sentient, spacefaring nonhumans settled the planet of Utapau, in the Tarabba sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim. Some created homes in the sinkholes of Utapau, while others chose to live on the planetary surface. Over time, the original colonists evolved into two distinct species: the tall and long-lived Pau'ans, and the diminutive Utai.

name: Paulef
summary: Paulef were a non-sentient creature that had delicate hands.

name: Peacock
summary: Peacocks were creatures that sported long, ostentatious tails that trailed behind them. Vain or ostentatious people were sometimes compared to a peacock. The Imperial bureaucrat Arsin Crassus sometimes wore a glittering robe trailing behind him like a peacock's tail.

name: Peasle
summary: The Peasle were an insectoid sentient species. They possessed orange shells and a natural urge to roll into a ball at the first sign of danger. During the High Republic Era, the Peasle Skuun served as an assistant to space traffic controller Milon Thakkery on a space traffic control satellite above the planet Valo. Skritt was a Peasle who was a member of the Rebel Alliance during the time of the Galactic Empire.

name: Peckva
summary: Peckva were a non-sentient species of ungulates native to Maryo, a resort planet in the Corporate Sector. They were known for their speed and were hunted by the rich who visited the world.

name: Pecoppi parrot
summary: Pecoppi parrots were a species of barely-sentient birds from the planet Recopia. The parrots were often drugged and sold to pet collectors. These birds were an intelligent species, that were one of the few animals that could speak various languages. The birds were herbivores, eating berries and fruits, but occasionally ate insects. They could be found in various bright colors, and were often were affectionate to other parrots and other species, and were social and curious birds. They were not classified as sentient, although they passed the sentience test. They were illegal to hunt, however they were classified as threatened due to poaching and smuggling.

name: Pectin-fly
summary: Pectin-flies were insects eaten by the Kubaz species in at least one dish.

name: Peeper
summary: Peepers were birds found on Belsavis. The planet Kegan had humming peepers.

name: Peeples's species
summary: Peeples's species was a species of sentient beings with nineteen eyes and a snout-like proboscis. The species displayed a unique understanding of what was an appropriate moment to tell a joke. In 232 BBY, Galactic Republic Ensign Peeples was a member of the species who served aboard the Longbeam cruiser Aurora IX of the Republic Defense Coalition. He helped rescue the personnel of a damaged solar collection station during a disaster in the Hetzal system, for which he was promoted to lieutenant.

name: Peko-peko
summary: Peko-peko were a type of flying creatures that could be found in the swamps of the planet Naboo.
distinctions: Clawed wings, long tail, prominent beak

name: Pelikki
summary: Pelikki were a species of non-sentient, river-dwelling birds from the planet Naboo. They had an expandable throat pouch in which they held their aquatic prey when hunting.

name: Pelko bug
summary: Pelko bugs were small creatures that were covered in millions of microscopic barbs that delivered a paralytic, blistering toxin which could penetrate armor. They lived only beneath sands of the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban, and were attracted to Force-sensitives. They would stalk and swarm their prey in the darkness. The bug's attunement to the Force allowed them to determine if a creature was suitable prey, as Darth Bane found when exploring the Valley, in which they found he was too powerful and did not attack. The barbs were used in training sabers at the Sith Academy because of the toxin's effects, which mimicked the effects of losing a limb to a lightsaber.

name: Pellata
summary: Pellata birds were a type of yellow bird introduced to Belsavis from Ithor.

name: Pendago
summary: Pendago were a sentient species with multiple tentacled limbs. One Pendago was a member of the Razorclaw Gang on Serenno, and had several of its limbs cut off by Asajj Ventress, who was attempting to learn the location of the Crolute criminal Glute.

name: Pendalanorian
summary: Pendalanorians were gigantic, skeletal humanoids native to the jungle planet Pendalanor. They had translucent skin and slightly fluorescent bones. A few months before the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, a group of Rebels stationed on the planet Hoth once sought the help of the Ho'Din Ho-Jon on Pendalanor. Ho-Jon, who specialized in tropical diseases, was the only one who could permanently heal General Hamilton Hammond's rare disease. The Rebels located Ho-Jon with ease, however, he refused to leave the planet until the rebels got rid of a recently arrived group of Imperial deserters. The Rebels used the local Pendalanorians to scare the group off-world.

name: Penguin
summary: Penguins were a sentient species flightless bird.

name: Pentabat
summary: A pentabat was a small creature that lived on Sophros. They had five legs and small wings that were tipped with claws. Their shell was hard and iridescent. They attacked in swarms and left a smell of burnt sulfur when ignited. A group of them attacked the Luminous Nine after their shuttle crash-landed on Sophros.

name: Peripleen
summary: Peripleen were long-living, simian sentients with strong jaws and arms. Wim Smoot, an inmate on Oovo IV, was a Peripleen.
distinctions: Reptilian apes, strong jaws and arms

name: Perkle
summary: Perkles were a mammalian species from the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Perlek
summary: Perleks were flying creatures that lived on Lok. They usually followed predators to scavenge off the carcasses left behind. Following the Battle of Yavin, the collector Breac Slaus tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of perleks.

name: Peroenian
summary: The Peroenians were a Near-Human species that originated on the planet of Peroenia, in the Unknown Regions. They had six digits on each of their hands and feet, and they also had long, yellow-and-gray-colored hair. The Peroenians were keen explorers and after they learned that the rival Shorak species had discovered the planet of Giaca, the Peroenians dispatched a number of expeditions to Giaca. The Shorak eventually attempted to establish a permanent colony on Giaca and the Peroenians sent a military force to ambush the colonists in the Giaca system, sparking a three-hundred-year-long war between the two species in which the Shorak were eventually victorious. Thousands of years later, about two decades before the Clone Wars, the Shorak re-established a settlement on Giaca and in response, the Peroenians dispatched representatives of their own to establish a presence on the world. While a number of skirmishes broke out on Giaca between the two species, the Shorak were eventually able to establish a permanent colony on the planet. However, the Peroenians continued to harry them and they frequently launched attacks on the Shorak colony.
distinctions: Six digits on each hand and foot

name: Persta
summary: Perstas were a bipedal species with large hind limbs upon which they hopped. Norky was a Persta.

name: Perthrillian nightwasp
summary: A Perthrillian nightwasp was a winged insect from the Perthrillia system. Nick Rostu claimed he could clip the wings of this insect with a gun at a thousand meters and not wake it up.

name: Pervian blood crow
summary: The Pervian blood crow was a type of bird that often swarmed on wonderhawks.

name: Petrusian
summary: Petrusians were a sentient species that was from the planet Petrusia. Kristiss and her father Rythus were members of this species. A group of Petrusians were held as slaves by the Galactic Empire at the Imperial outpost of Kullgroon, leading Kristiss to hire the smuggler Lando Calrissian to deliver arms to Kullgroon so they could gain their freedom.

name: Phantasmal beast
summary: Phantasmal beasts, also called phantasmal beasts of Moraband, were creatures of the dark side native to the planet Moraband. They had the rough appearance and movement of a canine predator. The beasts were concealed amid inky, tangible shadow except for their teeth and Red eyes. The beasts fed on terror rather than flesh, they hunted in packs to inflict suffering on their prey. It was unknown if the beasts were animals corrupted by the dark side or illusions of the force. It was also unknown if the beasts felt pain.

name: Phantidean
summary: Phantideans were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had pink skin and large tusks.

name: Pharple
summary: Pharples were small, flightless birds with long beaks native to the desert world of Lok. These cowardly insectivores caused little trouble to sentient beings. Breeds of pharple included giant pharples and runty pharples. During the Galactic Civil War, the Sulfur Lake Pirates tamed a giant pharple that they named Nym's Girlfriend as a means by which to humiliate their enemy Nym. The creature was later killed in the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout by a spacer working for Grenz Zittoun of the Lok Revenants.

name: Pherin
summary: Pherin were a species of omnivorous creature that were native to the planet Nyriaan.
distinctions: Able to assume one of three genders

name: Phidna
summary: Phidnas were a type of glowing parasitic insect native to the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. They were smaller and less deadly then the world's three-meter long sand snakes. Phidnas were domesticated and harvested by the native Geonosian species, who mixed phidna excretions, including their dung, with stone powder to make rock paste, a durable material that set as hard as rock and was used to fashion Geonosian buildings and spires. This included the brown walls of the conference room in the Stalgasin hive where the Executive Separatist Council met prior to the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY. Geonosis was sterilized by the Galactic Empire around 9 BBY, killing all but one of its Geonosian population.

name: P'hiili
summary: P'hiili were a species of aquatic creatures that were native to the world of Yuuzhan'tar. When the sentient Yuuzhan Vong, also native to Yuuzhan'tar, invaded another galaxy, they took knowledge of the genetic makeup of the p'hiili with them. The aquatic creatures were recreated and placed on the terraformed world of Coruscant after the Yuuzhan Vong captured it in 27 ABY.

name: Phillak
summary: Phillak were creatures native to the mountains of the planet Zeffo.

name: Phindian
summary: Phindians were a humanoid reptilian sentient species native to the planet Phindar that featured green skin, yellow eyes, elongated skulls, and long arms that extended past their knees. They were cautious by nature and generally preferred to avoid trouble. Osi Sobeck of the Confederacy of Independent Systems was a member of this species, as well as the criminal Moralo Eval. Other members included Hem and his wife, Teeyr Hem, and the administrator of the Phindar tanker facility.

name: Phlog
summary: Phlogs were a sentient species that inhabited the moon of Endor. A crash millennium ago was thought to bring them and Gorax to the moon.

name: Pho Ph'eahian
summary: The Pho Ph'eahians were a sentient people indigenous to Pho Ph'eah. They were generally humanoid bipeds whose four arms and bright blue fur made them stand out in a crowd. Their fur helped keep them warm on their cool, dimly lit homeworld, while their extra set of arms had such obvious advantages as allowing them to arm-wrestle two opponents at once. [[File:PhoPheahian-AE.png|thumb|left|150px|A Pho Ph'eahian.]] Pho Ph'eahians were mountain-dwelling omnivores, eating the small animals that lived on their planet and vegetables grown in their technologically advanced agricultural areas. They were interested in discovering new ways to improve food production. When they were first contacted by the Galactic Republic thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin, they had already developed nuclear fission and limited in-system flight. Since making contact with the Republic, their technological base quickly expanded. Soon, they became developers and exporters of a wide variety of high-technology products, from new agricultural methods to weapons and hyperdrives. Pho Ph'eahians were usually gregarious and cheerful, and they enjoyed being the center of attention. Though not many traveled offworld, those who did were often successful as entertainers. Others found high-paying work as starship mechanics and engineers, especially in the Corporate Sector. Another unique characteristic of Pho Ph'eahian culture was their concern for personal cleanliness. Pho Ph'eahians regarded their bodies as sacred, and intimately tied to their souls. Thus, any stain on their bodies could stain their souls if not quicky cleaned off. For example, Pho Ph'eahian mechanics, while not fearful of getting dirty in their work, always carried towels to wipe the grime and grease off their hands.

name: Phosflea
summary: Phosfleas were bioluminescent insects from Kashyyyk. Wookiees would use scented compounds to lure them into mesh lanterns and use them for light. They were one of the many bioluminescent organisms found in the lower levels of the wroshyr tree forests, which experienced continual darkness due to the thick canopy above. Because they could fly, they would make nightly migrations to the upper reaches of the forest.

name: Phosphor bug
summary: Phosphor bugs, also known as firebugs, were flying insects that flashed light. They were native to Belsavis.

name: Photon spider
summary: Photon spiders were bioluminescent crystalline predators native to Varl. They survived on the planet despite the desolation which caused its abandonment by the Hutts and t'landa Til. They required no air to survive, and lived on veins of aurodium.

name: Phydolon
summary: The Phydolon were a paired symbiotic sentient species native to the planet Mydasos that existed in the galaxy.
eyeColor: White iris with dark sclera and white fungal threads
distinctions: Symbiotic fungus/humanoid, gangly limbs, three fingers

name: Picolet beetle
summary: The picolet beetle was a species of beetle native to the planet Kubindi. Garindan ezz Zavor's clan was known for breeding and farming a sought-after strain of picolet beetle deemed "succulent" by the insectivorous Kubaz.

name: Pig rodent
summary: Pig rodents were a species of large rotund herbivorous creatures, native to the planet of Dathomir. These animals had clawed feet, large rodent-like incisors and long whiskers on their snouts. When scared, they could run very fast from danger through the underbrush. Pig rodents were often hunted by rancors. Dathomiri witches sometimes used pig rodents as a bait for catching wild rancors in snares.

name: Pijal varactyl
summary: Pijal varactyls were a subspecies of the reptavians, varactyls. The original varactyls had been imported to Pijal from Utapau by the Iltan clan to have an edge in the Grand Hunt. They were bred into the unique streamlined, swift, crimson-feathered Pijal varactyl. While on Pijal, Obi-Wan Kenobi formed a bond with one of these varactyls, which he later rode in the Grand Hunt.

name: Pijali
summary: The Pijali were a cultural group of humans from the Inner Rim planet Pijal and its moon. By 40 BBY, a group of Pijali known as the Opposition began to protest the signing of the Governance Treaty, which would form a democratic Assembly that would lack proper representation for the Pijali citizens of the planet's moon.

name: Pikaati
summary: The Pikaati were a bipedal sentient species whose heads had two large, bulbous cranial lobes and breathed hydrogen cyanide, a gas that was poisonous to humans. They created Pikaati armor, a rare black armor that was able to withstand blaster fire, which was confiscated from them. A full suit of Pikaati gear ended up in the possession of Thetis Quelton, the owner of Quelton Fabrications, who complemented the Pikaati on their craftsmanship and believed that she could get some ideas from their armor.
distinctions: Bipedal, two large, bulbous cranial lobes, breathed hydrogen cyanide

name: Piket
summary: Piket were slow-moving, long-necked, non-aggressive creatures native to the planet Dantooine. Though by nature they are non-aggressive, they were social creatures and would attack in groups if any individual was attacked. As they always traveled in large packs, this could prove to be extremely dangerous to any hunting parties.

name: Pikhron
summary: Pikhrons were a species of naturally herbivore mammals that lived on the planet Devaron. They were valued for their skin and teeth which would fetch considerable prices in the black market since the Galactic Empire had forbidden the hunting of Pikhrons. Pikhrons had a crown of several horns atop their heads.

name: Pikobi
summary: The pikobis were a species of small, non-sentient, fast-moving reptavian that were native to Naboo and could also be found on many other planets.

name: Pikpik
summary: Pikpik were a diminutive, sentient rodent species. Some Pikpiks worked as scrappers on the planet Bracca during the High Republic Era.

name: Pili Walde's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Pili Walde was a member of the species.

name: Pill bug
summary: Pill bugs were bugs that were used for entertainment.

name: Pilotta thranta
