summary: The pilotta thranta was one of the several species of thranta that were native to the planet Alderaan, which was destroyed by the Galactic Empire, and thus became extinct. They were considered the second largest of the thranta species, smaller only than the great thranta. Unlike the other species of thranta, the pilotta thranta possessed black skin on its dorsal side, while it had white skin on its underside. Their noses were short and pointed. The tails of the beasts were also somewhat different as they possessed three lobes instead of the four that were present on the common thranta and balana thranta. Like its cousins, the pilotta species would be trained to carry passengers with a compartment hanging from their bodies. Holograms of the pilotta thranta and many other species that suffered extinction in the destruction of Alderaan were displayed at the Holographic Zoo of Extinct Animals. Lyrre T'enna used the streams there to create sketches to be compiled in a field guide.

name: Pineath
summary: Pineath were a species of sentient beings originating from the Unknown Regions. They had burgundy colored feathers. Their culture included a habit that if one of them was harmed by an outsider, they demanded another life in return. They considered it "proper return of cost" to demand the return of doubled or tripled price. They were also concerned with matters of public honor and were reluctant to lose their face in front of the crowd. While they were able to speak Galactic Basic Standard, their own language sounded clickety in Human ears.

name: Pinedriller
summary: Pinedrillers were a type of creature that produced wool and could be found in the coastal forests of the archipelagos on the Outer Rim planet Ueda, home of the Ueda conifer pine. During the High Republic Era, the trapper Dyn Pilga kept the pinedriller population under control during winters and in 132 BBY he wore a black pinedriller wool hat when visiting the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop in Point Ueda, capital of Ueda.

name: Pink blob
summary: The pink blobs were possibly semi-sentient creatures that could join together to form other objects, including various technologies, such as an OG-9 homing spider droid. Each blob had six claws, along with a metal device on its back. [[File:Pink_blobs.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Anakin Skywalker and Serra Keto fighting pink blobs in the form of OG-9 homing spider droids.]] In 19 BBY, the blobs were responsible for taking down a horned green Jedi and a contingent of clone troopers aboard the space station, the Brink of the Celestial Wake in the Outer Rim Territories. Jedi Knight Serra Keto managed to destroy the blobs with the assistance of Anakin Skywalker, who tore a hole in the space station wall, leading to the station's explosive demise.

name: Pinurquian
summary: Pinurquians were a species of horned humanoids active in the galaxy. One well known member was Tinketh Fo, the leader of the planet Keyorin. The Alderaanian Resistance encountered the animated corpse of a Pinurquian in Darth Rivan's secret archive room on Almas. The Pinurquian had been killed in a firefight between the Stalfonauts and Jacen Yar's team of bounty hunters.

name: Pipa bird
summary: Pipa birds were a species of small bird with white feathers. Known for their long pink beaks and distinctive morning calls, they inhabited regions ranging from the jungles of Batuu’s southern hemisphere to the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost. Their songs were commonly heard within Black Spire from the nearby forests after sunrise.

name: Pipe-bird
summary: Pipe-birds were a type of bird with the ability to whistle. According to the maniacal ex-surgeon Cornelius Evazan, a dying princess in the Kingdom of Tion taught her pipe-bird to whistle her favorite song thousands of years before the Imperial Era. Other pipe-birds learned to mimic the princess' song and spread it throughout the galaxy over thousands of years. Evazan recorded the story—which he considered to be bittersweet—for his partner Ponda Baba in an entry of the Smuggler's Guide logbook while it was in his possession at some point between 1 BBY and around 1 ABY. He claimed that every time Baba heard a pipe-bird, it was as if a princess sung to him from beyond the grave. Evazan used this to emphasis his desire for immortality.

name: Pipe-weasel
summary: A pipe-weasel was a type of weasel. In 4 ABY, the human child Jak requested an electromagnetic pulse weapon from the Iktotchi crime lord Talvee Chawin as a reward for saving Chawin's associate Lazula. The crime lord—who operated out of Level 1313 on the planet Coruscant and suspected that Jak may have set up Lazula in the first place—explained that such a gift came with the cost of Jak having to work for him. The boy complained that saving Lazula should have been enough, but Chawin countered that it was only enough to prevent him from gutting Jak like a pipe-weasel. Jak then accepted Chawin's terms.

name: Pipunt
summary: Pipunt were a sentient species native to the planet Rena. Their occupations included hunting, winegrowing and winemaking. Pipunt revered the stars and a local predator, known as Renan bloodwolf, whom they called the "Great Beast Prince".

name: Pipyyrian
summary: Pipyyrians were a sentient species native to the planet Pipyyr.
hairColor: Shades of black, white and grey

name: Piranha
summary: Piranhas were carnivorous fish with green scales. They were found on Endor and Dagobah. Another variety existed on Hoth.

name: Piranha beetle
summary: Piranha beetles were a species of beetle native to the moon Yavin 4. The beetles harassed runyips while the other species foraged on the floor of the moon's forests.

name: Piranha eel
summary: Piranha eels were a type of eel that traveled in shoals. In 382 BBY, while traveling through the treacherous atmosphere of Wild Space's Planet X known as the Veil, the Path of the Open Hand Force religion member Marda Ro noticed balls of liquid swarming toward the Scupper, the ship of the smuggler Sunshine Dobbs that Ro and her companions were traveling aboard, that resembled a shoal of piranha eels.

name: Pirate gull
summary: Pirate gulls were seabirds from Vjun.

name: Pitdog
summary: A pitdog was a type of dog. In 382 BBY, the Disciples of the Whills chief archivist Feric Oranalli was intimidated by the Evereni Path of the Open Hand cult member Yana Ro into taking her to see Werth Plouth—the Path's Herald—who had been imprisoned in the Temple of the Kyber in the Holy City on the Mid Rim moon Jedha. After they arrived at Plouth's cell, Oranalli informed him of what Ro had done, referring to her as his pitdog.

name: Piton
summary: The Piton were a species from the planet Piton with pale skin. They were known for being tall and thin, with high foreheads. They also had near-white eyes. Most Pitons lived underground, causing them to have translucent skin and no hair. When traveling off world, they were forced to don eye shields to block any glare from a given planet's sun. Jedi Knight Miro Daroon was of this species.

name: Pitrillistian
summary: The Pitrillistians were a sentient species of large, imposing beings hailing from the planet Pitrillistia, in the Mieru'kar sector. They were a peaceful people who communicated through a series of musical buzzes. The Pitrillistians were marked by the fact that they had two completely different fine manipulators—the left was more insectoid, while the right was more humanoid.
distinctions: One humanoid hand, one insectoid hand

name: Pkorian
summary: Pkorians were a sentient species from Pkori. The species had red skin, long fingers, two hearts, and unusually keen senses. They could also have blue eyes and brown hair. By 22 BBY, no one in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant knew about the species or its origins, and there were no records of its home planet in the Jedi archives. One member of the species, Iskat Akaris, was a former Jedi Knight who joined the ranks of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius as the Thirteenth Sister.

name: Plague fly
summary: Plague flies were a type of fly. In 229 BBY, Jedi Master Avar Kriss was aboard a transport piloted by the Ugnaught Belin that was trying to evade a swarm of the Nihil marauders' scav droids in an asteroid belt in the Prandril system. When Kriss saw the scav droids coming around the far side of the asteroid belt, she mentally compared the way they swooped and shifted their direction to a vast cloud of plague flies.

name: Plague wasp
summary: The plague wasp was a creature from Delphon.

name: Plain hunda
summary: Plain hundas were non-sentient creatures that resided on the Inner Rim desert planet Sergia. Commander Luke Skywalker of the Rebel Alliance used the distraction caused by a herd of plain hundas to destroy an Imperial probe droid while on a mission to the planet.

name: Plains panther
summary: The Plains panther was a type of predator native to the planet Froswythe.

name: Plasmar
summary: The Plasmars were transparent, amoeba-like creatures native to dark world Y'nybeth. Living in an unlit environment, they absorbed any available warmth into their bodies.

name: Plattahr's species
summary: An alien race with huge, muscular bodies and heads that resembled the tips of stalks on their necks. No eyes or noses were visible on their heads, and a small opening revealed their mouths. Plattahr was a member of the species.

name: Platypus
summary: A platypus was a sentient species with teal fur, a duck-like bill, a flat, orange tail, and webbed feet. It communicated by making a repetitive clicking noise with its mouth. Their eyes could be brown. The Alliance to Restore the Republic agent Perry was a member of the species.

name: Plavonian starfish
summary: The Plavonian starfish was an aquatic creature native to the Plavonia system. Plavonian starfish could be stuffed and eaten as part of a meal, and were served aboard the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan and at the annual Vor-cal Feast held aboard the House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge over the planet Vycinyth.

name: Pleeky
summary: A popular pet on the Chadra-Fan homeworld of Chad, the pleeky, also named the chak-chak, was a species of rodent which was miniscule in stature. The pleeky's features inspired the design of Rebaxan Columni's MSE-series "mouse droid," and despite the manufacturing executives' hope that customers would find the MSEs cute, many buyers found the machines discomforting. Faced with bankruptcy toward the Clone Wars' end, the company sold all of its MSE-6-series repair droids to the new Galactic Empire.

name: Pliith
summary: The Pliith were a sentient species of plants. Lacking independent locomotion, the species was dependent on other species for movement. Their plant-like physiology required substantial amounts of sunshine, together with rain and fertilizer. A notable Pliith was Linkaas, president of Linkaas Corporation. Ruthless in his business endeavors, he tried to have his courier Dannen Lifehold killed so that he could retain the starship he had exchanged with the Human for a substantial debt. That plan was thwarted, however, and Lifehold fled his employ.

name: Plinovian
summary: Plinovians were the native species of the planet Plin Minor. They were gaseous life-forms that were able to self-combust when riled up.

name: Plumed rasp
summary: The howling plumed rasp was a small, dangerous bird native to the planet Talus.

name: Pluripleq
summary: A pluripleq was a tentacled creature that was created with bioengineering and possessed shapeshifting abilities. With only a few made, one was stolen from a biofarm on the astronomical object Thannt by the criminal surgeon Cornelius Evazan, using it to disguise himself as an alien named "Lopset Yas." Evazan's disguise tricked Chelli Aphra, his fellow inmate at the wreckage-prison Accresker Jail who believed he was a changeling. Aphra used "Yas's" apparent shapeshifting powers, in reality the pluripleq, to lie to the vigilante Tam Posla, who was hunting Evazan. However, the surgeon was able to use his disguise to fool the vigilante, and in the confusion captured Aphra and the assassin droid 0-0-0, the latter having killed Posla. Evazan revealed his identity to Aphra afterwards. Later on, Evazan used the pluripleq to pose as Princess Leia Organa in order to hire the hunters Winloss and Nokk, although the latter's sense of smell made him suspicious of a ruse.

name: Pocket orlax
summary: The "pocket" orlax was a tamer, non-venomous version of the orlax. Initially smuggled onto Nar Shaddaa as pets, they quickly became an invasive species on the planet. By the time of the Third Galactic War, they were a popular choice for pets.

name: Pointer fish
summary: Pointer fish were a species of fish native to Dac. They were eaten raw, rolled in pieces of lampfish tongue.

name: Polar bear
summary: A polar bear was a type of bear. The alien Sweebotta resembled a polar bear.

name: Poldt
summary: Poldts were lanky sapient bipeds that superficially bore some resemblance to Gungans and the Geonosians.

name: Poletec
summary: The Poletecs were a species of purple, red, or beige-skinned, lanky humanoids native to the planet Skako Minor. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, Clone Captain Rex, and Clone Force 99 encountered the inhabitants of a Poletec village while on a mission to rescue their fellow clone trooper Echo. Later, the Galactic Republic troopers were forced to visit the village a second time to ask for aid from the Poletec leader, Qin Yazal. The chieftain was reluctant at first, however he was eventually convinced. Both clones and Poletecs fought advancing droids from the Separatist army. With help from Skywalker, the day was won for the Galactic Republic, and the Poletec chieftain told the Jedi that the Republic would always have an ally on Skako Minor.

name: Pollinator
summary: Pollinators were swarming, territorial, pollinating insects from Vaynai.

name: Polosich
summary: The Polosich were a sentient species with velvety skin of yellow pigmentation. Tyew Fordrod was a Polosich living during the Galactic Civil War. Fordrod was traveling aboard the Kuari Princess, a giant luxury liner, on a cruise up the Relgim Run when it was attacked by pirates while passing through the Maelstrom. Fordrod had booked accommodation on the Lido Deck and considered himself superior to anyone who traveled on less expensive decks.

name: Polydroxol
summary: The Polydroxol were a species of sentient, denantium-based shapeshifters that were native to the world of Sevetta. They resembled two hundred kilogram masses of mercury while in their liquid state. Their native environment was the toxic volcanic pools of their homeworld.

name: Polynean
summary: Polynean were the human inhabitants of the planet Polyneus. When speaking with Caern Adan about Wyl Lark, New Republic General Hera Syndulla noted that she had seen two Polynean tributes in her career and had been impressed with their knack for piloting.

name: Pom-hopperMale and female
summary: The Pom-hopper was an animal from Naboo. An amphibious mammal, it was much more comfortable in the water than on land.

name: Pontu-siren
summary: Pontu-siren were a type of creatures with gray skin and a long snout-like appendage. Around 3 ABY, the pontu-siren were shown in an exhibit at Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures on the planet Hon-Tallos. The creature shared similar physical attributes to the thala-sirens, the mammalian creatures found on the planet Ahch-To.

name: Pooba
summary: Pooba were a bipedal sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They were covered in furry blue hair and had multihued eye color. Two members of the species, Nubs and Barabo, served the Jedi Order as a Jedi youngling and a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era, respectively. Pooba spoke the language Poobian.

name: Popahen
summary: Popahens were a type of chicken. While on the Outer Rim planet Valo in 229 BBY, the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem reflected that the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram was taking care of the Jedi younglings Tep Tep, Kildo, and Gavi like a popahen would care for its chicks.

name: Porcuspine
summary: Porcuspines were venomous arthropods native to Dagobah.

name: Porg
summary: Porgs were a non-sentient species of sea-dwelling beakless bird. They were native to the planet Ahch-To, where Jedi Master Luke Skywalker made his exile in the years prior to the Battle of Crait.

name: Porporite
summary: The Porporites were a cetacean species from the Porpor system. After making first contact with the Galactic Republic shortly after the Great Hyperspace War, they became addicted to ryll spice, which had recently been discovered. It whipped them into a homicidal frenzy, prompting them to attack other worlds. They withstood everything the Republic used to stop them until they were finally exterminated by the Ganks in 4800 BBY at the beginning of what became known as the Gank Massacres.

name: Porrgil
summary: Porrgils were a spacefaring species capable of naturally travelling in hyperspace.

name: Posenaur
summary: The posenaur was a creeping reptile native to Dagobah. Moving about on two legs, posenaurs had webbed feet and long tails to help them cross water and run on dry land respectively. Hunting rodents in packs, posenaurs had razor-sharp claws and powerful jaws.

name: Poss'Nomin
summary: The Poss'Nomin were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Illarreen. Thickly built humanoids slightly larger than the average Human, they were easily recognized by their large, shovel-shaped jaws and their three eyes.
skinColor: Red, with black- or brown-spotted forearms in some races

name: Possum
summary: Possums were bipedal, reptilian creatures hailing from the fourth moon of Yavin Prime. They possessed devices resembling goggles over their eyes. Luke Skywalker, shortly before assaulting the Galactic Empire's Death Star with the Rebel Alliance, encountered these creatures while exploring the Massassi ruins on the jungle moon.

name: Potolli
summary: Potolli were a furred species of animal native to Naboo. Its fur was used to ornament the throne room gown.

name: Povanarian
summary: Povanarians were a frog-like sentient species native to the planet Povanaria. They were one of the member species of the New Republic in 19 ABY, serving alongside Bagmims and Humans in the New Republic Defense Fleet.

name: Praelion
summary: The Praelions were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy, specifically from the Japrael sector. Axut Klem was a member of this species.

name: Prae'tus
summary: Prae'tus was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Volo Bolus was a member of this species. They were commonly mistaken for the similar-looking Nikto Ijosap'sai species.

name: Premlis rat
summary: Premlis rats were a type of rat found in forests on the planet Siline. They were most active around dusk. In 134 BBY, at dusk during the survival level of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual on Siline, the Silinese Rhos Arthyst suggested to her fellow contestants that they go hunting for either premlis rats or tusk bunnies. Arthyst explained both creatures were most active at that time and would make an excellent meal for their group, whose other members consisted of the Silinese Sitia Arthyst, the humans Lionine Graf and Yord Fandar, and the Theelin-human hybrid Jecki Lon. The group ultimately went hunting for tusk bunnies, killing two.

name: Prengalli
summary: Prengalli were water-dwelling creatures that could be found on the swampy planet of Artiod Minor, in the Morellian Commonwealth. The sentient natives of Artiod Minor, the Artiodacs, raised schools of prengalli in their aqua-farms.

name: Presta bird
summary: Presta birds were a type of nesting bird that featured in an expression from Kalastar about being defecated upon if you stood underneath a presta bird nest. In 9 BBY, the bartender M-6NK was reminded of the expression after the Jedi Knight Cal Kestis avoided a question about what he had been doing on the planet Coruscant. The bartender then repeated the expression for Kestis and his droid companion BD-1.

name: Preying makthier
summary: Preying makthiers were flying predators which lived in the crystal caves of Makthierse. These creatures looked like insect larvae with leathery, bat-like wings. Their mouths had two long, thin mandibles, while their tails had a paralyzing stinger. Having evolved to live deep inside caves, they were completely sightless, navigating and seeking prey through sonar. Preying makthiers had a bizarre, almost comical appearance, but their voracious appetites made them fearsome predators. Though they primarily ate small, cave-dwelling rodents, groups of up to ten would swarm unwary humanoids who blundered into their lairs, and sometimes even range outside their cave homes to search for larger prey. A preying makthier could eat twice its own body mass in a single feeding. Colonists on Makthierse tried to avoid settling near preying makthiers, in order to save themselves and their domestic animals from harm. Unfortunately, the crystal caves of Makthierse honeycombed the entire northern continent, and were incompletely mapped. Two colonists, Sirloss and Tovi Brill, only learned that their ranch was in makthier country when their three-hundred-kilogram lacas were carried off. Preying makthiers attacked their prey first with the stingers in their tails, which contained a poison which could easily stun an adult Human. The stunned prey would be wrapped up in the makthier's flexible tail, causing further injury as the coils were tightened. Even a conscious victim would have difficulty escaping, due to the numerous tail suckers which improved the makthier's grip. Although a victim who managed to escape would not be permanently incapacitated by makthier venom, some Humans reported a terrible headache when the venom wore off.

name: Priapulin
summary: Priapulins were a sapient species from the planet Pria, one of the Core Worlds.

name: Pritarr
summary: Pritarr were feline creatures native to the jungles of the planet Onderon.

name: Profogg
summary: Profoggs were small rodents that were native to Tatooine. They possessed a forked tail, sharp incisors, horns, and powerful digging claws. [[File:Profogg-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A profogg den]] Builders of complicated underground "towns", these rodents were the scourge of many an eopie rider, who were often thrown to the ground when their mount stumbled over a hole. Each profogg town could span several hectares, and contain 50 to 100 profoggs, with each compartmentalized burrow serving a specific function to the community (i.e. nursery, food storage, etc.). The biomass of these complexes was often quite high, as each individual weighed between 10 and 25 kilograms. Due to a high birthrate (6-8 young per litter, 6-8 litters per year) there was a healthy population of the creatures throughout the wilderness. Empty burrows would often be colonized by gorgs, ibians, and kreetles. Profoggs were often the prey of womp rats, and scurriers would often steal food from profogg towns. A major source of food for profoggs were molo seeds, but they also had a penchant for raiding moisture farm gardens. The farmers often set off stink capsules to discourage them.

name: Proliferan
summary: The Proliferans were a species of sentient non-humanoids who resembled large red ants. They were excellent at digging, often using their skills to dig under enemy forces and waylay them when they got close. They had their own empire, known as the Proliferan Empire which was in turn ruled by a monarch. At the time of the Galactic Civil War, the ruler was Queen Yentuki.

name: Proop
summary: Proop were edible slugs native to the oceans of Chad, where they traveled in herds. They were tentacled creatures that grew to about fifteen meters long. They were semi-domesticated and tended to stay in the warmer upper levels of the ocean.

name: Protean
summary: The Proteans (also sometimes called Protreans) were sentient beings indigenous to Nathas I which was located within the Questal sector.

name: Psadan
summary: The Psadan were one of the indigenous races of the planet Wayland. They were covered with lumpy plates that made them resemble walking, talking rocks, Scientists believe they were evolved from hard-shelled mammals. They were a warlike species and often fought the neighboring Myneyrsh. They were one of the races that the cloned and insane Jedi master Joruus C'baoth kept under his rule at the foot of Mount Tantiss. When the Yuuzhan Vong invaded, the Psadan and Myneyrsh tried to fight back and were mostly exterminated, the rest fleeing into jungles.

name: Psychotic jax
summary: The psychotic jax was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of bearded jax.

name: Pterathki
summary: The Pterathki were a bird-like species native to Makeb, they were also found in the wilds of Onderon.

name: Pterosaur
summary: Pterosaurs, also called Soarers, were flying reptiles native to the planet Ammuud. They were carnivorous, feeding on other small reptiles and land mammals. Pterosaurs were once used to compete in races sponsored by the royal families of Ammuud, and was one of the primary forms of entertainment on the planet. Afterward, the clans on Ammuud started wars between each other and this became infrequent. Pterosaurs could also be found on the planet Mandalore.

name: Puffball
summary: A puffball was a type of furry creature that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, one was present in Saludad—Dalna's capital city—near Vice President Hackrack Bep's house when Jedi Knights Yacek Sparkburn and Vernestra Rwoh, Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros, and the tooka cat Gemmy traveled to speak to Bep. After they arrived, the puffball quickly departed, making its way down an alley between houses. Gemmy spotted the creature, leapt off of Cantaros' shoulder, and began chasing the puffball. Not long later, the tooka returned to the Padawan as he sat outside Bep's house.

name: Puffer-frog
summary: A puffer-frog was a type of frog whose name the Ewok Kneesaa used as an insult for fellow Ewok Weechee when he was being boastful.

name: Puffer pig
summary: Puffer pigs were a non-sentient, herbivorous, mammalian pig species native to the planet Kyryll's World. Puffer pigs were known to inflate their bodies to a large degree when they felt threatened.

name: Puffer turtle
summary: Puffer turtles were a reptilian species of turtles found in the swamps of Clak'dor VII, a planet ravaged by biochemical warfare. Some of these turtles were violet. The species possessed bladders which they could swell to a point that stretched the flexibility of their shells. When they exhaled from the bladders, it could produce a sound similar to a low note on a bassoon. In the year 24 ABY, the Bith band Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes incorporated the sounds made by a nearby puffer turtle, along with other animals, into the music they played when they were in hiding from the Black Sun criminal organization.

name: Pug jumper
summary: Pug jumpers were non-aggressive creatures with hard, spiked skin. They lived on Kashyyyk and their tongues were appreciated by local traders.

name: Pugoriss
summary: A Pugoriss was a type of creature that could be found on Rori.

name: Pui-ui
summary: The Pui-ui species was native to Kyryll's World. The sentients' small bodies were formed by two spheres separated by a short neck. The lower of the two spheres had a number of cilia projecting from it, facilitating movement. The species was active in the galaxy in the early years of the Galactic Empire, with luxury facilities on the University of Rudrig campus and with their medical data programmed into 2-1B surgical droids.

name: Pulga
summary: Pulga were a type of creature native to the forest moon Endor. The sentient Ewoks also native to the moon would sometimes ride pulga.

name: Pulra
summary: The Pulras were sentients indigenous to Kuras III, which they called "Host". They shared their planet with two other species, the Aganof and the Hairy Savages.
distinctions: Amorphous, able to combine to form larger creatures

name: Pulsar skate
summary: The pulsar skate was a sea creature that could be found on the planet Corellia. A sea animal control worker for the Corellian Engineering Corporation headquarters was bitten in half and killed by a pulsar skate. When a group of First Order prisoners were sent to Corellia, Winshur Bratt assigned one of the new arrivals to the job.

name: Punn Rimbaud's species
summary: Punn Rimbaud belonged to a sentient species of amphibian humanoids with brown skin and a long bulging neck. They were bipedal, and had eyes with black pupils and irises that were mottled with black and grey. Their eyes also included a light green band around the irises, and sclera which was mottled with two shades of purple. They had deep voices, no hair, and a small, indented nose. Many members of the species were senators in the Separatist Senate at the time of the Clone Wars. One such individual was Punn Rimbaud, a female member of the species. When the senator for Onderon, Mina Bonteri, attempted to convince the senate to begin peace negotiations with the Republic, Rimbaud was opposed to starting any such negotiations. The matter was cast to a vote by the Separatist leader Count Dooku, and despite Rimbaud voting "nay" the overall vote was in favor of starting the peace talks.
eyeColor: Light Green band around the irides

name: Purbole
summary: The purbole was a simian creature native to the planet of Dathomir.
hairColor: Shades of blue to red with white patches

name: Purella
summary: The purella was a large predator native to the moon Yavin 8.

name: Purple alien
summary: Purple aliens were a sentient species with long necks and an indestructible outer skin. A number of these aliens could be found in the Mos Eisley Cantina, wielding their signature long range blaster weapons.

name: Purple Ones
summary: The "Purple Ones" were an alien species native to a planet. Unable to speak basic or use blasters, many were enslaved by Krastic Tarta, slavemaster of the Arkanian Dawn.

name: Purra-bird
summary: Purra-birds were a type of bird that could be kept as pets. In 5 ABY, the bounty hunter Jas Emari asked her colleague, the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus, about his future plans and whether they included settling down with his boyfriend Conder Kyl and having purra-bird pets.

name: Purrgil
summary: {{Update|, Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy, The Book of Beasts, , Yoda Rescue, The High Republic: Into the Light, Hyperspace Stories—Codebreaker 4, Part Two}} Purrgil were a semi-sentient species of massive whales that lived in deep space, traveling from star system to star system. Regular purrgil were only the size of a small starship, while another type of purrgil, known as Purrgil Ultra, was significantly larger. Purrgil had streamlined bodies with a smooth-looking bluish-purple skin, four large hind tentacles, and multiple fins. Their heads had a characteristic bulbous shape with one eye on each side. Living in groups consisting of up to dozens of individuals, they were able to fly through hyperspace by creating simu-tunnels. The natural ability of the purrgil inspired sentients to develop hyperdrive technology and wayfinders that were used for hyperspace navigation. According to Hera Syndulla, leader of the Spectres rebel cell, most spacers considered purrgil to be pests due to their habit of approaching and flying into starships near their flight paths, and for ships crashing into their swarms during hyperspace travel. Numerous spacer deaths could be attributed to purrgil-related incidents, leading most spacers to fire upon them on sight. However, Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger, another member of the Spectres, was able to establish a connection to the whales when he encountered a group of them together with the rest of his crew at a gas refinery in 3 BBY. He later used that bond to ally with a group of purrgil against Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn's 7th Fleet during the liberation of the Outer Rim planet Lothal in 1 BBY, ultimately removing the fleet from the planet by having the purrgil wrap their tentacles around Thrawn's starship and jump to hyperspace. Around 9 ABY, a group of Purrgil Ultra near the planet Seatos assisted Jedi Ahsoka Tano in following the Nightsister Morgan Elsbeth to a neighboring galaxy with the intent of preventing her from recovering Thrawn to the known galaxy. The creatures transported her and the Jedi droid Huyang aboard their T-6 shuttle to the extragalactic planet Peridea.
skinColor: Brown and gray (when depleted of Clouzon-36)

name: Purrgil Ultra
summary: Purrgil Ultra were a type of the semi-sentient, space-roaming purrgil. They were mostly identical to regular purrgil, albeit with significantly larger heads with slightly different features. In 1 BBY, during the liberation of the planet Lothal from the Galactic Empire's grasp, a group of purrgil and Purrgil Ultra completely wiped out Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn's blockade. Having established a connection with the purrgil, the Jedi Ezra Bridger then guided three Purrgil Ultra to wrap their tentacles around Thrawn's flagship, the Chimaera, and to jump into hyperspace, removing the Imperial threat from Lothal. Around 9 ABY, a group of Purrgil Ultra over the planet Seatos helped former Jedi Ahsoka Tano with following the Nightsister Morgan Elsbeth to a neighboring galaxy with the goal of preventing her from recovering Thrawn. The whales transported Tano and the Jedi droid Huyang aboard their T-6 shuttle to the extragalactic planet Peridea.

name: Puxian
summary: The Puxian were a rare species in the Galaxy who were almost never seen in the Core Worlds. The males and females of this species appeared drastically different. The male of the species was a flying creature about 50 cm in length with a very long nose and specially developed lungs giving them a thick, nasally voice. The males used large fleshy wings on their backs to fly. The female of the species on the other hand was a 1.5 meter tall humanoid with no ability to fly and a bloated form with malformed legs. The females were unable to speak clearly due to their biology and had a muffled sounding voice. A female Puxian could swallow her injured, even mortally wounded, mate into a pouch-like organ and later regurgitate him healed of any damage; however, this left both parties in a severely weakened state for some time. A male and female couple of this species lived on Fire around 200 BBY.

name: P'w'eck
summary: The P'w'ecks were a warm-blooded, saurian species similar in appearance to the Ssi-ruuk from the tropical planet of Lwhekk in the Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster deep in the Unknown Regions. They were regarded as inferior by the larger Ssi-ruuk who utilized them as slaves.

name: Pybus amphibipole
summary: The Pybus amphibipole was a species of amphibian found on the planet Pybus. Their claws were venomous.

name: Pydyrian
summary: Pydyrians were sapient avians indigenous to the moon Pydyr that orbited the planet Almania. They were tall, thin humanoids that had two-toed feet and three-fingered hands, and their bone structure was very thin. Because of their skeletal structure, many xenoarchaeologists believed that the Pydyrians evolved from flightless birds. Their oblate skulls were bald at the top, but ringed with a fringe of hair at the base of the skull. Millions of Pydyrians were killed in a droid detonation planned and carried out by Kueller, a Dark Jedi who had risen to power on Almania. Only 1000 Pydyrians survived.

name: Pygmy porlceetin
summary: The pygmy porlceetin was a type of large, hexapedal, venomous creature native to the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. They had green markings that they used to lay in wait for prey and evade potential predators. Some of the Nantex-class starfighters used by the sentient Geonosians had green highlights that resembled the markings found on porlceetins. Geonosis was sterilized by the Galactic Empire around 9 BBY.

name: Pyke
summary: The Pykes were a species of sentient humanoids native to the planet Oba Diah. The species had two distinct physiological groups. While both shared elongated heads, one group was characterized by their oversized craniums with undersized faces, while the other bore more humanoid proportions with piscine features. The Pyke Syndicate was the main focus of the Pyke economy and the galaxy's preeminent supplier of spice, a term for various types of narcotic substances mined by slaves on the planet Kessel and a number of other planets.
distinctions: Elongated, tapered skull with an undersized face

name: Pylat bird
summary: Pylat birds were a species of non-sentient avians native to the planet Neimoidia that were prized as status symbols. Some wealthy Neimoidians kept such birds in special cages. During 3 ABY the casino cruiser Morenia was offering a Pylat bird as a prize.

name: Pyn'gani
summary: The Pyn'gani were a Near-Human sentient species from the Outer Rim planet Polus. To protect them from the extreme cold of their homeworld, their cities were shielded by heat generators. The Pyn'gani played a major role in developing the carbon-freezing process, and mining carbonite produced a large proportion of the income for Polus. One Pyn'gani was the reclusive Jedi Master Anno Wen-Chii, who lived around 1000 BBY.

name: Qaberworm
summary: Qaberworms were a species of giant tentacled worms who had an inability to feel pain. They were also known to be protective of their owners. Vulaada Klam and her family owned a qaberworm named Gurtyl, who they brought with them to Milvayne.

name: Qadel
summary: The Qadel were a sentient species. According to the play Evocar, written by the Hutt playwright Direus'pei around 671 BBY, the Qadel were driven to extinction by the Tionese warlord Xim. When Xim was captured and placed on trial by the Hutts, he justified the extinction of the Qadel on the basis that they were slavers. Xim's conquests occurred approximately between 25,130 and 25,100 BBY.

name: Qartuum
summary: Qartuums were a goat-like species that inhabited the planet Nevarro.

name: Qella
summary: The Qella were a quadruped species from the planet Brath Qella.
distinctions: Quadrupedal, three fingered hands, lanky bodies

name: Qhuloskian
summary: Qhuloskians were a sentient species from Qhulosk. During the Imperial Era, they resisted the Galactic Empire, leading to a battle in the city of Howlan.

name: Qieg
summary: The Qieg were sentient insectoids indigenous to Lan Barell.

name: Qiraash
summary: The Qiraash were a near-human sentient species identifiable by their pink skin and large craniums. Leesub Sirln was a Qiraash who was present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina shortly before the Battle of Yavin.

name: Q'Itane
summary: The Q'Itane were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Trusk Berinato, a friend of Bail Organa, was a male Q'Itane from Upper Etrega.

name: Q'nithian mimbrane
summary: The Q'nithian mimbrane, also known as the mimbrane organism, was an unusual creature as it was essentially a living organic recording device. They appeared as thin pasty white sheets that were no longer than a Human finger. The creatures surface essentially consumed sound that was being emitted from its surroundings. They also possessed rudimentary sight buds allowing them to distinguish between light and dark. Though possessing small brains, the creatures would be trained to follow the simple commands of their owners to "play back" the sounds that they recorded. This made them the perfect recording "tool," as their small size—combined with their abilities—allowed people to smuggle them into conversations that they wanted to store for later use. Mimbrane organisms were grown in large colonies, one of which was present on one of the Q'nithian system's moons. This group lived deep within the fault and fissures of the planet's rocky surface.

name: Qom Jha and Qom Qae
summary: The Qom Qae and the Qom Jha were sentient avians native to the planet Nirauan. As adults, they averaged 60 to 100 centimeters from head to their taloned feet, and were covered in smooth, brown-gray skin. They had skin-covered wings, and bore a slight resemblance to bats. Their mouths contained two rows of small, sharp teeth. Although small, large groups of Qom Qae or Qom Jha were strong enough to lift and move starfighter-size vessels. This reflected the Qom Jha proverb, "Many vines woven together are stronger than the same number of vines separately." The Qom Qae and Qom Jha had only minor biological and cultural differences. The smaller, brown-skinned Qom Qae nested on cliffs, and perched upright. The larger, darker Qom Jha lived in Nirauan's cave systems, and preferred to perch upside-down from stalactites. Their different habitats meant that the cave-dwelling Qom Jha had excellent vision in darkened spaces, while the Qom Qae had keen vision in bright light. Both the Qom Qae and the Qom Jha were considered vermin by the Chiss and former Imperial troops who garrisoned the Hand of Thrawn fortress for the Empire of the Hand. They were quite intelligent, however. In fact, Qom Qae and Qom Jha were all slightly Force-sensitive, communicating partly through chirping and partly through telepathy. Aliens with sensitivity to the Force were able to understand their language. [[File:InfiltratingEC.jpg|thumb|left|Qom Jha and Qom Qae with Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade beneath the Hand of Thrawn.]] Qom Qae and Qom Jha organized themselves in small groups called "nestings," each led by a Bargainer. While the adults were territorial, the children were free to travel across boundaries, thus acting as unofficial ambassadors between nestings and information gatherers—even between Qom Qae and Qom Jha groups, who were otherwise unfriendly towards each other. Children were not named at birth, instead being referred to as "Child of (parent's name)". Adults gained their names from their characteristics or deeds, such as "Hunter Of Winds" (head of a Qom Qae nesting), "Eater Of Fire Creepers" (head of a Qom Jha nesting), "Splitter Of Stones," "Keeper Of Promises," "Builder With Vines," "Flyer Through Spikes" and "Child Of Winds" (the son of Hunter of Winds.) Qom Qae and Qom Jha were quite adventurous. Qom Jha enjoyed eating fire creepers, carnivorous insects that migrated through their caves in massive swarms. Both Nirauan groups were somewhat familiar with the Empire, the New Republic, and the Jedi, as some of them had eavesdropped on the Hand of Thrawn's personnel, and others had stowed away on starships. Qom Qae from Hunter of Wind's nesting, along with Qom Jha from Eater of Fire Creepers's nesting, helped Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker investigate the Hand of Thrawn.

name: Qonto
summary: The Qonto were a sentient species from the Qonto system, which was located in Wild Space. Although generally not known for their perception, some exceptional Qonto had senses considerably sharper than the Human standard. During the Galactic Civil War, Lina Adonais was a Qonto space urchin who worked aboard the Kuari Princess, a giant luxury liner, while she traveled the galaxy. She considered joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and while on a tour of the Relgim Run, she encountered a group of Rebels disguised as Anomids. She immediately saw through their disguise and questioned them about what they were doing aboard the Princess. Adonais was also present on the cruise when it was attacked by pirates while passing through the Maelstrom.

name: Qormot
summary: Qormots were omnivorous forest creatures from the planet Yeshocq's southern hemisphere. They were stocky quadrupeds with sharp claws and teeth. A qormot could easily be recognized from the single eye in the middle of its forehead, and the array of quills sticking out of its spine and flanks. These quills could actually be launched at opponents up to twelve meters away, though the effective range was limited to about five meters due to the poor depth perception of the qormot's single eye. Qormots were relatively docile during most of Yeshocq's thirteen-month year, only showing aggression if rival qormots or predators encroached on the territory of their small prides. When they were roused, however, they could be quite fierce. During the mating season in late autumn, their ferocity increased, making any creature who strayed into qormot territory a likely target. This included other qormots, as the females violently battled one another for access to choice breeding grounds.

name: Quadduck
summary: Quadducks were six-limbed avians that could be found on the planet Naboo, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. They were related to the ducks and the pelikki, two other waterfowl species that also lived on Naboo. In addition to their wings, they had not two but four legs. Despite being bigger than them, the quadducks were preyed upon by the twirrls, a species of flying mammalians.

name: Quaggian
summary: The Quaggians were a sentient species from the Quaggia system. They were known for having a hand gesture called the Quaggian hand turtle, which meant "It's great" or "Something's great."

name: Quamin
summary: Quamin (plural quamilla) were flying predators from the Kidron jungles. They had leathery skin, membranous wings, and a long tail. Their tails had razor-sharp fins, which quamilla used as their primary weapons. Their heads did not contain mouths, instead, quamilla sucked blood and other vital fluids from their prey through an array of spongy feeding vents on their head. Internally, quamilla had three hearts, large lungs which compensated for Kidron's thin atmosphere, hollow bones, and surprisingly powerful muscles. Redundancy in their internal organs gave them superior endurance, and allowed them to heal quickly from internal injuries. They also had a keen sense of smell, which they used instead of vision as their primary sense. Their tail blades were their main weakness: if a quamin's tail blade broke, it would take a standard week to grow back, during which it would be unable to hunt, and the injured quamin could starve. Quamilla usually traveled in packs, or flights, of five to ten members. Despite cooperating to kill large prey, quamilla did not seem to get along well. Once they had made a kill, they would frequently fight over the best portions. They would also fight for dominance in the pack. not territorial. Quamilla would fly silently through the skies, swooping down to attack larger creatures or groups of creatures in waves. They did not kill their prey instantly, rather, they lashed them with their tail fins, then followed their quarry until they collapsed from blood loss. The quamilla then sucked the fluids from their prey, leaving the husks for slorks. Travelers to Kidron were often advised to be wary when they traveled through Kidron's forests and hills, lest they fell prey to a quamin attack. However, the people of Kidron did find at least one use for quamilla. Quamin tail blades were used as weapons by some Orfites on Kidron, as well as by certain offworlders. They could be tied to poles, woven into whips, or used as throwing weapons. It was said that such blades never dulled, though they could break fairly easily. A quamilla population was also found on Nal Hutta. In arranging his elaborate trap on Nal Hutta for Jodo Kast, Boba Fett had Dengar round up a number of quamilla which were released to attack Kast upon his arrival. Dengar described the operation as being more of a challenge than some of his hunts, and the quamilla as "lovable leeches".
distinctions: Silent flight, razor-sharp tail, spongy feeding vents on head.

name: Quara
summary: The Quara were one of three sub-species of the Aqualish, and made their home on the highly contested islands of the planet Ando.

name: Quaraxian
summary: Quaraxian was a sentient species that aged very slowly and possessed significant intellectual prowess. By the time of the Republic Era, the species were virtually extinct, with the exception of individuals such as the Quaraxian female criminal Phaedra.

name: Quarf
summary: Quarfs were shapeshifting creatures that had the ability to fly and send signals through a horn on the middle of their foreheads. The only known quarf was seen on the forest moon of Endor, nicknamed "Silky" by young Ewoks from Bright Tree Village. In reality, "Silky" was the servant of the Dark Enchantress Jadru, sent to kidnap the Ewoks' Princess. [[File:Kneesaa_and_Silky.jpg|thumb|left|200px|"Silky" in his transformed disguise.]] Quarfs had powerful shape shifting abilities, and "Silky" was able to change his reptilian appearance into that of a beautiful horse-shaped creature, hiding his wings. Quarfs had excellent hearing as well as the ability to send signals to their "masters" from the prominent horn displayed on their brow, which stayed displayed even after shape shifting. They also were strong beasts and could carry a rider on their back as they flew through the air. Although Quarfs could follow complicated instructions, they served as pets and were never seen displaying conscious decision making abilities.

name: Quariped
summary: Quaripeds were an alien species. They boasted four limbs, and green wing-like appendages. The "bodies" of the Quaripeds were ringed by three red hoops.

name: Quarra
summary: Quarras were vicious predators native to the world of Devaron. They were large, four-legged reptilian creatures that possessed massive horned snouts filled with immense teeth. They were traditionally used for capital punishment by the Devaronians, especially in cases dealing with mass murderers and traitors to the lawful government. This practice prevented Devaron from joining the New Republic.

name: Quarren
summary: The Quarren, also known by the derogatory nickname "Squid Heads," were a humanoid, squid-like sentient species native to the planet Mon Cala, where they coexisted with the Mon Calamari in a peaceful, albeit tense, relationship.
distinctions: Four tentacles protruding from jaw; finned or suction-cup tipped fingers; ability to spit ink in defense

name: Qubey
summary: The Qubey were a sentient species of alien native to the moon of Caliban. They were short creatures, and in terms of technology, were not very advanced. Their homeworld was disturbed during the Clone Wars, due to an invasion by Separatist forces led by General Grievous.

name: Quednak
summary: Quednaks, also called riding beasts, were six legged, reptilian herbivores used by the Yuuzhan Vong as beasts of burden. They transported passengers and cargo. Though they were massive, they could reach speeds of forty kilometers per hour. Quednaks were also more intelligent than other Yuuzhan Vong creatures, and could minimally understand their orders. Occasionally, the Yuuzhan Vong would use them as war mounts, but this was rare, as they felt that the Warriors were more deserving of the honor of battle than mere beasts. They were used prominently by the Yuuzhan Vong at the Battle of Ylesia.

name: Queel water dragon
summary: The Queel water dragon was an aquatic creature that inhabited in the swamps of the planet Queel. Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano rode one such dragon during the assault on the Separatist positions.

name: Quellfish
summary: Quellfish was a type of fish.

name: Quenker
summary: The quenker was a small armored hopping rodent which lived on Dantooine. Its jaws secreted an acidic bile used for eating and digesting its victims' flesh. Following the Battle of Yavin, the collector Jener Mich tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of quenkers.

name: Querm Rybet
summary: The Querm Rybet, or simply Querm, were one of the many subspecies of Rybet, a sentient amphibian species. Querm Rybet hailed from the planet Quermia.

name: Quermian
summary: {{Update|Star Wars: The High Republic, Star Wars (2020) 1, Star Wars (2020) 9, The Ride, Savage Spirits, }} Quermians were a gaunt, long-necked humanoid sentient species native to the planet Quermia. They had two brains, one located inside their head and the other within their chest cavity, and two pairs of arms. During the Trade Federation's Invasion of Naboo, four Quermians were enrolled in the Jedi Order, one of whom was Jedi Master Yarael Poof, a member of the Jedi High Council.

name: Quesoth
summary: The Quesoth were a sentient insectoid species native to the Unknown Regions planet Quethold and spoke the Quesoth Common Speak language. Divided by castes, several races followed the reigning Quesoth Queen, the Queen of the Red, White, or Black, which changed periodically, blindly. The Quesoth Soldiers, who understood the Quesoth Soldier Speak tongue spoken by their monarch, the Midli caste—who oversaw the Workers—and the Circling, a caste composed by several subgroups formed by the Queen's advisers and breeders, carried their Queens across their respective cities: the Red City, the White City, or the Black City. In an attempt to rule forever, the reigning Queen of the Red in 8 ABY allied herself with alien warlord Nuso Esva—whose species were nicknamed the "Storm-hairs" by the Quesoth—and promised to help him in his campaign against the Empire of the Hand and Grand Admiral Thrawn. The warlord promised to murder the future Queen of the White, allowing the Queen of the Red to rule, while she would allow him to use the manufacturing facilities beneath the White City after capturing the location with the juggernauts they would steal from Thrawn. Unfortunately for her, during a battle against the Grand Admiral's forces, Esva killed her fearing treason.
lifespan: Queens: As long as their reign

name: Quexius
summary: The Quexius was a species of green-and-red birds native to the moon Endor. The bird was aggressive and would often peck at nearby beings for no reason. It was also an incredibly stupid bird that would antagonize predators. For this reason, the Quexius was an endangered species.

name: Quicker
summary: Quickers were aerial predators native to Kuras III that were two meters long and had a four and-a-half-meter wingspan.

name: Quivry
summary: The quivry was a four-legged hooved antelope-like creature native to Antar 4 and were hunted by the Gotals to sharpen their senses.

name: Quizzer
summary: The Quizzers were a mammalian species native to Gamorr which were fascinated by shiny objects. They shared Gamorr with the Gamorreans and the Morrts. The Quizzers were hated by the dominant Gamorreans, who tried without success to exterminate the species.

name: Quockran
summary: The Quockrans were a sentient species of slugs native to the planet Quockra-4. The species had a large, fat body that tapered to a tail. Their torso also had two arms, ending in stubby digits. The black-skinned Quockrans had no differentiated internal organs. During their evolution, their homeworld was a moist planet. Nevertheless, the climate changed, becoming dry and hot. This drove the Quockrans' society underground, apart from short forays to the surface. The Quockrans were a xenophobic species, desiring isolation from all other species. When the Minos Cluster was colonized late in the administration of the Galactic Republic, offworlders reached Quockra-4. The Quockrans responded to this violation of their isolation by manufacturing an entire society of droids to act as intermediaries with the offworlders. These droids traded with offworlders, largely keeping the existence of the Quockrans a secret.

name: Quork
summary: Quorks were a species of sentient furred bipeds found on the moon Endor. After word spread that the Ewoks of the Bright Tree tribe and a group of Yuzzums had seen off a group of Imperials in 4 ABY, a Quork was among a number of neighbors of the Ewoks who gathered at Bright Tree Village to share stories and work in unity with others.

name: Quor'sav
summary: The Quor'sav were a sentient species that moved about on at least two long, stilt-like legs. One such being was present in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY on the same day Luke Skywalker sold his landspeeder to a Vuvrian named Wioslea. At some point prior to or during 3 ABY, the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk'wassak'Cradossk assisted a Quor'sav narcotics agent on the astronomical object Uaua. When Bossk later confronted his sister Doshanalawook on the gunship Liswarr, he noted that her projector console showed a detailed personal history of him, including a mention of the Quor'sav agent.

name: Quosit
summary: Quosits were a species of twenty-five centimeter insects native to Rhommamool. The hermaphroditic beings inhabited the underground.

name: Qwohog
summary: The Qwohog were amphibious humanoid sapients indigenous to Hirsi, a planet mostly covered in freshwater lakes and seas. They remained isolated from the rest of the galaxy until they were swept up in the Galactic Civil War, when they aligned themselves with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Small-boned, agile, and delicate in appearance, they were sometimes called Wavedancers for their graceful movement through the freshwater oceans and lakes of their homeworld.
skinColor: Blue to green, silvery scales on head

name: Qworlth skaal
summary: A qworlth skaal, also known as dread weapon, was a biologically engineered worm-like organism that extended from the bow of a Yuuzhan Vong warship or worldship. The creature could penetrate the surface of an enemy ship or space station and suck out all beings aboard. Alternatively, this dread weapon could be used to puncture a planetary surface, as on Helska IV when the first Yuuzhan Vong worldship landed.

name: Ra-lugg
summary: The ra-lugg was a small, red, six-legged arachnid or crustacean native to Endor. The ra-lugg possessed yellow or black eyes, two grasping pincers, and a web-shooting tail to catch its prey, such as the tiny Fleebogs. One of these creatures in particular terrorized the Fleebog tunnels, until a dose of Ewok growing powder caused it to reach a larger size. Frightened by its sudden change in size, the ra-lugg fled into the forest.

name: Rabaanite
summary: The Rabaanites were Human inhabitants of the planet Rabaan.

name: Rabbit
summary: Rabbits were a type of species in the galaxy. One type was the ash-rabbit, which could be found on Graf-World and Sullust. Sentient rabbit-like species included the Lepi. LEP-series service droids were a rabbit-like series of service droid manufactured by Coachelle Automata, a company led by members of the Lepi.

name: Raccoon
summary: A raccoon was a type of creature with a black mask across their eyes. In 3.5 ABY, when the Wookiee Chewbacca disguised himself as the bounty hunter Snoova as part of a plan to infiltrate Black Sun leader Prince Xizor's fortress, his disguise gave him a raccoonlike mark across his eyes. The Colonies planet Mycroft had a large creature that, while similar in appearance to a black bear, had hands like those of a raccoon.

name: Rada-cat
summary: Rada-cats were a variety of cat. The family of Momin owned a pet rada-cat, Flitta, but he mutilated her to make a sculpture.

name: Radank
summary: Radanks were non-sentient predators in existence by the year 27 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, when the Yuuzhan Vong invaded the galaxy of the New Republic. Radanks possessed clawed limbs and a proboscis, and Yuuzhan Vong Warmaster Tsavong Lah even replaced one of his arms with a grafted radank leg in a show of devotion to his gods during the war. In 40 ABY, after the war was over, at least one radank hunted in the undercity of the planet Coruscant.

name: Radark
summary: Native to the homeworld of the Bothans and found on many of their colonies, including Mandell and Kothlis, the Radarks were subterrenean serpents that burrowed and tunnel underneath many Bothan structures. When these underground pathways and holes became plentiful, foundations of great institutions usually collapsed. Because of this the Radarks were considered the Bothans' most hated pest.

name: Radnoran
summary: Radnorans were the native inhabitants of the planet Radnor. Although they were fairly short in stature and sturdy in appearance, they were an intimidating humanoid species. In 27 BBY, the Radnorans had to evacuate their homeworld following an accident at one of their weapons laboratories, which resulted in the releasing of harmful toxins into the air. It soon killed most of the population in the city-state of Aubendo. The Jedi were sent to aid in the evacuation and to help curb the crisis' resultant panic, looting, and general chaos: the Radnorans were desperate to flee and escape the disaster (even the Radnoran security officers panicked and immediately stole the cruiser the Jedi had just arrived in). After the toxins subsided and a threat from their planet's neighbor, Avon, was averted, the Radnorans were left to rebuild and mourn the dead.

name: Raen sovra
summary: The Raen sovra, or electrocution worm, sometimes shortened to sovra, was an exotic species of worm first discovered by Dr. Safford Raen on Tenek, in the Mis-Tenek system. These segmented worms had a flexible metallic exoskeleton, and fed off electricity and metal. While they were a vital part of the ecosystem on their own planet, they were a serious threat to technological devices in the greater galaxy. Raen sovra could sense the flow of electrical currents, allowing them to search for "food." They could also store electrical energy, allowing them to deliver a deadly electric shock if disturbed. As well, their physiology did not require air, and was resistant to extremes of temperature, allowing them to survive indefinitely in the vacuum of space. This made them a serious threat on board a spacecraft or space station, where they could drain energy, eat wiring and other metal components, and disrupt computer processors. Dr. Raen first became interested in the sovra during his expedition while investigating the vinna trees and their thick, metallic bark. After several of his researchers were electrocuted, he discovered that the sovra living in the vinna roots fed off electrical energies conducted by Tenek's frequent lighting strikes from the trees to the moist soil. Sovra living in the soil fed off this electricity, with millions of the burrowing worms tilling the soil and thus distributing nutrients to the plants of the forest. Aside from the high levels of electrical energy and metallic elements in the system, this symbiote circle was similar to that found on many other planets. Due to the inherent dangers of the worms, the Mis-Tenek system was blockaded during the Imperial Period. Some smugglers continued to land on Tenek, accidentally spreading the sovra with them. While some sovra-infested ships were lost in hyperspace due to damage and energy loss, others managed to make their next destination. This spread the worms from spaceport to spaceport. The quarantine of the Mis-Tenek system was contested by some zoologists who wanted to study the sovra, especially their mechanism for creating their exoskeletons. Some private interests were willing to pay a substantial sum for a live sovra. The Galactic Empire also collected sovra, hoping to develop a "living armor" technology. One result of this research was a high-powered vibrodagger used by Imperial Intelligence assassins. A sovra was one of several creatures that the Jedi Callista Ming suspected might of been smuggled on to the planet of Gamorr and used to kill the Gamorrean Vrokk.
distinctions: Metallic exoskeletons, consumers and conductors of electricity

name: Ragithian Human
summary: Ragithian Humans were Near-Humans who inhabited the high-gravity world of Ragith III.

name: Ragoon
summary: The Ragoon were a type of creature that preyed upon the malia.

name: Raichling
summary: Raichlings were a large snail-like species which existed on Endor. They lived in mud, which they were able to slide across. They were also able to communicate with Ewoks, as Teebo asked several Raichlings to allow him and his friends to ride on their backs across a sea of mud in the native Raichling language. The Raichlings appeared to be on friendly terms with the Ewoks, as they gladly accepted Teebo's request.

name: Rain skink
summary: A rain skink was a type of poisonous amphibian found on the planet Siline. After rain, they crawled out of certain trees and secreted a venomous oil through their skin. In 134 BBY, while traveling through the arena where the survival level of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual was held on Siline, the Silinese Rhos Arthyst told Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon about rain skinks, and their group watched for puddles that could be hiding them.

name: Rainbow qaana
summary: Rainbow qaana were a species of insects that were bred and used by the Yuuzhan Vong. They were kept for the ethereal music that they produced when clicking their mandibles together and were only used in special ceremonies, or in the presence of the Supreme Overlord.

name: Raka
summary: The raka, a species that appeared to be extinct, was a creature renowned for its tree-climbing prowess, using its sharp claws to scale the tallest trees on the planet Tenoo. Raka skeleton fossils were unearthed at an excavation site on the planet.

name: Rakaan
summary: Rakaans were large, sentient, web-spinning predators native to Rakaa IV. They were notable for their five-phase life cycle, where they changed from one sex to another. Rakaans were land-dwellers, but they were also efficient swimmers. They had segmented bodies, mottled green, or dark-brown in color, with ten limbs. The front limbs were used as arms. Their heads were mounted on long, flexible necks, and had four segmented eyes, as well as openings for breathing and for hearing. However, their brains were in their abdomens, and their mouths were located on their underbellies. Rakaans were native to Rakaa IV's warm forests and jungles, and went into hibernation in freezing temperatures. [[File:Rakaan-AE.png|thumb|left|200px|A Rakaan in the andro phase caring for eggs.]] Rakaans were hunters who caught prey in the webs they spun from their abdomens. These webs ordinarily lasted two hours before losing strength, but Rakaan saliva mixed with nergk root juices produced a preservative that allowed them to last for weeks, and other glands in their mouths produced a substance which dissolved them. Long-lasted webs were used to cocoon prey for later feeding. In combat, Rakaans could shoot their webs, or bite with their fanged mandibles. Rakaans were born from eggs. They began their lives in a child phase, which lasted thirty years on average. In some cases, Rakaans would spend only five years as children, or spend sixty years before maturing. Rakaan children were only half a meter tall on average. At childhood's end, they went through a period called the "Transition". At the end of the Transition, a Rakaan would end up one of four sexes—male, female, neuter, or "andro". The balance of the different sexes depended on the conditions of a Rakaan community. During periods of famine, more Rakaans would be neuters. When the Rakaan population was in decline (during a hive war, for example), more Rakaans would go through the Transition to become male, female, or andro to increase breeding rates. Over a 160-year lifespan, Rakaans would go through the Transition several times. On average, a Rakaan would go through at least three Transitions, spending anywhere from three months to eighty years in one sex. During the Transition, Rakaans were often violent and ravenously hungry. [[File:Lud_Chud.png|thumb|200px|Rakaan crime boss Lud Chud with an alien bounty hunter.]] Rakaan males were about two meters tall, and had keener senses than other sexes. Females were the largest Rakaans, standing up to three meters tall. They also had an elongated abdomen, where they could carry and nourish fertilized eggs for three months. Afterward, they transferred their eggs to nesting chambers, where andros cared for them. Andros moved more slowly than other adults, and had the ability to produce a nourishing paste which they spread over the eggs. The last Rakaan sex, the neuters, took no part in reproduction. Instead, they were the guards, hunters, and warriors of the Rakaan community. Being only 1.5 meters tall, and having a more efficient metabolism, their food requirements were less than other Rakaans. Rakaans were rarely away from their homeworld, despite its central location in the galaxy.

name: Rakata
summary: The Rakata, also known as the Builders, were an ancient humanoid species with distinctive amphibian features native to the planet Lehon. They were technologically advanced and one of the earliest spacefaring races that once ruled the galaxy in its distant past and created early hyperdrive technology. The long-term use of the dark side of the Force corrupted their society and turned them into a race of merciless warriors. The Rakata used their potent technologies to conquer and enslave every other species they came across throughout the galaxy. During their reign, they were characterized by their cruelty, savagery, and arrogance. They were known to strip entire planets of their resources, terraform worlds to fit their own shifting needs and kill entire slave workforces; and to eat and defile the bodies of slain enemies and even members of their own species.
skinColor: Red, orange, brown, green, turquoise, blue, or gray

name: Rakatan
summary: The Rakatans, also known as the Rakata, were an ancient amphibious humanoid species native to the planet Lehon who ruled over the so-called Infinite Empire. According to legend, they were the first to develop hyperspace travel. Long before the Imperial Era, the Rakatans staged an invasion of the planet Kuat, but were eventually repelled by an uprising. A Kuati Signet embedded with a blue kyber crystal commemorated the uprising. Around 25,000 BBY, Rakatan invaders also sacked the planet Chandrila and stole the twelve Chandi Merle statues that stood in one of their temples around the same year. The Rakatan species was said to have eventually gone extinct as a result of corruption from the dark side of the Force. They shared their name with mystical antiquities known as Rakatan wraith boxes.

name: Rakazzak beast
summary: Rakazzak beasts were massive eight-limbed creatures that were tamed and ridden by the sentient Yuzzum native to the moon Endor. The Yuzzum used them to hunt ruggers and other rodents in the tall grass of the moon and the sentient Ewoks also found on Endor lived in treetop villages high enough to be safe from rakazzak beasts. In 4 ABY, the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick rode a rakazzak beast while leading a group of Yuzzum to confront a group of Imperials at an Imperial weapons cache. During the confrontation, Warrick leapt down from the creature and ultimately managed to best the Imperials.

name: Rakghoul
summary: Rakghouls were a type of Sith-spawned mutants, engineered by the Sith Lord Karness Muur. Desiring an army to rule over and seeking a way to cheat death as so many other Sith before and after him did, Muur had a talisman forged that he poured his spirit and power into, one that eventually came to be known as the Muur Talisman. Muur's talisman could turn almost any sentient being near him into a mindless rakghoul which he could control, but he found that there were exceptions: Force-sensitives and certain alien species could resist the talisman's effects. Thus, Muur engineered the "rakghoul plague," a virus-like disease that could be spread by a rakghoul's bite or a scratch from its claws, and that subjected the victim to a slower transformation into a rakghoul. Jealous and fearful of his power, Muur's Sith rivals killed him, and over time, the Muur Talisman came to reside on the Outer Rim world of Taris where the rakghoul plague ran rampant throughout the world's impoverished Undercity, creating vast numbers of rakghouls. The people of Taris would manage to put an end to the rakghoul presence on their world at some point prior to the year 19 BBY, and by the days of the Second Imperial Civil War, rakghouls were believed to be extinct. However, with the Muur Talisman lay the ability to create new rakghouls, and the galaxy would see the return of rakghouls when the oubliette belonging to the Sith Lord Remulus Dreypa was uncovered by Darth Vader, and the Jedi Knight Celeste Morne who had entombed herself and the talisman within for safekeeping nearly four thousand years prior, was revived. Morne battled Vader, but was no match for the skills of the Sith Lord and his clone stormtroopers, so she called upon the talisman's power to turn the stormtroopers into rakghouls; outnumbered, Darth Vader fled, stranding Morne on the desolate moon she had awakened on with only rakghouls and the spirit of Karness Muur for company. Several years later, Morne and the talisman would escape the moon aboard a Rebel Alliance shuttle, turning the crew of an orbiting Imperial-class Star Destroyer into rakghouls during her escape. Later, after her ship had been taken aboard a Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer, Morne turned the crew of the Iron Sun into subservient rakghouls with the power of the Muur Talisman. Morne and her rakghoul crew later came into contact with former Jedi Cade Skywalker, who convinced Morne to join him in his campaign against the current Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Krayt, after curing the rakghoul plague he had been infected with using his unique healing ability. During their attack on Krayt's forces, Krayt was killed and Morne convinced Skywalker to end her life and her suffering under Karness Muur's constant psychic presence. Skywalker then destroyed the Muur Talisman as it attempted to bind itself to a new host, effectively putting an end to the primary source of rakghouls.
skinColor: Varied; including shades of brown, green, and blue

name: Rakririan
summary: The Rakririans were sentient arthropods indigenous to the planet Rakrir. The sentients were distinctive in appearance, with five pairs of limbs and stalk-mounted eyes. They rarely left their homeworld, finding the wider galaxy too unrefined for their sophisticated tastes. Notable Rakririans that bucked that trend were the athlete Mogoyu, the fencer of stolen goods Endrigorn, and the exotic pet-store owner Sabodor.

name: Ral(stone ray)
summary: Rals, also known as stone rays, were a species of cold-blooded reptavian native to Bothawui.

name: Ralltiir tiger
summary: Ralltiir tigers were fierce carnivores native to the planet of Ralltiir. Although they appeared innocent when young, they quickly turned into savage and unpredictable creatures. Ralltiir tigers were prone to fits of blood madness, a craze that overcame them with a desire to kill everything around them. This blood madness could only be sated by the actual taste of blood.

name: Ramoan
summary: The Ramoans were a sentient species whose homeworld was ruined by the Yuuzhan Vong. Six years after the Yuuzhan Vong War, they were still being relocated to new worlds. The last stages of their relocation were supervised by Lowbacca, who abandoned the project to join the side of the Killiks. At least one member of this species became a Jedi Knight; Bazel Warv was a contemporary of Valin and Jysella Horn and gave his life while protecting Allana Solo.

name: Ran Deezy's species
summary: Several Jedi younglings, including Ran Deezy, belonged to a species with light green or blue skin and large eyes.

name: Ranat
summary: Ranats were a species of sentients rodent-like humanoids. Ranats had long tails, sharp teeth including large incisors, elongated whiskers, and a keen sense of smell. Ranats were found throughout the galaxy and worked in various occupations including as bounty hunters and soldiers.

name: Rancor
summary: Rancors were very large, semi-sentient reptilian carnivores native to the planet Dathomir, although they were also introduced to and present on Felucia, Tatooine, Ottethan and Koboh. Rancors were often seen as mindless, violent creatures, due to their extensive use as fighters across the galaxy, but were also capable of being trained and bonding well with their handlers and acquaintances.

name: Rangan
summary: Rangans were a indigenous pre-hyperdrive species of bipedal sentients native to the planet Rango Tan. They remained neutral in recent galactic conflicts as they had no interplanetary travel of their own. At some point, the Galactic Empire pretended to fire the Death Star to destroy the Rangans' homeworld, in order to test the Imperial gunners aboard the station.

name: Rangthang's species
summary: The DJ Rangthang was a member of a species that was humanoid race with 4 arms and 4 legs. The species also had tentacles on their faces.

name: Ranphyx
summary: The ranphyx (plural and singular) was a large, feline predator native to the A'driannamieq Mountains of the planet Elom.

name: Ranth
summary: The Ranth were sentient carnivorous mammals indigenous to Caaraz. Even before the Galactic Empire discovered their homeworld and brought the Ranth to the attention of the galactic community, they were a deeply divided people. While some Ranth lived a civilized lifestyle, others lived in tribes of nomadic hunters. The former wished to integrate themselves within the galactic community, while the latter preferred to keep to their lifestyle as hunters.

name: Raptor
summary: The raptor was a non-sentient species, a variant of the tonitran lizard found on Makeb. Born and bred for war, Raptors could be trained by an expert creature handler for use as riding animals. Raptors could be found on Rishi as well as Rakata Prime.

name: Raptor-wasp
summary: Raptor-wasps were flying insects from Corellia that lived in colonies.

name: Raptoran
summary: Raptorans were a species of large bird native to the river moon Al'doleem in the Mid Rim.

name: Raquor'daan
summary: Raquor'daan, commonly known as dark wolves or Sriluurian dark wolves, were a species of nocturnal canine predator native to the planet Sriluur. Members of the species possessed stinger tipped tails and claws capable of delivering poison as well as thick leathery hide on their shoulders and upper back to defend them from their own tails. The natural enemy of the Bandigo species, the wolves earned the respect of the sentient Weequay species also native to Sriluur, who sometimes tamed them for use in war, including the Houk–Weequay conflicts.

name: Raraza
summary: A raraza was an extinct bird of prey from Duro. "Raraza" was also a male Duros name.

name: Rasp
summary: The rasp was a small bird whose sub-species inhabited several planets. Most of them were docile and harmless, but a few rasps—like the plumed rasp—were aggressive and could cause wounds to an unarmed being.

name: Rass
summary: Rass were a species of predators native to the planet of Sakiya in the Saki system of Hutt Space. They possessed hard bones that were a pebbled black in color and used by the sentient Sakiyan species, who were also native to the rass' homeworld, to make the handles for bladed weapons. The Sakiyan Admiral Tarnese Bleyd who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars owned a knife with a handle made of rass bone, and considered the blade among his favorites.

name: Rasta Alien
summary: Rasta Aliens were a humanoid species that had spines on their calves, a long rippling strain near their neck, and short stubs on their heads. Known as dangerous predators, they were capable of shooting deadly spikes from their abdomen in three-pronged bursts. They could be found in the deserts of the planet Tatooine, where they primarily kept to caves, including the Tusken Cave where many Tusken Raiders could be found as well.

name: Rat
