summary: Rats were a non-sentient species of small, furry rodents considered vermin by many. They could be found on several planets throughout the galaxy, including Tatooine. A prong-nosed subspecies also lived on Lotho Minor. Rats were covered in gray fur; they had long, hairless tails and a sharp sense of smell. They would sometimes feed off cadavers. Some of them were bred and kept for scientific research.
distinctions: Long tail, keen sense of smell

name: Ratbat
summary: Ratbats were a non-sentient species that lived on Despayre, a prison world in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The ratbats were caught by the prisoners working on the surface of Despayre and roasted, contributing to their meager diet. All the ratbats on Despayre perished with the destruction of the planet by the first Death Star that occurred in 0 BBY.

name: Rathtar
summary: Rathtars were large, carnivorous cephalopods that were native to the planet Twon Ketee. Regarded as one of the most dangerous beasts in the galaxy, rathtars were known for hunting in packs, and their subspecies, the dwarf rathtar, were involved in an incident known as the Trillia Massacre. They shared common ancestry with the sarlacc, blixus, and vixus.

name: Rattataki
summary: The Rattataki were a Near-Human species characterized by their chalk-white skin and bald heads. Virtually isolated from the rest of the galaxy, the Rattataki developed a violent society on their home planet of Rattatak, which involved extensive gladiatorial combat. Warrior Aidus and criminal Kaliyo Djannis were both Rattataki. The Nightsister and Dark Acolyte named Asajj Ventress was generally thought to be a Rattataki, while in fact she was a similar Zabrak-Human hybrid species called Dathomirians.

name: Rattatakian redjacket
summary: Rattatakian redjackets were creatures from Rattatak who lived in swarms and stung painfully.

name: Ratter thist
summary: Ratter thists, also known as Kordulian Krisses or simply Krisses, were small and agile furry creatures with striped tan fur and retractable claws. They were sometimes kept as pets, and were used to guard livestock in mountain valleys. They were native to Kordu and could also be found on Eislo.

name: Ravenbeast
summary: The ravenbeast was a predatory species native to the jungles of Seregar. It was a large biped, with violet fur and horns. It had large curling claws and clear fangs which were used to attack prey. The claws and fangs were worth about 1,000 credits in Storrd Township.

name: Ravenscreecher
summary: A ravenscreecher was a large multi-clawed bird native to the Outer Rim planet Wxtm. They had a large wing span and six legs with claws half a meter long.

name: Ravinak
summary: Ravinaks were large reptiles that inhabited the frigid planet Pagodon, swimming underneath the ice.

name: Ravna's species
summary: The species of Ravna was a sentient species of vampiric creatures that could infect others and transform them into similar creatures.
distinctions: Infected scratches to transform other into similar creatures
Energy absorption from blaster bolts and lightsabers

name: Rawanikola
summary: Rawanikola were a diminutive sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Jaga Badur was a member of the species.

name: Rawwk
summary: Rawwks were a type of creature found on the gas giant Bespin. They flitted among the algal trees that grew in the breathable upper atmosphere of the planet and nested on vast floating beldons, preying upon schools of air shrimp. Rawwks had a small body and two wings covered in tan and blue feathers. Their head consisted of two eyes with small crests above them and a large mouth with teeth. The creatures also possessed a three pronged blue tail and were blue-and-red tipped. An illustration of a rawwk was included on a map of Bespin thought to have been drawn by the artist Gammit Chond based purely on travelers' tales. The map was later restored and published by the Graf Archive in the Galactic Atlas at some point after 34 ABY and was also included in the updated version of the book.

name: Raxshir
summary: Raxshir, also referred to as sabertooths, were a type of large, predatory feline with yellow fur with black stripes. One raxshir lived in a pine forest on the planet Shili and attacked the Togruta Pav-ti Tano and Ahsoka Tano there in 35 BBY. The creature took the infant Ahsoka and fled when more Togruta arrived, carrying her by the scruff of her neck to a clearing in the forest. There, the child used the Force to calm the raxshir and then rode on its back while they returned to her village. At the village, the raxshir allowed Pav-ti to take Ahsoka from its back before leaving peacefully.

name: Ray
summary: The Ray, also known as the Rayfish or blinding rayfish, were a species of predatory scalefish native to the planet Naboo and Koboh. The blinding rayfish had a protruding mandible and a skeletal appearance. They pretended to be long dead, waiting for their prey to approach. When close enough, the scalefish would stun their prey with a blinding flash of light and striked them with a single lethal blow. On Naboo, the scalefish could be seen in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by the large colo claw fish and opee sea killers that dwelt there. While on Koboh, the scalefish could be seen in the rock pools and watered gulches of the planet. At one point, a noble attempted to take a blinding rayfish as a pet. She decided to parade the rayfish at a gala, where a senator was blinded by the bioluminescent burst of light. In 9 BBY, the Sakavian fisherman Skoova Stev caught a blinding rayfish in a devastated settlement of the High Republic in the Stone Spires area, putting it to the fish tank in Pyloon's Saloon.

name: Rayboo
summary: Rayboo were antlered mammals native to the barren ice tundra of the planet Hoth. They gave loud, wailing cries and were hunted by wampas, alpha predators that occupied the top of Hoth's food chain but primarily hunted tauntauns.

name: Rayeth
summary: The Rayeth were an amphibious sentient species that lived on Inusagi. They had long and slender bodies as well as membranes. Bardbee was a member of the Rayeth species.

name: Raze's species
summary: This alien race were immense and had pale skin. They were distinguished by their long limbs and tall, wattled necks. Their heads were dominated by a pair of heavy tusks that protected their mouths and necks, and their long arms gave them an incredible reach. Raze was a member of this species.
distinctions: Heavy tusks, long arms, tall wattled necks

name: Razhak
summary: Razhak were a non-sentient worm species found on the frigid planet Ilum in the Unknown Regions.

name: Razor-boar
summary: Razor-boars were a species native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space which was nicknamed Graf-World by the Graf family of cartographers. While traveling through the world's swamps in a landspeeder searching for her brother, Lina Graf silenced the family droid CR-8R in case the sound he was making attracted razor-boars.

name: Razoronn
summary: Razoronns were non-sentient predators native to the planet Ord Mantell. They were one of the few carnivore species that could take down a Gapillian grazer by itself. They never got too near to Ord Mantell settlements, wandering the planet's beaches and meadows in search of prey; if not teased, they did not attack humans who came near them, but they could present a serious threat to anything smaller than an armored shuttlecraft if enraged.

name: Razort
summary: Razorts were aquatic creatures native to the planet Sedri. Otter-like, razorts had a fearsome look and a vicious nature. It was a fast predator, possessing long fangs and a razor-tail, along with armored joints. The Sedrian Karak managed to tame one, naming it Tooch.

name: Razorwolf
summary: A razorwolf was a type of wolf that resided on the Inner Rim planet Jakku. In 33 ABY, the human Rey was scavenging inside a starship on Jakku. Rey sensed danger when she heard a creak but was unsure if a razorwolf or another scavenger was on the ship with her. She then discovered the noise had come from two thugs of Unkar Plutt, the junkboss at Niima Outpost.

name: Rdava-bird
summary: The rdava-bird was a species of brightly colored bird native to the planet Garqi. They were small, no larger than the hand of a Human, and had orange and red plumage. Rdava-birds were commonly found in Vlassy Nature Preserve, where they were admired by visiting tourists. Large numbers of rdava-birds began to die off when a leak at an Imperial research station spread a pollen-carried nerve toxin into the nature preserve. Later, a rdava-bird was instrumental in grounding the starfighter of Corran Horn, a former CorSec officer hiding on Garqi.

name: Reap
summary: Reaps were creatures that lived in dead forests on the Forest Moon of Endor. They had a long body, the front end of which featured two eyes and a beak, with which the reap screeched when attacking foes. The reap also had a dark two-pronged organ located at the back end of their body, from which it extruded elastic, white-colored fibre that could entrap members of another species, such as the sentient Ewok and Gupin. Reaps were known to eat Gupins, having completely enveloped the young Gupin Oobel in their fibre when they planned to have him for dinner. When the Gupin Mring-Mring went missing, a group of Ewoks consisting of Kneesaa, Paploo, Wicket, and Teebo, stumbled upon a reap's nest as they searched for the lost Gupin. Agitating a group of reaps, Paploo and Wicket were captured by the reaps and taken to their fibre-built nest that imprisoned Mring-Mring, though Kneesaa and Teebo utilized a fallen tree branch to pull at the reaps' nest, building up force that released their three trapped friends from the reaps' dead forest when they let go of the branch. With their companions freed, Kneesaa and Teebo evaded further attacks from the reaps, quickly making their escape.

name: Rearing spider
summary: The rearing spider, also known as the giant cave spider, was a large arachnid native to Endor that got its name from its way of intimidation and attacking, standing on its rear and encompassing its prey with all of its legs. Unlike most spiders, the rearing spider would hunt its prey instead of capturing them in webbing, and it has six legs instead of eight. It could usually be found in desert caves or scavenging the rotten meat left by a Gorax. They were sometimes preyed upon by condor dragons.

name: Recyclopper
summary: Recycloppers were a species of nonsentient fishes that dwelled in the freshwaters of planet Naboo.

name: Red Nebula temple guardian's species
summary: A sentient species of humanoids stood over 4 meters tall and had shaggy blue-black fur. They had black skin with black, gleaming eyes and flat noses. Their mouths featured sharp canine teeth. The species had two sexes, male and female. By 0 ABY, the species had been reduced to a single member, a female who guarded a temple on a planet in the Red Nebula. When the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca came to the temple to steal the Great Life Jewels she was sworn to protect, she mistook the Wookiee Chewbacca for a cub of her species.

name: Red-pointed viper
summary: The Red-pointed viper is a venomous serpent found in the jungles and swamps of Belkadan. Although not considered as life-threatening, at least not for trandoshans, a red-pointed viper's venom causes nausea which can be cured with antidote. While hunting on Belkadan, trandoshan Qyzen Fess was bitten by a red-pointed viper which caused him sickness. He quickly approached Jedi Master Yuon Par's camp where she offered him antivenom.

name: Redbeast
summary: A redbeast was a omnivorous scavenger and hunter that lived in the lower levels of Vandalar City. They lived in packs of two to twelve creatures. They were about one meter at the shoulder, with a length of two meters. They also had a one-and-a-half-meter bushy tail. Redbeasts were remarkably hardy and adaptive. They were more resistant to poisons and extreme cold than Humans. Their jaws were extremely strong and filled with chisel-like teeth that could gnaw through most materials.

name: Redcrested cougar
summary: Redcrested cougars were large, non-sentient, carnivorous felines native to the Outer Rim planet Belkadan. Armed with large claws, fangs, and a bone-tipped tail, the cougars dwelt in Belkadan's jungles and occasionally attacked sentient beings. Redcrested cougars could not breathe Belkadan's atmosphere after it was changed to noxious fumes by dweebits released by the Yuuzhan Vong.

name: Redfish
summary: Redfish were native to the vacation world of Amfar. They were unusual, in that they congregated out of the water, normally on the beaches, during certain times of day. Because of the Separatist Crisis, there was a steep drop in the number of tourists who would usually scare the creatures. Because of this, the redfish began to reclaim the now-deserted beaches.

name: Redjacket wasp
summary: Redjacket wasps were a species of insect that lived in nests. When TIE/ln space superiority starfighters descended on the Alliance to Restore the Republic Fleet after the Galactic Empire sprung its trap at the Battle of Endor, it reminded Rebel pilot Norra Wexley of angry redjacket wasps descending on someone who had thrown a rock at their nest.

name: Redjelly
summary: Redjellies were a non-sentient species of aquatic creature which inhabited the Boiling Sea on the planet Drall. The creatures traveled in swarms and were light, translucent and delicate in nature. The sea they lived in was a brackish inland lake which was overgrown with kettleweed algae in the wet season and boiled in summer when the algae died on mass and released large amounts of gas.

name: Reeho
summary: Reeho were colorful birds from Gelgelar. They were hunted for food by the native Glarsaur. The Sullustan T'laerean Larn used the Force to merge his mind with the reeho who was named "Sunshine."

name: Reek
summary: Reeks were large, muscular quadrupeds native to the planet Ylesia that could also be found on Saleucami and the Codian Moon.
distinctions: Two cheek horns; one center horn

name: Reel
summary: Reels were large snakes native to Yavin 8. They killed their prey by crushing their bodies. These were among the predators native to the moon that preyed on the Melodies, the moon's sole sentient species. However, reels were in turn hunted by the avrils, massive birds of prey that may have been on the top of the food chain. Anakin Solo killed a reel that attacked Tahiri Veila by slowly stopping its heart with Morichro.

name: Reeman
summary: The Reeman were a sentient species in the galaxy from Katarr.

name: Reenee
summary: Reenee were beasts of burden genetically modified for use in the low gravity environments of Auratera.

name: Reepayto
summary: Reepayto was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. "Doctor Mandible" was a member of this species.

name: Reesarian
summary: Reesarians were a sentient species from the Reesaria system. Possessing almost simian features, they had acute senses and sharp eyesight that allowed them to see in infrared and ultraviolet. When a pair of Reesarians bonded, they became highly attuned to each other's whereabouts. Ort was a crimson-skinned Reesarian with long, plaited hair who served the Path of the Open Hand in the High Republic Era. Phenlass and Odla Sur were a pair of bonded Reesarians who joined the Resistance as soldiers and scouts.

name: Reevo
summary: Reevos were amphibians creatures native to the planet Cholganna. Each had a prominent, lizard-like head on a long, upright neck around 3 meters tall. Reevos also had a water-cannon-like ability to knock down prey.

name: Refuge Stinger
summary: A Refuge Stinger was a species of creature that could be found in the Darkside sector of the planet Coruscant.

name: Regineer Teed's species
summary: A species of sentient humanoid with yellow-and-blue skin and a pair of protruding tusks existed in the galaxy by the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire. Regineer Teed was a member of the species who, in 10 BBY, was part of the Cloud-Riders pirate gang, with the membership of the group being drawn from worlds victimized by the Five Crime Syndicates. Nineteen years later, several members of the same species were also present in various Outer Rim Territories locations.

name: Reigat
summary: The Reigats were a species of large humanoids with grayish, mottled skin and dark blue hair, eyelids, and lips. They were generally a species of loners whose yearly "breeding drive" was probably all that kept them from becoming extinct. The Reigats were sometimes very quick to anger. This was sometimes termed "Reigat Rage".

name: Reindeer
summary: Reindeer were horned creatures that lived in the galaxy. The Dathomirian Zabrak Darth Maul had cranial horns which he could use to impersonate reindeer. Santa Claus owned reindeer.

name: Rek
summary: Reks were a sentient species characterized by slender, whip-like bodies. They had thin skin with the texture and temperature of lukewarm rubber. All Reks had brightly-colored eyes; purple was a common iris color for the females of the species. Many Reks sought work as bounty hunters. A group of several Rek bounty hunters working for the crimelord Nandreeson captured Lando Calrissian and gave him over to their employer.

name: Rekk
summary: The Rekk were a sentient species and the native inhabitants of the planet Rekkana. They were known for their expertise in creating automatic computer-controlled systems. When encountering Imperial TIE fighters above Rekkana shortly after the Battle of Endor, Lando Calrissian guessed that the fighters had been modified by the Rekk.

name: Relix
summary: Relix were huge predatory fish indigenous to Maramere. It closely resembled the opee sea killer. One attacked Nym while he was searching the ruins of the sunken Syren.

name: Rellarin
summary: The Rellarins were sentient bipeds indigenous to Rellnas Minor, a moon orbiting the gas giant Rellnas in the Rell system.
distinctions: Thick plated skin, feeding spikes, reputation for wisdom

name: Relter
summary: Relters were a species of winged creature that resided on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.

name: Remmer
summary: Remmers were a scavenger species from Endor. Variants included the highland remmer. Following the Battle of Yavin, the collector Jener Mich tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of remmers.

name: Renan bloodwolf
summary: Renan bloodwolves were a predatory species native to the planet Rena. Imperial Governor Wilek Nereus once captured a bloodwolf as part of his collection of dental specimens. Mountain ranges above the Renan vineyards were home to this species, which stood just under a meter tall at its shoulder. Its two pair of slashing teeth were abnormally large compared to its skull. These creatures had long dense fur, silvery and mottled in broad patches for camouflage. Mature bloodwolves' tooth enamel was a dusky red-brown caused by iron deposits in the outer layer. Bloodwolves fed on spiny hordzats and hunted banthas in packs. This predator was revered by Pipunt people, who called it the "Great Beast Prince". Renan bloodwolves were known to fiercely protect their young. The brood-fathers of packs could fight to death to protect their offspring — or, when it looked a more secure way to save a cub, could take it into their jaws and run from danger at a speed up to eighty kilometers per hour (though sometimes during such escapes cubs got killed in their powerful jaws by accident).

name: Rendellian
summary: The Rendellians were a species native to the planet Rendel. Rendellians possessed fur that ranged in color from purple, green and orange, as well as wings that matched the color of their hair. Zalla and Bellan were members of this species. One such Rendellian told the story of the Wild Squadron to Rode, a Galactic Empire pilot, while on the planet Bray.

name: Reptilian flier
summary: Reptilian fliers (or flyers), also known as saurian fliers, and saurians, were a large species of carnivorous, winged reptavians native to the Outer Rim world of Dathomir. Beast masters were able to domesticate saurians as personal companions or mountable beasts of burden. They could also be killed and harvested for their leathery hides, bones and meat. Deadly and ferocious, a number of saurians attacked Quinlan Vos when, during 31 BBY, he embarked on a mission to Dathomir. Vos, after being freed from his ejector seat, used his lightsaber to defeat the aggressive beasts. During the time following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, a Dathomirian witch named Rubina offered at least one spacer a decorative model of a reptilian flier as a gift.

name: Reshtini
summary: Reshtini was a sentient alien species. Members of the species could have orange eyes on the sides of their head and could have tan and blue skin. The species had a long neck, a proboscis, two small bumps on top of their heads, and two arms with multiple fingers. Kesmer Faloodi was a member of the species who ate noodles at the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on the planet Ueda in 132 BBY.

name: Resputi-seal
summary: Resputi-seals, also referred to as simply resputi, were a type of large and fierce creature that lived in the deep sinkhole caves of the Outer Rim planet Utapau. The resputi-seals loved to eat Utai, a diminutive sentient species that inhabited the higher levels of the sinkholes, and Utai mine workers that entered the creatures' territory were often attacked by breeding resputi-seals. In 19 BBY, resputi-seals made their lair in caverns beside a bone mine above the pools and grottoes of Coranth in the Mining Level of the Pau Sinkhole on Utapau. Despite the danger posed by the resputi-seals in the darkness of the caves, the best known caverns, pools, grottoes, and ponds at the bottom of the sinkhole were kept safe by the residents of Pau City and so were popular places to relax.

name: Rethel
summary: The Rethel were a sentient species rumored to have existed on a planet in the Far Xandil sector, within the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was rumored that the Rethel had built a city on the planet, at one time long before 2 ABY. The ruins of the city emanated a sensor disruption field known as Rethel Point. However, the ruins were so old, with so little evidence left behind by the builders, that the idea that their name had somehow survived was hard to believe.

name: Reussi
summary: Reussi were Near-Humans from Reuss VIII.

name: Revwien
summary: Revwiens were a sentient species. A Revwien merchant sold Owen Lars a Zephyr-G swoop at an auction in Mos Nytram on the planet Tatooine. The Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse on the planet Coruscant was named for this species.

name: Reyko
summary: Reykos was the most common beast on the planet Volik. It was a docile herd animal similar to a bantha. They were covered in a hard shell-like skin that made the creatures appear like many of the large boulders that covered the planet's landscape; this camouflage aided them in hiding from predators. Their primary source of food was the grass that they shared their home with. They were hardy and impervious to blaster fire. Often, they were used as beasts of burden.

name: Rhak-skuri
summary: Rhak-skuri, which translated from the ancient Sith as "Dream Singer", were a dark side twisted sub-species of Diplura native to the planet Upekzar. The insectoid rhak-skuri excreted powerful pheromones that induced terrifying hallucinations in mammalian species, and fed not only on flesh, but on the terror of their victims—including Force-sensitives.
distinctions: Six legs with hooks, multisectioned body, mandibles, antennae and two-pronged tail extension with pincers on each.
Acid slaver and Carapace which resists to lightsabers energy.
Production of pheromones which create terrifying hallucinations.

name: Rhen Varite
summary: The Rhen Varites were a species indigenous to Rhen Var, where they built beautiful cathedral-like buildings. They went extinct when their homeworld entered an ice age.

name: Rhoa Kwi
summary: Rhoa Kwi were a species of large, fearsome predators from Dathomir that often traveled in packs. They were bipedal reptiles with bulky square heads. Beady eyes were set in the sides of their head, and sharp biting teeth jutted from their lower jaw. They had greenish yellow hides. When provoked they would spit a poisonous substance. They were a Kwi variant.
distinctions: Bulky head, teeth jutting from lower jaw

name: Rib-cat
summary: Rib-cats were a species of non-sentient cats found on the moon of Nar Shaddaa.

name: Ridadi
summary: The Ridadi were a species of star-locust who were known to migrate through space. While migrating, they used the specific magnetic pulses of nearby stars to guide them and usually avoided inhabited worlds. However, their way of navigation meant that any man-made magnetic pulses of a similar frequency could lead them astray. Ridadi were also known to migrate through the area near the planet Shuraden once every generation.

name: Ri'Dar
summary: Ri'Dar were sentient flying primates from the forests of the planet Dar'Or. As adults, they had a wingspan of three meters and were approximately one meter long, counting their furry tails. Ri'Dar evolved from tree-climbing creatures who had evolved flaps of skin between their arms and legs in order to glide. Over time, the simple gliding flaps evolved into true wings supported by extended fingers on their hands. The energy needed for flight required Ri'Dar to consume up to half their body weight in food each day, usually in the form of insects, fruit, and fungi. Ri'Dar were agile fliers on Dar'Or and other low-gravity planets, but they could not fly in environments with heavier than one standard gravity. The Ri'Dar became known to the galaxy after their homeworld was transformed into an Imperial nature preserve, not for any of Dar'Or's native fauna, but for a predatory bird called the elix. The animal came from a high-gravity planet that was on the brink of destruction from a looming supernova. Since Dar'Or was a low-gravity planet, the elix proved even deadlier predators after their relocation. The Ri'Dar, already preyed upon by the sabretoothed indola, had only their swiftness and keen senses to protect them from the new threat. On their homeworld, Ri'Dar lived a simple existence in their treetop warrens. Their technology consisted primarily of wooden spears, bows, and similar tools. The typical Ri'Dar was nervous and fearful by nature, since flying away from their many predators was their most effective defense. They tended to live for the present rather than the future, as they often had little confidence in their long-term survival. Such libertinism also gave them a mercurial temperament: a Ri'Dar had the capability to become very angry or very happy with little warning. During courtship, Ri'Dar engaged in mating dances. Ri'Dar were surprisingly common away from their homeworld, as they sometimes stowed away with smugglers and poachers who arrived on Dar'Or to hunt elix for their valuable meat. Ri'Dar were often found as companions of smugglers, either as pets, servants, or, rarely, full crew members.
distinctions: Graceful flight in low gravity, keen senses

name: Rigellian
summary: The Rigellians were hulking green-skinned sentient humanoids from Rigel VII. Due to the high gravity of their home planet, the reptilian Rigellians were very large-framed, dense, and heavily-muscled. This made them formidable foes on normal gravity planets, on which they were reportedly strong enough to tear apart vehicles and other metal objects. Rigellians sometimes were employed as assassins due to their impressive physical prowess. At the time of the Galactic Civil War, they were nearly extinct. The bounty hunter with the alias of Darth Vader's porter belonged to this species.

name: Rigellian
summary: Rigellians were a type of sentient species. Kang and Kodos were members of the species.

name: Riileb precursor species
summary: A species of insects native to the planet Riileb in Hutt Space eventually evolved into the sentient Riileb species, who could grow to between 2 and 2.75 meters tall. The precursor species were social in nature and possessed antennae. They lived on the few islands amongst the swamps of their homeworld, where they built complex labyrinth-like mounds to live in. The Riileb retained many aspects of the species's insectoid heritage including their antennae. They also built cities similarly complex to their ancestors mounds. The First Riileb to have evolved from the precursor species was an important figure in Riileb legend.

name: Riileb
summary: The Riilebs were a sentient species of humanoid insectoids that were indigenous to the planet of Riileb. Members of the species were relatively tall, with gray, knobbly skin and two antennae, which could detect changes in the biorhythms of other organisms. Using their antennae, the species could detect the mood of those around them, which made them good at setting others at ease and so resulted in others perceiving the Riilebs as a likable people. They also possessed four nostrils on a nose that was much flatter than that of a Human; two nostrils were for inhaling and two were for exhaling. The Riileb homeworld was within Hutt Space; however, after its discovery by Nimbanese scouts working for the Hutts, the Riilebs refused to bow down to the Hutts and serve them. Following several attempted invasions of Riileb by the Hutts, the invaders relented and the Riilebs retained their independence, making them one of the few species in Hutt Space to do so. Riileb society was controlled by the individual in possession of a piece of jewelry known as the ClanRing, which traditionally belonged to the eldest member of the motherclan, descendants of a mythical first Riileb, who was believed to have created the ring. The Riileb Tere Metallo was an agent of the Rebellion and the New Republic.

name: Rikahawk
summary: Rikahawks were a type of hawk that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Valo. Their diet consisted of the world's ground-dwelling creatures. In 229 BBY, the Jedi youngling Gavi thought about the way he perceived the Force as a network of threads and considered how all living entities formed systems—including how the sun evaporated water into the air to form a thermal for the rikahawks circling above.

name: Rikknit
summary: The rikknit was a crustacean native to New Plympto. They had eight to twelve legs and lived at the tops of hiakk trees. Rikknit spun webs for nests and storage. Female rikknit had ovum sacs connected to their abdomens. The Nosaurians removed these to harvest their eggs, which were sold offworld as a delicacy. They also harvested ovum sacks from rikknit and processed them into an addictive substance called ji rikknit. Rikknits were hunted with harvest blades before Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum declared them a protected species.

name: Rill
summary: Rills were reptiles native to Tatooine that looked like scyks. They were not aggressive unless attacked. They had spines along their backs and very sharp teeth, and lived in Tatooine's deserts alongside womp rats. After the Battle of Yavin, Animal Control officer Entha Kandela tasked a spacer to eliminate tempest rills around Mos Eisley to prevent them to chew on the insulation of power cables in the city. Rill meat could be used as food.

name: Rinacat
summary: The rinacat was a solitary hunting mammal native to Carosi XII. It preyed mainly upon herd animals but would occasionally descend from the mountains to attack Carosites. Rinacats were known for their unflinching tenacity, and would sometimes cross a continent in pursuit of prey.

name: Rindian
summary: Rindians were an alien race from the Rindia system. They were small in stature, had pointed ears, and possessed eight digits on each hand. Their speech was melodious to the hearer.

name: Ring-dog
summary: Ring-dogs were a type of dog that had banded tails. In 4 ABY, New Republic pilot Norra Wexley and her son, Temmin Wexley, argued about fleeing from the planet Akiva, with Norra claiming it was her decision to make as Temmin's parent. A thousand potential angry rebuttals to her statement ran through Temmin's head like ring-dogs chasing their own tails, but he decided it was not the right time for such a response and instead claimed to have a different plan for their survival.

name: Riorian
summary: The Riorians were an insect-like species. One named Loje Nella was present during a performance by the Max Rebo Band at Jabba's Palace in 4 ABY.

name: Ripclaw
summary: Ripclaws were predators of nerfs.

name: Ripoblus
summary: The Ripoblus, colloquially known as the Rips, were a cultural group of the Sepan species native to Ripoblus, one of the two primary worlds of the Sepan system. The Ripoblus were involved with the people of Dimok in the Sepan Civil War, a conflict which lasted intermittently for centuries.

name: Ripper-raptor
summary: Ripper-raptors, also known as ripper raptors, were a little-documented species of flying reptiles native to the planet Jakku. With their leathery wings and keen eyesight, they rode the thermals in the Kelvin Ravine or on Carbon Ridge, looking for carrion.

name: Rishi eel
summary: Rishi eels were predatory creatures native to the Rishi Moon, where the Republic's Rishi Station was located.

name: Rishii
summary: The Rishii were the inhabitants of the planet Rishi. They were an intelligent avian species that lived in high mountains. The Rishii were cordial and uninterested in advanced technology, choosing to remain relatively isolated. During the Clone Wars, they were led by Chief Gwark, and they cooperated with the Galactic Republic to repel Geonosian Separatists.

name: Risp
summary: The Risp were small dog-like amphibians native to Ord Vaxal, often trained as guard animals. Risps had yellow-green skin, wide mouths encrusted with serrated teeth, and six strong limbs with webbed feet and jagged claws. They hunted either solo or in family units. When they were alarmed or attacking, they emitted gurgling hisses and shrieks. They were susceptible to the rakghoul plague, and if infected would transform into minature rakghouls called raklings.

name: River frog
summary: River frogs were a type of frog that sang at night and were found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Genbara. While the former Sith known as the Ronin was traveling through the city Osou on Genbara after sunset, he expected to be left alone because it was dark enough for river frogs to sing. However, the storyteller known as the Traveler tracked him down, which troubled the Ronin.

name: River otter
summary: The river otter was a type of otter. The Sessehshellah, a sentient race of mustalids native to the Expansion Region planet Shaymore, resembled larger versions of river otters.

name: River Qwewt
summary: The River Qwewt was a reptilian found on the forest planets Tenoo and Yamradi. They lived near bodies of water and resembled a gecko.

name: River serpent
summary: A river serpent was a carnivorous predator native to the rain forests of the planet Kirtania. They were between two to three meters in length, and basked on river banks waiting for larger prey such as rodents or wild pigs. The serpents preferred to attack by luring their prey into rivers where they had the advantage, then constricted around them and bit them. They could kill prey up to the size of a Human.

name: River toad
summary: River toads were a type of toads. In 40 BBY, Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi felt that the Pijali Minister Orth's facial expression during a conversation about the Opposition performance troupe with Pijal's lord regent Rael Averross expressed disgust, as if she would rather lick a river toad than agree with the leader's musings.

name: Ro hypa
summary: The ro hypa was a serpentine creature native to the desert planet Mataou in the Anoat sector. They were red and purple in appearance and were highly venomous, capable of spewing potent poison at their prey.

name: Ro-roo
summary: The ro-roo was a small, herbivorous primate that was native to the wroshyr tree forests of Kashyyyk. Ro-roo paws were often used as good luck amulets.

name: Roba
summary: Robas were large pig beasts native to the planet Aralia. A roba's average adult weight was nine hundred kilograms. [[File:Roba_SWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A roba on Talus.]] Robas were the favored prey of the Ranats, who used hit-and-run tactics to kill them. Packs of Ranats would chase them, making swift, flesh-ripping attacks with their large tusks to weaken the robas and quickly retreating. Eventually, the weakened beasts would fall, and the Ranats would move in for the kill. Robas were rare on Aralia, possibly due to overhunting by the Ranats. On Taanab, they were farmed for their meat and were presumably the source of roba steak. Wild robas could also be found on the planet Talus and the forest moon of Endor.

name: Robuma
summary: Robumas were herbivorous mammals native to the moon Toshara where they roamed the savannas. Herd animals by instinct, they were domesticated by the first arrivals to the moon and became essential to Tosharan culture, with the creatures' milk, leather, and meat all commonly used in a variety of ways. The majority of robuma farmers kept their herds released across grazing territories and used speeders and droids to move them from place to place.

name: Rock beetle
summary: Rock beetles were six-legged insects that lived in the deserts of Tatooine. A large population of rock beetles was known to live in an area known as Rock Beetle Refuge. The cook Porcellus used rock beetle and cave beetle carcasses to make beetle broth for his master, Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

name: Rock hornet
summary: Rock hornets were swarming insects native to Tatooine. The ire of a disturbed rock hornet was proverbial.

name: Rock mouse
summary: A rock mouse was a type of mouse present in the rocky wilderness of the planet Korba. At some point by 19 BBY, the Korban miners Attu and Abat prepared to descend into the mountain Spire 17 mine. Abat's daughter Aau—who was secretly watching the pair—slipped down the edge of the spire and let out a short scream before hiding to avoid being seen. Attu investigated the sound but assumed the noise came from rock mice.

name: Rock sucker
summary: Rock Suckers were a type of gastropod native to Mytus VII that drew trace minerals from the stony crust.

name: Rock-vulture
summary: Rock-vultures were a species of carnivorous bird native to the planet Utapau in the Outer Rim Territories. They were one of the few species that inhabited the planet's wind-torn surface, where they devoured their prey without waiting for it to perish. The B1-series battle droid Mister Bones was modified by the young Temmin Wexley to have the cut of a rock-vulture's skull.

name: Rock wart
summary: Rock warts, also spelled rock-wart, were a species of venomous parasites that could be found on Tatooine. They had eight legs and four eyes. Within their sting and bite, the rock warts of Tatooine possessed a painful neurotoxic venom, and the rock warts used their toxic bite to kill their target before laying their eggs in his or her body. Rockwart venom could kill much larger prey. The venom was used in the preparation of a powder utilized by assassins.
distinctions: Eight legs, four eyes, venomous bite

name: Rock worm
summary: A rock worm was a type of worm. In 134 BBY, during the dueling tournament of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual on the planet Siline, the opponent of Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon commented on her small size. Lon responded by comparing herself to a lesser leaf viper, which she noted was both smaller and deadlier than the related elder viper, but appeared to only be as interesting as a rock worm. Lon's opponent asked if she had actually compared herself to a worm, and she replied that it was a "very dangerous" worm.

name: Rockfish
summary: Rockfish was a species of fish. Rockfish could be served raw and eaten as part of a meal, and was served aboard the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan and at the annual Vor-cal Feast held aboard the House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge over the planet Vycinyth.

name: Rockhopper
summary: The rockhopper was a bipedal riding animal.

name: Rockmite
summary: Rockmites were insects which could supposedly burrow into and nest inside the horns of Iktotchi suffering from horn rot. In 41 BBY, when Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi encountered the child inhabitants of the remote planet Lenahra, he was recruited by the changeling Zae-Brii to assist in persuading the young Iktotchi Gremac to take care of his horns before going to bed. The two brought up the dangers of rockmites burrowing inside his horns if they rotted, which frightened Gremac enough that he agreed to brush his horns.

name: Rockrender
summary: Rockrenders were large creatures who lived within the caves of the volcanic planet Sullust. They were attracted to the taste of dense minerals—including those found in stormtrooper armor. They had two extremely long claws on each front leg and a long tail.

name: Rodian
summary: Rodians were reptilian humanoids native to the planet Rodia. During the Clone Wars, Rodia was represented by Senator Onaconda Farr in the Galactic Republic's senate. He briefly sided with the Trade Federation during the war, under the promise of food and protection from pirates. Rodia was betrayed, and fell back in line with the Republic. A number of Rodians acted as bounty hunters, including Greedo and Jakoli. Greedo was an amateur eventually killed by the smuggler Han Solo, while Jakoli was a skilled bounty hunter who only killed his targets. Some Rodians also worked as informants, such as Tsoklo, who worked for the Galactic Empire.

name: Rodian Karstag
summary: The Rodian Karstag was a predator, native to Rodia, that inhabited swampy and damp forests. An adult was about 1.5 meters in height at the shoulder and between 4 and 5 meters long. Despite the animals' bulky appearance, they were deceptively fast creatures. They had scaled bodies that were supported by four powerful membranous webbed feet that aided locomotion in water and swamps. The karstag had an elongated neck and a triangular head. Its eyes were located at the top of head to allow visibility while the creature was submerged. Its mouth was lined with teeth and included one prominent incisor at the roof of the mouth and two at the bottom. A bone-like club with large spikes at the end of its tail was used by the animal as a weapon and was what made the Rodian karstag so dangerous. The Rodian Karstag was hunted for sport during the annual Vor-cal on the planet Vilhon in the Tapani sector. It was served roasted with Algae-bread stuffing at the Vor-cal Feast.

name: Rodian kelp gnat
summary: Rodian kelp gnats were a species of non-sentient insect from the planet Rodia. Naturally they lived for only twenty-four hours, however the Kubaz chef Zubindi Ebsuk could keep a member of the species alive for up to five years using growth enzymes, which caused many changes to the gnats. Those with extended lives could sing and whistle and in the fifth year of their life they developed tentacles with which they could move around on. In 13 ABY, the Hutt Jedi Knight Beldorion served a gnat that Ebsuk had raised for a year to the Human diplomat Leia Organa Solo after he captured her on the planet Nam Chorios. The gnat was blue and cherry-like in appearance when it was served and both the Hutt and Organa enjoyed it immensely due to the fact it was sweet, meaty, juicy, and subtly chambered.

name: Rodian rot-worm
summary: The Rodian rot-worm was a parasitic worm that shared its name with Rodia, a planet of jungle and oceans located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, as well as its native Rodian species of sentient reptilians. Its name was also similar to that of rotworms, which lived on the swamp planet Dagobah in the Outer Rim's Sluis sector. By 3630 BBY, excretions from drutash grubs that could be found on the planet Sullust in the Outer Rim's Brema sector were being used in folk medicine to cure parasitic infections such as that caused by the Rodian rot-worm. That year, an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing struggle between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire sent a companion to investigate the scientific validity of that practice, with the latter individual subsequently collecting biochemical samples.

name: Rodisar
summary: Rodisar was a sapient reptilian species from the planet Rodis in the Outer Rim Territories. Rodisars were a primitive inhabitants and waged seasonal wars with one another. General Nilo was a member of this species that was kidnapped from his homeplanet by a Zygerrian slavers. He eventually ended up in the gladiatorial arena of Rattatak around 22 BBY.
distinctions: Long snout, broad paws and dragging tail

name: Rodus
summary: A rodus was a type of rodent eaten by felinxes.

name: Roggwart
summary: Roggwarts were large, predatory reptiles with curved horns, long tails, and thick skin from the planet Mustafar, Vendaxa, and Guiteica. During the Clone Wars, General Grievous kept a roggwart named "Gor" as a pet.
distinctions: Long arms, claws, teeth, and curving horns

name: Rokarian dirt-fish
summary: The Rokarian dirt-fish was a type of fish found in the Rokaria system of the Outer Rim Territories. Members of the galactic populace were known to "gut" dirt-fish. In 21 BBY, during the ongoing Clone Wars, Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray, while being held prisoner aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tranquility, was questioned by Jedi Master Luminara Unduli. Reasoning that he needed to be scared, Padawan Ahsoka Tano snapped at Gunray, threatening to gut him like a dirt-fish with her lightsaber if he did not cooperate, although she was not serious. While Tano's outburst made Gunray more cooperative, Unduli quickly responded, reminding the Padawan that the Jedi Order did not use terror.

name: Rokkna
summary: Rokkna were a species of massive, tentacled sea creatures native to the planet Castilon.

name: Rok's species
summary: A green-skinned species lived in The galaxy. A group of the species, who served as woodsmen, landed on Endor to harvest the moon's trees. They also enslaved a number of Ewoks and foonars in order to further their efforts, including Dooni's mother.

name: Rolk-mangir
summary: Rolk-mangir (translated from Yinchorri as "horned death"), were an apex predator native to the planet Yinchorr. Four meters tall with an extremely tough hide, rolk-mangir were also quite fast and cunning, and lived in social groups centered around a strength-based pecking order. Although it was at one point fashionable for Imperial Moffs and other officials to train the beasts as guard animals, a series of violent incidents led to rolk-mangir being banned from private ownership throughout much of the galaxy.

name: Rollerfish
summary: The rollerfish was a meter-long, elusive fish that was native to the upper ocean layers of the planet Kamino. Distinguished by the curved spines found along the dorsal and ventral ridges of their bodies, rollerfish were named for the way in which they captured and killed their prey. After grasping prey with their toothy mouths, rollerfish then rolled their bodies around the prey, piercing it with their spines. The primary prey of the rollerfish was the sea-mouse. In 22 BBY, Jango Fett would occasionally take his son, Boba, fishing off the platform ledges of Tipoca City. To get a fish, one must spear it. Hitting a certain area will instantly stun the fish, making for an easy catch.

name: Rombuk
summary: Rombuk were non-sentient creatures in the galaxy used as mounts around 3627 BBY.

name: Romin
summary: Romin were a humanoid species with a somewhat smaller stature than that of Humans. Romin had golden skin and eyes. Their noses were flat, barely raised on their faces, and their mouths were wide and expressive. The Romin hailed from the planet Romin and were divided into two classes. The ruling class was the minority of Romin who had wealth and status. The majority of the Romin were of the working class who lived in poverty and took up homes in vast shanty towns that were set up outside the richer cities. The rampant disease and decay that dominated the ghettos of Romin gave the working class a much shorter lifespan, with many of their children not reaching their second birthdays. The Romin were ruled by a single dictator who went by the title of Great Leader. The Great Leader during the final days of the Republic before the Clone Wars was Roy Teda, who became infamous for hiding galactic criminals on the planet for substantial bribes collected by his "charity" deputy.

name: Ronga bug
summary: Ronga bugs were small insects of the moon Toshara. They possessed light-emitting organs that they used to locate one another in darkness. The Tosharans considered the bugs to bring good fortune when they landed in one's hand, with many tales revolving around magical ronga bugs granting advice or wishes.

name: Ronk
summary: The ronk was a vicious feline carnivore native to the planet Cilpar. The male ronk was considered a delicacy by the locals, while the female was fatally poisonous. Bodies were often cremated before a ronk would get to it. They were known to be attracted to light.

name: Ronto
summary: Rontos were four-legged saurian herbivores native to the desert world of Tatooine. Skittish yet gentle and strong, they were the favored pack animals and mounts of the indigenous Jawas.

name: Roonan
summary: The Roonan were a sentient species that were native to Roona. The Roonan had blue or gray skin and they had a ridged forehead and cranium with large, almond-shaped blue eyes. Short in stature, they had big ideas and were notoriously easy to offend. They were known to take even the slightest slip-up as a deep insult. The Jedi Master Halsey was a member of this species, as were Senators Aang and Edcel Bar Gane. According to C-3PO, the Roonan had tiny teeth. They were reputed for being very picky and particular regarding details; the slightest error could be taken as a grievous insult.

name: Roon's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Roon was a member of this species.

name: Root locust
summary: Root locusts were a type of insect found on the planet Siline. In 134 BBY, during the survival level of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual on Siline, the contestant Lionine Graf moved through a forest near badlands and heard the constant buzzing of root locusts.

name: Root-mouse
summary: A root-mouse was a type of mouse that squeaked. During the Wookiee holiday of Life Day one year, when the Wookiee Chewbacca removed a luma-bulb illumination device from the ceiling of his starship, the Millennium Falcon, it sounded like a root-mouse's squeaks.

name: Ropagu
summary: The Ropagu were Near-Humans who lived on Ropagi II. They were the creators of the Great Library, containing thousands of years of Ropagu history. The Ropagu were often hosts for the Kalduu, a species also indigenous to Ropagi II. The two species had a long-standing friendship.

name: Ropedancer
summary: Ropedancers were water serpents found on Yavin 8. With an average diameter of 1 meter and a maximum length of 48 meters, these fanged predators had a very elastic digestive system and were capable of expanding it up to twice its normal size. On rare occasions, Ropedancers were known to have swallowed entire Ursods.

name: R'ora
summary: The R'ora were a sentient species that were native to the planet Luprora. They had an antagonistic relationship with the Lupr'or, a race of humanoid migrants that had colonized Luprora. Following the Battle of Starkiller Base, the First Order lieutenant Sol Rivas was captured by the R'ora. Captain Phasma subsequently led a Lupr'or assault on the R'ora stronghold in order to kill Rivas to conceal her role in the destruction of Starkiller Base.

name: Rormaroo
summary: The rormaroo was a native species of Pallaxides that was frequently used as riding beasts.

name: Roshan
summary: Roshans were humanoid beings who lived on the planet of Rosha in the Leemurtoo system. They were a tall species with strong, flexible bodies and light blue or green eyes. Their most defining features were four antennae on their heads that were as delicate as tendrils and sensitive to light, shrinking against their heads during the day and unfurling in darkness or with anxiety. The Samarians also lived in the same system as them. The Roshans were about to make a trade agreement with the Samarians when the Galactic Empire intervened.

name: Rotgrub
summary: The Rotgrub was a non-sentient creature.

name: Rott Mercer's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Rott Mercer was a member of this species.

name: Rozzum
summary: The Rozzum were a species of sentient aliens who came from another dimension than that of the known universe. They had ties to the Order of the Terrible Glare, a group of dissident Jedi Knights formed during the Pius Dea Crusades. In ancient times, several Rozzum were stranded on PL-40112-CE-021105, a planet of the Wild Space. Some time later, during the Empire's reign, Imperial surveyors encountered that group of Rozzum after having inadvertently awakened them. The Imperials allied with the local people to fight the monsters off, which left only two survivors. During the Galactic Civil War, the young Luke Skywalker encountered Rozzum on Garn, where he had been lured by Rur, the last High Shaman of the Terrible Glare.

name: Rseikharhl
summary: The Rseikharhl were a sentient species from Rseik, which was located in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. By 214 BBY, the Rseikharhl were technologically advanced and were able to provide antidotes for the Bordal Contagion that year after the Galactic Republic's shipments were destroyed by Fujari pirates. Following the Republic's inability to aid the sector, the Rseikharhl, Kett Shipping, the Ma'ar Shaddam Weaponsmiths Guild, and other interests from the area set up a meeting with a representative from the Trade Federation, which ended with many of the organizations in the area becoming Trade Federation members. The Rseikharhl developed droids such as the LE-VO law enforcement droid, which they used in law enforcement across the entire sector. By the time of the Galactic Empire, the species was under Imperial jurisdiction, and their droids had spread throughout the galaxy, especially to worlds on the galactic frontier.

name: Ru
summary: The Ru were a small, furry, and primitive mammalian sentient species native to the planet Phorose. Despite the fact that the locals considered them rodents, scientists believed that the Ru were, in fact, sentient beings, due to the fact that they worshiped in temples that they built. During the battle of Phorose around 20 BBY, Padawans Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee accidentally found a group of Ru that had been living in a temple under the Phorosian capital. Their temple was destroyed by a patrol of battle droids sent to eliminate the two Jedi, and while the survivors were being evacuated via a LAAT/i, the gunship was attacked by two Vulture droids, killing the Ru onboard, except for two survivors.

name: Rubat spinner
summary: The rubat spinner was a species native to the planet Phemis.

name: Ruby-throated kete
summary: The Ruby-throated kete was a species of avians that were native to the world of Bellassa. They possessed pale faces and red throats, as did Kestrel when he grew angry, a similarity observed by Trever Flume.

name: Rugger
summary: Ruggers were a type of arboreal, herbivorous rodent native to the Forest Moon of Endor. Expert climbers, the agile creatures were hunted by many of the moon's predators, including the temptor, which used the furry heads of their long tongues to effectively bait the characteristically curious ruggers. The sentient Yuzzum also hunted ruggers, using domesticated rakazzak beasts to try and catch the rodents when they hid in long grasses so that they could make roasted "rugger." Rugger song could be heard in the treetop villages of the sentient Ewok species—who made jerky from the rodents—as ruggers climbed through the settlements.

name: Rughja
summary: Rugjha were non-humanoid sentients with fifteen flexible limbs, glossy mauve skin, and multiple eyes. To Humans, they appeared to be a tangle of limbs with the occasional eye peeping out. Rugjha could become talented musicians, partly because they could play ten or more instruments at once. Among the most famous Rugjha musicians were Umjing Baab and His Swinging Trio (though Baab was considered a part of this trio, as he only had two fellow members in the band.) Though they could play instrumental music which humanoids could hear and enjoy, they did not sing to them, as their natural voices were inaudible to most humanoids. Rugjha used artificial mechanisms to speak Basic to Humans.

name: Rujo
summary: Rujos were silver-furred, herd-dwelling quadrupeds from Annaj spread to Qina and other Moddell sector worlds as domestic animals for carrying cargo or riders.

name: Rulan Prolik's species
summary: This species was a sentient species found within the galaxy. They were distinguished by their polymorphic capabilitue. Upon death, members of this species will erupt into a bright ball of light before reverting to what may be their original form. One member of this species, Rulan Prolik, served as one of the four overseers of GenoHaradan by 3956 BBY, though they were eventually killed by Jedi Knights in the Shadowlands of the planet Kashyyyk after impersonating members of the native Wookiee population such as Grarwwaar.

name: Ruloosian sand-snake
summary: The Ruloosian sand-snake was a species from the Ruloosia system. It was also a slang term used by the Hutt crime lord Rarsk in reference to Han Solo, who tricked him and Bo-Dum.

name: Runner snake
summary: The runner snake was a species of snake that lived in the swamps of the planet Lowick. At some point during galactic history, the Hutt hunter Parella journeyed to Lowick on a quest to locate the last member of the Gorach species, and he had his droid drones bomb the world's swamps, in an attempt to drive out the creature. A number of runner snakes subsequently fled from the flames that were ignited by the bombing.

name: Runyip
summary: Runyips were a herbivorous species that foraged on the floors of Yavin 4's forests, where they were harassed by piranha beetles.

name: Ruori
summary: The Ruori was a flying animal native to the planet Zuliria. It was used as a personal transport in the planet's cities.

name: Ruping
summary: Rupings were a notable reptavian species native to the planet Onderon. They had vocal chords that produced a rasping roar, finger-like wingtips, and a thumb claw that allowed them to grasp and climb with their wings. Loyal and brave creatures, ruping were used as mounts by Onderonian outcasts and the Onderon rebels during the Onderon Civil War, during which the rebels equipped them with saddles and reins.

name: Rur's species
summary: This alien race was a race of humanoids similar in appearance to Siniteen, Sunesi or Vultan with thick cranial nodules on their bald plates. Rur was a member of this species.
distinctions: Thick cranial nodules on head plates

name: Rutanian
summary: Rutanians were the native species of the planet Rutan. Their species had an offshoot called the Senali who inhabited Rutan's own moon Senali. The rivalry between the two species was provoked by the Yuuzhan Vong into war, leaving both Rutan and Senali weak and vulnerable to invasion.

name: Rutian
summary: Rutian referred to one of the many skin tones of the Twi'lek species, generally denoting a shade of blue. Rutian Twi'leks included Jedi Master Aayla Secura, Jedi Padawans Vix Fonnick and Eldra Kaitis, twin masseuses Ann Gella and Tann Gella, Twi'lek Resistance member Gobi Glie, Free Ryloth Movement member Isval, Free Ryloth movement strategist Kaasha Bateen, Rebel pilot Yendor Brethen, and Galactic Republic Senator Orn Free Taa.

name: Ruurian
summary: {{Update|Mace Windu: The Glass Abyss, Star Wars: Alien Archive, }} Ruurians were a species of multi-limbed sentients with feathered antennae from the planet Ruuria. Slyyth, a Ruurian criminal, lived on Lothal around 3272 LY.

name: Ruusanian
summary: The Ruusanians were a species native to the planet Ruusan.

name: Rwook
summary: Rwooks were the most common Wookiee subspecies, native to the planet Kashyyyk. They largely inhabited the tree-city Rwookrrorro. Rwooks were distinguished by their fur, which commonly had more earth-like tones than albino Wookiees, such as red, brown, or chestnut. Chewbacca and Ralrracheen were notable examples of Rwooks.

name: Rybet
summary: The Rybet were an amphibious, frog-like, sentient species that lived in the galaxy. One Rybet was killed in Oga's Cantina on Batuu during the Clone Wars. One was also killed on the Elegencia as he got shot for doubting Pan Eyta's decisions. The Rybet were considered an ancient species and had long since scattered across the galaxy, resulting in numerous subspecies such as the Querm Rybet from Quermia.

name: Ry'coz
summary: The Ry'coz were a sentient species native to Novor 23, the sole habitable planet in the Novor system. It was located on the Sisar Run hyperlane, at the northern edge of the Periphery—a small region of space captured by the Galactic Empire that was formerly part of Hutt Space. The Ry'coz cooperated with immigrants of Human and other species to produce a thriving economy and cultural scene. This attracted the shipping company Jatayus Outbound to establish its offices on the Ry'coz's homeworld. The planet's Vos'yr valley was home to the villa retreat of the Black Sun Vigo Sprax.

name: Rycrit
summary: Rycrits were herd animals native to Ryloth. They were quadrupeds with short fur, long faces, four nostrils, pointed teeth, and sharp cloven hooves. Twi'leks raised them for their hides, and as a source of meat (often served as rycrit stew). Planets with a substantial Twi'lek population often imported rycrit herds. One such planet was Talasea, though the rycrits there went feral when the last of the Talasean colonists were killed by Imperial forces under Darth Vader. The Twi'lek Kur ate on one for a month when banished to the nightlands by Nolaa Tarkona. He used the bones for tools and hide for a blanket.

name: Rylothian blurrg
summary: The Rylothian blurrg, or Ryloth blurrg, was a type of blurrg that was native to the planet Ryloth. During the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War, the Twi'lek rebel Cham Syndulla rode such a blurrg.

name: Ryn
summary: The Ryn were a humanoid sentient species with white hair and prehensile tails. They were known to be itinerant and were rarely seen in the Core Worlds. Shortly before the end of the Clone Wars, two Ryn followed Lyra Erso only to offer a scintillating pendant.

name: Ryukyu hare
summary: Ryukyu hares were a type of hare that were prone to sneak away and flee when scared. When Imperial Grand Moff Valco Pandion suggested that the Empire retreat from the planet Akiva during the rebellion on Akiva in 4 ABY, Admiral Rae Sloane compared his suggestion to the behavior of a cowardly Ryukyu hare, silencing him.

name: Saadul
summary: The Saadul were a sentient species. In 25 ABY, a number of Saadul were displaced by the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy, and ended up with numerous other refugees on the planet Ruan. The Ruan authorities created a central database keeping track of all refugees. While the list was sorted by species, the Saadul did not receive an entry in the main listing; instead, along with the Rybet and Ryn species, they were placed in the "other" category. This was a common occurrence for the species.

name: Saarl
summary: Saarl, also known as Rift Worms, were large worm-like creatures that were native to the planet of Tython. These fearsome beasts possessed massive maws that they used to devour their prey. Typically, one did not fight the creatures and tended to run from them. The Je'daii encountered these animals following their relocation to Tython by the Tho Yor. Je'daii Master Quan-Jang and his apprentice Shae Koda attempted to catch one of these worms. The beast almost killed the pair though they managed to survive the encounter. When the Force Hound Xesh crashed on Tython, the event led to a powerful Force Storm being unleashed and a Saarl was able to project Force lightning due to the phenomena. This specimen attempted to kill Xesh but where it fought Sek'nos Rath, Shae Koda and Tasha Ryo.

name: Sabat
summary: The Sabat were a sentient species in the galaxy. The Sabat had blue, pink, or tan colored skin, large foreheads and flattened heads. Leevan Tenza, a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans, was a Sabat. Gelan Yees was a Sabat member of the Cloud-Riders. At least one Sabat was a Jedi Initiate during the Republic Era.

name: Saber cat
summary: The saber cat, or sabercat, was a huge, feline, carnivorous species native to the planet Monastery. They were predators with a thick horn which protruded from the top of the skull. The saber cat had four huge paws, each with five razor-sharp claws. Their teeth were also razor-sharp. [[File:SaberCat-MSW36.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A saber cat attacks Luke Skywalker]] In their years on Monastery, the members of the Order of the Sacred Circle had tamed several saber cats, and kept them as pets. The whelps brought a high price on the black market, and they were often pets and status symbols for crimelords and nobles. When Luke Skywalker accompanied Domina Tagge back to Monastery on a diplomatic mission, he saved her from a seeming-saber cat. In truth, Domina Tagge manipulated the creature, (as she had done earlier with a nightshrike).

name: Saber-fang
summary: Saber-fangs were a species of animal whose physiology included blood. Fully grown saber-fangs would sometimes fight one another, with the result usually being that both participants left the conflict bloodied and a victor being difficult to identify. In 20 BBY, the Sakiyan Tarnese Bleyd, who served as an Admiral in the Navy of the Galactic Republic believed a fight between himself and the Human combat instructor Phow Ji would be similar to a saber-fang fight, as he was not sure he could defeat Ji as an opponent.

name: Sabercat
summary: Sabercats were dangerous felines found on the planet Lothal that preyed on Loth-cat kittens. They used the grass of Lothal's grasslands as cover while hunting herbivores.

name: Saberfish
summary: Saberfish were a type of enormous fish that lived in the storm seas of the Mid Rim planet Tibrin. During the High Republic Era, a countess from the Core Worlds planet Abregado-rae ordered a saberfish for her private aquarium. The fish was transported to Abregado at great difficulty by the Byne Guild Class A modular freight transport Legacy Run under the command of Captain Hedda Casset in a water tank within its primary compartment. However, when the noblewoman's staff proved unable to take care of the fish, and when it became ill, she decided to pay full freight to send it back. The Legacy Run then returned the saberfish to Tibrin three days later. Casset later thought about the ordeal in 232 BBY, commending the countess for saving the creature when many other nobles would have let it die.

name: Saberjowl
summary: Saberjowls were large aquatic creatures that lived in the oceans of Kamino. They were one of several species of eel in the galaxy.

name: Sabetue
summary: The Sabetue were a species, genderless members of which were distinguished by a white skin. One Sabetue was a member of a gang of criminals in Coronet City of the planet Corellia in 13 BBY. That year, the Sabetue and their fellow gang members unsuccessfully attempted to purchase several vials of the coaxium hyperfuel from the human thief Han before attacking and then pursuing him through the city.

name: Sabi Sabo Acidy's species
summary: A species of sentient bipedal species existed in the galaxy. One member of the species was the crime lord Sabi Sabo Acidy.

name: Sacorrian grain fly
summary: The Sacorrian grain fly was an insect that fed on the grain of Sacorrian farms. Its bite injected a mild venom, painful enough to make farmers reluctant to fight the pest closely.

name: Sacorrian grey bear
summary: Sacorrian grey bears were a mammalian species of bear native to the planet Sacorria. They had grey fur and stood from 2.5 to 3 meters tall with especially long arms. The bears' appetites were huge and being omnivores they ate anything they could get their hands on, using their teeth and talons to attack prey, which could include sentients. The safest way to deal with a Sacorrian grey bear was to use heavy weaponry or avoid it all together.
distinctions: Sharp claws, long arms, voracious appetite

name: Saddlebull
summary: Saddlebulls were a non-sentient species domesticated by the Chiss. They were featured in the expression "When you see the saddlebull is about to throw you, jump off." In 18 BBY, Senior Captain Xodlak'in'daro, core name "Lakinda," had been censured by the Xodlak family for her role in the Hoxim incident, where the senior captain had led the Xodlak to take claim the planet Hoxim. The Chiss believed the planet to be rich with nyix metal, which was false. Lakinda was soon offered to join the ruling Irizi family, which reminded her of the expression—the "saddlebull" in her instance being the Xodlak family, who were already furious with her and contemplating removing her position in the family.

name: Saffa
summary: The Saffa were a sentient species that were responsible for the development of an important form of art, the Saffa paintings, after making contact with the Thennqora. The Saffa painting reached its height approximately 2219-1569 BBY.

name: Safrifan
summary: Safrifans were a sentient species native to the swamp planet Safrifa. They had skin the color of stagnant water, large oval eyes, and hair like pondweed. Despite their perceived scrawny nature, the Safrifans were industrious, able to raise crops in Safrifa's marsh terrain.

name: Saheelindeeli
summary: The Saheelindeeli were sapient primates indigenous to Saheelindeel. The ape-like aliens were green-furred humanoids. They had limited technology, and were just starting to move ahead toward automation by 0 ABY. They had a matriarchal society.

name: Sail-bird
summary: A sail-bird was a type of bird considered to be characteristically savvy. In 4 ABY, the New Republic pilot Norra Wexley and her sister-in-law, Shirene, discussed the challenges of raising Wexley's son, Temmin Wexley, while on the planet Akiva. During the conversation, Shirene compared Temmin's savviness to that of a sail-bird and his intelligence to that of a whip-snake.

name: Sakavian
summary: Sakavians were a sentient species from Sakavi Tar. One Sakavian, Skoova Stev, was a master fisherman on the planet Koboh in 9 BBY.

name: Sakiyan
summary: The Sakiyans were a humanoid sentient species with bulbous, hairless heads and sharply tapered ears. Sakiyans hailed from the Hutt Space planet Saki, and as such were often enslaved by the Hutts. Thanks to their keen senses and quick reflexes, Sakiyans were skilled hunters. Sakiyan skin tones ranged from gleaming black to jade and plum. One notable Sakiyan was Sixtat, a notorious bounty hunter known as the "Outlands Butcher."
distinctions: Enlarged hairless craniums, keen senses and quick reflexes, tapered ears

name: Sakuubian
summary: Sakuubians were the native species of Sakuub. They were humanoids with blue skin, yellow cat-like eyes, distinctive facial ridges, three-fingered hands, and four horns on their forehead. Dular and Pharika were Sakuubians. Nevertheless, it was unsure whether Pharika was a true Sakuubian or was simply wearing a disguise.

name: Salamander
summary: Salamanders were a type of amphibian that could be found in the galaxy. The frilled newt was a type of salamander that could be found in the planet Koboh. They frequented the planet rock pools and waters of the Dredger Gorge region to cool down, and were too evasive to pin down in the water. The mucous salamander was a type of salamander native to the moon Yavin 4. Salamanders could also be found on the planet Thule. The mouths of the Whippomorn species were as wide as that of a salamander.

name: Salenga
summary: The Salenga were a sentient species which existed in the galaxy. They had pink skin, yellow eyes with vertical eyelids and triangular pupils, and hands with one thumb, one finger and a single wide appendage where humans and species with similar hand shapes had more fingers. Salenga also had a flap of skin hanging below the back of their head which resembled long hair. Ione Marcy, a female Salenga, was a thief on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
distinctions: Three fingers with a wide hand appendage

name: Salini serpent
summary: Salini serpents were large aquatic reptilian creatures native to the planet Palagosal. They possessed a beaked mouth, long dorsal fins, and short vestigial hind legs, and could grow up to the length of a Galactic Republic Longbeam cruiser. The creatures would leap out of the ocean to swallow birds that roosted atop rocky spires. During the High Republic Era, Zenny Greylark piloted the yacht Redemption near a leaping salini serpent while being pursued by strikeships of the Nihil marauders, with one of the Nihil starships being caught in the creature's jaws.

name: Salky hound
summary: Salky hounds were genetically-modified kath hounds bred by the Galactic Republic biological engineers for use as a trained security beast. They were bred from numerous different galactic specimens, resulting in sharp claws, keen senses, impressive jaw strength, and an aggressive demeanor. While effective, the Salky hounds were brutal and difficult to control. They would break handler control and attack targets with lethal force, resulting in several dozen deaths before the military recalled the hounds. The creatures were then sold on the black market by their creators. Though they were banned on the Core Worlds, rumors persisted that they have been purchased on Coruscant.

name: Sallichen
summary: The Sallichen were a sentient species from the Core Worlds planet Salliche. The Sallichen senator Bulgeski represented Salliche in the Galactic Senate.

name: Salmaca
summary: A salmaca was a type of large lizard-like creature that lived in caves on the world Batuu. They raided homes for valuables to line their nests, and some believed that they only existed in legends. Around 379 BBY, a salmaca began raiding homes in Peka, a village on Batuu. During her Jedi Trials, Padawan Rooper Nitani assisted the people of Peka and was able to protect both the villagers and the salmaca.

name: Salt hawk
summary: A salt hawk was a type of bird that occurred around the home of Ciena Ree in the valleys of Jelucan, and whose cries were familiar to her. They could be heard from indoors before dark.

name: Salt mynock
summary: Salt mynocks were a subspecies of the parasitic Mynock that lived on the barren Mid Rim planet Lok. A variant of the salt mynock was the Lowland salt mynock.

name: Salt worm
summary: A salt worm was a type of worm that shared its name with salt, a cooking spice. When combined with kelp, the worms could be used to make protein squares. During the Eiram and E'ronoh War in 382 BBY, protein squares produced using the worms were distributed to Eirami citizens of the Outer Rim planet Eiram as part of ration packages. The Eirami Prince Phan-tu Zenn told Xiri A'lbaran, the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh's princess, about the contents of the bundles. As she watched the distribution continue from the royal palace's balcony, she reflected that she felt the squares would taste revolting.

name: Saltwater bird
summary: Saltwater birds were a type of bird that lived on the planet Eiram.

name: Samarian
summary: Samarians were a sentient species native to the desert world of Samaria. The Samarians were engaged in the process of setting up a trade agreement between their neighbors the Roshans, however the Galactic Empire intervened.

name: Samhari
summary: The Samhari were a sentient species of Near-Humans who inhabited Samhar, a planet in the Grumani sector. Their homeworld, covered in vast, green forests, was near the hyperlane known as the Duros Space Run; however, the Samhari held themselves aloof from the surrounding territories. Their insularity saw them focus more on their own internal intrigues than those of the wider galaxy. During the period of the Republic Dark Age, the Samhari were considered by the Jedi Order to have few friends in the sector. A brief note on their homeworld was included by the Human Jedi Master Vannar Treece in his briefing to Supreme Chancellor Genarra shortly before Treece embarked on a mission into the Grumani sector. In the missive, Treece expressed ignorance of what had become of the Samhari while the sector was being contested by the Sith Lords Daiman and Odion.

name: Sammakho beast
summary: Sammakho beasts were a type of amphibian found on the jungle planet Akiva. In 3 ABY, Kay Vess was attacked by a group of Sammakho beasts while in catacombs of Akiva.

name: Samuac
summary: The Samuac were a near-Human species from the Outer Rim Territories moon New Kisge. Around 12 BBY, the male Samuac Sisquoc graduated from the Galactic Outdoor Survival School, where he was a record-setting student. During the Galactic Civil War, the Samuac allied themselves with the Rebel Alliance, with the Alliance establishing its Delta Base on New Kisge.

name: Sand bat
summary: The sand bat was an animal native to the desert planet of Tatooine. The Tusken Raiders used its venom as a weapon to kill Krayt dragons during rites of passage. The bent end of a gaderffii, called the traang in Tusken, could be doused with sand bat venom, which had paralyzing properties.

name: Sand bear
summary: Sand bears were a species of bear that were native to the world of Kallistas. They typically attacked settlers, though this would never occur near the planet's cities. The pirate Jondrell Inx stained some of his clothes with sand bear blood, pretending it was that of his hostage, Cressis Linrec as a threat while demanding a ransom.

name: Sand beast
summary: The sand beast, also known as a sand ape, was a species of large, predatory, reptilian creature with six limbs that lived on the planet of Tatooine.

name: Sand beetle
summary: Sand beetles were a type of beetle from Tatooine. Giant sand beetles were rumored to attack and eat imprudent travelers in the Krayt Graveyard.

name: Sand burrower
summary: Sand burrowers were carnivorous worms native to the planet Blenjeel.

name: Sand cat
summary: Sand cats were a type of cat. In 9 ABY, a menu sign written in Aurebesh at the fake dining establishment The Restraining Bolt within Mos Espa Waystation, a battlefield inspired by the planet Tatooine that was located in the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara, stated that the building allowed both banthas and sand cats.

name: Sand demon
summary: The sand demon was a species of semi-sentient, six-legged insectoid that was native to the planet Tatooine. Feared by all other life on the desert world, sand demons preyed on a wide variety of creatures, including the legendary krayt dragon.
