Sand demons often lived for centuries, gliding beneath the surface of the desert as though the sand was an ocean and boring through rock with its razor-sharp legs. Tatooine's native Tusken Raiders believed that sand demons devoured their victims' life essences to grow stronger with each kill. Physically similar to the tentacled lyleks native to the planet Ryloth, sand demons were often tracked by members of the Jedi Order as part of the Tusken Raiders' Demon's Blood ritual, and while brave hunters occasionally sought to bring down one of the beasts, the creatures' ferocity and rarity left them shrouded in legends and myths.
distinctions: Hibernation periods preceded by shedding of skin and profuse bleeding

name: Sand dragon
summary: Sand dragons were a type of desert-dwelling reptilian creature which Malakili prepared for Hutt circuses.

name: Sand leech
summary: Sand leeches were a species of leech found in the deserts of Dreighton.

name: Sand monkey
summary: Sand monkeys were a species of animal which were good at climbing. When the Twi'lek pilot Hera Syndulla scrambled up a set of scaffolding on the planet Gorse, it was in a fashion similar to a sand monkey.

name: Sand rat
summary: Sand rats were a type of rat, known for living in hiding. The Mandalorian Paz Vizsla compared his tribe residing in a hidden covert after the Great Purge of Mandalore to sand rats.

name: Sand shark
summary: Sand sharks were sharks that lived in the planet Naboo's southern seas. The eyes of the sharks could be used to make chandeliers when dried out, as the membranes within could show their natural iridescence once the creature was dead. At some point during the High Republic Era, San Tekka family patriarchs Marlowe and Vellis San Tekka decorated the former's private dining room in their compound on the planet Naboo with three of the chandeliers. In 228 BBY, the Nihil General Abediah Viess took over the residence following Marlow and Vellis fleeing Naboo to escape the marauders. Viess shared in Marlowe's dining room with her captive, Cair San Tekka—a younger member of the family who engaged in anti-Nihil resistance activities—expounding on the latter's uncles' decor selections. Cair, who had been unaware of the gruesome details of his uncles' furnishings, felt ill as she calmly continued feeding herself urchins.

name: Sand skitter
summary: Sand skitters were a type of small, brown-furred creature that could be found on the desert planet Tatooine. In 4 ABY, a worrt captured a sand skitter with its tongue outside the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's palace and devoured it.

name: Sand sloth
summary: Sand sloths were large, fur-covered animals native to Annoo. Demma Moll used them as beasts of burden on her farm complex. When Artoo and Threepio tried to help with chores, a sand sloth hit Threepio with its tail.

name: Sand snake
summary: Sand snakes were a type of furry snake found on the arid planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. Their eyes and mouths were situated at the center of their body, which could grow up to three meters, or ten feet, in length. Larger and deadlier than the parasitic phidna, sand snakes were wily enough to keep their natural predator, the dog-like massiff, at bay. Around 9 BBY, the Galactic Empire sterilized Geonosis.
distinctions: Eyes and mouth located at the center of its body

name: Sand tick
summary: Found on most planets with hot and dry conditions, sand ticks were creatures that fed on larger animals' fluids. As big as a Human's fist, the pests were usually found on banthas, but were repelled by reptilian creatures like the dewback.

name: Sand worm
summary: Sand worms were gigantic worms that inhabited the Sea of Sand, a region of the desert planet Ponemah Terminal's southern hemisphere.
distinctions: Gigantic, powerful jaws, said to spit acid

name: Sandbug
summary: The sandbug was a type of creature. In the cuisine of the Swokes Swokes of the planet Makem Te, sandbugs were eaten live in a dish that also included spiced, boiled meat and schinga scales.

name: Sandfly
summary: The sandfly (also spelled as sand fly or sand-fly) was a species of insect found on the planet Tatooine. Sand flies could be found sitting on moisture vaporators, buzzing in the cracked eaves of pourstone buildings in the town of Anchorhead, and inhabiting desert caves. The insects buzzed around and disturbed banthas.

name: Sandhawk
summary: The Sandhawk was an avian creature native to Tatooine. It was often hunted for its savory meat.

name: Sandjigger
summary: The sandjigger was a small arthropod native to Tatooine. Its diet consisted mainly of razor moss that could be found in the desert.

name: Sandmaggot
summary: The sandmaggot was an insect native to Tatooine. Its kidneys could be prepared as a dish, as Porcellus was fond of doing for Jabba the Hutt, and its eggs fermented into a silvery-green delicacy.

name: Sando aqua monster
summary: Sando aqua monsters were enormous, muscular predators that could be found in the oceans and lakes of Naboo. They could grow up to 200 meters, but because there were few of them left on Naboo by 32 BBY, they obtained an almost legendary status. Thanks to their sharp teeth, they were capable of biting through the strong armor of the opee sea killers.

name: Sandstone scorpion
summary: Sandstone scorpions were a species native to the desert planet Pasher. The scorpions possessed poison glands and had armor which was highly effective at deflecting heat. Fayet Kelen chose to set up his business, Kelen Biolabs, locally on Pasher where he made large amounts of money from the medical applications of sandstone scorpion poison glands, as well as the glands of spine spiders. Kelen's daughter Nakari hunted the scorpions with a slugthrower as the creatures' armor could reflect blaster bolts.

name: Sandswimmer
summary: Sandswimmers were spider-like creatures that dwelled on Tatooine. They were among the planet's most deadly predators, as they would "swim" underneath the arid sands of the desert before moving up to the surface to drain all fluids from their prey. The Sandswimmer exoskeleton provided a natural resistance to Tatooine's harsh conditions.

name: Sandtusker
summary: Sandtuskers were reptilian scavengers native to the planet Tatooine that were known for their large tusks, the ridges of bone that protected them, and their toothy maw. The sandtusker's armored form inspired the members of a platoon in the Republic Army's 38th Infantry to name their armored walker the Sandtusker.

name: Sandviper
summary: Sandvipers were serpentine species found in the galaxy. The Hunters of the Outer Rim participant and former bounty hunter Imara Vex named one of her weapon wraps after this creature.

name: Sandworm
summary: Sand Worms or sandworms were rare creatures that lived deep in their burrowed holes in the desert sands of Tatooine. They traveled very fast underground and were hard to catch in a fight, and were a favorite food of the Krayt dragon. Kaleesh beast master Jai Quallo of the Tatooine Dust Vipers gang had a sand worm among his pet beasts, who were trained to assist him in a fight.

name: Sanl'jek
summary: Sanl'jek were a species of small quadrupeds that were native to the world of Dancreti. The species was named after zoologist who discovered them.

name: Sanval
summary: Sanvals were a species of reptilian dragons, and apex predators of their home environment.

name: Sanyassan
summary: Sanyassans were a humanoid species in the the galaxy; among its members was a pirate named Gruk who led other individuals of the species in criminal escapades during the New Republic Era. These pirates came into conflict with the crew of Sidon Ithano in a section of the galaxy known as the Lost Clusters, where Ithano's group managed to subdue Gruk's forces and commandeer his Munificent-class star frigate.

name: Sap drinker
summary: Sap drinkers were non-sentient insects that could be found on the planet of Devaron. They had a teardrop-shaped, iridescent blue body that featured two pairs of crystal-like wings and a barbed stinger, which they used as a defense against creatures that might attack their nests. They fed off plant sap trough a coiled proboscis.

name: Sapphire ice worm
summary: Sapphire ice worms were a species of worm native to the ice planet Hoth. They dug winding burrows, which the wind whistled through at night to create haunting melodies.

name: Sareeta
summary: The Sareeta were a humanoid, sentient species. They had dark, lidless eyes and pink skin. The species, native to the Outer Rim planet Sareet, reached atomic-age technology before encountering the galactic community. The Sareeta leadership then encouraged their people to explore the galaxy with the hope they would later return to raise the development level of Sareet. One individual, Sassan Sareeta, however, chose instead to pursue a career in smuggling. After aggressively running a blockade in the Lazerian system, Sassan was recruited into the criminal corporation Syndicate One.

name: Sargassum anemone
summary: A Sargassum anemone was a species Plana Van was reminded of when she saw Otto's eyes wide open.

name: Sarkan
summary: The Sarkans were a species of sentient, egg-laying reptiles that hailed from the planet Sarka.

name: Sarkhai
summary: The Sarkhai were a people native to the Mid Rim planet Sarkhai. Force-sensitives were uncommon among the Sarkhai, so much so that Nadia Grell was the only one known to have the abilities on her entire planet, though word of a child with similar traits reached her ears after she became a Padawan to the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order. The Sarkhai tradition of face-painting developed as a way to frighten the predators of their homeworld. In order to protect themselves against the great dangers on their planet, the Sarkhai developed highly sophisticated defensive technology that made them sought after for alliance. Upon joining the Galactic Republic, the Rift Alliance recruited the Sarkhai into their fold and the Children of the Emperor wanted them to join the Sith Empire, in order to get their technology.
distinctions: White painted face with blue painted patterns

name: Sarkin Enneb's species
summary: This species was a sentient species found within the galaxy. These bipedal humanoid sentients were distinguished by their pointed, high-set ears, wrinkled faces, split upper lips, and green eyes with vertical black pupils. They also possessed brown hair and sharp brown fingernails. Sometime during or before around 13 BBY, a member of this species, Sarkin Enneb, lead a criminal group on the planet Corellia. Enneb had dealings with the Grindalid Lady Proxima, purchasing slaves from the White Worms' crime lord, including the human scrumrat Qi'ra, who, after being purchased by Crimson Dawn, would eventually return to kill the slaver by 10 BBY.

name: Sarl
summary: Sarls were a species of amored bugs that lived on the moon of Draay 2 in the Outer Rim Territories. A swarm of those creatures dwelled in the secret temple built by the Jedi Master Lucien Draay to hide a Sith artifact known as the "Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger." They had formed a column around the Gauntlet and had become overwhelmed by the power of the dark side of the Force. After centuries of prolonged exposure to the artifact's energy, the sarls had become nearly invulnerable: their armored body could sustain both blaster bolts and lightsaber strikes. Additionally, their twin mandibles were strong enough to pierce through plastoid armor. At the time of the Clone Wars, the Jedi Master B'ink Utrila confronted the sarls in the temple with her Padawan Rennax Omani and a few clone troopers, but they were forced to pull back when confronted with the bugs' near-invulnerability.
distinctions: Segmented body with glowing bumps, two thick mandibles

name: Sarlacc
summary: Sarlaccs were dangerous, carnivorous creatures located on Tatooine and several other planets throughout the galaxy. It shared common ancestry with other species, including the rathtar, blixus, and vixus. One sarlacc identified as the "almighty Sarlacc" lived in the Great Pit of Carkoon, a depression of sand within Tatooine's Dune Sea, and served as one of Jabba the Hutt's favorite pets and a means of execution.

name: Sarravi
summary: The Sarravi were a sentient species in the galaxy. In 382 BBY, the Sarravi V'Kara worked in the Shrine of Sarrav on Jedha, before she was killed.

name: Sathari
summary: The Sathari were a reclusive sentient avian species native to the planet Arbooine. The species possessed hand-tipped wings capable of manipulating tools. The avians lived mostly in small settlements in the forest canopy of their homeworld.

name: Sathog
summary: Sathogs were creatures native to the planet Kashyyyk.

name: Saurin
summary: The Saurin were a species of sentient reptiles from the planet of Durkteel, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. They had imposing, jagged teeth, knobby skin, and ridges along the length of their heads. On the day Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker met Han Solo and Chewbacca in the cantina of Mos Eisley, two Saurin patrons were in the bar. A Saurin named Gauron Nas Tal was a resident of Jabba the Hutt's palace. He worked as a combat trainer for Jabba. Even though Gauron worked for Jabba, he planned to kill him.

name: Saurton
summary: The Saurtons were a sentient species of reptiles indigenous to the planet Essowyn. Often gold-skinned, these bipedal reptiles usually stood nearly two meters tall. Saurtons were quick, and had terrible tempers, often coaxing others into fights. Although resistant to disease, these creatures could be carriers of many dangerous bacteria. As such, visitors to the planet Essowyn had to take extra precautions to stay healthy, as Saurton cities had a high level of filth. [[File:Saurton6.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Miktiss, a Saurton.]] Because Essowyn had such an abundance of metal, Saurton were able to create advanced technology, including radio-wave transmission devices, projectile weapons, and advanced manufacturing machinery. After a Galactic Republic expedition discovered the planet, the Saurtons adapted to more advanced technologies, becoming on par with most galactic civilizations.

name: Sauvax
summary: The Sauvax were a sentient species native to the planet Leritor. They were amphibious crustaceans with great physical strength, distinguished by big pincers on their arms and six crab-like legs. While fearsome looking to Humans, the Sauvax were actually peaceful beings who preferred negotiation over war to settle disputes. They had a rich, complex culture that was not completely understood by outsiders. The planet Leritor held little attraction for most alien entrepreneurs and settlers, making the Sauvax species little known and affording them few chances to leave their planet. They had little contact with aliens and no tradition of Force users. At some point in Leritor's history, the Sith tried to take over the Sauvax, but the offworlders eventually disappeared, leaving a hidden Sith artifact. Later, the planet was sparsely settled by Human farmers from the Core Worlds who agreed to share the planet with the Sauvax, although they reduced the specific contact to a minimum. Centuries later, a Sith adept looking for Sith relics tried to unleash a war among the Sauvax and the Humans to distract the locals while she performed archaeological activities, exploiting Sauvax prisoners as underwater miners. However, some offworlders discovered the situation, and the Sith and her minions were defeated and peace was restored to Leritor.
skinColor: Red, with pincers and lower part grey or blue with pink shades
diet: Crops of algae and slime, game and fish, such as sea brackens, sea urchins, anemonae, and crustaceans

name: Saw-toothed grank
summary: The saw-toothed grank was a carnivore native to the Gungan Swamps of Naboo.

name: Sawal
summary: The Sawal were a humanoid sentient species originating from the planet Tastini.

name: Sayormi
summary: The Sayormi were a mysterious species that lived in the Dead Forest, a dark, rotten part of the Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk. They were led by the Sayormi Queen, who commanded her people with a fierce fist. Their most feared warrior was Cyrans the Unfeeling.

name: Scaled boar
summary: A scaled boar was a type of large boar with scales. One scaled boar was used to pull a woman's wagon as they traveled as part of a group of individuals on the road to Osou spaceport on the Outer Rim planet Genbara. The former Sith known as the Ronin observed the storyteller known as the Traveler tell fairy tales to the woman's children, who were sitting in the wagon pulled by the scaled boar.

name: Scalemonk
summary: Scalemonks were tree-dwelling creatures that could be found on the planet Batuu. While on Batuu in 382 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani noticed some shrieking scalemonks swinging in some nearby trees as she made her way toward the world's Black Spire Outpost settlement.

name: Scallop
summary: Scallops were a species of aquatic, mollusk-like invertebrates. Their shells could often be found scattered along the beaches of Talus.

name: Scalt
summary: Scalts were creatures apparently hailing from Tatooine. They evolved into scavengers, and could be found across the galaxy on starships. They featured large air sacks, clubbed tails, and emitted a high-pitched noise for which they were named.

name: Scalvi
summary: The Scalvi were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim planet Turrak. During the High Republic Era, the Scalvi of their homeworld were assisted by the Jedi Grand Master Yoda for a crisis with the Crulkons they were faring.

name: Scampweasel
summary: A scampweasel was a type of weasel. In 228 BBY, after members of the Jedi Order and Republic Defense Coalition failed to capture the Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk on the planet Mynos III, Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram commented on Apruk's escape to Jedi archivist Lyssa Votz, comparing him to a slippery scampweasel.

name: Scaraphyte
summary: Scaraphytes were acidic space-borne creatures. A swarm of them surrounded the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative base Hivebase-1, and a specific flight vector was required to evade the creatures when approaching the base. Around 1 ABY, the mobile rebel flight school Lucrehulk Prime was lured to Hivebase-1 by the rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra as a distraction to infiltrate the complex. The scaraphytes swarmed and damaged the flight school but eventually went erratic when they were fired upon by Aphra's droid Dek-Nil.

name: Scatalpen
summary: The scatalpen was a deadly predator from the planet Aleen. The Aleena podracer Ratts Tyerell named the vehicle he used in the 32 BBY Boonta Eve Classic race after the creature.

name: Scavenger hawk
summary: Scavenger hawks were winged creatures native to the planet Corellia. These avians had a strong, natural instinct to swoop down from the sky and snatch any object they could carry, be it prey, a loose branch, a fallen comlink, or whatever out-of-place object might catch their attention. Chaotic scenes attracted dozens of them, and they, as Corellians noted, "grabbed everything that wasn't nailed down."

name: Scazz
summary: Scazz were subterranean, verminous creatures that lived on the planet Zeffo. They could communicate hostile intent from the top of their heads to the end of their tails and had oversized mouths used for surprise attacks. They were vulnerable in bright light due to their poor vision, often residing in shady or dark areas however would be a serious threat in large numbers. While visiting Zeffo during the Imperial Era, the former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis was attacked by several scazz. Their meat was considered to be edible.

name: Schenor
summary: The Schenor were a species of tall felines native to the planet Rhamsis Callo. They upheld a code of honor and a respect for the martial arts, and lived in a stratified society with noble, middle, and peasant classes. All Schenor were Force-sensitive.

name: Scherkil Hla
summary: Scherkil Hlas were squat birds used by the Yuuzhan Vong. Flightless, they were a source of protein.

name: Schiav
summary: The Schiav were a sentient species. Standing at over two meters tall, they were distinguished by their tan-colored skin, long brown hair and two fangs projecting upward from their bottom jaws. The space pirate Jyn Obah was a Schiav.
distinctions: Two fangs projecting upward from their bottom jaws

name: Schinga shikou
summary: Schinga shikou were large, predatory, serpents native to Makem Te, and the most prized of the schinga species. A pureblood schinga shikou was roughly eight meters long, with smooth scales along the length of its body and dozens of large white fangs. It held its head upright as it slithered. Some were domesticated by the native Swokes Swokes, for whom schinga shikou breeding was a profitable business. Due to careful breeding, there were dozens of varieties of schinga. Red, gold, and white specimens were especially prized. The Schinga shikou had several relatives, such as the venomous Schinga ikkow, the subterranean-dwelling Schinga klaug, the small Schinga picai, and the strong Schinga equa.

name: Schizode
summary: Schizodes were an insectoid sentient species. Though they were considered to be good combatants and crafters, they were not very individualized.

name: Sclarin
summary: The sclarin were a reptilian species of creature that could be found on the planet of Cularin. They were a dangerous, raptor-like species of kilassin.

name: Scofti
summary: The Scofti were a sentient species from the Unknown Regions planet Bardram Scoft. The species underwent frequent changes in its leading Prefects and governmental regimes; transitions were often violent or motivated by the threat of violence. As a result, Scofti items made for the prefecture were not designed to last longer than a year. At one point, when the standing Prefect was assassinated, other parties from the Unknown Regions, including the Chiss Ascendancy, sent emissaries to Bardram Scoft to meet with the new leader.

name: Scorpion slug
summary: Scorpion slugs were a non-sentient species native to Despayre, an Outer Rim Territories planet. They were named for the stinger on the end of their tail, which could cause weeks of agony for many humanoid species until the victim either recovered or perished due to the potent venom. Meanwhile, a scorpion slug's sting was usually lethal to smaller creatures. The slugs liked to live among dried evergreen branches. By some point between 3 BBY and 0 BBY, prisoners such as Celot Ratua Dil often used the branches for sleeping mats, though they frequently changed branches to avoid the creatures. All the scorpion slugs on Despayre perished with the destruction of the planet by the Galactic Empire's Death Star battle station in 0 BBY.

name: Scrabbler
summary: Scrabblers were rat- or lizard-like reptiles that lived on planet Gloam in colonies. In 382 BBY, Dass Leffbruk hunted the small reptiles for food using a sharp stick, which he poked into the rocky nooks the scrabbler colonies lived in.

name: Scrange
summary: The scrange was a species found in the swamps of the planet Dagobah. A quick-striking creature, it used its spiked tail to attack and hid amongst the roots of gnarltrees.

name: Scrap crab
summary: Scrap crabs were a non-sentient species of crustacean that lived on the junk-planet Trionak. The crabs had massive claws and magnetic shells capable of collecting scrap metal for protection. The local rulers, the Tech Masters, implanted some scrap crabs with cybernetics in order to domesticate them. In being a crustaceous species that donned scrap metal as protection, they were similar to the trash crabs of the planet Lanupa. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa encountered scrap crabs while on an unsanctioned mission to Trionak.

name: Scrap rat
summary: Scrap rats were a species of scavenger creatures, which lived on the planet of Vorrnti. They were half a meter long and had knife-like teeth. Like garrals from Wayland, they were attracted by repulsorlift engines, that is why repulsorlift vehicles were banned everywhere around Vorrnti City, and facilities such as spaceports or junkyards were surrounded with high solid walls or thorn hedges, as scrap rats could gnaw landing gear or other equipment.

name: Scratch-hen
summary: Scratch-hens were a type of hen. In 382 BBY, the leader of the Path of the Open Hand cult, Elecia Zeveron, suffered a seizure while in the Path compound on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. As Elders of the group tended to her convulsing body, the Evereni Path Guide Marda Ro mentally noted that the Elders were fussing around Zeveron like a brood of scratch-hens.

name: Screech lizard
summary: Screech lizards were a species which inhabited one of the three moons of Obri in the Tython system. Their skin was of a bright green color. Lanoree Brock's sword had a leather sheath fashioned from the skin of one of these creatures.

name: Screecher
summary: A screecher was an animal native to the rain forest on Kirtania.

name: Screw maggot
summary: Screw maggots were a species of scavengers who lived in the jungles on the planet of Haruun Kal. In 22 BBY, the Jedi Master Mace Windu came to the planet to investigate a hologram depicting a slaughtered group of jungle prospectors and a recording that connected his former Padawan, a Chalactan woman named Depa Billaba, to their deaths. Windu later learned that Billaba had worked with Korun leader Kar Vastor to stage the scene so that Windu would come to the planet looking for her. The Jedi wrote in his journal wondering what kind of man could convince his followers to leave the bodies of civilians, especially the women and children, to be consumed by the likes of screw maggots and other scavengers such as jacunas and carrion flies. He found the idea revolting and quickly moved on in his thoughts.

name: Scrimp
summary: The scrimp was a creature that was used as a dejarik holomonster. Almost nothing was known about the creature as most of its origins were lost in time.

name: Scum-squid
summary: Scum-squids were a type of carnivorous squid that could eat humans and were found on the Hutt Space and Outer Rim moon Nar Shaddaa. In 0 ABY, after the Jedi-in-training Luke Skywalker entered a bar on Nar Shaddaa and told its patrons that he wanted a ride to the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, the bar's Zabrak bartender told the patrons to kill Skywalker, rob him and then feed him to the scum-squids. After fighting several of the patrons, Skywalker revealed he had a lightsaber, leading the Zabrak to attempt to strike a deal of getting the Jedi to Coruscant in exchange for his lightsaber, which Skywalker did not agree to. In response, the bartender told the patrons to follow the original plan of killing the Jedi and feeding him to the scum-squids, though Skywalker was able to escape and chased after a thief who had stolen his lightsaber.

name: Scurrier
summary: Scurriers were a species of small rodents that hailed from the desert planet of Tatooine. They were characterized by their long ears, distinctive snout, and skittish temperament. They normally roamed the desert, but were commonly found loitering outside inhabited settlements.

name: Scyk
summary: The scyk was a species of swift, vicious lizard native to the desert planet Tatooine. The M3-A Scyk interceptor manufactured by MandalMotors was named for the reptile.

name: Scyre-fish
summary: Scyre-fish was a type of fish that existed in the galaxy. While dreaming on the space station Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era, the Mon Calamari Chief of Security Ghal Tarpfen imagined being fitted with scyre-fish skinned trousers and tunics.

name: Sea-dragon
summary: The sea-dragons or waterworms of Drexel were gigantic sentient reptiles who dwelt in the never-ending ocean of their world. They communicated with each other using ultrasonic signals. When Governor Quarg's scavengers arrived on Drexel, they set up a scheme where they used a sonic jammer to cause any passing spacecraft to malfunction and crash to the planet. But the jamming signal proved damaging to the Sea-dragons and prompted them to attack the scavengers. The scavengers' technicians realized the damage their signals were causing and objected to their use, but their efforts were thwarted and they were exiled to the sea. But the technicians survived, and eventually developed a relationship with the Sea-dragons, and became to be known as the Dragon Lords, even though the relationship was between equals rather than one of servitude. As infants they resembled small lizards, and would spy on Quarg's city-ship to report the scavengers' intentions back to the Dragon Lords. [[File:Sea-dragon_baby.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Infant Sea-dragon]] When Crimson Jack and his battlecruiser entered the system at the direction of Han Solo and Princess Leia Organa, the scavengers tried to bring the huge craft down, but were unable to do anything but hold it in orbit. The Dragon Lords and the Sea-dragons feared the power that Quarg would attain if he were to acquire the huge craft, launched all out attack on the city-ship. With the help of Solo, Leia, and Luke Skywalker, the Dragon Lords and the Sea-dragons were able to defeat the scavengers and permanently disable their jamming equipment. [[File:9seadragon.jpg|thumb|a sea-dragon swims to an air-pocket cavern]]

name: Sea eel
summary: Sea eels were long, slimy, fish-like creatures that were native to Kamino. They had narrow eyes and huge mouths. Household sea eels were often fed sea-mice. They were one of several species of eel in the galaxy.

name: Sea Leviathan
summary: The Sea Leviathan was a semi-sentient form of Sithspawn, alchemically engineered by the Givin Vul Isen, a scientist in Darth Krayt's One Sith Order. Inspired by the original creation of the exiled Dark Jedi who became the first Sith Lords of millennia past, the Sea Leviathan was born in the depths of the aquatic Outer Rim planet of Dac solely to kill the native Mon Calamari species in accordance with Emperor Krayt's ordered extermination of the entire race. With assistance from the Quarren Sith Lord Darth Azard, Isen summoned the Sea Leviathan from the depths of Dac's Soheras Trench and unleashed it upon the seemingly helpless Mon Calamari, who had been detained in the Imperial Extermination Camp 28. In 137 ABY, the same year of its creation, the Sea Leviathan met its demise when it was attacked by the Mon Calamari Rangers, led by Imperial Master Treis Sinde. Despite the Leviathan's successful massacre of many Mon Calamari, Sinde was able to coax a school of devilsquid with the Force into an attack on the Leviathan. Unable to defend itself against the assault, the monstrosity was subdued and dragged into the abyss of Devil's Crevasse to be ravaged by the devilsquid.
distinctions: Blister pods on back capable of absorbing life-energy of sentient beings

name: Sea monster
summary: Sea monsters were a type of aquatic creatures that lived in the oceans of the planet Selonia. There were no sea monsters on the neighboring world of Corellia because its oceans were much smaller than Selonia's. In 18 ABY, Han Solo told his children that they could swim at the Gold Beaches of Corellia during a family trip to his homeworld. His youngest son, Anakin Solo, was dubious of swimming due to a concern that there would be sea monsters at the beaches, but Han assured him that all the sea monsters were on Selonia.

name: Sea otter
summary: The sea otter was a type of otter. The Tynnans, a species of aquatic mammals native to the Expansion Region planet Tynna, bore resemblance to the sea otter, to the point that the species could be regarded as an intelligent subset thereof.

name: Sea shrike
summary: Sea shrikes were birds introduced to the artificial seas of Coruscant.

name: Sea slug
summary: Sea slugs or sea-slugs were creatures that lived in seas. Decades after 382 BBY, the Scalvi Carli and Tren were playing amongst themselves re-enacting their uncle Bree Menaren's famed encounter with members of the Crulkon species. As Tren—who was playing as Menaren—pretended to stab Carli who was playing as a Crulkon, they told them to "die, Crulkon sea slug!" In 34 ABY, the Ace Squadron pilot Hype Fazon compared his teammates to sea slugs and threatened to leave the squadron if his squadron leader Jarek Yeager continued to make him work with them. The Mon Calamari Rask Odai disliked children, and he compared them to sea slugs.

name: Sea-snake
summary: The sea-snake, or seasnake, was a ribbonlike aquatic snake native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Riome. Sea-snakes were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the Royal Icqui Aquaria on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

name: Sebiri
summary: The Sebiri were a reptilian sentient species native to the planet of Sebiris in the Kathol sector.

name: Sedrian
summary: Sedrians were a people native to the oceans of the planet Sedri.

name: See
summary: See, also known as see fish, were a species of scalefish native to the planets Naboo and Koboh. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by the large sea beasts that dwelt there. It had large blue eyes and a mouth below their head. See fish were known for their agility and ability to outmaneuver most predators.

name: Seevi worm
summary: Seevi worms were a type of large worm that could live in lakes or saltwater. During the raid of the Innovator, the Jedi Initiate Tep Tep summoned a seevi worm to fight her Nihil enemies.

name: Segredo
summary: The Segredo were a sentient species with the ability to manipulate the minds of others in order to appear invisible. During the High Republic Era, there were few Segredo left in the galaxy. By the time of the Clone Wars, Kreeda was the last of the Segredo, using her ability to shelter individuals from the dangers of the war.

name: Seikoshan
summary: The Seikoshans were sapients indigenous to Seikosha. They were very tall humanoids with pale green skin and unblinking red eyes. They were hairless but for a small amount of black hair on the top of their heads as well as shallow crenelations from the bridge of their nose to their cranium. They also had two-toed feet.

name: Sekct
summary: The Sekct were a reptilian sentient species indigenous to Marca.

name: Selkath
summary: The Selkath were a species of aquatic beings native to the planet Manaan. The species was most comfortable underwater and preferred to be immersed in liquid. Because of the Selkath's water-dwelling nature, their chest armors were fitted with misting vents in order to keep their skin moist. Following the Great Hyperspace Disaster in the Hetzal system during the High Republic Era, Senator Izzet Noor guessed that the crisis had been caused by the Selkath, noting how Hetzal's production of bacta could ruin the Selkath's business. Historically, however, the Selkath were devoted to preserving their native oceans and taking care of the ill. For that reason, other species regarded them as a peaceful and helpful people. Indeed, the disaster had been caused by Marchion Ro, who served as the Eye of the Nihil. At the time of the Clone Wars, Selkath such as Chata Hyoki and Mantu brought shame to their people's reputation by working as bounty hunters.

name: Selldu
summary: Selldus were black-plumed reptavians that Dressellian resistance members rode during night raids agains the Galactic Empire.

name: Selligore
summary: Selligore were large creatures native to the planet Corsin. Despite their intimidating size (4 meters tall and 20 meters long), they were quite harmless, feeding on aquatic plankton and small fish.

name: Selonian
summary: Selonians were an otter-like sentient bipedal humanoid species from the world of Selonia. Selonians had a short muzzle tipped with a flat rhinarium nose, and bodies covered in fur that could be a range of colors from chestnut brown, to beige, to white, and was not uncommon to be striped. Following behind their tall and lanky 2 meter high bodies was a thick and sleek tail. They had particularly light–sensitive eyes, which meant that they were especially vulnerable to the weapons known as flashsticks, which emitted a bright flash of light to stun their target when used. Selonians were able to smell strong emotions by picking up on pheromones released by beings around them. Even with lack of vocal or body expressions, they could detect emotions like anger or shame. The type of weapon known as the shard shooter was a unique Selonian slugthrower that used electromagnetic propulsion to fire razor–sharp crystalline ammunition. It was popular with local defense forces on Selonia, but those taking it offworld were often questioned and hassled about the nature of the weapon. Leebon was a Selonian Jedi Master in the High Republic Era.

name: Semblan eel
summary: The Semblan eel was a species of eel native to the planet Sembla, which featured enormous coral reefs in its oceans. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Semblan eel was discovered among the reefs for the first time by explorers.

name: Senali
summary: Senali were the native species of the Rutan moon of Senali. They were an offshoot of Rutanians from Rutan, and the rivalry between the two species was provoked by the Yuuzhan Vong into war, leaving both Rutan and Senali weak and vulnerable to invasion.

name: Sensor star
summary: Sensor stars were an aquatic species native to the planet F'tral. The five-armed mollusks lived in groups of 20-30, and communicated with each other via subsonic tones, relaying warnings and advisories such as "food," "emergency," and "storm" to others in the pack.

name: Sepan
summary: The Sepan were a sentient species of humanoids native to the eponymous Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. The Sepan were divided between the peoples of Dimok and Ripoblus, the two primary worlds of the system. The Dimoks and the Ripoblus were involved in the Sepan Civil War, a conflict which lasted intermittently for centuries.

name: Sephi
summary: Sephi were a humanoid sentient species, found on both Isobe and Thustra in the Thustra system, who boasted long life and an affinity with droids and machinery. They had long tapered ears that could twitch, swivel and flatten in accordance with the emotional state of the subject. Their skin tones included lavender and peach, and their eyes could be green or blue. Sephi were capable of emitting a pheromone that was capable of knocking other beings unconscious with the sensation of being close to death, an ability developed by their ancestors as protection against predators. The Sephi made aerial craft known as flyers.

name: Septoid
summary: Septoids were segmented, venomous, carnivorous creatures native to the Carrion Plateau on Eriadu.

name: Serennian
summary: Serennians were a cultural group of humans native to the planet Serenno. Serennian nobility could be identified by the wearing of a Serennian cloak, such as the ones worn by Count Dooku and Duke Solha and his siblings, a symbol of their status. Serennian custom permitted a condemned prisoner one last request. While Solha was proud of Serenno's membership within the Confederacy of Independent Systems, heralding the world as part of a free star system, Dooku exploited his own people during the Clone Wars, creating internal strife on his homeworld. All the same, Serenno remained a major Separatist planet throughout the Clone Wars, in large part because of its status as Dooku's birthplace and base-of-operations. Some Serennians, such as Romar Adell, fled into Serenno's forests to escape Imperial occupation.

name: Sernpidalian
summary: Sernpidalians were a near-Human species native to the planet Hettitite. They had white hair, pale skin and red eyes, resembling Human albinos. The traditional Sernpidalian dress consisted of red-striped white robes with huge hoods. They were a deeply religious people, with one of their most revered deities being the goddess Tosi-karu. Most Sernpidalians were killed when the Praetorite Vong used the Yo'gand's Core tactic on Sernpidal, employing a large dovin basal to pull one of the planet's moons, Dobido, against the globe.

name: Serp
summary: The Serps were sentient, humanoid reptiles indigenous to the planet Serphidi in the Belial system. They were a sexually dimorphic species, with red-scaled and flat-faced males, and orange-scaled and long-snouted females. The Serps once had superior technology, but they used it for devastatingly destructive acts. Eventually, they chose to sign a pact that banned advanced technology and united the planet under a single King. Their remaining technology was simple, and they sublimated their destructive urges with jousting competitions. Each year, they held a tournament to remember the day of peace. Shortly before the eruption of the Galactic Civil War, King S'Shah came to power. He allied with the Galactic Empire, revived some of the Serps' ancient technology, and turned the previously nonlethal jousts into deadly affairs. Most Serps disliked S'Shah's reforms and showed sympathy to the Rebel Alliance; thus, the Human Rebel agent Luke Skywalker came to Serphidi to work with the Rebel-friendly natives in deposing S'Shah. With the help of an older Serp named Elglih, Skywalker entered the yearly tournament and defeated the King. Elglih became the new monarch, and the Serps officially allied with the Rebel Alliance.
distinctions: Sharp teeth, webbed digits, sexual dimorphism

name: Sessehshellah
summary: The Sessehshellah, or Sesseh', were a fierce aboriginal race of mustalids native to the planet Shaymore. Though skilled at swimming, combat, and stealth, the Sessehshellah had little in the way of advanced technology; resultantly, they were easy prey for the Galactic Empire, which exploited Shaymore's hydrocarbons. The Sessehshellah were subsequently aided by the Rebel Alliance, who supplied them with modern weapons; both parties worked together in a successful bid to derail the hydrocarbon extraction effort and force the Imperials off Shaymore.

name: Setaran
summary: Setarans were a sentient species that had domed, ridged heads, pale skin, and gills running from the bottom of the neck to jutting cheekbones, framing two deep-set eyes. Setarans did not possess a mouth, and instead communicated with other sentients via telepathy. The species was known for their Force-related tracking abilities. Calar was a Setaran associated with the Path of the Open Hand.

name: Sethro Dagri's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Sethro Dagri was a member of this species.

name: Sevorrt
summary: Sevorrts were reptilian creatures with a leathery hide, native to the desert planet Tatooine. They were related to worrts, but far more aggressive.

name: Seylott
summary: The Seylott were a sentient bipedal species of mammalians indigenous to the planet Seylott.

name: Sez
summary: A fish species known as sez was native to the oceans of the Mid Rim planet Bothawui. The species' name was used as a family name by the Bothans, a sentient species native to Bothawui. Mak Sezala, a Bothan senator serving the New Republic during the invasion of the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong, had "sez" as part of his surname, along with the clan suffix "ala."

name: Sgauru
summary: Sgauru was a bio-engineered beast created by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong during their invasion of the galaxy. She was part of a symbiotic pair of bio-engineered beasts known as the Biter and Beater with the other being Tu-Scart.

name: Shaak
summary: Shaaks were a bulbous mammalian species of non-sentient herbivores that grazed on the grasslands of Naboo, and were bred on other planets as well.

name: Shaclaw
summary: The shaclaws were massive, armored insects native to Voss that possessed powerful foreclaws able to tear through the flesh and armor of their foes. Shaclaws also used these foreclaws to burrow into the earth to find roots and subterranean mammals to feed upon. They were considered a delicacy by the Gormak, but would secrete deadly toxins after they died. As a result, they had to be specially cooked while alive. Captive shaclaw were kept on Nar Shaddaa while presumably transplanted wild populations of shaclaws existed on Taris. During the Cold War, the Republic experimented with breeding cybernetically weaponized shaclaws on the moon Nar Shaddaa to use against the Sith Empire.

name: Shadda-Bi-Boran
summary: The Shadda-Bi-Boran were a race of green-skinned humanoids indigenous to the planet Shadda-Bi-Boran. A peaceful sun-worshipping civilization, the Shadda-Bi-Boran faced extinction in 43 BBY when their system's star began to die, depriving them of radiation without which they could not produce vital enzymes. The plight of the Shadda-Bi-Boran became a galactic cause célèbre, but all efforts to relocate them ended in failure, and the last of the species died in 38 BBY.
distinctions: Dependent on particular radiation to produce vital enzymes

name: Shade stalker
summary: Shade stalkers were a predatory species living on the planet Odessen. Bipedal and covered in scales, they were extremely aggressive in nature, often hunting in packs. Bizzarely, when Doctor Juvard Illip Oggurobb studied the species, he was unable to determine their diet, as they did not consume the flesh of their kill or seemingly anything at all. Citing their defensive scales, Oggurobb theorized that the species rapidly evolved through an unknown process, possibly related to the Force. During Vaylin's Assault on Odessen, many Shade Stalkers were driven out into the open by the fighting and began assaulting both Alliance and Eternal Empire personnel.

name: Shadevale stalker
summary: Shadevale stalkers were serpentine creatures native to the planet Kashyyyk. They were known to make their homes in the pools and streams of the Kkowir Forest. They were similar in appearance to, and related to the crystal snakes of Yavin 4. Shadevale venomstings were another type of snake on Kashyyyk, yet they were more closely related to rawls.

name: Shadow barnacle
summary: The shadow barnacle was a silica parasite living on the planet Coruscant. This small crustacean anchored to buildings by feeder roots through which it absorbed nutrients. It retracted into its shell when threatened. The shadow barnacle reproduced by releasing "egg seeds" and "sperm pollens" into the air. It consisted of a tubular mouth, a shelled pod, and retractable anchor tendrils. It could also move by using its claw-legs, and it had external gill filaments that could be withdrawn into its mouth.

name: Shadow hunter
summary: Shadow hunters were creatures native to the planet of Ithor. They were extremely deadly to all things, including themselves.

name: Shadow leech
summary: Shadow leeches were a type of leech found on the planet Siline. During the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual, Jedi Padawan Yord Fandar encountered an active shadow leech nest and became covered in them.

name: Shadowman
summary: The Shadowmen were humanoids native to the "night planet" of Nivek.

name: Shadowmoth
summary: Shadowmoths were a type of moth. The resurrection of once-dead Nightsister Zombies from the pods in which the Nightsisters kept their bodies was comparable to the stirring of shadowmoths.

name: Shahkirin
summary: The Shahkirin were a sentient species from the Inner Rim Territories' Shahkir system. One Shahkirin was a member of the Rebel Alliance in 2 BBY, being present at the Alliance base on the moon Yavin 4 that year. Another member of the species, Yipsit, grew up on the planet Bestine IV and served as a Resistance mechanic at its base on the moon Ajan Kloss by 35 ABY.

name: Shaliz'Na
summary: The Shaliz'Na were a sentient species native to the planet Shar'Ack. The species had large wings, some with wingspans of 12 foot, and their bodies were covered in a fine down. Shaliz'na placed a premium on art of all forms, from music to sculptures to paintings. As a species, they were addicted to alcohol, and when conquered by the Galactic Empire, liquor was strictly controlled on the world. Some members of the species left their homeworld in an attempt to break their addiction; the musician Tyric was one such Shaliz'Na, eventually joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic in its struggle to overthrow the Empire.

name: Shallowbuck
summary: Shallowbucks were a type of herbivorous grazing mammal native to the grassy islands of the ocean moon Kef Bir. The members of Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters, hunted shallowbucks for meat and hide, harvesting their kills efficiently. The group used energy bows without power augmentation to kill the fleet-footed shallowbucks cleanly.

name: Shamunaar
summary: The shamunaar was a giant, long-necked saurian creature from Roon. It lived in the mud fields of Roon, and was a constant threat to the wild banthas of the planet. The shamunaar usually hibernated for decades at a time, however it could be woken up if disturbed. It was not believed that the shamunaar was native to Roon, but was rather an exotic transplant.

name: Shani
summary: The Shani were a sentient species of tall, multicolor-feathered reptilian humanoids from a homeworld within Wild Space. They possessed extremely long lifespans, and could unhinge their jaws to devour creatures and beings whole. Shani were considered by the Hutts to be the galaxy's original bounty hunters.

name: Shanjaru
summary: The shanjaru was a beast that was driven nearly to extinction at the time of the Cold War. Drooga the Hutt acquired what he believed to be the last two surviving members of the species, a male and a female, in order to serve them as part of his feast. Momi Andrell and a group of animal rights activists worked to save the shanjaru and repopulate the species. They stole the female from Drooga's pleasure barge and took genetic samples, sending them to Coruscant. The male shanjaru was later delivered to Drooga by Risha Drayen. The unorthodox scientist Lazhae claimed the species demonstrated evidence of evolving sapience, though his research was less than reliable.

name: Shaoryn
summary: Shaoryn, or swamp pixies, were a semi-sentient, Force-sensitive species native to the planet Toydaria. They used trickery to look like collections of wispy, yellow-white light, but were actually green amphibians. Tall and slender, with spongy bodies, they used leathery tendrils to entrap and drain the life out of their prey. They could also use the Force to affect their targets' thoughts and emotional state; for example, by convincing their prey that they were there to help. Grey Gabaki and Black Gabaki mushrooms grew from shaoryn droppings. Spicers protected shaoryn hunting grounds with holoprojectors that displayed "terrifying images."

name: Shaparak
summary: Shaparaks were a type of robust, green insect found on the tropical planet Akiva. Intelligent and docile, they emitted pacifying waves with their wings to subdue potential threats, although the expressive patterns on their wings were also used to scare off predators. Many of Akiva's inhabitants believed that an anxious mind could be soothed by watching a wild shaparak.

name: Shaper
summary: The shapers were shape-shifting creatures native to Togoria. One breed was the toothsome image.

name: Sharalian
summary: Sharalians were a sentient species of owl. They had light skin with tan feathers, blue eyes, and a beak. They had two digits and thumbs on their hands, and five digits on their feet. Sharalians had pointed ears that were emotive.

name: Shard
summary: Shards were a silicon-based species native to the planet Orax, who took the form of irregularly faceted cylindrical crystals thirty to forty centimeters in length. Faint pulses of light—thought signals propagating through their "brains"—could be seen inside their bodies. Shards were immobile in their natural state, but could be installed in specially modified droids.

name: Sha'rellian toop
summary: Sha'rellian toops were starfish-like creatures that that are soft and sticky like slugs and squeal like pigs. They are found on the Hutt homeworld, Nal Hutta and shared a symbiotic relationship with the Hutts.

name: Shark-boar
summary: A shark-boar was a creature that had white tusks. During the Republic Fair on the Outer Rim planet Valo in 231 BBY, Jedi Master Stellan Gios mentally compared the hull of the Innovator—an Elite-class research vessel—to the color of shark-boar tusks.

name: Sharnaff
summary: The sharnaff was a large herd animal found on Corellia. It appeared similar to a ronto from Tatooine, as well as the piket from Dantooine and was a favorite prey of scouts and hunters. The Nomad greatcoat, a traditional outfit of the inhabitants of the Nomad Mountains, was made from tanned hides of sharnaffs.

name: Sharptailed Fellwing
summary: Sharptailed Fellwing was a species of playful birds found on Tenoo.

name: Sharu
summary: The Sharu were an ancient humanoid species that built the colossal plastic pyramids on the worlds of the Rafa system and the Mindharp of Sharu. The Mindharp was a strange object that constantly changed form as it shifted through dimensions.

name: Sharvo fish
summary: A sharvo fish was a type of bioluminescent fish that was native to the planet Castilon. After the Colossus platform was sunk under the surface of the water, schools of these fish could be seen swimming around it. Several stormtroopers who were flushed out of the mostly sunken station during a plan by Kazuda Xiono and Neeku Vozo to rid the Colossus of its occupiers were supposedly eaten by the fish.
distinctions: Two rows of bioluminescent spots down their backs

name: Shashay
summary: The Shashay were sentient avians indigenous to Crytal Nest planet in Wild Space. They were renowned for their natural skills as singers and astrogators, giving them the common nickname of Space Singers. They had a reputation for fiery tempers and a strong loyalty to their species. In an attempt to prevent the Galactic Empire from plundering their home planet, the Shashay kept the planet's galactic coordinates secret—to the point of not trusting that information to navigation computers and instead relying only on a Shashay navigator's memory for astrogation. The Alliance to Restore the Republic, noticing that the Shashay disliked the Empire as much as they did, approached the Shashay and tried to convince them to join their faction, with partial success: The governing Nestmothers of the Shashay did not want a Rebel base in Crytal Nest until the Rebellion could demonstrate its might, but several Shashay navigators and pilots were assigned to Rebel starships. Despite their dislike for the Empire, the Shashay still sent artists to perform in Imperial space. One of these was the cultural hero Crying Dawn Singer, who was kidnapped by Yearo Seville, a pirate who, following orders from the Empire, pretended to be a leader of the Alliance. The Empire hoped that the Shashay would reject the Alliance from that point on. The Alliance then sent a team to track Seville and rescue Crying Dawn Singer, only to discover a conspiracy among Imperial commanders.
distinctions: Thick plumage and wings for gliding

name: Shatras
summary: The Shatras were sentient species of reptilian bipeds indigenous to Trascor.
distinctions: Flexible necks, talon-like feet, claws, infrared vision, four eyes

name: Shatual
summary: A shatual was a species of animal native to the planet Mandalore in the Outer Rim. Shatuals were large creatures that made their homes in Mandalore's veshok forests. Male shatuals, known as bucks, elicited a call consisting of a rhythmic bark when seeking to mate with a female shatual, known as a doe. An adult shatual size easily overshadowed one of their main predators, the strill, but a single strill was still capable of felling its larger prey on its own. A number of Mandalorians also enjoyed shatual meat, and it was not uncommon for a Mandalorian to hunt shatuals for food, sometimes with the aid of domesticated strills. Roasted shatual haunch was considered an excellent way to celebrate a joyous event, such as the birth of a child. In the year 20 BBY, sensing the approaching birth of Venku Skirata, the strill known as Lord Mirdalan hunted a shatual near the Skirata clan home, Kyrimorut, and returned with its body with the intent of providing for the baby. Walon Vau—the owner of the affectionately nicknamed "Mird"—and his associates found the display touching, and the shatual was prepared and roasted for the clan's consumption by Rav Bralor, a close friend to the Skirata clan. Both Vau and Mird again hunted a shatual for a clan meal in the year 19 BBY, not long after the rise of the Galactic Empire. By that time, the young Venku Skirata had been fashioned a number of simple toys from veshok wood, one of them carved in the shape of a shatual.

name: Shaull
summary: The Shaull were a sentient species that hailed from an unidentified planet. They possessed light-colored skin with patches of darker color on the wrist, forearm, and elbows. Shaull were hairless, but possessed a form of cilia-like growth on the backs of their heads, shoulders, and back. Their faces were very smooth and flat, without visible nostrils. Few Shaull explored the stars, and those who did often started out as indentured servants on more advanced ships. The species adapted well to galactic-standard technology and often possessed a combination of archaic and modern skills amongst those encountered in the space lanes. Some Shaull were known for their curiosity and love of new and unexplored places. Many simply wished to experience everything and see all things.

name: Shaupaut
summary: Shaupauts, also spelled shaupats, were carnivorous marsupials that were native to the Gungan swamps of Naboo. A large variety was the greater shaupaut.

name: Shawda Ubb
summary: The Shawda Ubb (also spelled Shawda-Ubb) were a species of squat, green-skinned, potbellied sentients. They had four thin limbs that ended in three digits apiece, and small heads whose faces sported heavy brow ridges. As an inborn defense mechanism, they were able to spit poison. A famous Shawda Ubb was Rappertunie, who played the Growdi Harmonique as a member of the Max Rebo Band.

name: Shear mite
summary: Shear mites were a large insect form of life native to the planet Dathomir.

name: Sheffi
summary: Sheffi were a type of small, gray-furred creature with black eyes. In 34 ABY, Gatha Elbaphay, a patron of the Canto Casino in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica carried the pet sheffi Awgree while at the casino tables.

name: Shell-bat
summary: Shell-bats were dangerous and deadly flying reptiles native to Geran.

name: Shenbit bonecrusher
summary: The shenbit bonecrusher was a large carnivorous lizard native to the planet of Barab I. It was covered with bony and thorny plates. It also had two horns and a long tail. Barabels hunted bonecrushers for sport and meat. Although the shenbit was extremely dangerous to most humanoid species of the galaxy, it was considered to be fairly average prey among the Barabels. In fact, in the Barabel, "shenbit" roughly translated to "weak person" in Galactic Basic Standard. The Braxant Bonecrusher and the shenbit bonecrusher blow were named after the species. Saba Sebatyne often referred to shenbits while making comparisons and examples.

name: Sher Kar
summary: The Sher Kar was the apex predator of its homeworld, the volcanic Outer Rim planet Mustafar. Large and scorpion-like, they possessed six segmented limbs with feet with at least four toes. A Sher Kar's tail was also segmented and far longer than the rest of its body, ending in two black prongs. The creatures' skin was brown in color and scaly, with spikes around the joints on their limbs. The head of a Sher Kar consisted of a large, toothy maw with a large pink tongue inside. The favored prey of the Sher Kar was the large, egg-laying tulrus, and the predators could often be found deep in their nesting grounds. They were also dangerous to humans and on one occasion a Sher Kar fought two humanoid individuals, one armed with a blaster and the other wielding a lightsaber.

name: Shifala
summary: Shifalas were a species of sentient simians coming from Carreras Major in the Outer Rim Territories. They were the dominant species of the Carreras system and had furry humanoid features. Following the aftermath of the Second Imperial Civil War, the Shifala were members of the Galactic Federation Triumvirate, the new galactic government, and were led by Governor Biala. In 138 ABY, the Shifala species was swept into the rogue Sith Darth Wredd's insurgency against the One Sith.

name: Shiff-shiff
summary: The shiff-shiff was a type of bird that the human Kata Akuna watched while living on the Inner Rim planet Birren. In 9 BBY, Akuna later listed the shiff-shiff while trying to remember all the birds from Birren when she was on board the Stinger Mantis, a luxury yacht that she had joined the crew of after leaving Birren and losing both of her parents. Greez Dritus, the owner of the Mantis, overheard Akuna and, having never been to Birren, asked for more information on the birds when she explained what she was doing. Akuna then put off the discussion till later.

name: Shi'ido
summary: The Shi'ido were a sentient species of shapeshifters from the planet of Lao-mon. Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole was a Shi'ido, and used his abilities to infiltrate and monitor other alien species.
eyeColor: Any color and usually deep set eyes

name: Shikitari
summary: The Shikitari were a rare, dim-witted insectoid species native to the planet Shikitari in the Unknown Regions. They possessed a multi-stage life cycle, and during the final years of the Old Republic, very few individuals were aware of the Shikitari, with fewer still considered experts on their unique physiology.
lifespan: Multi-stage; the pupae form lasting only two standard days

name: Shilian lamprey
summary: Shilian lampreys were a type of creature capable of firmly latching onto surfaces that partially shared their name with the planet Shili. In 230 BBY, the pilot Leox Gyasi used magnetic clamp gloves to open a hangar bay door on the Starlight Beacon space station. His colleague—the pilot Affie Hollow—worried about him, but reassured herself that the man's gloves would keep him tethered to the station like a Shilian lamprey.

name: Shimholt
summary: Shimholt were a tall, purple-skinned sentient species native to the planet Kar'a'katok. A very long-lived race, the Shimholt were known as a friendly, agrarian species until around 4000 BBY, when Kar'a'katok was devastated by invading Nelori Marauders. The war turned the Shimholt into a xenophobic and reclusive species, and although their wholehearted embrace of military doctrine repelled the Nelori, it gave rise to a fanatical religious faction that overthrew the planet's democratic government and ruled the Shimholt for millennia. Kar'a'katok was deemed closed to outsiders and Shimholt forbidden to travel offworld—no Shimholt were seen in the wider galaxy until the Galactic Civil War, when a Shimholt named Ampotem Za was taken prisoner during an Imperial raid on Kar'a'katok. Rendered a pariah on his homeworld for being taken offworld, Za submitted to the Empire and served until his death in 3 ABY under the name "Suprema."

name: Shimmerbird
summary: Shimmerbirds were an avian species whose tongues were used by the Koorivar to craft robes.

name: Shipweaver
summary: A shipweaver was a creature that wove webs within ships. By 382 BBY, a large amount of webs had been made by a shipweaver in a locker within the Scupper, a yacht owned by the prospector Sunshine Dobbs. That year, as she looked in the locker for clothing to change into, the Evereni Guide of the Path of the Open Hand cult Marda Ro noticed the shipweaver webs.

name: Shiro
summary: Shiros were hard-shelled, benign, slow-moving reptiles native to the Gungan Swamps of Naboo. A Shiro's main defense was to retract its head, legs and tail into its spiny shell. [[File:Shiro-trap_2.jpg|thumb|left|170px|A "Shiro-trap" retracted into its shell.]] They fed on mintri, zaela, grahn vine, chak-root, and occasional mud-dwelling crustaceans and mollusks. Shiros were very popular with Gungan cooks. Shiros rolled in mud and collected dirt and seeds between their shell ridges. Tooke-trap plants grew and flourished in these "soil pockets", creating a symbiotic relationship nicknamed a "shiro-trap." Tooke-traps provide camouflage for shiros from larger predators, especially from the saw-toothed grank which was the Shiro's main predator due to its ability to break through tough shells with its large, crushing jaws. In return, shiros provided locomotion for the tooke-traps.

name: Shistavanen
summary: Shistavanen were a species of sentient fur-covered bipeds with wolflike faces, clawed paws, and glowing yellow or red eyes. Their homeworld was the planet Uvena Prime. One Shistavanen was Odabba, who worked for Garello Technologies during the High Republic Era. According to a story, the red sun rays that hit of the moon of Lupal turned the visiting Shistavanen explorer Kordus Vrak into a feral beast. By the time of the New Republic, a Shistavanen known as Brutus sailed the stars as the First Mate of Mad Captain Silvo's pirate crew.

name: Shiverpede
summary: Shiverpedes, commonly known as springers by locals, were a species of winged insectoid residing on the planet Koboh. It had two pairs of wings and two arms tipped with scythe-shaped claws, as well as orange and yellow skin. Shiverpedes would blend into their environment, springing at foes who crossed their path. Shiverpedes hunted in small packs, but nested in large groups. They would perform intricate mating rituals that involved their sharpened forceps.

name: Shoal unitusk
summary: The shoal unitusk was a species of medium-sized fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War. It could be recognised by the single horn on its head.

name: Sho'ban Do's species
summary: This near-human race was native to Pitann. They were short and barrel-chested, with large, muscular arms and legs, and dark, leathery skin. Since their homeworld had a higher gravity than Dayark, they seemed to bounce when they walked. Sho'ban Do was a member of this species.

name: Shockapede
summary: Shockapedes were a species of insect used by the Yuuzhan Vong that resembled worms with legs. They resided in hives and were known to be dangerous. When the Rodian Jedi Knight Jovan Drark discovered an insect nest while attempting to repair and All Terrain Armored Transport that the Myrkr strike team found on the Yuuzhan Vong worldship Baanu Rass during their mission to eliminate the Voxyn queen, his fellow Jedi Jacen Solo inquired if the creatures looked like worms with legs over comlink. Drark, who was also familiar familiar with shockapedes, assured Solo that it was not a shockapede hive, but a nest of flitnats.

name: Shook
summary: The shook was a carnivorous creature native to Carratos. The stealthy, silent predator would jump on its prey from above.

name: Shorak
summary: The Shorak were a Near-Human sentient species that originated on the planet Shor, in the Unknown Regions. They were more muscular than baseline Humans, and they often dyed their hair deep colors and decorated their arms with tattoos. About 100 years before the Jedi Civil War, Shorak scouts discovered the nearby planet Giaca and over the next 50 years, a series of Shorak expeditions were launched to explore the new world. However, when the Shorak eventually attempted to colonize Giaca, the military forces of the rival Peroenian species ambushed the colonists in the Giaca system, sparking a war between the two species that lasted for three hundred years. The Shorak were victorious in the conflict and they later established the settlement Station 300 on Giaca. However, their colonization attempt was unsuccessful and the Shorak later abandoned Station 300. About 20 years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars, the Shorak returned to Giaca and expanded Station 300, renaming it "Station 3Z3." This ignited the interest of a number of regional powers—including the Peroenians—in Giaca, and representatives of a number of other worlds established outposts of Giaca, which led to a series of skirmishes between the Shorak and their rivals. By the time of the Battle of Endor, the Shorak had fortified Station 3Z3, which enabled it to support a permanent Shorak colony on Giaca, and by the time of the fall of the Galactic Alliance during the Sith–Imperial War, over 50,000 Shorak lived on Giaca. However, the Shorak were unable to secure full control of the world and regular military clashes occurred on Giaca between the Shorak and the Peroenians.

name: Shorwilt
summary: The Shorwilts were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tor Bez'lin was a member of this species.

name: Shownarri
summary: Shownarri were Near-Humans from Shownar. Oro Freatt was a Shownarri.

name: Shozer
summary: Shozers were a sentient species with pale-colored skin and black eyes. The Resistance technician Goss Toowers was a member of the species. Krel Noviip battled against the crumbling Galactic Empire during the Uprising in the Anoat sector, shortly after the second Death Star was destroyed.

name: Shredder bat
summary: Shredder bat was the common name for a number of related bat species of various worlds. They were originally native to the Core Worlds planet Atrisia. The species, which grew up to one meter in length and wingspan, had highly sensitive hearing produced by a series of hearing organs along its neck and forehead. Such acute hearing enabled the shredder bat to pinpoint prey up to fifteen kilometers away. The bats traveled in packs and attacked by dive-bombing prey with great speed and accuracy, sometimes killing their targets instantly. Shredder bats spread to over a thousand worlds, including Hethar and Pallaxides. The various species were occasionally hunted for sport, but more often were considered dangerous and unwanted predators. Scientists speculated over the mode of transmission between planets, with some xenobiologists proposing the shredder bats utilized infant hibernation such that otherwise ignorant target creatures carried their eggs.

name: Shreebird
summary: Shreebirds were an endangered species. Jar Jar Binks accidentally let loose numerous shreebirds from the Endangered Shreebird Aviary on Coruscant at one point.

name: Shriek-hawk
summary: Shriek-hawks, known as jai'galaar in Mando'a, were a species native to the planet Mandalore.

name: Shrikarai
summary: The Shrikarai, also known as the Nameless, as the Shrii Ka Rai or Shrii-ka-rai (Eaters of the Force or Force Eaters), were creatures that preyed on the Living Force, thus making them into natural predators for Force-sensitive individuals when they were forced off of their homeworld of Sophros. Exploited as weapons against Force-sensitives, the beings had an effect on Force users that strengthened with proximity, causing hallucinations, loss of connection to the Force, and in some cases, death, reducing the victim to a lifeless husk. During the High Republic Era, the Path of the Open Hand, which knew the creatures as "Levelers," used them as part of its crusade to rid the galaxy of Force users. Centuries later, the leader of the Nihil marauders, Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro, who possessed the means to control the creatures, intended to use the creatures to bring down the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic; after obtaining and testing the effects of one of the beings, Ro later acquired numerous more. Ro released a number of the Nameless aboard the Starlight Beacon space station at the same time as he dispatched Nihil marauders to orchestrate its destruction, disturbing the Jedi aboard and preventing them from saving the station. Following the time of the High Republic, the beings remained known to the Jedi. Spoken of alongside other phantasmagoria in stories by Jedi Initiates, the Nameless were also mentioned in a prophecy pertaining to the Chosen One and the supposedly frightening tale known as "The Curse of the Nameless."

name: Shrob
summary: Shrobs were saurian humanoids from the planet Mandalah III. They were tall and lean, with scaly brownish skin.

name: Shuimi
summary: Shuimi were a type of feathered creatures that lived in the scrub forests of the planet Artiod Minor. Juvenile members of the sentient Artiodac species, which were also native to the world, would forage in the forests to collect shuimi feathers for use in making crowns that they would then use to attract a mate.

name: Shungbeek
summary: Shungbeek were a sentient species that pupated at some point in their lifetime. They breathed an argon-rich atmosphere, and had to wear an enclosed perspex dome to survive in other conditions. Kid Malmash was a young Shungbeek who worked as a pilot, transporting refugees to safe destinations.

name: Shusugaunt
summary: The Shusugaunt were a species from the planet of Shusugaunt in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim. A race of space-faring warriors, the Shusugaunt were short in stature, and were considered to be an aggressive people. The Shusugaunt were encountered by a colony ship from Gravlex Med millennia before the Clone Wars, and attempted to conquer and take control of the Anx homeworld. However, the Shusugaunt were unprepared for the planet's high gravity, and found themselves unable to fight without becoming dizzy by the high gravitic forces. The Shusugaunt fled Gravlex Med, leaving the Anx alone.

name: Shydopp
summary: Shydopps were a sentient species from the planet Morak. After the fall of the Empire, Shydopp pirates attacked shipments of rhydonium being delivered to an Imperial remnant, as well as Din Djarin and Migs Mayfeld, who were disguised as members of the remnant. The Shydopp Vorg Alsum was a prisoner of the New Republic. Another Shydopp served as a fighter pilot in Gorian Shard's crew.

name: Shyrack
summary: Shyracks were large, bat-like avian creatures with razor like teeth native to the caves of Korriban.

name: Shyyyo bird
summary: The shyyyo bird was a rare species of massive blue-blooded bird native to the planet Kashyyyk. By 14 BBY, shyyyo were extremely rare and became an endangered species.

name: Si-hen
summary: Si-hens were birds native to Gelgelar. They ate grain, which they would peck off the ground.

name: Sibettan
summary: Sibettans were a sentient species in the galaxy. Loo Re Anno was a member of the species who, at some point in the distant past, created the Dragon Void Run and disappeared into the seams between space and time.

name: Sibilaari
summary: The Silbilaari were a sentient species that evolved on a planet near to Senex-Juvex.

name: Siblipede
summary: The siblipede was a non-sentient species of small insect native to Ithor, a planet in the Ottega sector of the Mid Rim. They often fed in groups upon the decaying leaves on the forest floor. Siblipedes were preyed on by manollium birds.

name: Sic-Six
summary: Sic-Six were a six-eyed intelligent species who, due to their unusual appearance, were easily mistaken for pests. One Sic-Six resided in the palace of Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

name: Sid'Han
summary: Sid'han, or mud crawlers, were mud-burrowing, crocodilian predators native to Seikosha.

name: Sikan
summary: The Sikan (singular: Sika) were a race of sentient beings that were native to the planet of Sika. Their planet was invaded by opportunistic Chekut forces during the Second Galactic Civil War.

name: Sikurdian
summary: Sikurdians were a sentient species from the Sikurd system. During the Clone Wars, Sikurdian privateers supported the Corporate Alliance, which had pledged its resources to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, in defending its headquarters on the planet Murkhana. During the Imperial Era, Sikurdian pirates were active in the Lower Flora Cloud, and Luke Skywalker claimed to have been attacked by them while bluffing his way through a stormtrooper patrol at a refueling station over Devaron.

name: Silan
summary: A silan was a monstrous, tentacled creature from Arorua. They resembled a mass of writhing tendrils and multiple toothy maws, quite similar to a sarlacc. The silan lived in a towering earthen structure, with animal skulls strewn about the dank and gloomy vicinity as trophies or offerings from locals. Silans were primordial creatures immersed in the dark side of the Force. Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi killed one of the creatures in 44 BBY, directed by the Living Force. After destroying it, Kenobi questioned whether what they did was right, wondering if even a creature like that had a place in the natural order, meaning it should be respected. Jinn expressed that he also found the experience unpleasant but felt directed by the Force to do so. He advised his Padawan that the ways of the Force were mysterious and the path of the Jedi was not an easy one, for they always had to be ready to serve something greater than themselves.

name: Siler
summary: The siler was a type of striped creature that was native to the planet Eriadu. While the planet was occupied by the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era, the Nihil slaughtered dozens of silers in order to sustain themselves. In 228 BBY, the Lannik Nihil Skrood licked the meat liquids off his fingers from one siler in his starship, the Sickle, consuming the last of a roasted foot from the deceased beast before finishing his meal with a burp.

name: Silik lizard
summary: Silik lizards were rare reptiles native to the Silent Desert on Tython. They were silicon-based life forms that were able to absorb energy from the sand.

name: Silika
summary: Silika were sapients indigenous to Dohu VII. They had a very rigid code of honor. Despite having three arms, they were not more dexterous due to their short, stubby fingers, additionally they had stumpy legs. As they consisted mainly of silicon, mineral water—or Silika water as they called it—had an intoxicating effect on the Silika. Silika would often challenge each other to the Contest, a water-drinking game.
distinctions: Silicon-based, an extra arm, stumpy legs and short, stubby fingers

name: Silinese
summary: The Silinese were a sentient species hailing from the planet Siline. They had crystalline bones, facial horns and teeth and diverse vibrant skin colors with matching hair and eyes. Because of their physiology, they were stronger and tougher than many species, including humans. The Silinese were originally a warrior people, but in the High Republic Era they became more peaceful and civilized and unified under one government. Apart from male and female, the Silinese also had other genders in their society.
distinctions: Crystalline bones, facial horns and teeth
Vibrant skin colors with matching hair and eyes

name: Silooth
summary: The silooth was a large Sithspawn beetle bred by the Sith Empire for use as a warbeast. Silooth were ferocious creatures that relentlessly attacked anyone or anything that strayed into their paths, spraying acid and using their powerful mandibles to crush their victims. The only deployment of the silooth in combat en masse was during the Battle of Kalsunor, when the Sith released the creatures on the planet Kalsunor and subsequently laid waste to the world.
