Afterward, the Sith continued to use the beetles on a smaller scale, and descendants of silooth transported to Kalsunor continued to inhabit the world thousands of years later.

name: Silpath
summary: Silpath were a creature found on the planet Jafan. They possessed antlers and hooves, resided in herds, and would migrate annually. At one point, Harli Jafan and her cousins were caught in a silpath migration, and had to climb a tree to escape.

name: Silt-rat
summary: Silt-rats were a type of rat with red eyes. In 4 ABY, the junk dealer Temmin Wexley felt like a soaked silt-rat that had drowned in a cistern while he hid under a tarp on top of Master Hyor-ka's dao-ben steamed bun shop on the planet Akiva during a mausim-storm.

name: Siltcrawler
summary: Siltcrawlers were creatures from the Outer Rim planet Nelvaan. They dug burrows for homes, were capable of hibernation, and lived in colonies. The massive and carnivorous horaxes often split open these burrows with their snout horns in order to eat entire colonies whole.

name: Silurian rodent
summary: A Silurian rodent was a creature that lived in nests. The protocol droid QT-3PO compared the inside of a Jawa sandcrawler to the inside of Silurian rodent nest.

name: Siluuk eel
summary: The siluuk eel was a species of eel found on the planet Toydaria. The eels were larger than a Toydarian, and were farmed in huge numbers in the city of Arnel.

name: Siluvian Seahorse
summary: Siluvian Seahorses were a type of aquatic creature. In 3 ABY, Siluvian Seahorse racing took place in the Aquatic Octagon, with the Seahorse Lillobell ahead of fellow racer Kirilee. Bets on the race could be placed on board the casino cruiser Morenia, with a droid-read advertisment for the bets made over the cruiser's speaker system questioning if Kirilee might overtake Lillobell.

name: Silver-nape beetle
summary: Silver-nape beetles were a species of beetle found on the swamp-covered planet of Dagobah. They burrowed inside of gnarltrees.

name: Silverback
summary: Silverbacks were a subspecies of the sentient Wookiee species on Kashyyyk. Two silverbacks were Wullffwarro and his son Kitwarr, who were taken into slavery by the Galactic Empire before being rescued by the Spectres.

name: Simoomian sensory hound
summary: The Simoomian sensory hound was a non-sentient species of six-legged canid native to the planet Simoom. Renowned for their preternatural eyesight, hearing, and sense of smell, they were domesticated by herders, and most noble estates of the Senex and Juvex sectors had a pack of sensory hounds for hunting and security. While on the planet Mimban in the year 2 ABY, the protocol droid C-3PO mistook the violent, howling sound of an energy mining drill for that of Simoomian sensory hounds, and assumed that the Galactic Empire had set a pack of them on the trail of himself and fellow Rebel Alliance members R2-D2, Luke Skywalker, and Leia Organa.
distinctions: Preternatural eyesight, hearing, and sense of smell

name: Siniteen
summary: The Siniteen were a humanoid sentient species that were native to Mileva. They were distinguished by their brain-shaped heads and hyperintelligence. They were capable of calculating hyperspace coordinates without the aid of a computer navigator. Siniteens were present in a wide variety of roles across the galaxy, ranging from bounty hunters to politicians.

name: Sink-crab
summary: The sink-crab was a crustacean native to Bestine IV. It used bladders that filled with air to propel itself. While living on Bestine IV, future Rebel pilot Jek Tono Porkins hunted these creatures in his T-16 skyhopper.

name: Sinkar
summary: The Sinkars were a species of helium-based slugs native to the planet Sinkar. They survived on solar energy and impurities extracted from the planet's surface. Galactic rumors conflicted as to the exact nature of the Sinkars—some claimed that the slugs were telepaths of great strength who communicated wisdom accumulated over a long lifetime. Others claimed they were mindless creatures, capable of sucking energy from other beings or starship drives.

name: Sinsaran
summary: The Sinsarans were a sentient species that was found on the planet Sinsara. Corlis Rath and Gara were members of this species.

name: Sipsk'ud
summary: The Sipsk'ud were a sentient species native to the Sipsk system in the Kanz sector. They were broadly avian in appearance, with a yellow duck-like beak and white feathers. They had a large cluster of seven eyes on their heads, and at least one Sipsk'ud wore a sealed spacesuit while in an atmosphere suitable for species such as Humans. During the Old Republic era, many Sipsk'ud were converted to Vianism by Argazdan settlers from the Core Worlds. They were one of many species that could be found wandering the streets of Nar Shaddaa at the end of the Clone Wars. During the Galactic Civil War, a Sipsk'ud was present among the space-freighters recruited by young Berd Lin to rescue his mother and her school after they were kidnapped by Imperial Major Stafuv Rahz. The individual was also present when Lin revised his plan in order to avoid an Imperial trap.

name: Siringana
summary: The siringana were vicious, reptilian predators native to the planet N'zoth. These beasts had four three-taloned legs, a pair of scythelike arms, a straight, spiked tail, a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth and a face similar to that of a Yevetha. Their tough, leathery brown skin allowed them to blend into the desert environment. They would turn on other siringana easily so there were never more than three in a group at a time, and they seemed to relish instilling fear in their prey before moving in on the kill. They reproduced by laying eggs, which were considered a delicacy in the Koornacht Cluster. The siringana were considered to be as merciless and brutal as the Yevetha, who were the only sentients native to N'zoth. These bigoted, violent natives revered the siringana and its ability to kill its enemies, and some high-caste Yevetha kept sirigana pits where they would sacrifice victims.

name: Sirroning
summary: The Sirroning were a six-limbed, sentient, tan-skinned species. One known as the Eye of Webbish Bog was locked in symbiosis with a blind Areobernos on the planet Mustafar.

name: Sisofish
summary: Sisofish was a type of fish that lived in the galaxy. In a contest held at the castle of Maz Kanata, Damor Gregon served a dish consisting of fried sisofish with citrus salad.

name: Sith familiar
summary: The Sith familiar was a type of Sith-developed creature that resembled a small scavenger bird. Familiars were created by the Sith—an order of dark-side adherents—and were produced via Sith alchemy. A familiar was bonded via the Force to the individual who created it, which allowed the master of a familiar to experience the sights and sounds encountered by his or her familiar and to project Force powers via the creatures, as if the master was at the familiar's location in person.
distinctions: Ability to wield Force powers known to the familiar's master

name: Sith snake
summary: The Sith snake was a type of snake from the Sith planet Moraband. During the Clone Wars on a mission to the planet, Jedi Master Yoda encountered Sith snakes.

name: Sith
summary: The Sith were a red-skinned species with tentacles, susceptible to using the dark side of the Force. They shared their name with the Sith Order, a religious organization of Force-sensitives who also used the dark side. Centuries before the Galactic Civil War, a member of the Sith species was part of the Darkseekers, a specialized sect within the Sith Order. During their attack on the Ascendant temple, the lightsaber-wielding Sith stabbed the Ascendant member Ilith, which ultimately led to his death.
distinctions: Frequent use of the dark side of the Force

name: Sith war behemoth
summary: The Sith war behemoths were beasts of war used by the Sith Empire.

name: Sith warbird
summary: The Sith warbird was a species of flightless bird from the planet Khar Delba that was commonly used as an artillery mount by the Sith, a Force-sensitive species from the world Korriban. By the time of the arrival of Dark Jedi Exiles on the planet Korriban around 6900 BBY, warbirds were a mainstay of the Massassi infantry of the Sith Empire, and the birds were later used by the Sith Empire of the fallen Jedi Exar Kun during the Great Sith War. Sith warbirds were notorious for their bad temper, and they typically used their large size to ram and trample down their prey.

name: Skakoan
summary: {{MultipleIssues|image|updatecontent=Mace Windu: The Glass Abyss, Star Wars: The Clone Wars, Doctor Aphra (2016) 15, Darth Vader (2020) 29, Darth Vader (2020) 30, }} Skakoans were a sentient species native to the planet Skako. In order to survive off of their homeworld, they were required to wear pressure suits to simulate its unique atmosphere and pressure, which were vastly different from the galactic standard. A male Skakoan known as Wat Tambor was the foreman of the Techno Union during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
distinctions: Required to wear pressure suits to survive off of their homeworld

name: Skalder
summary: The skalder were a mammalian desert species of herbivorous quadrupeds native to the plains of the planet Florrum. Primarily inhabiting lands filled with acidic geysers, the beasts had to ability to sense when the geysers would soon erupt in order to get to a safe distance. They were not normally ridden by sentient beings, but were surprisingly fast, and during the Clone Wars a group of Galactic Republic clone troopers led by Jar Jar Binks managed to mount and ride wild skalder during their mission to Florrum.

name: Skandit
summary: Skandits were a species of small, sentient bipeds with furred bodies, gangly limbs, and squat, compact torsos. Although the black fur around their eyes looked like a mask, the rest of the body was a bluish gray. A large group of Skandits lived in the forests of Endor, where they used slingshots, whips, and batons to ambush unsuspecting caravans of Ewoks and other species. Skandits spoke a noisy, chittering language. In 3 ABY, a group of Skandits ambushed a party of Ewoks from Bright Tree Village, separating them from their wagon of goods, and imprisoning the travelers. That same day, a band of wandering entertainers known as the Travelling Jindas arrived in the Skandits' home and arranged to perform for the masked marauders. When the Skandits discovered that a few Jindas had helped the Ewok prisoners break out, the show came to a close as the Skandits attacked the strangers. Nevertheless, the Jindas and Ewoks escaped into the forest.

name: Skar'kla
summary: The skar'kla, skar-kla, or glitterclaw, was a semiaquatic, carnivorous reptile, lethal predator native to Bothawui.

name: Skee
summary: [[File:TwoheadedRodent-TheHauntedVillage.png|thumb|right|180px|A Skee in Gorneesh' hut]] The two-headed rodent known as a Skee was found on Endor, where it was seen quickly devouring a leg of leftover meat on a table in the home of the Duloks, before Gorneesh scared it away by smashing the table with his club. One Skee was loyal to Morag the Tulgah witch. The beast was quite strong, and its two heads worked together when eating. Its jaws were strong enough to snap bones in half and consume them in a matter of seconds. Besides its two heads, Morag's pet had six limbs and two tails. It was quite quick and scurried on the floor on all its paws. It was present at Morag's lair during Morag's final conflict with the Ewok Shaman Logray and taunted the Ewok children Wicket Wystri Warrick, Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, Latara, and Teebo who had been forced into servitude by Morag. Wicket attempted to frighten the creature away by throwing a bone at it, but the two-headed monster simply caught the bone in its mouths and consumed the bone quickly. When Logray arrived at Mount Thunderstone, Morag ordered her Yuzzum guards and her two-headed pet to attack Logray. However, before the beast could reach the elderly Ewok, young Teebo grabbed the creature and threw it aside. After recovering, the pet tried to resume its attack, but Logray used the Sunstar to create a flash of light, and the Yuzzum and the two-headed creature retreated. Although the pet may have escaped Morag's lair at this moment, it was more than likely killed when Morag flooded her fortress with lava once she had taken the sunstar from Logray. It was not seen escaping the lair with Morag's Yuzzum guards during this occurrence, meaning that it either escaped during the early part of the attack, or was simply killed by the lava.

name: Skeeg
summary: Skeeg was a mollusk native to the planet Vendara.

name: Skeeris
summary: Skeeris was a non-sentient species native to the shadow world of Umbara. The four-legged species had two clawed digits on their front legs and a long face with large teeth.The Commander and Lana Beniko killed several skeeris during the events of the Crisis on Umbara.
distinctions: Skeel body with large jaws and two front-looking teeth

name: Skeezump
summary: Skeezumps were creatures found on the planet Lateron. They were fuzzy and had digestive systems that fermented whatever they ate, which put the creatures in a state of constant inebriation. The Stinger Mantis pilot Greez Dritus commented during a mission to infiltrate a Haxion Brood base between 12 BBY and 11 BBY that the Haxion Brood members were probably "drunk as skeezumps in the cantina." When Jedi Knight Cal Kestis inquired what a skeezump was, Dritus was surprised that the Jedi was unfamiliar with the creature and enthusiastically explained their appearance and biology. He then claimed that they made poor pets.

name: Skeïtos
summary: The Skeïtos were a sentient species. They made starships.

name: Skel
summary: Skels were a sentient species that dwelled on Hoth. Hunting in packs, they were a primitive people, attacking whatever they could find without warning. They could burrow under the snow, and survive in extremely cold conditions. The Skels resided in caves, within the mountains of Hoth. The species' name originated as a nickname given to them by combatants during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

name: Skembo
summary: The Skembo were a sentient species in the galaxy. They had short legs and long, prehensile tongues with which they could seize food. The Skembo had a rivalry with the Hassarians. Ceeril, one member of the species, served as the Ambassador of Rion during the High Republic Era.

name: Sketto
summary: Skettos were medium-sized, blood-sucking flying reptiles that dwelled in the caverns of Tatooine. Only emerging at daybreak and twilight, they possessed many rods in their eyes to assist their vision in low-light conditions as they ate airborne insects. Though reptilian, they were warm-blooded and gave birth to a single offspring at a time. Skettos would often gather loose bantha wool for nests. [[File:Sketto2-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Sketto swarm.]] Sketto tended to swarm with others of their kind to suck the blood of sleeping larger animals. Their large teeth helped to puncture tough hides, and legend had it that a sketto swarm could suck a sleeping dewback dry overnight. They bled green blood. In 32 BBY, during the Boonta Eve Classic podrace a group of skettos that inhabited a cave, fled from one of the cave exits to escape an explosion caused by the podracer Ratts Tyerell crashing his Podracer into a pillar of stone.

name: Skib
summary: Skibs were creatures that built dams and moved along the surface of water on their elongated feet, which resembled natural water-skis. They were found on the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Skilla
summary: The Skilla were a sentient species. Their vital organs, including photosensitive orbs for sight, vibrating cilia for hearing, and smell receptors, lined an uvula-like bulb suspended from the roof of their mouth, behind rows of sharp teeth. The bounty hunter Carib Diss was a Skilla who had an unsettling appearance as a result of his species' biology and wore a sensor dome cap to gather data about his surroundings without needing to open his mouth.

name: Skim-snake
summary: Skim-snakes were a species of rainbow-colored snake native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space nicknamed Graf-World by the Graf family of cartographers. They lived in the heavy tree canopy above the world's swamps. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Lina Graf, the family's eldest child, drove out in the family's landspeeder to search for her brother Milo Graf in the swamps of the planet. The sound of the vehicle disturbed skim-snakes in the canopy above, causing them to burst from the trees.

name: Skindle
summary: The skindle was a creature found on the planet Batuu. The sounds they made could be heard from the Saka homestead outside Black Spire Outpost.

name: Skinflayer
summary: Skinflayer was a non-sentient reptilian species. Skinflayers had two legs, large arms with four claws on each hand, a short tail, spikes on their heads and a mouth full of sharp teeth. Skinflayers could be found in jungle environments of Belsavis and Taral V. A Skinflayer named Fleshripper was owned by the Hutt Suudaa Nem'ro on Nal Hutta, while another Skinflayer named Mister Ripper was a pet of Thades Gorkultok, a gladiator in the Arena Grand of Zakuul.

name: Skipper squid
summary: A skipper squid was a creature that the Human Royal Naboo Security Forces Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes was familiar with. In 32 BBY, during the Battle of Naboo, the militiagung soldiers of the Gungan Grand Army used large amounts of boomas, explosive weapons utilizing blue slimy plasma, against the battle droids of the Trade Federation. In a comment made to a superior in the battle's aftermath, the Naboo-native Sykes compared the plasma slime-covered site of the engagement to a giant skipper squid having exploded at that location.

name: Skitter
summary: A skitter was a small animal known to infest buildings. The Imperial Governor's Hall on Verkuyl had a skitter problem late in the Galactic Civil War. Skitters could be recognized by the sounds of their squeaks and scurrying claws. They had voracious appetites, said to eat almost anything (though not metal).

name: Skitterfly
summary: Skitterflies were a type of fly. In 228 BBY, Jedi Master Porter Engle pursued the Nihil Minister of Protection Abediah Viess to the world Isolt, intending to end her life. When she inquired about him detonating half of her base on Isolt, Engle mentally considered whether he should ask her a question in return or continue trying to trap her via violence like a skitterfly in a glass box.

name: Skittermouse
summary: Skittermice were nocturnal creatures inhabiting the planet Jakku. Industrious and determined, skittermice crossed the deserts at night in search of food and salvage to make nests and burrows. They were preyed upon by numerous predators such as ripper-raptors, pole-snakes, and the vicious vworkka bird.

name: Skizzard
summary: The skizzard was a creature found on the planet Troiken. Skizzards were sometimes featured in the native Xextos' mosaic artwork that were designed to evoke feelings of speed and motion.

name: Skotcarp
summary: Skotcarps were a species of non-sentient reptiles native to the planet Barab I. Making their home on the shale slopes of Mount Ste'vshuulsz, the skotcarps were small and fast, hiding below ground during daylight hours.

name: Skrat
summary: Skrats were a type of rodent-like creature that it was rumored were used to make Turbo Dogs. In 9 BBY, while a pair of stormtroopers where discussing what to eat at the end of their shift patrolling on the planet Coruscant, one trooper suggested Turbo Dogs. The other trooper brought up the rumor, which the first trooper denied, but the pair then began considering other options instead. It was speculated that Undercity Meats used skrats as primary ingredients in its low-quality production.

name: Skree-skater
summary: Skree-skaters were nonsentient creatures native to Galantos that glided across the gelatinous pools of their homeworld, hunting small prey.

name: Skreeg
summary: Skreegs were small mammalian humanoid creatures native to the jungle moon Yavin 4. They had short and flat ape-like heads with big eyes and a short snout. They had long limbs, and their claws served as their only natural defense. Their body with partially covered with hair, the color of which ranged from cream to brown. Skreegs were herbivorous and lived in small colonies throughout the forests of their homeworld. They were aggressive and considered any approach of other humanoid lifeforms as encroachments on their territory and would fight savagely to defend it. After the Battle of Yavin, the Exar Kun cultists tamed a skreeg named Mother Luresh that they used to defend the Temple of Exar Kun.

name: Skreen's species
summary: This sentient species were native to Lusaanda. Skreen was a member of this species.

name: Skreev
summary: The Skreev, also known as the Dxunian Raptor and as the Dxunian Devourer, was a reptavian that was native to Onderon's moon of Dxun.

name: Skriffle
summary: The skriffles were a type of rodent native to the planet Federian. The rodents naturally lived on the Federian trees within the forest. The skriffles were able to glide from high places safely. The skriffles could also be found on the planet Aludia.

name: Skrilling
summary: The Skrilling were a three-fingered, bipedal sentient species with green skin and brown eyes. The arms dealer Pote Snitkin was a Skrilling, as was the Jedi Knight Ord Enisence.

name: S'krrr
summary: The S'krrr were native to a planet of the same name. They were tall mantis-like insectoids with sharp body segments and small transparent, vestigial wings on their backs. S'krrr could not fly, because their small wings were unable to carry their weight. They would use their wings for a form of communication known as "wing-song". [[File:Rabaanite_SWJ9.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A S'krrr fights a Rabaanite.]] There had once been a rivalry between the S'krrr and the Humans of the neighboring planet, Rabaan (known as Rabaanites). One-on-one combat would often take place on the Combat Moon. Even after this ended, some S'krrr continued to practice melee combat with vibroblades. Despite remaining technologically advanced for a people on such a remote planet, they never developed interstellar travel. Some S'krrr worshiped the lower insects of the planet, such as drog beetles, because they believed they were descended from insects such as these.

name: Skud's species
summary: Skud's species were a race of red-skinned humanoids. They had a frill of spines atop their heads, and what appeared to be naturally armored bodies. Their armor was not strong enough to stop a blaster bolt, however, as Skud learned at his peril when he was killed in a fight with Han Solo and Chewbacca on Orleon.

name: Skuir fish
summary: The skuir fish was a species of fish native to the planet Sakiya. They were aggressive, and grew to an average of five meters in length.

name: Skup
summary: Skups were a humanoid sentient species with long arms, stooped shoulders, four fingers per hand, a bulbous abdomen, a pair of close-set eyes, and a long nose. Antha Mont was a female Skup affiliated with the Resistance.
distinctions: Long arms, four fingers, stooped shoulders, bulbous belly, close-set eyes, long nose

name: Skura
summary: The skura was a species of vermingilua found on the secluded planet Bal'demnic where the Sith known as the Stranger lived. They used their long snouts to forage on the stony shores of an island on the world, feeding on stone fleas and formants in sea caves. Skura used their slate gray skin and slab-like heads to camouflage themselves when danger approached. In 132 BBY, the former Jedi Verosha Aniseya encountered a family of skura on the world after she was brought there by the Stranger.

name: Skylar-bird
summary: Skylar-birds were a type of bird that lived on the world Batuu. While meditating in the Batuu Jedi temple around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani reached out with the Force, perceiving the life around her as glowing colors and sensing both a flock of skylar-birds and a herd of horned stoans in the wilds surrounding the temple.

name: Skysnare
summary: Skysnare were large avians native to the planet Auratera.

name: S'kytri
summary: The S'kytri (meaning the Windborn in their language) were a sentient species of winged humanoids indigenous to the planet of Skye, also known to the Galactic Empire as Marat V. They were normally tall, muscular and thin, which is why they were regarded as one of the most beautiful species in the galaxy. Throughout history, the S'kytri had built up a reputation of noble warrior bards.
skinColor: Blue or soft green and cyan

name: Slaatik hagworm
summary: The slaatik hagworm was an enormous non-sentient predatory myriapod which lived in the Lianorm Swamp, on Naboo. It was protected by a hard, chitinous exoskeleton, and was vulnerable primarily on its underside. It also had pincers on its tail, and had green and white skin tones. The slaatik hagworm attacked its prey by unleashing a barrage of poisonous gas from glands about its mandibles and by throwing its massive bulk onto its prey in an attempt to crush it. Hagworms could also share a symbiotic relationship with native kreetles. In 32 BBY, two Jedi defeated a slaatik hagworm in the swamps on their way to Theed.
distinctions: Giant corpulent and long body, insect-like features

name: Slakari-hound
summary: Slakari-hound were hounds that fed on rotten carcasses. While in the gas giant Bespin's Cloud City in 4 ABY, the wealthy Onderonian Jintar Oarr tried to convince fellow Onderonian and Imperial loyalist Borgin Kaa to stand down when rebels raided his residence for access to a control panel there. Though Kaa felt that Oarr had a convincing enough demeanor to coax a slakari-hound away from consuming a rotten carcass, the former refused to believe that the Galactic Emperor Darth Sidious was dead, choosing to stay loyal to the Empire.

name: Slang
summary: The Slangs were small, nomadic beings that traveled the galaxy as true space scrappers. They had four arms with long, thin fingers, a stocky thorax, and an elongated face.

name: Slar
summary: Slars were predators native to Port Evokk that would not hesitate to attack humanoids.

name: Slashrat
summary: Slashrats were rodent-like predators native to Bimmiel. They hunted in packs and had powerful olfactory senses. Whenever a slashrat had made a kill, the pack would unleash a combination of sweat and pheromones called killscent. When a slashrat was killed, its corpse would release a different scent called stink, which would warn away other slashrats. Killscent would attract slashrats from miles away, sometimes from multiple packs, forming an inescapable zone called a killball. One strategy for escaping slashrats was to distract them with a killball, since they would ignore all other prey. Ganner Rhysode and Corran Horn fought slashrats when they were on Bimmiel. They also spread killscent all over a Yuuzhan Vong camp so that the slashrats would attack. Slashrats were capable of running at speeds of up to 40 kilometers per hour.

name: Sledfrid
summary: Sledfrids were a sentient species that resembled jellyfish. Members of the species were notable for their lighter-than-air, gelatinous physiology, which allowed them to float, as well as their electric fronds that could be targeted at threats and were quite sticky. Sledfrids were incapable of speaking Basic without a vocabulator. During the High Republic Era, the Sledfrid Môr served as the bodyguard of Gloovan crime boss Straan Valgar, who ran a small mob on the Port Hunavon space station.

name: Sleen
summary: Sleens were a species of insect-eating lizard native to the planet Dagobah. They lived in holes in the ground and hollowed-out logs. The Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker encountered a sleen in the Cave of Evil while he trained on Dagobah.
habitat: Holes in the ground, hollowed-out logs

name: Sleft-chuff
summary: The sleft-chuff were large airborne herbivores native to Taloraan. They inhabited the upper atmosphere of the planet, filling their hollow bodies with gas to keep them afloat. They grazed on clouds of single-celled plant organisms that they collected with their tentacles which were covered with feathery hairs. Female sleft-chuffni usually gathered in herds of around a dozen, while males were solitary. The creatures were generally gentle and placid, but were known to become jittery during thunderstorms. The sleft-chuff were domesticated by the Denfrandi, who used them as both transports and as mobile homes, attaching gondolas to the creatures' undersides. Since the average sleft-chuff could carry up to fifty tons of dead weight, the Denfrandi and their homes did not present a burden to the creatures.

name: Sliideptra
summary: The sliideptra was a species of large annelidians from Tel IV.

name: Sliiskiis
summary: The Sliiskiis was a sentient, insectoid species found in the galaxy. They had retractable pincers. During a mission on the planet Tatooine to recover an agent and escort him off-world, a group of Rebels made their way to Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina. While in the cantina, the group was threatened by a member of the Sliiskiis species, but the situation did not escalate to anything more than just the threat.

name: Slime-toad
summary: Slime-toads were creatures in the galaxy. It was also used as an insult.

name: Slimesnipe
summary: A slimesnipe was a type of creature that could be found in the jungles of the planet Felucia. In 3 BBY, the Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa visited Felucia on a pathfinding trip and watched her instructor, Chief Pangie, shake off a slimesnipe. While Pangie was distracted by the creature, Organa took the opportunity to speak to her friend, the Apprentice Legislator Kier Domadi, who was also on the trip.

name: Slimy nonakara
summary: An inhabitant of lakes and swamps, the slimy nonakara or whirling snakes was a species that somehow had spread to numerous planets.

name: Slinker
summary: A slinker was an animal native to the rain forest on Kirtania.

name: Slith
summary: The Slith were a sentient serpentine species native to the moon Yavin 13. Nomadic creatures, they lived in patriarchal tribes of up to fifteen individuals and had little civilization and no permanent structures. The Slith were venomous, preferring to paralyze their prey before eating them alive. They communicated with each other via a rudimentary language consisting of noises produced by rubbing their scales on the ground. Slith had little contact with the wider galaxy, remaining largely undiscovered until the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, their moon was wiped of all life, leading to their extinction.

name: Slitherfish
summary: Slitherfish were a non-sentient species found on the Mid Rim planet of Naboo. Despite their name, they did not live in the water, but under the shade of trees, where they formed clusters that made them look like vines at first glance. They had long bodies with smooth, green skin, ending in a pointed tail with fins. Their head featured two eyes, a glowing luring apparatus, two nostrils, a mouth containing sharp fangs and a forked tongue, which the creatures occasionally flicked. One day, while on a quest to find a soshinyday blobball, Padmé Amidala and Jar Jar Binks had to cut across a cluster of slitherfish. The creatures proved hostile, frightening the adventurers' kaadus and ensnaring Binks. Unwilling to slaughter the entire cluster, Amidala shot holes in the tree canopy with her blaster, causing the slitherfish to retreat due to their innate fear of bright lights.
distinctions: Long body, sharp fangs, luring apparatus

name: Slitherwolf
summary: Slitherwolves were a type of wolf. They were known to be preyed on by rancors, who let the slitherwolves feast on their own prey before catching them when they were gorged and asleep. The slitherwolves were a subject of a code phrase used by Captain Magna Tolvan of the Rebel Alliance to identify their deep-cover operative Thassilio Smeuse.

name: Slivilith
summary: The slivilith were a species of large, green, non-sentient creatures originally created by the Yuuzhan Vong as a long-range intelligence gathering device thousands of years before their eventual invasion of the galaxy. Fearsome predators with little mind of their own, slivilith could travel immense distances across the vacuum of space in a sort of hibernation state before awakening on re-entry into a new atmosphere, after which it immediately sought heat. Although they frequently appeared in popular entertainment, slivilith were often considered myths by the galaxy at large. Only four encounters with slivilith had been confirmed by the time of the Galactic Civil War, including a battle between a slivilith and a team of Rebel operatives on Arbra in 3 ABY.

name: Sljee
summary: The Sljees were nonhumanoid sentients indigenous to the planet Sljee.
distinctions: Multiple limbs and tentacles, blindness, acute sense of smell
language: Sljee{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030102ccw|text=Jeseej and the Sljee: Coruscant and the Core Worlds Preview

name: Sloat
summary: Native to the planet Wielu, Sloats were large carnivorous snake-like creatures with long mouths and large feathered wings. They were attracted to the glowdart, another creature on Wielu. A crime lord named Shon Ti'Ja owned a sloat on the planet. Since Wielu was commercialized, sloats, and several other creatures, were deemed dangerous and were forced out of their habitats. Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and the smuggler Rook Pryce used their symbiotic relation with the glowdart to enter the base of the crime boss Traygura.

name: Slombo's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Slombo was a member of this species.

name: Sloogarian
summary: Sloogarians were slimy, slug-like sapients from the Sloogaria system. They were known to enjoy eating bantha droppings and other treats that most species usually found disgusting. They were also known to stretch the truth for profit. Squishmael was a member of the species; he told the supposedly true story of Han Solo and the Kessel Run in exchange for a few drinks, and then offered to tell about his "good buddy" Darth Vader's Tauntaun-hunting expedition on Hoth.

name: Slopewing
summary: A slopewing was a creature that was used in the herding of such creatures as nerfs and naugas. The slopewing could be found on Corellia, where Wedge Antilles rode one in farm school.

name: Slork
summary: Slorks were solitary, omnivorous ungulates native to the swamps of Kidron, but also found on Corellia. They vaguely resembled swine, and were fiercely territorial. While they seldom engaged in predation, they scavenged on the remains of quamin kills. They also ate industrial waste and garbage, and were themselves immune to predation due to their own stench. The primary sense they relied on to perceive environment was smell, facilitated by a large snout.

name: Slovar
summary: Slovar were a type of large, furry predator with six limbs. During the Republic Era, a group nested in an abandoned temple of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door on the planet Cerosha. After the brotherhood member Minakatso unsealed the cave and disturbed them, the slovar began snatching children from the city of Műch, where residents began calling the creatures the snatcher. After the Jedi Knight Qui-Gon Jinn saved the child Peroka from a slovar, the pair began investigating the creatures and tracked one back to the temple. There, they found Minakatso and freed him from bindings, waking the Slovar Queen. Minakatso and Jinn then fought four of the creatures and slew the queen before sealing the temple. Jinn later told his Padawan, Obi-Wan Kenobi, about his encounter with slovar on Cerosha.

name: Sludge panther
summary: The sludge panther was a dangerous carnivorous predator native to the planet of Talus. The sludge panthers lived in swamps and dank jungles of Talus. They often rolled around in mud to mask its scent when hunting. They lived in small packs, females usually hunted for food while males protected the nests and young from predators. A larger subspecies of the common sludge panther was the greater sludge panther. The sludge panther was distantly related to the Corellian sand panther.
hairColor: Mat of mottled brown and gray

name: Sludge salamander
summary: Sludge salamanders were a species native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space which the Graf family temporarily named Graf-World. While Milo Graf, the youngest Graf child, was attempting to capture an ash-rabbit he had discovered in the swamps, the family's droid CR-8R queried if the creature that Graf was pursuing was a sludge salamander or horned billipede.

name: Sludir
summary: The Sludir were reptilian sapients indigenous to Sluudren. They were large, imposing people, with two arms, six legs, and a thick armored carapace. For millennia, they lived without advanced technology in a society ruled by the proud members of a warrior caste. This changed once Sluudren was discovered by offworlders, as their homeworld was conquered by the Galactic Empire, and the Sludir were enslaved.

name: Slug-beetle
summary: The slug-beetle was a species of small blue, winged beetle that lived on the planets Naboo and Tatooine. On Naboo, they lived exclusively amongst the roots of the perlote tree, which grew only in the world's eastern swamps. Gungans could eat the insects whole, and they were a favorite snack of Senator Jar Jar Binks.

name: Slug-rat
summary: Slug-rats were indigenous to Ruten, and were considered by the inhabitants of that world to be the most disgusting creatures on the planet. In addition to simply being distasteful, slug-rats were prone to biting, and they were usually rabid. Slug-rats resembled furless, four-legged rodents with slimy slug-like bodies. The creatures bred at a rapid rate, frustrating attempts to exterminate them. In one notable incident, Governor Bursthed of Ruten hosted a pet show, in which a slug-rat had been secretly introduced by agents opposed to his rule in the hopes of humiliating him. During the pet show, Bursthed placed his hand into the opaque cage which was supposed to hold his own entry in the show, a rare Glittering Mynock. Bursthed was surprised to have his hand attacked by a slug-rat which had been placed in the cage in place of his mynock.

name: Slugh
summary: The Slugh were a gastropod sentient species.
distinctions: Gastropods, pedonculate eyes, evolutive muscular illness, electromechanical genius.

name: Sluissi
summary: The Sluissi were the indigenous sentient species of the planet Sluis Van, located in the Outer Rim Territories. While their bodies above the waist were humanoid, their lower halves were serpentine, long and heavily muscled. Sluissi were noted for their calm temperament; aversion to rushing and impatience; compliance to protocol, no matter how trivial; and technical aptitude. Like many reptiles, Sluissi could use their forked tongues to sense heat. Renowned for their ability to repair and maintain starships, the Sluissi were active in galactic society almost since the beginning of the Republic. This was because the Sluissi's technology was almost on par with other space-faring races such as Duros and Humans.

name: Slybex
summary: Slybex was a non-sentient species native to the swamps of the shadow world of Umbara. The four-legged species had a long tail and a large head, with tentacles on their faces and spikes on their backs that could be luminescent in adult specimen. Slybex greatly varied in size, from the small slybexan to the large Alpha Slybex, some were even big enough to ride as mounts. The Commander and Lana Beniko killed several slybex during the events of the Crisis on Umbara.
distinctions: Head with tentacles at the front and spikes on the back

name: Slygel
summary: Slygels were a type of soft-bodied invertebrate that resided in the orbit of the moon Toshara. They possessed gelatinous skin and fed on energy, such as that from starships and the energy cells of satellites. When slygels perished, they vaporized into a surge of bubbles and then faded.

name: Slyyyg
summary: Slyyygs were large carnivorous snail-like gastropods found in the forests of the planet Kashyyyk. They were simple minded and displayed no apparent signs of intelligence or emotions, only continuously hunting for food. They could emit a toxic sludge, which they could use to attack. Slyyyg had a long soft yellow body without any limbs with a slightly upright head at the front. On it's head it had two black and yellow horn-like appendages leading to their red-colored eyes and a mouth.

name: Smoke Demon
summary: Smoke Demons were a dark side manifestation that could be summoned through Sith sorcery. They could metamorphose into their targets' worst fears and sought to vaporize their bodies. At some point following the Battle of Yavin, the S'kytri Dark Jedi named Kharys used a Smoke Demon to murder the smuggler Katya M'Buele.

name: Smooka
summary: The smooka was a small, winged, non-sentient creature native to the planet Dagobah.

name: Smoza
summary: The smoza was a species of aggressive, carnivorous insect that resembled large, silver hornets.

name: Snail fish
summary: Snail fish were a type of fish that partially shared their name with snails, a type of creature with shells. Following the Republic Defense Coalition and the Jedi Order's attack on the Nihil's Lightning Crash space station in 228 BBY, Jedi Master Elzar Mann used his Jedi Vector's tractor beam to pull in one of the station's escape pods, reflecting that it was as easy as catching a snail fish from a tide pool.

name: Snap-crow
summary: Snap-crows were a type of crow that lived on the Outer Rim planet Valo. The crows could squawk to make high-pitched noises when disturbed. While on Valo in 229 BBY, Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram climbed the damaged exterior of the Valo Temple and accidentally put his hand on a nestled snap-crow, thinking the spot was a sturdy stone inlay. The small snap-crow pecked at Jomaram's hand and squawked indignantly, causing the Padawan to almost topple backward. After the bird voiced a few more high-pitched threats toward Jomaram, it flew away, leaving him to recollect himself.

name: Snapfish
summary: Snapfish was a species of fish that was native to the world of Haruun Kal. They typically preyed upon bottle bugs, leaping out of the water in which they lived to catch them.

name: Snarlap
summary: Snarlaps were a non-sentient long-necked feathered species native to the planet Ques.

name: Snarlok
summary: The Snarlok was a legendary creature among the people of Batuu. It was said to have constructed the Black Spire of Black Spire Outpost out of the corpses of misbehaving children, according to Grana, an elderly woman in a farming community, who told her grandson Dolin that the creature was real. Upon hearing of the Snarlok, Vi Moradi thought of the Naklor, a similar mythological creature that was said to be the cause of the Black Spire's creation.

name: Sneep
summary: Sneeps, also known as pishnes, were a species of non-sentient bird that were long-necked, soft-mouthed, feathered creatures that resembled a combination of avian and mollusk. They could be found in the galaxy thirty years after the battle of Endor. During his time on the planet Jakku, the Nu-Cosian Bobbajo carried several sneeps on his back. At one point, Bobbajo showed a traveling artist the sneeps he carried on his back and would speak to the birds as if to old friends.

name: Sneevel
summary: Sneevels were a fur-covered sentient species. Boles Roor was a Sneevel Podracer pilot from the world of Sneeve who competed in at least three Boonta Eve Classic Podraces, two of which the pilot had won. A more infamous Sneevel was the Garel City crime lord Skraik, who operated in the years before the Galactic Civil War.

name: Snivvian
summary: Snivvians, nicknamed Snaggletooths, were a species of sentient mammalian humanoids native to the planet Cadomai Prime. They had large mouths and short fangs. The winters on their home planet were long, harsh, and difficult to survive. During this time, the Snivvians spent their time in underground caverns in artistic pursuits. Some of the species escaped the icy tundras to become bounty hunters offworld. As a species they displayed great tracking skills, so were particularly suited to this work. Sol Charless, Geezum, Drix Gil, Katt Mol, Narb, Nod, Sinrich, Takeel, and Zutton were members of the species.
distinctions: Protruding lower jaw and large nostrils

name: Snogar
summary: Snogars were a tall, furry sentient species native to the ice-covered planet Ota in the Mid Rim. The Snogars were descended from a technologically advanced race referred to as the "Old Ones," who built cities within Ota's ice canyons. Over time the Snogars forgot how to use their ancestors' technology, and reverted to primitive lifestyles inside their ancient cities. By 1 ABY, that had resulted in a major crisis, as the Snogars were unable to power the heating machines that kept their homes habitable, threatening their way of life on their frigid homeworld.

name: Snomat
summary: A Snomat was a creature that lived in the swamp of The Green in Coronet City, Corellia. They emitted high pitched chirping noises.

name: Snook Uccorfay's species
summary: A sentient species of mole-like humanoids could be found on the planets Cantonica and Daiyu. Snook Uccorfay was a member of this species.
distinctions: Mole-like heads, radial flanges around snout

name: Snorbal
summary: Snorbals were grazing herd animals from the planet Lok. They were found among the arid wastelands of their homeworlds. Snorbal were highly intelligent and docile creatures, rarely attacking other than to defend their herd. Their trunk had two 'fingers' at the end, allowing them to manipulate simple objects. Snorbal had a highly efficient digestive system. The Snorbals were physically very similar to the thunes of Dantooine.

name: Snot-hopper
summary: Snot-hoppers were a type of nasty pest that could be found in the sewer tunnels of Capital City on Lothal when they were filled with water, along with pikobis, Loth-rats, and dianogas.

name: Snow Bear
summary: The Snow Bear was a white-furred predatory beast found on the ice planet Hoth.

name: Snow demon
summary: Snow demons were predatory creatures native to the planet Toola. They hunted mastmots and were in turn hunted by Whiphids. They had white claws, large teeth, hairy wings, and long purple tongues. Snow demons flew via a series of tubular bladders that were filled with methane gas to provide lift. Their wings were used primarily for propulsion.

name: Snow falcon
summary: The snow falcons were avian creatures native to the frigid planet Rhinnal, where they built eyries within glaciers. During the Galactic War, the endangered snow falcons of Rhinnal were considered a rare and prized delicacy, worth a small fortune to those willing to risk life imprisonment by hunting them. These creatures became extinct prior to the rule of the New Republic. The Holographic Zoo of Extinct Animals on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant dedicated an exhibition in honor of the extinct snow falcon, which gained widespread popularity among visitors.

name: Snow Mynock
summary: The Snow Mynock was a variant of the mynock, a silicon-based parasitical species often found within asteroid belts, that had found its way to the ice planet Hoth.

name: Snow owl
summary: Snow owls were a non-sentient type of owl that lived in the area surrounding the Appenza Peak mountain on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan. The avian creatures were known to reside in the knotholes of trees and could endure cold weather. In 3 BBY, the Apprentice Legislator Amilyn Holdo looked for snow owls while on a pathfinding excursion with her friends. The Alderaanian Apprentice Legislator Kier Domadi questioned his peer about why she was seeking the avians but eventually accepted her reasoning that there was no reason she should cease her search.

name: Snow shredder bat
summary: Snow shredder bats were a type of bat found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Gigor. They inhabited the caves that riddled the frigid world's mountains, which they shared with jexxel cats and sentient Gigorans, as well as edible mold and mushrooms that thrived around deep hot springs.

name: Snow slug
summary: Snow slugs were creatures native to Alzoc III. They would burrow a tunnel to the surface of the snow and open their cave-like mouths, waiting for unsuspecting prey to enter. They appeared to possess a large amount of body heat, seeing as their trails in the snow produced large amounts of steam.

name: Snow stork
summary: Snow storks were white-feathered avians from Berea.

name: Snowfeather bird
summary: Snowfeathers were a non-sentient Force-sensitive bird species found on the ice planet Ilum deep within the Unknown Regions.

name: Snowmouse
summary: Snowmice were small, rarely-seen, land-scavenging rodents native to the icy wilderness of the planet of Hoth.

name: Snutib
summary: The Snutib were a sentient species of mantid-like hunters that allied with the Killiks during the Swarm War.

name: Socorran granite-hawk
summary: The Socorran granite-hawk was a type of bird from the planet Socorro.

name: Soikan
summary: Soikans were a sentient species from the planet Soika. Tall in build and having pointed ears, they were divided into at least two groups, Gagics and Livtaks, both of which had distinctive colorations. White hair, silver skin and lilac eyes were typical for the Livtak. Velko Jahen, a member of the species, served aboard the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era.

name: Soka fly
summary: Soka flies were a type of buzzing fly that could travel in groups. After being wounded in a battle against the Nihil marauder organization at the Cyclor Shipyards in 231 BBY, Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar felt that everyone around him was constantly checking on his welfare, similar to soka flies swarming around.

name: Solif-spider
summary: A solif-spider was a species native to the planet Pasaana that could produce silk strands. Many of these silk strands were in the modified WTK-85A interstellar transport called the Bestoon Legacy.

name: Sollux
summary: The Sollux was a humanoid sentient species with frog-like features which the mysterious being Orphne belonged to.

name: Solodoe
summary: Solodoe were a sentient species.

name: Sommato bird
summary: Sommato birds were a type of bird found on the tropical planet Akiva, where they lived near large bodies of freshwater. Their scaly skin was gray on their back, head, and wings while the birds' underside was yellow and their feathers red. The birds also possessed black beaks, eyes, and feet, the latter of which had large webbing that made sommato birds excellent at swimming and diving.

name: Song serpent
summary: Song serpents were desert-dwelling snakes from Proxima Dibal. They were covered in iridescent feathers and had sets of vocal membranes which vibrated as they breathed. When viewed up close, they appeared to be singing. Sabodor's, an exotic pet store on Etti IV, sold song serpents to the planet's wealthier citizenry.

name: Song sparrow
summary: A song sparrow was a type of colorful sparrow endemic to the planet Coruscant. Ky Narec, a Jedi Knight, enjoyed feeding and watching song sparrows and crown finches fly around the Great Tree, located in the Jedi Temple training ground in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Around 23 BBY, Narec's voice told Sith apprentice Asajj Ventress that when he was off-world, he missed feeding the birds that lived in the Jedi Temple. Song sparrows were regularly seen to flutter around the Temple's Great Tree.

name: Songbird
summary: Songbirds were a type of bird. Around 228 BBY, as a drift of Jedi Vectors flew through the sky above the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, they swooped and dived like a flock of songbirds chiming through the air.

name: Songfish
summary: A songfish was a type of fish that was found in the streams of the planet Caamas. It was capable of producing an audible piping noise. Around 18 BBY, the Caamasi artist, Ves Volette, experienced a memnis while on the planet Coruscant. During the experience, he heard songfish in a stream near his hamlet in Jualya Village before the village was destroyed. The memnis was a vivid memory caused by many offworld Caamasi learning of the Galactic Empire's destruction of their homeworld.

name: Soo
summary: The Soo were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by the large sea beasts that dwelt there.

name: Sooman
summary: The Soomans were a sentient species of red insectoids indigenous to the planet Sooma, located in the Outer Rim Territories.

name: Soona Taj's species
summary: A near-human species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species were almost identical to humans, but had two hearts and had pink to fair-colored skin, white hair, black eyes and narrow, almost non-existent, black eyebrows. Soona Taj and their father and other parent were members of the species and lived on Kiranno. Another member of this species was present on the planet Janix sometime during or after 19 BBY.

name: Sorrusian
summary: Sorrusians were a Near-Human species from the planet Sorrus. They differed from baseline Humans in that their skeletal system could compress, allowing them to squeeze through tight places. Notable Sorrusians included the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.

name: Sortuvian brain moth
summary: Sortuvian brain moths were a type of carnivorous moth that consumed brains. When being pursued by TIE fighters, Han Solo claimed that boarding was unadvised due to escaped Sortuvian brain moths, but the TIE pilots were not fooled.

name: Sorumi
summary: The sorumi were a species of mammals. Female sorumi, known as a doe, were tall, slender, and were considered gracious and fast runners.

name: Sosear Latta's species
summary: [[File:Grock.png|thumb|Grock, a Koboh tradesman and mechanic.]] A sentient species of brown-skinned bipeds with appendages on the side of their heads lived in the galaxy. Members of that species included Grock and Sosear Latta.
distinctions: Appendages on the side of their heads

name: Souma
summary: The Souma were a species of sentient felines hailing from the planet Soum. Their whole bodies were covered with a thick coat of fur, and they had gentle, frank-looking eyes. The Souma species had a 1-to-5 male-to-female ratio. Compared to females, the male Souma were considered intellectually challenged. As such, they were usually relegated to menial tasks. The businesswoman Triaz Kirr, director of the Kirr Ltd. and co-founder of the Tlan-Kirr network during the Galactic Civil War, was a female Souma.

name: Southern Mustafarian
summary: Southern Mustafarians were one of the two subspecies of Mustafarians which evolved separately in underground caves. They worked together to collect valuable minerals from the lava flow and had a trade agreement with the Techno Union. Southern Mustafarians were stockier and stronger as well had more resistance against heat. They were burly and short, measuring 1.5 meters, and performed all physical tasks. They had tough, blaster-resistant skin, but still required protective armor to work near the lava of their volcanic habitat. Southern Mustafarians lived in groups known as clanholds. Father Kkkt, who also happened to be Force-sensitive, led one such clan. When Mustafar was rocked by the construction of Fortress Vader, Kkkt made contact with other clanholds and led an army to attack the castle.

name: Sowsquatch
summary: Sowsquatch was huge, barely tamed four-legged animal with sharp teeth. Kulltu Kutta rode a sowsquatch during battles in the Cauldron on Rattatak.

name: Space mite
summary: A space mite was a type of silicon-based arachnid that could reside in the vacuum of space. Space mites spent their youth living on mynocks as parasites. Once they reached maturity, the creatures detached from their hosts and would rapidly develop into their adult form, reaching about one meter in length. They would then spin hardened egg cases, into which they would lay up to a dozen eggs. During the Galactic Civil War, a group of space mites nested in the computer system of the damaged 3-Z light freighter Whisper, which was situated near to the planet Korad.

name: Spalexian
summary: The Spalexians were a sentient species were native to the planet Spalex. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Empire attempted to mine Spalex for its thorilide but were met with strong resistance from the native species. The species were eventually able to force the Empire offworld.

name: Spamel
summary: Spamels were blue- or purple-skinned, long-legged riding creatures native to the desert moon of Jedha. The beasts featured a thick neck that carried their wedge-shaped head. Standing up to 4.9 meters tall, spamel mounts were fitted with a saddle and a rope ladder for their rider to reach the back of the beast. The creatures were used as part of a parade held in Jedha City on the eve of the annual Reflection Day festival. In 9 BBY, Jedi Knight Cal Kestis and his companions, the Nightsister Merrin and the droid BD-1, mounted a spamel to reach the Hidden Path network's secret base on Jedha after Kestis used the Force to tame one of the beasts. During the Galactic Empire's occupation of Jedha, Imperial sandtroopers mounted spamels to traverse the moon's cold desert landscape and patrol pilgrimage routes to Jedha City. The beasts were also used by the surviving members of Saw Gerrera's rebel Partisans as well as Rebel Alliance members Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker while they were on a mission to locate and help the survivors on Jedha in 1 ABY, following the destruction of Jedha City by the Empire's Death Star battle station.

name: Sparadillo
summary: The sparadillo was a creature whose armored skin was used as a material for clothing. The frontman of the Guavian Death Gang, Bala-Tik, wore boots made of sparadillo armor.

name: Spark-roach
summary: Spark-roaches were a species that lived in a pit in Vader's castle. When the personal servant of Darth Vader, Vaneé, was imprisoned in the pit by his master, Vaneé relied on spark-roaches as his only companions and sustenance. In the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, as the Mustafarians Giggek and Tuttel freed him, Vaneé expressed his relief by thanking Locphet and revealing that he had only spark-roaches for food and company. Vader's servant further muttered that he found pleasure in devouring the creatures, to which Tuttel reacted with disgust.

name: Sparkfly
summary: Sparkflies were a type of bioluminescent fly that could be found on the Outer Rim planets Ab Dalis and E'ronoh. In 382 BBY, Jedi Knight Gella Nattai noticed incandescent sparkflies while in E'ronoh's royal palace. In 232 BBY, Garello Technologies' chief executive Larence Garello noticed a cloud-like haze in front of his company's ships as his employees fled Ab Dalis, comparing it to the flies' appearance.

name: Speagull
summary: Speagulls were birds native to the ocean planet Castilon.

name: Speckled versimillipede
summary: Speckled versimillipedes were a type of versimillipede that was found on the planet Khofar in the Outer Rim. Unlike other versimillipedes, the speckled versmillipede was poisonous.

name: Spice eel
summary: Spice eels were giant sand and rock burrowing worms native to Sevarcos II. Their average length was 15 meters, but some old specimens were known to grow beyond 30 meters in length and 5 meters in height. Their bodies were ridged with powerful sediments to facilitate their underground burrowing, while their mouths consisted of several molars allowing them to burrow through rock. In their early life stages they lived in the underground pools of Sevarcos, and after a series of metamorphoses at various stages in their life, they would take the shape of giant worms, burrowing through the porous substrata of Sevarcos II. They were blind and relied instead on pressure sensitive organs in their heads that allowed them to hear fairly well and to locate vibrations indicating potential meals. This made them very sensitive, and they were fairly easy to scare off with sonic detonators and other powerful explosives. Spice eels were often attracted to the activities in the Imperial spice mines on Sevarcos II, and it was not uncommon that spice eels wreaked havoc during such mining operations. Spice eels were hunted by the Human Sevari tribes for food.

name: Spice spider
summary: Spice spiders were members of a species of spider that could be found on Aaloth, Taul, and allegedly on Kessel. Their webs were pure glitterstim. At some point prior to the Battle of Takodana, a group of droids stranded on Taul were ambushed by a swarm of spice spiders. Security droid PZ-99 then sacrificed himself to save the rest of the droids, of which only one would make it off the planet. According to Fugas Fandita, the spiders in the Spice mines of Kessel were supposedly attracted to light and could sense motion and fed on unwary miners.

name: Spider crab
summary: The spider crab was a species of crustacean found on many worlds. They superficially resembled Jodakan needler crabs.

name: Spider-King
summary: Spider-King were a subspecies of the crystal web spiders. It was able to produce very strong and sticky webbings.

name: Spider People
summary: The Spider People were a sentient species native to the planet of Ord Cestus. They were most likely related to the Cave spiders that were still extant in more modern times. This species was quick to jump to conclusions. After losing to the X'Ting in a war, the Spider People were driven underground from the planet's surface into the underground caves of Ord Cestus.

name: Spiderbat
summary: Spiderbats were a species of bat that, like a spider, had eight legs. They could be found on the planet Coruscant and served as the inspiration for the Seventh Sister's use of seeker droids after a sparring session in which her rival Iskat Akaris used a swarm of spiderbats against her.

name: Spidercat
summary: The spidercat was a fur-covered insect that lived on the Inner Rim planet Tasariq. It had characteristics of both spiders and cats and had a venomous bite. The creature was bred by Tasariq's Tasari species for use as temple guardians when they were worshipping the local tasar crystals in the wake of their homeworld's devastation by a meteorite bombardment.

name: Spidery nightglider
summary: Spidery nightgliders were rare animals native to the planet Altarrn. Considered premium pets, they were sold at Sabodor's pet shop on the planet Etti IV.

name: Spika-wolf
summary: The spika-wolf was a species that was known to consume raw meat.

name: Spike-finned sounder
summary: Spike-finned sounders were fish found in the shallow seas of Kamino. Predators and scavengers, they could leap out of the water five meters and glide at least two dozen meters. Opportunists they were, they traveled in packs, following saberjowls and feeding of the larger creatures' leftovers. Their heads boasted a hanging appendage which detected changes in pressure or temperature, helping them find their prey. They were believed to have descended from Kaminoan-cloned b'tan flyers, a species originally from the bayous of Rodia. Sounders attacked Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker during the Battle of Kamino. Others of the species were attracted to the battle droids which were flushed into the sea during the battle.

name: Spike-sparrow
summary: A spike-sparrow was a type of sparrow that could be found on the Outer Rim world Elphrona during the High Republic Era. By 232 BBY, a spike-sparrow killed all but one member of a charhound pack on Elphrona. The survivor—a female puppy named Ember—then fought the spike-sparrow, ultimately crawling away from the fight. Around 228 BBY, Ember mentally recalled her fight with the spike-sparrow after it had killed her pack when she reflected on her life while on the Wild Space planet Sophros.

name: Spikeshell
summary: Spikeshells were common crustaceans native to the planet Ord Mantell. The species of spikeshell populating the coasts of Kessan's Landing were known to grow particularly large. Spikeshells were generally docile, but could defend themselves with large, sharp claws when threatened. The grip pressure of their claws could be strong enough to slice through durasteel. Spikeshells were a popular food source across Ord Mantell and a notable staple in Ardak Point. Often as the main ingredient in noodle dishes, or even served with only skycorn and kebroot, although this was ideally only when heavily seasoned. Strangely, spikeshells would stand on the shore with their claws raised into the air during certain nights of Ord Mantell's lunar cycle.

name: Spilesnark
summary: The spilesnark was a type of creature found on Endor, a forest moon in the Outer Rim Territories. During a particularly bleak winter on Endor between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick wished to leave his home in Bright Tree Village and see the snow covered forest, but he was confined to the village due to his age. Warrick's friend Teebo tried to cheer his friend up by claiming that the snow would soon thaw and then Warrick would be allowed to swing through the trees like a crazed spilesnark again.

name: Spine dragon
summary: The spine dragon was a type of creature. Tarl Sokoli, a war hero of the Galactic Empire, was known as the "Spine Dragon of Anaxes."

name: Spine spider
summary: Spine spiders were a species of spider native to the desert planet Pasher. The spiders possessed poison glands which had medical applications. Fayet Kelen chose to set up his business, Kelen Biolabs, locally on Pasher where he made large amounts of money from the medical applications of spine spider poison glands, as well as the glands of sandstone scorpions.

name: Spine-wolves
summary: Spine-wolves were a type of wolf that lived in a forest on the planet Serenno. As an infant, the Serennian Dooku was abandoned in that forest by his father, Gora. Gora contacted the Jedi High Council asking them if they could take his son away, and a Jedi seeker brought Dooku to the Jedi Temple. In 90 BBY, Dooku, who had become a Jedi Initiate, told fellow Initiate Sifo-Dyas of his findings that dangerous spine-wolves lived in that forest. Dooku also speculated that, if Gora had not abandoned him, he could have become much more than a Jedi. Dooku later recounted the incident to his sister Jenza via holo-letter. Around 23 BBY, Dooku showed his recently-recruited Sith assassin, Asajj Ventress, a holographic data disk detailing his conversation with Sifo-Dyas about the forest and its spine-wolves. After listening to the disk together, he gave her several more holo-letters for Ventress's investigation into Jenza's location.

name: Spined puc
summary: Spined pucs were an amphibian frog-like creature. Spined pucs and giant spined pucs were native to Yavin 4. Another race known as pug jumpers were native to Kashyyyk. Spined pucs were named for the spiny ridges along its back and sides that carried a powerful toxin capable of blinding its victim. Spined pucs had leathery hides.

name: Spined snake
summary: Spined snakes, also called spined vipers, were snakes native to Lok. They lived hiding among the rocks and sand of the deserts of their homeworld. These predator snakes had venomous spikes along the top ridge of its body and only hunted at daytime. Spined snakes existed in several sizes and varieties. Known variants included giant spined snakes, sandy spined snakes and spined snake recluses.

name: Spinefin
summary: Spinefin were a type of creature that was native to the planet Eiram. The species had silver skin along with fins and tentacles.

name: Spinefish
summary: Spinefish were a species of animal from the planet Vodran in the Vodran system of the Si'Klaata Cluster in Hutt Space. They lived in the stagnant rivers of their homeworld alongside the predatory dianoga and were caught by the native sentient species, the Vodran. The spinefish were caught by the Vodran during a primitive stage of the sentients history, at a time when they lived above the rivers in suspended thatched huts from which they hung down nets to entangle the spinefish swimming below. This practice was continued until as late as around 25,100 BBY.

name: Spiner
summary: Spiners were nearly-extinct bipedal sentient mammals with sharp quills. They were capable of hurling these with great speed and accuracy by flexing their muscles in a certain manner. Their native world, Worxer, was destroyed when its sun went supernova. The surviving population gradually became sterile for a lack of nutrients found exclusively in their home sector of Elrood.

name: Spintiri lynx
summary: Spintiri lynxes roamed the forests of the planet Spintir in packs.

name: Spiny bograt
summary: Spiny bograts were a species of rat that were native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah. While living in exile on Dagobah, Jedi Grand Master Yoda often found spiny bograts and various other swamp life coming through the door of his hut. He allowed all but the venomous creatures to stay and keep him company.

name: Spiran Firefly
summary: Spiran Fireflies were a species of firefly native to the planet Batuu. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised fireflies to become pets or for other reasons.

name: Spire falcon
summary: The spire falcon was a bird native to the planet Coruscant. It was at the top of the food chain of animals such as gully rats, grate toads, ferro-worms, and trantor pigeons.

name: Spiridian lizard
summary: Spiridian lizards were a type of lizard that could be eaten as food. By 382 BBY, during the High Republic Era, a meat trader sold seared Spiridian lizards in the Holy City on the Mid Rim moon Jedha. That year, the trader was bored and listed seared Spiridian lizards among the food items they had for sale as a group of wargaran creatures were loose in the city.

name: Spit-crawler
summary: Spit-crawlers were a type of parasitic worm that dwelt within the snouts of happabores. They existed as both greater and lesser nasal nesting spit-crawlers. Infections of the parasite in happabores could be treated with Happy-Bore Medicated Dewormer, a product produced by Galacti-Stok which contained Trestibinexocycline 5-Gamma, thlank oil, greel-root acid and forage products. Use of the dewormer on spit-crawlers was suggested in the instructions for the product.

name: Spitapillar
summary: A spitapillar was a creature native to Tatooine. Luke Skywalker encountered one inside a Jawa sandcrawler.

name: Spitscuttle
summary: The spitscuttle was a creature known to infest the starships of the Galactic Empire's fleets. They were similar in appearance to the scurrier, a creature from the planet Tatooine, though had no relation. Doctor Chelli Aphra used a spitscuttle in her plan to get revenge on her former associate Shrem, who she tricked into believing that a spitscuttle was a rare type of scurrier.

name: Splox
summary: A splox was a type of large, non-sentient insect native to the Outer Rim planet Bogano. Usually found in groups, splox were known to launch coordinated attacks against their prey. The insects were omnivorous, and they inhabited Bogano's wetlands and mesas.

name: Spor crawler
summary: Spor crawlers were small eight-centimeter-long poisonous insects native to the planet Nar Bo Sholla.

name: Spotlight sloth
summary: The spotlight sloth was a species found on the planet Dagobah. It shared its swampy habitat with such other creatures as the bogwing and the dragonsnake. Yoda's hut contained a rug made of spotlight sloth fur.

name: Spotted ice phoenix
summary: A spotted ice phoenix was a type of phoenix. During the High Republic Era, Nihil General Abediah Viess had an office in her manor on the planet Sarumo furnished with the spotted pelt of one of the creatures. In 228 BBY, when Jedi Master Porter Engle snuck into the office, he noticed the pelt spread across the room's tile floor, and felt that the decor represented the trappings of wealth.

name: Spotted jugadoo
summary: The spotted jugadoo, also known as jugaloo, was a species of multicolored elephantine creatures native to the planet Dandelo, from the Dandelo system.

name: Spotted spider
summary: Spotted spiders were a type of giant spider. During the High Republic Era, the Jedi youngling Kildo put a jar of the spiders inside the Jedi Master Eicho's bag when he returned to the Outer Rim planet Valo's Jedi temple. Eicho left the temple shortly afterward until he could recover from the incident. In 229 BBY, after the Jedi youngling Gavi told Padawan Ram Jomaram about the spotted spider incident, Kildo defended himself by saying the Master had deserved it for speaking rudely to his friend—the Jedi youngling Tep Tep—after she had brought a rathtar named Bubbles into the temple not long before that occasion.

name: Sprantal
summary: The sprantal was an amphibian native to the planet Dathomir. Sprantal were massive amphibians with thick hides, long legs, and longer necks. They were typically a deep mottled-green color that helped camouflage them, particularly underwater. Their four strong legs were able to raise their stout bodies three meters off the ground. Sprantals possessed a four-meter long, rope-like neck which ended in a head with three large, globe-like eyes in a triangular arrangement on top and one eye below a fang-filled mouth, giving them a 360-degree view around their head. When a sprantal hid underwater, their heads were just under the surface, allowing their eyes to remain above the water to watch for potential prey and enemies. These predators typically ambushed their prey while they were drinking from a sprantal's pond, but sometimes they attacked prey walking past. The additional, forward-facing eye below their wide, toothy mouth allowed them to see underwater as well as giving them a better view when attacking prey. Their stout bodies were approximately three to four meters long and half again as wide. Their necks could extend in a highly flexible manner, allowing sprantals standing at full height to attack creatures everywhere except directly to the rear.

name: Spukami
summary: Spukami were a common breed of Corellian housecats that hunted vermin. The Fed-Dub Protective Services Spukami pocket blaster, manufactured on the nearby Corellia system worlds of Talus and Tralus, was named after the species.

name: Spydr
summary: The spydr was an insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. The meat of the spydr was thought to be a delicacy in some cultures. The ghost spider was one spydr species. One spydr was encountered by Darth Maul in the caverns beneath a Bartokk fortress on Ralltiir.

name: Squall
summary: A squall was a type of rodent that could be found on the moon Endor. In 4 ABY, while in a forest on Endor, the Ewok shaman Logray sensed the many life forms around him, including the life presence of a pack of squalls carving out a fresh burrow.

name: Squall
summary: Squalls were small lagomorphs that inhabited the planets of Endor and Chandrila.

name: Squalris
summary: Squalrises were a species of sentient, yellow-skinned humanoids indigenous to the planet Ifmix VI in the Colonies region. The Squalris anatomy was characterized by a corpulent frame, bristly hair garnishing the face, and a rounded crest running the length of the skull. The quest for fortune and social standing was the driving factor in the Squalris psyche. This led Squalrises to become formidable businessbeings and dealmakers. The species had a natural proclivity for charisma and sociability, which aided such deals. They tended to prefer ostentatious attire that marked the wearer's wealth and status. Ifmix VI became part of the galactic community in the earliest days of the Galactic Republic, and the blazing of the Perlemian Trade Route in the region allowed Squalris merchants to spread beyond the Ifmix system to ply their trade. One such merchant was Sanglui, who opened an import–export business on Vorzyd V in the Outer Rim Territories. With the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War, Sanglui joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic and secretly used his prominent position to aid the Rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
distinctions: Rotund build, thick skin, bristly growths on face

name: Squamatan
summary: The Squamatans were a sentient species of humanoids notable for their blue skin and acidic venom. They were enslaved under the Galactic Empire to assist in acquiring thorilide minerals from their homeworld.

name: Squark-bat
summary: Squark-bats were a type of bat. In 4 ABY, the Pantoran public relations representative of the New Republic Senate Olia Choko was interviewed in Hanna City on the planet Chandrila by reporter Tracene Kane of the Queen of the Core Network. When Kane asked Choko if she was ready to begin the interview, the Pantoran hestitated with a strained smile on her face and looked like a panicked squark-bat frozen in the beam of a miner's headlamp before signaling that she was ready.

name: Squib
summary: {{Update|Choose Your Destiny: A Smuggler Mission, , The High Republic (2023) 8}} The Squib were a sentient species. SquibLabs was a corporation managed by Squibs that produced grabbers, a device used for cheating at sabacc.

name: Squidge
summary: Squidge was the insulting name given by the Vindar to the race of beings they oppressed. They were diminutive blue creatures with elongated skulls and wavy black patterns on their skin. They spoke a primitive form of Basic and were organized under "den mothers". Long after the death of Luke Skywalker, two Squidge, Remoh and Otalp, found a broken C-3PO, known to them as the storyteller, in a cave. When Otalp was killed by the Vindar, Remoh picked up a lightsaber he found in the droid's wreckage and determined to bring hope to his people again.
distinctions: Wavy black patterns on skin, short height
language: Primitive dialect of Galactic Basic Standard

name: Squill
summary: The squill was a large carnivorous creature native to the planet of Tatooine.

name: Squollyhawlk
summary: Squollyhawlks were massive worm-like creatures native to Arorua. One nearly killed Obi-Wan Kenobi during his visit there in 44 BBY. A false face located on top of the squollyhawlk's head was meant to make its prey believe that it was a smaller creature hiding in the foliage. It would then ambush the unsuspecting prey. Squollyhawlks were vulnerable to having their mandibles smashed; if this happened, they would be unable to eat and would die.

name: Squork
summary: Squork was a rare species of fast lizards that lived on both land and water.

name: Srifly
summary: Sriflies were a type of fly found on Kashyyyk.

name: Sriluurian butterfly
summary: Sriluurian butterflies were a type of butterfly from the planet Sriluur.

name: Srrors'tok
summary: The Srrors'toks were a sentient species of fur-covered, fanged, anthropomorphic felinoids native to the planet Jankok in the Bozhnee sector. They had a mostly non-technological society of hunters, characterized by their stern concept of honor and their life debts.
