A Srrors'tok could be indentured to any being, which led some Srrors'toks to leave their homeworld to travel with an alien who had saved their lives. Such was the case with Tyionsis Cex and Ahnjai Rahmma, two Srrors'toks who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
hairColor: Golden, yellow, or gray with shades of brown

name: Ssi-ruu
summary: The Ssi-ruuk , Ssi-ruu in singular form, were a saurian species that invaded from the Unknown Regions of the galaxy and initiated the Invasion of Bakura in 4 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Endor. This race relied on a technology called entechment that involved extracting the life-energies of sentient beings and using them as power sources for their mechanical technology. They had a sizable war fleet and ruled an empire called the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium in the Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster near the galaxy's rim. Ssi-ruuvi society was deeply compartmentalized—being dominated by a rigid caste system based on skin color which signified one's socio-economic standing. As a species, most Ssi-ruuk were xenophobic towards members of other species due to their stringent religious beliefs and the compartmentalized state of their society. Due to the remote position of their home territory in the Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster and their religious fear of dying on an unconsecrated world, few Ssi-ruuk traveled outside their Star Cluster. Thus, they remained largely unknown to the rest of the galaxy, and contact with outsiders was limited even in the days of the New Republic and the Galactic Alliance.

name: Ssither
summary: The Ssither were a species of sapient snakes indigenous to Jatee. They were relocated to Butler's Cove when their homeworld was destroyed by its sun going supernova.

name: Ssori
summary: The Ssori were a sentient species of diminutive size, who were typically seen in mechanical suits to compensate for their stature.

name: Ssurian
summary: Ssurians (or great dragons) were major reptilian predators on the planet Dathomir. Their hides were so thick and their teeth so sharp that most creatures would simply avoid them rather than fight. The Scream of the Ssurian, a powerful Nightsister spell, allowed its caster to reproduce the great dragon's hunting call and territorial warning. Like all reptiles, the Ssurians were cold-blooded vertebrates.

name: Stacchati
summary: The Stacchati were a sentient species. The CZ-series secretary droids CZ-1 and CZ-3 once served members of the species and were modified from standard models to more closely resemble their masters. The changes included alterations to their photoreceptors to give them an appearance similar to that of Stacchati eyes. The two droids were no longer in the species' service after being abandoned following a crash on the planet Tatooine at some point by 1 BBY.

name: Staga
summary: Staga were large, horned animals native to the planet Ambria. They were transported to the planet Taanab as a farm stock along with other creatures during the settlement of the planet as an agricultural outpost in 2320 BBY, where they were found in the pens of the meat-processing plants near the temperate poles. Staga meat was used in the dish Salted Staga-Sub.

name: Staglint
summary: The Staglints were a blue-skinned sentient species with twenty arms.

name: Stalaat
summary: The stalaats were creatures living in caves of the rocky planet Rex Strata. Kai Brightstar, Zia Zaldor Zanna, and Ace Kallisto encountered two of them when their shuttle crashed into a cave.

name: Stalker lizard
summary: The stalker lizard was a reptile native to the planet of Dantooine. Possessing a purple-blue skin color and moving relatively low to the ground, the animal perfectly matched the color of the native grasses, making it a stealthily-camouflaged pack-predator. They dined on nettars in the early morning and evening, and could grow to over three meters in length.

name: Stalking bird
summary: The stalking bird was a species of flightless reptavian predator with long neck and legs native to the planet Alderaan. They were known to flush out their prey by walking together in formation, spearing animals as they fled the grass before them. Unfortunately, the species became extinct when Alderaan was destroyed by the first Death Star.

name: Stalking onsonker
summary: A stalking onsonker was (allegedly) a species of ambulatory, plantlike carnivore. Vilmarh Grahrk had a pet of the species, named "Fluffy." Grahrk claimed he had infected Bobo with Fluffy's spores. According to Vilmarh Grahrk, the babies would grow out of Bobo's stomach. Fluffy sniffed out Bobo by the scent of her young, and, to brood the babies within her, ate Bobo. Many beings had never heard of such a beast and doubted the species existed.

name: Staplarint
summary: The staplarint was an arboreal omnivore. Staplarints were introduced to the planet Brosi by Republic settlers. Once repulsorlift technology began to receive widespread use, the staplarints' usefulness ended. Many staplarints escaped and became wild. In the time of the Galactic Empire, they had spent centuries in the wilds of Brosi. However, around 2 ABY, the Brosin Underground managed to tame a few staplarints and used them as mounts.

name: Star-locust
summary: Star-locusts were insects that could live in the vacuum of space. The Ridadi were a species of star-locust that were known to migrate through interstellar space in giant swarms.

name: Starfish
summary: The starfish was a species of creature that inhabited Lake Paonga on the planet Naboo. Starfishes had light orange skin and five limbs.

name: Stargerm
summary: Stargerms were aquatic animals native to Dagobah. These creatures jumped out of the water to grab prey, and then returned to the water to consume them.

name: Starklebird
summary: Starklebirds, also known as just starkles, were a type of carnivorous, migratory bird found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Saleucami. Flocks of starklebirds took shelter in greater cake trees, filling their many layers. In 4 ABY, a group of starklebirds migrated east near enough to the Taffral house on Saleucami that their chatter-sounds could be heard by the Taffral family inside as they ate dinner together. The two sons of the family, Dav Taffral and Webb Taffral, had chosen opposing sides on the ongoing Galactic Civil War to each other and began arguing about the conflict over the meal. Their father, Glen Taffral, compared their bickering to a group of starklebirds fighting over who got to eat the first and last worms and claimed that they both should have chosen family over either side.

name: Starlow
summary: Starlows were a species that lived on the planet Corellia. They gathered in flocks on the rooftops of Coronet City. Starlows were named after their brown feathers, which sparkled in the streetlights of the city, giving them the appearance of starlight when they took flight.

name: Starweird
summary: Starweirds were an ancient species of semi-corporeal spirits that resonated with the Force and were considered a great and terrible power. Tall, thin, almost skeletal in appearance, and with pale skin, Starweirds had blazing eyes, long white hair, long arms that ended in three-fingered sharp claws, and long legs. Overall, they were regarded as a terrifying species.

name: Stathas
summary: A stathas was a sleek, venomous reptile native to the Mandalore system, located in the region of the galaxy known as the Outer Rim. The stathas was known to use its seemingly harmless appearance to hide its deadly capabilities.

name: Stauz Czycz's species
summary: This alien race were tall, muscular beings with orange skin, three-fingered hands, five green eyes, and a large, triangular head with snakelike tendrils in place of hair. Their homeworld was razed by the Empire. Stauz Czycz was a member of this species.
distinctions: Snake-like tendrils in place of hair

name: Stava
summary: The stava was a quadruped carnivore on Honoghr that had good endurance. It was rendered extinct after the contamination of the planet during the Battle of Honoghr in the Clone Wars. The native Noghri named a martial art after the stava. There was also an expression used by the Noghri about arguments, that something was being fought over like "a bone among hungry stava."

name: Steel-boring beetle
summary: Steel-boring beetles were a type of beetle found in the iron jungles of the planet Ylagia's eastern continent. In the first year of the Empire's reign after its formation in 19 BBY, the former resident of Ylagia Soujen Vak-Nhalis heard the metallic murmur of steel-boring beetles in the jungles below him while he was on a mountainside on the world.

name: Steel-tailed stalker
summary: Steel-tailed stalker was a predatory subspecies of Tarisian Bogstalker that rapidly evolved on the planet Odessen after being transplanted there. The creature evolved a plasteel-like barb at the end of its tail, which Doctor Juvard Illip Oggurobb deemed enough to classify it as a new breed.

name: Steelee
summary: Steelees were a species of quadrupedal riding mounts found on the rocky planet Elphrona. They had silver skin and duralloy hooves, which sparked when they made contact with Elphrona's metallic surface and produced an organomagnetic field that allowed the creatures to lock their feet in place. Steelees could also be tamed using the Force, in which a Force-sensitive could connect with the creature to calm it and communicate. The Blythe family owned a herd of several steelees at their homestead on Elphrona. When members of the Nihil marauder organization kidnapped the Blythes, the raiders stole some of the family's steelees in order to transport the prisoners back to their starships. After being alerted to the raid, the Jedi stationed at the nearby Jedi Order outpost took the remaining steelees to pursue the Nihil. During the pursuit, the steelee rode by Jedi Master Porter Engle was killed by one of the Nihil, but the Jedi managed to almost catch up to the raiders, destroying one of their two vessels.

name: Steelpecker
summary: Steelpeckers were a non-sentient species of nocturnal carrion bird that could be found on the planets Jakku and Ferrix. The birds were ragged and mangy in appearance, with scraggly black feathers. They had strong beaks and talons that were tipped with iron and sharpened on scrap. They fed mainly on metal, to which they were drawn by its magnetic signature. To digest the metal they consumed, steelpeckers stored vanadium, osmiridium, and corundum in their gizzards. Named for their diet, these birds were useful commodities to scavengers, who collected their carcasses and guano.
habitat: Sand dunes and rock outcrops near wreckage

name: Steep
summary: The steep were a species of non-sentient amphibians native to the planet Metellos. Possessing ten-centimeter-thick skin, they dwelt in the sewage-filled seas of the planet, bobbing on the surface of the waters. At night, the carnivorous steeps wandered the alleyways of Metellos' settlements, searching for children to eat.

name: Stellan
summary: The Stellan were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim planet Stellan. A fiercely isolationist but peaceful race, the Stellan maintained that tranquility by abandoning children that they identified as too aggressive. Those children, such as Jeigh Esse, were launched into space. Esse herself was discovered by Rodians and followed in their trade as a bounty hunter.

name: Stenax
summary: The Stenax were a fierce, ill-tempered, brooding, and violent race from the planet of Stenos. They fanatically followed the dictates of their god, Vol. They were responsible for the Stenax Massacres, which killed countless millions. Despite their violence, the Stenax remained a very spiritual people.

name: Stennes
summary: Stennes were a Near-Human sentient species from the planet Stennaros. A Force-sensitive offshoot of their species, the Stennes Shifters, were subject to millennia of persecution that led to many Stennes also being killed. As a result, the Stennes also persecuted the Shifters, and were a xenophobic species that avoided outside contact, but were socially and culturally advanced within their native Stennaros system.

name: Stennes Shifter
summary: The Stennes Shifters were a sentient species that had an innate ability to use the Force to pass invisibly through crowds and were typically hyper-wary of strangers. They could have tan skin and brown hair. Known members of the species included Trinto Duaba and Braconnor Bakiska.

name: Stereb
summary: The Stereb were the tall, primitive natives of Serroco. They built the Stereb cities and had low technology.

name: Stillsail
summary: The stillsail was a type of membranous creature that lived in the Stratos Distribution, a vast Unknown Regions corridor of dust, asteroids made up of ice and mineral-rich rock, and forests of crystalline comet fronds. The stillsails measured more than a hundred thousand kilometers across, and they shared their habitat with predatory lightning-jacks and asteroid-burrowing wormlike chewers, the latter of which were evolutionarily related to the sentient Lugubraa species that also originated in the Stratos Distribution.

name: Stiltwalker
summary: Stiltwalkers were quadrupedal amphibious insectivores that inhabited the swamps of a large number of the galaxy's planets.

name: Sting insect
summary: Sting insects could be found on the planet Danos V. The insects were large compared to other similar species found in the galaxy, growing up to the size of a house.

name: Sting-snake
summary: Sting-snakes were guard animals on Tasariq.

name: Stinger fish
summary: Stinger fish were aquatic creatures native to the planet Sedri. They were jellyfish-like creatures with suction cups that stung upon contact. The sting was not life-threatening, but was irritating and annoying. A large number of stinger fish in one place could cause confusion and panic. Karak's renegades released a large number of stinger fish into the Fitsay marketplace as part of their raid on the city in an effort to secure coral from the Golden Sun.

name: Stinging blue butterfly
summary: Stinging blue butterflies were a type of blue butterfly that migrated and could sting. During the High Republic Era, the young Hutt Churo recorded the migration patterns of stinging blue butterflies. When his elders learned that Churo would rather record the butterflies' migration patterns than feed traitors to their pet rathtars, they sighed in disappointment. In 228 BBY, during a mission to the planet Mynos III, Churo mentally resolved to make his family proud so that they would no longer be disappointed in his preference for recording the migration patterns of stinging blue butterflies.

name: Stinging midge
summary: Stinging midges were small creatures that lived in the jungles of D'Qar, near the Resistance base. Rose Tico was a wary of them.

name: Stinkfish
summary: Stinkfish were sea creatures native to the planet Sedri. The stinkfish exuded a poison as a form of defence that could render individuals unconscious.

name: Stintaril
summary: Sintaril were a species of rodent native to the moon Yavin 4. They hunted in packs in the giant Massassi trees found on their homeworld and there overwhelmed roosting whisper birds.

name: Stone crab
summary: Stone crabs were small creatures living near the water. They could disguise themselves as rocks thanks to their rock-like shells. In 9 ABY, Grogu interacted with the crabs on a planet.

name: Stone flea
summary: Stone fleas were a type of flea found in the sea caves of an island on the planet Bal'demnic in the Outer Rim's Auril sector. The skura that nested on the island during the High Republic Era ate stone fleas and formants in the sea caves.

name: Stone mite
summary: Stone mites were a stone-and-metal-eating species of non-sentient insect that originated on the planet Coruscant before spreading to various locations across the galaxy. The mites lived in trios that shared a single central shell, with each mite's head emerging from a different corner and a feeler-tail capable of delivering an electric shock located between each pair of heads. An undetected stone mite infestation during the Orleon Belt Grand Slalom Finals resulted in several racers and their vehicles being devoured while the event was being broadcast live across the galaxy. During the Galactic Civil War, stone mites also infested the Millennium Falcon, a YT-1300 light freighter piloted by Captain Han Solo and the Wookiee Chewbacca, who were forced to remove the infestation and repair the damage it caused.

name: Stoneray
summary: Stonerays were a species of flying reptavian carnivores native to Yavin 4. Living in swamps and jungles, they used their taloned tails to disembowel their prey. Seeing them hunt in this way was especially horrifying at night under the red glow of Yavin Prime which caused the stone rays to appear as if covered in blood.

name: Storm beast
summary: The storm beasts were large reptilian creatures twisted by the dark side of the Force, that lived on the world of Malachor V. They had several abilities, including being able to emit a wave of destructive sonic energy and enhanced strength.

name: Storm-hair
summary: The Unknown Regions warlike species known to the insectoid Quesoth as the Storm-hairs emerged from an Unknown Regions planet, led by the brutal Storm-hair Warlord Nuso Esva, and ravaged Unknown Regions and Wild Space. By 0 ABY, Nuso Esva's realm had expanded its reign—considered a reign of terror—to the Galactic Empire's fringes.

name: Strak
summary: The Straks were a sentient species native to the Expansion Region planet Teya IV.

name: Strang's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Strang was a member of the species.

name: Strega
summary: Strega were a type of harrier bird with blunt beaks that were roughly the size of dogs. They were capable of being powerful hunters and could be trained when motivated properly. By 5 ABY, the Imperial Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck had several trained strega, which he kept in iron kennels. That year, after Tolruck had captured the New Republic operative Jom Barell, he held the man in one of the cages he used for his strega. When the man's colleague—the former loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus—came to rescue him, disguised as an Imperial officer, the Grand Moff brought Barell out in the strega kennel he was being held in. As Velus noticed his teammate's injuries, he also reflected on the attributes of the birds that Tolruck owned and kept in enclosures.

name: Striber
summary: Stribers were an aquatic species originally native to Julsujod III. The Stribers relocated to the water-covered planet Iskalon to escape a cataclysm that struck their homeworld around five millennia before the Galactic Civil War, and became a part of the Iskalonian School, a cultural group of several aquatic species that had traveled to Iskalon with the aid of spacefaring benefactors. Blue-skinned and telepathic, Stribers were known as very slow to react when addressed, as they preferred to carefully examine all aspects of a situation before acting. By the Galactic Civil War, the Stribers were the rarest species among the School, and biologists estimated that they would die out completely within the next few generations.

name: Strill
summary: Strills were a type of creature with thick brown fur during winter. The Mandalorian known as the Armorer wore a mantle of thick winter strill fur over her armor while living in a secret covert on the planet Nevarro in 9 ABY. She continued wearing the fur after moving to the Glavis Ringworld, then a world with no name, and then the planet Mandalore.

name: Striped canth
summary: Striped canths were a type of marine fish found on the ocean moon of Kef Bir. The group of human First Order deserters known as Company 77 fished for striped canths and blubs as a food source using sea skiffs. The raging seas in which they fished teemed with shoals of both creatures and on a productive day of fishing the group could fill their two skiffs. Back on land, the fishers baked their catch over fires, harvesting what they killed efficiently and collecting other materials as well as meat.

name: Stromma
summary: The Stromma were a strong-willed sentient species from the planet Oristrom in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy.

name: Strutter
summary: Strutters were a species of sentient avians. Members of the species had svelte bodies with blue legs and beaks, and long arms with dexterous hands. A group of them inhabited the Strutter village on the Forest Moon of Endor, where they used mirrors to admire themselves as they groomed their pink and yellow plumage. Strutters placed great importance on trendiness and style and did not refrain from critiquing the comportment of others. This behavior made them seem extremely vain to members of other species and earned the avians a reputation for silliness. In 3 ABY, a strange figure appeared in the Strutter village and offered them a totem pole, emphasizing its cutting-edge flair. The Strutters eagerly accepted the gift, but in reality, the object was made up of a group of beings who had been enslaved by the peddler. In the night, the peddler activated them via a magic ring and ordered them to rob the village. However, a pair of Ewoks foiled the burglary and saved the Strutters' possessions.
distinctions: Twin tufts of yellow feathers on head; extreme vanity

name: Stunfinn
summary: A stunfinn was a deadly blood-red, long-fanged aquatic creature native to the Colonies world of Balmorra. The stunfinn's organs produced a powerful electric discharge to stun its prey. In 23 BBY, bounty hunter Jango Fett was confronted by a stunfinn that had been strategically positioned by Rigorra the Hutt in the warlord's hazardous subterranean "Impromptu Semiannual Balmorra Death Run" competition. While Fett was sure his flight suit would protect him from such a shock as the stunfinn might produce, he was more concerned about the effect an electrical discharge might have on his helmet's sensors. Notwithstanding, Fett was able to jaw-wound the creature with a gauntlet dart before it could inflict any damage.

name: Subteroth
summary: The subteroth was a bipedal non-sentient species native to Makeb. Subteroths typically lived in deep underground caverns, and hunted using scent and the crest on the back of their head, a hypersensitive organ that picks up the electromagnetic fields of a prey's heartbeat and transmits it directly to their nervous system. When their native planet was invaded by the Hutt Cartel in 3638 BBY, the subsequent mining of Isotope-5 caused ground-quakes that drove the subteroths out of their normal hunting grounds and toward the surface. [[File:Subteroth.0001.png|thumb|left|250px|A gigantic female Subteroth on Oricon]] In the last stages of the Dread War, several Makeb predators were taken to the Oricon moon where they were used in the defense of the Dread Masters. Among them were the Subteroths who were corrupted and tasked with guarding the Dread Fortress. Two gigantic Subteroths could be found in the Dread Cavern area north of the Dread Fortress. In the Dread Fortress itself, packs of smaller Subteroths patrolled its corridors and attacked any intruders; however, these creatures were altered in such a way so as to explode when slain.

name: Suerton
summary: The Suerton were a sentient reptilian species that lived in the galaxy. An eerily lucky species, the Suertons allegedly had the ability to subconsciously affect probability. The brothers Dodibin, Thodibin, and Wodibin were all Suertons from Chanceuxi.

name: Sugati
summary: Sugatis were large creatures native to the planet Otavon XII with characteristics similar to a rancor or balyeg. Their skin was resistant to lightsaber attack, but they were just barely smart enough to be influenced by Jedi mind tricks. During the early years of the New Order, the Ovoni rebels on Otavon XII found a way to attract a Sugati to cause it to attack Imperial troops via a sound emitter, a tactic they used to great effectiveness in the destruction of Tremor Base.

name: Sugi
summary: The Sugis were a species that earned a reputation as being among the best arms dealers in the galaxy. Sugi were short bipeds, some of whom wore armored powersuits that provided them with four large legs and a segmented, barb-tipped abdomen. Because of this, some people, including the Imperial officer Wilhuff Tarkin, mistook them for an insectoid species. A group of Sugi arms dealers operated on Utapau during the Clone Wars. They were all dressed in powersuits save for their leader, Endente, who was also the only Sugi amongst the group who spoke or understood Galactic Basic Standard, along with Chong. The Sugi arms dealers were in possession of a massive kyber crystal that the Confederacy of Independent Systems wished to purchase.
height: Less than half than that of a Sugi "powersuit"

name: Suiraon
summary: Suiraons were a lizard-like humanoid species. They were a cold blooded species requiring the heat of native area to survive. Their eyes were snake like and their tongues were forked.

name: Sulfur mynock
summary: Sulfur mynocks were a subspecies of the parasitic mynock that lived on the arid Outer Rim planet Lok. Contrary to regular mynocks, the sulfur mynocks lived in an atmosphere and had two horns on their head. Variants included the Riverside sulfur mynock and Sulfur pool mynock.

name: Sulituan
summary: Sulituans were a species with nautilus-like heads and shells with long tentacles that served as arms and legs. They lived on Archae Teuthis. The Podracer Tzidik Wrantojo was a Sulituan.

name: Sullustan
summary: Sullustans were a species of humanoids that hailed from the planet of Sullust, and were experts at manufacturing, scientific and technological development, and economics, having founded the prosperous SoroSuub Corporation.
distinctions: Two flaps of jowls around their cheeks, mouse-eyed

name: Sullustan ash-rabbit
summary: The Sullustan ash-rabbit was a species of ash-rabbit found on the planet Sullust. While on "Graf-World," a Wild Space planet, Milo Graf encountered an ash-rabbit, which he likened to a Sullustan ash-rabbit.

name: Summa-verminoth
summary: Summa-verminoth were a gigantic, space-faring species of legend that dwelled in the Akkadese Maelstrom around the planet Kessel. With numerous eyes and electrified tentacles that they used to ensnare prey, summa-verminoth were often misunderstood creatures. In 10 BBY, after the Raid on Kessel, Beckett's gang accidentally awakened a summa-verminoth in the Maelstrom, whilst aboard the Millennium Falcon. Han Solo, the ship's pilot at the time, endured a chase with the creature until he lured it into the Maw gravity well using the Falcon escape pod. The Maw's gravitational pull tore the skin from the summa-verminoth's skeleton before the creature was destroyed entirely.

name: Sumria
summary: The Sumrias were a sentient species hailing from the Lol system, a part of the Lol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Members of the Sumrian thought-caste had hands with four digits, and as a result the species developed a base-eight measuring system that went on to serve as the basis for the development of Df, a parameter characterizing the combat performance of military artillery. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the contribution of the Sumrias to the development of Df was mentioned in a compilation of Imperial documents made by Rebel Alliance historian Major Arhul Hextrophon for Alliance Supreme Commander Mon Mothma and other Rebel officers.

name: Sun beetle
summary: Sun beetles were large insects that were the size of banthas that lived on the world of Kubindi and raised by the native Kubaz. They were considered beasts of burden in the past until such duties were taken over by droids and other forms of machines. Wild sun beetles would duel each other by locking pincers and pulling against each other until one combatant was able rip the other's pincer from the socket. Among some criminal circles, there existed staged sun beetle fights, but these were considered illegal. Sun beetles were generally slow, passive, and considered to be feeble.

name: Sun-lizard
summary: The Sun-lizard or Tralusian sun-lizard was a reptile that inhabited the planet Tralus in the Corellian system. They had the ability to regenerate both their limbs and their tail. They could be domesticated as pets and live in cages.

name: Sun snake
summary: A sun snake was a type of snake. Around 160 BBY, the Jedi Knight Indara was captured during a mission on the planet Ruathi and forced to fight in an arena against a gheriol, a creature with a long sinuous body, six legs, and a black pelt. Upon seeing the creature, Indara thought that it looked like a cross between a tooka cat and a sun snake.

name: Sunesi
summary: The Sunesi were a species of sentient amphibian humanoids native to the planet Monor II. Capable of breathing their world's toxic air, the species was noted for their early metamorphosis they underwent during adolescence.

name: Sungwa
summary: Sungwas were massive, doglike pack scavengers native to the bog moon of Bogden. Resembling a nightmarish cross of wolf and weasel, they were quadrupedal creatures with yellow skin covered in golden fur and a pair of red eyes. A pack of sungwas inhabited an abandoned freighter marooned in one of the moon's swamps that became a base of the pirate Gir Kybo Ren-Cha. After imprisoning Gerin Toda, the daughter of Lord Malameu Toda, aboard the starship, Ren-Cha attempted to use the pack to dissuade her from escape her cell. Despite this, Toda was able to fight off the sungwas with the help of Jann Tosh and C-3PO, who, along with Jessica Meade and R2-D2, were sent by King Mon Julpa of Tammuz-an to liberate Toda, while R2 led away the pack and manipulated them into attacking Ren-Cha, who was pursuing the trespassers through the moldering ship's bowels.

name: Sunrise peacock
summary: Sunrise peacocks were a type of peacock. While in the San Tekka manor on the planet Coruscant in 228 BBY, the physicist Xylan Graf wore a long salmon-colored jacket featuring a scalloped style. Upon seeing him approach, Jedi Master Avar Kriss mentally reflected that his ensemble had enough ruffles for a dozen sunrise peacock fans.

name: Supply beast
summary: Supply beasts were a terrestrial species of creature utilized by the Galactic Republic's clone troopers during the Clone Wars. They had black eyes, brown skin, a long face, and a shell on their back. The beasts were also equipped with technology on their shells. At one point, four supply beasts were accompanied by four clone troopers as they traversed a grassy landscape.

name: Sur-avka
summary: Sur-avka were a species of flying creatures native to Polyneus. New Republic pilot Wyl Lark grew up riding sur-avka on Polyneus, giving him the ability to fly starfighters. They had down feathers, leathery skin, and an unpleasant odor.

name: Surakkean peacock
summary: A Surakkean peacock was a type of peacock originating from the Surakkea system in the Mid Rim Territories. In 3 ABY, when the Lepi businessman Jaxxon T. Tumperakki visited the Baron Administrator of the planet Bespin, Lando Calrissian, in the hopes of gaining an investment from him, he dressed in a way that Calrissian compared to the appearance of a Surakkean peacock.

name: Sureggi
summary: Sureggi were a species that lived on the forest planet Kashyyyk, and were kept in stables under some Kashyyyk wroshyr trees that doubled as cities.

name: Surpossian
summary: Surpossian was a humanoid species in the galaxy. Buck Vancto was a member of the species.

name: Surronian
summary: [[File:Surronian.svg|thumb|100px|Symbol of the Surronian.]] The Surronians were a race whose society was based on groups called guilds. Within each guild, there was a hive mind which governed each individual Surronian. They were known for their starship designs, unique creations almost never seen offworld. When the Surronian economy fell on hard times, they entered a contract with Rendili StarDrive, a deal which eventually produced the Starlight-class light freighter. They also produced the Conqueror-class assault ship, the same class of ship as Guri's Stinger. It is presumed the Surronian Farstar was also produced by Surronian craftsmen.

name: Surtop
summary: The surtop was a carnivorous creature found on the planet Troiken. By the time of the Galactic Empire, they lived primarily in zoological preserves.

name: Susaut Volupicite's species
summary: A bipedal species had gray fur and brown horns, skin, and eyes. Around 33 BBY, before the Clone Wars, a member of this species was an accomplice of Fissark Tozan. They were killed by Jango Fett when he came to collect a bounty on Tozan. Later, during the Imperial Era in 10 BBY, a member of this species named Susaut Volupicite was present at the Lodge on Vandor when Tobias Beckett, Qi'ra, Han Solo and Chewbacca arrived in search of Lando Calrissian. Later again in 2 BBY, a third member of this species served as a soldier for the newly formed Rebel Alliance at its base on Yavin 4.

name: Sussimi
summary: A sussimi was a nearly-transparent crustacean from the planet Mon Calamari. The creature were only clearly seen after feeding, because its stomach quickly transformed the food into a transparent intestinal goo. The creature was a predator with a wicked pinch, using hooked claws to snare little fish. When frightened, it sprayed a caustic transparent ink that had skin-burning acidic properties. Colonies of sussimis inhabited nests inside reefs and shipwrecks, and their shells were coveted by transparisteel artists on Dac.

name: Suubatar
summary: Suubatars were majestic riding beasts native to the rolling plains of Ansion. They were six meters tall, with protruding lavender eyes speckled with silver. The suubatar's smooth, tapered skull hinted that it was a creature of impressive speed. Suubatars pumped their six muscular legs when in full gait, gripping the grasslands with their long splayed toes, and launching themselves across the prairies in a speedy, yet smooth, run. At the command "Elup!" they arose to launch into their gallop, raising one set of legs at a time: the front, middle, and finally rear. Each of their six feet had six toes, and they were exceptional swimmers. The suubatar body was long and narrow, ending in a lean, leg-length tail. They were covered in a coat of short, soft, and dense bronze-colored fur striped with distinctive patterns of green, providing excellent camouflage on the Ansonian plains. They had a single nostril, no mane, and their ears lay flat along their head. Suubatars had a superb 25kz range of sound. Suubatars were omnivores, with their massive jaws hinged to allow the swallowing of large fruit and small prey whole. Four canine teeth protruded above and below the jaw, giving them a fearsome appearance—which was a deceptive illusion, for the domesticated suubatar was ever gentle and patient when treated in kind. Suubatar riders sat in leather viann supports that elevated the driver above the suubatar's spinal ridge. Suubatars had long been domesticated and were typically reserved for the Alwari Highborn. To ride a suubatar was to mark oneself as being important and with good taste among the Alwari. These handsome, magnificent beasts were thus highly valued and expensive to purchase. In 22 BBY, a Jedi team consisting of Masters Luminara Unduli and Obi-Wan Kenobi, and their Padawans Barriss Offee and Anakin Skywalker, secured six purebred suubatars for themselves and their Alwari guides while on their mission to settle a planetary border dispute and to convince all parties involved to resist all efforts at secession and to vote to remain within the Galactic Republic. The Jedi, who had bartered for the beasts, that they might carry them overland across the prairies in their search for the ruling tribal overclans, were astonished at the speed, beauty, and smooth gait of their splendid, towering mounts. Though it was said that no suubatar could outrun an airtruck, the agile creatures could certainly outmaneuver one: attempting to corner an Alwari mounted on a good suubatar, went the saying, was a good way to die. Wild, undomesticated suubatars were known to attack and destroy entire caravans.

name: Suuri
summary: The suuri was a crab-like species of crustacean native to the Expansion Region planet Tynna. The suuri lived beneath kelp-covered rocks, and was one of the main sources of food for the native Tynnans, who preferred to catch it live when it tasted best. When prepared boiled, the shell was preferably cracked first to release trapped steam pockets. Suuri was sold in the markets of Tatooine.

name: Svaper
summary: Svapers were eel-like predators native to Rodia.

name: Svivreni
summary: Svivreni were short, furry, equinoid sentients native to the planet Svivren. Due to the rocky environment of their homeworld, they developed into a stout species and created a civilization of hard-working people with a natural talent for geology. Svivreni were particularly known for their skill in mineralogy and for their stubbornness. The Svivreni had elaborate greetings and farewells, never using the word "goodbye," which they considered to be bad luck. Initially members of the Galactic Republic, the Svivreni forbade weapons on their planet and exacted strict punishment for outlaws, including execution, which reduced crime and was one of the factors that turned Svivren into an important trade world. The species avoided involvement in the Clone Wars and tried to remain neutral during the Galactic Civil War. In the days of the New Republic, the Galactic Empire attempted to conquer Svivren, but the Svivreni resisted Grand Admiral Thrawn's attacks through sheer obstinacy. The species later associated with the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Galactic Alliance Remnant. Many Svivreni achieved prestige as some of the best and hardest-working miners, including Saqc'or and Kitalic Nirasik. Another Svivreni, Mihalik, abandoned his job to illegally track the people who had injured his co-workers. Svivreni working in other areas included the crime lord Torsteen and two senatorial aides—Tyro Caladian, who aided Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Tyro's cousin, Curran Caladian, who became a political fugitive under the Empire.
hairColor: Orange, copper in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|Star Wars Adventure Journal

name: Swamp bantha
summary: The swamp bantha was a subspecies of bantha that was brought to the moon Ohma-D'un. It was smaller and less hairy than its desert relative. The swamp bantha was known for eating almost any plant.

name: Swamp buffalo
summary: Swamp buffalo were a type of swamp creature that were dangerous, but not necessarily effective, when gathered in large numbers. In 4 ABY, the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus compared stormtroopers to swamp buffalo during an argument with the bounty hunter Jas Emari.

name: Swamp Gator
summary: Swamp Gators, also known as Igua-Jaws, were predators of Dagobah with crocodilian-like traits.

name: Swamp monster
summary: A swamp monster was a species that inhabited the planet of Zeenada. Its eggs were the size of big rocks and they could take up entire lakes. They were extremely territorial.

name: Swamp puppy
summary: The swamp puppy was a creature found in the swamps of the Outer Rim planet Tenoo. It had textured purple skin and amber eyes. During the High Republic Era, the Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs befriended a swamp puppy during a scavenger hunt set for them by Jedi Master Yoda.

name: Swamp rancor
summary: Swamp rancor was a sub-species of Rancor living in swamps. Their notable difference from common rancors were the two large horns on their head, as well as a darker shade of skin. They could be found in the Endless Swamp on Zakuul, the capital world of the Eternal Empire.

name: Swamp rat
summary: Swamp rats were small predators native to the swamps of Trigalis.

name: Swamp serpent
summary: Swamp serpents were brown, predatory serpents native to Marca. Though air-breathers, they were excellent swimmers. They hunted in schools consisting of ten to fifteen individuals.

name: Swamp shark
summary: Swamp sharks were meter-long predatory fish on Marca. They did not hunt in groups.

name: Swamp slug
summary: Swamp slugs were a species of creature native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah.

name: Swamp wampa
summary: Swamp wampas were humanoid, semi-sentient predators, similar to the wampas of Hoth. The only major differences between the two wampa species was that the wampas of Hoth had adapted to their surroundings with heavy fur coats to survive the harsh climate of the ice world; the swamp wampas, in comparison, had lighter fur coats due to their native warm climate and were found in the swamps and marshes of Dromund Kaas. The two species were so similar that scientists believed swamp wampas may have directly descended from ice wampas.

name: Swamp worm
summary: Swamp worms were four-meter long ambush predators from Veron's swamps. Swamp worms were experts at moving through the thick mud of Veron's surface. They would often bury themselves in a few centimeters of mud and wait for a creature to walk by. Once the vibrations reached the swamp worm's soft skin, it sprang to life, attempting to kill with the stinger on the end of its tail. Swamp worms were dangerous simply because they were usually not noticed until it was too late. They were found in the swamp-like regions of the forest floor. Their appetites weren't large, but they were willing to die in defense of their territory.

name: Swarm bug
summary: Swarm bugs were methane-filled bugs of Gorsh which exploded when swatted.

name: Swarmer
summary: Swarmers were a non-sentient species of insects that were native to the world of Karra. When gathered in large groups, these insects could temporarily blind or deafen anything caught in the swarm by flying into open orifices in the face. The native Karran people had learned to control the insects as war beasts, pitting the swarmers against enemies on the battlefield.

name: Swaze
summary: The Swaze were a technologically advanced people from the Jidlor system. Though they had an advanced culture, with access to starship technology, they revered the wisdom of the comparatively primitive Rellarin people of Rellnas Minor. Every year, the Swaze leaders would go to Rellnas Minor to seek advice from the Rellarin tribal leaders and sages, the un'Yala.

name: Sweat bee
summary: Sweat bees were a type of bee that inhabited the planet Salient I.

name: Sweebotta's species
summary: This species was an alien species that existed in the galaxy. Sweebotta was a member of this species.

name: Swift
summary: Swifts were large, green, reptilian quadrupeds indigenous to the swamps of Naboo. Their running speed was comparable to a speeder bike, and they were capable of jumping great distances to traverse rough terrain. They were domesticated by Gungans to serve as mounts for their military scouts.

name: Swimming People of Dellalt
summary: The Swimming People of Dellalt, also known as Swimmers or Dellaltians, were sentient, lake-dwelling sauropteroids indigenous to Dellalt. They were large, with small heads on top of long, muscular necks, four flippers for movement in water, and heavy, short tails. Their hides varied from light gray to green and black. The Swimmers had blowholes on the tops of their heads instead of nostrils, and their eyes were protected by a nictitating membrane. Their mouths were filled with sharp, pointed teeth, which they used to catch fish and for defense. As a species, the Swimmers were territorial and had a set of laws to govern their lives. For a fee, they would ferry people and cargo across their lakes on rafts. Swimmers spoke an accented form of Galactic Basic, using their mouths to form the words.
skinColor: Varied from a light gray to a deep green-black

name: Swirl prong
summary: The swirl prong was a herd creature from the Forest Moon of Endor. Swirl prongs were related to the similar looking paralopes.

name: Swokes Swokes
summary: The Swokes Swokes were a sentient species that were native to the planet Makem Te. This little-known species had the unusual ability to regenerate body parts. This made them good at combat. Due to their violent nature, they often took positions as bodyguards and even bounty hunters. They had a reputation for being merciless violent people caring only about themselves and vast wealth, which they saw as an indication of social status. They also had a great fondness for gemstones. Their natural habitat was desert or wastelands. At least three members of the species were officials in the Galactic Senate during the Invasion of Naboo.

name: Swonk
summary: The Swonks were a reptilian sentient species.

name: Sy Myrthian
summary: Sy Myrthians were a sentient species from Sy Myrth who moved on one large "foot" (similar to the Hutts). They were covered in short fur and had elongated heads. Later some Sy Myrthians joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, although not all Sy Myrthians joined Count Dooku's movement. One part of the galaxy was known as Sy Myrthian space.

name: Syblin
summary: The Syblins was the name given to individuals of the species of Queen Sybil, an insectoid being who resided on the planet Metagos and whose species' name was unknown. The hatchlings of Sybil's thousands of eggs would be left to survive on their own and exterminate each other until they were ten years old, after which they would be given numbers.

name: Syboona
summary: Syboonas were a species of blue-skinned humanoid sentient beings from the eponymous world of Syboona. They had thin physiques and long limbs, and their heads featured long curved muzzles. Knire Dark was a Syboona who distinguished herself in the sport of Podracing during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

name: Sybrial brain slug
summary: The Sybrial brain slug was a type of slug that shared its name with the Sybrial system of the Vodilux sector. At one point during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, a Wookiee hijacked the starship of a group of Alliance agents in order to launch a rescue attempt of his family at the Imperial prison on the planet Branth. When one of the Rebels translated the Wookiee's explanation of his actions to the ship's captain, the latter voiced their protest. In response, the Wookiee made a loud exclamation in the Shyriiwook language, but, when the Rebel once again began translating, the captain cut them off, proclaiming his comprehension of the intent behind the utterance and comparing the Rebel to a Sybrial brain slug.

name: Sycanid
summary: The sycanid was a type of exotic creature. A sycanid from Humbarine was being carried aboard the cargo vessel Sketter's Quarrel while it was traveling to the Mol'leaj system to deliver exotic creatures, many of which were illegal to personally own, to the star system's Regent Solculvis. The vessel was left dead in space during the journey after the crew were killed by kheilwar wasps that had escaped from a damaged cargo container. In 34 ABY, the ship was discovered and its contents, including the sycanid, were catalogued by members of the Sector Rangers. Information from the Rangers' file on the case was later published in the book Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious, which was authored by Police Commissioner Exantor Divo.

name: Sylar Saris' species
summary: Sylar Saris was a member of an insectoid sentient species closely resembling the Yam'rii species. Saris' species was potentially a subspecies of Yam'rii. The species was capable of spitting green acid out of their mouths.

name: Sylphe
summary: Sylphes were a botanical, humanoid sentient species, native to Sylvia IV.

name: Symbiont
summary: A symbiont was a fungoid creature involved in symbiosis. General Yiv the Benevolent owned multiple symbionts, which he wore on his shoulders like epaulets. Yiv's symbionts tested air and liquids for toxins and other harmful substances.

name: Symeong
summary: The Symeong were a sentient ape-like species who had large, sensitive ears. The Symeong metalsmith Albrekh, who worked aboard the Knights of Ren's starship Night Buzzard, used his ears to determine the heat of metal from the tone it produced when struck. Another Symeong, Dathan, was a slave of the Sith Eternal who helped a young Strand-Cast of Darth Sidious escape the planet Exegol.

name: Syrinxian
summary: Syrinxians were a cultural group of a horned species hailing from the Outer Rim planet Syrinx Prime. Between 40 BBY and 34 BBY, the Syrinxians went to war with the neighboring Vekurans, as the latter invaded Syrinx Prime following centuries of distrust and tension between the two groups. Syrinxians were susceptible to Jedi mind tricks.

name: Syrox
summary: Syrox, also known as the Wolf Worms of Monsolar, were an alpha species of ectomorphic worm native to the planet Monsolar. They lacked a brain, yet were highly efficient predators which fed on blood using their large circular mouth of sharp teeth. Syrox were parasitic for the earliest stages of their life cycle, with Syrox females laying their microscopic eggs into the rivers of their homeworld, where they were consumed by other animals. These animals would become hosts for the juvenile worms, which would slowly incubate and grow within them for several years. They would eventually emerge from their host, with adults having grown hugely in size. The worms could be coaxed out of their hosts by the smell of Anzati snot garlic, and a folk remedy on Monsolar said if a host placed a bulb of garlic on their pillow while they slept the Syrox would crawl out of their mouth. Waleed Nagma, a native of Monsolar, became infested by a Syrox prior to being incarcerated in Cog Hive Seven. Whilst in the prison he had some garlic smuggled in and drew the creature out, after which it was killed. Another Syrox had incubated within Nagma's body and it emerged from his corpse shortly after his death, whilst it was still small enough to go unnoticed. The creature went on to reside within the pipes that surrounded the prison, growing to large proportions and feeding on prisoners that it encountered. In 33 BBY, the worm consumed the prisoners Vas Nailhead and Strabo after they entered the pipes in pursuit of the prison officer Augustine Smight.

name: Tabage
summary: Tabage were quadrupedal creature native to Corellia and Talus. Their eyes were covered by narrow slits, and they had small, pointy teeth. They were the prey of the dalyrake.

name: Tach
summary: The tach were a species of non-sentient, tree-dwelling primates native to the planet Kashyyyk. A harmless and even friendly creature, the tach could often be found on the ground searching for overripe fruits. It was characterized by its bright, reddish skin, fur that was white on the head and grayish-blue elsewhere, and long tail with a tassel-like tip. It walked on all fours, and its arms were longer than its legs. In 14 BBY, during Cal Kestis' mission to Kashyyyk, he found several tachs living on the Origin Tree whilst climbing it. His droid companion, BD-1, then scanned the creatures, supplying Cal with information on them.

name: Tahlboorean
summary: Tahlbooreans were sapient humanoids indigenous to Tahlboor. There were two variants of the species: the blue Troobs and the purple Hobors, who were at constant war with one another. They once had a highly-developed civilization that had created the sky cannon, but a misfire of it had caused them to revert to relative barbarism.

name: Tah'Nuhna
summary: The Tah'Nuhna, also referred to as the Tah'Nuhnan, were an insectoid sentient species which hailed from the Mid Rim ice-planet of the same name.

name: Taï
summary: The Taï were the native sentient species of the planet Taypho.

name: Tailring
summary: Tailrings, or sand dragons, were desert creatures native to Socorro. They dwelt in small flocks near oases. They had wings, black scales, and short patches of fur. They shed their skin annually, and their age could be determined by the number of knobs on their tail rattles. Sociable beings, they were popular pets among spacers, as they voraciously preyed upon mynocks.

name: Tal Nami
summary: The Tal Nami were a sentient species from the planet Tal Nami in Hutt Space. They were enslaved by the Hutt species but were renowned for loathing their masters. To survive, members of the species needed to consume both the fruit of the egoa tree and the roots of the capabara plant as part of their regular diet. As the two foods only grew in different regions of the species' homeworld, the Tal Nami developed a rigid honor system for trading. The species became known as avid merchants and haters of those who traded unfairly.

name: Talid
summary: The Talid were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. A male podracer Gen-Goma was a member of the species. By sometime during or after 5 ABY, a large statue of a Talid could be found on the planet Ando Prime.

name: Tallimarian
summary: The Tallimarians were a sentient species. The aristocrat Centada Ressad from the Ressad Dynasty from Tallimar Prime and the scavenger Velorie Sarcon on the planet Jakku were members of the species.

name: Taloron
summary: The Talorons were a species of sentient, blue-skinned humanoids native to the Wild Space Taloron system. For much of their existence, the Talorons were peaceful farmers and merchants. However, when pirate groups set up operations in the Taloron system and began preying upon its peaceful denizens, the Talorons were forced to regroup and militarize, lest they be wiped out completely from the predations. The resulting war, the Taloron Pirate Conflict, completely reshaped Taloron society and birthed the infamous Taloron Hunters, distinguished by their trademark armor. Once the Talorons had driven the pirates from their system, many members of the species turned their strong reverence for law and order toward careers as bounty hunters and assassins. During the Galactic Civil War, members of the species split their loyalties: the Taloron Hunter known as Crutag, for example, supported the Galactic Empire and pursued bounties on members of the Rebel Alliance, while the Hunter known as Korgath supported the Rebels as a member of the Special Operations Scandium Team. Another Taloron, known by the alias "Blue" Imcrix, smuggled spice after the rise of the New Republic. The Talorons had access to starship technology and manufactured the craft known as the Taloron Prey Chaser.

name: Talortai
summary: The Talortai were an avian sentient species that possessed feathers and clawed feet. Talortai hailed from Talor, an astronomical object that featured tropics. The species was strong in the Force, and Talortai could use their affinity to navigate the galaxy with precision; however, in the case of the Talortai navigator Udi Dis, their connection to the Force did not extend to the premonition that the Jedi were known for. Dis, at one point a soldier, left Talor, eventually coming to use his navigation skills in service to the Nihil marauder organization under Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro. By that time, the only possession that he had from his home were the curved wingblades that he carried. Dis accompanied Ro to the frozen planet Rystan, where Kufa, a cousin of Ro, was to take the two of them to the Shrine. Dis, not having experienced the cold growing up in the tropics of Talor, was affected by the temperature.

name: Talpiddian
summary: {{Update|}} Talpiddians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had acute eyesight at close range, but had difficulty identifying individuals of other species, particularly humans. Their hair could stand on end as a threat gesture, or when they were nervous. Huper Tenrecs was a Talpiddian weapons specialist who worked with the Resistance. The species shared its name with Talpiddi, an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories.

name: Talpini
summary: Talpini were a sentient species native to Tal Pi. Weeteef Cyu-Bee, a member of the Partisans, was a member of this species.

name: Talz
summary: The Talz were a sentient species native to the planets Alzoc III and Orto Plutonia, on which they remained undiscovered until the Clone Wars. Their discovery caused a brief war between a Talz village and the Pantoran Assembly due to Chairman Chi Cho of Pantora believing they were a hostile force. After the death of Cho, Pantoran Senator Riyo Chuchi talked and ended the war with the Chieftain of the village, Thi-Sen, after which the Talz were officially recognized as a free and equal people and were allowed to live peacefully on their homeworld.
distinctions: Unable to speak Galactic Basic Standard

name: Tambles
summary: The Tambles were a group of diminutive sentient beings who lived on the forest moon of Endor. They bounced along the surface of rivers; without water, they would die.

name: Tammarian
summary: Tammarians were a species from Tammar. Because of the relatively small atmosphere on Tammar, Tammarians possessed air sacks which would allow them to survive in vacuum for short periods. They also had intense fear of water, as Tammar was completely lacking in surface water. Ayddar Nylykerka was a Tammarian.

name: Tammuz-an
summary: The Tammuz-an were a species of humanoids from the planet of the same name that had taller frames and longer legs than average. They were ruled by a monarch. When the fledgling Galactic Empire refused to mass-produce Kuat Systems Engineering's R-22 A-wing, the Tammuz-an bought the existing prototypes to complement their planetary defense fleet.

name: Tanc mite
summary: Tanc mites were insects native to the jungle moon Yavin 4.

name: Tandreed
summary: Tandreeds were a type of non-sentient species native to the planet Wor Tandell. Jarael rode one of those creatures in 3963 BBY.

name: Tang tang bird
summary: A tang tang bird was a type of bird. At some point between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, Jedi Master Uumay Hawlatha sang a song about a tang tang bird, referencing it several times by referring to Jedi Knight Iskat Akaris as one.

name: Tangak
summary: Tangaks were carnivorous predators native to the planet Coyn. They were considered to be a highly unintelligent yet very dangerous species. They had a shaggy coat of fur and moved about on two legs. Tangak's were surprisingly agile for their immense size, and they could easily blend into their surroundings. Although Tangak's preferred to eat the six-legged tris, there were several documented accounts of them attacking young Coynites.

name: Tangrene
summary: The Tangrene were a sentient species that evolved on the Outer Rim Territories planet Tangrene. The species developed a peaceful, nomadic society that lived on a world with very little surface vegetation. Their homeworld was discovered between 5,000 and 3000 BBY, and was the terminus of a hyperlane. Under the Galactic Empire, the Tangrene were enslaved in order to construct an Imperial Intelligence Ubiqtorate center. Following completion of the project, the local Imperial Moff ordered the genocide of the Tangrene to prevent any future uprisings.

name: Tannor
summary: The tannors were a venomous species that were indigenous to an unidentified planet.

name: Tanray
summary: Tanrays, also known as lava lizards, were predatory reptiles from Mustafar. Tanray heart crystals were named after this creature, due to the crystal's resemblance to a tanray's heart.

name: Tantla
summary: Tantlas were cyclopian scavengers native to Ealor.

name: Taozin
summary: The Taozin were a type of creature that, as a grub, had a long body with eight limbs. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept a Taozin grub on display in his study aboard his ship, the First Light. A Taozin grub was also kept in Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu in 34 ABY. The Taozin was placed in brine that the creature infused with certain qualities. Some species considered the infused brine a delicacy that increased their mental fortitude.

name: Tappratine
summary: The tappratine was a four-winged creature from Munto Codru.

name: Taqwa
summary: The taqwa (which translated into "snow-strider" in Galactic Basic Standard) was a multi-headed, non-sentient quadruped hailing from the planet of Vallt. Despite their innate ferocity, the taqwa were used as draft animals by Vallt's native, blue faced sentients, the Valltii.

name: Taras-chi
summary: A Taras-chi was an insect native to Kessel. It had six legs under a hard round carapace about three centimeters in diameter. Kyp Durron explained that they offered nutrition to the slaves in the spice mines who could catch them to eat. Having spent time on Kessel, Booster Terrik also knew of this insect, and passed on the knowledge of it to his son-in-law Corran Horn. Both Terrik and Durron felt that the taras-chi tasted awful, although Kyp did say that they tasted less awful if prepared properly. In order to show solidarity to the Jedi Order, Kyp Durron pretended that his belief that Jacen Solo should be a Jedi Master was merely an attempt to argue the other side in order to properly view all sides of an issue (which he called Taras-Chi). Later, Luke implemented that idea and with the name Taras-chi.

name: Tarasin
summary: The Tarasins were a bipedal, sapient reptilian species indigenous to Cularin. They were remotely related to the gigantic Kilassin.

name: Tarc
summary: The Tarc were a sentient crustacean species, indigenous to the planet Hjaff. Standing at around two meters tall with four arms and a chitinous exoskeleton, they appeared intimidating to most humanoids, a reputation furthered by their ruthless and emotionless behavior. The Tarc, in fact, did not lack emotions, but believed them to be private and not to be shared with others. Fiercely protective of their culture and sovereignty, the Tarc saw other species as a threat to both of these and, as a result, were extremely isolationist as a society. The Tarc colonized the star systems around their homeworld, making the area a buffer between them and the rest of the galaxy and using their navy, the Ivlacav Gourn, to destroy any intruders. That practice led the species into conflict with the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
distinctions: Four arms, chitinous exoskeleton, lack of teeth and tongue

name: Tarc precursor species
summary: A species of primitive sea-dwelling creatures evolved on the planet of Hjaff with in the Colonies. Originally living in the planets oceans the species was eventually forced to move onto land. Once on the land the species gradually moved further away from their original ocean home as they evolved, moving deeper into their homeworlds large desert regions. In the deserts the species would eventually evolve into the sentient Tarc species.

name: Targappian
summary: The Targappians were a species of sentient humanoids characterized by their webbed fingers and iridescent hair. Four years after the Invasion of Naboo, their homeworld of Targappia was represented in the Senate of the Galactic Republic by a female senator.

name: Targon
summary: Targons were a species of giant cats that possessed thick fur, tufted ears, four eyes, and tufted tails. Despite being a predator species, they had low-level empathic abilities. Lina Soh, Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, owned two pet targons, Matari and Voru, who accompanied her wherever she went.

name: Targonnian
summary: Targonnians were a green flightless avian species native to the planet Targonn. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the Targonnians were ruled by Craw the self-styled Dictator-Forever of Targonn. Craw was extremely self-absorbed and cared little for the troubles of his people, creating a 99 percent tax, and forcing child labor. The chief enforcer of his will was Captain Steggus. Craw sought the secret of savorium which he planned to utilize to stop the peasants under his rule from complaining about the poor conditions in which they lived. Around 5 BBY, the Revoltist faction led by Shay were dedicated to overthrow of Dictator-Forever Craw's rule.

name: Tarinna
summary: The Tarinna, also known as Critonian story vampires, were a sentient species that fed on experiences and memories. The cartographer Emil Graf, along with the droids CR-8R and BB-00 and the Kowakian monkey-lizard Noni, encountered a Tarinna in the Lost Library of Nelgenam, who fed on Graf's memories. With the help of his companions, Graf was saved, but had lost the memories of numerous stories he had been told in the process.

name: Tarlafar
summary: Tarlafars were a short, white-furred sentient species of which Wamoth, Ailish, and Bayrn were members.

name: Tarnab
summary: The Tarnab were a sentient species that were native to Tarn that had a triangular skull and a cluster of horns amid rough hair. During the era of the High Republic, Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter represented the species in the Jedi Order. During the waning decades of the Galactic Republic, they were represented by Senator Mot-Not Rab in the Galactic Senate.

name: Tarong
summary: The Tarongs were large sentient avians from the twin worlds of Iri and Disim in the Epidimi system. Notably skilled mimics, Tarongs were typically talkative and friendly people. They were fond of space travel, gems, and protocol droids.
distinctions: Quadrupedal avians, keen vision, vocal mimicry

name: Tarro
summary: The Tarro were muscular humanoids from Tililix, a planet in the Til system deep in the Unknown Regions. Their skin color varied from light gray to dark green, while their eyes were bright yellow. Tarro hair colors varied with their sex, with males having dark blue or black hair while females had brown hair, sometimes tinged with red. Their seven-fingered hands had long curved claws, which they could use along with their sharp teeth in hand-to-hand combat. Many non-Tarro found their strength and natural weapons to be intimidating. Their faces were distinguished by their large foreheads and flat noses. Though they had an advanced technological civilization, they had few ties with the rest of the galaxy, with alien freighters arriving in their system very rarely. This changed around 100 BBY when their sun, Til, suddenly exploded. The cause of this explosion was still unknown during the Imperial era, though rumor among Tarro and non-Tarro alike blamed it on an experimental superweapon. These rumors differed on whether the Tarro or other, unknown parties were responsible. [[File:Tarro_pilot.png|thumb|left|150px|A Tarro starfighter pilot]] Only the Tarro who were off-world at the time survived—and they were less than five hundred in number. These refugees soon scattered through the Unknown Regions and the Outer Rim. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, their descendants had dwindled in number to about three hundred and fifty. As a result, little was known of their original culture—though they managed to preserve the Tarrese language. The efforts of Tarro elders to preserve their culture were hampered by the Tarro personality. Tarro were independent by nature and individualistic in philosophy. Most of them preferred to work alone, quickly losing their patience with others—even fellow Tarro. Some of them could suppress these tendencies, and work in groups—but even then, they were not shy about expressing their dissatisfaction when things did not go their way. The largest group of Tarro recorded during the Imperial era was a group of seven in Sommin City on Seltos. Most others lived a solitary life. It is probably this individualistic outlook which led many Tarro to support the Alliance to Restore the Republic's struggle against the Galactic Empire. Several Tarro had prominent roles within the Alliance, including the Alliance Intelligence operatives Kassar Kosciusko and Qatak Qantaras, and Lieutenant Commander Masakayan. Other Tarro became bounty hunters, mercenaries, scouts, or criminal enforcers. They tended to live a transient lifestyle, rarely staying long in the heavily regulated and densely-populated regions of the galaxy. Though the majority of Tarro survivors had little interest in reuniting their scattered people and going through the bureaucratic procedure of establishing a new Tarro homeworld, a few Tarro searched the Unknown Regions for lost Tarro colonies. Tarro names included Paraster Daskalion, Ruskor Votaran, and Terrant Skayanestro.

name: Tarron Neb's species
summary: A species of sentients native to Yavin 8 were targeted by Galactic Emperor Palpatine for extermination. Tarron Neb was the sole survivor.

name: Tarsarian devourer
summary: Tarsarian devourers were non-sentient predators that spawned on Taris's destroyed surface during the Cold War. They were the product of a rakghoul virus mutation that spread to the tarsarian stomper. The stompers were non-native beasts, kept only in zoos, that initially thrived in the post-bombardment jungles of Taris, but were overwhelmed by their more aggressive infected cousins. Although it was impossible to contract the rakghoul plague from these creatures, the devourers became the strongest and most feared species of the planet, on the top of the Tarisian food chain.

name: Tarsarian stomper
summary: The Tarsarian stomper was a non-native predatory species kept in Taris zoos. A breeding population survived the Destruction of Taris, and initially thrived in the post-bombardment environment. A mutated strain of the Rakghoul plague infected the population, resulting in the Tarsarian devourer. This new predator soon out-competed its predecessor, driving the stompers extinct on Taris.

name: Tarsunt
summary: The Tarsunt were a species of furry sentients from the planet of the same name. They were represented by Senator Colandrus in the Galactic Republic, and by Lanever Villecham in the New Republic; the latter went on to serve as chancellor in the New Republic Senate until his death in the Hosnian Cataclysm.

name: Tasari
summary: The Tasari were a species of sentient bipeds that were indigenous to the world of Tasariq. They had brightly colored blue skin and bright orange or red feathers down their head to spine. They also had a bright yellow beak and also had large eyes. They had slightly mottled skin, and had five fingers and toes. They had four total limbs, with two arms and legs.

name: Tash
summary: The Tash were a sentient species native to Dagobah who grew herbs. These herbs were used in drinks like the Dagobah Slug Slinger on Batuu.

name: Tatooine Howler
summary: The Tatooine Howler, also known as a "desert wampa" due to its resemblance to the ice wampa of Hoth, was a creature native to Tatooine. They were large, shaggy creatures with bulky builds and curling horns. Their dirty yellow fur helped them blend in with their desert surroundings. Only their teeth, claws, and horns were visible, but barely enough to blow their cover (especially in sandstorms). When seen from afar, Howlers were easily mistaken for banthas. They were dangerous, extremely intelligent, and unpredictable, but were also very rare. Most people considered them legends or rumors designed to keep the curious away from secret smuggler bases in the deep desert. When hunting, howlers made loud howling noises to scare prey. They herded them towards rock cul-de-sacs or similar killing grounds. They dried portions of each kill in the hot air and buried them in the sand. If prey was scarce, then howlers would return to their secret cache of food. While they preferred fresh meat, they never ventured too far away from their caches. While it possessed characteristics of a wampa, such as tusks and fur, genetic testing proved that the Tatooine howler had no actual relation to it at all.

name: Tatooine mynock
summary: Tatooine mynocks were a subspecies of mynock native to the planet Tatooine. They were considered a pest and could be aggressive. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker was attacked by Tatooine mynocks in the deserts of Tatooine. Later, the Human Pfilbee Jhorn commissioned an Imperial-aligned spacer to eradicate the pests near Bestine. In return, he rewarded the spacer with a number of credits. Around the same time, W. Wald also hired spacers to deal with large Tatooine mynocks eating power cables in Watto's junkyard in Mos Espa.

name: Tau serpent
summary: The tau serpent was a non-sentient species of serpent that lived by 20 BBY, Around that year, when Ko Sai, the Chief Scientist in charge of producing the Grand Army of the Republic, was captured by clone trooper trainer Kal Skirata and his adopted children, they clothed her in a borrowed gown. Upon seeing the Kaminoan's long neck extend from the outfit, Jedi Knight Etain Tur-Mukan was reminded of a tau serpent freeing itself from a bag.

name: Taung
summary: The Taung were an ancient sentient species of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. The day of Taungsday was named for the species. The beskad, a traditional Mandalorian sword, was based on an ancient Taung design. The Taung & Zhell Society, a student group at the University of Coruscant, shared its name with the species.

name: Tauntaun
summary: {{MultipleIssues|expand|updatecontent=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back, Star Wars (2020) 12, Tales from Wild Space: A Tauntaun Tail, }} Tauntauns were a species of semi-sentient reptomammals native to the snowy plains of Hoth. They were used by members of the Rebel Alliance after they domesticated some of them when they built their new headquarters on Hoth, as the extreme conditions made airspeeders unreliable. When Luke Skywalker was injured by a wampa, Han Solo used the sliced open corpse of his recently deceased mount to keep Skywalker warm until Solo was able to construct a shelter.
height: 1.3 to 2 meters at the shoulder *2.7 meters total

name: Taurill
summary: Taurill were a multi-limbed, furry species that shared a hive mind. At one point, Bandit Billie and Ratty-Ratty hired a group of Taurill to help them steal a starship, thinking their hive mind would work to their advantage.

name: Tawd
summary: Tawds were non-sentient creatures native to the planet Durkteel. They were woolly and long-tailed, and also present on Ottinger 7. Mattis Banz mentioned that one tawd could destroy a dozen farms by eating every living thing and destroying what remained.

name: Tayan falcon
summary: The Tayan falcon was a species of predatory bird with sparkling amber feathers found in the mountains of the planet Kinyen. Tayan falcon imagery was used in Kinyen's Doellinist religion, and the birds themselves were revered as avatars of the religion's primary deity, Doellin. They shared a name with Taya, another of Doellin's avatars. The falcons were trained by herders to fend off pests, and the falcons' methods of doing so influenced the socialist Tayan League, the political party that led the planet.

name: Taymar
summary: The Taymar were a sentient species that inhabited the galaxy. Taymar had human-like faces, glittery blue-green skin, flowing tendrils, and the ability to float, as well as multiple arms. During the High Republic Era, Svi'no Atchapat and her family were a group of Taymar from the Core Worlds planet Corellia who formed a musical group.

name: Tazi sloth
summary: A tazi sloth was an extremely rare species of sloth found on the planet Tenoo. One tazi sloth was known as the "Guardian of the Tenoo Jedi Temple" who hibernated at the top of Tenoo tree which crowned the Tenoo Jedi Temple. Tazi sloths were known for their centuries-long hibernation. Unlike other kinds of sloth, tazi sloths could move quickly through tree canopies.

name: Tchuukthai
summary: Tchuukthai, also called Wharls, were sapient ceratopsian quadrupeds from the Unknown Regions.

name: Teal oroko
summary: The teal oroko, commonly known as simply oroko, were aquatic nine-pointed echinoderms that could be found in the sea of the planet Kwenn. The creatures had numerous spawning grounds within the islands of the Gem Cities of Kwenn, including near the Gala, Essafa, and Malbaira Keys. The latter island, a protected nature reserve, was known for its views of the oroko. After the ecological collapse of Kwenn during the Republic Era, the zoological academy on the planet Alderaan, judging Kwenn as a lost cause, removed a school of oroko to a lagoon preserve, returning the creatures after Kwenn's environment was restored in the High Republic Era's Grand Renewal.

name: Tectozin
summary: The Tectozin were a sentient species native to the planet The Deep. They had stalked eyes and retractable talon fingers. U'rum was a member of this species.

name: Tedellian besiioth
summary: The besiioth was a red-eyed, quadruped creature from Tedel. The most common subspecies was the plains besiioth. Various subspecies were hybridized to create the stalker besiioth breed.

name: Tee
summary: The Tee were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by colo claw fish and opee sea killers that dwelt there. Tiny yobshrimp lived in the gills of tee, and they were licked out and eaten by laa scalefish.

name: Tee-muss
summary: Tee-muss were a species of domesticated farm animals native to the jungle planet Onderon. They were located on various worlds around the galaxy—such as Balnab, Felucia, and Florrum—because of domestication purposes or to serve as mounts.

name: Teedo
summary: Teedos were a sentient reptilian species native to the planet Jakku, in the Western Reaches. They were diminutive in height and had gray-green skin, most of which was covered in wrappings to protect them from the intense heat of their homeworld. Teedos made no distinction between individuals, and so each member of the species was simply named Teedo. The species experienced an unknown form of telepathic connection between individuals, and Teedo were known to recall events that happened to other Teedo. They spoke a language called Teedospeak. They worshiped a goddess named R'iia, and believed the violent storms on Jakku were her breath, or X'us'R'iia.

name: Teek
summary: {{Update|, Force Collector}} Teeks were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At some point, a crashed ark brought Teeks to the moon of Endor. When Han Solo and Lando Calrissian were searching for a pilot on Frander's Bay, Solo pushed his way through a group of Teek before dodging a lumbering Kullp. A Teek worked at Port Borgo around 9 ABY.

name: Teevan
summary: The Teevan were a sentient species that originated from the Teevan system. In 382 BBY, a Force-sensitive Teevan man was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult.

name: Teezl
summary: A teezl, also referred to as a screamer, was a non-sentient, bluish, luminous, swirling creature that could be used as a natural hyperspace communications amplifier. A living example of a teezl was discovered by the Galactic Empire in the Valtha Divide during the Galactic Civil War, its abilities caused the Empire to immediately recognize its potential as a difference-maker in the ongoing war with the Rebels. However, a resulting Rebel operation to prevent the teezl's integration into the Imperial war machine resulted in the teezl's destruction, and the death of the only known member of the mysterious species.

name: Tefaun
summary: Tefauns were a blue-skinned, sentient humanoid species with ridged heads and bulging eyes. The Tefaun banker Kelek purchased the Wheel, a space station gambling resort, launching a brutal gladiatorial competition called the Big Game.
