When the Wheel lost clientele and experienced reduced revenues, Kelek borrowed money from the InterGalactic Banking Clan to win back customers but was unable to meet her payment schedule, forcing her to sell her shares to businessman Dominic Raynor. During the Galactic Civil War, Soth Petikkin from Tefau served as a persuasive recruiter for the Rebel Alliance, using his contacts in crime lord Jabba the Hutt's Palace on the planet Tatooine to gain support for the Alliance.

name: Teirasan
summary: The Teirasans were a sentient species that originated in the Teirasa system of the Mid Rim's Iskin sector. During the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, the star system was located outside the borders of the Galactic Republic. When the Republic, which at the time was under the control of the Humanocentric Pius Dea cult, launched the Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade against both the Teirasans and the Zarracines of the Zarracina system in 11,660 BBY, Republic forces advanced toward the Teirasa system.

name: Telerath eel
summary: A species of blue-skinned eel could be found in the waters of the planet Telerath. They had eight eyes, sharp teeth, and at least three fins, one of which was a dorsal fin. In the year 19 BBY the Jedi Knight Dass Jennir encountered a member of this species after escaping from the T'surr crime lord Ken-Kiba's and his spice runner gang through a trap door in the floor of the brothel known as Ember's Fire in the town of Noua. The eel emerged from amongst some rocks and attempted to devour Jennir while he was submerged, but the Jedi narrowly escaped when he was pulled to safety by a local fisherman named Fish.

name: Telfreyan
summary: The Telfreyans were a sentient species native to Telfrey, a planet they shared with Humans. They were green-skinned humanoids with small patches of green hair at the top of their heads. Due to their proud nature they rebelled against the Galactic Empire when it became active in the Iskalon system where they lived. The Empire responded quickly to this unrest due to the actions of two Human Rebels from Telfrey, Yom Argo and Tay Vanis, who were spreading unrest throughout the system. A Base Delta Zero attack was used on Telfrey, which killed all life there and rendered it uninhabitable for many years.

name: Telkadis hiding tree spider
summary: The Telkadis hiding tree spider was a mostly static predator from Telkadis. Spider's eggs hatched inside a taku tree and hatchlings burrowed deeper inside the trunk while they grew. They hunted small rodents like voletes, preying by the presence of heat in the surroundings. Their poison was not lethal for humanoid-sized creatures.

name: Teltior
summary: The Teltiors were a tall humanoid race. They were closely related to the Meris, who also hailed from the planet Merisee in the Meris system.

name: Temolak
summary: Temolak were a sentient species indigenous to Zirulast. They were renowned as scavengers throughout the galaxy.
distinctions: Heavily muscled, fin-like structure on underside of forearms

name: Tempestro
summary: The Tempestro were a Force-sensitive sentient species indigenous to Koda's World.

name: Temptor
summary: Temptors were a type of quadrupedal creature found in the forests of the moon Endor. The long-necked creature had a brown leathery skin and 5 pairs of black eyes. To hunt in the wilderness, temptors were also equipped with small but sharp teeth in their jaws, as well as a long fur-tipped tongue to lure targets; perfect for an ambush against unsuspecting prey. In 4 ABY, the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick unknowingly released a trapped temptor, thinking it was a verkle due to its fuzzy tongue. Another Ewok Meedro rescued Warrick and pierced the creature's tail, which caused the temptor to sever its tail and flee.

name: Tentacle bird of Pelemax
summary: The tentacle bird of Pelemax was an unusual flightless avian with tentacles that originated in the Pelemax system.

name: Tenticulon
summary: Tenticulons were natural predators of the firehead fish, who lurks in the half-light waters beneath the polar ice sheets on the planet Rhinnal. Their enormous body is an amorphous blob towing dozens of ribbon-like arms, each with a specialized function. Some limbs blink to bewitch passing fish, others sting, and still others grasp and rend. The creatures are capable of rapidly regenerating lost appendages. If the tenticulon hits its target with at least five grasping tentacles, it can swallow the victim whole. Many residents of Rhinnal consider the tenticulon a myth; its existence remains (in their eyes) unproven. Others disagree, positing that the creature typically does not fight what it cannot kill.
distinctions: Amorphous body with dozens of ribbonlike tentacles
habitat: Waters beneath the polar ice sheets

name: Terbeast
summary: The terbeast was a three headed canine creature that roamed the forests of Ogden Minor, terrorizing the locals. The two Jedi Aayla Secura and Quinlan Vos were sent to kill the creatures. Terbeast were large three headed canine species that were very aggressive in nature. Their bodies resembled that of a bear but their heads were more akin to the look of a canine. Terbeasts have a monstrous bark and heart skipping growl.

name: Terecon
summary: Terecons were eight-meter-long reptilian predators of Essowyn, one meter at the shoulder. They burrowed into pits from which they ambushed hoskas.

name: Terentatek
summary: Terentateks were a species of hulking bipeds found on the arboreal planet of Kashyyyk that craved the blood of Force-sensitives.
skinColor: Mottled brown, blue with yellow patches

name: Termidote
summary: Termidotes were a type of tiny creature found on the forest moon Endor. They possessed six limbs, a pair of wings, two antennae, two black eyes, and a pair of long teeth. Similar to fleas, they caused great amounts of itchiness by biting furry creatures such as the sentient Ewoks of Endor, causing those infested to scratch themselves.

name: Terra tree toad
summary: Terra tree toads were a species of toad native to the planet Batuu. They lived in the Batuu tree. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised terra tree toads as pets or for other reasons.

name: Terrelian Jango Jumper
summary: Terrelian Jango Jumpers were tall, slender humanoids who were known for their acrobatic abilities. The criminal Cassilyda "Cassie" Cryar was a Terrelian Jango Jumper, as were the Eighth Brother, a member of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, and Lika, who was held captive by Trandoshan big game hunters.

name: Teryx
summary: Teryx were small reptavians living in the Cloudland Peaks on the planet Selonia.

name: Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant
summary: The Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant was a very rare and furry tree-dwelling creatures.

name: Tevellan
summary: The Tevellans were a sentient species from the planet Tevel. The Tevellans were covered in orange fur with white or dark brown stripes, long tails, and membranes between their arms and torsos which allowed them to glide. After the First Order seized Tevel to take control of a bacta production plant, several Tevellans contacted the Resistance, requesting help. Finn and Poe Dameron of the Resistance managed to liberate the production plant, saving the Tevellans.
hairColor: Orange with white or dark brown stripes

name: Thaelo
summary: Thaelos were a race of primates native to the many forested craters of Saleucami.

name: Thafslanu
summary: The thafslanu was a creature whose hide could be used to create clothing. While living as a hermit on the planet Pasaana, Lando Calrissian wore a sensor-shrouding coat made from thasflanu hide.

name: Thak
summary: Thaks were a creature used as traditional transport on Eiattu 6. Plourr Ilo was an excellent Thak rider, having been trained in her childhood.

name: Thakwaash
summary: Thakwaash were equinoid biped species from Thakwaa.

name: Thala-siren
summary: Thala-sirens were large pinnipeds, found on the planet Ahch-To, among other watery worlds. Characterized by their udders, large flippers, and long snout, they were found basking on the cliffs of the sacred Temple Island, the site of the first Jedi Temple, when Rey traveled to the island to find Jedi Master Luke Skywalker. They were docile mammals who were not hunted and thus did not fear the natives of the island. They enjoyed sunning themselves along the coastal rocks of the island. The females, which were known as sea sows, produced a nutritious green milk for their young. The milk was also harvested by Luke Skywalker and the native Lanai as a food source. Their docile nature meant they were not scared of people like Skywalker approaching for their milk, which proved to be a vital food source during his exile. During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, thala-siren green milk was exported to Bubo Wamba Family Farms on the planet Batuu, who sold it at the Milk Stand in Black Spire Outpost. The thala-siren became part of a less common logo for Bubo Wamba Family Farms which was featured on their Novelty Drink Vessel.

name: Thalassian
summary: Thalassians were a sentient species, some of whom worked as slavers. During the reign of the Galactic Republic, the Er'Kit Senator Danry Ledwellow accepted bribes from Thalassian slavers and allowed them to operate on his species' homeworld. Around five years before the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire's 291st Legion raided a nest of Thalassian slavers on the planet Galpos II using All Terrain Defense Pods.

name: Thanrax
summary: Thanrax were creatures that were native to the moon Hubin. One thanrax chased Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, and Han Solo through a forest on Hubin before being scared away by an Thane Markona.

name: Thanu
summary: Thanu were silicavores native to the volcanoes of Kamur. They ate rocks, digesting organic materials trapped therein and expelling the crushed leftovers. The ability to eat rocks was only gained at maturity, and young survived by eating plants.

name: Tharnakan
summary: Tharnakans were sentient species from the planet Tharnaka. When Tharnaka was flooded due to storms, the Tharnakans left the planet, leaving behind the Tharnakan Story Stone. Once the floods receded, Ishbul Ekwesh was a Tharnakan who was sent to search for the Tharnakan Story Stone during the High Republic Era.

name: Thatch-sparrow
summary: A thatch-sparrow was a type of bird that flitted around when scared. In 4 ABY, the bounty hunter Jas Emari thought about how she had tracked the Imperial moneylender Arsin Crassus around the galaxy for the last month, considering his travels comparable to the scared flitting of a thatch-sparrow.

name: The Home mynock
summary: A group of silicon-based sentient invertebrates, related to mynocks, evolved on a lone asteroid in the MZX32905 system near Bimmiel. The creatures referred to their asteroid, which had been imbued with the dark side of the Force, as "the Home." They had triangular yellow eyes and some had hands on their wings. The creatures subsisted off stellar radiation and silicate materials. It is believed that the lingering dark side energies were what allowed these creatures to evolve. Presumably, it was for this reason that the creatures could not reproduce anywhere else in the galaxy than the Home, an act which they referred to as "the Return."

name: The Magys's people
summary: The Magys's people were a sentient species that resided within the Unknown Regions and hailed from the planet Sunrise. The Magys was a Force-sensitive member of the species.

name: The Warlord's species
summary: A sentient species, with a body shape that could be confused with that of an Eickarie or a Lakra's, originated in a star system in Wild Space. The Empire of the Hand confederation, which had not encountered the species, determined that the individual who ruled the planet Kariek for fifty years known as the Warlord was a member of the species instead of an Eickarie or Lakra after the Imperial stormtrooper Unit Aurek-Seven captured him on the Kariek, the Eickarie homeworld, by 22 ABY. The Hand also learnt of the species' point of origin from him and subsequently prepared to send a task force to contact the species. Shortly after, Aurek-Seven Jorm Whistler Mackenni informed the Eickarie Su-mil of their discovery and plans to establish contact with the Warlord's kind, and theorized that the Eckarie ruling body of the InterTribal Council would like to have Imperial Star Destroyers over Kariek in case that the Warlord's species attempted to attack the planet.

name: Theelin
summary: The Theelin were a rare sentient species recognizable by their brightly colored hair and spotted skin.

name: Theelin-human hybrid
summary: A Theelin-human hybrid was a sentient hybrid species that consisted of an individual that was both Theelin and human. The Max Rebo Band dancer Rystáll Sant was one such individual who was a Theelin-human hybrid, as was Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon during the High Republic Era.

name: Thelpian lizard
summary: A thelpian lizard was a type of lizard that could be served as food.

name: Themian
summary: The Themians were a sentient species of Near-Humans from the Inner Rim planet Themis. During the Clone Wars, they were ruled by Prince Lumon.

name: Thennqora
summary: The Thennqora were a sentient species from the Thennqor system that influenced Saffa paintings after their initial contact, several millennia before the Galactic Civil War. Tamish was a member of this species.

name: Theoretical Serias species
summary: New Republic scout Korren Starchaser led an expedition to the Serianan system that uncovered evidence of an advanced sentient species. Starchaser found several bits of evidence for the species's existence: the planet Serias, which was located in the same star system, was inhabited, and the Serianan Belt contained runes in various sizes that, due to the asteroids' density, suggested that they had been created by beings with access to tools that required more power to operate than anything known to Starchaser's team. Starchaser also discovered five alien statues. The scout guessed that the creators of these artifacts were humanoids but not Humans. The team gathered the statues, logged the runes, and departed to analyze their data. Afterward, a team of alien xenoarchaeologists discovered the Serianan system's mysteries and began their own analysis. A followup visit by the New Republic Scout Service discovered the independent scientists as well as prospectors who sought to exploit the asteroids. A later group of spacers was kidnapped by pirates and brought to a base that resembled one of the Serianan statues.

name: Therii
summary: A therii was a large herding creature that could be found on the planet Batuu. Elee was a therii that was the pet of Black Spire Outpost resident Salju.

name: Thermal vulture
summary: Thermal vultures were a type of vulture that could be found on the planet Coruscant. In 228 BBY, Jedi Master Elzar Mann noticed some of the vultures flying high above Coruscant's Jedi Temple while on one of the temple's balconies with Jedi Master Yoda.

name: Thernbee
summary: The thernbee was a large, white-haired, semi-sentient creature with psychic powers. Thernbees communicated in psychic visions. They lived in the mountains of Almania. Their hair fell out constantly leaving their coats patchy, and exposing pink skin. They were a playful species, sometimes toying sadistically with their prey before ultimately killing it. Their saliva was also an anesthetic that numbed their victim's senses. They were omnivorous and ate small animals, plants, and fruits. Kueller owned a few of these creatures, and one ate a ysalamir as it was emitting a Force bubble. Kueller also put Luke Skywalker in a cage with a thernbee. The thernbee actually helped Luke with the injuries he had suffered when his X-Wing exploded using the anesthetic it naturally produced in its saliva. The thernbee communicated with Luke using its psychic powers devising a way to escape. They did so, but not before being confronted by stormtrooper guards. The thernbee quickly disposed of the guards and it and Luke separated.

name: Th'er's species
summary: A species of humanoid beings resided on the forested planet Bri'n. Some members of the species held great value in the many trees that covered the world, but a faction known as the Metal Clan desired to destroy the venerated plants. During the Republic Era, the Clan conspired against Th'er, the Priestess of Wood, in order to achieve their goal. According to the laws of their people, however, the Metal Clan could not harm the trees of Bri'n without either the Priestess' permission or her blood. When negotiations between the factions turned violent, Th'er was escorted offworld to Coruscant, where Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn convinced her to seek aid from members of the galactic community.
distinctions: Horns protruding from side of head

name: Thidaxx
summary: Thidaxx also known as Tar monsters, were a species of cave-dwelling predatory creatures native to Taul. They had squirming tentacles and shark-like heads covered in eyes. At some point prior to the Battle of Takodana, a group of droids stranded on Taul were attacked by tar monsters. After ripping 2MED2 apart and destroying CO-34, the monsters snatched C-3PO's left arm, attempting to drag him away too. However, O-MR1 held onto his fellow droid, and thus the monsters were only able to rip C-3PO's left arm off.

name: Th'iruckai
summary: The Th'iruckai were a primitive, reptilian, sentient species from the planet Th'irus. They were a warlike species who had a vast knowledge of poisons. Their society was organized into tribes led by kings called Teruks. When explorers from other species reached Th'irus, the Th'iruckai tribes fought bloody battles over the advanced technology brought to their world. A group of offworld smugglers eventually learned that the Th'iruckai fought because of an ancient misunderstanding and began mediating a ceasefire between the clans.

name: Thissermount
summary: Thissermounts were a type of stump-legged creatures that lived on the Inner Rim desert planet Jakku. They possessed brittle manes of hair and were used as riding beasts by the anchorites that dwelt on the world. The orphan child Gallius Rax considered thissermounts' manes to be similar in appearance to the dried hair of the various corpses he had seen amongst the deserts of Jakku.

name: Thissp mouse
summary: The thissp mouse was a rodent native to the planet Thisspias. The sentient Thisspiasians native to the world ate live thissp mice, a practice against galactic social norms. When traveling offworld, Thisspiasians quickly adopted the more socially accepted practice of cooking their food without complaint, although many planet-born Thisspiasians were loathed to do so and it was common practice to gorge on a live mouse banquet upon returning to their homeworld.

name: Thisspiasian
summary: Thisspiasians were a serpentine species, distinguished by their long snake bodies and thick beards, that were native to the planet Thisspias. Thisspiasians had four arms, but a pair of them were often hidden beneath their clothing. Thisspiasians slept for a couple of hours per day, but their main form of rest was a type of trance that could last for minutes or hours. The trance provided neurological repair. If a Thisspiasian missed the trance, they could become emotional and irritable. Thisspiasians' tails helped them slither over the rocky environment of their natural habitat and their thick beards helped deter swarms of biting cygnats. The Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis, who had a place in the Jedi Council during the Battle of Naboo, was a Thisspiasian. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Thisspiasian Ooris Bynar worked as a bounty hunter. Codo Keburr was also a member of this species.

name: Thistlebuzzer
summary: Thistlebuzzers were a species of insect native to the desert planet of Pasaana. They were typically eaten by the oki-poki as part of their insectivorous diet.

name: Thodian
summary: Thodians were a blunt-faced sentient species that originated from the Thodia system. During the High Republic Era, at least one Thodian was present on Valo during the Nihil attack on Valo.

name: Tholothian
summary: {{Update|}} Tholothians were a species of sentient near-humans native to the planet Tholoth. They could be distinguished from typical humans by their partial colorful skin pigmentation, their scaled craniums and fleshy white, blue, or red tendrils that sprouted from their skullcaps. Jedi Masters Adi Gallia, Stass Allie, Jedi Knight Indeera Stokes, former Padawan Ty Yorrick, and the youngling Katooni were members of the species.

name: Thookah
summary: The thookah were a species of animal that had shaggy fur. The Ithorian Zorneth fed thookah the savorium herb. Thookah steaks then had the same properties as the drug itself. The first batch of thookah meat was fed to the Krozurbian War Council. They subsequently embraced peace, ending two hundred years of warfare.

name: Thorn lizard
summary: A thorn lizard was a type of lizard found on the planet Siline. In 134 BBY, during the survival level of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual on Siline, the human Lionine Graf looked out over a forest canopy around dusk and heard birds screaming and a strange, piercing cry that they thought was a thorn lizard, which they liked.

name: Thota
summary: Thota were a savage species of predatory creature native to the planet of Varl. They were considered the primary predators of the sentient t'landa Til species who also dwelt on their homeworld. The predators were capable of producing a relatively high pitch, shrill wail, the sound of which caused t'landa Till to panic and flee mindlessly. The thota's homeworld had its atmosphere destroyed in a cataclysmic event which left the planet barren and poisoned, killing most of the creatures on it. In the year 1 BBY the Rodian Sniquux used a recording of a thota's wail to panic a group of six t'landa Til priests in Colony Nine, a colony city on the planet Ylesia. The priests attempted to locate the source of the sound then fled from the noise, causing them to run into a number of monofilament wires that the Rodian had set up, which killed them. By this year the thota were considered ancient.

name: Thradian
summary: The Thradians were a species of humanoid sentients from Thrad. They had yellow skin, full black eyes, and annulated appendages that grew from the top of their skulls. Senator Nadea Tural was a female Thradian.

name: Thranta
summary: Thrantas were a large, flying species native to the planet Alderaan. As a species, they survived the destruction of their homeworld due to the relocation of some thrantas to Bespin.

name: Thranta Rider
summary: Thranta Riders, also known as wing riders, were humanoid sapients who tamed flying thrantas and rode them, performing aerial circus-like shows around the world of Bespin. They liked to paint or tattoo themselves with complex patterns. During the New Jedi Order era, Jacen Solo fell down from Cloud City while being hunted by some Black Sun followers. If not for one of the Thranta Riders that saved him, he would have fallen down and been crushed from the pressure.
distinctions: Elongated bodies, two-toed feet, four-fingered hands, colorful tattoos

name: Thraxso
summary: Thraxsos were a species of large non-sentient reptilian carnivores native to the moon Olgothon 3.

name: Three-footed noor
summary: The three-footed noor was a type of bird with three feet found on Birren, a planet in the Inner Rim Territories. During her time living with her family on Birren, the human Kata Akuna saw three-footed noors and other birds while bird-watching. Akuna eventually left Birren and, after the loss of both her parents, joined the crew of the luxury yacht Stinger Mantis in 9 BBY. While on the ship, she tried to list all of the birds she had encountered while on Birren, including the three-footed noor, which was overheard by the owner of the Mantis, Greez Dritus. Dritus asked what she was doing and, once Akuna explained, he asked for more information on the birds as he had never been to Birren; however, Akuna put off the discussion till later.

name: Throbe
summary: Throbes were small sentient creatures.

name: Thrumfrog
summary: Thrumfrogs were a type of frog that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Tarkin family members Emelsine Tarkin and Lady Krevlin Tarkin utilized a number of thrumfrogs to lure the veermok Balinta—owned by the Tarkin family head Sevran Tarkin—into Krevlin's greenhouse in Bri-Phrang City so they could use Balinta to uncover Sevran's recent actions. Afterward, Jedi Knight Qort arrived at the greenhouse and Emelsine asked him if he had any idea how many thrumfrogs it had taken the two to lure the veermok there.

name: Thuggatoris
summary: Thuggatoris was a sentient species in the galaxy. Tredgar Volk was a member of the species.

name: Thunder bat
summary: Thunder bats were a species of bat that could be found on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, the Endor-residing Ewoks Paploo and Wicket Wystri Warrick were playing drop-the-sack, attempting to drop a sack of mud on their friend Teebo. When Warrick accidentally hit his aunt Bozzie instead of Teebo, Paploo told Bozzie that the mud had been thrown by a giant flock of thunder bats.

name: Thunder lizard
summary: Thunder lizards were massive creatures native to Marca. Twelve meters long and three meters high, they were primarily aquatic herbivores, eating seaweeds in the shallows and coming on land only to mate.

name: Thunderhead hawk
summary: The thunderhead hawk was a type of hawk native to the planet Makeb. A ground-based creature known as the vrake, also native to Makeb, featured a head crest that greatly resembled the head of a thunderhead hawk, and vrakes used the crest to startle their prey—typically small rodents and birds—before pouncing on them.
distinctions: Faces similar to a vrake crest

name: Thune
summary: The thune was a large herbivorous creature with gray, wrinkled, and hard hides. Living in small herds on the grasslands of Dantooine, they were typically not aggressive; only when angered did they became dangerous opponents. Thunes were the size of a small shuttle. From the center of the thune's face hung a huge, noselike appendage, while thin, full ears circled its head like a halo. The thune could flap its ears—filled with thousands of blood vessels—in order to cool down. The cooled blood in the ears would flow through the rest of the body, lowering its overall temperature.

name: Thunian wart-hornet
summary: Thunian wart-hornets were a species of insect native to and quite commonly encountered on Thune, a planet situated in Wild Space. Wart-hornets had bloated, slimy bodies reminiscent of toads, and they had two pairs of multicolored wings akin to Gorsian dragonflies. Their backs were covered in pulsating warts that glowed aquamarine. The tongues of wart-hornets were covered in venom that caused pain and swelling in the area of the lick. When attacked, a wart-hornet would emit a high-pitched warning cry that summoned others of its kind.

name: Thurrb
summary: Thurrb were non-sentient creatures in the galaxy used as mounts around 3626 BBY. They were known to be helpful as beasts of burden. While generally friendly and docile, they had a tendency to slobber all over unsuspecting individuals who got too close to their large mouths. There were a number of Thurrb variants, including "Earthen," "Tellurian," "Brumal," and "Conflagrant" Thurrbs.

name: Thuvasaur
summary: Thuvasaurs were carnivorous predators imported to the planet Eiattu 6. The thuvasaur was not a native creature, but was transported to Eiattu specifically for sport. Due to their ability to adapt to harsh environments, they quickly killed off the local predator and moved to the top of the food chain. They were said to be a distant cousin of the dewback.
distinctions: A horn at the tip of the nose

name: Thylefire scorpion
summary: The thylefire scorpion was a type of scorpion native to the planets of E'ronoh and Eiram. While the scorpion was non-venomous on E'ronoh it was poisonous on Eiram. Although the poison of the scorpions on Eiram was survivable, Queen Adrialla successfully tried to weaponize the poison. However the production of this poison was stopped and except for a few samples, which were archived as a weapon which might be needed in a fight against future enemies, completely destroyed. On E'ronoh, the scorpion was also an important part of the culture, as it was served in food as fried scorpion and candy, as well as in drinks in the form of a red syrup extracted from the scorpion's blood. It was also an important symbol of strength for E'ronoh as the creature could survive under the harsh conditions of E'ronoh's desert. Because of this a naval squadron stationed on E'ronoh, Thylefire Squadron, also shared the creature's name.

name: Thyrsian
summary: The Thyrsians were a subspecies of the Near-Human Echani originating from the Inner Rim world of Thyrsus, defined by their differing culture and almost polar-opposite appearance to the Echani. Thyrsians were also known for their role in the development of the Force pike. The Sun Guard Sith cult arose from the Thyrsians.

name: Tibanna mynock
summary: The Tibanna mynock was a highly adaptable species of mynock that could be found on the gas giant Bespin and other planets where Tibanna gas was present. The Tibanna mynocks resembled normal mynocks, but possessed specialized gills that allowed them to breath air that was highly concentrated with toxic fumes. They also consumed Tibanna and their bodies contained pockets of the gas. In about 17 BBY, an Ugnaught inadvertently disturbed a group of six Tibanna mynocks that were perched on top of a Tibanna container in Cloud City on Bespin, causing the mynocks to attack a nearby group of Alderaanian Resistance agents.
distinctions: Ability to breath air highly concentrated with toxic fumes

name: Tibannuck
summary: Tibannucks were intelligent creatures native to the planet Bespin. There, they fed on the tibanna gas, which was then processed by their four lungs. The Tibannucks were hunted and killed when they found themselves in the core of mining operations of Cloud City, a floating settlement; in particular the queen mother was a target with a considerable price on her head.

name: Tibidee
summary: Tibidees were a type of giant silicon-based creature native to Stygeon Prime, though they could also be found on other mountainous Outer Rim planets, such as Oosalon.

name: Tibidon sand whale
summary: Tibidon sand whales, or just sand whales, were a relative of the tibidee that was native to the desert planet Tatooine. Measuring three hundred meters in length, the sand whales used their pectoral fins and a tail fluke to propel themselves through either sand or air. In 9 BBY, the sand whaling station Tibidon Station was set up to harvest meat from the corpse of a tibidon sand whale on Tatooine.

name: Tikiarri
summary: Tikiarri (sing. Tikiar) were sleek, dark, sapient predatory birds from Joralla in the Mektrun sector. The Tikiar starfighter was named after them. They were known to use the six-limbed Oslets as mounts.

name: Tikotiko
summary: A Tikotiko was a small species of creature. A batch of tikotikos hatched and infested Hap's Sap Tap after accidentally being delivered there.

name: Tima
summary: Timas were a species middle-sized, two-legged critters found on the world of Naboo, a terrestrial planet located within the Chommell sector. Their had reptavian traits and somewhat resembled the kaadu, another creature also native to Naboo. There were several subspecies of Timas, with significant phenotypical differences: some specimens sported horns while others did not, some had a short, feathered tails while others had longer, lizard-like tails. Timas came in bright shades of red, yellow, blue and green.
distinctions: Feathers, horns, long tail (depending on subspecies)

name: Tineback
summary: Tinebacks were large creatures native to the rocky planet Ruhnuk, with stouts and spiked tails. These creatures were notorious burrowers and roamed from canyons to clifftops in groups called "mixes," which ranged in size from small packs to large mobs. They were known to nest near areas with shallow but plentiful water. The Waterworks was a popular choice for them. The Tinebacks have several subspecies such as the "Knock-Kneed," the "Dulcet Tone," and the variety of the famed Essa'Mu. They were known to prey on the Irewing, thanks to their scent being particularly attractive to the strong olfactory senses of the Tineback. As a result, Tinebacks were capable of leaping great distances, as well as being able to do so high into the air. Tinebacks also rarely fed on Dewbacks due to their nutrient-rich meat, but only exceptionally fast and strong Tinebacks were capable of hunting them. Ash'ad beastmasters were known to train them. However, capturing them was notoriously difficult. In order to restrain Tinebacks, electrified durasteel nets were used in conjunction with tranquilizers.

name: Tinian
summary: The Tinians were a sentient species that existed on a planet in the galaxy. They had very sensitive skin and considered blindness to be a gift and sight to be a disability. Around 2000 BBY, the Tinians forged the Tinian Codex, a stone carving with metal inlay which could be read by touch. In 3 BBY, while at a Senate Investiture party, Kleya Marki briefly described the Tinians while removing a listening device from the Tinian Codex.

name: Tinnell
summary: The Tinnell were a felinoid species of sentients from the Mid Rim. While considered naïve, they were master mechanics with the skill to improvise repairs that made things work better than designed.

name: Tintinna
summary: The Tintinna were a hairy, rodent-faced sentient species. In 382 BBY, when the Children of E'ronoh attacked E'ronoh's mining village of U'ronoh, a tintinna family lived there.

name: Tionese
summary: The Tionese were a cultural group of humans native to the Tion Cluster. The Tionese established a proud ancient civilization within the Tion Cluster in opposition to the Galactic Republic established in the Core Worlds.

name: Tip-yip
summary: Endorian chickens, also known as tip-yip in Ewokese, were a species of birds that lived in the forests of Endor. These domesticated animals were kept by the Ewoks primarily as a source of food, and their meat was considered delicious.

name: Tiperoo
summary: A tiperoo was a diminutive creature with blue skin, two green eyes, a prominent lower jaw, and a glowing antenna. One such being was present at Akim's Munch, a street cafe located in Mos Espa while a precocious Jedi Initiate was visiting the planet Tatooine to create a songbook for Anakin Skywalker.

name: Tirginni beast
summary: Tirginni beasts were a non-sentient mammalian species native to an unsettled desert planet of the Kathol sector. Roaming the deserts, the tirginni were preyed upon by mole serpents. Noted for their distinctive odor, the tirginni's scent glands were extracted and refined to produce a perfume marketed as tirginni cologne.

name: Tirra'Taka
summary: The Tirra'Taka was an ancient dragon that lived on the planet Serenno. In ancient history, users of the dark side of the Force captured a Tirra'Taka and corrupted it to use in battle. The people of Serenno fought back, and the Tirra'Taka broke free, becoming trapped underneath the surface of the planet, becoming a Serennian legend, in which it supposedly held Serenno together. When the young Jedi initiate Dooku visited Serenno, the Tirra'Taka sensed the Force within him and awoke, causing groundquakes. Many years later, Dooku controlled the Tirra'Taka to help overthrow his brother Count Ramil, but was forced to kill it when the creature became uncontrollable.

name: Tirrith
summary: The Tirrith was a unique empathic gaseous sentient creature native to the planet Beheboth. A hive-based culture, the Tirrith was composed of individual energy wisps that shared sensations and intelligence, and could feel what the entire hive felt. Together, Tirrith hives had the ability to alter the composition of Beheboth's atmosphere, creating new weather systems or producing gases that could render other sentients unconscious. The Tirrith was reclusive and pacifistic, and its difficult-to-detect nature meant that it was years before Beheboth's Human settlers discerned the organism's intelligence and ability. However, its unique strengths caused several malefactors to attempt to exploit the Tirrith for their own ends once its power was revealed.
lifespan: Child: 1–2 years *Adolescent: 3–5 years *Adult: 6–450 years *Middle age: 451–781 years *Old: 781–1,000 years *Venerable: 1,001+ years

name: Tiss-shar
summary: The Tiss-shar were a sentient reptilian species in the galaxy. Oos-Rin-Arrek was a Tiss-shar contortionist who made a name for himself in the Gullet Gang. They were native to the Tiss'Sharl system in the Outer Rim Territories.

name: Tiss'shar
summary: The Tiss'shar were a species of predatory sentient therapod reptiles from the planet Tiss'sharl. They were comparatively strong, dexterous, and intelligent, possessing slender frames with long necks and short tails. Their mouths were filled with sharp teeth, and their eyes were dark and glassy. Members of the species were well known for their considerable business savvy, and Tiss'shar businessbeings could be found throughout the galaxy. They were also known for their cunning assassins, who were sought after for their efficiency and business-like demeanor. Tiss'shar politics were dominated by the Tiss'sharl League, a group of successful business leaders who ran Tiss'sharl's government. Tiss'shar politicians were known for their cutthroat practices, sometimes involving assassination of other members. The species was caught up in an Imperial scheme eight months after the Battle of Yavin. Ordered by Darth Vader to reduce the prices of one of their world's products, the President of the Tiss'sharl League was approached by an agent of the Rebel Alliance, only to discover that drawing out Rebels was the actual purpose behind Vader's demand.
distinctions: Long necks, sharp teeth, colorful scales, tails

name: Titan-erke
summary: Titan-erke, also known as erke, were a species of creature found on the desert planet Pasaana. The creatures had both antlers and a large, singular horn. The horns and antlers of the titan-erke could be hollowed and used to create the twinned erkehorn, a type of musical instrument.

name: Titavian
summary: The titavian, also known as the goffbird or huge goff, was a gigantic, near-legendary, reptavian native to Naboo.

name: Titterbug
summary: The Titterbugs were a species of sentient insectoids who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were small beings with four legs, two arms, and—at least in some members—an orange carapace. Their heads were large in relation to the rest of the body, the site of two large eyes, a wide mouth, two antennae, and a full head of hair. Titterbugs recognized some members of their kind as princesses, and in 3 ABY, one such Titterbug was considered as a potential wife for Vork, prince of a tribe of Gorphs who lived on Endor.

name: Tizowyrm
summary: Tizowyrms were a species of small worms bioengineered by Yuuzhan Vong alchemists that, when inserted into an ear, translated and allowed the wearer to speak alien languages. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, their advance agents used tizowyrms to communicate with the people of the galaxy when completing tasks in preparation for the coming invasion force. Throughout the conflict that followed, the Yuuzhan Vong wore tizowyrms when speaking with the residents of the galaxy.
distinctions: Ability to store large quantities of information
Allow wears to speak and understand alien languages

name: T'kkrpk
summary: The T'kkrpk were a species of sentient, long-lived insectoids. They did not begin to calculate time according to the Galactic Standard Calendar until their homeworld's Great Reconciliation circa 95 BBY; as a result, many of them did not know how old they were. Their language consisted of chittering and clicking noises. Their homeworld was defended by local defense forces, which included a female officer named T'Chttrk.

name: T'Laeem
summary: The T'Laeem were primitive amphibians native to the planet Affadar.

name: t'landa Til
summary: The t'landa Til were a massive, quadrupedal, sentient species distantly related to the Hutts.

name: Tlönian
summary: The Tlönians were a species of sentient arachnoids from the planet of Tlön in the Tlönia system. They were known for their poison-sacs and habit of preying on starships imprudent enough to cross their frontier. By the 6100s BBY, they had been exterminated by the Mandalorian Crusaders. Prior to their extinction, the Tlönians crafted a particular type of shield. By the time of the Clone Wars, one of those Tlönian shields ended up in the possession of a genetic decoy of the terrorist Zeta Magnus.

name: Toad
summary: A toad was a creature whose body was similar to that of a Thunian wart-hornet minus the wings. Luke Skywalker used the terms "toad" and "frog" interchangeably. Leia Organa once compared Emperor Palpatine to an "evil old toad." On Jelucan, youth played Lizard-toad-snake, a zero-sum hand game in which "toad" would trump "lizard."

name: Tobar's species
summary: This alien race had tentacles with suckers instead of arms. Tobar was a member of this species.

name: Toccat
summary: The toccat was a species native to the jungle planet Darlyn Boda. The creatures had four hooves, long pink snouts, and black-furred bodies. Haruspexes—fortune tellers on Darlyn Boda—made a living divining the future from the entrails of slain toccats.

name: Tocoyan
summary: The Tocoyans were a sentient species indigenous to the desert world of Tocoya, in the Ktilac Regions of the Inner Rim. Each member of the species had a hairless, domed head, a humanoid torso, two arms, and wrinkled skin. The head sported two enormous, pointed ears, two small eyes, and a curved snout. This muzzle ended in a gaping mouth with four white teeth. As one of the three member species of the Ktilac Regions, the Tocoyans shared a common culture with their galactic neighbors—the Ktilacs and the Murachaun. Each of these species controlled sixty-three systems within their region of the galaxy. The Tocoyans also shared their comrades' beliefs in the sanctity of the Ktilac Regions; any Tocoyan found abroad was thus understood to be a religious apostate, unable to ever return. Nevertheless, members of the species did make their way in the greater galaxy. For example, Neb Dulo visited the court of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure sometime during the Galactic Civil War.

name: Toe mangler
summary: The toe mangler was a species of small fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War.

name: Tof
summary: The Tof were a sentient humanoid species in the galaxy. They had green skin and were much taller than the average human. The species had potential to be quite strong as warriors, and could speak in Galactic Basic Standard. During the Fenril crisis, Anzati sorceress Reyna Oskure had several Tof soldiers in her employ on Nagi.

name: Tofallid
summary: Tofallids were a humanoid species with elongated necks. The anatomy of the protocol droid PZ-4CO was designed by the droid manufacturer Serv-O-Droid, Inc. to resemble that of Tofallids.

name: Tognath
summary: Tognath were a sentient species that were native to the planet Yar Togna. The Tognath had a striking look thanks to their insectoid and mammalian characteristics; another factor was their having both an endo- and exoskeletons. They also possessed a very primitive nervous system, which provided them with immunity to most pain (a helpful trait in combat).

name: Togorian
summary: Togorians were a sentient species of large, feline beings with digitigrade feet. Their bodies were covered in short, thick fur that could be brown, white, orange or red with stripes, and their eyes could be yellow or green with a yellow hue. Togorians had retractable claws, and were a proud race. They moved with grace and spoke with a sibilant voice. H'sishi, owner of the Amon Yinchom Dojo, was a female Togorian. The male Jedi Knight Jak'zin, who encountered Count Dooku on Sullust, was a Togorian.

name: Togruta
summary: The Togruta were a tall near-human species, characterized by their colorful skin tones, large montrals, head tails, and white facial pigments. They hailed from the planet Shili, in the Expansion Region. Although Shili was their homeworld, they also had a colony of some 50,000 individuals on the planet Kiros, also in the Expansion Region. Some well known Togruta included the Jedi Master Shaak Ti, Jedi Master Jora Malli, Supreme Chancellor Kirames Kaj, and Padawan Ahsoka Tano.

name: Toko bird
summary: Toko birds were a kind of bird eaten by the Paqwepori.

name: Tolanese
summary: The Tolanese were a sentient species from Tolan. Var'Rotha Fin'Rotha was a Tolanese.

name: Tolemite
summary: The Tolemites were a sentient species native to the Wild Space planet Tolis. Living around twenty thousand years before the High Republic Era, the Tolemites were steeped in the Force, which they worshiped as the Peace. During an expedition, the Tolemites discovered the homeworld of the Force-draining creatures later known as the Nameless, bringing some of the beings back to Tolis. However, when the Nameless were removed from their home, the creatures were transformed and corrupted by their hunger and instead fed on the Tolemites. The Nameless, as well as the affliction known as the blight, destroyed the Tolemites' civilization. The surviving Tolemites retreated, constructing three rods using Echo Stones that were used by the Three Ancients to control the Nameless, leading the creatures back to their home. Although the Tolemites were successful, the survivors numbered only several hundred, and their demise was inevitable. Some Tolemites fled aboard starships to spread the word, while the remaining members of the species constructed a new city on an island, containing a repository that would preserve their story. The Tolemites' new civilization was eventually destroyed in a flood, leaving their city and the repository underwater. Thousands of years later, the Tolemites had fallen into legend. Jedi Knight Reath Silas and former Jedi Master Cohmac Vitus investigated the Tolemites, hoping to learn their knowledge of the Nameless and the blight. The pair discovered the location of Tolis and traveled there, uncovering the Tolemites' repository.

name: Tolgroat
summary: Togroats were a sentient species that could be found in the galaxy. They had blue skin with darker blue spots and multiple appendages stemming from their head that faded into white on the ends. Togroat's eyes were yellow-orange and they had dark blue eyebrows. They also had three fingers on each hand and had no toes. One Togroat was present on the planet Chandrila on the day of the Hanna City Flight Academy end-of-year family race at some point between 8 ABY and 34 ABY. Shortly before the race began, they wore white and red clothes and a tan hat with goggles. They worked at a stall selling items touched by the Jedi Luke Skywalker.

name: Tolo
summary: The Tolos were one of two sentient species native to the Core Worlds' Panto system. Having evolved on the planet Toloran, they worked together with the amphibious Lomins of the system's first planet, Pantolomin, to create a system-wide tourist resort. On the Tolos' homeworld, they offered a range of recreational winter activities.

name: Toma
summary: The Toma were the sentient natives of the planet Oznek. They were distinguished by their green fur, yellow eyes, and brown skin.

name: Tomith Garbis' species
summary: Tomith Garbis and his family belonged to a species of tall humanoids with a bald cranium, whitish skin with black patterns, five-fingered hands and slit nostrils. While males of the species were broad-shouldered, the females were more spindly.

name: Tonitran
summary: The tonitran was a large non-sentient lizard native to the planet Makeb. Tonitran lizards stood on two legs and had yellow skin with green markings on their back. Juvenile tonitran lizards were known as coppi lizards.

name: Tooka
summary: Tookas, also called tooka-cats or Adoris Felines, were a subspecies of feline cats. They were popular as pets as the carnivores ate many unwanted pests, but were also considered by many to be feral nuisances themselves. When properly trained, they could be excellent hunters of pests. One specific breed of tooka was the Loth-cat, native to the planet Lothal. Tooka were known to enjoy milk. Tooka were common in the underworld of Coruscant, where they hunted nuna.

name: Tooke
summary: Tookes were creatures that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Batuu in the forests near the ancient ruins. Tooke tracks were visible in the dirt around Black Spire Outpost during the occupation of the planet by the First Order in 34 ABY and were included in a scavenger hunt created by the Amani Bina, owner of the local Creature Stall.
distinctions: Two legs ending in clawed paws

name: Toong
summary: The Toong were a sentient species of bipeds with a unique appearance that were native to the planet Tund. They possessed long legs and arms, several skin colors, and a large head located where the torso would normally be in humanoids. One famous Toong was Ben Quadinaros, a podracer who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic.

name: Toothspike raptor
summary: The toothspike raptor was a creature native to the planet Colla IV. The bell-shaped hull of the Droch-class boarding ships used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems produced by the Colicoid Creation Nest were loosely based on toothspike raptors.

name: Tordich Envlo's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tordich Envlo was a member of this species.

name: Tordusian
summary: Tordusians were a sentient species that lived on the planet Tordus.
distinctions: Spikes on head, neck and shoulders

name: Torphlusian
summary: The Torphlusian were a tentacled sentient species that lived in the galaxy in 5 ABY. One such Torphlusian represented their homeworld Torphlus in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic.

name: Tortapo
summary: The tortapo was a six-legged tortoise that was one of the last surviving species on Bonadan, which had lost most of its wildlife due to heavily-polluted environments. It was capable of retracting it's head into its shell.

name: Tortle
summary: Tortles were a species of a shelled creature found on the planet Palagosal.

name: Torton
summary: Tortons were red and green testudines with long legs. They originated on Naboo's moon of Rori. A species called the tortur, almost completely identical to the torton, lived on the planet Talus. The only notable difference between the two species was their skin pigmentation. Though not normally aggressive, these massive creatures (equivalent in size to a Fambaa) would put up quite the fight when challenged. There also lived pygmy torton variations.

name: Tortur
summary: The tortur were large quadrupedal beasts native to Talus. Torturs were a close genetic cousin of the torton of Rori. They had a large back shell, as well as four other plates of hard body armor. Two short horns grew from their snout, in a vertical fashion. Both their skin and armor plating came in hues of either red or green.

name: Tosarvi
summary: The Tosarvi were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Sarria was a member of this species.

name: Tostonian
summary: The Tostonians were a sentient bipedal species. Members of the species had large, round, black eyes and mottled pink skin. They possessed two arms ending in three-fingered hands with sharp claws. In 9 BBY, a male Tostonian who spoke an alien language worked on the planet Daiyu, at the spice laboratory known as the Den. The human Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi followed the Tostonian and acquired his clothing, which the Jedi then used to infiltrate the Den.

name: Toxic peko-peko
summary: The Toxic Peko-peko was a creature raised and mutated by the outlaw Cornelius Evazan. He conducted experiments on peko-pekos from the planet of Naboo, hoping to create invincible creatures that would act as his protectors and mounts.

name: Toydarian
summary: Toydarians were a sentient, winged species from the planet Toydaria in Hutt Space. In addition to their ability to fly, Toydarians were physically defined by their long snouts and webbed feet, and could resist mental manipulation from the Force. During the Clone Wars, the Toydarians were ruled by King Katuunko. The Toydarians were, for a time, neutral during the Clone Wars, before eventually siding with the Galactic Republic.

name: Tra'cor
summary: Tra'cors were the amphibious cousins of the rancor native to Socorro. Though smaller and almost completely waterbound, tra'cor shared most of the rancor's traits, including its hostile temperament. While the tra'cor could survive on the underwater grasses and mosses of Socorro, they would consume meat whenever the opportunity presented itself, waiting within Socorro's water cellars to trap mutriok and other creatures that came to drink. Tra'cors could also move on land, but remaining out of water for more than 24 hours would result in severe dehydration. They were rarely caught on land long enough to die of dehydration, however, as they were equipped with special glands on their necks that allowed them to locate nearby water sources. In fact, tra'cors often migrated across land from one water pool to another when it was necessary to find a new grotto. Tra'cors rarely lived in groups of more than two or three, although most were usually solitary.

name: Trailian
summary: The Trailians were a sentient, humanoid species of great beauty. Native to the Outer Rim planet Trailia, they had developed a low technology society by the time of the New Republic. During that period, Cronal, one of the Emperor's Hands, established a laboratory on the planet and experimented on Trailian subjects, turning the once peaceful and docile individuals into ferocious warriors. Those creations were unleashed on nearby worlds before being defeated by a group of offworlders.

name: Trakkrrrn
summary: The trakkrrrn was a type of creature native to the forest planet Kashyyyk, homeworld of the sentient Wookiees. The creature had naturally spicy meat that was cooked on the bone and served with sauce to make the dish Barbecued Trakkrrrn Ribs. The Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs claimed that cooking the meat slowly at a low heat was the best way to bring the spiciness to the surface, and included a recipe for Barbecued Trakkrrrn Ribs in his second cookbook, The Life Day Cookbook, which was released at some point after his first cookbook was published in 34 ABY. Tuggs claimed that the dish would leave any Wookiee satisfied, as he never seen them eat anything faster then they did a plate of Barbecued Trakkrrrn Ribs.

name: Trandoshan
summary: Trandoshans, also called T'doshok, were large, bipedal reptilian sentient humanoids from the planet Trandosha, and were renowned as great hunters. Trandoshans relished the thrill of a hunt, and were known to embark on a hunting related rite of passage. They were also famous for their ability to regenerate limbs and heal effectively. Garnac was a Trandoshan hunter who operated a game preserve on the moon Wasskah, and oversaw his son's fatally failed rite of passage, which was done in the form of hunting a Jedi Padawan. One of the most feared bounty hunters in the galaxy was a Trandoshan known as Bossk, who pulled jobs for various organizations, including the Galactic Empire. Other notable Trandoshans included the Jedi Master Sskeer and the information broker and cantina owner Ciddarin Scaleback.

name: Tranthebar mountain ripper
summary: The tranthebar mountain ripper was a species of bird of prey that possessed a wingspan of over five meters, and was native to the Mid Rim planet of Tranthellix. Captured beasts were trained by local hunters or used in illegal races throughout the Core, with racers strapped beneath them. They were often smuggled offworld.

name: Trantor pigeon
summary: The trantor pigeon was a type of gray bird that lived on Coruscant and Trantor.

name: Trappu
summary: Trappus were large reptiles native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Dalna. The Dalnans typically used them to pull wagons when the planet's few landspeeders were otherwise occupied. Some of Dalna's more remote farmers also claimed trappus could sense groundquakes. Dalnan security chief Tracer Lore recommended to Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh that she ride a trappu when she was planning an expedition to the Maawat Mountains to investigate possible Nihil activity in the area.

name: Trash crab
summary: Trash crabs were a hermit crab-like species of crabs that roamed the planet Lanupa, where they scavenged and wore pieces of technological scrap. Trash crabs then were able to communicate, although very limited, with the technology they scavenged; this was because they were capable of mimicking sounds such as basic speech. The human Wim believed this was a sign they were sentient. One gigantic member of the species was Tet'niss. Trash crabs were similar to the scrap crabs of the Outer Rim planet Trionak.

name: Trash rat
summary: A trash rat was a type of rat. Around 3 ABY, Tasu Leech—a member of a crew led by the bounty hunter T'onga—killed the Pyke Syndicate gangster Omel Sampak after learning the reality of a bombing Sampak had been responsible for, as well as a number of insults the Pyke had made towards him. After being confronted by members of the crew about his actions, Leech attempted to play it down by stating it was good that they had been paid in advance, to which T'onga reminded Leech that Sampak had been their client. Leech apologized, before noting that Sampak was a "kriffin trash rat." T'onga agreed Sampak was a trash rat, but added that he had been a paying trash rat.

name: Trawaki
summary: The Trawaki were a small cave-dwelling sentient species native to the world Rushan IX that spoke the Trawak language. The species evolved on its world independently of all other life. The Trawaki eventually went extinct over a thousand years before the Imperial Era, and their language subsequently died.

name: Tree-burrower
summary: Tree-burrowers were a species that lived in the canopies of Kashyyyk's forests.

name: Tree cow
summary: Tree cows were a type of massive cow found on the astronomical object Holpern. By around 161 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Indara traveled to Holpern and gasped when she saw tree cows there. Around 160 BBY, when Indara, by then a Jedi Knight, arrived on the planet Ingae, she was stunned by its beauty and recalled other marvels she had seen on her travels, including tree cows, but felt that none of them had prepared her for the planet's beauty.

name: Tree-goat
summary: The tree-goat was a type of goat. Roxi, a resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, owned a tree-goat, which often had to be rescued from the roof of her neighbor's house.

name: Tree
summary: The Trees were an ancient species of sentient, though non-animate plants. The myth "The Silent Circle" tells the story of how the Trees, the Fae and the Beasts once lived in harmony on Batuu.

name: Tree-tick
summary: Tree-ticks were parasites that lived in the trees of Yavin 4. Woolamanders were one of the animals that they preyed on.

name: Tree viper
summary: Tree vipers were venomous serpents from the jungles of Najarka. Their bite caused paralysis; individuals paralyzed by the venom had to receive a general anti-toxin within eight minutes to avoid irreversible brain damage.

name: Treefrog
summary: Treefrogs were a type of frog that could be found on the rainforest moon Felne 6. While on Felne 6 in 228 BBY, Jedi Knights Burryaga Agaburry and Bell Zettifar walked through the moon's forest, with the former noticing when they entered a relatively quiet area of the woodland that had no treefrogs making noise.

name: Tren
summary: The Tren were a species of sentient humanoids with tough, hairless, blue-purple skin and simple facial features. Members of the species sought order in their society, a pursuit that sometimes impeded their judgment of right and wrong. The Tren colonized three worlds, including Nopsin. During the Galactic Civil War, the Tren were initially divided over whether to support the Galactic Empire or the Alliance to Restore the Republic. As the Tren colonies swore their allegiance to the Empire one after another, a resistance movement sprung up to oppose the New Order. When Nopsin voted to join the Empire, the species had become completely integrated into the Empire. Nevertheless, the resistance continued, at least at the individual level. One such Rebel sympathizer was the Tren Opit-Wenbruh, who finished his commission in the military and joined the Rebel Alliance. He served as a member of Scandium Team and Brace Team as a heavy weapons specialist.

name: Tresher
summary: Treshers were large seabirds which nested on the coastal cliffs of the planet Tinallis. They fed on fish and other aquatic animals, especially the blue-ringed sea crab.

name: Treton
summary: Tretons were vicious beasts native to the planet of Aesolian.

name: Treveel
summary: The treveel was a species native to the planet Cato Neimoidia.

name: Trianii
summary: The Trianii were a species of bipedal felinoid sentients from the Trian system. In an attempt to impress a Trianii debutante, Lando Calrissian once took a swing at the Esoomian brawler Bumblethunk, who beat him down and stole the Smuggler's Guide from him.

name: Tribis
summary: Tribis were small bipedal reptilian creatures native to Ossus.

name: Triffian
summary: Triffians were a sentient species with yellow eyes and black, blue, yellow, and cream skin native to Triffis. The podracer Ebe E. Endocott was a Triffian.

name: Triggerbird
summary: Triggerbirds were native to Bespin, where they lived in symbiosis with beldons. The birds lived in the gas creatures' tentacles for shelter and ate small creatures.

name: Trigha
summary: Trigha were a non-sentient species of large reptilian predators that were native to the jungles of Ord Vaxal. Trigha possessed green scaly hides that were often mottled with dark stripes and spots. They hunted in family units and bellowed when moving through underbrush in order to flush out prey. Their preferred hunting tactic was to emit a high-pitched shriek when spotting prey to alert the rest of its pack. They would then chase the prey with single-minded aggressiveness, having little regard for their own safety. A trigha inadvertently rescued Lando Calrissian and Han Solo from a band of Imperial stormtroopers while they were on Ord Vaxal.

name: Trilark
summary: Trilarks were a type of creature that could be found on the mudfields of Bororn. During the High Republic Era, the former Jedi Ty Yorrick and Segredo Drewen Qweebjillan fought such a beast, bringing trophies from their kill back to members of the local population.

name: Trill beast
summary: The trill beast was a small, dangerous species of animal from the planet Breshig, located in the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. A smuggler once left a sound chip of a pre-recorded trill beast inside their T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor to scare away customs officers onboard the luxury liner Alamintari. The smuggler was hiding ten kilograms of rare Garcornian spice inside.

name: Trinitaur
summary: A trinitaur was a creature that roamed beneath the surface of Mandalore, following the Great Purge of Mandalore. One trinitaur attacked and destroyed a langskib when a scouting party of Mandalorians traveled to the Great Forge, attempting to retake their homeworld.

name: T'rinn
summary: The T'rinn were a sentient species with bright plumage and claws, and a body plan which allowed them to wield a shoulder-mounted missile launcher. In 2 BBY, one female T'rinn worked as a mining technician within the criminal mining operation of the Human J'uoch on the planet Dellalt. She was killed when the operation was attacked by the Guardian Corps, a brigade of war-robots under the control of a group known as the Survivors, who feared that J'uoch was a threat to them.

name: Trinovate
summary: The Trinovates were a sentient species with three eyes. They were native to Trinovat, a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Gordian Reach sector, located on the Junction-Tierell Loop. Their homeworld was verdant, with numerous farms and mines. In 2 ABY, the Trinovate Pilliask was present on the planet Toprawa, playing the card game Seven card comet against the Human Havet Storm. The Trinovate was almost out of credits and was preparing to call for the next round to be a "Tail game"—wherein credits from the "Comet tail" or pot were added to the credits available to win that round—when another player beat him to the call.

name: Trinthan prowler
summary: Trinthan prowlers were a non-sentient feline species native to the Trinith system. After their discovery, these deadly cat-like creatures were sold across the galaxy for use as trained hunters and trackers. Due to their savage behavior and given some incidents where bystanders were badly mauled, the Republic made prowler breeding illegal and almost all the creatures were released into the wild. They could be found on a great many planets, such as Quesh, where their predatory skills allowed them to hunt smaller and slower creatures and, sometimes, also to attack sentients who were unlucky enough to find themselves near one of these beasts. The spleen of individuals found on Quesh was specialized to filter radioactive materials from their bloodstream, and, for unknown reasons, was extremely similar to the spleen of a Geo Beast native to Oricon.

name: Tripion
summary: The tripion was a crustaceous species with three venomous tail stingers and over 600 different subspecies. They were best suited to live in the deserts of hot worlds, including the moons Gall and Yavin 13, with the species' diet consisting of small lizards and insects.
height: Less than 1 meter and up to 18 meters

name: Tripod
summary: The "Tripods," as they were dubbed by Luke Skywalker, were a sentient species of three-legged, triocular beings with sac-like bodies. They had long yellow fur around their hips and tentacles, as well as shadings of pink and turquoise. They were indigenous to an Imperial planet in the Outer Rim, on the route from Pzob to Belsavis. A number of them were taken prisoner aboard the Eye of Palpatine, though they were able to resist being brainwashed by Imperial agents. Their needs were taken care of by a gentle Talz. The Protocol droid C-3PO and Luke Skywalker were unable to identify their species by proper name. Primitive beings not familiar with galactic civilization, they referred to themselves simply as "the People" and their homeworld as "the World."

name: Tris
summary: The tris was a species of six-legged animal that was native to the world of Coyn in the Elrood sector and employed by the Coynites as mounts. They could grow up to 3.5 meters long and 2 meters tall at the shoulder. From childhood, a Coynite was paired with a tris that became his companion and with which they were said to have a spiritual bond. The Coynite who rode the tris is called its kars'asruul which translated as "soulrider". The kars'asruul braids the tris's mane to match his own and often paints runes of their accomplishments on the animal side. The tris were headstrong and very difficult to ride by others that are not their kars'asruul. They were predatory animals with fangs and red pupil-less eyes which made them an intimidating sight. Thaddeus Ross once delivered a baby tris to Tatooine.

name: Tritonite
summary: The Tritonites were an insectoid species from the moons of Triton. They were followers of Gactimus, and as acolytes they were a common sight in spaceports around the galaxy, offering tracts to individuals for their personal enlightenment. They operated the Triton Moons, famous as checkpoints.

name: Trizz Vezcro's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Trodatome
summary: The Trodatome were a sentient species. While they had no arms, they possessed prehensile sensory antennae and flippers. The Trodatome Klaud worked as a mechanic in the Resistance. At least one Trodatome, Gido, was present on the planet Koboh in 9 BBY.

name: Troglof
summary: The Troglof were a rare sentient species with tentacle-like arms native to Troglofa. A diminutive species, the Troglof had a pleasant natural odor. Troglofs could also move their eyestalks independently. Thamm was a Troglof who worked as a croupier in the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight. Another Troglof worked as a spa attendant and waiter at the Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa on Lanupa.

name: Trogodile
summary: Trogodiles were a species from the planet Rattatak.

name: Trogwhale
summary: Trogwhales were a non-sentient species of horned animals from the planet Kintan in the Kintan system of the Si'Klaata Cluster in Hutt Space. The species evolved over several thousand years due to mutations caused by a large dose of radiation which originated from M'dweshuu, a star located at the heart of the Si'Klaata cluster, going nova. The species was immense in size and were considered fearsome monsters. Due to the threat the trogwhales posed the sentient Nikto species, who were also native to Kintan, the Nikto drove them to extinction.

name: Troig
summary: Troigs were a sentient species that was native to the planet Pollillus. They had two heads, each head having its own personality and temperament. Both heads shared the same awareness, therefore they were very alert and observant. Troigs were a very clever and curious species, able to learn many languages and produced plenty of great scientists. Both heads of a Troig had individual names but they could be combined for clarity. For example, the great podracing announcer Fodesinbeed was an amalgamation of the two heads, Fode and Beed. Fode and Beed provided commentary on the sport in two different languages. Their natural habitat was forest or jungle.

name: Troiken indictidile
summary: The Troiken indictidile was a predatory, non-sentient insect species native to the jungle planet Troiken. They curled into a ball and rolled through undergrowth in order to impale prey on the irregularly shaped spikes that covered their long, thin bodies. The insects had black skin and an orange eye located at one end of their body. The Tynnan Bowspritz, who served as both a Jedi Master and a biologist, included information about indictidiles in the "Galactic Bestiary" chapter of The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force, a book given to students of the Jedi Order that was published around the year 990 BBY.

name: Troithe sewer rat
summary: Troithe sewer rats were a species that lived on Troithe. Comparing someone to a Troithe sewer rat was a saying used in the galaxy.

name: Trollbane
summary: Trollbane were a predatory species native to the planet Weik in Wild Space.

name: Trome
summary: Tromes were small humanoid beings found on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were characterized by their small size, high voices, and large beards. Despite their small size, their favorite sport was wrestling; they had wrestling tournaments annually.

name: Tromonid
summary: Tromonids were creatures, native to the planet Rywin, imbued with a fatal bite. Months after their discovery, they infested five planets due to their high reproduction rate. At one time, Jabba Desilijic Tiure dealt with Gaar Suppoon where one of these creatures was a trade item. Later, Jabba found, with a gleam of rage, that Suppoon had actually given him a sterile member of the species. Jabba later released the creature, which bit Suppoon. The Hutt, of course, used the situation to his advantage, forcing Suppoon to give him all his trade items in exchange for a cure.

name: Trompa
summary: Residing most often in forested areas, the trompa was a shaggy, powerful monster with foot-long claws. The creature's physiology links it to the wampa, to which it appeared to be a distant cousin. Despite its carnivorous urges, the beast did not prove to be a cunning hunter, and trompas randomly attacked whatever creature happened to be closest. The trompa was a very solitary creature, and was mildly intelligent, despite its hunting habits.

name: Trontoshell
summary: The trontoshell was an extremely large species of animal that resided on the planet Koboh. They had brown skin with a green, turtle-like shell on their backs, a prominent fin on their heads, and long necks. One trontoshell was spotted by Cal Kestis and BD-1 after they crash-landed on Koboh in 9 BBY.

name: Troos armored crebik
summary: Armored crebiks were predatory arthropods native to Troos's subarctic forests. Their thick shells were heavy, and they hunted other arthropods by hanging from trees and falling on and crushing prey passing below.

name: Trooshti
summary: The trooshti were a species of flying insect native to the planet Tatooine where they existed in small number of colonies. With their four wings and sharp eyesight, trooshti were experts at preying on smaller insects. They were a rare sight on Tatooine and were usually shy of larger creatures and remained close to their hives. However, trooshti could venture further afield in search of prey when necessary. They could also swarm into vast, fast-moving columns in order to deter predators. Trooshti appeared to be at least semi-sentient, utilizing pumps to obtain water on the desert world, and possibly responding to attempts to verbally negotiate with them. In 32 BBY, Jar Jar Binks spotted a trooshti stealing a battery charger from Anakin Skywalker's podracer and pursued the insect, gaining Padmé Amidala's reluctant help. Jar Jar managed to capture the original thief with his extendable tongue, but it passed the charging unit to another trooshti. The two commandeered a speeder to chase the insect into the Tatooine desert and escape two angry Gamorreans that Jar Jar had clumsily run into. While in pursuit, Jar Jar threatened the captured insect, however Padmé stopped him, arguing that civilized beings needn't resort to violence. Though unsure if it could understand her, she promised it's safety until they had re-obtained the charger and offered the idea of negotiating for its return. The chase lead the group to an abandoned moisture farm where the trooshti colony had used an underground pump to create a small oasis of water. There they learned that the pump was malfunctioning and the colony appeared to be using the charger to attempt to re-prime it. Padmé offered to help repair the pump if the colony would return the charger and also protect her from the Gamorreans, who had just arrived on the scene. While the trooshti swarmed the Gamorreans, Padmé worked on the pump and got it working just as the warriors slipped into the water, surprised by Jar Jar resurfacing in the water. The large wave resulting from the pump suddenly starting washed the Gamorreans away. However, instead of directly giving them the charger, the Trooshti took off with it again. Jar Jar and Padmé chased them again to find they had returned the charger to the podracer. Padmé speculated that they may have intended to do so all along.

name: Troukree
summary: The Troukree were a reptilian sentient species, native to their homeworld in the Unknown Regions. Some of them served Thrawn in his fight against Nuso Esva on Poln Major, using their prowess with blades in close-quarters combat. They had a strong belief in an honor system. Several Troukree fought alongside renegade stormtrooper Daric LaRone and his Hand of Judgment as well.

name: Trout
summary: Trout were a kind of fish on the forest moon of Endor. The native Ewoks would sometimes go fishing to catch trout to eat. A fur-bearing variety existed on Paulking XIV.

name: Troxan
summary: The Troxans were a sentient species native to the planet Troxar in the Expansion Region. They had gills on their necks that fluttered and vibrated to convey emotion. Gill patterns varied from individual to individual, so much so that those olfactory organs were used as identity markers by Troxan security devices, such as incendiary packets. At least part of the Troxan government was known as the Benevolence of Troxar, itself a bureaucratic organization that featured departments such as the Bureau of Patriotic Defense and posts such as the under-palatine for patriotic liaisons and the first diplomatic legatee. During the Clone Wars, the Troxans sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. However, as the Grand Army of the Republic gained the upper hand against the Troxans and inflicted severe damage on the species' homeworld, the Troxans considered suing for peace. The species sent a delegation to the Republic, but their appeals were rebuffed. They then hatched a new plan: to pretend to surrender only to mount an insurrection once the Republic recalled most of the troops it had sent to subdue the world. However, at a summit on the planet Vjun with the Separatist Head of State Count Dooku—actually the Sith Darth Tyranus—the Count planted suggestions in the Troxans' minds to keep them fighting—little did they know that Darth Sidious, the mastermind behind the war and Dooku's Sith Master, wanted their world to continue fighting so as to drain the resources of the Republic army.

name: Truffleboar
summary: The truffleboar was a species of pig-like creature, similar in appearance to a small happabore. Dolin, a farmer who lived on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, owned a pet truffleboar named Waba.

name: Trunk ripper
summary: Trunk rippers were arboreal mammals who tore into trees in search of insects. They could reach lengths of two meters. They had dual foreclaws, a toothed snout, and prehensile tail.

name: Trunsk
summary: The Trunsks were a species of sentient mammals native to the planet Trunska. Descended from predators, Trunsks were stout, fur-covered bipeds with large ears and nostrils, well adapted to their cold, thin-atmosphere homeworld. Their wide, tusked mouths, vestigial horns, and sharp fighting claws gave them a fearsome appearance. Trunsks typically had a gruff temperament, and they were paranoid toward outsiders and strangers. As the species progressed from agricultural settlements along rivers to continent-spanning empires, Trunsk warlords continually feuded with each other. Eventually, the planet was unified by Tyl the Deplorable. By this point, the Trunsks had developed information-age technology. Without wars to slow their progress, they rapidly developed hyperspace technology and joined the Galactic Republic. When the Galactic Empire came to power, the Trunsks lost their freedom, becoming one of many legally designated slave species. The Trunsk ruler, Emperor Belgoa, became an Imperial puppet who publicly denounced the enslavement of his people but secretly allowed the Empire to take slaves—especially Belgoa's political enemies. The slave trade continued, although the defiant nature of Trunsks made them unpopular among buyers and sellers. Even free Trunsks on Trunska were not allowed access to armed spacecraft or personal weapons, a law strictly enforced by Belgoa's police.
