The indignities of slavery drove many Trunsks to join the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Sully Tigereye was one example: he escaped from a life lived in a cage to join the Rebel Red Alpha team as fire support. After a distinguished career that continued as the Alliance became the New Republic, the Trunsk resigned to follow his commanding officer, Colonel Andrephan Stormcaller, into a mercenary band known as the Red Moons. With this group, Tigereye continued to fight a remnant faction of the Empire, the Pentastar Alignment.

name: Trypto Buball's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Trypto Buball was a member of this species.

name: Tsaelke
summary: Tsaelke were a type of long-necked, graceful cetaceans from Chad. They were used as mounts by farmers on the planet to tend their herds. The creatures had barrel shaped bodies, long necks and small heads. They could carry up to 75 kilograms. Callista Ming designed her lightsaber hilt with a bronze inlay of several of these creatures to remind her of her homeworld.
skinColor: Bronze with a unique pattern of stripes, spots and rings

name: T'sarki
summary: The T'sarki were a seal-like species native to Kalishik in the Gordian Reach sector. They were generally regarded as a friendly species, but were quick to take offense at what they perceived to be routine dishonesty and swindling at the hands of other species. They played a part in the industry of the Back Reach; they regularly sought work permits for the factories of Feldwes, and the mining venture on the planet Usta was a joint venture between the T'sarki and the inhabitants of the Arda system. The gambler Groomert, who played in a game of seven card comet with the Trinovate Pilliask and the Humans Havet Storm and Vain, was a T'sarki.

name: Tsevukan
summary: The Tsevukans were a sentient, if ferocious, species that hailed from the planet of Tsevuka, in the Outer Rim Territories. They rode meters-tall creatures called kivaroa. After the Galactic Empire took possession of their home planet, the Tsevukans attempted to resist. Although the general responsible for the conquest had told Wilhuff Tarkin, Grand Moff and governor of the Outer Rim, that the planet was pacified, the Tsevukans were still a threat to the Empire when Tarkin himself came to investigate.

name: Tsil
summary: Tsil, also known as Spook-Crystals or Smokies, were mineral-based life forms that resided on the planet of Nam Chorios. Oldtimers, descendants of the planet's original Human settlers, gave the Tsils their names and nicknames, and were unaffected by the electrical storms they produced. Offworlders caught in the five-to-ten minute electrical storms that the Tsils created, were left sick for about a day and a half. The Guardian crystals were the largest of all the crystal variants; this made them capable of controlling the smaller crystals. As Luke Skywalker discovered, Tsils could reflect and amplify light and life energy. This increased the Force sensitivity on Nam Chorios, and the slightest use of the Force on the planet would set off a wild Force storm. Tsils communicated via telepathy by putting images in another's mind. Oldtimer religious leaders known as "Listeners" could hear these "voices." One apparently had to be Force-sensitive to understand a Tsil. The Tsils warned the Oldtimer prophet Theras that the drochs which inhabited the planet were the cause of the terrible Death Seed plague. Drochs were weakened by light, so the Tsils' ability to amplify light rendered drochs harmless on Nam Chorios. A number of Tsils were taken offworld for commercial and industrial exploitation. They were officially designated for use in filtering light for K-Class planets, but their primary purpose was to function as the core component of Centrally Controlled Independent Replicant systems in the CCIR Needle and synthdroid projects undertaken by Loronar Corporation. The reprogramming process used to harness a Tsil for these purposes was considered an atrocity by the Tsils. Tsils offered the solution to the Death Seed plague to Leia Organa Solo if she made sure all the Tsils thus enslaved were returned. She agreed, and most of the Tsils were returned to Nam Chorios after containing the droch threat. In 44 ABY, Sith apprentice Vestara Khai killed a Tsil during a battle against the dark side entity Abeloth in order to create a death convulsion, which harmed Abeloth in the process while also allowing her and her Jedi allies to escape.

name: T'surr
summary: The T'surr were a sentient species indigenous to the planet of T'surr. T'surr were rarely seen in the galaxy. The species was among the galaxy's most dangerous predators, although their relative scarcity made them less threatening. One of the most famous T'surr was the notorious pirate and slave trader Krayn. Although their level of technology did not meet the galactic standard, T'surr capably used technology scavenged from the ships of their victims.

name: Tsyklen
summary: Tsyklen were a sentient species native to the planet Tsyk in Hutt Space. The species had exceptional vision and nimble hands of nine digits each. The Tsyklen were considered wily, and the Hutt species saw them as a prized client species. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Yuuzhan Vong invaders attacked the Tsyklen homeworld.
distinctions: Taut skin, round shape, large eyes, nimble hands

name: T'Syriél
summary: The T'Syriél were tall, muscular humanoids native to the planet Shiva IV. United into the Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél, the T'Syriél were ancient rivals of the Human Calian Confederacy, with which they warred for generations en route to building a strong and respected warrior tradition. In 2 ABY, those battles were brought to an end with the signing of the Concordat of Peace, although many disaffected T'Syriél were used as troops by Imperial General Bentilais san Sk'ar's attempt to conquer the world.

name: Tu-Scart
summary: Tu-Scart was a serpentine bio-engineered beast created by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong during their invasion of the galaxy. His name literally translated as 'slithering smasher', although he was also known as 'Beater'. He was part of a symbiotic pair known as 'Biter and Beater' with the other being, Sgauru.

name: Tuareg
summary: Tuaregs were two-meter tall equine quadrupeds used as mounts by the Nocivs of Kadril.

name: Tuash'aa
summary: The Tuash'aa was a giant bird native to the planet Kesh. There was said to be Two, a light one and A Dark One.

name: Tuggle
summary: Tuggle were carnivorous animals native to the planet Toola and used by the Whiphids to draw their sledges. They were lightly colored, long, thin animals with four short powerful legs and covered with sleek thick fur. They were very strong animals for their size. Six tuggle tethered to a sledge in parallel could pull two Whiphids. In the wild, tuggle were pack animals and they used their great stamina to drive down their prey. Domesticated animals were capable of pulling a sledge all day with only a couple of breaks, if fed correctly for several days at a time. They were popular among Rebel SpecForce arctic wilderness fighters.

name: Tuhgri
summary: The Tuhgri were a sentient species native to the planet Ehjenla in the Kathol Outback.
distinctions: Diamond shaped nose with four nostrils

name: Tuk'ata
summary: Tuk'ata were a species of creatures classified as a Sith warbeast. Also known as Sith hounds, they could be found on Moraband.
distinctions: Sharp claws and fangs, long tail, spined back

name: Tulakt's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tulakt was a member of the species.

name: Tulgah
summary: Tulgah were a sentient species introduced to the moon of Endor at some point.

name: Tulli Mu's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tulli Mu was a member of the species.

name: Tulrus
summary: Tulrus were large egg-laying beasts which could mainly be found roaming on and around the Tulrus Nesting Grounds on Mustafar, void of all other species except the jundak. For safety reasons, the tulrus usually traveled in small packs of two or more, and were very protective, and therefore aggressive if provoked. Their tusks were made from ivory. Legends claimed that a tulrus was trapped in an ancient Republic facility and had grown to a great size and strength. It was never proven true, for everyone who had entered the facility never came out alive. Swords could also be constructed from their bodies. Due to their sheer size, the tulrus were very dangerous creatures, but they were not particularly smart. Due to their poor eyesight and bad temper, they often charged the instant they detected the presence of anything other than themselves. When attacking they used their large mass to knock their enemies off their feet, and then trample them to their death. Sometime following 0 BBY, one particularly ferocious tulrus named Foehorn attacked several miners. Chief Ulon Glost of the Mensix Mining Company hired a number of hunters to try to kill the beast. [[File:MagmaHorn.jpg|200px|thumb|The magma horn was very similar in appearance to a normal tulrus.]]

name: Tulvaree
summary: Tulvarees were a species of semi-sentient avian hunters native to the planet of Pochi. Each of their wings was tipped with three razor-sharp talons, and their small mouths were filled with sharp teeth. There were a number of different Tulvaree tribes, which engaged in intense warfare with each other. When the Human pirate Faarl the Conqueror took control of their homeworld, the Tulvarees quickly learned how to take orders from the warlord. Faarl, recognizing a source of soldiers, provided a constant food supply to the Tulvarees in exchange for their allegiance.

name: Tumble Bunny
summary: Tumble Bunnies were three-eared rabbits. On the Forest Moon of Endor, Tumble Bunnies were taught by a trainer to do tricks at a carnival to the delight of young Ewoks; as punishment for scaring those woklings, the Ewok Wicket Warrick had to perform several Tumble Bunny shows.

name: Tumblebasker
summary: Tumblebaskers were a species that lived in the underwater seatree forests of the Mkbuto Seatree Preserve on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dac. Along with needlefish, blossoming gulpers, and seatrees, tumblebaskers were a part of the region's delicate ecosystem.

name: Tumnor
summary: Tumnors were a species of large flying predators that lived on the fifth moon of the planet Da Soocha, which was located in the Cyax system of Hutt Space. With a five meter wing span the creatures could fly and were able to attack prey with both their teeth and claws. Tumnor hunted the sentient Ixll species also native to their homeworld and were especially fond of devouring their young. Due to their role as the species natural hunters the Tumnor featured prominently in Ixll legend and always took on an evil and merciless role. Whilst the New Republic maintained a presence on the moon during the Operation Shadow Hand part of the Galactic Civil War in 10 ABY, Republic scientists stationed their never actually sighted a Tumnor. Dar Soocha V was destroyed in 10 ABY by the Galaxy Gun, a world–devastating Imperial super weapon.

name: Tunda Ress' species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Tungar
summary: Tungars were a non-sentient species of quadrupeds that could be found on the desert planet Golak. They were domesticated and utilized as mounts by the native Jangori.

name: Tunguray
summary: Tunguray were a sentient species with vulpine features, purple fur, yellow eyes, and two leaflike antennae. The entire species was evacuated from the volcanic planet Tunguray, near Sullust, to Coruscant by a Galactic Republic Pathfinder team. Cherro was a member of this species, and she was imprisoned with Axel Greylark.

name: Tunnel worm
summary: The tunnel worm was a type of four-meter-long segmented worm that lived on the Inner Rim planet Tasariq. They were carnivorous, could bite, and burrowed tunnels in the earth. Tunnel worms frequently hunted around their homeworld's habitable, Type I–atmosphere craters, where the largest amounts of food were available, but their ability to store oxygen in their body also allowed to them to hunt on Tasariq's surface, where the atmosphere was Type III. The residents of the planet's inhabited craters made concerted efforts to control the number of tunnel worms in their vicinity. At some point by the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, an attack by tunnel worms on the landspeeder of the Human miner Ansan Talam caused irreparable damage to the vehicle, which forced him to purchase an All Terrain Cruiser K-111 steam rover instead.

name: Tunneling garrix
summary: The Tunneling Garrix, or the Jagomiri Tunneling Garix was a massive underground creature that feeds off Meter long grubs or any other creature it can sink it's giant teeth into. It only came above ground to feed or defend its tunnel network. Since the creature was blind, it had an amazing sense of smell and could feel the vibrations of any creature close to it. The Ardan resistance encountered a Tunneling Garrix when they arrived on Jagomir, but were able to fend off the mighty creature due to the fact that the creature was cowardly, and would flee if it took too much damage.

name: Tunroth
summary: The Tunroth were bipedal sentients indigenous to the Jiroch system of the Mid Rim. Towering and physically strong, Tunroth had distinctive elongated heads, a vertical nostril at the top of the skull, and three-digit hands and feet. Widely spaced eyes and sharp horns that lined the chin constituted other distinct physical features. The species was renowned throughout the galaxy for their hunting and tracking skills. They had an innate ability to track a quarry, and over time, an elite association known as the Tunroth Hunters came into demand for employment as bounty hunters and big-game hunters. The fact that the Tunroth maintained their use of sacred hunting weapons such as the klirun bow and the kilter staff even after galactic-standard blasters became available to them attested to the religious importance the Tunroth placed on hunter traditions. Each Tunroth community was ruled by the greatest hunter present. Aggressive and hard-working, Tunroth had a tendency to intimidate members of other species. The Tunroth were members of the Galactic Republic for thousands of years. After first contact with outsiders, the species spread to other habitable planets in their system. In 7 BBY, during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Lortan fanatics virtually wiped them out in an onslaught known as the Reslian Purge. The Empire intervened to save the Tunroth from total annihilation, and the Tunroth came to greatly respect the galactic government. The species slowly recovered, as expatriate Tunroth returned home to help rebuild their civilization. The system joined the Empire, although some members resisted the Emperor's anti-alien policies as members of the Rebel Alliance. After the transition from Galactic Empire to New Republic, the Tunroth remained wary of the new government but eventually joined it.

name: Turazza
summary: The Turazza were sentient, short, mottled reptiles that hatched from eggs. They were able to run faster than a Human and had comparable strength, but they sometimes had trouble trying to use items designed for taller beings. Turazzas were seen on several planets during the years of the Galactic Civil War, although they rarely spoke any language but their own. Turazzas were often considered to be unsuitable for certain kinds of job, and were sometimes seen as little more than pets. The Turazza sisters Nizzal, Rizzal and Vizzal acted as assistants to the Twi'lek trader Loh'khar, although their abilities were frequently underestimated by his clients. Similarly, while the Turazza known only as Redeye—because of the color of his eye patch—was in charge of the security at the clandestine pub Exovar's Emporium on the planet Neftali, many of Luskin Exovar's acquaintances and customers were surprised by that fact.
eyeColor: Green, no iris or pupil visible.

name: Turgle's species
summary: This species was a sentient species. Turgle, a native of Lissam, was a member of the species.

name: Turlossus
summary: The turlossus were a colossal species of reptiles home to Dhandu 3. Non-aggressive herbivores, the turlossus walked on the grasslands of Dhandu 3 in herds. To prevent their cities from being crushed by the turlossus, the Dhanduese inhabitants instead built on top of the creatures' flat shells, with catwalks and bridges to connect the various districts together when they were nearby.

name: Tusk-cat
summary: Tusk-cats, also spelled as Tusk Cats, were non-sentient carnivorous felines found on the grasslands of the planet Naboo. They used the grass as cover when hunting herbivores. They had a long muscular tail and pair of tusks growing from their lower jaws. Despite their fierceness, they could be used as mounts.

name: Tusk-pig
summary: Tusk-pigs were were a type of pig species that were native to the jungle planet Haruun Kal.

name: Tuskbeast
summary: Tuskbeasts were a non-sentient species native to the planet Kintan. They were considered dangerous and so were driven to extinction by the Nikto species.

name: Tusken Raider
summary: {{Update|Star Wars Helmet Collection 11, Queen's Hope, Star Wars (2015) 15, The Sand Will Provide, Obi-Wan 5, From a Certain Point of View, Darth Vader (2015) 1, Age of Rebellion - Jabba the Hutt 1, Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land, Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine, Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa, Star Wars: Commander, Force Collector, , Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy}} Tusken Raiders, less formally referred to as Sand People or simply as Tuskens, were a nomadic sentient species indigenous to the desert planet Tatooine, where they were often hostile to local settlers. Tusken children were called Uli-ah. The name of Tusken Raiders was acquired much later, due to a period of concerted attacks on the settlement called Fort Tusken around eight decades before 19 BBY. One tribe captured the bounty hunter Boba Fett, but they accepted him into their tribe after he had proved his worth to them.

name: Tusker
summary: Tuskers were creatures native to Haruun Kal. They had snouts, and could grow up to a hundred kilos in mass.

name: Tuskette
summary: Tuskettes were a non-sentient species of tusked mammals that lived feral on the planet Courkrus. Members of the Hutt species ate tuskettes raw as palate cleansers. On at least one occasion, the Hutt Shala forced a pair of tuskettes to fight each other to the death for his entertainment.

name: Tuut Orial's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tuut Orial was a member of this species.

name: Twenchok
summary: The twenchok was an ocean creature that could be eaten as food. Battered and fried twenchok was served at the fiftieth birthday party of Nifera Shu.

name: Twi'lek
summary: Twi'leks, sometimes referred to xenophobically as tail-heads or Twi, occasionally referred to as Rylothians, were a tall near-human species whose most striking feature was a pair of long appendages protruding from their skulls, called lekku. They hailed from the planet of Ryloth, in the Outer Rim Territories, and female Twi'leks were often exported off world as slaves. Twi'leks were considered one of the most common species in the galaxy, with its members easily able to blend into a crowd without drawing attention, as opposed to rarer, more prominent species, like Togrutas. Some armies used this to their advantage, employing Twi'leks as undercover agents.

name: Twirrl
summary: The Twirrl was a carnivorous, mammalian falconoid species, native to Naboo. The Twirrl preyed upon plain-dwelling avians, small rodents, and Naboo's four-legged waterfowl. It could also handle prey surpassing its own size by 10 percent. Their diet was supplemented by berries. Keen eyesight, precision flying, and extraordinary diving speed made them favorites for sporting and hunting parties of the Human settlers. Twirrls were trained and used by Nabooian Human aristocracy for a recreational activity known as twirrling. It was known by experienced human hunters not to keep Greysors and Twirrls together, even if both were domesticated. Males staked out territories in the spring and mated with any willing females that passed through. They emitted shrill territorial and mating calls. Females gave birth once or twice a year and served as sole caretakers of the young. Typical litters were three to four young, with maturity occurring at approximately four months.

name: Two-Headed Toothvole
summary: The Two-Headed Toothvole was a creature from Bogmadada with two heads each with a set of eyes. At least twenty cycles before 3 ABY, the pirate captain Hondo Ohnaka claimed to have killed the fearsome Two-Headed Toothvole of Bogmadada by shooting it between both sets of eyes in the first draft of chapter 112 of his holobook, "Hondo's Memoirs". Ohnaka left an excerpt of chapter 112 on a datapad at the Ohnaka Hideout on the desert planet Tatooine when the Ohnaka Gang abandoned the base.
distinctions: Two heads each with a set of eyes

name: Two-headed tortuce
summary: Two-headed tortuce were a diverse species that were found in many parts of the world of Canastra IV.

name: Tybis
summary: Tybis were a beast of burden native to the planet of J't'p'tan. They were known for having a gentle nature. They could also be found in the jungles of Yavin 4.

name: Tymp
summary: Tymps were omnivores native to Serat. Originating in the world's forests, they were opportunistic, and adapted to life in Seratian cities, raiding storehouses for roti grain. Seratians' hunting of symers—the only natural predator of tymps—resulted in a tymp population explosion that jeopardized local agriculture.

name: Tynnan
summary: The Tynnans were a species of furred and bucktoothed aquatic mammalian sentients from the planet Tynna. The species was adapted to freshwater environments and had sensitive snouts to make up for their poor eyesight. The species as a whole had an aptitude for bureaucracy and were regarded as jovial and gregarious in the wider galaxy. One Tynnan named Bazil served as a tracker for the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
distinctions: Coat of hair, prominent upper front teeth

name: Typhloractyl
summary: Typhloractyls were a species of reptavian creatures related to the Varactyls. They were kept as pets during the time of the Third Galactic War and could be found on the planets Coruscant and Dromund Kaas. Typhloractyls lacked visual organs and instead maneuvered using highly developed olfactory glands. They were highly averse to certain smells and were known to prefer cleaner environments. Traveling alongside Typhloractyls while carrying food was not recommended because of their sensitivity to scent.

name: Tyrannosaur
summary: Tyrannosaurs were a type of dinosaur native to Togoria. The eaters native to the planet Abonshee were similar to tyrannosaurs.

name: Tyrant rancor
summary: Tyrant rancors were a subspecies of rancor of gargantuan proportions.

name: Tytahuso fish
summary: The tytahuso fish was a species of fish native to the planet Ahch-To. The Caretakers constructed a ladder from the vertebrae of a tytahuso fish.

name: Tythonian reptilian
summary: The Tythonian reptilian was a non-sentient, bipedal reptile native to the Deep Core planet known as Tython.

name: T'zaki
summary: The T'zaki were a species of sentient insectoids that shared a unified consciousness in the form of a hive mind. By the time of the Republic Era, T'zaki culture more readily accepted slavery compared to many human cultures. In 40 BBY, the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn theorized that the species' acceptance of the practice could be because T'zaki language roughly translated the term for freedom to mean having no purpose.

name: Tzorbi
summary: The Tzorbi were a sentient species. At some point, they established a medical laboratory at their homeworld. The Tzorbi eventually became one of the first species to join the Galactic Republic, which was founded in 25,053 BBY. Millennia before 3643 BBY, however, they became extinct, with the remains of some of the members of the species eventually becoming fossilized at their homeworld. Around that year, an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing struggle between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire sent a companion to study the fossils of the Tzorbi. The latter individual collected samples of genetic traces from the aliens' remains and also discovered their ancient laboratory.

name: Ualaq
summary: The Ualaq were one of three subspecies of the Aqualish from the planet Ando. Quaysail, a pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron was a Ualaq, as was Separatist Council member Po Nudo.

name: Ubasameir
summary: Ubasameir were a sentient species with an inborn tenderness for younglings. During the Galactic Civil War, some Ubasameir worked in the Sub-Adult Center on the Bazaar Deck of the Kuari Princess, a giant luxury liner. Parents were able to drop off their younglings to the center for the Ubasameir and droids to provide educational and recreational care. They were present on the cruise ship when it was attacked by pirates when passing through the Maelstrom nebula.

name: Ubdurian
summary: Ubdurians were a species of sentient humanoids native to Nag Ubdur and Ubduria. Their bald heads featured dark eyes seated deep in their sockets, but no visible nose. In ancient times, the Mandalorians undertook a crusade into the galaxy's Inner Rim star systems and devastated the planet Ubduria out of contempt for the native Ubdurians, who they viewed as dishonorable cowards. Prashee and Cratinus, two Ubdurian brothers, were present in the castle of Maz Kanata when the First Order assaulted Takodana.

name: Ubese
summary: The Ubese were a sentient species that spoke Ubese. Originating from the planet Uba IV, the Ubese were notoriously isolationist, rarely conducting trade with off-worlders. When an Ubese was exiled from Uba IV, their identities were removed from Ubese public record, and they were unable to return and reintegrate into their society. Leia Organa impersonated the Ubese bounty hunter Boushh when she infiltrated the palace of Jabba the Hutt.

name: Ubese Thorn-Back War Dragon
summary: Ubese Thorn-Back War Dragons were huge, violent beasts that were introduced to the populated worlds of the galaxy by Nomad-Damon during the Clone Wars. The reptilian beasts were utilized as mounts by some individuals. With the rise of the Galactic Empire, however, the War Dragons were largely wiped out.

name: Ubialla Gheal's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Ubialla Gheal was a member of this species.

name: Ubuugan
summary: Ubuugans were a sentient species from the planet Ubuuga. They had grayish skin, three eyes, and a long snout. The Ubuugans developed a toxic secretion that protected them from the deadly Ubuugan fleshborers. Some of them even considered the fleshborers as a delicacy. The Ubuugan criminal Chung, was captured by the bounty hunter Boba Fett and was en-route to being taken back to Imperial Center when Fett picked up a distress call from the freighter Mingula, which was revealed to be infested with fleshborers that had killed the crew. Fett managed to escape as his armor proved resistant to the deadly parasites. Upon realizing that some of them had infiltrated his ship, Fett ran to the lockup, expecting to find them feasting on Chung, but discovered him feasting on them instead.

name: Ubuugan fleshborer
summary: Ubuugan fleshborers were parasitic winged worms native to the swamps of Ubuuga The fleshborers spent the majority of their life cycle within the original host body, emerging only to find another host. Upon finding a suitable host, they shed their wings and burrowed into the creature's skin. They were able to eat through some form of metal via corrosive secretions. Rodomium was vulnerable to their secretions, however Mandalorian armor was resistant. The Ubuugan species that shared their homeworld evolved biological defences against the parasites and regarded them as a delicacy. Emperor Palpatine's third cousin, Volpau, was killed by fleshborers while on Ubuuga, however the cause of his death was undetermined at the time. His body was placed in a rodomium casket, which was shipped back to Coruscant for ritual incineration on the freighter Mingula, While on route, the fleshborers emerged and killed the Zylurian crew, The infamous bounty hunter Boba Fett picked up the ship's distress beacon and boarded, hoping to find valuable salvage. Detecting no life forms, he had his prisoner, Tsumo, board first, to test how dangerous it was. While searching through the treasures in the ships hold, they were attacked by a swarm of fleshborers. Tsumo was killed but Fett escaped due to the resilience of his armor. He set off an explosion that destroyed the ship, and presumably the worms. Some managed get onto Slave I but were devoured by Fett's other prisoner, the Ubuugan Chung, who regarded them as tasty.

name: Ugnaught
summary: Ugnaughts were a species of porcine, sentient humanoids, native to the planet Gentes. They were considered by many to be among the (if not the) hardest-working species in the galaxy. Although endemic to the planet Gentes, countless Ugnaughts considered Bespin's Cloud City their “home”; when the Corellian Lord Ecclesias Figg initiated construction on the ”cloud” civilization in Bespin's atmosphere, he had ultimately hired many Ugnaughts, due to their fastidious, driven and loyal work ethic. As a gesture of goodwill (and as a reward for their labor), the Ugnaught workers were gifted with several of the large lower levels of Cloud City, to settle and populate, a gift for which they remained forever grateful. In addition to populating the new floating settlement, those first Bespin Ugnaughts (as the ones predominantly responsible for constructing Cloud City) shared their knowledge with one another, as well as passing it on to their future generations. Their natural diligence and quick problem-solving would greatly benefit Cloud City's daily maintenance needs, in addition to the many utilities and mechanical, electrical and structural concerns associated with the floating city.

name: Ugor
summary: {{MultipleIssues|image|updatecontent=The High Republic (2021) 4, The High Republic: The Rising Storm, The High Republic (2021) 15, The High Republic (2023) 4, }} Ugors were a sentient blob-like species that existed in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, Archivist OrbaLin was the first member of the species to ever join the Jedi Order. HarrGick was a male Ugor that was in Coronet Spaceport on Corellia in 13 BBY, during the Imperial Era. Ugors could sprout pseudopods that performed the functions of limbs and, according to Tyro Viveca, they exuded an unpleasant smell.

name: Uizani
summary: Uizani was a breed of avian creature endemic to the world of Radnor.

name: Ukian
summary: The Ukians were a species native to Ukio.

name: Ukian Torbull
summary: The Ukian Torbull originated from the agricultural world of Ukio. The Torbull was an experiment by the Ukians to breed a hardy pack animal that could survive any environment. They were partly successful in that the animal was very capable of functioning in diverse environments and was easy to domesticate. Its one major disadvantage was its voracious appetite. The Torbull had to be fed and watered at least four times a day to survive. As a result the creature was not a popular pack beast. The Torbull was a popular source of food. A soup made from the flesh of the animal's tail was a popular dish.

name: Uller
summary: The uller was a horned creature that lived on Kashyyyk. These clever hunters are superbly equipped for life on planet Kashyyyk. They possess a unique skeletal structure that allows them to absorb significant kinetic damage. The uller's skull and horns are particularly resistant to attack. The most famous uller was Sawtooth. An uller's mating call was distinctly unpleasant and sounded like the hum of a hyperdrive.

name: Ulmatran condor
summary: An Ulmatran condor was a purple-feathered bird, presumably from Ulmatra. Ziro Desilijic Tiure wore some feathers of an Ulmatran condor on his head.

name: Ulorin
summary: The Ulorins were the native species of the planet Dela III, in the Centrality.

name: Ultaarian Greenback
summary: The Ultaarian Greenback was a sentient, four-armed, bipedal species. Members of the species had green eyes, a pink horn growing from the nose, large fangs, and pink skin. During the Galactic Civil War, a member of the species faced the Human Han Solo in the Big Game, a gladiatorial combat on the space station known as the Wheel. The four-limbed warrior wielded a dagger thorn in each hand during the bout.

name: Umaren'k'sa
summary: The Umaren'k'sa were a sentient species from the planet Umaren'k in the Unknown Regions. After another species, the Hemes Arbora, migrated to their world, the Umaren'k'sa adopted much of their visitors' culture, a societal shift that was prompted by the appearance of the sentient planet Zonama Sekot in the Umaren'k system.

name: Umbaran
summary: The Umbarans, also known as the Shadow People, were a near-human species native to the planet of Umbara. They were characterized by their pale, bluish skin and colorless eyes. In the waning decades of the Galactic Republic, the Umbarans were represented in the pan-galactic Senate by Mee Deechi. However, after Deechi's murder by senatorial aide Lolo Purs during the Clone Wars, they joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, bringing their extremely advanced technology to the enemies of the Republic.
distinctions: Ability to see in the ultraviolet spectrum

name: Umbramoth
summary: The umbramoth was a type of large moth that resided in the forests of the planet Khofar. A group of umbramoths was known as an eclipse. As larvae, they gestated in protective cocoons on the trunks of trees until they hatched into winged creatures that were attracted to light. During the High Republic Era, when a team of Jedi visited Khofar in search of the Force-sensitive assassin Mae-ho Aniseya, they were led by the tracker Bazil through a grove that served as a breeding ground for an eclipse of umbramoths. Aniseya's sister, Osha, touched one of the creatures, which awoke and became hostile. When Jedi Master Sol ignited his lightsaber, the umbramoth flew toward it and Sol sliced the creature in two. Later that night, during a confrontation with the Stranger, Osha used her droid Pip as a beacon to attract the umbramoths and attached it to the Stranger's back. The moths then carried away the Sith, even though he managed to free himself later on. Another umbramoth later attacked Master Vernestra Rwoh from behind, though she ignited her lightwhip and sliced it in two.

name: Umbraspider
summary: The umbraspider was a type of spider that produced silk with unusual properties, making the spider's webs virtually invisible due to how it refracted and absorbed light. The silk of the umbraspider was used by the Sakiyan species of the planet Saki to weave the shadowsuits that made the wearer almost invisible except in bright light. The chemists of Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles synthesized a rival material called shadowsilk after studying the properties of the fur of the Defel species, but Sakiyans claimed that umbraspider silk was superior.

name: Umgullian blob
summary: The Umgullian blob was a small, gelatinous creature native to Umgul. The typical blob was a base color of sickly green. Most, however, were patterned with vivid spots and stripes. There were many subspecies of blob, some bred for racing, some bred as domestic pets and some even for medicinal purposes. All, however, consisted almost solely of a large mass of jelly-like fluid encased in a thin membrane. This membrane was thin enough to let the moisture of Umgul's foggy atmosphere to pass through. This skin also had the ability to break and then reform instantly. This allowed the blob to split into two new blobs. These new blobs would behave exactly like the original blob until, at any point, they were able to re-merge into one. This was also how the blobs reproduced; when a blob grew to the appropriate size, it would divide into two equal, smaller blobs, like giant amoebae. They participated in their own sport called blob racing. This was considered a major sport on Umgul and the surrounding systems with major betting.

name: Umrach
summary: Umrachs were large reptilian bipeds, introduced to Coruscant when the Yuuzhan Vong Vongformed the planet into Yuuzhan'tar. These creatures inhabited the lower levels, and often fed upon Coruscanti. The umrach had two muscular hind limbs and two spindly forelimbs which were used to catch prey. The creature hunted by ambushing its victims from above, killing them with its razor-tipped mouth tentacles. These tentacles could reach up to four meters. Gengi Tung kept two pet Umrachs, Toi and Tixo.

name: Unakki eye spider
summary: Unakki eye spiders were a species of arachnids that caused damage to Human eyes. The Sith Lord Darth Scabrous unleashed a number of unakki eye spiders on his Sith academy on Odacer-Faustin around 3645 BBY. The spiders killed two students and attacked at least eleven others, including Hartwig and Soid Einray. Although Hartwig survived the incident, he would continue to wake up on a number of mornings with blood in his eyes. Soid Einray hanged himself as a result of the damage caused by the spiders.

name: Under-Dweller
summary: Under-Dwellers were a massive species that lived in caves beneath the surface of Planet X but longed to escape. They were adverse to light, but were able to withstand it. The creatures had a set of jaws lined with sharp teeth under a cluster of black eyeballs. While on a mission to retrieve eggs of the Nameless species, members of the Path of the Open Hand cult were attacked by one of the creatures after they retrieved many eggs from the walls of the caves beneath the planet. A Force-sensitive Ovissian member of the cult's team named Bokana Koss sensed the creature using the Force and claimed they were connected to a coming blight, warning they wanted to chain the Force itself and claiming that the Under-Dwellers actually wanted them to escape to begin the blight. After killing a member of the team named Galamal by stabbing her with its barbed tongue and eating her, the Under-Dweller followed the team to the surface, where it was attacked by and fought another large being called the protector. The protector also attempted to stop the Path's escape from Planet X, but Koss, who shook off the terror brought on by the vision after the Under-Dweller had attacked, sacrificed himself to hold it off. By 228 BBY, the blight foretold by Koss was spreading in the galaxy proper because of the Nameless being stolen away from their homeworld.

name: Underground turtle
summary: Underground turtles were a type of turtle that lived underground and could be found on the moon Olgothon 3. Sometime between 20 BBY and 19 BBY, while waiting to meet the slicer Ginntho there, the Jedi Knight Iskat Akaris touched the ground and reached into the Force, sensing the presence of several burrowing creatures, including a number of very aggressive underground turtles.

name: Underwalker
summary: The Underwalkers were a species native to Makeb. There was a female Underwalker on the planet Oricon named Nefra, who guarded the Dread Fortress there during the Dread War.

name: Unet
summary: Unets were a sentient insectoid species. They had four arms and spoke a language called Une. During the Clone Wars, their homeworld was conquered by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

name: Ungrila
summary: The Ungrila were a sentient species in the galaxy. They had several pairs of horns above their mouths. Yasto Attsmun, Brushaun, and a crime boss were members of this species.

name: Unidentified Abtin species
summary: This species was a sentient species that was present on the planet Abtin.

name: Unidentified Adin species
summary: This species were a race of thin humanoid aliens with red skin and white facial stripes indigenous to Adin. Other distinctive features were their two-fingered hands and pale pink teeth. Senator Meido was a member of this species.
distinctions: Thin build, two-fingered hands, pale pink teeth

name: Unidentified Aldraig IV bird
summary: A species of rare bird lived on the Core Worlds planet Aldraig IV. At one point, it was hunted nearly to the point of extinction; however, later preservation efforts helped revive its population.
habitat: Southern polar region of the planet

name: Unidentified Angcord species
summary: A sentient species was found to the planet Angcord, commonly described as the first Pilgrims of Angcord among the Angcord kingdom, and comprising the majority of the Pilgrim Warriors by 482 BBY. They had elongated heads, with blue skin, black or brown hair, and gray eyes.

name: Unidentified anteater-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified ape-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The humanoid species was distinguished by their ape-like faces. By 32 BBY until at least 22 BBY, four members of this species were associated with the Galactic Senate.

name: Unidentified aquatic creature
summary: The creatures were an ancient species on the planet Batuu. According to the myth "The Silent Circle" the creatures inhabited the oceans of Batuu even while the trees were young and before the trees nurtured the fae.

name: Unidentified aquatic predator
summary: A finned, hundreds-of-meters–long creature lived in the ocean of the aquatic moon of Delriss in the Expansion Region. A powerful predator with several spikes on its head, at some point by the time of the Galactic Civil War it attacked an undersea sanctuary of the Jedi Order, severely damaging the facility. Later, during that conflict, the predator sensed the arrival of a group of off-world Force-sensitives aboard the sanctuary and again attacked it, ultimately sending the facility sinking to the bottom of the ocean and chasing the group's starship out of the water.

name: Unidentified aquatic species
summary: An aquatic species was native to an ocean planet that Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa crashed on after the mission to Ktath'atn.

name: Unidentified aquatic Tolis creature
summary: A type of aquatic sea creature was found on the planet Tolis.

name: Unidentified arachnoid species
summary: An arachnoid species was brought into the New Republic in 5 ABY through the negotiations of Leia Organa, just prior to the Battle of Mindor. The arachnoids were native to a minor star cluster. They were hairy and, unlike most arachnoids, had heads like those of humanoids, including mouthfuls of gleaming white teeth, just like those of Humans. During the negotiations, Han Solo found them to be very creepy.
distinctions: Humanoid-looking faces with a mouthful of gleaming white, entirely human-looking teeth

name: Unidentified Asmeru species
summary: This sentient species was native to Asmeru. They had been extinct, as evidenced by the numerous ruins that dot Asmeru's surface.

name: Unidentified avian
summary: A type of flock-dwelling avian creature with quicksilver wings dwelt on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila. In 26 ABY, while the Jedi Kyp Durron and Jaina Solo were talking outside an abandoned Chandrilan villa, a flock of the avians was startled by a clap of thunder, which caused them to rise into the sky behind Durron.

name: Unidentified avian species
summary: An avian species was native to the planet Birukay and was known to Detta Yao, a Shadow University student. By the time between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the species had become extinct. During those two years, after making her way to Birukay with a group of individuals, Yao recalled the avian species that had lived on the planet before its extinction.

name: Unidentified avian species
summary: A species of avian predator lived on the Inner Rim planet Fennesa.

name: Unidentified B-bel species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed on the planet B-bel.

name: Unidentified bald blue-skinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified bald diminutive species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified bald mottled species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified bald mustard-skinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified bald red-skinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified bald species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified bald yellow-skinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Banas species
summary: A sentient species was native to the planet Banas. They had blue, gray, or white colored skin. Halorum and Moular were members of this species.

name: Unidentified barbed light blue species
summary: This species was a bipedal humanoid sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their light blue skin, as well as a fin-like growth on top of their head and four pointed barbs extending from their face. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was present at Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk when Koresh attempted to take Din Djarin's Mandalorian armor.

name: Unidentified barbed orange species
summary: A sentient species with orange skin existed in the galaxy. These aliens were bipedal humanoids that possessed four pointed barbs protruding from their faces, two below their mouths and two above. They also possessed two tube-like protuberances wrapping around each side of their faces, flanking their ears, as well as a pair of jagged fin-like growths also extending from the top sides of their heads and ending in points above and behind their craniums. In 9 ABY, one member of this species visited Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa, a city on the planet Tatooine. They were present when the Sanctuary was blown up by the members of the Pyke Syndicate.

name: Unidentified barbed pale species
summary: A sentient species with pale skin existed in the galaxy. These aliens were bipedal humanoids that possessed four pointed barbs protruding from their faces, two below their mouths and two above, with a pair of jagged fin-like growths also extending from their cheekbones around the sides of their heads and ending in points above and behind their craniums. In 9 ABY, one member of this species visited Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa, a city on the planet Tatooine. They were present when the humans Boba Fett and Fennec Shand made their first visit to the establishment to speak with the Twi'lek owner Garsa Fwip.

name: Unidentified barbed red species
summary: A sentient species with red skin existed in the galaxy. These aliens were humanoids that possessed two pointed barbs protruding from their faces, extending from the sides of their upper lips, as well as pointed ears black hair. One member of this species was present at The Pits on the moon of Shakari during or after 11 ABY.

name: Unidentified barbed yellow species
summary: A sentient species with yellow skin existed in the galaxy. These aliens were bipedal humanoids that possessed four pointed barbs protruding from their faces, two below their mouths and two above, with a pair of fin-like growths also extending from their cheekbones around the sides of their heads and ending in points above and behind their craniums. In 9 ABY, one member of this species visited Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa, a city on the planet Tatooine. They were present when the humans Boba Fett and Fennec Shand made their second visit to the establishment to speak with the Twi'lek owner Garsa Fwip shortly before the arrival of the Hutt brother and sister crime lord duo known as the Twins.

name: Unidentified Basteel tunnel creature
summary: A species lived in the caves in Basteel's mountains. The species was black and rather small, and lived in large swarms. During Operation Yellow Moon, Leia Organa and her team were attacked by a swarm, which left each of them with multiple bites.

name: Unidentified bat-like Endorian species
summary: Two adult creatures resembling bats and their small cub were seen cowering in a tree during an intense storm on Endor. One of the creatures protectively covered its cub with its wing to shield it from the storm. In addition to wings, the species also had tails and long ears.

name: Unidentified beaked head-tail species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Maby Sagedo was a member of this species.

name: Unidentified beaked species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified beaked two-toed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy, found at locations such as the moon Quantxi.

name: Unidentified bean-shaped species
summary: The species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their rounded, bean-shaped bodies, with thin limbs, pink or brown skin, and striations running across their body, extending out from their face. The species possessed large eyes with yellow sclera and beady black pupils, as well as dark red or grayish-brown lips, and pointed ears. Some members of the species possessed pointed noses and exposed lower teeth, while others had spherical noses instead. At least one member of this species was present on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY, while another visited Bezz Drexx's tower around the same time during the Clone Wars.

name: Unidentified bear-like creature
summary: A large bear-like creature was native to the Colonies planet Mycroft. Although the creature resembled a black bear, it had mottled green fur and hands similar to those of a raccoon. The creature lived in an area of low, forest-covered mountains. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, a team of Rebel Alliance agents underwent a mission to the mountain-covered area of Mycroft during the planet's winter season. The black bear-like creatures were ravenous from the long, cold harsh season and their presence in the area was a potential hindrance to the Rebel agents' mission.
distinctions: Hands similar to that of a raccoon

name: Unidentified beast of burden
summary: A beast of burden with antlers was found on the planet Genbara. One was used by an uncle traveling as part of a large group to Osou. The beast was tall enough to provide shade to everyone nearby.

name: Unidentified Betshish species
summary: The swamp-planet Betshish was home to a sentient species. Their homeworld, which was located on the Pinooran Spur hyperlane of the Gordian Reach sector, between the Mogoshyn and Kli'aar systems, was scouted by colonists from Setor looking for possible sites for a colony. The species went unnoticed during the initial survey of the planet, but were discovered upon the first major landing on the planet's surface. Their sentience rendered void the Colony's title to the planet, a fact later celebrated by the scout Lile Gorsek, who found the swamp-planet dismal and so was relieved not to have any ongoing connection with it. The species had developed to a pre-industrial technology by the time of the Galactic Empire. The Empire interdicted their homeworld, but never actually exploited the species.

name: Unidentified big-eyed pointed-cranium species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified big-mouthed creature
summary: A big-mouthed creature lived in the swamps of Dagobah. It was amphibian-like in appearance; it had stubby legs and feet and a long tail with four protuberances at the end of it.

name: Unidentified Biituian bird
summary: A species of bird was native to Biitu, an agriworld in the Cassander sector. It had a plump body and a tapering tail, which was about the same length as its body. On each side of this body, it sported a wing, with which it was capable of flight. Each wing had four dominant feathers. The body, tail and wings of this avian species all had a uniform, orange plumage. The birds had two short, yellow legs, which stuck out anteriorly while in flight. They had a small head, with a triple-pointed crest, and a short, yellow beak. Their eyes had white scleras and black pupils. The species had a musical call.

name: Unidentified bipedal species
summary: This species were blue-skinned bipedal creatures. Two members of their species once hassled a clone trooper as he was attempting to destroy a bridge.

name: Unidentified bird-like creature
summary: A type of bird-like creature was used as a mount by members of a species on a planet. Members of the species rode the creatures while attacking the Jedi Tsubaki.

name: Unidentified black-and-white species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified blob-like Endorian creature
summary: Endorian blobs were primitive jelly-like creatures found in the forests of Endor. They were green and had multiple small red eyes, as well as a bigger central one, which they could spit out at a victim to attack it.

name: Unidentified blue-and-tan species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified blue Dathomir bird
summary: A species of bird was native to the Outer Rim planet Dathomir. The birds cleaned the teeth of the rancor when they got dirty.

name: Unidentified blue-furred species
summary: A species of blue-furred bipeds could be found on the forest moon Endor. They had fluffy, blue tails, large, pointed ears, and long snouts with a black nose and sharp teeth. After the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, word spread across Endor that Imperials had returned to the moon but been seen off by members of the Ewok Bright Tree tribe and their Yuzzum neighbours, who had been summoned by the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick. This led to many of the tribes neighbours, including atleast six members of the blue-furred species, gathering in Bright Tree Village to meet the Ewoks, share stories, and work in unity to build the forest's future together. During the gathering, the blue-furred visitors all wore orange capes and black face masks while sitting around a table and eating various types of food.

name: Unidentified blue humanoid species
summary: This race of blue-skinned humanoids were native to a planet. Their homeworld was the location of the battle during the Clone Wars. Jedi Master Yoda defeated an entire Separatist army using only a giant chaingun. A cantina patron was a member of this species.

name: Unidentified blue long-faced species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified blue-masked species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified blue-skinned short-legged species
summary: A humanoid species of blue-skinned and short-legged beings with conical heads existed, one of which was the notable Podracer pilot Toy Dampner. The species could exhibit red hair on their heads, and featured short legs in conjunction with long, skinny arms. A crowd favorite on the moon of Oovo IV, Dampner served as an example of his kind in the public spotlight.

name: Unidentified blue-skinned species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their blue skin, black eyes and cranial ridges.

name: Unidentified blue-upper-face species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The humanoid species was distinguished by their blue upper faces. One member of this species was a member of the Jedi Order, though they were killed by members of the 501st Legion during the attack on the Jedi Temple.

name: Unidentified bluish-green humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Blutopia creature
summary: A type of creature was native to Blutopia.

name: Unidentified boneless species
summary: A species of boneless sentients with crystalline eyes existed during the time after the Imperial Period. They spoke through their prehensile trunks. These trunks had fine tendrils at the ends, and members of the species had at least five trunks. They formed a colony on Chalcedon, and were its bureaucrats. One member of the species, who worked in the center of a glass building for a strange water pool, was known as the Indexer.

name: Unidentified Bororn species
summary: This species was a sentient species found on the planet Bororn.

name: Unidentified Bosph species
summary: A sentient species inhabited the planet Bosph. In 3 BBY, the Galactic Empire attempted to commit genocide on the species when its Imperial Navy repeatedly carried out large-scale orbital bombardment of their homeworld, enacting an ongoing quarantine on those that survived. In response, the species chose to dis-remember the Empire, refusing to acknowledge that the state ever existed as what was considered a grave insult in the species' society. In 35 ABY, the historian Beaumont Kin mentioned the species in his book The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire. Despite generally encouraging readers to seek out accounts of Imperial atrocities from the victims themselves, Kin stated that the species' choice to disremember the Empire and remain silent on the matter should be respected.

name: Unidentified Bouyant species
summary: A sentient species was at one point present on the planet Buoyant. The species terraformed the planet, causing it to rotate faster. The species also used a number of machines on Buoyant and imported various animal species to the world.

name: Unidentified bovid species
summary: A species of bovid lived in the Wasteland of Prine. Their manes were red and several villi stuck out of their foreheads. Jedi fugitive Dass Jennir utilized one as a mount after being stranded in the region after taming it through the Force. It was injured during the initial struggle, but Jennir managed to tend to its wounds despite his relatively mediocre healing abilities. After regenerating its strength with the help of his droid H2, who gathered plenty of green food, Jennir rode the beast into battle against the pirate band that had kidnapped his companion Ember Chankeli. He later gave it to Maddie, a young girl Chankeli befriended in captivity. The Jedi instructed it to lead them to water, as he had initially found it drinking from a small pool. After discovering some, Jennir decided to head back to rescue Chankeli, who had been left behind during the rescue. He gave Maddie the rest of the food, as she would be unable to eat the same stuff as the creature. Jennir instructed the beast to keep her safe and lead her home, which it did successfully. Afterwards Maddie kept the animal on her farm.

name: Unidentified brown furry-faced species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their long brown fur that covered almost all of their faces aside from their eyes, as well as sometimes a white horn extending from the top of their heads. In 4 ABY, at least one member of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren, and another worked for the crime lord Allic at a casino on the planet Qiaxx.

name: Unidentified brown-skinned species
summary: A species with brown skin, a tail ending in a heart-shaped tip, and four limbs ending in three digits each could be found on the forest moon Endor. The species also had a long snout with red markings around their mouth at the tip and a large dark-brown protrusion on each side of their head. Shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, word spread across Endor that members of the Bright Tree tribe of Ewoks, including the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick, and their Yuzzum neighbours had seen off a group of Imperials who had returned to Endor seeking an Imperial weapons cache. This resulted in many of the tribe's neighbours visiting Bright Tree Village to meet the Ewoks and share stories with them while working together to decide the forest's future. At least one member of the brown-skinned species attended, wearing a golden crown, large hoop earrings, and three gold necklaces. They stood in the village with the Ewok Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka and a Wokling, both of who were taller than the crowned individual.

name: Unidentified brutish blue species
summary: This humanoid species tended to be light blue in appearance. They had hairless heads except for sideburns across their cheeks. Their eyes tended to be mostly white, and they had relatively flat noses. They had a large stature, approximately twice that of the average Human. The Jedi Jastus Farr was a member of this species.

name: Unidentified brutish green species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified brutish reptilian species
summary: An unidentified reptilian-humanoid species dwelled in the Galaxy. One individual served as the champion of Jabba the Hutt around 32 BBY. The species appeared to be sentient as they were capable of using tools and were seen wearing clothing.

name: Unidentified bubble-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their blue and red skin with large heads, bubble eyes, and downturned mouths. In 5 BBY, one member of this species was present at the Coruscant Eastern Spaceport on the planet Coruscant.

name: Unidentified bug-faced species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Byrsym species
summary: This sentient species were native to Byrsym. Their homeworld was close to its system's sun, making it very hot during the day. During the night, when it was cooler, they became more active.

name: Unidentified carnivorous tree-like Endorian creature
summary: A tree-like creature next to a river on Endor used its long tongue to capture and eat a flying insect, and it smiled widely as it devoured its prey. The tree's eyes and mouth resembled seashells, and it had several more shell-like grows around its main trunk area, although it otherwise resembled a regular tree.

name: Unidentified cheek-and-forehead-spiked species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified cheek-folds species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified cheek-spine species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Cianap riding creature
summary: A species of creature was native to Cianap. The species was black-skinned, with four red eyes, two horns protruding from the back of their heads, and six hoofed legs, as well as two wing-like protrusions from their rear. Numerous members of the species were present during the battle above Cianap, and one such member was rode in combat by Darth Vader against the Ender.

name: Unidentified Cianap species
summary: A sentient species lived on Cianap. They had blue skin and hair of various colors. Mira was a member of this species. They were a much more advanced society, but the Ender, destroyed their society, forcing them to live underground.

name: Unidentified claw-tailed reptavian
summary: A species of reptavian was native to the planet Tenoo. The winged creatures possessed a tail that functioned as a quasi-limb, ending in a three-taloned appendage. Aside from this, the reptavian featured no additional arms or legs. Jedi youngling Nubs encountered one of the creatures in the swamps of Tenoo in 232 BBY while attempting to gather fruit from a tall tree.

name: Unidentified clawed creature
summary: A species with red eyes, yellow claws, and a tail could be found on the Forest Moon of Endor and in the deserts of Tatooine. They moved by propelling themselves with their large pincers, using them to jump into the air.

name: Unidentified coral
summary: A breed of coral was found exclusively on the planet Dac. The coral was particularly dense and was therefore used to create coral pikes, a traditional Mon Calamari melee weapon that shared some similarity with Force pikes.

name: Unidentified crab creature
summary: A non-sentient crab species existed on a planet filled with swamps. During the intergalactic conflict known as the Clone Wars, which began during 22 BBY, the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker scouted the planet. After several escapes from the planet's other dangerous wildlife, they encountered one of the crabs, which tried to intimidate them with its claws. Kenobi stepped on the crab and killed it.
distinctions: Twelve eyes, ten limbs, sharp teeth

name: Unidentified creature
summary: According to a story told by the Espirion Saan, a creature was native to the planet Eadu. Many years before 20 BBY, the human boy Gideon traveled to Eadu with their father and their brother Wilhuff Tarkin to survey the planet for lommite ore. During the trip, Gideon fell into a ravine with multiple of the creatures in it. Unable to escape due to an injured ankle, Gideon called for their brother to help, but Tarkin ignored Gideon and abandoned the boy, allowing his brother to be attacked and killed by the creatures. Many years later, in 1 BBY, Tarkin had a vision of Eadu onboard the Death Star space station which ended with the same creatures appearing and attacking him. The creatures were quadrupedal, with yellow eyes, sharp teeth, brown skin, and spikes on their backs. Sometime between 21 ABY and 35 ABY, Saan told the story that included the creatures to the human First Order defector Fry.

name: Unidentified creature
summary: A creature was native to the Outer Rim planet Tao. The skin of the creature was called shagreen, and was used to wrap the hilt of a lightsaber that was passed down through the generations of the Yasaburō clan, a notable family on Tao.

name: Unidentified Crèche creature
summary: A species of massive, winged entities lived on the planet Ovanis. At the time of the Cold War, an egg of the species was praised and nurtured by the Crèche, a culture which believed the egg to carry a "savior unborn."

name: Unidentified curved-beak species
summary: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their pink skin and long, downward-curved beaks. At least one member of this species was present on the planet Orvax IV in 19 BBY.

name: Unidentified cylindrical-headed species
summary: The species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their tall, cylindrical heads that ended in points, with small, solid eyes set low on their faces. At least three members of this species were present on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.

name: Unidentified Cymoon 1 species
summary: A species of sentient beings with pink flesh and yellow eyes inhabited the junkyards of the moon Cymoon 1 in the Corellian Industrial Cluster. Members of the species had tentacles protruding from all parts of their body, some of which they used as limbs. A group of scavengers belonging to the species began dismantling the light freighter known as the Millennium Falcon while it was hidden in the junkyards near the Imperial Weapons Factory Alpha. The protocol droid C-3PO, who was inside the Falcon as it was being taken apart, attempted to initiate the starships autopilot feature in order to pick up a group of Rebels who had sabotaged the weapons factory. The droid discovered however that autopilot was not functional due to the scavengers work, and was ordered by the Falcon's owner, Han Solo to prevent the creatures from further dismantling the ship.

name: Unidentified Dagobah creature
summary: A large creature was native to the planet Dagobah. It lived in a swamp and had six eyes. By 4 ABY, Madelin Sun, a former sava at the University of Bar'leth, was attacked by the creature when she traveled to Dagobah in search of Jedi Master Yoda, who Crimson Dawn leader Lady Qi'ra hoped she could enlist into joining her attempts to destroy the Sith.

name: Unidentified dark-blue humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified dark-crested species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified dark-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified dead red moon species
summary: This sentient species was native to a dead red moon orbiting the third planet in the Sixela system. They had been extinct for millennia before their homeworld was visited again by Rezi Soresh in 1 ABY. They built underground tunnels, lasting long after their extinction, which Soresh would use during his time on the moon.

name: Unidentified dianoga-like species
summary: A sentient cephalopod species existed that had one eye mounted on a single eyestalk and a mouth with appendages on both sides at the base of their eyestalk. The species had anterior flipper-like appendages and a long, flexible tail. At least one member had reddish-brown skin with black stripes and a hazel eye. They were similar to the dianoga, a species native to the planet Vodran. The species' culture controlled their environment through terraforming abilities. Niado Duegad was a Force-attuned member of the species who hailed from the dianoga's homeworld. During the Galactic Civil War, Duegad worked as a mercenary, and his enhanced adrenal glands allowed for short bursts of incredible strength.
distinctions: One eye on a single eyestalk
Mouth at base of eyestalk with small appendages on sides

name: Unidentified diminutive green-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified diminutive green species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified diminutive helmeted species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified diminutive pale species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified diminutive pointed-eared species
summary: This sentient species were diminutive humanoids with a lavender spot on top of their bald heads.
distinctions: Lavender spot on top of bald heads

name: Unidentified diminutive round-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified D'Qar lizard
summary: A type of small lizard inhabited the planet D'Qar. They could be found running up and down trees. Also called tree-lizards, they were brilliantly colored and nocturnal. The lizards were known for their distinctive calls, which resembled squawks and squeals.

name: Unidentified draconian species
summary: This sentient species were dragon-like and had red skin. A member of this species was the associate of a reclusive assassin.

name: Unidentified Dractuvian grazing creature
summary: The Dractuvian grazing creature was a large, four-legged animal that grazed on the fields of the planet Dractu. These creatures roamed alone across the expansive fields of low, tufted, plant-like vegetation, where they fed. The animals were quite strong and ran quickly.

name: Unidentified Dractuvian snout-nosed creature
summary: Small, four-legged, long-snouted animals inhabited the forests and mountains of Dractu, a planet in the Mid Rim. They moved in groups and scattered when other creatures approached.

name: Unidentified Dractuvian turtle-like creature
summary: A small turtle-like species inhabited the forested regions of Dractu, a planet in the Mid Rim. These creatures were very small and appeared weak, yet they curiously observed any beings that passed by. Their fragile bodies were protected by a shell, and for awareness they possessed a complex eye resembling that of a humanoid. Other external organs used to interact with their environment were either absent or poorly developed.

name: Unidentified droopy-eared species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Duroonian crawler
summary: Unidentified Duroonian crawlers were spotted by Han Solo after nightfall on the planet Duroon during his adventures there in 2 BBY. They looked like bundles of straw, and slowly crawled through the fronds of fern-trees.

name: Unidentified Duroonian flyer
summary: Unidentified Duroonian flyers were spotted by Han Solo after nightfall on the planet Duroon during his adventures there in 2 BBY. They were lacy, thin, and white, which flew through the air with a swimming, rippling motion.

name: Unidentified dust-breathing species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified earless humanoid species
summary: A pale-skinned humanoid species found within the galaxy.

name: Unidentified elephantine species
summary: A species of sentient elephantine existed during the High Republic Era. The species was seen on Batuu, Tenoo, Starlight Beacon, and Yarrum.

name: Unidentified Endor frog
summary: A species of giant tree frogs lived in the forests of Endor.

name: Unidentified Endor mushroom
summary: A group of mushrooms existed on the forest moon of Endor in 3 ABY. These fungal creatures possessed a brown stem topped by a dark-red cap with orange spots. The stem exhibited facial features, including two white eyes, a nose-like protrusion, and a mouth. The creatures were capable of emoting; when startled, they emitted a yelping sound and withdrew into the base of their stem. In 3 ABY, a field of these mycomorphic creatures had arisen near the position where Argazdan archaeologist Doctor Raygar had parked his vessel. Raygar, who had arrived on the forested world in pursuit of the powerful Sunstar gem for the Galactic Empire, had captured four of the native Ewoks toward that end. The Ewoks, however, escaped their cell on Raygar's vessel with the assistance of Imperial droid PD-28 in an escape pod affixed to the ship. Shortly after launching, the vessel jetted uncontrollably around the surrounding area and toward the mushrooms' cluster. The creatures, frightened by the wayward pod, retreated into their stems until it had cleared their cluster.
distinctions: Brown stem, dark red cap with orange spots, facial features

name: Unidentified Endor quadruped
summary: A species of furry, long-necked mammals lived on the forest moon of Endor.

name: Unidentified Endor snake
summary: A species of huge forest snakes lived on Endor. They had green scales with red motting.

name: Unidentified Endorian felinoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that was present on the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Unidentified Endorian goat creature
summary: These Endorian goats were a species of goat found on the Forest Moon of Endor. The native Ewoks were known to have domesticated Endorian goats.

name: Unidentified Endorian insectoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that was present on the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Unidentified Endorian lizard creature
summary: A species of green lizards with long tongues lived in the trees of Endor.

name: Unidentified Endorian snail creature
summary: These Endorian snails were tiny creatures with orange and white coiled shells that lived in grassy hill areas on the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Unidentified enlarged-cranium blue species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The bipedal humanoid sentient species was distinguished by their enlarged craniums, blue skin, and white markings on their faces, as well as a lack of visible ears. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was present at Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk, fleeing when Koresh attempted to take Din Djarin's Mandalorian armor.

name: Unidentified enlarged-cranium purple species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The bipedal humanoid sentient species was distinguished by their enlarged craniums, purple skin, and white markings on their faces. In 9 ABY, at least two other purple members of the species frequented Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine, with one of them being present when Sanctuary was blown up by the Pyke Syndicate.

name: Unidentified Escalan species
summary: A sentient species lived on the primitive Outer Rim Territories planet Escalan. The species did not speak basic. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the smuggler Han Solo was dumped onto the world after he had been shot by the bounty hunter Greedo. Two younger members of the species then took him to Doctor Aber, who did her best to save his life despite not having the full knowledge she needed of human anatomy. A week later, Solo awoke and Aber called for Elder Sy'Son to visit her. Sy'Son arrived with another individual, and the doctor led the two to Solo's body, and informed them he had spoken what she considered strange words, his name Han Solo. Sometime later, Solo went for a drink but struggled to communicate with the bartender as he did not speak the species' language. He then went to acquire a starship so he could leave the planet to rescue his friend Chewbacca from being executed by the Benelex Marshal Service, but was unable to acquire one as the locals did not understand him. At this moment, a merchant who appeared to be able to speak basic informed Solo he had a ship. When they arrived at the ship, the merchant told Solo that his people helped out strangers as it was their way. As they left Escalan, Solo went to thank the merchant, but learned he did not actually speak basic. In response, Solo reluctantly pulled out his blaster and used it to take control of the merchant's ship, which he used to rescue Chewbacca, Maz Kanata, and Phaedra from Gulhadar. After they boarded the ship, Solo again thanked the merchant for being able to use his ship, and the merchant responded. Phaedra asked what he had said, and Solo stated that he had no idea.

name: Unidentified exposed-nostrils species
summary: This species was a sentient species that was found within the galaxy. These bipedal humanoid sentients were distinguished by their dark green skin covered in bumps, as well as stalky muscular builds, with heads featuring wideset solid black eyes, large white teeth, exposed nostrils, and a fleshy facial flap connecting their jowls to their nose ridge, in addition to three distinct cranial ridges. By around 3 ABY, a group of members of this species belonging to the Predak Vane criminal group confronted Chelli Lona Aphra and company at Club Lazuli in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica, claiming she destroyed their ship before engaging their targets in a losing brawl.

name: Unidentified extra-galactic race
summary: A sentient, ancient race existed in an unknown galaxy. Millions of years ago, the race designed a gigantic, planet-sized artificial probe with the mission to examine all evolved life forms in the universe and to suppress those which endangered the balance established by the Force. An old man named God was a member of this race.

name: Unidentified eyebrow species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified eyestalk species
