summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified facial-apparatus species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified fan-crested species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished the fan-like crest that ran from the bridge of their nose and over their head. Some time prior to 22 BBY, at least one member of this species was a member of the Jedi Order, their busts displayed within the Temple Archives.

name: Unidentified feathered lizard
summary: A type of feathered lizard was found in the forest of the astronomical object Cethis. The lizards possessed bright plumage and large fleshy wings that they could walk on like front legs. Their domed head featured six black eyes, three on either side, and a pointed beak containing an array of jagged teeth. During the High Republic Era, after the blight emerged on Cethis, two of the lizards became infected. In pain, and with their hunting grounds empty of prey, the lizards pursued a number of citizens of the settlement Haven, though Jedi Master Mirro Lox and his Padawan, Amadeo Azzazzo, killed the creatures, relieving their suffering and rescuing the settlers.

name: Unidentified feline species
summary: This feline species lived on Ephemera. Their excrement was discovered by a philosopher who saw that it had healing properties.

name: Unidentified Fikzwaa species
summary: The diminutive species was native to Fikzwaa, an astronomical object which was under the control of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, the natives usurped the Empire from their homeworld. In 5 ABY, by which the Fikzwaa natives numbered in the billions on their homeworld, the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing carried out a string of genocides against Imperial breakaway factions. After the fighter wing wiped out the residents of the planet Fedovoi End, the 204th engineer Agias Rikton heard from other members of the 204th that Fikzwaa may be their next target and discussed the possibility with the TIE pilot Lieutenant Yrica Quell, describing the Fikzwaa natives as no taller than Quell's knee.

name: Unidentified fin-headed beaked species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished their wide, beak-like mouths and fin-like crest that fanned from the sides of their chins to the top of their head where it grew thickest. Some time prior to 22 BBY, at least one member of this species was a member of the Jedi Order, their busts displayed within the Temple Archives.

name: Unidentified fin-headed species
summary: The fin-headed species was a sentient species in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified finned amphibious species
summary: This species was a sentient species that was present on the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Unidentified fish creature
summary: A gigantic aquatic fish creature was native to a planet.

name: Unidentified fish creature
summary: A gigantic aquatic Fish creature was native to Naboo.

name: Unidentified fish-like creature
summary: Three creatures resembling fish were seen poking their heads out of a river on Endor as an Ewok crossed the water by using a tree root as a makeshift bridge.

name: Unidentified flat-and-lobed-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They possessed reddish-brown skin with large flat heads lined with drooping lobes, lacking any other discernable facial features. Sometime between 0.5 ABY and 1 ABY, at least three members of this specie could be found on the streets of Panna City on the moon Panna Prime when Boba Fett and Chewbacca arrived in search of a serum for the sleeping virus which was affecting Han Solo and Luke Skywalker.

name: Unidentified flat-backed river species
summary: A species of flat-backed beasts with carapaces that inhabited the rivers on Felucia a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The Jungle Felucians rode these beasts around the water ways. Between 3 BBY and 1 BBY, Galen Marek used the force to attract a member of the species. After connecting with its mind Marek considered it semisentient at best and used it to traverse part of Felucia during his mission to hunt down Jedi Master, Shaak Ti.

name: Unidentified flat-bodied creature
summary: A flat-bodied creature was native to the swamps of Dagobah. Its body had a brown and yellow coloration, and it had four eyes.

name: Unidentified flat-headed frog-like species
summary: A frog-like sentient species with green skin and a flat dome-shaped head existed in the galaxy. The species had two bulging yellow eyes with large black pupils, and scattered bumps on their head. They also had a thin long pink mouth that stretched to both sides of their face. The aliens had two thick legs and two thin arms that ended in three fingers and a thumb, with the tips of each colored orange. At one point by 19 BBY, a member of the species was in a settlement marketplace on the planet Korba, carrying a large tube on their back.

name: Unidentified fleshy-flap-faced species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified fleshy hook-headed species
summary: A sentient species that possessed a fleshy appearance, with various bulges and folds, including multiple chins and layered jowls, with large ears, and a curved, an almost snake-like head-stalk that ended in a pair of eyes with exposed, vertical nostrils situated between them. They also had various wart-like growths spread across their skin, as well as a small patch of hair under their bottom lip.

name: Unidentified fleshy-horned pointy-eared species
summary: A humanoid sentient species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species had tan skin with a pair of short, flesh-covered horns protruding from the upper fronts of their heads. They also had two pointed ears and could grow gray mustaches and eyebrows. At one point no earlier than 1 BBY, at least two adult members of the species were present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the city Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. One of the individuals had no facial hair and wore goggles while the other had facial hair and a scar over their right eye. Both individuals drank from cups at the bar.

name: Unidentified fleshy species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified floating species
summary: A floating sentient species lived in the galaxy. They had an elongated, ovular body shape with several tentacles at the rear, a fanged mouth at the front, parapodia along their sides, and striped skin. They could move by floating through the air. Two members of this species attended a party on Alderaan where Princess Leia Organa was present.

name: Unidentified flying carnivore
summary: A large flying carnivore was native to the planet Mycroft in the Fakir sector. It possessed a snake-like body and had thirty centimeter-long fangs that were capable of delivering a poisonous bite. The carnivore inhabited the low, forest-covered mountains on the planet. During the Galactic Civil War, Reekeene's Roughnecks' Green squad were deployed on a mission to Mycroft. The carnivores had starved during the harsh winter, and were ravenously hungry. The presence of the carnivores in the area was a potential hazard to the Rebel agents' mission.

name: Unidentified flying creature
summary: These winged creatures lived on the planet of Alderaan and had sharp beak-like snouts, crests on their heads, small ears, four paws, grayish-white skin and long tails. They were probably very rare, or were discovered just not long before the destruction of Alderaan, as zoologists never had an opportunity to identify the name of the creature or to study its habits properly. It was believed, though, that it fed on nectar and insects — including some large ones, like woolly moths. These creatures became extinct, along with many other species of the Alderaanian fauna, after the destruction of Alderaan in 0 BBY by the first Death Star.

name: Unidentified flying flower species
summary: Members of a species of flying flower creatures lived on the Floating Mountain on the Forest Moon of Endor. While at first they could be mistaken for simple plants, the creatures were actually capable of communicating with other beings. They had a somewhat lizard-like build and petal-wings that rotated, allowing them to fly.

name: Unidentified flying insectoid Endorian creature
summary: A flying creature which strongly resembled known species of insects was seen flying near a river on Endor, before a carnivorous tree used its tongue to capture the creature, drag it into its mouth and swallow it whole. The insect made a loud buzzing sound as flied, and its wings were seen rapidly flapping, allowing it to remain airborne before being eaten.

name: Unidentified flying life form
summary: A flying life form lived in the atmosphere of a Jovian gas giant.

name: Unidentified flying lizard
summary: The planet Da'nor was home to a semi-sentient species of flying lizard. These lizards were ectothermic, and they were distinguished by a set of wings and iridescent skin. In 0 ABY, a small group of Rebels crash-landed on Da'nor, and one of the members, twelve-year-old Stuart Zissu, was accompanied by a lizard as he journeyed across the planet.

name: Unidentified flying monstrosity
summary: A species of green-skinned reptavian flying monstrosities that resembled miniature dragons inhabited the planet Ziost. During his time on Ziost, Ben Skywalker speculated that these creatures could be mutated by the planet's water, which he hoped wasn't the case since he needed water to survive.

name: Unidentified flying red Endorian creature
summary: Two unidentified red creatures were seen using their long tails to hang upside down from a tree branch on Endor, before they used their wings to fly away.

name: Unidentified flying reptile
summary: A large type of non-hostile flying reptile lived on the planet Sophros, baring a resemblance to rock-vultures. During the mission to Planet X, Marda Ro, Bokana Koss, Ort, Radicaz Dobbs, Galamal and Tareen came across a pair circling above them.

name: Unidentified flying serpent
summary: A non-sentient species of flying serpent lived on the Forest Moon of Endor, and at least one specimen lived in a cave. The creature had two small wings slightly forward of the midpoint of its body, and black eyebrows situated above yellow eyes with black pupils. Mostly a single shade of purple, but with a paler snout and spots on its wings, the creature had a forked tongue and four fangs. Its body, which was long and flexible, sported a rattle at the end, and its head featured several spikes. In 3 ABY, the Ewoks Weechee Warrick, Widdle Warrick, Paploo, and Teebo frightened one such serpent when they passed through its cave on their way to the Tree of Light.
distinctions: Elongated body; small wings; forked tongue; rattle

name: Unidentified forehead species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified four-armed creature
summary: This four-armed creature was encountered by C-3PO and R2-D2 when the droids were stranded on a planet due to their space vessel needing a new supply of space crystals. The creature was covered in red fur, and had a round pink nose, yellow eyes and pointed ears. The creature emerged from the trees in a forest as the droids were looking for a cave containing replacement crystals. At Artoo's suggestion, C-3PO pet the hand of the creature, who then pointed the droid in the direction of the cave.

name: Unidentified four-armed crested species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified four-armed four-nostriled species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified four-armed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified four-breasted horned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Groff Zugga and Groff Haugg were members of this species.

name: Unidentified four-breasted species
summary: A four-breasted species was a sentient humanoid species that existed in the galaxy. Around 9 ABY, a light-skinned, dark-haired female member of the species was present at Starport Borgo, performing solo dances as a door girl to attract customers to a local dance club.

name: Unidentified four-eyed crested species
summary: A sentient species that possessed a large cranium, with a head crest, four eyes, an inverted nose, pronounced upper lip, and bony neck.

name: Unidentified four-eyed Jawa-like species
summary: The species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their short stature and four glowing eyes, commonly wrapping their bodies in cloth and robes. At least four members of this species were present on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.

name: Unidentified four-eyed lobed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified four-eyed quadruped
summary: One of a four-eyed quadruped species was ridden by former Nihil Tempest Runner Lourna Dee on the planet Ballum, in her capacity as enforcer for the Hutt Skarabda. It was covered in white fur that was tipped with blue and pink, and had blue spots on its sides. It had a wide mouth full of sharp teeth and a pointed blue tongue. Its face featured four yellow eyes with red pupils as well as four nostrils, and it had four small horns on its head. Its underbelly was pink with round orange protrusions. It ran on four legs that were tipped with long, sharp claws. When ridden, it was mounted with a saddle and bridle.

name: Unidentified four-eyed species
summary: A four-eyed species existed in the galaxy. An individual of the species was a member of the Pendarran's Revenge.

name: Unidentified four-eyed tendrilled species
summary: The species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their elongated heads, with four dark or yellow eyes, as well as a cluster of tendrils dangling from the bottoms of their faces. They also possessed serrated, claw-like hands, and green pigmentation. At least one member of this species was present on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY, while another visited Bezz Drexx's tower around the same time during the Clone Wars.

name: Unidentified four-horned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified frilled reptiloid species
summary: This reptiloid race had large frills on their necks and broad tails. A member of this species was a New Republic diplomat.

name: Unidentified frilled serpent
summary: A species of frilled serpent was found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dekien. The massive creatures had wide maws, needle-sharp teeth, black scales, and barbed tails. Two of the serpents were summoned by Mirahi while her puppet, the Sith demon Kouru, was on Dekien, in order to distract the Jedi that were threatening her.

name: Unidentified frog-like creature
summary: An unidentified creature resembling a frog resided within a river on the Forest Moon of Endor, where it was was seen on top of a victoria which an Ewok used as a makeshift cover with a reed to act as breathing tube while swimming underwater, although the Ewok collided with a rock, causing the frog to quickly jump off the pad into the water.

name: Unidentified furry Endorian creature
summary: A species of small, brown furred creatures were native to the Forest Moon Endor. After her parents were rescued from the Gorax, Cindel Towani held one creature of this species in the Warrick family hut.

name: Unidentified furry large-eared species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified furry species
summary: A furry, humanoid species lived in the galaxy. One eyepatch wearing member of this species was present at a cantina on Keyorin when Han Solo, Lando Calrissian, and Chewbacca visited. A representative of this species was also present at the First Conference of Free Peoples in 4 ABY.

name: Unidentified Gansevor creature
summary: A winged creature lived on the planet Gansevor. It was used as a draft animal.

name: Unidentified Gap Nine species
summary: This biped reptiloid species was native to the swamp planet of Gap Nine.

name: Unidentified Garqian anthropoid
summary: A species of furry anthropoids was native to Garqi, an agriworld in the Cassander sector. In 25 ABY, when the Jedi Knight Corran Horn led a team of his fellow Jedi to Garqi to investigate the Yuuzhan Vong presence on the planet, several of these anthropoids were frightened by his starship as it traversed a purple forest. The creatures scurried away from its approach.

name: Unidentified Garqian fowl
summary: A species of fowl lived on Garqi, an agriworld located in the Cassander sector. The fowl had a small body, with a tail several times its length. This was divided into three, circular-tipped, central tail feathers. The bird had two, long wings, each terminating in two-digit, bald, pink claws. The body, wings, and tail were all covered in pink plumage. The species had a small, bald head, with a pink comb between its eyes. These eyes had a white sclera and black pupil, and were placed one on each side of the head. The species' beak was pink and ridged, and had an overhanging maxilla. In 19 BBY, four birds of this species were disturbed from grasslands when the youngling Evan ran away from the clone commandos of Aiwha Squad shortly after the conclusion of the Battle of Garqi. The fowls scattered in different directions, with one shedding several feathers as it flew away.

name: Unidentified Garqian reptile
summary: A species of green reptile lived on Garqi, an agriworld located in the Cassandran Worlds. The reptile had four limbs, which each terminated in three digits, and a long, dexterous tail that it could wrap around tree branches. At its very end, this tail divided into two, curled parts. The reptile had a long, jagged jawline, a stubby nose, and large, round, lidded eyes. A spiky frill ran along the crest of its back from just behind its first shoulder joint down to the start of its tail. An additional frill grew on the final length of tail. In 19 BBY, a reptile of this species slept in a bough near the campfire of the clone commandos of Aiwha Squad, shortly after the conclusion of the Battle of Garqi.

name: Unidentified Garr'lst species
summary: This felinoid race were native to the planet Garr'lst. They were massacred by the Human mercenary brigader Jarrow Rusher.

name: Unidentified gelatinous lifeform
summary: A type of lifeform found in the galaxy. In 3 ABY, a Umgullian transport ship containing a number of the lifeforms illegally docked in Hanger 5 of Hauler's Keep, a space station located in the Khepi system. While it was docked the lifeforms escaped the the ship and later an announcement was made over the station's speaker system informing the owner of the ship that the lifeforms were loose and were interfering with the station's equipment.

name: Unidentified giant bird
summary: A type of giant bird was once found on the moon Olgothon 3 and served as a natural predator to the reptilian thraxsos. However, these large carnivorous birds went extinct, leaving the thraxsos to roam free and eat anything they wanted. Around 20 BBY, Jedi Knights Tualon Yaluna and Iskat Akaris met the Anzellan slicer Ginntho on Olgothon 3, aiming to recruit her to serve the Republic military effort in the Clone Wars against the breakaway Confederacy of Independent Systems. During their meeting, the Jedi and their company of clone troopers were attacked by two thraxsos, which Yaluna and Akaris succeeded in killing. In the aftermath, Ginntho expressed her annoyance at thraxsos in general and briefly explained how the giant birds that had once preyed on them went extinct, leaving the thraxsos without a predator to keep them in check.

name: Unidentified giant bird-like Endorian creature
summary: A giant bird was found on Endor. It was resting on top of a cliff, until it was disturbed by the Ewok Teebo as he attempted to use a lasso to swing across the cliff, but the rope got caught around the bird’s lower body, causing it to angrily squawk and fly into the air, with Teebo still holding onto the rope before he fell to the ground.

name: Unidentified giant serpent
summary: A giant non-sentient serpent lived on a terrestrial planet. When lifting its upper body vertically, it could reach the height of a 1.7-meters-tall 3PO-series protocol droid. The snake was covered in red scales, and it had a row of crests running along the top of its body. It had yellow eyes and a red-colored split tongue. When the creature's belly was stroked it would fall asleep. At one point, the protocol droid C-3PO and the astromech droid R2-D2 visited the planet inhabited by the giant serpent. The two droids undertook a trip to try and locate a source of space crystals needed for their starship; however, one of the serpents blocked their way on a narrow mountain pass. While the creature observed the pair with its body raised upward, R2-D2 informed C-3PO how to make it fall asleep. Initially hesitant, the protocol droid ultimately put the serpent asleep, after which the droid pair continued on their journey.

name: Unidentified Gloam predator
summary: A predator was a type of carnivorous mammals that inhabited the swamps of the planet Gloam. They appeared to be a cross between a charhound and a giant cat. They had three eyes across the center of their head, a pink nose, a mouth with two rows of needle-like teeth and a pair of spiky black antlers protruding from their forehead. They stood on four legs and had a muscular body covered in a layer of thin black-and-green fur. Three of these enormous beasts were encountered in 382 BBY by Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani and Jedi Master Silandra Sho while they were searching for survivors of Outer Rim Expedition Two-Five-Two, a fellow Republic Pathfinder team. The predators sought to tire the two female Jedi out, but through the aggressive defense of Sho's shield bonking them on the nose and bodies, they were eventually compelled to retreat.
distinctions: Three eyes and a pair of spiky black antlers

name: Unidentified goggled species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified googly-eyed species
summary: An extra-galactic sentient species with googly-eyes visited the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War. They pitted the crews of an Alliance to Restore the Republic corvette and an Imperial Star Destroyer against one another in a form of sporting contest. They declined to become involved in the war, however, as they were heading back to their home galaxy.

name: Unidentified Gottlegoob species
summary: This sentient species was native to Gottlegoob. During the Presidency of Leia Organa Solo, they suffered from famine.

name: Unidentified gray horned species
summary: This species were gray-skinned humanoids with muzzles and cranial horns which sprouted from the back of their heads. A member of this species was a scavenger in Mos Espa who sold parts scavenged from destroyed podracers. A number of other members of this species served as guards under the authority of the Hutts in Mos Espa around 32 BBY. The species was forceful, but slow, and individuals were relatively obedient if paid to guard something or the like.

name: Unidentified gray human-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified gray near-human species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified gray reptilian Endorian creature
summary: A species of large reptilians lived on Endor. They could attack their victims with their strong tails or leap into the air to lunge at them.

name: Unidentified gray-skinned pointy-eared species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The bulky humanoid species was distinguished by their gray and pointed ears. One member of this species was present on the planet Varkana in 34 ABY, commonly seen alongside another human, the two fleeing together when the First Order arrived.

name: Unidentified gray wide-set-eyes species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their gray skin and tall heads with wide-set eyes, some members of the species also sporting a series of small lobes extending from the back of their head, possibly consisting of hair or feathers. In 4 ABY, at least three members of this species, two adults and one child, boarded a transport headed for the planet Phorliss alongside the Human Mara Jade.

name: Unidentified green-and-tan-faced species
summary: A sentient species with green-and-tan skin existed in the galaxy. The aliens were short and had two legs and two arms that ended in three fingers each. They had pointed ears, red eyes, upturned noses, and ridges on their forehead. Members of the species were capable of consuming a type of beverage. At some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY, at least two members of the species were present on the planet Golak. One left the Golak Mahal by speeder bike as the human siblings Rani and Charuk arrived, the former being Force-sensitive. Another member of the species witnessed an Inquisitor confront Rani and was caught up in a scuffle when a sandstorm passed through the Mahal. Both members on Golak wore red turbans with an assortment of colorful robes and cloths with curled shoes.

name: Unidentified green-and-yellow tree-dwelling Endorian creature
summary: A species of monkey-like creatures inhabited the forest moon of Endor. They possessed green and yellow skin, with a row of brown spikes running down their back. The species also had long, prehensile tails, sharp claws, and pointed teeth. They seemed to primarily dwell in trees and were proficient in both jumping and climbing. In 3 ABY, the female Ewoks Latara and Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka approached a group of these creatures in an attempt to sell them a type of automated mixer, though unable to understand their sales pitch, one of the creatures swallowed the device whole before grabbing Latara. They attempted to carry her up and off into the trees, though she was saved by the Kneesa's quick thinking, who had thrown a grappling rope for her friend to grab onto.

name: Unidentified green-armed species
summary: This species was a bipedal humanoid sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their white faces, green arms and necks, and tan hands. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was present at Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk when Koresh attempted to take Din Djarin's Mandalorian armor.

name: Unidentified green bug
summary: A species of green insects inhabited the jungle planet Cholganna in the Outer Rim Territories. About the size of a Human thumb, the insects were capable of flight and buzzed as they did so. They also possessed stingers, which made them dangerous to other large animals if the bugs were in a swarm. The bugs would flee if faced with smoke, meaning smoking them out was an effective strategy to combat the insects. By the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, a group of hundreds of the bugs had made their home in escape pod 34 Besh, a pod from the Confederacy of Independent Systems Munificent-class star frigate Sa Nalaor, which crashed on Cholganna at the end of the Clone Wars, a previous galactic conflict. The group swarmed anything which approached the pod. During the Galactic Civil War a group of spacers attempting to locate the Sa Nalaor investigated escape pod 34 Besh and were swarmed by the insects living inside.

name: Unidentified green cone-headed species
summary: A sentient species that lived in the galaxy had multiple members served as senators in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic.

name: Unidentified green creature
summary: Green quadrupeds were creatures who inhabited a swampy planet that was visited by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker sometime during the Clone Wars, an intergalactic war that started during 22 BBY. The creatures generally lived in packs, and they were known to continuously make a sound that sounded like "nog" over and over again.
distinctions: Large round eyes, four limbs, sharp teeth

name: Unidentified green-finned species
summary: A green-finned species colonized the gas giant Yorn Skot. They were humanoid, and their skin color was a bright to olive green with darker green mottled spots on their head and arms. The species had small green fins on the backs of their forearms and calves. Some individuals had hair on their heads, but they were otherwise hairless. Both sexes had very small ears and gill-like structures on the sides of their necks, and females had breasts. Their eyes were round with a large round pupil, and their teeth were noticeably sharp. Clode Rhoden, Madam Rhoden, and Buck were of this species.

name: Unidentified green flying species
summary: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their green skin and ray-like frames, lacking arms or legs, instead possessing a pair of wing-like limbs. Capable of flight, they seemingly had few facial features, save for a mouth on the underside of their bodies and potentially squinted eyes. They donned only strapped satchels for clothing. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species were present in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.

name: Unidentified green long-faced species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified green near-human species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their green skin and colorful hair. In 4 ABY, numerous members of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren, serving who was believed to be Jeodu criminal Dequc, though it turned out to only be a decoy.

name: Unidentified green reptilian Endorian creature
summary: A large reptilian creature was hanging from the ceiling in Logray's hut on Bright Tree Village, and while it appeared to be unresponsive when an intruding Dulok opened its mouth and peeked inside, a smaller reptile which had been hiding inside the creature stuck its head out of the larger beast’s mouth and angrily snarled at the Dulok.

name: Unidentified green reptiloid species
summary: When Leia Organa first visited Cloud City on Bespin, at least two members of a species of green reptiloids were present there.

name: Unidentified green-skinned humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified green-skinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified green thin-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their green skin and long, almost noodle-like necks and head. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species were present in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.

name: Unidentified green yellow-eyed species
summary: The species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their green skin and solid yellow eyes, with flat lips, naturally downturned mouths, hairless heads, and a lack of visible nostrils. At least two members of this species, clad in identical yellow and purple robes and headgear, were present in Bezz Drexx's tower some time during the Clone Wars.

name: Unidentified greenish-blue species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified groove-skinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Gwori lizard
summary: A species of lizard inhabited Gwori. One lizard killed a clone trooper during the Clone Wars.

name: Unidentified hairy-eared species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified hairy-humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified head-tail species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified head-tendril species
summary: The Jedi twins Tiplee and Tiplar were members of a humanoid sentient species. Their skin color was red and green, respectively, and both had blue eyes.

name: Unidentified head-tendrils species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Hijarna species
summary: This sentient species was once native to Hijarna. They were the builders of the Fortress of Hijarna, which was their last point of defense against alien invaders. They were made extinct around that time.

name: Unidentified Hissrich species
summary: A sentient species were native to the planet Hissrich.

name: Unidentified Hitaka species
summary: The Hitakans were a blue-skinned race of Humanoids found on the farming planet of Hitaka.

name: Unidentified hive-mind beetle
summary: A type of hive-mind beetle lurked in the service corridors of the First Death Star during its construction over the planet Geonosis between 14 BBY and 9 BBY. Though able to navigate independently, the murderous bugs could combine into a menacing monster capable of quickly slaughtering large beings, including a Whiphid, with their fangs. When Imperial pest controller Jonram Dremel was tasked with tracking down a large creature in the depths of the space station with the aid of four prisoners, the group encountered some of the flying beetles and the Dianoga Omi. The combined form of the beetles ambushed the Whiphid J'Rea and a Dianoga hatchling, scaring the human criminal Geratt into fleeing. The criminal was quickly subdued by the Imperial pest controller by activating Geratt's stun collar. In the brief moment Geratt was taken to the floor, a large number of beetles surrounded the criminal before they coalesced into their fanged form and took the human's life. As the survivors turned on one another, Dremel was slain and Espirion criminal Saan was left to die by the Mohsenian Kricad. Kricad was nearly attacked by the creature before Omi pounced on the beetle monster, giving the Mohsenian a chance to escape. Unfortunately for him, however, a number of the beetles stowed away onto Dremel's ship as Kricad made his jump to hyperspace.

name: Unidentified hive-mind insectoid species
summary: A species of sentient grasshopper-like beings produced sound and speech by rubbing together their legs. Members of the species shared several bodies via single hive mind. During the Galactic Civil War, one such alien worked as a bartender and at one point sold information to the smuggler Roark Garnet.
distinctions: Produces speech by rubbing legs together

name: Unidentified horn-beaked Endorian creature
summary: A species of bird with a beak shaped like a horn inhabited the forest moon of Endor. One with green feathers was flying near Bright Tree Village, and it later cowered in terror when the village was attacked by Duloks. Another sat on a tree perch and observed two munyips kissing in a neighboring tree. A blue-feathered bird was seen flying away in terror when Teebo played a prank by dressing up as a monster to scare his friends.

name: Unidentified horn-row species
summary: A species that existed in the galaxy. This bipedal humanoid sentient species was distinguished by the row of horns that extended from their forehead up and over the top of their craniums. By 138 ABY, a member of this species served as a Sith Lord among the One Sith and Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, defeated and left to die that year on the planet Daluuj after a confrontation with Cade Skywalker and his allies.

name: Unidentified Horn Station species
summary: This hulking reptilian species had green skin and were native to Horn Station. Kerlo was a member of this species.

name: Unidentified horned humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified horned pointed-ears species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified horned squirrel
summary: A species of squirrel lived within the swamps of the planet Tenoo. The creatures were small and herbivorous, and possessed a pair of horns that spiraled upward from the tops of their heads. In 232 BBY the Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs, along with Jedi Master Yoda, encountered a group of the squirrels after having tamed a large swamp puppy. The Jedi shared a portion of fruit they had harvested from the swamp with the creatures as Master Yoda educated them.

name: Unidentified Hovun IV creature
summary: A large tentacled creature was native to the planet Hovun IV.

name: Unidentified H'relac species
summary: This sentient species was native to the H'relac system. They fought to maintain their freedom when an alliance of corporations tried to take control of the system, around the time of the Battle of Yavin.

name: Unidentified hulking furry species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified hulking horned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified hulking hunched species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified hulking plated species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified hunched lizard species
summary: This species was a sentient species found within the galaxy. They were distinguished by their reptilian bodies, with hunched posture, long snouts, and textured green, almost porous skin. One member of this species, nicknamed "lizard boy", worked as a thief in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine by 32 BBY, where he encountered the Human Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn after stealing a plasma ignition capacitor from a young Anakin Skywalker, the lightsaber wielding man sparing the alien after dispatching his scavenger accomplice.

name: Unidentified hunched species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Hurikane species
summary: A sentient gray rock and crystal species was indigenous to the planet of Hurikane. In 58 BBY, while still a Padawan who had not built his own lightsaber, Mace Windu was sent to Hurikane to negotiate with these beings and possibly obtain special lightsaber crystals from them. The mission did not start out well, resulting in Windu being chased by several members of the species. When one of his pursuers fell into a canyon, the young Padawan turned back to heal the being's broken body by using the Force. In gratitude, Mace received some of the crystals from the being's body—the very Hurrikane crystals he sought.

name: Unidentified Ilum creature
summary: A type of creature inhabited the planet-turned superweapon Ilum in the Unknown Regions. The creature had bat-like wings and a carnivorous diet.

name: Unidentified insectoid species
summary: A sentient species of ancient insectoids were active in the galaxy following the Battle of Jakku. Navigators known as the Attendants were members of the insectoid species. At least two of the species were present on the Supremacy, the flagship of First Order Supreme Leader Snoke in 34 ABY.

name: Unidentified Iokath species
summary: A species in Wild Space, the name of which had been lost to time, was responsible for the construction of the massive habitable sphere named Iokath.

name: Unidentified jagged-cranial-spikes species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Jakku quadruped
summary: Several creatures of a quadruped species were present at Tuanul on the desert planet Jakku, shortly before the First Order sacked the village.

name: Unidentified Janguine species
summary: A sentient species of jungle barbarians inhabited Janguine, a planet located in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They shared the planet with the Mooloolian tribes, which occupied the mountainous regions of the planet. The jungle barbarians eventually vanished, and their language was absorbed by the Mooloolian tribes by 275 BBY. In 25 ABY, the protocol droid C-3PO speculated that the language of the jungle barbarians was related to that used by a newly encountered species, the Yuuzhan Vong; however, the speculation later proved groundless as the Yuuzhan Vong's origins were extra-galactic.

name: Unidentified jawline-horns species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were a bipedal humanoid species distinguished by a series of pointed boney horns protruding from their jawline. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was present at Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk when Koresh attempted to take Din Djarin's Mandalorian armor, attacking the bounty hunter before being taken down.

name: Unidentified jawline-spikes species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified jellyfish
summary: A variety of jellyfish was native to the planet Dac. Cloned tissue from the jellyfish was used to produce organic gills.

name: Unidentified Jeosyn species
summary: Prior to the Galactic Civil War, a sentient species used to live on the planet Jeosyn. The only remnant of their civilization was ceramic statues containing crystals that gave them the energy to move when sentient brain activity on the planet suddenly stopped, such as when a sentient being died. When that happened, a number of statues corresponding to the amount of organisms that just died would begin moving towards the corpse or corpses before carrying them away, presumably to the chamber the statues came from.

name: Unidentified Jerrilek species
summary: Archaeologists discovered evidence that in approximately 1,000,000 BBY an intelligent, aquatic species inhabited Jerrilek, a planet located on the Koros Trunk Line of the Deep Core. All that remained of the species by the time of the Battle of Yavin were ruined cities in the depths of the planet's oceans. Due to the ruins, rumors spread about the possibility of the species.

name: Unidentified Jomark species
summary: This sentient species was native to Jomark. They were an ancient people that were the builders of the High Castle, who had long-since vanished by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

name: Unidentified Kamar species
summary: The astronomical object Kamar was home to an insectoid sentient species that were once encountered by Amara Kel.

name: Unidentified Kardoa creature
summary: A type of green flying creature inhabited the planet Kardoa.

name: Unidentified knobbly-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their large, three-toed feet, as well as massive, three-fingered hands. They also possessed long faces with knobbly craniums. In 4 ABY, two members of this species traveled aboard a transport known as the Tippler's Groan headed from Darsie to the planet Phorliss alongside the Human Mara Jade.

name: Unidentified Kullgroon species
summary: This species was a sentient species from the planet Kullgroon. Batalla was a member of this species.

name: Unidentified Kursid species
summary: A sentient humanoid species resided on Kursid. In 104 BBY, Darth Plagueis and Darth Tenebrous fought members of the species—warriors specifically—and Plagueis later took his own Sith apprentice, Darth Sidious to murder members of this species with him.

name: Unidentified land-dwelling shelled Endorian creature
summary: During the Ewok Civil War, three Ewoks rode atop a large shelled creature during a brutal battle between different Ewok factions. One of the Ewoks sat at the front of the creature's shell and handled the beast's reigns, while another stood on its shell brandishing a spear, and the other another aimed a bow while standing on its shell.

name: Unidentified lanky species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified large-armed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified large-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified large gray humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified large-headed humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified large-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified large-headed tendriled species
summary: A sentient humanoid species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species had large heads and green or pink skin. They had two small tendrils that danged from their upper lips, large black eyes, and lacked any visible nostrils. At one point no earlier than 1 BBY, at least two adult members of the species were present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the city of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. Both individuals wore similar outfits featuring gloves and a full body suit with straight grooves on the shoulders and torso.

name: Unidentified large Tolis creature
summary: A type of leviathan creature was found on the planet Tolis. Larger than mountains, the leviathans were immensely strong in the Force. The creatures were ancient, existing before the rise of the native Tolemites and outlasting the species' extinction; Jedi Knight Reath Silas suspected they were the cause of the Tolemites' Force-based religion. After the Tolemites' civilization was destroyed in a flood, the leviathans hibernated in the ocean off the shores of Tolis's islands. During the High Republic Era, Silas and the former Jedi Master Cohmac Vitus visited Tolis to learn about the Force-draining Nameless creatures and the blight. The pair spotted the leviathans, assuming the creatures were mountains, though Silas eventually learned the truth. Silas, assisted by Vitus and Jedi Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo, later reached out to one of the leviathans, hoping it would assist by distracting a Nameless that was pursuing them. The leviathan awoke, and the Nameless, as Silas had hoped, attempted to feed on it. As the Nameless climbed up the leviathan, the larger creature returned back to the sea.

name: Unidentified large-upper-teeth species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their long snouts and buck teeth. In 4 ABY, at least one member of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren, and another in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.

name: Unidentified large white humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified leviathan
summary: A leviathan species lived on the coral moon Rugosa sometime before a calamity had boiled its oceans away. A skeleton remained on the moon during the time of the Clone Wars, allowing a school of neebrays to colonize the ribs.

name: Unidentified long eyestalk Endorian creature
summary: A green creature on Endor with two long eyestalks any many legs was setting next to a river, before it launched itself into to air and landed on sand, which it instantly buried itself in, and it then used its legs to quickly crawl away.

name: Unidentified long-faced species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified long-headed alien species
summary: A sentient alien species lived during the Imperial Era. They had dark gray or dark blue skin and possessed an elongated head. One such being was once at the Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy.

name: Unidentified long-headed black-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their wrinkled brown skin, with elongated snouts and craniums, as well as solid black eyes. In 4 ABY, at least three members of this species, a mother and two children, could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren.

name: Unidentified long-legged species
summary: A reptilian species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified long-necked dark-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their long necks and large dark eyes. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren.

name: Unidentified long-necked furry species
summary: An unidentified long-necked furry species, with slender bodies, long necks, and elongated faces, possessing tufts of hair around their mouths, as well as four-fingered hands and medium-length tails. While still early into their development, this species was discovered by the Karflo Corporation, who converted their homeworld into a mining colony and illegally exploited and abused the native population, forcing them to mine valuable raw material for minimal wages. While the Galactic Empire turned a blind eye to Karflo's disreputable practices, the New Republic Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services began to uncover similar "development colonies" such as Gargolyn IV, potentially including the one housing this species as well, causing the new governing body to confirm they had no leniency for such illicit activities with the intent to take action against them.

name: Unidentified long-necked masked species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified long-necked species
summary: A bipedal species lived in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. A species of tall, thin-necked beings, at least one member resided in a mining village on Mapuzo in 9 BBY, while another was present on the Spur Orbiting Market in 3 ABY. That individual was on the space station during an altercation between an Arcona bounty hunter and the cyborg Beilert Valance.

name: Unidentified long-snouted sunken-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their gray skin, with elongated probiscis-like snouts, as well as sunken eyes and pronounced brows. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species were present in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.

name: Unidentified long-tailed Endorian creature
summary: A long-tailed, four-legged creature was found on Endor. It was sleeping in a tree until it was awoken by the sound of Logray teaching Teebo to use magic, and it was visibly started by the noise.

name: Unidentified lumpy-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified lupine species
summary: A lupine species of bipedal sentients lived on a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, near the border of Galactic Republic space. They had lupine lower legs, with high ankle joints and three-clawed feet. The species had pointed ears and gray skin, with red eyes. They had sharp teeth and typically wore hoods. During the Mandalorian Wars, their homeworld was conquered by Mandalorian forces under control of Rohlan Dyre, a commander of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders who was trying to escape the army so as to discover the true motivation of the Mandalorian expansion. He killed many of the species while making his escape. A couple of members were caught on the surveillance tapes of Eejee Vamm while the Duros was searching for Gorman Vandrayk. Later, at least one member of the species was part of the Taris Resistance after the planet was conquered by the Mandalorians. He was present when Shel Jelavan attacked Zayne Carrick on his arrival at the Resistance base.

name: Unidentified maggot
summary: A non-sentient species of maggot lived on the planet Felucia. Theelin New Republic pilot Chass na Chadic heard stories from her mother about how the maggots spent most of their lives being blown around the planet on storm winds. Although they were occasionally carried to the other side of the planet by the winds, the maggots would return to their point of origin in order to breed.

name: Unidentified Majoor species
summary: A species of sentient, green-skinned humanoids made up at least part of the population of the planet Majoor in the Expansion Region. Each member of the species had two three-fingered hands, a globular head, and thick lips. The species had access to galactic-standard technology by the time of the early Galactic Empire. Their architecture featured dome- and saucer-shaped, white-colored structures, some held aloft by narrow towers. Their government supported a fleet of spacegoing vessels, some of which were used to engage in diplomacy with neighboring peoples. To this end, the species also fielded ambassadors. During one such mission, the Ambassador Zell led a convoy to the planet Armath to discuss peace. However, the ships were attacked by the pirate captain Reddjak, who had been freed from incarceration on Majoor by Zell's own son, Llez. Llez had a child's romantic view of piracy, but the boy soon saw his mistake when he realized that Reddjak intended to attack his father's peace mission. With the help of his droid caretakers, C-3PO and R2-D2, Llez saved his father's convoy and allowed Zell to lead a security team to Reddjak's ship to overpower and apprehend the fugitive pirate.
distinctions: Three-fingered hands, thick lips, round head

name: Unidentified Malpaz species
summary: A sentient species of avians were native to the planet Malpaz. During the Clone Wars the species began integrating with colonists from all over the sector.

name: Unidentified Mamendin species
summary: The planet Mamendin was the homeworld of a sentient species of humanoids. In 25 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Siri Tachi, Anakin Skywalker and Ferus Olin impersonated the Slams, a criminal gang composed of members of this species.

name: Unidentified mammalian Endorian creature
summary: A species of mammals were small, predatory creatures native to the Forest Moon Endor. While considered cute and cuddly, the animals could become agitated when restless. When restless, they would bite or claw the perpetrator. When the Human youngling Cindel Towani visited Endor, the native Ewok Wicket Warrick allowed her to play with one who was quite clearly scared of the child.

name: Unidentified mammalian species
summary: A mammalian species was one of the many sentient species of the galaxy.

name: Unidentified mandible species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified maroon species
summary: A maroon-skinned humanoid species found within the galaxy.

name: Unidentified masked humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The humanoid species was distinguished by their distinctive masks which possessed an almost beak-like shape, as well as a curved protrusion extending upwards from their cranial area. In 9 BBY, a member of species attempted to apprehend a young Leia Organa on the planet Daiyu before being shot in the back by Jedi-in-hiding Obi-Wan Kenobi. In 35 ABY, another member of this species was present on the planet Pasaana during the Festival of the Ancestors.

name: Unidentified mercury-based species
summary: A sentient species of beings mostly made of mercury and capable of shapeshifting was native to the Outer Rim planet Sevetta, which was mercury-rich and had a toxic atmosphere. The rogue clone trooper Hunter was aware of the species, and during or after 18 BBY, while on the mercury-rich planet Tryth, he told fellow clone Omega about them, which amazed her.

name: Unidentified mermaid-like species
summary: An aquatic mermaid-like species lived in the galaxy. Several members of this species once performed as dancers at Chalmun's Cantina in Mos Eisley.

name: Unidentified Mid Rim creature
summary: An extract from a creature that lived on moon in the galaxy's Mid Rim was used as a mild anaesthetic by the natives of the moon. The First Order Commander Malarus used it to promote body mass growth and to stimulate intelligence.

name: Unidentified Millinar species
summary: A species of hermaphroditic sentients lived on the temperate planet Millinar that was located in the Inner Rim's Hapes Cluster and was hidden from the rest of the galaxy by a giant dust cloud. Members of the species developed skills in using the Force, including abilities that were unknown to Luke Skywalker, a Human Jedi who attempted to establish a new incarnation of the dissolved Jedi Order between 4 ABY and 11 ABY.

name: Unidentified mostly-blue species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified moth
summary: A type of moth was found on the planet Siline. It had curling antenna and rainbows of spiky fur on its back. In 134 BBY, during the great hunt—the final round of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual on Siline—Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon saw bright silver flitting in her periphery and noticed one of the moths in a forest within the hunting arena.

name: Unidentified mouthless humanoid species
summary: A mouthless sentient species existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified mouthless species
summary: A mouthless green-skinned alien species lived in the galaxy. The species was humanoid in form. Two black eyes were set in its face, along with a pronounced nose. The species could be fed nutrients through a special suit. During the Cold War, one member lived aboard the Colossus on the planet Castilon and liked to rest at Aunt Z's Tavern. The alien later watched the descent of the station into the ocean in a corridor with Jooks.

name: Unidentified multi-chinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished their long, blubbery necks with multiple chin folds, as well as stringy hair. Some time prior to 22 BBY, at least one member of this species was a member of the Jedi Order, their busts displayed within the Temple Archives.

name: Unidentified multi-legged Endor creature
summary: A species of small multi-legged creatures was native to the forest moon of Endor. The Dulok king Gorneesh used one such creature as a sponge while bathing.

name: Unidentified mushroom breed
summary: A special breed of mushroom grew in the excess condensation of moisture vaporators on the desert planet Tatooine. The breed was edible to Artiodacs and was used as an ingredient in the dish Tatooine Terrine, with its juices providing moisture in the recipe. In 34 ABY, the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs included the mushrooms in a recipe for Tatooine Terrine in his first cookbook, The Official Black Spire Outpost Cookbook.

name: Unidentified Neijaia species
summary: A humanoid species native to a Neijaia that spoke the language Neijaian. Members of the species chased Poe Dameron and BB-8, and later caught them, along with Kori Ong, in a trap. With Ong's help, Dameron and BB-8 escaped the natives, and were able to leave the planet.

name: Unidentified Neona species
summary: A sentient species lived on the planet Neona, which was located in the Freeworlds Territory of the Colonies' Tapani sector. The species developed an advanced culture and constructed an extensive network of structures on Neona's surface. Around 19,997 BBY, Neona underwent a sustained warming period: polar ice caps melted, raising the level of Neona's oceans until all the planet's landmasses were covered except for a frozen continent at each pole. The flooding of their cities led to the extinction of the species. Twenty-thousand years later, the ruins of their civilization still dotted Neona's ocean bed. By this time, Neona had become a mining world under the control of Hanson Mining Consolidated. While under Hanson Mining's administration, teams of archeologists and xenoanthrolopogists occasionally explored these ruins, including when the Mrlsst Academy dispatched a team of scientists to examine the ruins in a systematic study. They established a small research station underwater at the edge of a large ruin in Neona's southern hemisphere.

name: Unidentified Niamos seabird
summary: A type of seabird lived on the planet Niamos' coast in 5 BBY.

name: Unidentified Nilash species
summary: The Nilash natives were a tree-dwelling people and were noted for their inventiveness, spirit and the ability to form telepathic group minds. This species was enslaved by Sith Lord Daiman and forced to work in a Daimanite munitions factory, however they were liberated by the Jedi Knight Kerra Holt shortly after the Destruction of Chelloa in 1032 BBY.
distinctions: Tree-dwelling, able to form telepathic group minds

name: Unidentified nose species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified noseless species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Nyny species
summary: The Outer Rim planet Nyny was the homeworld of a sentient species with three heads. When wounded, the species leaked out black ichors. In 17 ABY, a member of the species represented Nyny in the New Republic Senate. In the bombing of the Senate Hall on the planet Coruscant that year,—orchestrated by the darksider Kueller in an attempt to incapacitate the New Republic—the senator was killed. Han Solo, the husband of the Chief of State Leia Organa Solo, saw the senator lying on the lawn outside the Senate Hall, with all three of his heads bent backward at an awkward angle.

name: Unidentified octopoid species
summary: An octopoid species lived in the galaxy. Two members of this species were serving on the Aurorient Express as musicians in a band.

name: Unidentified octopus-like creature
summary: An unidentified creature resembling an octopus resided within a river on the Forest Moon of Endor, and it clung to the head of the Ewok Latara after she jumped into the river in order to retriever the sunken canoe which she had been sailing in. A terrified Latara hastily pulled the creature off her head. It was later seen again clinging to Latara's head when returned to land to regroup with the other Ewoks who were on the canoe, and she pulled it off again and tossed it aside.

name: Unidentified ogre-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified one-eye-stalk species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by a singular eyestalk perched atop their head, with two elongated, pointed ears, and a large mouth. Some time prior to 22 BBY, at least one member of this species was a member of the Jedi Order, their busts displayed within the Temple Archives.

name: Unidentified one-eyed bumpy species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified one-eyed tentacled species
summary: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their green and white skin, with starfish-shaped bodies, including tentacles, as well as a single large eye in the center of their body sporting a bright red iris. In 4 ABY, at least three members of this species were present in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.

name: Unidentified orange-haired humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified orange pointy-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified orange scaly species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their orange skin and scales, with pointed ears, solid black eyes, large lips, and sharp teeth. In 4 ABY, two members of this species came into conflict with some Ubuugans in Gorb Drig's cantina on the planet Phorliss.

name: Unidentified orange species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their orange skin, large noses, and low-set mouths. In 5 BBY, a member of this species was enjoying the beaches of the planet Niamos with another alien individual when Cassian Jeron Andor was wrongly arrested by the Galactic Empire.

name: Unidentified Orooturoo species
summary: A species was indigenous to Orooturoo. With small tentacles, four of which ended in a two-prong feature, extended from a large, purple-colored slug-like body, the species had a mating ritual which involved the female devouring the male, similar to some insects. Jabba the Hutt learned of the ritual when Princess Nampi captured him and ate his traitorous aide Scuppa.

name: Unidentified Orvax species
summary: A sentient species resided on their homeworld, the Outer Rim planet Orvax, by 382 BBY. Around that year, a Republic Pathfinder team led by the Jedi Knight Gella Nattai undertook an expedition to make contact with the species. However, following three days of failed attempts to establish communication, the equipment of Nattai's team began to disappear. Ultimately, the team left Orvax unsuccessful and reported back to the Jedi Council.

name: Unidentified ovoid-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Oyokal species
summary: The planet Oyokal was home to a quadrupedal native species.

name: Unidentified Oznek carnivore
summary: This unidentified carnivore species was native to the planet of Oznek. During a mission to the planet, one member of this species encountered a squad of clone troopers, and consumed one of them.

name: Unidentified pale-blue humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pale-blue near-human species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tox and their family were members of this species.

name: Unidentified pale high-hairline species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pale human-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pale mottled species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pale-skinned near-human species
summary: A pale-skinned near-Human species found within the galaxy on planets like Tatooine. Tork and Sosio Kakra were a members of this species.

name: Unidentified pale three-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pale wrinkled species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified panther-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Aleksin and Pavol were clones of a member of this species.

name: Unidentified partially-red humanoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Pashvi avian
summary: This avian species was native to the homeworld of the Pashvi. The avians were carnivorous, and ate Pashvi. They lived atop the thousands of stone pillars that dotted the world's surface.

name: Unidentified penguin-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pink-and-white species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pink creature
summary: A species of pink mammal lived in the forests of planet Öetrago. During the High Republic Era, the forest habitat of it and other creatures of Öetrago was ravaged by fires, and Jedi Master Sskeer and his Padawan, Keeve Trennis, were dispatched help save the local wildlife. The two Jedi held back the flames so that the creatures could escape.

name: Unidentified pink droopy-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their pink skin, with rounded heads featuring black eyes with drooping eyelids, pointed ears, and an open tube extending up from the tops of their heads. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren.

name: Unidentified pink-haired enlarged-cranium species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pink hairy species
summary: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their pink skin and hair. At least one member of this species was present on the planet Orvax IV in 19 BBY.

name: Unidentified pink pachydermoid species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pipe-bodied creature
summary: An unidentified alien used its pipe-like body parts to create unsettling music behind the curtain of Horville's Hut of Horrors on Endor. The Ewok Teebo asked where the music was coming from, and the creature then emerged from the cut with steam and music protruding from its pipe-like growths, and the Ewoks were startled by its appearance.

name: Unidentified pointy-cheeked species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pointy-chinned species
summary: This species was a sentient species found within the galaxy. They were distinguished by their dark eyes and pointed chins. One member of this species was present at Grappa the Hutt's palace in 11 ABY.

name: Unidentified pointy-eared partially-blue species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified pointy-headed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their red skin with large, pointed heads. In 5 BBY, one member of this species was present at the Coruscant Eastern Spaceport on the planet Coruscant.

name: Unidentified pointy-teeth species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified porpoise-like species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified predator
summary: These unidentified predators were a species of carnivorous felines that inhabited the jungle of the planet Zeenada.

name: Unidentified prominent-nasion species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified purple-and-white species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified purple beast
summary: A species of large, non-sentient, purple beast could be found on the planet Korba. The creatures' skin and hair were purple, and their round, large eyes and mouth were black. They possessed two ears and four legs that ended in three orange feet with black claws. Korba's native Korbans outfitted the beasts with saddles, containers, and harnesses to ride them. By 19 BBY, at least six beasts were present at a Korban settlement, where the Korban girl Aau groomed the purple beasts. One day, when two Korbans were riding two beasts, Aau brushed a beast and pried a shelled insect off the creature's side after it neighed.

name: Unidentified purple-faced species
summary: This species of bipedal sentients lived on a planet in the Outer Rim, near the border of Galactic Republic space. Their face was split down the middle, flaring out in two flaps over a mouth full of sharp white teeth. They wore goggles over their two eyes. Their homeworld was conquered by Mandalorian forces under control of Rohlan Dyre, a Mandalorian Crusader who was trying to escape the army so as to discover the true motivation of the Mandalorian expansion. He killed many of the species' blue uniformed military while making his escape. A member of this species was also sighted on the Sith homeworld of Korriban in 3993 BBY.

name: Unidentified purple mouthless species
summary: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their purple fur that extended up in points on the upper sides of their heads, as well as dark eyes. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren.

name: Unidentified purple near-human species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified purple-skinned humanoid species
summary: This humanoid race had purple skin. Their notable features included insectoid antennae protruding from their cranium on females but males did not have this feature. They were native to an unknown planet.

name: Unidentified purple snake-like Endorian creature
summary: A purple reptilian, snake-like creature was hiding inside a larger reptile, which was hanging from the ceiling in Logray's hut in Bright Tree Village on Endor. It angrily stuck its head out of the larger beast’s mouth and snarled at an intruding Dulok who peeked inside. It had large fangs, yellow eyes, and spikes on its head and upper neck.

name: Unidentified purple tentacled species
summary: An aquatic sentient species existed in the galaxy. They had purple or pink skin. Three notable members of this species were Moggee, Sylvestarr, and Ziggee.

name: Unidentified purple yellow-eyed species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Rismor and Kertas were members of this species.

name: Unidentified ray monster
summary: A species of unidentified ray-shaped predator was native to The Forest Moon of Endor. One was housed by King Elbo in his Coral Castle. The beast was kept in an isolated pool, above which hung a large wooden crate. Intruders would sometimes be trapped in the wooden crate, and the ray monster would harass the prisoners by jumping from its pool and snapping at the crate, trying to get at those inside. When the Ewoks Wicket Wystri Warrick, Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, Latara, and Teebo were trapped in the crate, Teebo accidentally increased the size of the monster due to a misplaced potion. The much larger monster was able to get at the crate more easily, and it threatened to devour both the crate and the Ewoks. However, Elbo stopped the monster from doing so at the last minute.

name: Unidentified red-and-black species
summary: A sentient species existed in the galaxy. These aliens were humanoids that were distinguished by their red skin, as well as black pointed stripes on their face and black hair. One member of this species was present at a bar on the moon of Shakari during or after 11 ABY.

name: Unidentified red-and-blue-faced species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified red-masked species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Red Nebula species
summary: A sentient species inhabited a planet in the Red Nebula in Wild Space, that was slowly drifting away from the galaxy due to a cosmic cataclysm. They were humanoid beings who resembled Humans with pink or pale skin and large, pointed ears. Members of the species were deeply religious, and followed a faith centered on a pair of gems known as the Great Life Jewels. According to the species' legends, the jewels came to their world during an cataclysm that created the Red Nebula and forced it to drift away from the galaxy, taking their homeworld with it. The gems, the legend claimed, shielded a valley on their planet from the destruction wrought by the nebula on other celestial bodies within it. However, rather than unifying the species' culture, the belief split them into rival factions. One side, represented by an order of crimson-robed priests, considered the Great Life Gems a boon to civilization and thus venerated the stones. Their rivals, however, believed that the gems had thwarted fate, and kept the species alive when it should have been destroyed. The nihilist group was eventually cast off the planet and forced to roam the galaxy as exiles. In 0 ABY, the outcast faction, under the leadership of Klysk, kidnapped scoundrels from the galactic fringe to mount a raid on the temple where the gems were kept. Klysk hoped to steal the jewels and destroy them, thus hastening what his faction believed to be the species' true destiny: extinction. One of their abductees was the Human smuggler Han Solo, who managed to pilfer the jewels from the temple and then con Klysk into taking a sackful of rocks into the system's sun instead of the jewels. Three years later, Domina Tagge led a mission to the world to steal the gems in a bid to spread a plague to the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. She razed the species' main city and removed the gems.

name: Unidentified red pachydermoid species
summary: A red pachydermoid species of sentients lived on a planet in the Outer Rim, near the border of Galactic Republic space. They had short trunks which ended in white tendrils, and had a large tusk on each side of this trunk. The species also had large ears and three-fingered hands. [[File:RPS_fighting_Mandos.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The species fights against Mandalorians.]] The species was represented in the Galactic Senate from at least the time of the Exar Kun War. Their homeworld was conquered by the Mandalorians during the Mandalorian Wars, before the Battle of Vanquo. Afterwards, at least two members of the species joined the Mandalorian forces, and were present on Taris.

name: Unidentified red-skinned near-human species
summary: A red-skinned humanoid species found within the galaxy on planets like Coruscant.

name: Unidentified red-skinned species
summary: Somewhere in the galaxy lived a species, known for their red skin. A number of them were painted on patina-darkened vases owned by Temmin Wexley in his junk shop on the planet Akiva. This race of people were often seen to have been dressed in dark robes.

name: Unidentified reptavian species
summary: This species of reptavians originated from a farming moon in orbit of the planet Kashyyyk. These creatures dropped seeds from their beaks over the farmlands of their moon. During a battle in the Clone Wars, Grand Master Yoda used one of those reptavians to reach the roof of a scythe harvester.

name: Unidentified reptoid species
summary: The species of sentient reptoids from the depths of the Unknown Regions had long-vanished before the formation of the Galactic Empire. Known members of the extinct reptilian race included the Kanzer Exiles, a fanatical flock led by the Lord Ravager Korman Lao. Lao’s group worshipped demons and claimed that they had been able to mentally enslave many minds at once.

name: Unidentified Rhand species
summary: An unidentified species had once inhabited the planet Rhand in the ancient past. After the original inhabitants of Rhand mysteriously disappeared, the structures that they had constructed fell into ruin. Millennia later the Knell of Muspilli, Kanzer Exiles, and Warriors of Shadow merged their belief systems in the Nihil Retreat with the greatest of their sorcerers taking up residence in the central ruins on Rhand. These sorcerers would come to be known as the Sorcerers of Rhand.

name: Unidentified ridged-head species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

name: Unidentified Ridlay species
summary: A sentient species resided on the planet Ridlay. A group of the species lived in a settlement consisting of stone structures, situated near the Ascension Well. Every fifty years, during Ridlay's total eclipses, beings emerged from the Ascension Well that the inhabitants believed to be spirits, and as such the eclipse was a time of celebration, where the lands of the living and the dead were combined. On an eclipse that took place during the Clone Wars, however, the beings attacked the Ridlay inhabitants, forcing them to flee from their homes and hide in a shelter.
