The garden's many denizens and forced tourists would observe, not without horror, how the tree's limbs would suddenly drop and attempt to strangle, more often successfully than not, unwary passersby—captive beings that Gardulla constrained to enter the garden for her own and others' perverse entertainment. Momaw Nadon planted a vesuvague tree in his garden in the Mos Eisley home on Tatooine. It acted as a watchdog for the site, and its reputation warded off stormtroopers and local police. The grove also concealed a secret chamber for hiding local Rebels.

name: Veubg
summary: Veubgri (Veubg for singular form) were an insectoid species native to the high-gravity world of Gbu in the Outer Rim. They were tall six-legged beings, with tendrils for arms. During 14 ABY, the Veubgri of Gbu were visited by a New Republic delegation including Chief of State Leia Organa Solo and her children as part of her tour of several remote New Republic member worlds. During the visit to Gbu, the New Republic delegation was forced to meet with their Veubgri counterparts on a satellite due to the high gravity of the planet. Grake, a slave of the Empire Reborn, was a Veubg.

name: Vexis
summary: The vexis was a serpent native to the desert world Pasaana. The species burrowed under the sand of Pasaana, and oils excreted from its skin hardened the sand it passed through to form an ever-expanding network of tunnels. The signet of the Mandalorian House Kast was a coiled vexis. At some point during the New Republic Era, Neo-Imperial warlord Commander Janu Coin had the head of a vexis mounted on a wall in his estate on Shakari. [[File:ReyApproachesVexis-TROS.png|thumb|300px|left|Rey approaches a wounded vexis on Pasaana to head it.]] At some point, the scavenger Rey learned from a trader on Jakku about the serpent, that dwelled on Pasaana's desert. According to the trader, the vexis was relatively peaceful unless provoked. In 35 ABY, after sinking into the underground tunnel system through the Shifting Mires, Rey, now a Jedi Padawan, and her Resistance companions Finn, Poe Dameron, C-3PO and BB-8 encountered a vexis during their search for the Bestoon Legacy. At first fearing there was no way out of the tunnels and that the creature was hostile, Rey realized it was injured and use the Force to calm it and heal its wounds. Once restored to health, the creature slithered away and, in the process, revealed a previously hidden opening to the surface.

name: Vhe'viin
summary: A vhe'viin was a species of small rodent native to the Outer Rim world of Mandalore. While the quick-moving vhe'viin was a burrowing creature most often seen covered in coats of tan fur, vhe'viine were known to change the color of their fur to white when living amidst a snow-covered region. The tiny rodents were a common sight on Mandalore, and developed a reputation for infiltrating fields of grain in large groups, feeding on an unlucky Mandalorian farmer's crop.

name: Vhork
summary: A Vhork was a type of giant hawk from the Daruvvia system. One of its known traits was to be very territorial.

name: Vicon
summary: The Vicon were a sentient species that grew to a height of only one meter. They had long noses, which twitched. Hran Beling was a male Vicon who was training at the Coruscant Jedi Temple as a youngling in 89 BBY. That year, the Dark Holocron was stolen from the Temple, and Beling conveyed this news to one of his contemporaries at the Temple, Dooku, speculating that there could have been an intruder in the building. Beling later competed with Dooku in a challenge against another team of Jedi trainees to secure a piece of muja fruit from a market, although the Vicon was stunned unconscious by the other team.

name: Vidara Jurness' species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Vidara Jurness was a member of this species.

name: Videllan
summary: The Videllans were a gold-skinned sentient species native to the Videll system. Kearn-sa'Davit was a Videllan who was a member of the Rebel Alliance.

name: Viidaav
summary: The Viidaav, or Viidaavs, were a species of sentient humanoids with green or orange skin and angular projections growing from their heads. They were thin beings with large, expressive eyes and three-fingered hands. The Viidaavs hailed from the eponymous planet Viidaav, where many of them worked as miners, shipbuilders, and soldiers. During the Clone Wars, the Viidaavs allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Clone troopers from the Galactic Republic attacked their homeworld, sparking a battle on the planet. The natives resisted the Republic troops, but were eventually driven back to defending a small mining array. The Viidaavs were preparing to retreat when Separatist leader Count Dooku ordered his battle droids to detonate mining charges set within the planet's crust. A lone Viidaav commander managed to defuse the explosives seconds before they exploded.

name: Villarandi
summary: Villarandi were a sentient insectoid species that had segmented bodies and multiple limbs. The species had excellent hearing. Kradon Minst was a male Villarandi who owned the Enlightenment tapbar in the Holy City of the Moon Jedha.

name: Vilosorian
summary: The Vilosorians were a sentient species native to the Mid Rim planet Vilosoria. Their bodies followed a seasonal cycle, metamorphosizing into powerful carnivores with the onset of the warm seasons. During the Galactic Civil War, the Vilosorians were able to repel the Imperial presence from their world with the intervention of Rebel agents who delayed Imperial reinforcements. Their homeworld was later within the territory of Imperial Admiral Treuten Teradoc's Greater Maldrood.

name: Vindalian
summary: Vindalians were a humanoid species. They appeared Human, but their facial features bore a vulpine resemblance. The females of the species were larger than the males, and size was considered a desirable quality in females.

name: Vindar
summary: The Vindar were a species of white insectoids with four arms and a tough [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carapace carapace]. They possessed large black beady eyes, and they were able to fire powerful purple energy blasts from their hand. Long after the death of Luke Skywalker, they oppressed a species they referred to derogatorily as the Squidge. The Vindar considered all things not of themselves to be inconsequential, and worked to destroy the culture and heritage of those they oppressed. They were also responsible for the "death" of C-3PO after they blasted his remaining parts to oblivion.

name: Vindinax
summary: A vindinax was a type of dangerous predator that originated on a world in the Unknown Regions, on which it was at the top of the food chain. The vindinax were humanoid and had long tails, and they also had dark green, chitinous carapaces that led some people to believe that the species was insectoid in nature. However, some of the creatures' other traits, such as their forward-facing eyes, their claws and their sharp teeth suggested that they were mammalian. A number of scientists studied the species and came to the conclusion that the vindinax's natural habitat was either a forest or a jungle, because the creatures appeared to favor hiding in high-up places, from which they would pounce on their prey. At some point during galactic history, a merchant obtained a captive vindinax and planned to sell the creature to a zoo on a planet in the Unknown Regions. However, en-route to his destination the merchant landed on Iol Station, a space station located in the Iol system. The creature was confiscated by the port's customs officers, because the merchant lacked the paperwork required to be able to transport the creature, and they fined the merchant for bringing a potential threat to the station. The customs officers placed the vindinax's shipping container in one of the station's cargo bays and they subsequently did not take good care of the creature. Desperate for food, the creature broke out of its container and ate the station's entire crew. However, the vindinax's victims were not sufficient to sustain it and when a group of spacers landed on Iol Station several days later, the creature attacked them in one of the station's storage rooms.

name: Vine cat
summary: Vine cats were felinoid reptomammals found in the outlying portions of Haruun Kal and the forests of Ziost. They came in half a dozen species, and their skin was used to make leather.

name: Vine snake
summary: Vine snakes were a species of snake native to the swamp planet Dagobah. They were capable of squeezing into relatively confined spaces, including the engine of an X-wing starfighter.

name: Vinefish
summary: Vinefish were a type of fish creature. Vinefish were grilled by vendors and sold as food near Yinta Lake on the planet Vulta during the time that the smuggler Zeerid Korr was on his way to meet his daughter, Arra Yooms, in the year 3653 BBY. One such vendor attempted to sell Korr some freshly grilled vinefish, but Korr did not buy any.

name: Vintian
summary: Vintians were a sentient species from Vint that had an appearance similar to that of a regular rock. Geode was the nickname of a Vintian who served as the navigator of the transport Vessel during the High Republic Era.

name: Viper wasp
summary: Viper wasps were indigenous to Yavin 4. These stinging insects lived inside of vines and would swarm if disturbed. The viper wasp's venom, in significant quantities, could cause cramps, diarrhea, yellowing of the eyes, numbness of the extremities, pustules on the mucus membranes, and hormone disruption. Smoke could be used to drive the insects away. Biggs Darklighter accidentally cut the vines of a viper wasp hive while searching the forest for a cure for Derek Klivian. A smoke grenade saved him from their attack without any serious injuries.

name: Vippit
summary: The Vippits were gastropods from Alee, an agricultural world in Hutt Space.

name: Vir vur
summary: Vir Vur were four-legged creatures often found roaming around Rori. They were known to be trained by creature handlers to do many tricks.

name: Viraanntesse
summary: Viraanntesses were ten-legged crustacean-like aliens from the Viraanntesse system. Jedi Master Jmmaar was a Viraanntesse.

name: Virevol
summary: Virevols were a non-sentient species of saber-toothed rat found only on Despayre, a prison world in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The virevol could grow to the size of wolves, and were considered formidable creatures by the prisoners on Despayre. A Brigian prisoner—known to be a former assassin—was rumored to have killed a virevol with only a stick, after which he was supposed to have cooked and eaten it. All the virevol on Despayre perished with the destruction of the planet by the first Death Star in 0 BBY.

name: Viridian
summary: The Viridians were a sentient species native to the Viridia system.

name: Viska
summary: The Viska (singular, Visk) were winged sentients, indigenous to Rordak.
distinctions: Able to see into the infrared spectrum

name: Vixian mauler
summary: The vixian mauler was a non-sentient species native to the shadow world of Umbara. Immense predators standing several meters tall, vixian maulers had two large arms and a pair of legs strong enough to carry their big bodies. They had two glowing tendrils on top of their heads. The Commander and Lana Beniko killed one vixian mauler during the events of the Crisis on Umbara.
distinctions: Large beasts with tendrils on their heads and glowing patches on their skin

name: Vixus
summary: A vixus was a stationary, non-sentient creature that originated from Umbara. The vixus had tentacles that looked like harmless vines that it would use to ensnare victims and draw them into its toothy mouth, which had a long grasping tongue shaped like a three-pronged claw. Several vixus creatures were encountered by the 501st Legion during the Battle of Umbara. One unfortunate clone trooper was devoured by a vixus, but the creature was killed when it attempted to do the same to CT-5555 "Fives," who dropped a thermal detonator into its open mouth, blowing it up from the inside. When chasing the rogue Jedi Master Pong Krell, the clones suffered heavy losses as they pursued him into the jungle. Clone trooper CT-5385 "Tup" made a plan to lure Krell towards a vixus, and the clones managed to lure Krell into the clutches of another vixus which attempted to eat him. It had its tongue and several tentacles severed by the Jedi, which later had it killed and who was immediately afterwards stunned by Tup, allowing the clones to capture him. They shared a common ancestor with the rathtar, blixus, and sarlacc, all possessing a large maw, tentacles, and a voracious appetite. Each found on different worlds, the different species had adapted differently to become a great hunter in its specific environment.

name: Vjun
summary: The Vjun were a mysterious species recorded in the library records of Darth Plagueis, possibly contemporaries of the Rakata.

name: Vlotti trout
summary: Vlotti trout were a type of freshwater fish found leaping over the currents of the many rivers on the homeworld of the alien fortune teller Tulakt. In 9 BBY, the Jedi Knight Cal Kestis asked Tulakt what she missed from her homeworld while they were in the Pyloon's Saloon cantina on the planet Koboh. The fortune teller then mentioned the many rivers and leaping vlotti trout among the things she missed while feeling homesick.

name: Vnal
summary: Vnals were sentient organic constructs created by the Vaathkree. Also known as "life-towns", vnals were domed cities used by off-world visitors to the planet Vaathkree. Vnals were partially organic, and were also marvels of metallurgy and engineering. As a result, vnals were partially alive and able to communicate with their inhabitants. While they were comfortable for brief periods, most visitors were unnerved by the prospect of sleeping inside a living, breathing, building.

name: Vobati
summary: The Vobati were a little-known sentient species that were native to Vobes. Valwid Ined was a member of this species.

name: Vodran
summary: The Vodrans were a sentient species native to Vodran, a planet located in the Hutt Space region of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. They possessed distinctive horns around their face and could have blue eyes and light brown skin. The Vodrans were turned into slaves or vassals after their world was conquered by the Hutt Cartel, a criminal organization controlled by the Hutts from the neighboring planet of Nal Hutta. At least one Vodran attended the auction of the Jedi Padawan Eldra Kaitis by the Xrexus Cartel prior to the Invasion of Naboo. At some point, Harra the Hutt built a palace on Vodran and consolidated her holdings there by banishing or enslaving the natives.

name: Voe Atell's species
summary: Voe Atell was a member of a near-human species distinguished by the double rows of four horns that ran along the sides of their heads, as well as their blue or green skin and purple or yellow eyes. Members of this species inhabited the planets Rattatak and Raxus Secundus and the moon Zardossa Stix.

name: Voegliss's species
summary: A sentient species were predatory beings with red-colored carapace-like skin and a tooth-filled maw. Two members of the species at one point attacked the team of the Galactic Empire scientist Devlor Samt on a world that the former were not native to, being eventually killed themselves. Samt subsequently raised the alien's infant son, Voegliss, as his own child, with the young being ultimately being pressed into service as an Imperial assassin-in-training.

name: Void drifter
summary: The void drifter was a species of giant fish native to the planet Dantooine. It was extremely hard to catch, and was considered almost legendary. Rumors spread in Dantooinian cantinas that a void drifter could materialize in any body of water it chose across all of Dantooine. It is unknown if these rumors were true, however void drifters were an extremely rare sight, regardless.

name: Void strider
summary: Void striders were a species that lived on the planet Abafar.

name: Vojak's species
summary: This species was a species of tall, muscular, purple-skinned humanoid sentients. Vojak and his brother were both members of this species.

name: Vole-kite
summary: Vole-kites were whiskered, furry-feathered animals that could be found on Chandrila. Three such creatures were searching for crumbs in the Eleutherian Plaza in Hanna City when Leia Organa and Mon Mothma walked together in the plaza.

name: Volice worm
summary: The volice worm, also known simply as the volice, was a type of unusual massive worm that at one point lived on the volcanically active, jungle-covered Unknown Regions world Lwhekk. It ingested rocks containing crystalline substances that could be used as focusing elements in the lightsaber weapons used by the Jedi tradition of Force-sensitives. Consequently, once every eleven years the volice worm excreted a unique crystallized and translucent substance known as sapith. At some point long before 3956 BBY and many millennia before the Battle of Yavin, the volice worm went extinct, with certain specimens eventually becoming fossilized. Over time, individuals would excavate such volice worm remains in order to obtain the increasingly rare sapith crystals, which were used by ancient Jedi Knights as lightsaber focusing crystals and were available in the galaxy by 3956 BBY.

name: Volkaran
summary: Volkarans were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Elan Rast was a member of this species.

name: Vollick
summary: Vollick were a sentient species. Osika Kirske was a Vollick warlord on Rattatak. The Jedi Master-turned-Sith Darth Krall was a Vollick.

name: Vollka
summary: Vollka were a species of hunting cats that were native to Mirran Six. They were nearly the size of small humans but not as large as targons, another feline species, and they had green and blue rosette markings. The spiraled horns on their heads produced electricity that could be unleashed in bolts of energy. By 331 BBY, they were nearly extinct due to scientists hunting them in hopes of testing and replicating their rumored ability to fade into invisibility while hunting. A counter claim held that the cats merely moved so fast that they seemed to disappear. The San Tekka clan discovered and adopted a female vollka named Remy over a century prior to the attack on Tiikae. During that event, Remy's owner was a San Tekka cousin named Jordanna Sparkburn who served as the deputy on Tiikae.
distinctions: Electricity produced by spiraled horns on head

name: Volpai
summary: Volpai were a four-armed sentient species found in the galaxy. Notable Volpai included Robbs Ely, Tiggs Leo, and Moregi.

name: Vonduun crab
summary: Vonduun crabs were carnivorous crabs native to the remote planet Zav Alox. The Aloxians, the planet's native sentient species, were born highly aggressive. As a result, Aloxian children were sent to hunt the crabs at a young age, and if they were not eaten, would wear the crabs' skulls in order to temper their aggression. When the Aloxians eventually grew out of the skulls, they would break from the force of the wearer's head. The Patrolian Farks acquired a vonduun crab skull during the High Republic Era and gave it to the pirate queen Maz Kanata, who kept the skull in her castle on Takodana until it fell into the possession of the young Force-sensitive Aloxian Qort after he wound up there.

name: Vonomi
summary: The Vonomi had four arms and four legs, each having a tentacle-like appearance. DJ Rangthang was a member of this species.

name: Voolukarian
summary: The Voolukarians were a sentient species found in the galaxy. They worshiped a fertility god named Kuk'waibi.

name: Voorpak
summary: Voorpaks were a non-sentient species that inhabited the galaxy. They came from Naboo and were often kept as pets. They were small enough to be lifted by a humanoid, had six legs, and excreted purple urine. Torra Doza, a human resident of the Colossus platform on the planet Castilon, owned a voorpak named Buggles. Qi'ra, a human woman associated with the crime syndicate Crimson Dawn, sometimes wore a shirt lined with voorpak fur.

name: Vor
summary: The Vors were a sentient species inhabiting the Mid Rim world Vortex. They were thin, brittle-boned reptilian mammals who flew on leathery wings. Although they were a flying species, they lived in underground hummocks. While Vors seemed inscrutable and nearly emotionless by Human standards, they were capable of creating music that was considered beautiful both by the Vors themselves and by members of other species. Throughout the galaxy, the Vors were renowned for the Cathedral of Winds, a colossal building on Vortex that created music by vibrating with the wind. Annually, the Vors played a concert in the Cathedral, flying through it to open and close windows and doors, using the Cathedral like an organ. The structure became one of the Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy but was generally considered a myth until the Vors joined the Old Republic. However, the Vors still had few extra-planetary interests. When the Galactic Empire replaced the Republic, the Vors felt repelled and refused to play their annual concert again. In 11 ABY, they began playing their music again and they invited dignitaries from the New Republic, which had since succeeded the Empire. However, remnants of the Empire sabotaged the event, and the Cathedral was destroyed, with the blame initially going to the New Republic. Once the real guilty party was identified, the Vors—who had already built a new Cathedral—joined the New Republic. They aided that government during the Yuuzhan Vong's invasion of the galaxy years later.
skinColor: Green, with white and grey spots

name: Vorantikus
summary: A vorantikus was a large bipedal non-sentient species native to the planet Voss. The Gormak experimented on vorantiki to create monstrous cybernetic war beasts, and the dark side entity Sel-Makor corrupted a vorantikus into the servant known as the Gormak Guardian.

name: Voraxx
summary: Voraxx were massive, hairy creatures found in the Hutt Space planet Klatooine's Derelkoos Desert. Tribes of the planet's native Klatooinians that lived in the desert used voraxx as both mounts and food animals. Without the massive creatures, the Derelkoos Desert would have been nearly uninhabitable. Voraxx also lived on Klatooine's Ferelakk Savannah where, like in the Derelkoos Desert, they were used for riding and food. Voraxx were similar to banthas, a non-sentient species from the planet Tatooine.

name: Voreclaw
summary: Voreclaw were a species of large insectoid bipeds living on Medriaas. Taller than an average Human and protected by large chitinous shells, they were able to sustain themselves on both plant and animal life. As a semi-sentient species, they lived underground, where they formed colonies linked by the hive mind. The species nearly went extinct - in fact the voreclaw living deep underground remained the only things alive on the planet - in 4999 BBY, when a Sith Lord named Vitiate performed the Ritual of Nathema that granted him immortality while stripping the Force from the entire planet, transforming Medriaas into a barren and lifeless world known as Nathema. However, the voreclaw hive mind was obliterated by the ritual, leaving their underground colonies nothing more than groups of mindless individuals. When the voreclaws, driven by hunger, finally emerged onto the surface, radiation from Nathema's sun ravaged the insects, burning their exposed flesh and their chitinous shells. In the utter absence of any other food, the creatures were forced into cannibalism, attacking and eating each other until only a handful remained. Vitiate eventually captured the few remaining survivors and stored them in carbonite beneath the Sanitarium, using them as guards for generations as he needed. Several voreclaw were encountered and killed by Lana Beniko and the Alliance Commander when they took shelter in the Emperor's Vault beneath the Sanitarium in 3630 BBY. After life returned to Nathema sometime after 3630 BBY, voreclaws were observed to be living wild on the planet along with new generations of juveniles.
distinctions: Large, bipedal insects with chitinous shells

name: Voridsec
summary: Voridsec were a sentient species with insectoid features. They possessed four arms and had yellow spines on their back. Chilla Zin was a Voridsec male member of the Assassin's Guild during the Imperial Era.

name: Voritor lizard
summary: A voritor lizard was an aggressive, venomous reptilian creature commonly found on Dantooine.

name: Vorlaggn
summary: Vorlaggn were a sentient species native to Vorlag, a cavernous planet. They had skin like the cracked char on a piece of fire-cooked meat whose fissures suppurated clear fluid, three hollow-set eyes, and spoke in the third person, which could confuse individuals of other species. Slussen Urla-fir Kal Kethin-wa Canker, a male Vorlaggn crime lord, owned a palace on Vorlag.
distinctions: Fissured skin that suppurated clear fluid, spoke in the third person, three hollow-sets eyes

name: Vorn tiger
summary: Vorn tigers were a non-sentient feline species native to the planet Alderaan. They were one of the numerous species of predators of Alderaan, distinguished by their distinctive horns and covered by a blue, sleek fur. Considered an extremely territorial and solitary hunter, a Vorn tiger usually avoided major settlements, but were absolutely merciless to anyone unlucky enough to wander into their hunting grounds. A particular behavior observed by zoologists was how tigers marked their territory, they did so by gouging bark from trees with their horns. They noted that those particular markings were both unique and consistent, this because each tiger scratched consistently their "own" pattern and in a unique way.

name: Vornskr
summary: The vornskr was a canine beast that could hunt using the Force. Vornskrs were native to the forest planet Myrkr and hunted the native ysalamiri. Over time, the ysalamiri developed abilities to suppress the Force as a defensive adaptation against vornskrs.

name: Voroos
summary: Voroos were a non-sentient, reptilian species of stationary predator that were found throughout the galaxy. Due to a lack of limbs, they could not chase prey, instead relying on camouflage and the use of their strong tongues to capture prey and pull it into their large mouths. Zoologists believed that the palak species of beetles were involved in voroos' reproduction, but the subject was poorly understood.

name: Vorshak
summary: Vorshaks, informally nicknamed "bark-eaters," were a type of furry, quadrupedal creature that lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They had powerful front teeth that allowed them to consume the trees of the forest. In 3 ABY, one vorshak was captured by a tribe of Duloks and set loose in the Ewoks' Bright Tree Village, which it began to devastate. The Ewok shaman Logray managed to tame the vorshak with a love potion and save the village.

name: Vorzydiak
summary: The Vorzydiaks were a Near-Human species indigenous to Vorzyd IV and Vorzyd V. They were tall and gaunt with yellowish-green skin, larger than usual eyes, and a pair of antennae.

name: Voss
summary: The Voss were a sentient, humanoid species native to the planet of the same name, in the Voss system of the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Their capital city was Voss-Ka, a fortified settlement atop a mountain. Their totalitarian society was defended by commandos and ruled by Force-wielding mystics, who served as seers and healers and whom the other members of the species considered infallible. The Voss population was small, vastly outnumbered by their homeworld's other native group, the Gormak—a species who saw the Voss as an aberration to be eliminated; however, both species eventually learned that the Voss were in fact offshoots of the Gormak. For centuries, the Voss fended off the assaults of the Gormak. Following the Treaty of Coruscant in 3653 BBY, which ended the Great Galactic War and started the Cold War, off-worlders discovered the planet by chance, the Voss becoming known to both the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. The Empire attempted to conquer the planet, but their plans were thwarted by the secret interference of the Star Cabal; in the aftermath, both the Republic and the Empire believed the Voss were responsible for the invasion's defeat, and established diplomatic embassies on the planet.

name: Voxbug
summary: A voxbug was a species of insect.

name: Voxyn
summary: Voxyn were a genetic cross between a fero xyn and a vornskr—both deadly predators—shaped into being by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species. Designed to hunt and kill the Force-sensitive Jedi of the galaxy, which the Yuuzhan Vong were invading, the reptilian hounds were all clones of the voxyn queen, the only successful cross between the vornskr and the fero xyn. As they were made to kill Jedi, the voxyn could sense Force-sensitives through the Force and had a variety of deadly abilities and tools at their disposal: sonic blasts, flesh–melting acid, disease–coated claws, and a poisonous barbed tail. After creation, voxyn were typically trained by the Yuuzhan Vong aboard the worldship Baanu Rass over the world of Myrkr to hunt Jedi in a multitude of environments as well as how to avoid various hazards. Measuring a meter high and over four meters in length, the carnivorous voxyn were fast and agile on their eight legs. In existence by 27 ABY, in the midst of the war between the Yuuzhan Vong and the New Republic, the voxyn quickly killed many Jedi on numerous worlds, becoming a great source of concern to the New Jedi Order. The Jedi focused on dealing with this threat by dispatching a strike team to Myrkr, where the voxyn queen had been located. In the Myrkr system, the team boarded the Baanu Rass, where, although taking heavy casualties, it managed to kill the voxyn queen and put a stop to the cloning of the voxyn, preventing any more of the beasts from being created. Because of the beasts' short life spans and their inability to reproduce, this spelled the end for the voxyn, and they began to die off. Despite the diminishing voxyn numbers, the Yuuzhan Vong continued to use them on critical missions, with the last voxyn perishing in the Treskov system in 28 ABY.
lifespan: About 3 months, if without a certain nutrient from Myrkr

name: Vrake
summary: The vrake was a species native to Makeb. The vrake came very near to extinction until an enterprising scientist named Kaylah Taprish took a liking to the creatures. After five years of study and crossbreeding, Taprish released a dozen colonies of the vrake into the wild. Due to increased numbers, the vrake became more aggressively territorial.

name: Vrakolian
summary: The Vrakolian were a species with thick skin from the planet Vrakolia. They used the spinblade for harmless games of skill. Other species adopted them as weapons.

name: Vrathean
summary: Vratheans were a type of huge, tentacled, deep-sea leviathan with a bioluminescent carapace that lived in the oceans of the planet Pabu, rarely surfacing from the depths. During or after 18 BBY, a vrathean attacked the Force-sensitive Asajj Ventress and the clone Omega while the pair were on a Pabu skiff testing Omega's m-count. The creature capsized the skiff and grabbed Omega, who was rescued when Ventress cut off the vrathean's tentacle with her lightsaber. Omega's allies then opened fire on the creature from their attack shuttle Marauder, but Ventress had them stop and then calmed the vrathean with the Force, causing it to leave.

name: Vratix
summary: The Vratix were a species of sentient insectoids from the planet Thyferra. They were the inventors of bacta, a gelatinous substance that encouraged the rapid healing of serious injuries. The production of bacta gave Vratix an almost mystical pleasure. It had such an intoxicating effect on them that they felt the need to produce the substance. After discovering the healing properties of bacta, the Human settlers of Thyferra began to exploit the Vratix addiction. They encouraged them to produce more and more bacta, which they then sold to the general public. The Vratix eventually became a slave labor force, while the settlers made huge amounts of money.

name: Vratixan blood eagle
summary: The Vratixan blood eagle was a species of bird native to the rainforests of the Inner Rim planet Thyferra. The birds had a wingspan of over four meters and were covered in waxy red feathers. Blood eagles had curved, red beaks and huge talons that were able to grab a fully grown member of the sentient Vratix species, which grew to an average height of 1.8 meters. The blood eagles flew over Thyferra's trees and alazhi fields searching for food. When they found prey, the eagles dove and snatched it up. If the target possessed armor, the eagles would use their beaks to beat it against rocks. Although the Vratix attempted to prevent the eagles from attacking them, deaths still occurred during the alazhi harvest. The mechanical legs of Grievous, the leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' droid army, were jointed in a way that allowed them to grab and crush objects similarly to the feet of the Vratixan blood eagle.

name: Vray
summary: The Vray were a gentle sentient species that was one of many forced to flee from the invading Yuuzhan Vong during the pangalactic Yuuzhan Vong War, started when they invaded the galaxy from another. In 27 ABY, Jedi ally and former New Republic leader, Leia Organa Solo, and her husband Han traveled to the Bilbringi Shipyards to request that its commander, General Muun, provide them with ships to form an escort to protect the evacuation convoy of the Vray. There were at least a hundred thousand Vray who had been being evacuated for weeks before the Solos arrived in the Bilbringi system. Muun refused at first, unwilling to leave the shipyards vulnerable to a Yuuzhan Vong attack. However, when Yuuzhang Vong Warmaster Tsavong Lah sent Nom Anor to Bilbringi to tell the Solos that he would have many refugees killed if the Jedi did not surrender to the Yuuzhan Vong, Muun saw protecting the Vray refugees as an opportunity to boost his career. He therefore led a convoy of ten vessels to escort the Vray to safety.

name: Vrblther
summary: Vrblthers, also spelled vrblthr, were dangerous predators found on Nar Shaddaa. Like the Hutts, they were originally from the planet Varl.

name: Vrelt
summary: The vrelt was a large, hairless rodent. The evasive creatures had two hind legs which they used to hop around. They ate crops, but sometimes gnawed at campers as they slept. Talus Ironworks's ASP-9 autopistol was designed for the express purpose of hunting vrelts and fired in bursts to make it easier to hit the creatures.

name: Vrobal
summary: Vrobals were a type of carnivorous pig species that were native to the moon Rori. They had a large snout, long ears, a tail and light-colored leathery hide.

name: Vroom
summary: Vrooms were creatures used as mounts by Pugs on the Forest Moon of Endor.

name: Vrot
summary: The Vrot were a small race. A Vrot mercenary who worked for Soergg the Hutt was a member of this species.

name: Vulagool
summary: Vulagools were a non-sentient species of diminutive, hunched bipeds commonly found on the planet Alderaan during the era of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The species was believed to have not been native to Alderaan, with some researchers theorizing that vulagools were once a sentient species that was driven to near extinction and enslaved by Alderaan's native Killiks during their era of expansion thousands of years prior. Other scientists believed that vulagools were the descendants of Killik Joiners who had been driven from their nests after mutating unexpectedly. Regardless of their origins, vulagools seemed to both hate and fear the Killiks, and actively avoided them. Although they were normally scavengers, packs of vulagools were known to be able to bring down larger animals.
distinctions: Instinctive fear and hatred for Killiks

name: Vulpor
summary: Vulpors were a non-sentient species with long, silky tails that inhabited the grasslands of Skuhl.

name: Vulptereen
summary: Vulptereens were a sentient species that had a shovel-like mouth with six tusks, a feeler on their snout, and two pointed ears. A Vulptereen podracer named Dud Bolt, who was native to Vulpter, participated in the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine in 32 BBY.

name: Vulptex
summary: Vulptices (singular: vulptex) were a non-sentient species of omnivorous and gregarious canids from the mineral world Crait. They were distinguished by their coats made up of white crystalline bristles.
habitat: Highland caves and canyons, salt flats

name: Vulptilla
summary: Vulptillas were fox-like non-sentient creatures that developed crystalline armor around their vital areas, as they reached maturity, and possessing great intelligence. They were apex predators of the frozen wastes. The Infernal variants were found underground in areas with molten activity, with their fiery eyes and glowing crystalline armor. Around 3628 BBY, they were very desirable to beast tamers across the galaxy and could be used as mounts.

name: Vultan
summary: Vultans were a Near-Human species native to the planet Vulta. They were physically similar to Humans except for their pale olive skin, and a mass of fleshy cartilage folds, ridges, and strands covering the top and back of their heads. These ridges were said to be able to protect the head of the Vultan against most forms of injury. Male Vultans tended to have folds and ridges on their heads, while females tended to have fleshy strands radiating out from the head. This visible difference was said to have an impact on the Vultans' mating and courtship rituals. As a people, the Vultans were enamored with the latest in trends and fashions, and were known for their skill with technology. Other features include: two toed feet, ridged structures on the upper torso, fin-like growths on the back, and, sometimes, white eyes, lacking pupils and irises. This may signify blindness, which is not an obstacle to a Jedi or Sith career. Oss Wilum was a famous Vultan who was also a Jedi during the Naddist Uprising. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the Vultan Echari Di'San became leader of the Cularin Trade Alliance, a trade organization that operated in the Cularin system.

name: Vuole
summary: Vuoles were small lizards, approximately the size of a Human hand, that could be found throughout the Rafa system, thriving in all kinds of terrain. They possessed two small protrusions below the mouth, and one beside each eye; the ones beside the eyes met above the head and merged into a crest approximately an inch high. Described as "curious," vuoles were one of the culinary staples of the Toka (whether they continued to be so after the Toka's reemergence as the Sharu is unknown). They were usually spit-roasted over an open fire, then peeled off the stick and eaten by hand. Lando Calrissian was nearly sick to his stomach upon seeing his Toka companion Mohs consume one this way.

name: Vurk
summary: The Vurk were a reptilian sentient species that was native to the planet Sembla. They had green, dark green, gray, or pink skin. It was thought that the Vurk were a primitive species, but they were highly empathetic and skilled mediators. They had a bony crest sitting atop their heads. The head crest was a key feature of the species and continued to grow throughout the life of the Vurk. Jedi Master Coleman Trebor was a member of this species. Another Vurk was Sweitt Concorkill, who was present at the Galaxies Opera House with Supreme Chancellor Palpatine on Coruscant during the last days of the Clone Wars.

name: Vuvrian
summary: Vuvrians were a sentient species of humanoids whose oblong, insectile head featured twelve eyes and two long antenna-like appendages. Hailing from Vurdon Ka, they never established any colony world. Thanks to their heightened senses, Vuvrians were exceptionally perceptive. They were renowned across the galaxy for their skills in diplomacy, sales, and negotiation, and many of them excelled as Jedi. In 1 BBY, a Vuvrian named Wioslea bought Luke Skywalker's x-34 landspeeder in Mos Eisley, Tatooine.

name: Vworkka
summary: Vworkka were a species of carnivorous raptor native to the desert planet Jakku that preyed upon skittermice. Vworkka would perch silently and patiently waiting for their prey. When the child Gallius Rax saw the corvette Imperialis landing on Jakku in around the year 30 BBY, it reminded him of a vworkka. In the year 5 ABY, the skittermouse that accidentally re-activated the battle droid Mister Bones hoped that it would not be eaten by a vworkka or ripper-raptor while doing so.

name: Vylla Tendeil's species
summary: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Vylla Tendeil was a member of this species.

name: Vynock
summary: The vynock was an atmosphere-breathing subspecies of the mynock. They were native to the planet Kalarba, but could also be found on Corellia, Talus and Bothawui.

name: Wadie-platt
summary: Wadie-platts were creatures native to Nim Drovis, a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They had luminscent green eyes that glowed in the dark. Wadie-platts occupied the swamps and marshes of Nim Drovis. In 13 ABY, when the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 arrived on the planet along with the starship captain Bortrek, their landing pad was surrounded by swamps filled with wadie-platts, gulpers, and marsh-gunnies.

name: Wagaa bird
summary: Wagaa birds were a rare species of bird found on Tenoo. They often migrated from one side of the planet to the other. Kai Brightstar, Nubs, and Lys Solay tried to log the birds in the Galactic Creature Guide in 232 BBY but were stopped because of a rainstorm that surfaced on the planet.

name: Wailer bird
summary: The wailer bird was one of several types of bird found on the Inner Rim planet Birren that the human Kata Akuna watched while living on the world with her family. Akuna later left Birren and lost both of her parents before joining the crew of the luxury yacht Stinger Mantis in 9 BBY. In that year, Greez Dritus, the owner of the Mantis, overheard Akuna listing all of the birds that she could remember from Birren, including the wailer bird. He asked her what she was doing and then for more information on the birds once she explained, as he had never been to Birren; however, she put the discussion off till later.

name: Walk worm
summary: Walk worms were a giant species of worms. They had brown exoskeletons with tan undersides, multiple sets of legs and large mandibles. At least eleven walk worms inhabited the burrows below a narrow cliff path to the fortress of the mass murderer Uda-Khalid on a jungle terrestrial body. Between approximately 58 BBY and 44 BBY, the Jedi Knight Mace Windu travelled across the narrow path on his mission to bring Uda-Khalid to justice. Two of Khalid's guards, a Gotal and a Human, observed Windu from the fortress as he approached the path; they discussed their assumption that the walk worms would deal with the intruder before he became the guards' responsibility. As the walk worms emerged to attack Windu, the Jedi used the Force to leap into the air and land safely on a further part of the path. As Windu continued walking, the segment of the path containing the walk worms burrows collapsed, sending the creatures tumbling down.

name: Walluga
summary: Wallugas were large creatures that lived on Kashyyyk and were generally found on the Rryatt Trail and in the Etyyy hunting grounds. Among the most deadly creatures on Kashyyyk, the Walluga used their powerful limbs to stomp and smash their enemies. These legs also allowed the walluga to travel at great speeds to avoid large groups of hostiles or any of the (few) more powerful creatures it may encounter in the wilds of Kashyyyk. Subspecies included walluga skullsmashers and stoneskin wallugas. Wallugas known by name included Wallugget, Bonecrusher and Stoneleg.

name: Waluna
summary: The Waluna were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. One Waluna, Doma Dendra, was a female Waluna who lived on the planet Koboh in 9 BBY.

name: Wampa
summary: Wampas, or wampa ice creatures, were a carnivorous, semi-sentient white-furred primitive species of mammal which dwelled on the snow-clad planet Hoth.

name: Wampa
summary: Wampas were a species of cave-dwelling, winged mammals similar to gigantic bats. They were native to the basalt planet Brazadann, and were ridden by the local Brazanites. When Daymon Thorn, the Emperor's "War Dog," attacked Brazadann City the citizens utilized Wampas to aid in defending their home. Due to how few airspeeders they had, the fighters rode about twenty Wampas into battle. The Brazanites mounted the Wampas loaded with explosives and proceded to bombard Thorn's aerial forces. During the battle, they lost about fifteen Wampas.

name: Wanderwing
summary: A type of high-soaring avian, the wanderwing was a native of the ocean moon Kef Bir. The members of Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters, hunted the birds using their custom made energy bows without power augmentation, with both wanderwings and cloudrippers being popular prey for the group. Members of the company harvested their kills efficiently, gathering not only meat but also other materials from the carcasses.

name: Wandrella
summary: Wandrella were giant worms native to the plains and swamps of the planet Mimban, also known as Circarpous V, located in the Circarpous system. Mimban was a sparsely populated, largely unexplored world, allowing the Wandrella to have free roam over much of the planet. Notorious for their simple intelligence and rudimentary thinking, the Wandrella were omnivores with only basic tactics in hunting, demonstrated by their charging headlong after prey, flattening anything in their path. Wandrella had phosphorescent, cream-colored bodies with brown streaks, thick hides, plated underbellies, and could reach lengths of fifteen meters or more. Their heads consisted of dull eyes set in a large group of haphazardly-spaced spots similar to those of a spider, and powerful jaws surrounding a mouthful of jet-black teeth set in large concentric circles. Wandrella were slow to react to outside forces, possibly due to their nervous systems being too evenly distributed throughout their large mass to provide a vital center. One such creature came upon Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, a Force-sensitive named Halla, and two Yuzzem during their search for the Kaiburr crystal, hidden in the Pomojema Temple, deep in the swamps of Mimban. The beast attacked and chewed their Swamp crawler to pieces, then perished when it tried to follow Luke and Leia down the Thrella well in which they hid, its tremendous weight causing part of the well to collapse, sending it falling into the seemingly bottomless pit below. A wandrella was also responsible for biting off the right side of Gargonn the Hutt's head on Circarpous V, but didn't prove to be lethal since Jedi Masters Mace Windu and Depa Billaba found him alive and well several years later on Nar Shaddaa.

name: Wantu
summary: The Wantu were a sentient species that hailed from the Outer Rim Territories. The members of this species believed in a river that could heal all wounds. In 5 ABY, the RA-7 protocol droid FR-D 8T-KA mentioned the Wantu during a conversation with the cyborg Beilert Valance. The protocol droid described them as one of the various Outer Rim cultures that had legends of organics being restored.
homeworld: Somewhere in the Outer Rim Territories

name: Waroot
summary: The Waroot were a sentient species native to the planet Ab'Bshingh. They warred with another indigenous species, the Farang, for centuries, developing unique tactics and customs. Those tactics were studied by Imperial strategist Crat Dakerno, who used them as the basis for the holo boardgame B'shingh.

name: Warthog
summary: The Warthogs were a sentient species. They were notable for their long snouts and tusks. One Warthog served as a pirate for Captain Gorian Shard onboard his corsair while another Warthog pirate was a member of Silvo's pirates.

name: Wasilsi
summary: The Wasilsi were a sentient humanoid species that lived on the planet Joralla. They constructed temples and villages, worked metal, and had a written language. Joralla was inhabited by another sentient species, the avian Tikiarri, with whom the Wasilsi warred for many years. While the Wasilsi were stronger and more intelligent than their opponents, the humanoids eventually became extinct. A sentientologist from the University of Huvveck theorized that the Wasilsi were not native to Joralla and became extinct after contracting a plague.

name: Wasp-worm
summary: Wasp-worms (also spelled as waspworms) were a type of worm that resided in hives on the planet Vrogas Vas, although they were not native to the planet. During a battle on the planet, Han Solo and Doctor Aphra became covered in wasp-worms after shooting a pair of hives. This led the two humans to panic and run into each other, leading both to lose consciousness. When Solo awoke, he was displeased to find that he was covered in "wasp juice," which had stained his clothing.

name: Watch-beast
summary: Watch-beasts were native to forests of Gamorr, the homeworld of the stout Gamorreans, and were domesticated to be guards. As cubs, Gamorreans took Watch-beasts from their mother to bond them with someone, which made them only follow that person's commands. Watch-beasts were extremely territorial, and would attack anyone or anything that was not the person they were bonded to, and would never leave the person or area they were assigned to guard. As they attacked, Watch-beasts would make a croaking bark which would intimidate, and could be heard for kilometers. With extremely keen vision and a good sense of smell, Watch-beasts were not taken off guard, and were dim creatures; Besides guarding an object or a place, Watch-beasts could not be taught other commands. Watch-beasts had gray fur, large, squat, and sturdy bodies with large heads, and long, porcine faces and snouts. They had short horns on their head as well as tusks. The predators also had thick, furry legs which culminated in four powerful paws with dull claws. A number of Watch-beasts were brought by the Imperial Army to the Imperial training world of Sirpar to guard garrisons there.
distinctions: 4 powerful paws ending in dull claws

name: Water bug
summary: [[File:WaterBugs.jpg|230px|thumb|Water bugs of Rori]] Water bugs were a swimming species that inhabited the subterranean waterways on the planet Mimban. These vermin also lived on Tatooine, Naboo, and Rori. They swam with an anxious, darting motion.

name: Water chicken
summary: Water chicken was a creature from the Aakaash system planet Water. It was used in various dishes of the star system, including Water chicken meat pie and Water egg fried rice, or could be eaten fried. It was an egg-laying organism.

name: Water cyc
summary: Water cycs were large jellyfish-like predators that floated in the rivers of Sulon, though a similar creature was also found on Dromund Kaas. Never giving pursuit, they lay in wait for their prey, snatching it with their tentacles.

name: Water glider
summary: Water gliders were red, ten-legged insectoids that skimmed quickly on the water's surface on Marca. They possessed sharp mandibles, but would flee from sudden movements.

name: Water wallock
summary: Water wallocks were large fish used as mounts by the an Unidentified amphibious sentient species on the forest moon of Endor. They had long snouts.

name: Watith
summary: The Watith were a sentient species hailing from an Unknown Regions star system. They used a type of hyperspace prediction technology, their own script, and employed a class of gunboats that could be piloted remotely. Around 18 BBY, serving the Grysk "Jixtus," the Watith Captain Fsir intercepted the Chiss heavy cruiser Springhawk and Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss to prevent them from joining the Hoxim incident. Unfortunately for the captain, the Chiss knew of his ploy, which he defeated where Fsir claimed the Vagaari pirate base was located. Shortly after, Generalirius Nakirre of the Kilji Illumine nation attempted to acquire several Watith prisoners—including Fsir—from Thrawn at the Unknown Regions planet Zyzek; however, the senior captain refused.

name: Wayuning
summary: Wayunings were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Topi Topi was a diminutive member of the species from Ardennia who by 34 ABY had a bounty placed on their head for stealing a Kowakian monkey-lizard from the Creature Stall in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. Topi Topi later attended the Festival of the Ancestors on the planet Pasaana in 35 ABY.

name: Web weaver
summary: A web weaver was an animal native to the rain forest on Kirtania.

name: Webweaver
summary: Webweavers were a large species of spiders indigenous to the planet Kashyyyk. They were capable of devouring humans. Wookiees hunted and ate the spiders. Infant webweavers were larger than a human hand and lived in nests with numerous individuals. During the liberation of Kashyyyk in 5 ABY, Han Solo, Chewbacca, and their allies released a swarm of webweaver spiders aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Dominion. The spiders proceeded to kill Rear Admiral Urian Orlan and several stormtroopers. This allowed Han and his team to force their way aboard the ship's bridge.

name: Weed-eel
summary: Weed-eels were a type of silver-colored eel found in the Braan River on the temperate Mid Rim planet Qiilura in the year 22 BBY.

name: Weequay
summary: Weequays were a sentient species from the planet Sriluur common throughout the galaxy. Weequay possessed tough, leathery skin resistant to desert environments and blaster fire. Many Weequay were mercenaries, pirates, and bodyguards for the Hutt Clan. Notable Weequays included Hondo Ohnaka, who led the Ohnaka Gang, and the Jedi Sora Bulq.
distinctions: Tough, leathery skin that provided resistance to blasterfire

name: Welatak
summary: A Welatak was a species of aquatic creature that lived on Dorumaa. The research student Solwyn Tamm once observed some of them near Trammel's island.

name: Wellagrin
summary: The wellagrins were a type of creatures native to the frigid planet Andraven. Snowball was a member of this species.

name: Weltfly
summary: Weltflies were creatures that stung their enemies. Although a weltfly's sting was not dangerous alone, a large number of them could be. In 19 BBY, during an attack on the Paataatus species' homeworld of Nettehi carried out by the Chiss Ascendancy, Mid Captain Ufsa'mak'ro, the Chiss heavy cruiser Springhawk first officer, compared the Paataatus fighters' attacks to that of angry weltflies.

name: Wermal
summary: Wermals were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They had one large eye, nose-slits, pink skin, and three hearts. They could live for well over a century. Kedpin Shoklop was a Wermal from Werma Lesser.

name: Wetakk
summary: The Wetakk were a sentient species of serpentine build with six arms. In 22 BBY, a Wetakk was present in Cuipernam, a city on the planet Ansion. It was part of a multi-species group hired by the Hutt crime lord, Soergg Vosadii Bezhin, to attack the Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and her Padawan Barriss Offee, and derail their attempt to keep Ansion as a member of the Galactic Republic. Attacking Offee with a hooked blade, the Wetakk had one of its arms severed. While the attacking group almost got the better of the two Jedi, the arrival of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker tipped the balance towards the Jedi woman, and the Wetakk's group eventually fled. Despite this attempt on their lives, the Jedi succeeded in negotiating with Ansion's representatives to stay part of the Republic.

name: Whaladon
summary: Whaladons were large sentient mammals that were native to the oceans of Dac. With a civilization totally separate to that of their neighbors, the Mon Calamari and the Quarren, the Whaladons communicated using sing-songs, and lived relatively peaceful lives. The poaching of Whaladons was forbidden by Mon Calamari law, but when the Galactic Empire occupied the planet, they did away with the old policies, and began hunting the mammals. Following the Battle of Endor, Captain Dunwell set up the Whaladon Processing Center, and due to hunting by him and his Aqualish crew, the Whaladons soon found themselves endangered as a species. The rare white hump-back breed of Whaladon was almost totally wiped out, save for Leviathor, leader of the Whaladons. He attempted to rally the aid of the New Republic, and thanks to their efforts, Dunwell was stopped, and his poaching operation disbanded. Over a century later, the Whaladons, along with the other inhabitants of Mon Calamari, fell prey to spores unleashed into the oceans by Sith scientist Vul Isen. Although many Whaladons died, some were successfully evacuated thanks to the efforts of the Galactic Alliance Remnant.

name: Whale-ship
summary: Organic, living whale-ships made up Doctor Cylo's research base, and therefore his fleet. The whale-ships had four long fins and thick tails that allowed them to maneuver through space. They also had massive teeth.

name: Wharzog
summary: Wharzogs were large creatures native to Kintan.

name: Whellay
summary: Whellays were non-sentient creatures native to the forests of the planet Okator VIII, located beyond the Inner Rim. Whellays were gentle animals that could easily be domesticated, and consequently were farmed for their meat and coats. Each whellay had a unique scented coat of hair and a unique way of whickering. An anonymous soldier of the Galactic Republic once made a record for the Caamasi historians of the Palace of Memnii, in which he remembered having caught and befriended more than six whellays during his childhood on Okator VIII, during the Tionese War. The young man's pet whellays were killed when a group of Tionese warships destroyed the settlements of Okator VIII and burned the forests.
distinctions: Gentle disposition, covered with a coat of hair

name: Whicci
summary: Whicci were carrion birds native to Vaced.

name: Whiforlan
summary: Whiforlans were an avian sentient species native to the planet Whiforla II, which was located along the Shipwrights' Trace trade route, that spoke Whiforla-song, among the most complex forms of communication in the galaxy. In 0 ABY, a Whiforlan rebel cell, along with several others along the Shipwrights' Trace, intercepted Imperial communications. As a result, the Alliance to Restore the Republic to sent Luke Skywalker to meet with the rebel leaders and retrieve data-tapes containing the logs, under the belief that they could give the Rebellion a picture of Imperial operations along the entire trade route.

name: Whilk
summary: Whilks were a species of non-sentient, long-legged critters. They were farmed for their milk and their hides, which made for fine leather. Their meat, however, had a ropy consistence. Their babies were referred to as whilk calves.

name: Whip-snake
summary: Whip-snakes were a type of snake known for being smart. While on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 4 ABY, the woman Shirene, the sister-in-law of New Republic pilot Norra Wexley, compared the intelligence of Norra's son Temmin Wexley to that of a whip-snake while the ladies spoke about the challenges of raising him.

name: Whiphid
summary: Whiphids, or simply a Whiph, were a sentient species of large, furry bipeds that had two large ivory tusks protruding from their lower jaws native to the frozen planet Toola. J'Quille and Valarian were both Whiphids.

name: Whippomorn
summary: Whippomorns were a sentient species the existed in the galaxy. A gangster named Sturg Ganna was a member of this species.

name: Whiskerback widow
summary: The whiskerback widow was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of hermit spider.

name: Whisper bird
summary: Whisper birds were a species of golden-colored bird native to the moon Yavin 4.

name: White bantha
summary: White banthas were a type of large pack animal native to the frozen Outer Rim world of Nelvaan. They had vast amounts of white fur and long black horns.

name: White-furred bantha
summary: The white-furred bantha was a large animal native to the planet Nelvaan. These creatures were used as riding mounts for the native Nelvaanian population and carried Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi to a Nelvaanian village.

name: White-horned serpent
summary: The white-horned serpent was a species of serpent. It was the symbol of the underground organization known as the Collective. Nifera Shu, a Corellian benefactor of the Collective, owned one such serpent as a pet.

name: Whiteworm
summary: The Pertorqus candus, more commonly known as the whiteworms or crystal worms of Mygeeto, were enormous creatures that inhabited the towering ice crystals of the Outer Rim world. Nesting in burrows dug out of the crystalline world's crust, the whiteworms' skin absorbed energy from the planet's core and converted it into food. Equipped with a circular maw of jagged teeth for chewing through the planet's crystalline mountains, whiteworms had been discovered as early as the Ruusan Reformations of the Galactic Republic and had been noted in the Archives of the Jedi Order.

name: Whuffa worm
summary: Whuffa worms were long worms that inhabited the planet Dathomir. They were intelligent and had hydrostatic skeletons.

name: Wickwar
summary: The Wickwar were a sentient species with face tentacles. Wazellman was a Wickwar from Wick 111.

name: Wide-winged rok
summary: The wide-winged rok was a type of bird with a wide wingspan found on the Inner Rim planet Birren. While living their with her family, the human Kata Akuna watched wide-winged roks and other birds. After she had left Birren and lost both her parents, Akuna tried to remember all of the birds she had encountered on Birren while on board the luxury yacht Stinger Mantis in 9 BBY. Greez Dritus, owner of the Mantis, overheard her list, which included the wide-winged rok, and asked what she was doing. Once Akuna explained, Dritus asked for more information on the birds as he had never been to Birren, but she put off the discussion till later.

name: W'iiri
summary: The W'iiri were a six-legged sentient species with horn plating and pincers. A number of W'iiri worked for J'uoch, the leader of a criminal mining operation, on the planet Dellalt. They were present when J'uoch's mining camp came under attack from reactivated war-robots that had been part of Xim's Guardian Corps; three W'iiri died while defending the camp against the attack.

name: Wild
summary: Wilds were ungulates native to Kuras III that grazed on the plains in herds. While males and females spawned, a third, separate gender, the carrier, was impregnated with the resulting young during gestation.

name: Wildernerf
summary: Wildernerfs were a species of herd beast that lived on the planet of Noquivzor. They were frequently hunted by taopari.

name: Wind Dancer
summary: The Wind Dancers were a sentient species native to the planet Galloa II, a planet in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Members of the species were noted for their innate grace; accordingly, in 9 ABY, the Human historian Voren Na'al compared the Human smuggler Mara Jade to a Wind Dancer in his personal journal. Their homeworld was integrated into the greater galaxy at some point between 3956 and 1000 BBY. During the Clone Wars of 22–19 BBY, it fell within territory controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Between 4 and 6 ABY, after the fall of the Galactic Empire, the planet was within the empire of the Imperial warlord Zsinj.

name: Winged floater
summary: A winged floater was a flying animal native to the rain forest on Kirtania.

name: Winged quenker
summary: The winged quenker was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of quenker.

name: Winged xendrite
summary: The winged xendrite was an insectivore native to Xend. It was exported to various planets throughout the galaxy in attempts to control insect infestations.

name: Wingflii
summary: The wingflii was a giant insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. It was similar to the flii.

name: Wingle
summary: Wingles were birds that were genetically engineered by food corporations to be silent and wingless. They were raised on Ruan.
distinctions: Genetically engineered to be silent and wingless

name: Wingmaw
summary: Wingmaws were a species of carnivorous flying creature that could be found on Ashla, the primary moon of the Deep Core planet Tython. They would feed by picking the flesh from the bones of already-deceased prey. During the High Republic Era, after the Jedi Master Elzar Mann emerged from the ocean off Ashla's Isle of Seclusion after experiencing a Force vision, wingmaws circled in the sky above him as he lay on the shore. Though the creatures were ready to scavenge, Mann was not dead; the Jedi picked himself up and headed for his Vector to depart the moon.

name: Wingstinger
summary: Wingstingers were a species of small insects found on Drongar. They were considered pesky by the Rimsoo personnel there, who used osmotic fields to keep them out of their operating theaters. Wingstingers possessed eight legs and were bi-winged.

name: Winroc
summary: Winrocs were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At least a few Winrocs were living on the planet Skuhl during the Imperial Era.

name: Wipplebog
summary: A wipplebog was a creature that snorted when it was sleepy. Around 233 BBY, when the starship engineer Zepher asked the pilot Nash Durango if she would help a trio of Jedi younglings go on a test flight, she rhetorically asked if a wipplebog snorted when sleepy. When the three Jedi gave her blank stares, Durango explicitly confirmed "yes."

name: Wirutid
summary: The Wirutid were a sentient species of ambulatory fungus. They were hyper-intelligent, and evolved into an outwardly human form that enabled them to secure shelter and trap prey. Shortly before the start of the Clone Wars, a member of the species was present in the Outlander Club on Coruscant when Zam Wesell entered the establishment to hide from the pursuing Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker. That patron appeared as a white-haired woman wearing a green dress.

name: Wisp spider
summary: A wisp spider was a type of spider that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. According to the Dalnan Honesty Weft, his father—Ambassador Weft—had captured a wisp spider and then set it free outside on at least one occasion. While he did, the ambassador stated that the spider was trying to do its job and that it wasn't its fault it had got lost. In 232 BBY, while on the Outer Rim moon Wevo after his father's death during a bombing by Nihil pirates, Honesty was approached by Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros—who had also lost his Jedi Master, Douglas Sunvale, in the bombing—who suggested the two find the Nihil who had killed his Master and Honesty's father. The Dalnan then mentally questioned if his father would want him to take revenge, recalling his father's capturing of a wisp spider and his words as he shooed it outside. Honesty eventually agreed to accompany the Padawan.

name: Wistie
summary: Wisties, also known as fire sprites or firefolk, were a small, radiant, sentient species native to the Forest Moon of Endor. Like the Ewoks, with whom they shared their homeworld, the fairy-like flying Wisties were fierce defenders of their forests, and the two species were allies. Ewoks sometimes used pouches full of Wisties as a weapon against intruders, such as Imperial stormtroopers. They threw the pouches in the direction of a target; on impact, the sprites emerged and attacked the invaders.

name: Wizard of the Night Spirit
summary: Wizards of the Night Spirit were followers of the Night Spirit who were formerly from the Forest Moon of Endor. They came into conflict with the Ewoks, who banished the wizards from Endor to another world. Eventually, an eclipse opened a rift in space through which one wizard, the Stranger, escaped. The wizard returned to Endor and stole the Sunstar from Bright Tree Village, using it to reopen the rift so that the rest of the wizards could speed through. After a decisive battle, the wizards were defeated and pushed back across the rift and back to their otherworld.

name: Wode
summary: The Wodes were an octopedal sentient species native to a planet with a gravitational pull twice that of the galactic standard. When traveling to worlds with lesser gravities, the Wodes took very heavy steps, unaccustomed to their lighter weight. During the Clone Wars, in which the Galactic Republic fought against the Confederacy of Independent Systems from 22 BBY to 19 BBY, the Wodes were liberated by the Republic's General Solomahal. At some point between 2 BBY and 1 BBY, a number of Wodes were present on the planet Bonadan at the same time that the smuggler Han Solo was there investigating an enslavement ring.

name: Wok-Wok
summary: The Wok-Wok was a monkey-like scavenger that was native to the planet Aris. They were friendly, and often roamed the platforms strung between the trees on which the population lived.

name: Wol Cabasshite
summary: Wol Cabasshites were a sentient species of sedentary, limbless beings that sported a long tongue from Wol Cabassh. Because of their appearance, they were frequently mistaken for pests. At the time of the Galactic Civil War, a Wol Cabasshite named Ghoel resided in the palace of Jabba Desilijic Tiure, glued to the walls and arches. The mollusk-like being possessed a prehensile tongue as long as his body, which he used to lick courtiers. He was present when C-3PO and R2-D2 arrived to deliver a message from Luke Skywalker.

name: Wollod
summary: The wollod was a species of mollusk that lived in the waterways of Naboo, a planet in the Mid Rim's Chommell sector that featured seas and swamps on its surface as well as an extensive system of water-filled tunnels beneath it. The creature's name eventually became a surname used among members of Naboo's native Gungan species, with Gungan Commander Wollod—who was in service by the time shortly before the Battle of Naboo of 32 BBY—being one such individual to share that name.

name: Wolvkil
summary: The Wolvkil was a feral creature that was utilized by the Vagaari in 22 ABY during their attempt to destroy the remains of Outbound Flight. Wolvkils in stasis could be worn over the shoulders of a Vagaari warrior and had a long-snouted head with clawed forepaws. The Vagaari used elaborate blue-and-gold collars around their necks which could be used to put them into stasis or bring them out. Two aspects made the Wolvkil very dangerous; one being the remarkable speed that it was capable of accomplishing, making it a quick killer. Secondly was their resilient and powerfully-enduring bodies which were capable of shrugging off blaster shots to the head itself, even withstanding direct hits with a Chiss charric. This was related to the creatures' decentralized organs which prevented them from being fatally injured by ordinary means, allowing them the chance to shred their prey easily. The only quick and efficient way of killing these creatures was to either destroy the entire body with an explosive or acidic compound or by cutting them in half with melee weapons as strong as a lightsaber. According to the First Steward Bearsh of the Geroon Remnant—who in reality was a General in the Vagaari Empire—wolvkils were a feral subspecies of a predator creature native to the planet Geroon.

name: Womp rat
summary: Womp rats were creatures native to Tatooine, and were considered pests by local moisture farmers who hunted them for sport.
length: Not much bigger than two meters

name: Wonat
summary: A wonat was a kind of creature that moved silently due to its furred toe-pads. Around 10 BBY, while sneaking in the Trader's Luck starship, the young Human male Han Solo moved as silently as a wonat.

name: Wonderhawk
summary: The wonderhawk was a type of bird. Pervian blood crows often swarmed on them.

name: Woodoo
summary: Woodoos were a species of nesting creature found on the planet Tatooine. The child of two miners living in a homestead near Mos Entha could hear the calls of nesting woodoos during the otherwise silent nights at the homestead.

name: Wookiee
summary: Wookiees, known in their own language of Shyriiwook as "the People of the Trees," were a species of tall, hairy humanoids that were native to the planet Kashyyyk. A notable member of this species was the warrior Chewbacca, Han Solo's best friend and co-pilot, who played a vital role in the Clone Wars during the Battle of Kashyyyk, the Galactic Civil War by aiding the Rebel Alliance in their fight against the Galactic Empire, and the war against the First Order. They were quite strong, and were known to rip people's arms out of their sockets when provoked. Though being from a temperate planet known for its swamps and forests, Wookiees were perfectly comfortable on icy worlds like Ilum and Hoth, not requiring any additional protective clothing, i.e. gloves or boots.

name: Woolamander
summary: Woolamanders were a species of creature native to the moon Yavin 4. They lived in the canopy level of the gigantic Massassi trees native to the world where they cradled their young, and late at night produced echoing mating calls. Woolamanders had rotund bellies, a pair of arms that were much longer than their legs, and a thin tail capped with a bushy tuft of rainbow-colored hair. Their bodies were mostly covered in blue fur with occasional patches of red and yellow. Kes Dameron was capable of tracking woolamanders by scent.

name: Woolly pig
summary: Woolly pigs were a type a pig species that were native to the planet Togoria.

name: Woolly veermok
summary: Native to the planet of Naboo, woolly veermoks were dangerous predators that lived on the frozen swamps of Naboo's northern hemisphere. Once the natural enemies of Gungans during Naboo's ice age, the woolly cousins of the four-legged veermoks were known for their untameable nature, prompting the Naboo government to make attempted capture of the creatures an illegal activity.

name: Woostoid
summary: The Woostoids were sapient humanoids indigenous to Woostri.
distinctions: Tall, wiry frames, long life spans, large eyes, intelligence

name: Woostroid
summary: Woostroids were a black-eyed sentient species. The assistant for the Troig Reezingrom Abbayav, Morna, was a Woostroid.

name: Worrite
summary: Worrites were a sentient species of crustacean–insectoid hybrids from an unknown part of the galaxy. As tall as Wookiees, their anatomy was dominated by a knobby, protective carapace. Members of the species had four arms, two of which served as small manipulators, and two ending in huge claws. A Worrite's face consisted of a mass of sensory feelers and four eyes on long stalks that were able to swivel in all directions. The Worrite Mazumoda, nicknamed "the big bug," left his homeworld and served as a thug-for-hire in the underworld of Coruscant during the Imperial Era. His frightening appearance and giant pincers served as assets in his line of work.

name: Worrmp
summary: Worrmps were small creatures known to inhabit the sewer systems of the Meatlump Hideout beneath the streets of the city Coronet on Corellia. Although they closely resembled worrts in appearance, Chef Schlump referred to the worrmps as rodents. The Meatlump Gang was known to stomp on the worrmps and meetles infesting their hideout, and use their juices to create Meatlump wine, a preferred drink of the Meatlump King.

name: Worrt
summary: Worrts were a non-sentient species that hailed from the desert of the planet Tatooine. These squat, large-mouthed creatures caught prey by sitting stationary in the sand and using their purple prehensile tongues to wrap around passing rodents, insects or birds.
distinctions: Toothy mouth, purple prehensile tongue dexterous forelimbs, heat-sensitive palps, two cranial antennae

name: Worrt rooster
summary: The worrt rooster was a type of dinosaur-like bird that possessed reptilian features and crowed at sunrise on its home planet of Tatooine. In spite of being gentle, the bird exhibited a fearsome appearance and would become a menace if provoked as well as screeching if it felt at risk. In 9 ABY, one such bird was present on Tatooine, where it crowed on top of a building once it spotted one of Tatooine's two suns.

name: Wraid
summary: Wraids were large reptilian creatures found on many desert planets around the galaxy, including Tatooine, Ruhnuk, and Korriban.

name: Wrean
summary: Wreans were a sentient species native to the planet of Wrea. They were aquatic lifeforms who dwelled deep in the oceans of their homeworld.

name: Wreck-weaver
summary: Wreck-weavers were a species of arachnid creature. Their diet consisted of metal, and they were averse to bright light. Wreck-weavers could be found on the planet Nelgenam, where they infested the Lost Library of Nelgenam.

name: Wriggler
summary: Wrigglers were an amphibious species native to Drongar. The average size was about five meters long and half a meter thick, making them the largest of all known land-based lifeforms on that world. The creatures' cilia could deliver an electrostatic charge that was powerful enough to knock a grown Human off his feet. Like other Drongar lifeforms, they were invertebrates. They were eaten by the Republic forces stationed on Drongar during the Clone Wars, and, seared in redfruit juice and sprinkled with fried fire gnats, made a tasty meal, somewhat reminiscent of fleek eel.

name: Wrist-hawk
summary: A Wrist-hawk was a type of bird. Lieutenant Commander Villian Dance once compared Darth Vader as Emperor Palpatine's wrist-hawk.

name: Wrix
summary: The wrix was a mountain-dwelling large carnivorous creature. It was mentioned in a popular, yet unsettling, Corellian fable about two reckless boys who disobeyed their parents. Wrixes were also ideally suited for pit-fight competitions.

name: Wroonian
summary: Wroonians were near-human species that originated from the Wroona system. Around six millennia before the Battle of Yavin, Wroonians colonized Saleucami. Wroonians were similar in appearance to Pantorans, both having blue skin. This made the two species easy to confuse with one another.

name: Wroshyr louse
summary: Wroshyr lice were insects found in the wroshyr trees of Kashyyyk. The native Wookiees processed them in distilleries to make wroshyr lice syrup.

name: Wrosidian
summary: Wrosidians were a semi-plant-based sentient species that originated from the Outer Rim's Wrosdi system. The humanoids had a set of five organs for atmospheric filtering at the back of their head. Members of the species began their life as a bud on a stalk, which resulted in Wrosidian culture not having the same familial and gender identities found in other cultures, but Wrosidians who budded from the same stalk were considered roughly analogous to relatives. In 132 BBY, the Wrosidians Bihun and Basko were present in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on the planet Ueda when the human assassin Mae Aniseya attempted to kill the human Jedi Master Indara in the establishment.

name: Wulkarsk
