summary: Wulkarsks were six-limbed, four-eyed pack predators from the jungles of Joralla. They were easily capable of eating humanoid-sized prey. Wulkarsks were trained to hunt for the Tikiarri. They were part of a family of animals known as wulkensos. Wild wulkarsk were always found alone, prowling the jungles of the planet.

name: Wuorl
summary: The Wuorl were a frog-like species that lived in the branches of the Greenstalk trees on the planet Mrlsst in the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector. The Wuorl were considered a delicacy and were harvested for their flesh. Jabba Desilijic Tiure usually ate them for breakfast.

name: Wyrwulf
summary: Wyrwulves were six-legged canine animals that, while often mistaken by outsiders for pets or working animals, were in fact the children of the Codru-Ji race.

name: Wystoh
summary: Wystoh were seven-meter predatory creatures native to Chad. They were frantically territorial and tended to hunt in the deep oceans of that world.

name: Wyvarl
summary: Wyvarls were a reptile indigenous to a planet in the Maw where the dark side entity Abeloth was kept imprisoned for millennia, until 44 ABY. Wyvarls were large, bipedal lizards with broad green backs, thick tails, and a single blue eye. The lizard had a nictitating membrane that drew down over its eye when it went to sleep. Wyvarls lived in herds, and when in danger, a wyvarl drummed its tail against the ground in order to warn fellow herd-mates to stay away. In 44 ABY, Luke Skywalker found a female wyvarl that had been trapped in a drop-bramble, a plant with poisonous barbs. Skywalker used the Force to make the wvarl go to sleep and then shot it with a blaster to put her out of her misery.

name: Wyyyschokk
summary: Wyyyschokk were a species of gigantic spider that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. Both highly intelligent and extremely hostile, they could ensnare prey by casting webbing at them from a distance, and would often wait to ambush their prey by attacking them from above or below. A notable subspecies was the Albino Wyyyschokk. Their eggs were used for a cake named Kashyyyk seven layer cake.

name: Xa Fel
summary: The Xa Fel were a Near-Human race that inhabited Xa Fel in the Kanchen sector of the Core Worlds.

name: Xamster
summary: The Xamsters were a sentient species. The species had exceptional brains capable of thinking quickly and processing sensory data at high speed. The podracer Neva Kee was a Xamster.

name: Xan
summary: The Xan were a small-bodied sentient species. Some of them had established a colony on the planet Gan Moradir, in the galaxy's Mid Rim. Geeska Dotalo was a male member of this species.

name: Xandank
summary: Xandanks were predatory creatures that lived in the dolovite mines on the volcanic world of Mustafar. For years, Xandanks were kept out of the mines by Kongo the Disemboweler before he was taken to fight in Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa.

name: Xando's species
summary: A sentient species had horns, toothed mandibles, and glossy dark eyes. In 0 BBY, six members of the species who were part of the Norclu Order were seeking to undergo a pilgrimage from the planet Tatooine to the world of Norclune. They attempted to arrange transportation with the smuggler Han Solo; however, he refused the aliens' request.

name: Xandu
summary: Xandu were an aerial mammavian species native to the planet Iego. They were one of many predators native to the world. They could hunt and carry prey as large as a human. The six-eyed species fiercely defended their territory and patrolled the rocky spires that dotted their homeworld. The species were known to snatch their prey and smash them against rock walls using their two arms and legs. They flew using their four wings. They had large ears that could detect prey from great distances. Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi encountered one while attempting to find reeksa root on Iego.

name: Xaxax
summary: The Xaxax were an extinct sentient species, native to the Unknown Regions. They were a technologically advanced species and created many strange and powerful devices. Some of their technology was left scattered across the Unknown Regions after they were gone, and the legend of their technical prowess was known to traders in the region as well. They were said to have created an entire world, which was the source of these bits of technology, though almost no one in the Unknown Regions used them. They created cures for deadly diseases, as well as small devices that allowed users to communicate over vast distances. They also built a hidden space station, which was similar to the design of some hyperdrives. After their extinction, an organization called the Guardians was brought together to protect the advanced technology that they left behind. Though they were once a proud and honorable organization, over thousands of years they grew corrupt and greedy, jealously guarding the secrets of the Xaxax. They looted the artificial world the Xaxax had created, stealing all they could. The Guardians also split up the power core of the Xaxax's space station, using one of the pieces to power their largest ship. They used the space station as a center of study, as well as a vault to keep their stolen artifacts.

name: Xendekian
summary: The Xendekians were a sentient species native to the planet Xendek. The Xendekians believed the argora, a bird species, brought rain and crops and was responsible for all good fortune on Xendek.

name: Xexto
summary: {{Update|Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2016), Epilogue, Age of Rebellion - Han Solo 1, , Hunters: Battle for the Arena, War of the Bounty Hunters 1, }} Xexto were a sentient species of slight, spindly, six-limbed aliens who were native to the planet Troiken. Xexto were highly dexterous, enabling them to participate in the highly dangerous sport of podracing. Slingshots were extremely popular with Xexto, since their multiple sets of limbs made the weapons convenient to use. Gasgano, a famed Podracer pilot, was a Xexto, as was the pickpocket and pawn shop owner Ferpil Wallaway. A Xexto known as Sister Six worked as an assassin during the Galactic Civil War, while Captain Perrili of the bulk freighter Romary was a smuggler and Resistance contact.

name: Xi Charrian
summary: The Xi Charrians, also known simply as the Charrians, were the sentient insectoid. They were behind the Haor Chall Engineering Corporation company, which notably designed the Sheathipede-class transport shuttle, the Sheathipede-class Type B shuttle, and the Vulture-class starfighters, which they designed in their own image and built in their cathedral factories on the planet Charros IV. The vulture droid was created on behalf of the Trade Federation, but after the Clone Wars began, these designs were licensed to Baktoid Armor Workshop. Xi Charrians notably believed in short quick answers to their problems, and this carried over into their starfighter designs. They had four legs.

name: Xi'Dec
summary: The Xi'Dec were an insectoid sentient species from Stic. Ubbla Mollbro, a female opera singer with engorged egg sacs, was a member of this species.

name: Xidelphiad
summary: The Xidelphiads were a sentient species in the galaxy. Individuals within the species would change sex at several points in their life, and would do so by encasing themselves in a chrysalis. One famous Xidelphiad was the fine artist Sannab Ro, who notably created a propaganda poster for the Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic.

name: Ximpi
summary: The Ximpi were a sentient species of small, winged humanoids with gray skin, broad heads and pointed ears from the planet Shuraden on the Galactic Frontier. A number of Ximpi were in the employ of the crime lord Papa Toren. Those individuals would translate Toren's otherwise unintelligible mumbles to his discussion partners and, if necessary, protect him from harm.

name: Xorfin
summary: Xorfin were a type of giant fish found on the planet Tordus. They were dangerous and aggressive if approached.

name: Xot
summary: The Xot were a sentient species characterized by their small size and head shaped like a pair of macrobinoculars. Known Xot included Bidvel and Davil, who operated a scrap pile.

name: X'Ting
summary: The X'Ting were an insectoid species, native to the planet Ord Cestus. The X'Ting were also called Cestians, although the term also came to embody anyone of any species native to the world. They were governed by the Hive Council. The X'Ting were all part of a single colony, but had many hives around the world.

name: Xunji
summary: The xunji were large creatures. If individuals of different species were scratched by a xunji, they would turn into a xunji too. The Mythrol Gren turned into a xunji during the High Republic Era.

name: Xyrass
summary: The Xyrass were a small, skeleton-like humanoid species from Tabor V.
distinctions: skeletal, thick skin, extremeley sharp teeth

name: Ya-ya fly
summary: Ya-ya flies, also known as yaya flies, were a type of fly native to the jungle world Akiva. They were purple with a pair of wings, four appendages and a long needle like protrusion sticking out from their head. While not posing a threat to organic beings, their large numbers gave them a reputation for being one of the planet's worst annoyances. However, some residents caught the flies for food, even selling them in the form of crispy Yaya skewers. After the rain seasons, the flies came in waves, leading some Akivan parents to add netting above the cribs of their children to keep the flies out. After the Galactic Empire constructed a dam in Myrra, the capital city of Akiva, the habitat of the flies were disrupted, leading to some taking refuges in people houses. They shared their name with the Ya-Ya Melodies, a band active on Akiva. Ya-ya flies were not found on the planet Chandrila.

name: Yaga drone
summary: The Yaga drone was a subspecies of the Yaga, created through genetic engineering following the rise of the Galactic Empire.

name: Yaga
summary: The Yagai (singular, Yaga) were sentient insectoids indigenous to Yaga Minor. They were one of the many species enslaved and exploited by the Galactic Empire.

name: Yaggie
summary: A yaggie was a small, green, winged creature hunted for both its hide and meat on Greater Marianas. They were considered to have little intelligence.

name: Yahk-Tosh
summary: The Yahk-Tosh were a slug-like sentient species from the planet Xolu in Hutt Space and were believed to be distantly related to the Hutts. Their bodies were slug like in appearance, with four thick arms, which they used for moving around, and their scaled skin had a dirty green color. Four thin antennae sprouted from the tops of their heads and their pointed snouts were filled with rows of blocky teeth. Like the Hutts, the Yahk-Tosh were also immune to Force mind tricks. As well as their homeworld the species controlled the planet Far Pando also in Hutt Space, but pledged their loyalty to the Hutt Grand Council. One Yahk-Tosh Lord named Gar-Oth subjugated Princess Lourdes' homeworld, until he was killed by the Princess with the help of Jedi Knight Yoshi Raph-Elan.

name: Yaka
summary: The Yaka were a race of Near-Human cyborgs hailing from the Yaka system. Centuries before the rise of the Galactic Empire, the neighboring Arkanians, known for their genetic experiments, implanted the naturally dim-witted species with cybernetic implants. Some Arkanians saw this effort as beneficial to the Yaka, while other socially-conscious Arkanians questioned the ethical implications of such an act.

name: Yalaran
summary: The Yalarans were a sentient, yet primitive, species native to the Wild Space planet Yalara. Unprepared for integration into the galaxy, their homeworld was hidden by a cloaking device created by the Jedi Master Broden Kel Verdox.

name: Yalbec
summary: Yalbec were an insectoid species found on Yalbec Prime. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, several Yalbec were involved in an Insurrection on Yalbec Prime, during which they came into conflict with the Republic's elite Clone Force 99.

name: Yalor
summary: The Yalor were the native sentient species of the planet Yaloris. They had troopers.

name: Yam'rii
summary: {{Update|}} The Yam'rii, also known as the Huk, were an insectoid sentient species from the Wild Space planet Huk. Members of the species were characterized by a triangular-shaped head poised on a long neck, large forward-facing eyes, and prominent upper limbs that were bent and held together at an angle. They were greedy and destructive insects that resembled praying mantises with superior technology.
subspecies: Sylar Saris' species {{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/bad-territory-episode-guide|text="Bad Territory" Episode Guide &
distinctions: Tall, large eyes, bent upper limbs

name: Yapi
summary: The Yapi were sapient canoids indigenous to Kathol which were created by the DarkStryder which considered them a successful warrior guardian servant race. The furry Yapi eventually developed their own society and culture; one which was very divided with factions forming and collapsing. Some of these tribes showed loyalty to their creator while others showed outright hatred which resulted in inter-tribal warfare among the species. Despite these constant wars, there were the occasional peaceful periods which allowed the exchange of information and trade. The Yapi were a superstitious race and believed that the use of the Ta-Ree life energy could only be done by a tribe's shaman. When the crew of the FarStar arrived in the Kathol sector to defeat the Moff Kentor Sarne, who had allied with the Darkstryder, the Yapi lent their assistance. They allied with the Charr Ontee and Zizimaak, though they had certain trouble working with the latter as they considered them a source of food.

name: Yara
summary: The Yaras were a species who lived on the planet Makeb.

name: Yarin
summary: The Yarin were a sentient species whose appearance resembled that of trees; their limbs were reminiscent of branches, while their skin had a wooden texture. The species was mobile but slow moving. In 24 ABY, a Yarin served as Harbormaster on the Dac resort known as Crystal Reef. He loaned his personal submersible to the Jedi Knight Cilghal and her companions from the Yavin 4 Jedi Praxeum.

name: Yark
summary: A yark was a creature with fur.

name: Yarkora
summary: Yarkora, also known as Yarkorans and Yak Faces, were a sentient species found in the galaxy. Saelt-Marae and Jedi Master Adampo were Yarkorans. Due to most Yarkora eating constantly throughout the day, they had two stomachs, four kidneys, and three livers.

name: Yarzion Vell's species
summary: The Jedi Yarzion Vell was a member of a sentient species which could have red or green skin, red eyes, black hair, and pointed ears. When Vell returned to his home planet, he had a skin-scribe of the same species tattoo him with runes from his ancestor's language that spelled the name of his greatest teacher—his Jedi Master, Lulad—in accordance with the planet's tradition.

name: Yashuvhi
summary: The Yashuvhi were descendants of Humans who had attempted to settle the planet Yashuvhu in the millennia past. According to Chiss records, the Human population arrived a little more than three thousand years prior to its rediscovery by Luke Skywalker, though they may have arrived even earlier in history. The Human population lost contact with the rest of the galaxy and began to form their own culture and society, becoming self-sufficient. One such change was linguistically, in which the Yashuvhi language evolved. Upon their arrival, the crew of the Galactic Republic exploration vessel Pathfinder III discovered that the Yashuvhi language was a heavily evolved derivative of Galactic Basic Standard. During their first contact mission, the crew also discovered that the Yashuvhi were of sizable population but scattered across the planet. The Yashuvhi had a Force-based tradition which stemmed from the arrival of a Jedi millennia prior to their rediscovery. This Jedi, was believed to have been Human crashed onto the planet and became stranded. He settled within the Yashuvhi society and started a family. The Jedi wrote a "sacred scroll" with a few lines of the Jedi Code, which would be passed on to his descendants. The Jedi's family started a bloodline of Force Adepts who were talented, but untrained. One such descendant was Valara Saar, who would eventually become one of the planet's key spiritual leaders and protectors. Yashuvhu was rediscovered by the Republic in the years prior to the Clone Wars. The Pathfinder III landed on the planet on a first contact exploration mission. The Yashuvhi population flocked towards the crew, desiring to know if they were Jedi who had come to live among them. The first-contact specialists tried to teach the natives about the Jedi and learn about the people as well. Valara Saar convinced the crew of Pathfinder III to take her offworld with the hope of becoming a Jedi. Even though she learned some basic skills, she was not able to join the Order. She wandered the galaxy briefly, but ultimately resettled in the Yashaka Mountains. There, in a small isolated hut, she became a teacher of the Force to those on Yashuvhu and was known as the "Prophetess." She was also responsible for protecting her planet from a threatening Chiss Ascendancy who had also discovered the world. Initially, Saar did not meet with the leaders of the Chiss advance landing party. When the Chiss tried to approach her residence in the mountains uninvited, they were forced away by her formidable techniques. The Chiss contact team fled in a hasty retreat. During the confrontation with the Chiss, she wielded what appeared to be a lightsaber. The entire event was documented by the Chiss after their retreat. By the broader galactic community, the planet was largely forgotten by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. Yashuvhu was later rediscovered by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and a team of Jedi who were searching for Zonama Sekot in 28 ABY. During their search, the team of Jedi did research at the Chiss Expeditionary Library on Csilla. In the process of their research, the teachings of Valara Saar were discovered. Also included in the Cheunh text was how the Chiss had been expelled from the planet by the "Prophetess" known as Valara Saar.

name: Yathik acid slug
summary: Yathik acid slugs were a type of slug originating from the Yathik system in the Expansion Region. In 0 ABY, the human rebel Nakari Kelen, when imitating her father, Fayet Kelen, pretended to order a collection crew to travel to a planet and bring back three hundred acid slugs.

name: Yatir
summary: The Yatir were a humanoid, sentient species. They were native to the planet Absit, located in the south-western portion of the Outer Rim. During the Galactic Civil War, the Yatir were sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The Galactic Empire became aware of that sympathy and tried to suppress the humanoids, initially without full success. Ultimately, the Hell's Hammers, under the command of Colonel "Rancor" Johans, traveled to Absit and finally subjugated the Yatir. Shortly after that battle, Johans was promoted to High Colonel.

name: Ycaqt
summary: A ycaqt was a large reptilian herd animal native to the planet Velmor. Strong, stubborn and fast for their size, ycaqt mainly survived on a diet of plankton, using their massive maws to gather and filter up to 20 kilograms of water at a time. Despite their imposing stature, ycaqt had a generally peaceful temperament, and preferred to run away from predators unless cornered. Ycaqt were important parts of Velmor's culture and tradition, and were notably used for ceremonial festivals as well as for herding and sport activities.

name: Ychna
summary: Ychna were massive, bioengineered, space slug-like creatures that had mouths over eighty meters wide. Long enough to coil around an orbital city, ychna were used during the Yuuzhan Vong War by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species to mainly assault space stations and other orbital structures. One ychna was deployed in 26 ABY over the planet Duro, where it practically ate the orbital city of Orr-Om. In the last year of the war, another was part of an attack on Caluula Station.
length: Long enough to coil around an orbital city
distinctions: Body resembling a massive space slug

name: Ychthytonian
summary: The Ychthytonians were a sentient species of four-armed beings native to the Ychthyton system. They were part of the galactic community by 0 ABY and were part of the New Republic by 14 ABY. One notable Ychthytonian was the bartender Bômlas, who worked in the asteroid belt Smuggler's Run, a hideout for hundreds of smugglers.

name: Yeat
summary: Yeat were quadrupedal omnivores from Mutanda that impaled prey on their horns. Originally peaceful grazers, they evolved into vicious hunters on Mutanda. They were the fastest animals on Mutanda and their ability to quickly change direction by long leaps gave them great advantages when hunting prey. They had four limbs, with thick black and brown hair. The yeat's body was short and sturdy and allowed for great speed. The family unit consisted of a mated pair, with an occasional litter of three to four new pups.

name: Yellow-bellied sand lizard
summary: The yellow-bellied sand lizard was a small non-sentient reptilian species originating from an unknown homeworld, though their name and behavior suggest they adapted to desert climates. An adult yellow-bellied sand lizard could be trained to perform several complex tasks. When the Nu-Cosian storyteller, Bobbajo visited the Reestkii settlement on Jakku, he exhibited a pair of yellow-bellied sand lizards, whom he had trained himself. They leaped from his sleeves and reared themselves onto their hind legs, whereupon they puffed their chests and swayed in rhythmic unison. On his command, the pair scuttled back to the cages and released a pair of zhhee, which they proceeded to mount.

name: Yellow-tailed summerbird
summary: Yellow-tailed summerbirds were found on Coruscant, including near the Senate Rotunda.

name: Yellowtail ibbot hawk
summary: The yellowtail ibbot hawk was one of the sixty-eight species of ibbot bird native to the planet Drall. While most ibbot species fed on algae, the yellowtail ibbot hawk was carnivorous. As with every ibbot species, the yellowtail was evolved to fill a particular niche in Drall's ecosystem.

name: Yeomet
summary: Yeomets were small, disease-carrying omnivores which infested numerous urban worlds, space stations, and spaceships.

name: Yerdua poison-spitter
summary: The Yerdua poison-spitter blurred the distinction between animal, plant, and fungus. Its trunk was green and the flowering body was usually red and white. The "flower" consisted of four thick "petals" with a poison-shooting organ in the center. Although its roots were firmly planted, the Yerdua could maneuver its vine like trunk and flower with speeds usually associated with animals. It was considered semi-sentient. It could identify threats in its environment, aim, and release poison globules within seconds. If a predator got too close, the pedals would contract together, protecting the sensitive central organs. The Jungle Felucian natives were able to train the plants to guard their villages and trade routes from the native predators, and other enemies. In return, the Felucians fed the Yerdua meat, and kept the plants free of parasites. It is likely that the Yerdua's Poison was used by the Felucians for various purposes as well.

name: Yesula's species
summary: The child Yesula and her father were members of a sentient species. At some point no earlier than 227 BBY, multiple members of the species were present on the astronomical object Veek when the home of Yesula and her father caught fire. They were rescued by Jedi Master Kelnacca and his Padawan, Yarzion Vell. Once they escaped, Vell returned to the building to save their droid, Zeekay, whose databank had holos of Yesula's deceased mother.

name: Yevetha
summary: The Yevetha were a lithe, skeletal species indigenous to N'zoth in the Koornacht Cluster in the Core Worlds, known for their xenophobia and death-centered culture.
distinctions: Retractable dew claws, six fingers (one thumb), six toes

name: Yimi
summary: The Yimi were a species of sentient, diminutive humanoids with large skulls that were indigenous to the world of Kathol. They were created by the DarkStryder and contained large brains which were flash-printed with necessary skills. The species was created to be extremely loyal to their creator. Despite their complex brains, they were unable to learn new skills that were not flash-printed. It was believed that the Yimi were crafted by DarkStryder to be twisted versions of the ancient Kathol themselves, as a cruel joke on its own creators.

name: Yinchorri
summary: Yinchorri were a reptilian sentient species. They possessed broad, rounded snouts and unlike other reptilian species such as the Trandoshan and Saurin, had smooth scaleless skin. Jodak, a pilot for the Riftwalkers, was a Yinchorri.

name: Yista bug
summary: Yista bugs were a type of insect capable of burrowing under a being's skin and incrementally causing illness. In 22 BBY, Jedi Master Sember Vey likened the effects of the dark side of the Force to a yista bug infection.

name: Ylesian white worm
summary: Ylesian white worms were a species of worm that lived in mud and were native to the planet Ylesia. They were white in color and relatively lengthy in size. Members of the Hutt species enjoyed eating them.

name: Ylvan
summary: The Ylvan were a sentient species of humanoids. Their skin was reddish-brown and they featured large ears. Tallin was a member of the species. Around 0 BBY, Tallin visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina located in the city of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine and witnessed a shootout between the bounty hunter Purong and the Ariwook Rff Huff.

name: Ylvrin
summary: Ylvrins were creatures that chirped to each other to communicate. The creatures could be found on the rainforest moon Felne 6. While on Felne 6 in 228 BBY, Jedi Knights Burryaga Agaburry and Bell Zettifar walked through the moon's forest, with the former noticing when they entered a relatively quiet area of the woodland that had no ylvrins chirping to each other.

name: Yobcrab
summary: The yobcrab was an aquatic creature with a hard outer shell. Yobcrab legs could be eaten as food, though the shell had to be removed beforehand. Finn attempted to eat a yobcrab leg at the fiftieth birthday of Nifera Shu.

name: Yobshrimp
summary: Yobshrimp were a species of tiny creature native to the planet Naboo. They were eaten by the seven species of scalefish found in Lake Paonga and in the Naboo Abyss. Tiny yobshrimp lived in the gills of tee scalefish, and were then licked out and eaten by laa scalefish. On the planet Batuu, fishing families cultivated the foreign yobshrimp for consumption, and Yobshrimp Noodle Salad was a dish available at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

name: Yoda's species
summary: The species to which the Jedi Grand Master Yoda belonged was ancient and shrouded in mystery. Members of this species were rarely seen anywhere in the galaxy. The few members of this species seen in the galaxy were all Force-sensitive, and the species' homeworld and name were unknown.
distinctions: Long ears, three-fingered hands and three toes on the feet

name: Yokaa
summary: The Yokaa were a sentient serpentlike species. They possessed tri-lensed eyes with multi-spectral vision. Kalo'ne was a Yokaa who drove a DN-25 treadable on the planet Pasaana, her species' vision allowing her skills to remain sharp.

name: Yootak
summary: A Yootak was a dangerous predator on Endor and Ewok hunting prey. It had green fur and two long arms. On its hands were three long fingers with long and sharp claws. Its mouth was full of razor-sharp teeth.

name: Yozusk
summary: Yozusks were creatures native to Dromund Kaas. They were territorial beasts with rocky protrusions on their back. When the first Sith arrived on Dromund Kaas, they referred to the yozusks as "rock wardens". They were still predominant by the time of the Cold War.

name: Yrashu
summary: The Yrashu were technologically primitive sapient beings indigenous to Baskarn. They were large baldheaded primates with green fur covering their bodies, and at first sight appeared intimidating.

name: Ysalamiri
summary: Ysalamiri were lizard-like tree-dwellers about 50 centimeters in length native to the planet Myrkr, most known for their ability to repel the Force by creating a Force-neutral bubble. This ability evolved in response to predation by the Force-sensitive vornskrs. Many ysalamiri grouped together would expand their Force-neutral bubble by varying distances—sometimes by kilometers.
distinctions: Ability to repel the Force and block detection by it.

name: Ysanna
summary: The Ysanna were a humanoid race who resided in the wastelands of the planet Ossus. They wore tribal masks and depended on the native kirruk, residing in the nitrogen-rich valleys near the Eocho Mountains. Farming was their main source of food, though hunting with concussion bows became increasingly useful. The Ysanna possessed a level of sensitivity in the Force, able to influence the projectiles of their concussion bows and feeling a duty to protect Ossus's Jedi ruins. The shamans of the Ysanna were known as storm shepherds, and learned to predict the planet's lightning storms. The race spoke the Ysannan language. According to the legendary Qel-Droma Epics, the Ysanna were once the human Jedi survivors of the Cron Supernova, which devastated Ossus. The non-human survivors supposedly died out, and the remaining Jedi were forced to band together to survive the devastated wastelands of the planet.

name: Ystervark
summary: The ystervark was a giant creature with defensive plating and toxic spines. It was viewed as a worthy foe and a revered delicacy by the sentient Thisspiasians of the planet Thisspias. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the creatures were extinct and considered ancient, but their brutality left a lasting impact on Thisspias and for centuries engineers sought to replicate their plating and quills. Xenoarchaeologists even theorized that the planet's Blood Monarchy grew from ritual ystervark hunts. Ancient Thisspiasian warrior-sages created weapons in the beasts' image and for 250 years poisoned ystervark spears were the Thisspiasian Royal Guard's most iconic weapon. As the public influence of the Blood Monarch fell among the population, so to did that of the ystervark, although they were still well respected. The call for ystervark weapons diminished, and before the rise of the Galactic Empire, the only one to retain its mass appeal was the quillbomb, an explosive using synthetic venom based on the ystervark's toxic quills which was capable of impairing motor function with a single quill and causing excruciating pain with any further. During the Galactic Civil War, Thisspiasian royalists loyal to the monarchy wore ystervark quills both as a sign of their loyalty and as makeshift weapons, with the use of the quillbombs also becoming a symbol of resistance against the Empire.

name: Y'tras
summary: The Y'tras was one of the five races of Shatras. The most common race, Y'tras, composed the 87% of the Shatras population. They were technologically advanced and commonly traveled through spacelanes, having colonies in different worlds. The Y'tras knew of the Hy'tras race living in Klypash. After a vast, centuries-long war that made the Hy'tras reject technology, the Y'tras made a deal with them: Leaving the Hy'tras alone in exchange of their riches. Both parties respected the agreement.

name: Yubal
summary: Yubals were pack animals that were domesticated by the Chiss on the planet Celwis. The family of rancher Xodlak'phr'ooa had a herd of yubals, and could lure them using lure sticks, and herd them using growzers. According to the young Chiss girl Lakris, yubals were some of the dumbest things on four legs. However, the Agbui youngling Frosif insisted that she had seen dumber animals trained to do actual tricks.

name: Yubesho rat
summary: Yubesho rats were a type of rat found on the moon Toshara. Living mostly underground, the rats were mostly blind, but had a heightened sense of smell that could lead them to food at impressive distances, and they were known to chew through wood and even metal to get to it. They were considered to be pests, with their population in the city Mirogana at least ten times that of sentient beings.

name: Yunu
summary: The Yunu were a large, furred, sentient species native to Arkinnea. They lived in the planet's forests, and allied with the Jedi refugees led by Jedi Master K'Kruhk, helping them establish a secret temple there. They seemed to have been aware of the Jedi for a very long time, able to recognize the group as Jedi and kneel down in respect after Sidirri had killed the Arkinnea Militia with her force power and know the location of an abandoned temple and even recognized it being owned by the Jedi. Master Zao noted they possessed stories of the Jedi and still looked upon them with respect and fondness.

name: Yuuzhan Vong
summary: The Yuuzhan Vong—"Children of Yun-Yuuzhan", also called the Chosen Race, known to the Chiss and Ferroans as the Far Outsiders, and sometimes incorrectly abbreviated to Vong (which implied that one was disowned by their family and their gods)—were a nomadic extra-galactic sentient species that nearly destroyed the New Republic, and were responsible for the deaths of over 300 trillion sentient beings during their invasion of the galaxy. The Yuuzhan Vong were descended from an ancestral species from the planet Yuuzhan'tar in a distant galaxy. A typical Yuuzhan Vong resembled a Human in form, though they were taller and heavier than the average Human and had less hair on their heads. The Yuuzhan Vong were religious zealots, who viewed mechanical technology as blasphemy. Their technological innovations were genetically engineered and purely organic. Additionally, the Yuuzhan Vong deeply respected pain to the point of sadomasochism and strove to improve their physical capabilities through organ grafting. Such grafting was a status symbol within Yuuzhan Vong society. Perhaps most notably, the Yuuzhan Vong were unable to be sensed through the Force. This confounded the Jedi who first encountered the Yuuzhan Vong. However, they were susceptible to some Force based attacks.

name: Yuvernian
summary: Yuvernians were a two-headed sentient species from the Yuvern system, they each had two spot-covered heads sitting atop a long neck. Cane Adiss, a member of Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire, was a male Yuvernian.

name: Yuzzem
summary: The Yuzzem were large, heavy, furred humanoids with long snouts and large black eyes. Their homeworld was the forested planet Ragna III. They were quite strong and temperamental. They fought fiercely, and their large size made them hard to subdue. Yuzzem also adhered to strict codes of honor and debt-fulfillment. Because of their strength and intelligence, many scientists believed the Yuzzem to be distant relatives of the Wookiees.

name: Yuzzum
summary: Yuzzums were a sentient species native to the Forest Moon of Endor. A Yuzzum named Joh Yowza occasionally sang with the Max Rebo Band, while another known as Wam Lufba worked as an exterminator.

name: Yvarema
summary: The Yvarema were bipedal sapients indigenous to Yvara. The Yvarema were an example of a non-insectoid hive-mind species. Consisted of several different classes, they were ruled by the Majjvara, and each was totally dependent on the other.

name: Zaba wolf
summary: The zaba wolf was a type of legendary wolf on the world Andraven. The Andraven inhabitants once befriended the zaba wolves with kao reed flutes, also using them as mounts. By 232 BBY, however, none of the wolves had been spotted for a number of years. During the Andraven Gumar Adraki's Ancestors Circuit, a zaba wolf appeared and pursued Adraki and his friends—the Jedi Initiates Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs. The Jedi distracted the wolf while Andraki fashioned a flute from a kao reed. Using the flute, Andraki befriended the wolf, which carried him to the end of the circuit.

name: Zabrak
summary: Zabraks were a near-human carnivorous species native to the planets Iridonia and Dathomir. Most members of the species had distinctive horns atop their heads, as well as two hearts. Although most Zabraks lived on Iridonia, some settled on the planet Dathomir, where the females of the species, known as Nightsisters, ruled over the Nightbrother males and practiced powerful dark side magick. Notably, female Dathomirian Zabraks had paler skin and lacked the cranial horns shared by the rest of the species. Zabraks fought against the Galactic Empire's attempts to undermine and subvert them, and instead of surrendering, many joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Zabraks were considered to be proud, self-determined, and even arrogant to some, and they were one of the most independent species in the galaxy.
distinctions: Vestigial horns, two hearts, facial tattoos

name: Zakkeg
summary: Zakkegs were a species of creature known for being crafty and stubborn. The mercenary Saponza compared the Tusken Raider known as the Jundland General to a zakkeg after discovering that he had several heavily fortified bases. Associates of the smuggler Liana Kor described her as being as "stubborn as a zakkeg, and twice as mean."

name: Zakool
summary: A Zakool was a cat-like creature native to the forest moon of Endor. They appeared to be carnivorous but were not known to attack the Ewoks who lived on the moon. Zakools had dark fur and sharp claws which allowed them to scale trees to an extent. During the return of the Raich, the creature used its special ability to control animals, to turn a Zakool against the young Ewoks, Teebo and Latara. Luckily, the Raich was eventually defeated by Wicket Wystri Warrick, and the Zakool left the scene, uninterested in the small prey.

name: Zalaaca
summary: Zalaacas were swift, intelligent, and fierce omnivores native to the Gungan swamps of Naboo.

name: Zalorian rock-lion
summary: The Zalorian rock-lion, also known as the rock-lion, was a species native to the planet Zaloriis. The rock-lions' habitat was in the mountain range known as the Fantain Mountains, among the boulders which provided shelter from the planet's strong winds. Basilisk war droids were alternatively described as resembling an armored rock-lion or a cross between a rock-lion and a Karran beetle. In 19 BBY, following the death of the Jedi Knight Etain Tur-Mukan, the Jedi Master Kina Ha compared the duty of the Jedi to that of a rock-lion at a gate, ready to give their life in the protection of other beings.

name: Zambarti
summary: The Zambarti were lavender-hued humanoids with wide bodies and huge heads. Their eyes were shaped like saucers, and their hair resembled a slate-colored bird's nest. Their large ears were pink in coloration, and looked like wings. Members of this species had more than one heart. Big Bunji was a member of this species.

name: Zandor Rocker
summary: The Zandor Rockers were a species of sentient beings who looked like rocks with legs and faces. By hiding on the ground, legs retracted, eyes and mouth closed, they could pass for mundane stones. The Rockers could run quickly on their legs or burrow rapidly through the ground. Zandor Rockers lived on the Forest Moon of Endor in the land for which they were named. At one point, an Ogre named Gantu began raiding their territory for sunnydew flowers. Without the plants' nectar to sustain them, Zandor's flora died out and left the region barren. When two Ewoks ventured into Zandor in 3 ABY searching for the Ogre, the Rockers aided them in finding and fighting the raider. Their efforts helped chase off Gantu and restore the land to fertility.

name: Zanibar
summary: The Zanibar were a cannibalistic sentient species native to the planet Xo.

name: Zardimallo
summary: The zardimallo was a rare species of non-sentient quadrupedal lizard. They had had green skin and could roll up into a ball. The species was highly valued and therefore sought by many factions. Shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire, renegade Clone Force 99 was hired by Cid to retrieve an individual of the species, whom squad member Omega named "Ruby." The squad intercepted the lizard from the Rhokai gang, who had stolen it from an unknown source. The squad successfully delivered her to Cid's Parlor on Ord Mantell to be given to her client, though Cid did not know what it would be used for.

name: Zarian
summary: The Zarian were a species of short amphibious humanoids from the planet Zaria in the Zaria system. Although they remained free on Zaria, they were still under the control of the aristocratic Ancient Houses. The con artist Woetar was a member of this species, as was Alliance to Restore the Republic member Arvee. They were toadlike beings with wide heads, bulbous lips, webbed digits, and brown, slimy, thick, scaly, mottled skin covered in bumpy warts. Due to their slimy skin and small stature, they were hard to get a hold on. They had powerful legs and were capable of leaping great distances, along with natural regenerative abilities. Their coloring could serve as camouflage in some environments. They usually moved by scuttling quadrupedally, and moved slower when they held objects in their hands. Their lungs were sensitive to inhaling too much dust. The average Zarian stood 1.2 meters tall.

name: Zarracine
summary: A sentient species, the Zarracines hailed from the planet Zarracina III. In 11,660 BBY, the Pius Dea–controlled Galactic Republic attempted to gain control of the planet, with the Zarracines resisting the efforts. Ultimately, Republic Commodore Daymont Praji ordered the orbital bombardment of the world that rendered the species nearly extinct. The surviving Zarracines became nomads in space and harbored a millennia-long hatred for the Republic and House Praji. Many Zarracines later joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and, during the Clone Wars, five Zarracine terrorists unsuccessfully attempted to board the repulsorlimo of First Minister Tannon Praji of the Coruscant Ministry of Ingress.

name: Zaur
summary: Zaur were a species of lizard native to the planet Bogano. They had a low stance and an adhesive grip, allowing them to travel quickly across many types of surface, including cavern walls. They thrived in rocky and windy habitats, and their sensitivity to climate meant that they functioned better in colder temperatures than warmer ones.

name: Zdrinbagh
summary: Zdrinbaghs were shelled creatures native to several worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. They were prized for their light and tender meat. Zdrinbaghs had razor sharp teeth, a thick hide, four legs, and four claws.

name: Zedrahl
summary: The Zedrahls were a species of sentient, reptilian Humanoids. Their skin was covered in scales. The species was in a major nuclear conflict amongst themselves caused by Arglos, a fanatical, religious leader who sought to eliminate all life on their planet.

name: Zeer
summary: The Zeer were a species of giraffe-like, non-sentient creatures.
distinctions: Tall. Two swiveling horns on head, similar to that of a dwarf bantha

name: Zeetsa
summary: Zeetsa were a small spherical species with short arms and legs native to the planet Ord Cestus. Zeetsas had leathery skin. They came in at least blue and gray, but possibly other colors. The height of one particular Zeetsa was described as "knee-high," placing them at around .25 to .5 meters tall. Their skin changed colors or turned splotchy in times of heightened excitement or anxiety. Guntar and Shar Shar were Zeetsas. Zeetsas were an important part of Cestian society in ancient days. The X'Ting would feed them and receive a food known as Lifemilk in return. Eventually, the Zeetsa developed sentience, and some of them chose to join general Cestian society, though others did not, preferring a quieter, simpler existence. Interestingly, these creatures were able to shape-shift somewhat, assuming and mimicking the facial features of others at will. While they retained their size and spherical shape, they were able to alter their typically hidden eyes, nose, and mouth to mimic someone else, as Obi-Wan Kenobi found out. Also, they could apparently defy gravity to a limited extent, and their preferred method of transportation was bouncing or rolling.

name: Zeffliffl
summary: The Zeffliffl were intelligent, seaweed-like aliens native to the planet of Zeffliffl, in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Living in tight-knit groups, the species had a subconscious connection with its group members, which rejected any outsiders. A group of Zeffliffl traveled to Crseih Research Station in pursuit of healing for a sick groupmate.

name: Zeffonian
summary: {{Update|Star Wars: Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple, Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order, The High Republic Adventures — The Monster of Temple Peak 2, }} The Zeffonians, or Zeffo for short, were an ancient sentient species native to the planet Zeffo. Many Zeffonians could wield the Force, which they referred to as the "Life Wind," and those who did became known as sages. Originating as a peaceful civilization, over time they became more and more corrupt, eventually falling to the dark side of the Force. Facing extinction, the remnants of the Zeffonians fled into the Unknown Regions of the galaxy, what they called the great unknown, in hopes of finally finding peace.
distinctions: Specific shape of the frontal lobe of the skull and absence of a nasal septum and nostrils

name: Zeftgeist
summary: A zeftgeist was a creature that ate grain. In 232 BBY, the Dalnan Honesty Weft expressed his frustration about having to accompany a Dalnan delegation to the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon so the Outer Rim planet Dalna could join the Republic. In response, his father—Ambassador Weft—told him to appreciate the opportunity to witness history and compared him to a spoiled zeftgeist fat from too much grain.

name: ZeHethbra
summary: The ZeHethbra were furry, anthropomorphic sentients with vestigial tail, claws and fangs. They possessed an acute sense of smell that they could use to detect their fellow ZeHethbra's pheromones and thus gather information about them. They could secrete a natural biochemical spray to blind and stun foes in a fight, although other ZeHethbra were immune to its effects. ZeHethbra were moody and bad-tempered, and valued honesty and social status. As they were aggressive and strong, they commonly found employment in security forces, military organizations, or related fields, such as bounty hunting. The ZeHethbra evolved on the Mid Rim world of ZeHeth, joining the Galactic Republic millennia before the rise of the Galactic Empire. The species founded settlements on several planets, giving rise to autonomous ZeHethbra cultural groups. While trying to establish a colony on Malastare, they waged a war against the Dugs.
hairColor: White streak; brown; red; white-blue; sometimes mottled; black

name: Zekodoan
summary: Zekodoan was a sentient species in the galaxy. Mycho Zala was a member of the species.

name: Zeldrate
summary: The zeldrate was a reptilian predator that lived on the green plains of Balmorra. It fed mainly on the giant grazers known as bormu, attacking those that roamed too far from their herds. Unlike their herbivorous counterpart, the zeldrates were small in number because of the Balmorran industries that hunted the reptiles for a caustic chemical secretion used as a cleaning solution for multiple industrial parts. During the Cold War, Imperial forces bombarded the surface of Balmorra, consequently destroying its industries. This led to both a decrease in the number of bormus, due to the contamination of the fields, and an increase of zeldrates, as the industries started operating below half capacity. With these variations, zeldrates fed on fewer bormus, forcing the predators to begin looking for new prey. They targeted sentient beings such as Imperial troops and resistance fighters, preying mostly on those who were wounded during battle. During this same period, a population of zeldrates could also be found on the plains of Dantooine.

name: Zele
summary: A zele was a slender, lop-horned herd animal that was native to the planet Dagro. The farmers of the planet managed to domesticate zeles for use as pack animals.

name: Zelosian
summary: Zelosians were sentient plants native to the planet Zelos II.

name: Zelrey wyrm
summary: Zelry wyrms were a species of creature that could served live as food. During a competition to determine the next sous chef of the pirate Maz Kanata's castle on the planet Takodana, the chef Jom Jarusch prepared a spicy living zelrey wyrm while crawling around the castle's kitchen to dodge stun blasts meant to test the contestant's abilities to cook under stressful conditions. The chef used instructions from the recipe book of the castles previous sous chef Robbs Ely, which Jarusch had stolen shortly prior to Ely's murder. The Artiodac head chef Strono Tuggs considered live zelrey wyrm to be an ambitious and daring dish to attempt, but believed Jarusch had executed on it perfectly.

name: Zeltron
summary: Zeltrons were a humanoid sentient species whose skin varied in shades of red. Whenever a Zeltron became angry, their skin turned a deeper red. Ric Farazi was a Zeltron journalist during the High Republic Era. Later in the High Republic Era, the Zeltron Klias Teradine was a Jedi Padawan on the planet Alaris Prime. A Zeltron boy served as a youngling in the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic's reign and often sparred with the human youngling Caleb Dume. Lorica Demaris, who joined the Resistance, was a female Zeltron. Allegedly, the Zeltrons gave off pheromones that made people like them and had a calming effect. Although Demaris was unsure of the veracity of that belief, she did manage to calm down an angry Gigoran by petting her. At any rate, due to their unique nature, Zeltrons experienced amplified versions of the feelings of those around them, especially those they cared about. On their very first day of grade school, young Zeltrons were taught that they should not let themselves be led around by their emotions.

name: Zemerin
summary: Zemerin were a species of telepaths that fed on negative energy. A group of Zemerin visited the world Enujut and caused negativity between its residents in order to feed, but their plans were foiled by local peacekeeper Evor Haris and a protocol droid that had discovered the truth behind their arrival.

name: Zenezian
summary: Zenezians were a sentient species. The musician Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins was a Zenezian, as was Sudswater Dillifay Glon. It was considered a major insult to refuse a musical instrument from a Zenezian.

name: Zeolosian
summary: The Zeolosians were a sentient species from the Zeolosia system in the Mid Rim.

name: Zess-fly
summary: Zess-flies were a type of fly. When the Death Star superweapon's Docking Bay 327 was locked down in 1 BBY, it caused a swarm of multicolored indicators representing traffic control for hangars 250 to 350 to crawl like zess-flies on a screen that Commander Pamel Poul was watching in the Death Star's Station Control West.

name: Zeuol
summary: The Zeuols were a species of sentient, pale-faced beings recognizable for their large, solid-black eyes and coarse, off-white hair. At least one member of the species ventured into the galaxy at large, and at the end of the Clone Wars, the Mid Rim world of Ord Zeuol was homeworld to a female Zeuol named Eeusu Estornii who worked as a senator for the Galactic Republic. Estornii attended the funeral of Padmé Amidala, senator and former queen of the planet Naboo, in 19 BBY.

name: Zexx
summary: Zexx were a gray-skinned species, featuring cone-like heads and long tusks. They were aggressive and unintelligent. It is possible they were related to the Esoomians. They were indigenous to Prazhi in the Expansion Region. Zexx were often found acting as pirates or mercenaries for Hutt crime lords. Individuals of the race included Fnnbu. The Zexx tusks were strong and sharp enough to cut through living tissue. Their culture attached much importance to concepts of ownership and property, and they reacted violently to "borrowing" objects without permission.

name: Zhell
summary: The Zhell were a historical sentient species of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. The species was believed to be the origin for the name of Zhellday, a day in the standard week. The species shared its name with the Taung & Zhell Society, a student group at the University of Coruscant, and the Zhell Reversal card game.

name: Zhhee
summary: Zhhee were a non-sentient species of winged lizards. They sported bright colors and had a noisy, mischievous, and obstreperous behavior. Bobbajo, a Nu-Cosian nickamed the "Crittermonger," owned a mated pair of zhhee.

name: Zilka
summary: The Zilka were a sentient buglike species. They possessed four legs and were armored. Two Zilka enforcers encountered the undercover Jedi Master Mace Windu on the planet Metagos.

name: Zilkin
summary: Zilkins were a diminutive humanoid sentient species whose members had spotted green skin and stood at an average of roughly 0.33 meters in height. Colonel Meebur Gascon, a native of Great Zilk, who served on Republic Strategic Command during the Clone Wars was a member of this species, as was Fasca Tiradé, a member of the Resistance during the First Order-Resistance War. On the planet Kamil, a member of the species specialized in selling robas.

name: Zillo Beast
summary: The Zillo Beast, sometimes referred to simply as "the Zillo," was a non-sentient, reptilian species endemic to the planet Malastare. The Dugs believed this gargantuan creature to be extinct long before 21 BBY; during the Battle of Malastare, however, the seemingly last specimen alive was inadvertently unearthed by an electro-proton bomb used by the Galactic Republic. Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine sought to use the Zillo Beasts' indestructible hide to aid the Grand Army of the Republic. Shortly after the creature was brought to Coruscant for study, however, it broke free from its restraints and rampaged through the capital. In the end, the Jedi and Republic army were left with no other choice but to kill the Zillo Beast using a powerful toxin, the same one that had compelled it to ravage Coruscant, but in larger doses. After the creature was killed, Palpatine ordered it to be cloned. All cloning attempts failed until after the formation of the Galactic Empire and the appropriation of Kaminoan cloning technology, when doctor Royce Hemlock finally succeeded in achieving a breakthrough and successfully cloning several beasts which were transported and contained in the Tantiss Base inside Mount Tantiss. One Zillo Beast lived in Wild Space where it was worshiped as a god by the Benathy, though it was later killed by Kylo Ren, Master of the Knights of Ren and a warlord in the First Order.

name: Zinchorian
summary: The Zinchorians were a sentient species that originated from a world with a methane-rich atmosphere in the Zinchori system. Sage Kinzem was a member of this species.

name: Zixon
summary: The Zixon were a sentient species native to the planet Minfar. They were shorter than humans, covered in short and thick green fur, and had long pointed ears, a snout, and long-clawed hands. According to Glenna Kip's intelligence, the Zixon lived almost exclusively underground and were named after the squeaking noises made on first contact with outsiders.

name: Zizimaak
summary: The Zizimaak were a species of sentient insectoid avians that were indigenous to the world of Kathol. They were genetically created by the DarkStryder to serve as scouts. The race eventually escaped and formed their own society. The Zizimaak despised their creator, the DarkStryder, and developed a friendly alliance with the Charr Ontee and the Yapi though they fed on them and the Segmi. Unlike the other genetically made servants of the Kathol or DarkStryder, the Zizimaak had no connection with the mystical Ta-Ree life energy that existed on the homeworld of the Kathol. They aided the FarStar crew and helped fight against Imperial Moff Kentor Sarne.

name: Zoa'mon
summary: The Zoa'mon were a sentient species. According to the play Evocar, which was written by the Hutt playwright Direus'pei between 920 BBY and 671 BBY, the Zoa'mon were driven to extinction by the Tionese warlord Xim during his conquests of the Tion Cluster that occurred between 25,130 and 25,100 BBY. In the play, Xim is captured and placed on trial by the Hutt Empire. During the trial, Xim justified the extinction of the Zoa'mon and other species by arguing that they were all slavers. However according to The Despotica, a collection of literary works about Xim and his conquests, Direus'pei bypassed accepted history and chronology while writing Evocar in order to use Xim and other famous figures as a political screed to excoriated the Hutts' continued subjugation of the Evocii, a species native to the planet Nal Hutta.

name: Zobberan hound
summary: The zobberan hound was a species of eight-limbed creatures. While not known for their intelligence, they were known to be extremely loyal and obedient once trained. They were native to the Zobbera system.

name: Zolander
summary: Zolanders were the native species of Zolan. They were adapted to the extreme cold of the planet. As their sun's radioactive emissions increased, the Zolanders created a skin-altering gene, inadvertently creating a genetic offshoot of the Zolanders, the Clawdite. After the formation of the New Republic, the Zolan Civil War broke out between the two species, and the Zolanders became dominated by the Clawdite, whom they previously treated as a lesser species.

name: Zomba
summary: A zomba was a forest creature on the moon of Endor. It was apparently carnivorous and would eat anything that wandered into its territory. Zombas appeared to run and chase prey using only their hind legs. Their front legs would then be extended in front of them as they tried to grasp their fleeing target. The Ewok Teebo crafted a zomba costume for use in his first Shadow Night Festival. The costume was so authentic that he was able to trick his friends Wicket Wystri Warrick and Latara into believing that he was a real zomba, chasing them through the forest for a time. Teebo would use the costume once more to sneak into the Raich's cave during the temporary return of the Raich.

name: Zongorlu
summary: The Zongorlu were a sentient species from the Outer Rim Territories planet Zongorlu. They were large, slow-moving plants. During the Mandalorian Wars, when the Galactic Republic was transmitting from Zongorlu propaganda targeting the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, the broadcasts made various false claims about the planet's inhabitants—according to the propaganda, the Zongorlu had a society organized into warrior-tribes and had withdrawn to their homeworld after the Mandalorians had destroyed Zongorlu youngling vacation camps during their attack on the planet Serroco. When a Neo-Crusader force later arrived on Zongorlu, the warriors encountered the native aliens, discovering the truth about them.

name: Zoolli
summary: The Zoolli were a sentient humanoid species, distinguished from Humans by their longer noses. Judge Arabelle Lorteli was a Zoolli member of the Galactic Alliance judiciary. She was personally appointed by Chief of State Natasi Daala to the Court of Jedi Affairs; however, the Chief of State later publicly removed her from that post after allegations that the Zoolli had been mind tricked by members of the Jedi Order.

name: Zronta grazer
summary: Zronta grazers were non-sentient herbivores that were native to the planet Pii III. The species had a mild temperament.

name: Zucca
summary: Zucca were a type of creature. They could be eaten as food, and were served to Jabba the Hutt to celebrate the return of his cousin Crakka.

name: Zucca boar
summary: The zucca boar or zucca pig was a large pig species native to the planet Tatooine. A muscular beast, it was slightly larger than the average womp rat, but not nearly as dexterous. Although the creature was herbivorous, it had thick skin and dangerous tusks. Nevertheless, the animal was often considered as as an example of easy prey.

name: Zugorak
summary: A zugorak, also known as an apexathor, was a creature native to the ice planet Jekara. They had purple and gray skin, tentacles, and multiple sets of teeth. In 3 ABY, the bounty hunter Dengar was attacked by a zugorak but was saved by the assassin Deathstick.

name: Zuxu
summary: The zuxu was a creature native to the planet Ganlihk, along with the ludos and the ryless.

name: Zuzabol
summary: The Zuzabol were a sentient bipedal species shorter in height than humans. The Zuzabol Avga Rosene and another member of the species worked as a fueling crew for the Resistance in the year 34 ABY. Both were present in the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar shortly before the Battle of Starkiller Base.

name: Zybahhod Yenyoni
summary: The Zybahhod Yenyoni was a sentient species originating in the Outer Rim Territories' Zybahhod system. They were well-adapted for life in deserts, having special salt glands that removed sodium from the brackish water they drank. The Zybahhod Yenyoni played a music instrument known as udjudg and, at some point, tribes of the species settled on the planet Tatooine.

name: Zygerrian
summary: The Zygerrians were a humanoid feline species from Zygerria. Having evolved from a horned sentient canine species, they built a powerful empire by capturing and selling slaves until the Jedi of the Galactic Republic went to war with them and outlawed it. The Zygerrians openly revived their slave trade when they allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

name: Zygerrian precursor species
summary: A sentient precursor species with canine features and horns served as the predecessor to the Zygerrian species.

name: Zylurian
summary: Zylurians were a sentient humanoid species with blueish skin, long hanging nostrils and three fingers. The crew of the ZZ-class freighter Mingula consisted of four Zylurians who were all killed by a swarm of Ubuugan fleshborers. The bounty hunter Boba Fett discovered the corpses when he searched the freighter for valuables.

name: Zymod
summary: Zymods were a type of color-changing reptile native to the jungle moon Ajan Kloss. They had poisonous tongues and webbed feet that let them climb almost anything. The Resistance base established on Ajan Kloss in 34 ABY suffered a small infestation of zymods, and in 35 ABY, the Jedi-in-training Rey had to dodge the flick of one's tongue while on the base's training course.
